dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan nga/'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog nga/ zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum/ gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin da rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lag par sel nang da sī tshogs ring lags / mi gnyi dang pho ri bsdu〉 ri kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'byur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma/ nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe/ skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib la jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su chud pa'i ba'i yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bu la bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (ngo/da // 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga nga/ zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad snyelas ba rtsams chos ches ma/nga zhing / bod kyi ches srid rig gnas thad snyel mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen ngo/ gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig /spang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha chang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes nga/'i dpe/ tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang chugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du la jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gcug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar re/sa gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig ge las ga'i brgyud rim cha chang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu chad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad snyel chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad kur stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag sgo nas thugs rje che zhu'o//krung go'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009la'i zla 8par/

ste/sprang ba/shā//rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'jam gling go la chen ngo/'i spyi gcug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig /ler/ pha spel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong bcan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kye sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mchar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri sring snyeX btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar bcugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gco bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mjad de/ shes rig mjed brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mjad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad /ce cag /sna bus tshe gang nga la ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yu la gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgya la /lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs nga/ sder nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de /sna bu'i rtsa che'i rigs ga zhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yang rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las kur gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ka khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla bshu pa'i tshes 7la/3

bsdo/ sgrig ga tha 95 nga'i skad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mjad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mjad pa dang/ yang sgos mjad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa sde/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs 5 thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang bcal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe bcal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gcug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 200((nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/ bod ljongs dpe/ mdzod khang sogs rig dngos chan nga/ /spag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khrag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang /legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe/ deb nyis brgyar snye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i /bongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum ngo/da nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mjad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gcug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de ba blon dugs po mnga' ris grwa chang gi gsung 'bum 'o/spyol par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos chan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka) (kha) (gnakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ((nas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam ngo/da gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la ( ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11nga/ snyel pod rtags (nya) sde rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum nga/ dang bzhi pa/ dpon sgrub paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon nge/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa/ rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags (1)sde zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13nga/ la po da rtags (tha)sde bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos chan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa /pa pod rtags rtod)sde dam can chas srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs ma/chod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos chan bcu bdun/ deb /)5pa la pod rtags smyon)sde lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags khong na/ sde phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong /lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)sde 3du pa ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)sde bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (5) (chen ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhedas rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dzen ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgya la mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos chan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos chan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)sde bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang /brag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)sde tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kye nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)sde rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28nga/ gsung nang ma khong)ste /le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po rta la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la kheng gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ta cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su snyel spri mang cam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'chal zhu /lhag par du rnam dpyod dang thon pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na/ (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/(kyi

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / chog phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mchams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'gyung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'jin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong bde la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul me nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad kur ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal ba rtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib la jug khang dang / pho brang po tā snyel 'a rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu 'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang /lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15 pa/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mchan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mchan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa ca rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa 'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lco kha 'phyangs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod chul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu rbe'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mjad pa dang / chos skyong /bag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'a tu gel bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mchan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra chang nga/ chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis chul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mjad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams nga/ smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo cer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa snyel gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 4)

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khrag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mjad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab sgo|ga brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa ngo/da nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa g.yin don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho pobs phyogs sgrig khang nas/

dkar chagazab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig ga ba'i chu rgyun las glegs bam ga sdo/34 pa/ (1)'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gnam lcags gi66) skor/ (14)pad gnubs dbang gi brgyud par bka' gter gnyis kyi skor/ (27)yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri phung po ri bo che nas sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i skor/ (33)bal mon sogs kyi gter kha sprul pa'i gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i gter chos kyi skor/ (44)gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i gshin rje khros pa'i thugs sgrub kyi skor/ (56)sprul sku rgya'i gter byon gtad rul skyes bu zangs gling gi gter ma dang 'dra ba'i brgyud pa'i skor/ 468)gangs bar phug mo che nas rgya ston padma dbang phyug gis spyan drangs pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i skor/ (80)gter ston snye mo rgya gong ri pa sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis gter du bzhes pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgub kyi chos skor/ (93)gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas kyis mtsho maṇḍal nag po nas spyan drangs pa'i bde ba can gyi 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i skor/ (128)

gter ston dung mtsho ras pas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa'i skor/ (162)sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos spyan drangs pa'i rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub bam rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs kyi skor/ (187)rtsa rlung zab lam gsang 'khrid bde stong rgya mtsho zhes rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi yum bka'i skor/ 4211)rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung dpal mgon legs ldan nag po stag gzhon lcags khrab can gyi skor sogs/ (243)sprul sku dam pa dmar pos sba gro bcal gyi brag nas spyan drangs pa'i bdud rtsi chen po'i bcud len skor/ (272)rta mgrin padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag rnams kyi skor/ (275)shar gter sprul sku pad ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas ston pa'i gter chos khrag gi skor/ (289)lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas gdan drangs pa'i sman rtag tu ngu dang 'brel ba'i sman gyi skor/ (345)yang rje tse/ rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa'i pad ma bka' thang sogs bka' thang sde lnga'i skor/ (350)sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams zab cing rgya che ba'i skor/ (376)gter ston rdo rje gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/ (405)2

gter ston pad ma kun skyong gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gis sne snar/ (424)gter ston chos rgyal ratna gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/ (433)sprul pa'i gter ston zhig po gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/ (470)sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/ (490)gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs skor/ (509)gter ston chen po padma gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos sna tshogs kyi skor/ (523)

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnar༅༅/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i sdom sbyo/na las glegs bam ga rna/ma pa bzhugs rbesto/ /༄7/ /gsol 'debs las/ gnubs ban skye sprul dum pa rgya zhad khrom/ /dra nga rdo rje kun grags rgya phur bu/ /lha rje gnubs chung rgya ston seng ge dar/ /gnyags ston lha 'bar zhes rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i nang tshan dum pa rgya'i gter ni/ gnubs kyi bka' shog rgya bo che las/rgya gar mkhas pa bi mā mi tra dang / /o rgyan mkhas pa padma 'byung gnas dang / /bal po'i mkhas pa bha su dha ra dang / /bod kyi mkhas pa dzñā na ku mā ras/ /bdag la gnang ba'i man ngag 'di rnams yin/ zhes rgya bod kyi mkhas pa du ma'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod brtol nas gdams ngag rgya mtsho chen po la dbang sgyur ba'i gnubs kyi bande sangs rgyas ye shes ni slob dpon padmas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du rje 'bangs dgu smin par mdzad pa'i tshe lho 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor du bka' babs/ sgrags kyi yang rdzong du 'jam dpal gshin rje dngos su 'grub/ brag la phur pa 'dam ltar btab/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dam la 'dogs pa (2na)sogs mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mngal skyes zhig la ltos pa'i 'gran zla dang bral ba yin zhing / slob dpon des sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas dang rgya gar mkhas pa bzhi la gsan pa'i zab chos bka' gter gnyis su bzhugs pa'i gter ma rnams spyan 'dren pa po ni/ zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag las/ de dus bskal ba'i mtha' ma la:nga min nga yi cha byad can sha ni ser la skra ni li: bongs ni thung la g.yas ni dkar: g.yon ni dmar ba'i sha mtshan can: so ni dkar la so tshags dam sme ba'i ga sha yod pa yi: lo ni khyi 'brug lo pa la:— —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/rus rgya ming ni zhang khrom zhes: de lta bu yis rnyed par shog: ces gnubs chen gyi smon lam mdzad pa bzhin rang gter spyan 'dren pa la bsams bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa dum pa rgya zhang khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar du grags pas spyan drangs pa'i gter kha rnams yin la/ gter gnas kyang phung po ri bo che'i gter byang las/ g.yung gi phu yi rdza lhud nag po la dam chos bka' (2ba)rtags dum skur bcas pa gtad:g.yas ru nyug gi rdo rje sgrom bu phu dbang rtags rdo rje'i bka' ru bcas pa sbas: g.yas ru gtsang 'khris phung ngo ri bo cher: dbang rtags bse sgrom smug por bcas pa sbas: skal ldan las 'phro can la kha byang bris te bzhag lan cig rnyed nas mi spel yid la rnogs: dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'byung nges kyi:zhes dang / zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag las kyang: spyir yang gter kha brgyad cu sbas gtsang gi phung po ri bo che: rgya yi mon mo'i gtsug rum: nyug gi rdo rje sgrom bu: gtsang 'gram mchod rten skyer ma bzhi/ de bzhi thon la bstan pa srungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gtsang gi phung po ri bo che: nyug gi rdo rje sgrom bu g.yung gi rdza lhud mo/ gtsang 'gram skyer ma/ gzhan yang spra dun rtse mkho mthing lha khang / bsam yas mchims phu sogs nas byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde dang khyad par bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa'i gtso bor gyur ba ni dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i skor rnams yin la/ de yang bka' shog rgya bo che las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung bar bya ba dang / /dkon cog dbu 'phang bstod par bya ba'i phyir/ /las kyi 'brel ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /dad pa che ba legs pa'i sgron ma dang / grogs mchod dam pa ye shes dbang phyug dang / /rtsol shugs gtong phod che ba'i blon rje 'phags pa bzhi/ /dam tshig dam pa snying la 'jog pa 'dra nas su/ /dam chos gzhung bzhin bka' la brten te lo bdun bar du bshad/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mang yul lan bdun btang / /drag sngags chos 'di bstan par mi 'os kyang //(3na)tshangs pa'i yang gter gzhung las 'di ltar gda'/ /skyes bu blo rtsal brtan zhing dad pa mos pa dang /lus dang srog kyang mi 'phang gtong phod na/ /de dang 'brel bar 'dod na drag sngags bshad/ /ces —2

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogana'abyung bas/ de phyir bdag gis yon tan rgya mtsho la/ sgrub lugs mi mthun brgya dang rtsa bdun gtad de bzhag /ces pa ltar tshe bdag gi skor rang gi rigs kyi sras gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho la gnang ste/ de nas rim gyis brgyud pa'i bka' ma yang yod la/ khyad par dbang chu'i brgyud pa bka' gter gnyis ka nas brgyud pa khyad med du 'dren pa yin zhing / de yang bka' 'byed las/ phyi skor lcags 'dra'i skor dang gcig nang skor thog 'dra'i skor dang gnyis: gnam lcags thog ma'i skor dang gsum: zhes lcagasasdig la skor gsum du gsungs par ma zad bha su dha ra'i spyi gcod 'phrul gyi lde mig las 'dri lugs rnam pa gsum ni lcags 'dra ba'i lugs: thog 'dra ba'i lugs: gnam thog chen po'i lugs: zhes lcags 'dra la yang skor gsum du gsungs pa'i gnam thog chen po'i skor la yang / pad lugs dang gnubs lugs gnyis su yod pa'i thog mar lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis ma'i smin byed kyi dbang la/ pad lugs kyi dbang gzhung smin byed dbang gi sgron ma dang / bam chen gsang ba rab 'byams kyi dbang gnubs lugs dbang chog mu tig phreng ba sogs rnam grangs mang du yod na'ang la stod se brgya mkhar ba se ston chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan la brgyud pa de dag dang khu lung pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' ma sogs dbang rgyun ma lus pa yongs su mnga' ba'i dbang gi chu bo gcig tu 'dres par bzhugs shing /gsung las kyang / (3ba)dgongs rgyud mngon phyung dngos grub nyer bsdus pa/ smin byed dbang gi sgron ma padma'i gzhung / dpang du nye bzhag 'khrul med phyag len gyis/ legs par brgyan byas nges don bde'ajug bkod/ ces gsungs pa'i don ltar pad lugs dpang por bzhag bla ma'i phyag len gyis brgyan cing gzhubs lugs nas zhal 'phang dgos rnams 'phangs/ kha 'geng dgos rlams bskangs te/ dbang chog nges don bde 'jug la byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po'i phyag len gyis legs par brgyan te ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ji skad du/ bde chen ye shes sku dang mchog gi bam/ /mtshan ldan gzung ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhes pa ltar gtso bor bgrod pa rnam pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang phra mor phye na phyi dri ma 'khrud par byed pa las bum la brten pa'i dbang / nang nus pa 'jog par byed —3—

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/pa rnam bum la brten pa'i ye shes lnga'i dbang / sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang / gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa sngags kyi dbang / thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang /yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gdug pa zil gnon dpa' bo'i chas/ bar gcod zhi ba rdo rje'i tshe/ gsang ba skal ba ster zhing dngos grub thob par byed pa bam gyi dbang / 'phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa sbyor sgrol gyi dbang / khams gsum yongs su sgrol ba drag po zor gyi dbang / mngon spyod las kun 'grub pa da khri'i dbang / chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang /rtsa dang thig le'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bde ba chen po bskyed pa'i dbang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bcu drug dga' bzhi rdzogs pa'i dbang / rang byung ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rig rtsal ye (4na/zhes lnga rdzogs kyi dbang rnams lan gnyis smin rgyas su legs par nos nas/ lung la lcags 'dra/ ༷/rmo lcags sdig dang gsum/ dang po la pad gnubs gnyis las/ /dang po la pad lugs kyi skor la/ dpal gshin rje gshed 'byul 'khor nag po sdig pa snying 'dzings gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa bal po'i slob dpon bha su dha ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches bsgyur ba/ rgyud 'di lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis ka la yod cing byang pa rigs 'dzin gyi gsan yig tu gnubs 'u/gas lcags 'drar yod pas gnubs 'u/gas kyi lcags 'drar yang mi gtogs pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang man ngag rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa sgron ma drug pa sogs kyang rtsa ba'i khungs rgyud 'di la brten pa'i phyir gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te pad lugs kyi thog mar bzhag pa yin no/ /drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud dam ma tshang ba kha skong ba snying po don gyi gsang rgyud bsam gtan lha yul du grags pa le'u bdun pa 'bri gung lugs la lcags sdig gi chos sder mdzad pa mi 'gal te rtsa rgyud dang kha skong gi rgyud gnyis po lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis ga'i rtsa bar 'gro zhing / se ston chen po'i gsan yig na pad lugs su yod pas 'di yang de ltar du bkod do/ / bal po'i slob dpon nor 'dzin dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ sdig pa snying 'dzings rtsa ba'i man ngag gu ru padmas mdzad pa gnubs chung —4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnasangs rgyas ye shes kyi khyad chos rong gi g.yung phu'i pha bong g.yu sga mor gter du sbas pa rgya ston rdo rje 'od 'bar gyis spyan drangs pa/ sgron ma drug gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag gi gnad bsdus pa rin po che'i 'od 'phro phag ston shākya mgon pos mdzad pa/ rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi don bsdus man ngag (4ba)rtsa ba la 'grel ba'i tshul du lag len gsal bar ston pa man ngag gsal byed sgron ma'am sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi man ngag sgron ma drug pa ces bya ba brag ltag pa rdo rje rin cen gyis mdzad pa/ sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa yang gsang rang gshed nag po sgron ma drug pa las ri rab kyi rtse la gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba gsang ba las kyi mtshon cha bzhi'i nang tshan mthar thug mchod rten nag po'i dril sgrub gsang ba yang gsang rno ngar du bsdebs pa mchod rten gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma se ston chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi zhal gdams gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba snying nang gi khrag lta bu rdo rje 'chang zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa/drag sngags las kyi sdeb yig sgrub pa drag po'i bzla lugs gnyis las snga mar ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog smug nag dang phyi mar rtsa ba'i lha rnams gsal 'debs lugs sogs sbas tig 'di gnubs lugs kyi sbas tig dang mi gcig pas 'dir bkod kyi pad gnubs gang du gtogs slar yang phyogs 'dir tshad mar gyur pa'i sngags 'tsho byung na dpyad do/ /nag po snying 'dzings kyi man ngag shin tu zab pa/ las thams cad pa'i 'khor lo'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba sbyor ba rdzas kyi khyad par/ bsnyen sgrub drag sngags kyi khyad par/ mjug sdud las kyi khyad par dang gsum gyis bstan pa'i zab khyad can/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag gter brgyud kyi gsol 'debs chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa kun khyab ye shes ma/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang brgya mkhar ba se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ zil gnon las byang gi sngon 'gro kha skong gi so sdeb dang bcas pa chos rgyal ma bla'i mtshan can gyi ljags (5na)bsgrigs/ se ston las byang gi zur 'debs sgom don ngag tu blang bde ba'i ched du rnam nges rin cen sgron me'i gsung rgyun tshigs bcad du byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen pos bsdebs pa/ snying 'dzings —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negater srung gi mchod pa 'gyur med ma dang / kha skong spyan 'dren rigs 'dzin pad 'byung ma dang bcas pa/ zil gnon mngon rtogs rgyun khyer se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i drag sngags cog brdung du grags pa/ tshe bdag nag po'i rgyun khyer gtor 'bul bstod pa bzlas pa bkra shis smon lam dang bcas pa tshang ba'i sgrub thabs zab bsdus sngags 'chang legs ldan rdo rje'i zab bzhes/ bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par nges pa rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba brgya mkhar ba se ston chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ khro bo phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bam chen gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i lag len rdo rje'i las rim gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phyag len ji lta ba g.yung gi rdza lhud mo nas rgya zhang khrom gyis gdan drangs pa/ brgya mkhar ba se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga nges pa'i don bde blag tu la jug pa/ dgongs rgyud chen mo las phyung ba'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg /dbang gi sbyin sreg /drag po'i sbyin sreg /las kyi mtha' rgyas sreg pa me'i sbyor ba slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa sgrags kyi gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyi khyad chos pha bong g.yu sla mo nas rgya rdo rje 'od 'bar gyis gdan drangs pa/ rten mkhar brtseg pa/ dmag bzlog pa/ gsal shing 'dzugs pa/ rgya bre ba/ drod tshad bya ra/ 'grul srang (5bskotod pa/ bla rdo/ phra ma/ za lam/ lha 'dre'i pho brang gdab pa/ dbang po bzhag pa/ dgra zin g.yul bskrad pa/ dmag zas byin pa/ sgrib shing gzugs pa rnams ston pa'i man ngag gser thur/ phyi nang gi sgrub pa 'grub ma 'grub kyi skyon dang / za kha ma khrel ba/ longs spyod chung zhing 'khru ldog che na spang blang gi man ngag /dngos nyams rmi lam gyi ngan ltas bzang ltas/ khri lan 'khon nag cha bzhir bgos te/ ltas ngan dngos grub tu blang ba'i zab gnad sngags nag rnams kyi gces nor/ zhe sngang thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba khyad par gyi gdams pa tshe bdag tsakra kā rta' man ngag zab mo/ tshe bdag nag po'i thun gyi dmigs pa dgu ma rus sbal snying gzer nag po'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa nas phyung ba/ bar gcod bgegs kyi sbyor ba myur mgyogs kyi pho nyas bzlog —66

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)cing gzhom pa thun rdzas mda' ltar 'phen pa drag po zor gyi las/ zor gyi bkra rtags ston pa rus sbal snying gzer nag po'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa nas phyung ba/ de dang 'dra min gcig /phyag rgya zil gnon gyi u lta ṣa la brten pa'i phyir bzlog /ngan sngags kyi bcud phyung ba rdo rje gnam lcags gi'u sgo mu stegs kha 'bar nag po'i rgyud la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba lha sngags la dpags na man nga gzur pa zhig tu yid gnyis dang gter ston kyang gsal bar ma byung rung / da lta rgya zhang gi gter mar ngos 'dzin zhing tshe bdag las phran du mdzad pa ni las phran gyi rigs la mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas min zhes gya tshom du smra bar mi rigs mod slar yang gnubs ban zab chos la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa rnams kyis dpyad par mdzod cig /dus rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pas sbyor ba bzhi par grags pa tshangs pa rlung gnon du gter du sbas pa (6na)de'i zhal gdams lag len man ngag snying gi yi ge /yang bzlog gze ma chu spar ba nag po/ gong gi lag len bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris pa rnams/ lo zla zhag za ma'i skag bzlog /dgra bo longs spyod dang bral ba/ dmag dpung gzhes pa'i sbyor ba/ mkhar dang dbral ba/ nyi klung gud pa gso ba'i sbyor ba/ dang gud 'pho ba'i sbyor ba/ ltas ngan dbab pa'i sbyor ba/ yul khams 'phung ba'i sbyor ba/ rtags gso ba'i sbyor ba rnams so/ /de yang lcags 'dra'i chos sde la them byang sogs med pas chos kyi mtha' chod pa dka' mod/'on kyang lcags 'dra pad lugs su grags pa ni padma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag pa la de dang rjes 'brel gyi yig sna rnams la ngos 'dzin la mjug gi las phran rnams man ngag rtsa ba las 'phros pa'i nges pa bka' yang mdzad pa po sogs dang bstun chos sder mdzad cing / pad lugs tshe bdag gi skor 'di cung zad nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan de dus rgyal khrims gnyan pas mngon spyod la rag ma lus par gnubs kyis slob dpon chen po la gshed skor gyi mtha' rgya gcod pa ma byung bas so/ /gnyis pa gnubs lugs kyi skor la/ rgya zhang khrom nya mo lha khang du byon pas rnal 'byor pa dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus sogs gter byung bsdus pa phung po ri bo che'i gter byung rgyas pa/ zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud dam rdo rje'i thog 'bebs sku'i rgyud le'u dgu pa —7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shelha yul du grags pa bal po'i slob dpon bha su dha ra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis ba ra sa ru mkha' 'gro dang bka' bgros te bsgyur ba/ dpal tshe bdag nag po'i rgyud drag (6ba)sngags kyi de kho na srog dmar len gyi spu gri zhes bya ba le'u bcu gnyis pa/ sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi don spyi sa cod 'phrul gyi lde mig sgron ma gsal ba'i spra 'khrid ces bya ba lam 'di nyams su len pa la med du mi rung ba'i gdams pa zab mo bal po bha su dha ras mdzad pa/ zil gnon sgrub khog chen po'i tshe bdag kha thun nag po'i skor gyi gtsug lag dpal dge'i ngan sngags yang mdzod ces pa legs ldan zhabs dang chos rgyal ma sgo'i mtshan can gyi gsan yig na zhib par 'dug pa dang 'di gnyis zhus dag pher ba lta bu la gnam lcags so bdor dang mthing gi bya ra dgram pa gnyis ngos 'dzin mi mthun pa tsam 'dug /legs ldan rje dang byang pa rigs 'dzin gyi lcags 'dra gnubs lugs gsan yig na sgrub khog chen po'i rtsa ba zhes 'di bgrangs 'dug pas sgrub khog rtsa ba dang kha thun yang mdzod gnyis gcig gam 'dra min yin dang phan tshun 'phrul shes pa sogs gang yin dpyad ma bzod/ 'di kha thun yang mdzod yin na brgyad pa lcags sdig dang gcig cing dpe ris rnams lcags 'dra la bltos dgos pa gsan yig na 'dug go /rtsa ba ngan sngags snying la sdig pa nag po 〈co 'dzings dril sgrub gsang ba las kyang gsang ba bstan du med pa rgya gar mkhas pa gtsug lag dpal dges ngan sngags su phyung ba yang mdzod kyi gdams pa shin tu gsang ba rdo rje nang 'gras sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings pa 'jam dpal dril sgrub gsang ba bstan du med pa'i zhal 'khrid gsang ba'i mig phyung yang gsang sgron ma bu ddha dzña na'i man ngag /'khor lo lto bshags nag po'i zhal 'khrid bu ddha dzña na'i gdams pa/ dpal gshin rje'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba phyi mchod rten la brten pa'i yang gsang snying po don gyi sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po khrag 'thung nag po'i zhal gdams/ sdig pa nag po snying (7na)'dzings las yang gsang spra 'khrid sgron ma 'bri gung pa'i phyag dper 'di skor lcags sdig tu ngesabazung 'dug pa da lta lcags 'dra'i khongs su som nyi med par ngos 'dzin yang gsang sngags zab mo'i gnad gsang 'di rtogs par dka' bas da dung mkhas pa 'dra dang phrad na dri bsdur bya'o/ /gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba yang gsang du bsdebs pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po khrag 'thung zhabs kyi zhal gdams/ mchod rten lag tu blang —8

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaba'i spra 'khrid sgron ma/ gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten gyi thig gdab lus rgyud dang bha su dha ra'i phyag bzhes bzhin gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten la bstod cing lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskul ba chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang ma slob dpon bha su dha ras mdzad pa/ 'khor lo'i gdams pa spu 'khrid gsang ba gtsug lag dpal dges bal yul yam bu'i dgon par gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ba/ gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i gdams pa sgron ma spra 'khrid nang nas rang gshed gsad pa'i snying thun sgron ma mnan pa'i las drag sngags kyi rgyal po yang gsang bcud gcig pa'i man ngag srog gi 'khor lo/ sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzings drag po dbang sdud kyi man ngag /lha srin ming srog 'phrog pa'i ting nge 'dzin sngags par ngag gshed 'bebs pa'i gshed ma/ rang gshed sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi ngag kyi 'bru bshad thems yig /phye ring drag po sngags kyi 'bru 'grel sngags pa ru tra nag po'i gshed ma yang mdzod kyi gdams pa/ stong srog 'khor lo nag po drag sngags kyi yang snying dril ba stobs chen nus pa dbral zhing (7ba) bshig pa/ gu ru gtsug lag dpal dges gnubs la gnang ba'i yang mdzad gdams pa sngags thems/ lus so spu gri gsum la brten pas stong srog gcig tu bsdebs 'di med na yungs kar spang la gtor ba dang 'dra bar gsungs/ pa'i zhal 'khrid g.yas ru rdo rje sgron bu nyug gi brag nas rgyas spyan drangs pa/ drag sngags rnam par bshad pa'i 'grel pa sngags don gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ lha sgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya rin po che gsal ba'i sgron ma/ bha su dha ras gnubs la gtad pa/ mchod bstod gsal 'jam dpal rdzus skyes zhes pa slob dpon chen por ngos 'dzin na lcags 'drar gtogs sam snyam par dpyad/ ba'i sgron me zhar byung yum gyi bskul dang bcas pa/ bsrung ba bsam gtan stong srog gi 'khor lo'i bri brgyud bsrung bzlog gnyis kyi mthar thug gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rgya gar du lan gsum byon te grub thob gsum la zhus nas phyi ma bsam yas mchims phu'i brag la sbas pa rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa/ dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub thabs gnubs kyi las rim gsal sgron du grags pa/ gshin rje tshe —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/bdag nag po'i bam gyi bkang ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa phung po ri bo che nas rgya zhang khrom gyis gdan drangs pa/ gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas rgyal po kun skyong yan chad du zhal gyi gdams par gnas pa las gtsug lag dpal dges yi ge bkod pa/ phyi bum pa la brten nas nad gdon dag par byed pa'i khrus/ nang bsam gtan la brten nas sdig sgrib dag pa'i khrus/ chos nyid kyi khrus la brten nas stong pa'i go cha bla na med pa/ 'byung ba bzhi las la bko pa ba'i mtshon cha zla gsang nag po'i nang nas zab pa'i mthar (8na)thug rnal 'byor pa nyal yang dgra 'chi bar nges pa/ byad dang ngag 'grol ba gser gyi lde mig bum bcas dang byad 'grol ba'i lag len ston pa'i rtsa ba/ bum bcas phan yon bsrung ba 'dri thabs rmi ltas lo rgyus mngon rtogs rnam pa ston pa slob dpon khrag 'thung nag pos rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang nas gter bton te gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ba g.yung gi rdza lhud mo nas rgyas spyan drangs pa/ byad 'grol gser gyi :she mig gi mngon rtogs dang mjug tu 'don rgyu'i dmod bcol/ byad 'grol ba'i 'khor lo'i gzungs ring / byad 'grol gyi lag len cho ga'i bya thabs byad 'grol kun gyi bcud phyung ba khrigs bsdebs lag len kun tshang mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa/ rigs gsum mgon po la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bsrung ba zab mo/ rigs gsum mgon po la brten pa'i bsrung 'khor 'dri thabs/ glang dmar gyi bzlog pa/ tshe bdag 'chi bdag srog bdag gsum gyi za yig bskyed chog rdzong chen ma/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog pa'i log gnon zab rgya can kun tshang brag nas rgyas spyan drangs pa/ gtor nag la brten pa'i urmo nang gcod kyi phyir bzlog drag po'i sngags/'jam dpal gyi drag sngags thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa mtshan brjod las rdo rje ral gri ma lus gcod ces pa la brten nas slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ zas lha sprul pa gsum dbang du bsdu pa'i man ngag /gshin rje'i gtad khram bcu gnyis kyis khram la gtad pa/ sgron gsal gyi bar gcod nyams len ma lnga yang bzlog ces pa myul le skrod pa/ gnam thog (8ba)chen po'i lugs — /0—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)srol min pa'i ma hā yo ga dang mthun pa'i las byang / lhan skyes gnam lcags 'bar ba'i snying po 'brog nag sangs rgyas rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rnams dpe ris skor la/ mun smag steng 'og 'khor lo/ zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu gcag pa/ de dang 'dra min gcig /gnam lcags so brdar mchog phag /gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i steng 'og 'khor lo/ mchog phag gsang sgrub stong srog 'khor lo/ btsad po/ slob ma dam nyams/ dam tshig gcig pa'i sngags pa/ spyi'i sbun/ bon po/ urmo mkhan gsod pa'i ling ga drug /gtad bzlog dril sgrub/ ngag gnon du nan lnga pa mchod rten gyi 'og tu gnon pa'i dpe dang bcas pa/ gtad bzlog klu bdud lto 'khor/ rus sbal gyi lto bar bris pa'i bsrung ba phyag rgya bsam gtan/ lus la 'dogs pa'i bsrung 'khor/ gsad pa gnam lcags u rme sbal sdig ma/ ma nyes par dgra langs na seng ge'i lto bar gsad pa/ btsad por seng ge kha 'thab/ ma mo mkhan la shwa na lce 'thab/ gshin rje mkhan la khya mo gshog 'thab/ slob ma la rdo rje mar 'thab/ gtad mkhan la sprul nag lte 'thab/ bya khyung mkhan la rma bya mjing bsnol/ sngags par rus sbal lto sdeb/ drag sngags mkhan la stag mo kha 'thab/ dge 'dun gyi sde la glang chen mche 'thab/ bon dang mu stegs la rkang mgyogs bzlog pa/ drag sngags mkhan la thog 'khor/ rus sbal snying 'phrog rus sbal bsnol ma/ steng du lding ba'i rus sbal lto 'khor/ rnon po nang gcod tsakra kirti/ 'byung bzhi las bcol 'khor lo/ gnam lcags so brdar 'brub khung / gsang ba tsitta'i 'brub (9nasgo gyang / bsnal bzlog dkrug pa'i 'brub khung pho nya rkang mgyogs bzlog pa'i 'brub khung / tsitta dkrugs pa'i 'brub khung / stong srog 'brub khung / thod pa zhal dbye dang yum 'khor/ steng gcod nam mkha'i 'khor lo/ 'og 'degs rlung 'khor/ bya khyung so brdar/ gtad kyis dmigs sdig pa'i lus tshad/ sbyin sreg gi steng gcod/ sbyor ba'i 'khor lo/ gdan 'khor/ 'og 'dregs/ stegs pa'i rus sbal mchod rten gyi phyi nang / sgrub gtor/ mchod gtor/ gter bsrungs gtor ma/ bam bkang rnams so/ /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'adi tsam kho bos thos pa yin zhing gzhan yang zor gyi byung rabs rgyal ba sogs dang bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi yig sna mang ba zur kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs kyis gzigs pa dang ming gi rnam grangs gsan pa byung 'dug kyang chos rgyun ma rnyed mod/ gtso che ba'i dngos don gyi snying po ni ma tshang ba med do/ /de yang tshe bdag lcags sdig dang yang bzlog sogs la mkhas shing sgrub pa brnyes pa'i 'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas lcags 'dra'i don lcags sdig dang 'dra bas na lcags 'drar bshad pa'i sgrub byed dang 'dra ba'i phyogs dngos ma yin pas lcags 'dra mi zab par gsungs pa rni cung zad 'thad par ma sems shing / gsung la dpags na 'bri gung phyogs su lcags 'dra de tshe bdag pad lugs yin khul las mtha' chod par yod pa zhig ma mngon/ 'brug pa pad dkar gyi tshe bdag las byang du bka' brgyad ga'i zor dang shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong dkar sogs tshe bdag la yong don med pa mang po bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs nas bris pa'i rdza gcog sna tshogs 'dug par brten chos (9ba)rgyal ba bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis co 'bri'i tshul du dri ba mdzad pa'i lan du/ padmas mi mkhyen gnubs kyis shes smra min/ /dang po zab sbas phyi ma gsal bstan yin/ zhes pad lugs la zab mo rnams sbas pas mi zab pa dang gnubs lugs gsal bar bstan pas zab khul gsung pa'i don 'brug pa pad dkar gyi zhe 'dod la lcags 'dra dpe lugs dang / lcags sdig gnubs lugs su byas nas/ bka' 'byed du/ o rgyan padmas mdzad pa la: chos tshan sum cu rtsa brgyad yod: 'khor lo nyi shu rtsa bdun yod:shog ldebs gsum la tshang bar yod: sdig pa'i chos la bsgrig tu med thun mong bsrung mtshams tsam du 'gro: zhes pa de lcags 'dra pad lugs yin khul du bsams na'ang pad lugs ni man ngag rtsa ba la zer bas/ de la chos tshan sum cu rtsa brgyad med cing shog ldebs kyang gsum las mang bas bka' 'byed kyi nang du rigs 'dzin rnams kyis mdzad ces bgrangs ba de rnams lcags 'dra rang la phyi skor/lcags 'dra nang skor thog 'dra/ gsang skor gnam thog chen mo'i skor gsum du bshad pa'i phyi skor lcags 'dra'i chos tshan du gtogs na'ang / man ngag ci rtsa ba sogs dang gnubs lugs kyi lcags 'dra gong du — /2

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)smos pa rnams ni gnam thog chen mo'i skor shin tu zab pa ste/ rgyu mtshan bha su dha ras/ gzhal yas khang lhun grub/ lha lkog bzhengs/ sngags thug phrad yin tshul spyi gcod du gsal bar gsungs so/ /'brug sprul gyis lcags sdig las gzhan pa'i lcags 'dra'i gnubs lugs ye rtsad ma chod cing /bka' 'byed kyi tshig des 'khrul gzhi byas nas rje 'bri gung pa dang 'brug pa (10na)gnyis ka tshe bdag pad lugs mi zab cing lcags sdig zab par bzhed kyang gnam thog chen po'i lam srol gyi lcags 'dra'i pad gnubs gnyis ma'i skor dang / lcags sdig gi sgrub thabs che 'bring gnyis su rgyu dang rkyen las ma bskyed par lha bsgom pa sogs gnam thog chen po'i lam srol dang mthun la/ sgron ma drug gi 'khor lo sogs man ngag dngos bstan gang yod zab mnyam las lcags sdig la sger du lhag par med cing / lcags sdig zab par grags pa lcags 'dra lugs gnyis la med pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum lhan cig tu lag tu len pa sogs 'khor lo man ngag rnam grangs mang ba tsam gyis zab par grags pa yin/lcags sdig las byang ma hā yo ga ltar bsgoms pas lcags sdig thams cad gnam thog chen po'i lam srol yin min kyang dpyad dgos so/ /'bri 'brug gnyis gar gnubs lugs yin na lcags sdig yin pa las 'os med de 'dra ha cang thal ches par mngon te/ zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag las/ gnubs kyi ban chung sangs rgyas ngas:lo ni brgya dang sum cu lon: nyon mongs bod yul dbus su langs 'tsho ba'i zas rnams 'bangs kyis phral: rgya gar yul du lan bdun phyin: dkar chag gnubs yul rong du btab: rtsal chen rdo rje sgrom bur rdzogs: bla ma bcu gcig zhabs nas bteg: 'on kyang mkhas pa bzhi la gtugs: slob dpon dpal gyi seng ge dang : rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po dang : 'phung byed shinti garbha dang bal po bha su dha ra bzhi mkhas pa bzhi yi thugs brtol nas zab pa'i chos drug thugs la bcangs: (10ba)g.yin yang gdams ngag rtsis las 'das: zhes bshad ma thag pa'i mkhas pa bzhi'i man ngag rnams bod du gdan drangs pa'i nang tshan tshe bdag gi skor rnams lcags 'dra gnubs lugs las 'os med cing /— /3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nelcags 'dra zab pa'i mthar thug gnam thog chen po'i lam srol pad gnubs gnyis gar lam gyi gnad la khyad par med pa sa phyogs 'di la 'brul pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi mnga' ba'i brgya mkhar ba se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las/ de ltar tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon lam/ /padma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag la/ /pad lugs zhes grags gzhubs kyi yang mdzod 'di/ sgrub khog sor bzhag gnubs lugs zhes grags mod/ /lam gyi gnad la khyad par ci yang med/ 'on kyang 'phrin las byang bu'i brjed byang la/ /khyad par cung zad yod pa legs phye nas/ 'dir ni padma'i lugs nyid gsal bar byas/ /zhes pas kyang shes par nus la ha cang rgyas pa tshig mang bas ma spros so/ /'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gnam lcags urmo'i skor/gnyis pa 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gnam lcags yo skor ni mkhas pa la la dag nang skor thog 'dra'i skor yin zhes ngos 'dzin par mdzad pa gnam lcags kyi thog lta bus gang la yang thog thug med pa'i rgyu mas gyis thog 'drar sgra bshad du rung mod/ skor gsum du phye ba'i thog 'drar ngos 'dzin par mi rung ba 'dra ste/ rim pa gsum po la zab khyad yod la/ urmo'i skor 'di gnam thog chen po'i skor las kyang ches cher rno zhing myur bas so/ /spyir tshe bdag la rnon po nang gcod bsrung ba'i rna cha/ khro 'dus bzlog pa'i rna cha/ 'khrul 'khor rgyas sdeb sdebs kyi rna cha/ rlung nag 'khrug pa 'byed (11na)pa'i rna cha/ du ri kha mnan pa'i rna cha/ char ka nag po mdos kyi rna cha/ srog dmar len gsad pa'i rna cha/urmo ngan sngags kyi rna cha'am/ yang na khro 'dus bzlog pa'i rna cha/ urmo gsad pa'i rna cha/ char ka zor gyi rna cha/ king gang mnan pa'i rna cha/ kha thun thod pa'i rna cha/ 'khrul 'khor rgyas sdeb sdebs kyi rna cha/rlung nag 'byed pa'i rna cha/ sa 'tshol du ri gtad kyi rna cha brgyad du bshad pa'i gsad pa'am ngan sngags — /4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)kyi rna char yang ngos 'dzin pas lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis las logs su 'dren rigs sam snyam/gdams pa 'di lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis las thugs gtsigs che ba'i mnog chos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gnubs kyi gsung las/ yang snying thugs dam gsang ba 'di na la yod pa ma yin te: tsitta'i dkyil du gsang rgya thob: snod ldan chig brgyud ma gtogs pa: kun la spel na chos skyong 'khrug: ces bka' rgyas btab pa'i skor 'di la sātstsha dkar nag gi urmo dang gnam sa lto ba dkrug pa'i urmo gnyis gnam sa lto ba dkrug pa'i phan ni lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis dar mi gtogs pa'i zab khyad sna 'don ma yin la/ urmo sātstsha dkar nag ni byang lugs la gnam sa lto dkrug dang chos sde gcig tu mdzad/ 'bri gung lugs la mtshon cha las 'khor du ngos 'dzin so so'i rgyun gnyis ka thob pa sa 'dir yang bkod la/ gsang sgrub skor lcags sdig tu ngos 'dzin mi 'dzin ji ltar yang gnam sa lto dkrug lag tu len pa'i lhan thabs su med thabs med pa zhig ni 'dug go /las/ dang po ni/ drag sngags thams cad kyi nying khu/ srog gcod thams cad kyi spu gri/ bsrung ba thams cad kyi rgyal po/ zlog pa thams cad kyi mthar thug ngan sngags thams cad kyi lto dril/ gzhan (11ba)gyi ngan sbyor bshig pa la sogs pa'i man ngag gi mthar thug 'di la bcas dang bod bod gsad gsum gyi gnad la brten te byad ma mkhan po ngag mnan te rang gshed 'bebs pa tshe bdag nag po'i gsang sgrub ral gri ngar ma/ skye bo pho mo gsod na kha bsgyur dang g.yu sbyar bcu bzhi bstan pa tshe bdag nag po'i gsang sgrub/ gnyis pa ni rdo rje urmo gnam sa lto ba dkrug pa'i man ngag ban dgra de bsod nams chu bcad pa bzhin du song nas mi nor thams cad zad de sprad mthar srung ma bdud du babs nas 'chi ba'i man ngag rnams/ urmo gsang sgrub kyi su tsā ra la jug pa'i ling ga /gnam sa lto bar dkrug pa'i steng 'khor 'og 'khor gzhung gi dngos bstan dang mi 'dra ba'i zab khyad chos rgyal ma bla'i mtshan can gyi phyag bzhes ma rnams so/ /gsum pa 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i skor ni/ bka' 'byed du phyi skor nang skor gsang skor te gsum du gsungs pa'i gnam thog gi skor yin la/ de dag ni ji skad du/ban chung bdag gis bod du 'ongs: sgrags kyi grong khyer bdun cu gtan la phab: yig sna 'di nyid bal — /5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/yul yam bu'i tshal du skyel snyam ste: na so'i dbang gis yongs ma 'khyol: gnam lcags gi sna'i chos skor 'di: ma li skor rnams lhud mo'i rdza la sbas bu yi skor rnams rdo rje sgrom bur sbas ban chung nga 'dra gcig la smon lam btab: de nas zhad khrom nyid kyis thon: zhes pa ltar ma bu gnyis su byas te gter du sbas pa sprul sku zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa yin pas de'i chos sde'i bzhugs tshul ni/ dregs pa phyag na rdo rje yis: ting 'dzin nyid kyis rab (12na)dgongs nas: lcags sdig lus kyi phyi nang la:dpe dang brda yis mtshon pas ni: gnam lcags chos sde tshang bar 'dug: ting nge 'dzin gyi sdig pa bshags: rigs 'dzin rnams kyi don slad du: chu dar sngon pa'i logs dag la: rin cen gser gyi yi ger btab: 'dod chags ko bse'i sdig pa bcos: lus dbyibs mgo dang rwa dang bcas: yan lag mjug ma gnyer ma dang : don snod bu ga dgu rnams la so sor rang rang chos sde bcas: bse sdig khro chu'i sgrom du bcug: dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du sbas zhes gsungs pa'i dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi chos sde phung byed shinti garbhas bton te rim gyis brgyud nas gnubs la bka' babs pa ltar dkar chag tu btab pa'i bzhugs tshul bzhin 'god pa la lcags sdig khams lnga'i 'od mdangs las byung ba'i smin byed dbang gi cho ga mu tig 'phreng ba/ 'di la 'chi bdag bcu gnyis kyi lha dbang gi zur rgyan dgos pa byang pa rigs 'dzin gyi phyag dper yod cing kho bos kyang nges don bde 'jug kha 'geng skabs sgo ma bzhi yan chad bskangs ba thob pa yin/ 'bri gung gi phyag dper sgrol ging zhag gshed kyi dbang sogs 'dug pa ni rgyas pa'i lugs shig yin shas che yang gter gzhung du yod med mtha' ma chod/ mchu'i rtse mo las sdig pa nag po'i gsang ba'i skye rgyud/ lus po mthing nag gru gsum las rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzings le'u bco lnga pa/ drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi rgyud dam snying po don gyi gsang rgyud bsam gtan lha yul du grags pa ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud le'u bdun pa bal yul gyi slob dpon ba su dha ra dang bod kyi (12ba〉so tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin gyi lcags sdig gi gsan yig tu yang mi 'dug cing lcags 'drar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ mgo bo sdi/ ga༄/ma las — 16

dam pa 'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganasgrub thabs snying gzer nag po zhes pa dkyil 'khor bzheng zhing 'jam bsnyen las sbyor dang bcas pa bstan pa/ snying gzer nag po las sbyor gyi lag len gnas rdzas mchod rten 'brub khung / tsitta sngags phan yon te don bdun gyi sgo nas bstan pa bca' gzhi rgyas pa'i spra 'khrid/ brdung ba'i rwa gnyis las phyi phye ring bsnol ma/ nang bzlog pa/ gsang ba dkrug pa/ yang gsang dmar len 'bru bshags spel mar bzla thabs urmo gyang 'gyel las gzhi/ bsnol mar bzlas pa'i rtags dang bzlog dkrug 'bru bshags bya ba'i dus bstan pa man ngag ( 'i sbra)rtags rim/ nang rgyal sdig pa snying ('i bri ) 'dzings zhes pa sgom pa lha/ rten 'brel rdzas/ drag po sngags/ 'khor lo bca' ba'i rim pa ste bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa drag po mye rings lag tu blang bya lag len dmar 'khrid sgron ma/ rtsa rgyan gyi lha dang he ru ka rigs lnga'i sgom thabs/ 'dzab gyi 'phro 'du/ bskyed rdzogs chos sku'i lam khyer/ rgyas gdab gsum/ gzhom pa gsum/ rtsa rgyan gyi lha bsgom thabs/ bdud bzhi slong ba/ stong srog sgos srog gsang sngags kyi thems/bsnol dkrug bzlog bshags kyi dmigs rim/ gnas gsum du rigs gsum mgon po bsgom pa'i dmigs rim rnams/ gong gi bsgom thabs nas 'dra min 'gor sgom pa'i gnad du gsal zhes yod pa'i snying po bsdus ( 'i bri na pa tshe bdag gi las rnams rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ phyi gye ring bsnal mar bzlas pas stong nyid bsrung ba'i dra gur gzhom pa (13na)nang gye thung bzlog ste bzlas pas gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor bshig pa/ gsang ba phye ring dkrugs te bzlas pas dug gsum bdud bzhi gshed 'bebs/yang gsang dmar len 'bru bshags kyis 'byung ba'i stobs bshig nas gsad pa rnams bstan pa gyang 'gyel gyi zhib cha'i zhal ('i bri ) gdams shin tu zab pa/ bsrung ba phyag rgya bsam gtan la brten nas rang lus btsan po'i mkhar du gzhug pa/ bshig pa gnod sbyin mdze thod la brten nas dam nyams ru tra'i sbyor ba bshig pa/ mnan pa dug sprul rwa can la brten nas ngag gi nus pa mnan pa/ gsang ba mdze dmar lhog bshags la brten nas dam nyams dra tra gsad pa dang bzhi/ blta ba'i mig gnyis las bka' 'byed gser gyi lde mig /rgyab stod gnyer ma gsum po las mda' thod sku la brten pa'i bsnyen — 17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)sgrub las sbyor gyi zhal gdams che 'bring chung gsum/ smad kyi gnyer ma gsum po las tshe bdag nag po'i 'phrin las chen mo dbang sgrub zor las sogs dang 'brel ba/ 'phrin las 'bring po mchod rten dang 'brel ba gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs la dgos pa/ 'di'i mjug cung zad ma tshangs pa 'bri byang gnyis ka'i phyag dper 'dug pa shog ser las 'bebs dus byung bas 'phror lus skad do/ /'phrin las chung ba rgyun 'khyer lus dkyil dang 'brel ba ste 'di gsum la bstod bskul che 'bring chung gsum du yang grags/ bar gyi gnyer ma gsum po las/ gshin rje nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa chen mo las byang rgyas pa dang 'brel ba mchod rten la brten pa'i mngon rtogs las byang ('khri)'bring po dang 'brel ba/ mngon rtogs chung ba rgyun (13ba)gyi lta 'khru)rnal 'byor bstod bskul chung ba dang 'brel ba/ mngon rtogs chung 'bring 'di gnyis byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po'i phyag dper mi 'dug cing / gdan la phyogs skyong bcu gsal bo yod pa'i mngon rtogs urmo gyang 'gyel gyi chos tshan zhig la mngon rtogs 'bring po'i kha yig btab cing / gyang 'gyel gyi chos can rtsa rgyan gyi lha tsam yod pa la bdud bzhi slong ba'i dmigs rim yang yod pa zhig la mngon rtogs 'bring po'i rtsa ba zhes kha yig 'dug pa chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang dpe rgyun yod lugs 'di bzhin sde pa snang rtse ba dang sog bzlog pa sogs sngags rlom mang po'i dpe rgyun du 'dug pa mthong bas sngon gyi yig rnying 'khrugs pa'i rgyun 'byams pa zhig lus par mngon/ 'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ma yin zhes dpyad par dka' na'ang 'bri gung pa'i phyag dper 'dug pa 'di 'brel chags par mngon/ gang ltar 'bri byang gnyis ma'i lcags sdig gi thugs rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po yin pas mi mthun pa 'ong don mi 'dug /slar yang phyogs 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes 'dra byung na dpyad do/ /mgul gyi gnyer ma gcig pu las snying po don gyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo tshe sgrub pa la mchog tu shis pa bsam gtan nyal chog tu grags pa mchod rten lus la bkod pa'i zab gnad ngo mtshar yod pa/ de'i bri yig don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan pa/ g.yas kyi yan lag bzhi la lo sgom zla ba/ zla sgom zhag /zhag sgom dus/ dus sgom sbyor bas bshig pa'i༄khro las bzhi'i man ngag /— /8—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)de bzhi po'i man ngag gsal byed nam mkha'i mthongs su ser ba/ bar snang khams su (14na)sde brgyad rbod gtong / khang sel/ zhing sel/ dur sel/ phung sel/ rgya mtsho'i gting du nag po gtad gyi byas pa bshig pa rnams/ g.yon gyi yan lag bzhi las 'gugs 'khor/ gcod 'khor/ ngan sngags rgyun gcod stobs dang ngag gnon sbyor ba'i 'khor lo la brten nas urmo sbyor ba bzhi pa'am mnan pa'i las bzhi/de'i man ngag gsal byed lcags sdig mgo dgus dam nyams kyi ngag /gyi ling rta'i thod par sde brgyad rbod gtong mi min spre'u'i thod par mi chen po'i bsod nams sde brgyad bye brag tu gnon pa rnams/ bu ga brgyad po las dmar len srog gi ga'u zhes pa dregs pa bco brgyad sogs kyi srog snying gzir ba'i 'khor lo bca' ba dang dgra bo'i lus kyi cha shas gshen rje so sor gtod pa'i zab gnad can/ mjug ma lcags kyu gug pa las bsrung ba sdig pa stobs chen zhes pa byang pa'i phyag dper ma tshang ching chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig tu yang mi 'dug /'bri gung pa'i phyag dper chos tshan gcig pu 'di ma tshang tshul 'dug cing babs la bltas na dpe rgyun 'di sngar nas chad pa zhig yin nam snyam/'bri gung gi shog khra'i khrod na dpe ris ni 'dug pas slar yang mkhyen brtse nus ldan gyi sngags 'chang 'dra la btsal na rnyed dam snyam/ dri chen dri chu sogs lus kyi dri ngan la mtshon cha las kyi 'khor lo zhes pa byang pa'i phyag dper mi 'dug cing / deng sang lcags sdig mkhan po phal cher la yang med pa shas che/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig na thebs kyang chos tshan ngos 'dzin gyi gsal kha ma byung zhing phyag (14ba)dper mi 'dug /'bri gung gi phyag dper urmo su tstsha dkar nag la ngos bzung zhing / lcags sdig gi dpe khungs btsun gzhan zhig na'ang 'di bzhin 'dug pas rje rin cen phun tshogs de bzang rdzu 'ug pa spos pa lta bu'i bla chen dang mi 'dra bar mkhyen brtse nus pa dang ldan zhing khyad par chos tshul 'di la mkhas shing grub brnyes yin 'dug pas de'i rgyun ma nyams pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i bar du zhugs pas chos sde'i ngos 'dzin de bzhin du mdzad pa'i rgyun yang thos shing 'thad par sems/ 'on kyang byang pa rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi gsung rgyun phyag len dang tshe bdag — /9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum / (rsāgasang sgrub 'di ga'i chos kyi babs la dpag na lcags sdig gi chos sder mi gtogs pa'i zur pa zhig min pa'i nges pa mi 'dug /lhag tu bka' 'byed las/ 'di la chos can brgyad yod de zhes pa ltar na da lta chos tshan brgyad kyang kha gsal 'dren rgyu mi 'dug pas som nyir gyur mod/ da dung lugs 'di la gdeng tshad thub pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba 'dra dang phrad na dpyad par bya'o/ /stod dril nyi ma shar ba las byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde zhes pa yi ge drug pa rdo rje sgra la brten nas mtshan ma'i sgrib pa 'dag pa/ a la brten nas ka dag lhun grub kyi don ston pa/ ddha la dbang bskur bas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/rdo rje'i bzlas pas rlung dbu mar bzung rgyud sde'i snying po'i nyams len gyis tshe 'dir mngon sum grol ba'i zab chos/ bar gyi sgal tshigs bcud phur las gnam lcags ā khro thams cad dril ba'i cog brdung gnod sbyin dmar nag bskul bas zla ba mi 'gor ba'i drag sngags/ smad mkhris dug gi rtsa ba las mtshon (15na)cha las sbyor dug 'khor zhes pa reg zas du ba gsum la rang bsrung / lus dum bur 'gyur ba/dri tshor tshad brlag pa/ za bsrangs/ 'khums pa/ khrag tu skyug pa/ bshal ba/ long ba/ sbos pa/ lhog pa/ lo dus 'chi ba/ skam rlon mdzes khyer/ skrangs pa/ bskams pa/ spos ril/ smyo ba/ me yong ba/khrag 'joms/ rdo shing 'bubs pa/ mda' thebs pa/ skra byi ba/ bu mi skye ba/ mgo 'khor/ shu thor/ zha ba rnams la brten nas ring por mi thogs par 'chi ba/ khyi 'dus nas 'brad pa/ rdzas dus la brten nas bya rigs bgegs gdon skrod pa rnams/ smad kyi snod rnams las gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum phyung zhes pa gzhang kha tshil gyi 'khor lo las gtad bzlog nag po'i 'khrul 'khor smag sdud mthing nag gru gsum du grags pa/ rgyu ma khug par ring mo nas byas pa bshigs pa'i 'khor lo/ long kha gnye ma'i mdzod phugs las phag mo gsang ba'i 'brul 'khor/ pho ba me drod 'dzin pa las rus sbal mchog gi 'khor lo/ grod pa snod bzhi'i rdzing bu las gsad bzlog sbrags pa'i 'khor lo/ zhe sdang khros pa'i chu rgyus nas sprul nag rwa can 'khor lo/ mkhris pa dang ma'i mdzod phugs las gnam lcags so brdar 'khor lo/ rgyu tshil gnye ma ring mo las mnan pa las drug 'khor lo/ lgang lpags chu'i thum bu las gtad —20

dam pa 'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabazlog nag po'i 'khor lo/ srog rtsa las bsam gtan stong srog 'khor lo/ g.yas na rgyu ba'i brkyangs ma las bshig pa gnod sbyin mdze thod/ g.yon na rgyu ba'i ro ma las mnan pa ri rab stobs chen/ srog rtsa dang ma dkar po las༅lkos so sdeb 'khor lo ste bcu gsum (15ba)yod la/ 'bri gung gi phyag dper mnan pa las drug mchog phag gi mjug tu 'dus pa mnan pa las drug gi rdzogs 'tshams na mchog dang phag mo lto sdeb kyi gsad bzlog rdzogs so zhes par dpags na 'brel mi chags pa mi 'dug na'ang yig mkhan gyis nor ba 'byams pa las g.yin du mi 'dra ste/ ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon du yang go rim bka' 'byed kyi rjes su 'brang la/ zhabs drung bdag po'i gsan yig tu yang de ltar 'dug pas/ 'dir yang bka' 'byed kyi go rim bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /she u me so sdeb kyi 'khor lo'i lag len yang zhun (3bri)khrag 'thung nag po'i tshang brtol nas bod kyi ban chung la bshad pa/ de'i zhal gdams ('bri ) da me gri dug gi so sdeb/ 'phrin las bskul ba ('khri)zhe sdang me 'bar ma so sdeb kyi drag sngags gdug pa'i las ('i bri ) mthu zla gsang nyi shu pa/ tsitta'i gdams pa bdun gyi nang nas urmo ( 'i sbra)so sdeb nyams su blang thabs rnams yod pa/ bka' 'byed du/ 'di las mang na brtsams pa yin gsungs pa ni gong gi chos tshan bcu gsum po dang mi 'brel ba'i gzhan la dgongs pa'o/ /'khor lo 'di rnams bsgrigs pa la: khrigs kha rin cen phreng ba yod: ces pa'i skor la/ 'og bcas rgyas pa gzhang kha dang gtad zlog 'khor lo/ bar bcas rgyas pa mchog phag gsad zlog rwa can rnams kyi 'khor lo steng bcas rgyas pa so brdar 'khor lo ste phyi mchod rten la brten pa'i lha gral gyi skor/ mnan pa las drug sogs nang ga'u la brten pa'i lha gral/ gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i lha gral/ mchod rten nag po'i gzungs (16na)gral/ 'og bcas rgyas pa mun smag gtad zlog yig chung / bar bcas rgyas pa sprul nag rdo rje'i cod pan/ mchog phag /zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu gcag pa rnams kyi yig chung / steng bcas rgyas pa so brdar bca' ba'i yig chung rnam shes snying gi pho brang nas sngags byang snyem khra 31 zhes pa bsnyen ji/ba byang pa'i phyag dper sngags byang snyem dkar mo zhes kha yig btab 'dug /bla tshe —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'agugs pa/ lha dbye/ log 'khyams gcod gsum rdugs 'khor lto bral rnams kyi ngos 'dzin sprul pa gsum gyi mngon rtogs dang bcas pa rig sngags 'chang ba'i lag cha zab mo/ sngags byang snye ma khra mo zhes pa phyi mchod rten la brten nas stod kyi lcags thag gsum sbrel/ nang 'brub khung la brten nas bar gyi lcags thag gsum sbrel/ gsang ba tsitta la brten nas smad kyi lcags thag gsum sbrel/ lcags thag rgya las 'grol ba'i gdams pa zab mo sngags smyon rnams kyi mtshon char med du mi rung ba/ glo ba gangs ri dkar po las lag len don sdeb chen mo zhes pa stod dkar po byang chub lam gyi sgron mas bsam gtan lam du 'khyer ba/ bar ngan sngags dug gi 'khor los dgra bgegs kyi srog la 'khor lo bskor ba/ smad bka' nyan lcags kyi ber gas 'dod dgu sgrub pa gsum las phyi ma sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdon dregs pa can rnams 'khrugs nas las mi byed na/ bka' nyan gnam lcags kyi ber ka spyi don bcu'i sgo nas sngags kyi sdeb lugs khyad par can bstan pa/ de'i zhar la dug gsum gshed dbab/gtsang ma lha'i sdeb dang bcas pa sngags pa'i snying nor/ chos sde rnams phan tshun gang dang gang du sdeb (16ba)dgos pa'i gnad 'gag gi sdom bstan pa'i don sdeb chen mo/ mchin pa mchong ri smug po nas gnas kyi las rim phun sum tshogs pa lngas bstan pa zhar byung rdzas dang 'jim pa'i byin brlab/ mkhal ma tshel gyi mdzod phugs la rab gnas ye shes zung la jug ces pa mchod rten byin gyis brlab thabs/mcher pa rgya zor khug pa las man ngag gser gyi yang zhun zhes pa sku bskyed ('bri ) nas gzhan gyi sbyor ba zlog cing gnod sbyin pho mo kha 'ching zhing gzir ba don lngas bstan pa 'bri gung gi rgyun la 'di kho na ngos 'dzin cing byang lugs la 'di mi 'dug /bar du sngags kyi dug mda' khong du bskyal zhing mkha' 'gro zan la dbab ba don bzhis bstan pa me rlung skyin thang bsad pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ tshe bdag nag po'i man ngag gi lde mig rin po che'i 'phrul gyi sgo 'byed ces pa bca' thabs bsdus pa'i lag len shin tu bde ba 'jam dpal gshed 'khor nag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs te rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shigs pa'i sku bskyed pa/ 'di 'bri gung lugs la thems med du mdzad kyang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras gser zhun du ngos 'dzin mdzad nas bla dpe'i kha —22

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganayig tu yang thebs 'dug /nam mkha'i mthongs su sbyor ba'i stobs bshig pa/ ri rab kyi rtse nas gnam lcags kyi so brdar ba dang / ri thang mtshams su zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu gcag pa/ rgya mtsho'i gting du mun pa'i smag bsdu ba/ 'khor ba'i rgya gling du srid pa'i ri bo sgyel ba/ de dag la med du mi rung ba'i las phran dang bcas te chos sde gcig tu bstan pa khong nang gi snying lta bu'i gdams pa/ bad gan dar dkar yol ba las phyi nang rtags kyi ngos 'dzin dang bzlas pa grags kyi drod tshad bstan pa/ bdag (17na〉sna dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis: de rnams thams cad dril ba las: sgron ma rgyas 'bris bsdus gsum zer gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde mig byung : zab mo phyag rgya drug dang bcas: 'di a tsi tshi la nga re 'jigs: zhes pa'i sgron ma rgyas pa gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde mig ces pa mchod rten mun smag /gzhu gcag pa/ so brdar/ gzir ba/ bsrung bzlog gsad pa/ gnyen po/ sngags/ thun/ gsang ba yang gsang du bsdebs pa/ mnan pa/ ar gtad/ gsang ba tsitta drag po'i thun gyi spra 'khrid dang bcas pa zab mo phyag rgya drug gi gdams pa bca' bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis ga'i thun mong la dgos pa/ sgron ma 'bring po gnam lcags lta 'bri ) la gyi lde mig ces pa rdzas dang 'brul 'khor gyis rang gshed dbab pa/ lha'i rang gshed ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon pa/ sngags kyi rang gshed drag sngags kyis sgrol ba/ bca' bzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis ma'i thun mong la dgos pa/ sgron ma bsdus pa gnam lcags ('khru/'phrul gyi lde mig ces par dkyil 'khor lha'i sgron ma dang mchod rten sgron ma'i sbra 'khrid zhang khrom bu la gtad pa'i man ngag bca' gzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis ka thun mong du dgos pa rnams/ sgron ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di 'bri gung gi rgyun la ngos 'dzin 'di bzhin mdzad pa bka' 'byed kyi sgron ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zer ba'i tshig la ras mi 'phog cing phyag len skabs kyang nges par dgos pa'i khungs btsun par mngon/ paṇa chen sku mched gnyis kyi phyag dpe'i rgyun gyi byang pa'i bla dpe sogs la mi 'dug pa zab khyad kyis gab pa rgyun (17ba)'byams su song ngam phyag len gyi ngos 'dzin lugs ma gcig pa yin dang don du med pa yin kha tshon ma chod chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig dang phyag dpe'i rgyun —23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/gcig na sgron ma rgyas pa 'di thebs 'dug /'bring bsdus gnyis mi 'dug /'jam dpal tshe bdag skor la gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gran zla med pa brgya mkhar ba se ston chen po'i rgyun la lcags 'dra gnubs kyi gnam thog chen po'i chos sder sgron ma rgyas pa yod pas lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis mar sgron ma gsum po 'di 'phrul shes dgos pa zhig yin na/ de min lcags sdig tu med par bzhed tshe gong gi chos sde yongs rdzogs 'khrugs bsdebs su byas pas sgron ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum don gyis thon pa la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /'on kyang lcags 'dra'i skor la se ston chen po dang byang pa yab sras mtha' shin tu chod pa'i mkhas shing grub pa brnyes la/ lcags sdig la rje 'bri gung pa chen po mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa'i gdeng tshad rnyed pa nas kho bo lta bu'i blo gros kyi mig chung ngus mtha' gcig tu kha tshon ma chod do/ /thems med lcags sdig kun gzhi gti mug sems byung las chad pa'i dbang bka' rin cen 'phreng ba zhes pa mchod rten gyi lha la dbang bskur thabs/ 'ji 'bri gung pa'i lugs la med byang bdag yab sras kyi phyag bzhes su mdzad/ 'di bar skabs su gnubs pa'i zhal ngo 'ga' zhig gis dbang 'di slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi dbang du 'khrul nas phyag len ma dag pa'ang thor bu byung bar snang / lcags sdig yan lag drug las tshe bdag nag po'i gtor zlog /gser lcags 'khor lo'i nang du bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong sogs skyabs yul/ bsrung bya/ mdun bskyed mchod rten gtso bo'i thugs (18na)kar rdor sems bsgom pa sogs sgom khog zab mo tshig nyung don rgyas gnad 'gag can/ khro rgyal lam bsdus mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis bsam yas su mdzad pa/ des 'phrang 'gor mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ des 'phrang 'go o rgyan chos rdzong du mdzad pa'i tshe 'dir byang chub 'grub pa'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo/ lcags sdig thog 'dra'i skor gyi 'phrin las snying po bsdus ('bri na pa 'bri gung pa dbur smyon thugs kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i bca' bzhi rgyas ('i bri ) bsdus gnyis ga'i mchod rten gyi las byang ngag bsgrigs ma shin tu legs pa/ des mdzad pa'i gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum chabs cig tu nyams su len pa ṭikka rin cen 'phreng ba'i gsal —24

dam nga 'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabyed rdo rje 'bar ( 'i bri ) ba'i mtshon rnon rnams/ dpe ris skor la/ mchod rten gyi phyi nang / lha gnas chos 'byung / phur ba/ byang bu/ mun smag gam gtad bzlog nag po lte ba gru gsum sdig ling gsum ldan gyi steng 'og 'khor lo/ de dang 'dra min gcig /byas pa bshig pa'am zhe sdang khros pa'i gzhu gcig par yang grags pa'i 'chi bdag khram shing sprul zhags bsnams pa'i lto 'khor rtsibs brgyad gri sdig can/ mchog phag bsnol ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs rtse sprad so gnyis pa/ de dang 'dra min gcig /gsad bzlog sbrags ma sbal sdig lto sbyar rtsibs rtsa sprad so gnyis pa/ sprul nag rwa can rtsibs rtse sprad so gnyis pa/ liṅkar sprul 'khyil ba/ gnam lcags so brdar sdig phag bsnol ma rtsibs rtse sprad so gnyis pa/btsad po/ slob ma/ sngags pa/ bon po/ skye bo/ bud med rnams kyi liṅga/ gtad bzlog nag po'i steng 'khor (18ba)chu srin mgo can gyi lto bar rtsibs rtse sprad so gnyis pa/ 'og 'khor rus sbal lto bar bris pa 'dra min/ mnan pa ri rab stobs chen zas so'i lhor gnyi bris pa/ bsam gtan stong srog rgyas pa lto 'khor chen mo/ chung ba snying po don gyi bsrung ba mtshon cha can/ bshig pa gnod sbyin mdze thod gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i lto bar rdo rje rtsibs brgyad dang bzhi yod/ urmo so sdeb rus sbal lhor rtsibs rtse sprad so gnyis rnams/ gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum dngos bstan/ gshed po las rgyal lam gzhu gcig /dregs pa khram shing zhags pa 'dzin pa'i ltor 'phrul mig bcu drug rtsibs nyi shu pa/de dang 'dra min sdig brgyad yod pa gcig /sbal pa'i lte bar stong srog 'khor lo/ 'phrul mig bzhi bcu pa/ mu stegs bon po dang 'gras na pho nya rkang mgyogs zlog pa/ dam med slob ma dang 'gras na rdo rje me 'thab/ ༷snye du mkhan dang 'gras na glang chen stobs 'gran/ gtad mkhan ngang 'gras na sprul nag lte 'thab/ dam tshig gcig pa dang 'gras na seng chen kha 'thab/ sngags pa nang 'gras la stag mo kha 'thab/nus cen stobs dang bral ba rdo rje rgya gram/ zlog dkyil ma tre/ gter snod lcags sdig phyi nang gi dpe ris rnams byang lugs kyi rgyun phyag len sor gnas dang / 'bri gung lugs la dbang lta'i bri)chog dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor/ bstod bskul chen mo dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor/ gyang 'gyel e ring bsnal —25—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebazlog dkrug bshags bzhi/ bdud bzhi nang slong gi liṅga gnyis/ snying po don gyi bsrung ba sto 'khor ma/ byas pa bshig pa'i 'khor lo 'gugs bcad gsad mnan gyi 'khor lo bzhi dang (19na)bcas pa/ dmar len srog gi ga'u'i pho 'khor mo 'khor/ bar 'khor/ de'i liṅka'i lus la lha tsho gos bkod pa/gsad sgrub sātstsha dkar nag gi pho 'khor mo 'khor/ 'di'i dpe ris byang lugs rang dngosang / skye bo phal pa dang sngags pa'i liṅga/ bcud phur gnam lcags urmo'i pho 'khor mo 'khor/ ṭīkka rin cen 'phreng ba'i nang gi smag sdud steng 'og /byas pa bshig pa'i pho 'khor mo 'khor/ mchog phag 'khor lo/ btsad po seng ge /slob ma stag /sngags pa sdig pa/ bon po phag /skye bo rus sbal/ bud med bya'i khog par bris pa'i 'khor lo/ sprul nag rwa can steng 'og 'khor lo/ gsang bzlog sbrags ma'i steng 'og 'khor lo/so brdar steng 'og 'khor lo gto bzlog steng 'og 'khor lo/ mnan pa ri rab stobs ོ bsam gto stong srog lto 'khor/ gnod sbyin mdze thod pho
