'bor mo 'bor/ urmo so sdeb steng 'og wor lo/sgron ma rgyas pa gnam lcags phrul gyi lde mig gi mchog phag /rgyal po/ slob ma/ dam gcig pa/ dam mi gcig pa/ bon po/ drag sngags mkhan te rang gshed liṅga drug 'di'i dpe ris byang lugs dngos gtsang / 'byung ba khram bzlog gam pho nya rkang mgyogs bzlog pa/ sgron ma rgyas pa nas gsungs pa'i gsang ba tsitta la brten pa'i steng 'og 'khor lo/ skye mched bcu gnyis rkos la btab pa'i liṅga/ nam mkha'i mthongs su mthing gi bya ra sbyor thabs/ bshig pa'i steng 'og 'khor lo/ rin cen 'phrul gyi sgo 'byed nas gsungasapa'i sbrul nag rdo rje cod pan/ de nas bshad pa'i ngag gnon liṅga/ steng gcod nam mkha'i 'khor (19ba)lo/ 'og 'degs rlung gi 'khor lo/ 'chi bdag zhal dbye/ rgyal chen sa'i dkyil 'khor/ ngag gnon lcags sdig mgo dgu/ sde brgyad spyir gnon/ dza ya dkar nag 'khor lo/ mchod rten gyi bca' gzhi rgyas pa/ bsdus pa rnams so/ /de ltar lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis ma'i gzhud dpe ris yongs su rdzogs pa dang man ngag gi yi ge rnams bstun te lcags 'dra gnam thog chen po'i sbyor ba brag ltag pa rdo rje rin cen gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag sgron ma drug pa dang se ston gyis mchod rten gsal byed gzhir —26—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabazhag la zhal shes kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi phyag bzhes mtha' dag dmar 'khrid du lan gsum dang / gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum khrigs kha rin chen phreng ba man ngag gser zhun gsum la gzhi byas/ chos sde gong 'og rnams 'khrugs sdebs su ngo sprad pa'i lcags 'drar med pa'i 'khor lo rnams lcags sdig gi steng nas sbyar te nyams su len dus kyi phyag 'khrid/ lcags 'dra la ma ltos par lcags sdig rang rkyang gi 'khor lo bcu gsum sdeb tshul sogs man ngag mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'o/ /pad gnubs dbang gi brgyud pa'i bka' gter gnyis kyi skor/pad gnubs dbang gi brgyud par bka' gter gnyis las/ bka' ma pad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /bal po'i rgyal po ba su dha ra/ lha rje gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che/ 'di nasabazung (20na lon tshab mgon po zla ba'i bar sngags dkar lcang lo can sha stag yin zhing bon po'i thog dpang rje btsun khrom gyi phyir bzlog pas mnga' bdag gi sngags pa rnams thod du khur bas lha rje thogs la/ gtsang smyon pas mi la'i rnam thar du lha rje zer na 'tsho byed las 'os med snyam ste lha rje gnubs chung la sman sngags gnyis ka shes pa zhes smra ba ni blun gtam mo/ /lha rje poXkyibs khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ de sras lha rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ lha rje gnubs padma dbang rgyal/ lha rje gnubs bla chen 'jam dpal/ lha rje gnubs rgya gar rdo rje/ lha rje gnubs chos kyi ye shes/ sngags 'chang khro bo 'bar ba/ mthu chen dar ma rgyal mtshan/ bla ma yang dag rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin phug pa sher rgyal/ slob dpon rdog ston 'bum legs/ sngags la 4 o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi gsan yig na rdog ston 'bum le zhes snang ba brtag /gro ston chen po bsod nams 'bum/ bla chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ phag ston sngags 'chang shākya mgon —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepo/ sbug ston chen po dpal ldan mgon po/ mkhas grub rdo rje gling pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zur i/ spang ston zur tsho chu kha pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dge legs rgyal mtshan/ rtse ston chen po sngags 'chang rin cen rgyal mtshan/ spyan tshab chos rje mgon po zla ba/ lbo rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi gsan yig na bsod nams mgon po zhes snang ba brtag /mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rten dge slong /khri srong rnam sprul chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po/ zur chen rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor sngags smyon drag rtsal rdo rje la'o/ /bgrangs ma thag pa 'di bam chen gsang ba'i dbang (20ba)brgyud gtso che zhing las byang gi bdud rtsi sman mchod la mdzad/lcags 'dra pad lugs gnam thog chen po'i dbang dang chos skor rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ phyag na rdo rje/ lha'i bu tshangs pa/ lha bu nyi ma/lha'i bu bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ bal po bha su dha ra/ lha rje gnubs chen sangs rgyas/ gter ston rgya shad khrom/ 'di nas phag ston pa'i bar spang sngags pa dkar po'i/ /bral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs ban bkra shis dar/ rngog ston 'bum legs/ gro ston bsod nams 'bum/ bla chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ phag ston shākya mgon po man sngar ltar ro/ /yang na gangs ban bkra shis dar nas/ 'di nas phag ston pa'i bar yang sngags dkar/ gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shāka 'bum/ rgyal ba g.yung ston rdor dpal/ gsang mas rdo rje snying po la/ phag ston shāka mgon man gong bzhin no/ /'di las byang rgyud 'debs su yang mdzad/ yang na gter ston nas/'u zangs 'od 'bar/ thang ban bsangs thub/ thang ston jo rdor/ shus ston ring mo/ thang ston kun dga'/phag ston jo kun/ phag ston kun don/ phag ston shāka— mgon man gong bzhin/ yang pad lugs snying 'dzings kyi lung rkyang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ phag ston shāka mgon yan gter brgyud ltar la/ 'di nas dpal ba po shis stobs rgyal gyi bar spung sngags dkar/de nas spug ston dpal mgon/ mkhas grub rdo rje gling pa/gu ru gdung 'dzin/ sgrub pa mo lha mo/ sgrub chen byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bla ma (21na skol 'byor mgon —28

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)po/ brag ltag pa rdo rje rin cen/ sngags 'chang zil gnon rdo rje/ brag ston so rigs legs ldan rdo rje/'di mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po dang mtshan gcig pa ma gtogs mi mi gcig byang bdag pos bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti gsan pa de yin/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal man gong bzhin no/ /yang na phag ston la brag ltag pa rang gis kyang gsan pa yin no/ /gnubs lugs gter ma lcags 'dra gnam thog chen po'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ phyag na rdo rje/ lha'i bu tshangs pa/ lha bu nyi ma/ lha'i bu bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyon slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /'phung byed shinti garbha/ rgya gar dha na dha la/ gu ru khrag 'thung nag po/ bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ bral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs ban bkra shis dar/ gangs pa ri dkar ba/ mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum/ gra phyi g.yung ston rdor dpal/phag ston shāka mgon man bam chen gsang ba'i brgyud pa ltar ro/ /byad 'grol gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni lcags sdig gi lung brgyud sor gnas so/ /byad 'grol gyi man ngag phyag len du bkod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin chen po nas/ gtsang bla ma ri sbug pa yab kun mkhyen dbang phyug /thugs sras 'jam dpal legs ldan rdo rje/ glang bu chos rje chos skyong dbang phyug /zhal lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /urmo gsang sgrub skor dang rdo rje urmo gnam sa (21ba/sto ba dkrug pa gnyis kyi lung dang phyag len zhal shes khyad par 'khor lo'i man ngag rlom phal cher gyi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shinti garbha/ khrag 'thung nag po/ gtsug lag dpal dge /bha su dha ra nas g.yung ston pa yan lcags 'dra gnubs lugs gnam thog chen pa dang 'dra ba la/ de nas bal po smon lam seng ge /bla ma 'od zer seng ge /mkhas grub chos rje dpal/ bla ma dngosagrub sdings pa rje btsun rin po che/ rin po che chos kyi blo gros/ klong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/—29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shemakhas grub padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /gnubs lugs bka' ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon/ sprul sku gsang ba'i bdag po/ dga' rab rdo rje/ lha'i bu tshangs pa/ lha bu nyi ma/ lha'i bu bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshesaganyen/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /rom bu gu rgya de ba tsand+ra/ 'phung byed shirnyi garbha/ ā tsarla dha na dha la/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ rgyal po bha su dha ra/ lha rje gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ lha rje gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ lha rje gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo ston lcags dpe/ me ston dran chung / dran ston mtha' bral/ me ston dkon cog rin cen/ slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma mthar phyin lha sgom/ mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum/ gra phyi rgyal ba g.yung ston/ phag ston shākya mgon po man bam chen gsang ba'i brgyud lugs dang (22na tshe khog /'di ni spang ston nas brgyud pa'i lugs yin la/ rta nag sgrol ma pa nas brgyud tshul ni/ me ston dkon rin yan gong ltar la/ de nas skyes mchog mkhas pa/ lha rin cen grags/ rdo tsha bsod nams byang chub/ bla ma 'dzam gling rin cen/ gu ru shes rab rdo rje/ mkhas btsun dkon cog bzang po/ sgrol chen 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ sgrol ma ba'i ༷ngo 'di rnams sngags pa dkar po ba/ sgrol ma sangs rgyas rin cen/ sgrol ma 'jam dbyangs chos grags bzang po/sgrol ma nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ se ston chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan man bam chen gsang ba ltar ro//yang na g.yung ston pa yan bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ de nas 'gro mgon tshe bdag pa/ yab sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ sngags yong legs pa dpal/ yab lha rigs 'jamasadabyangs rgyal mtshan/ de sras legs ldan rdo rje man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho yan bka' ma gnubs lugs ltar la/ de nas gnubs padma dbang rgyal/ lha rje gnubs jo bo 'jam dpal/yum chen so gad so gyen/ lha rje ye shes gzungs/ bla ma lha dar/ lha rje jo dor/ lha rje dharma/ lha rje rgya hor/lha rje dbang ga 'ozhe/ lha rje chos seng / bla ma bkra shis dar/ bla ma dar ma seng ge /lha rje seng ge dar/—30

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gu ru ye shes rgya mtsho/ bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje/ rtsa brgyad pa rdo rje seng ge /bla chen chos dpal bzang po/sprul sku dge legs dpal/ rtsa brgyad pa bkra shis bzang po/ sngags 'chang padma dbang / yab 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ lha rigs legs ldan (22na rdo rje man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na sprul sku dge legasadapal nas/ bya btang bsam grub rgyal po/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnas brtan chos skyong lhun grub/ bla ma mang thos pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che/ legs ldan rdo rje man gong ltar ro/ /yang na rtsa brgyad pa bkra shis bzang po nas/ rje btsun rgyal mtshan seng ge mkhas pa kun bzang rnam rgyal/ chos rje sangs rgyas skyabs/ mnga' ris rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /gzhubs lugs dbang mchog mu tig 'phreng ba'i dbang brgyud bka' ma dang lcags 'dra gnubs lugs kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la/ g.yung ston pa yan gnubs lugs bka' ma sngar smos pa ltar la/ de nas bla ma seng ge bzang po/ mchims rdo rje spre chung gi skye ba skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ rgyal ba g.yung gi skye ba dharma ke tu/ kong long ral gsum gyi bla ma rin po che chos kyi blo gros/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ gcen padma dbang rgyal/ gcung legs ldan rdo rje man sngar ltar ro/ /'bri'i rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i mu tig 'phreng ba'i dbang gter ma lugs dang lcags sdig yongs rdzogs kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes yan gnubs lugs bka' ma ltar la/ mnga' ris pa paṇa chen rin po che'i gsan yig tu gshin rje gshed nas shirnya garbha 'dug pa bka' 'byed dang mthun pas mi 'gal/de nas gter ston rgya shad khrom/ gnubs lcags gtun nag po/ gnubs ston chos grags/ gnubasabya bral ba skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ /mchod rten la dbang bskur ba'i dbang bka' rin cen 'phreng ba ma gtogs 'bri'i rtags yod (23na)med la ma bltos pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje yan sngar ltar la/ de nas rje 'bri gung zur pa gnam lcags me 'bar/ bla ma rin cen dpal ba/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rin cen/ ratna gnyis pa 'bri gung chos kyi grags pa/ sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegrub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /de yang lcags 'dra lugs kyi mchod rten 'khor lo sogs kyi phyag len dmar 'khrid ni sman mchod kyi brgyud pa dang brgyud 'debasaganyis gtso che/ lcags sdig gi man ngag zhal shes ni mu tig 'phreng ba'i gter brgyud gtso che/ brgyud pa mtha' dag byang bdag rigs 'dzin yab sras la tshang ba las chu bo kun 'dus kyi gdams pa zur chen khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyis kho bo za hor gyi sngags spyon bzhad pa rtsal la gnang zhing bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams kyang lag tu bstar ba'i nyams 'og tu chud cing mchod rten bcas chog chen mo dang / gnam lcags༄khro/ mnan pa ri rab stobs chen sogs las sbyor mang po lag tu blangs pas dgra sde cham la phab pa'i lag rjes tsam yang gda'o/ /lcags sdig rang lugs kho nar brten pa'i phyag len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'khor lo bcu gsum yongs rdzogs su bca' ba sogs kyi phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid ni rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje yan gong ltar la/ chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs/ bla ma rin cen dpal/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas rin cen/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa/ des bdag la zhal shes rnams mtha' chod par stsal zhing de don (23ba)bsdebs nas khrigs kha rin cen 'phreng ba'i gsal byed rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon zhes bya ba'i dgongs gter gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /de yang bka' 'byed las/ yang rdzong seng ge'i rdzong chen du byang chub sgrub cing yod tsa na mnga' bdag rgyal po'i bang chen byung : bsam yas mthil du spyan drangs nas dbu rtse bya 'dab lho ngos su zab chen seng ris gdan du btings g.yu dmar bya mgo phyag tu phul: lha phyag byas nas 'di skad gsungs zhes pa ltar mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis gnubs chen la lcags sdig gi skor rnams zhus na'ang gnam lcags ur 'dra'i chos skor zhig gtad nas sdig pa'i chos rnams gter du sbas par gsungs pas slob dpon 'di khri srong lde btsan nas bzung dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar du byung ba la brten mkhas pa rnams dpyad gzhi che bar mdzad kyang bka' shog rgya bo cher/ klu mal dro gzi byin gyis/ rig —32

dam pa'i chos kyi gsang yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)pa rang dbang thob pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas khyod mya ngan ma 'da' sems can don la bzhugs: zhesazhus pa'i lan du ji tsam bar du stod pa'i dbang yod kyang : phyag na rdo rje'i dbang gi bka' mi bcog /ces dang / cha ga'i thems byang las/ lo grangs brgya dang bcu gnyis lon pa na zhes yod pas tshe'i rigs 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir khri srong lde btsan gyi dus nas bzung dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar du bzhugs par mngon la/ slad nas 'byung 'gyur gyi yang bzlog khro chu sogs kyang rgyal khrims zhig /phyogs ris kyi 'khrug pa rnams dar ba'i dus su slob dpon 'dis bal yul nas gdams pa rnams spyan drangs par nges (24na)so/ /yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri phung po ri bo che nas sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i skor/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches bal yul du lan bdun byon pa'i phyi ma la bal po bha su dha ras mna' bsgags nas rdzogs par gnang ba'i yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri phung po ri bo che dang lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du gter du sbas pa las phung po ri bo che nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i dbang zhes par gshin rje rigs lnga brtul zhugs dang bcas pas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bum gsang ba shes rab ye shes bzhi pa'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi smin byed thod rgal rdzogs chen snang ba bzhi'i dbang / bye brag gi dbang zhes pa sku lha dbang /snying po sngags dbang / thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang / phyir dur khrod chas kyi dbang / nang nyan bshad sgom sgrub 'phrin las kyi dbang / bka' rdzogs mchod rten gyi dbang / yon tan 'dod yon gyi dbang /—33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebasgral ba srog ye shes su dbang bskur ba/srog zor gtad mnan bcas pas 'phrin las kyi dbang /khyad par gtor ma'i dbang dang bcas pa chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs kyi ljags bsgrigasakyi steng nas rnon po nang gcod kyi gtor dbang bka' gtad dang bcas pa yid ches par thob/'di la gzhogs drud nas snang rtse sde pas rnon po nang bcud kyi rjes gnang zhes gcod pa dang bcud kyi khyad par ma shes par go don log par bzung ba'i rang bzo'i dbang chog gsar du brtsams 'dug pa ni shes ldan rnams (24ba)kyis dug bzhin du spang bar rigs so//lung gi skor la yang bzlog me'i spu gri lo rgyus (ka)rgyas pa dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/lo rgyus sngon du 'gro ba'i yang bzlog ('khon)6/lo3)me'i spu gri mar 'a gzhung /bsrung zlog gsad gsum la nang gses kyi sngags dmigs (6nga)lta'i)gnyis su phye ba'i yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i zhal gdams shog dril gces pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i man ngag chu dar sngon po la dngul gyi yi ger bris te mchod sgrom smug por shel gyi par bur rgyas bto tshul/yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i lag len gab pa mngon ('khond(6re lo3)du bla ma'i phyag len ltar phyung ba lag len dngos gzhir grags pa/bsrung zlog gsad gsum gyi dus su ye shes sems dpa'i man ngag gab pa gsal stong (6re/lha)sgom pa lha'i gnad kyi zhal gdams/bca' gzhi rdzas kyi gnad/dgra bo gsad pa'i gnad/sgom pa lha'i gnad/bzlas pa sngags kyi gnad/drod tshad rtags kyi gnad de zhal gdams gnad lnga mar ('khond(6she73)grags pa gser srang gang gi bka' rgya can/gtor ma'i gnad kyi man ngag shin tu gab pa/(rmu re lo3)zur tsam bstan la/'khor lo'i gnad/lha'i gnad/sham bu kha bsgyur gyi gnad gsum bton pa zhal gdams lta'i)gnad gsum du grags pa'i u pa de sha rgya ston nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtshos mdzad pa/des gu ru tsa spros bskul ngor mdzad pa'i spu gri dkar nag gi bca' thabs rab gnas/nang 'gras la bya thabs skor bzhi/mtshan bzhi/gnad gsum dang ldan pa'i gdams pa/lta'i)zab mo byad ma stobs 'joms4/des bla ma zla (25na)bas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i smyug tshigs dang mnan gsad kyi ling (ci)ga thun rdzas dang bcas pa'i zab gnad zhal gdams byad ma srog len zhes bya ba/ nying bzlog la nye bar mkho ba'i dbye (nyid(cha ( ) 'gugs gtor sngags kyi zhal shes zab mo/ rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas long po nas rtsad bcad pa'i 'khor lo dang ling ga'i (3)zhal gdams slob dpon padmas gnubs la gnang ba kun la med pa'i khyad chos sngags pa stong dang 'gras kyang nyal bas chog pa/ long po'i zhal shes kyi 'phros bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi sngags kyi sham bu bsgyur (nyi)lugs kun la med pa'i man ngag khyad par can rgya gar khrag 'thung nag pos bal po bha su dha ra la gnang ba'i bla ma byang chub mgon po'i gsung bzhin bris pa/ling ga thog mar blta ba lugs dang / bar du 'ching ba/ mthar chos longs sprul gsum gyi sgo nas rnam shes spar ba zer gyi mjug tu bya ba'i man ngag zab mo/ bla 'gugs kyi ting 'dzin dus sngags lha dbye'i (zur/(zhi)zab gnad bskul dang bcas pa rgya'i gter ma/ lha dbye mthing nag gru gsum ma sngags rdzas dang bcas pa dus drug gi bla 'gugs kyi bskul/ yang bzlog mkhan po nang 'gras na pu ri'i bca' (ni re lo3)thabs dang sngags zlog lugs/ 'go ba'i lha lnga la brten pa'i bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi kha bsgyur zhing (klu re lo3)tshor ba lnga ldan gyi sgo nas bla 'gugs pa/ shrī sidha'i bsam gtan nyal chog dang snying (zurd(3)thig gi za yig /dgra sri gnon pa'i kha bsgyur spu gri'i sngags bsnal (nyi)zlog gi man ngag zab mo/ du na bdun pa'i sdebs lta'i)kyi gnad dbab/ yang bzlog nang 'gras (25ba)zlog pa'i (zu re lo3)kha gnon/ rang gshed dbab pa chu'i spu gri (zurd/shrī)gsang ba reg gcod zab mo/ bzlog gsad dus su za ba dang 'byug rdzas sbas pa'i lha'i (zurd('i)man ngag zur tsam bstan pa/ 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i spu gri bzhi skor gyi dmigs pa skyogs gnyis nang phrad kyi gdams pa/ spu gri bzhi skor gyi gsang sngags shin tu zab pa/ lus ngag yid gsum mnan rtags gsal ba'i sgron me/ (zurd/me)dang bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi za yig /tshe srog 'chi gsum gyi za yig 9)skyes mchog rdzong rṣa ma/ rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi cho ga rje (zur/zur pas mdzad —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nepa/ 'bri gung dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa'i dbang rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i sgrub khog rṣa mo/ des mdzad pa'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon/ des mdzad pa'i gong gi lhan thabasargyun bshags sdom gzung / des mdzad pa'i thod rgal snang bzhi'i dbang chog /des mdzad pa'i phyi nang gi chas dbang rgyas pa zur du sbas pa/ des mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi dbang bskur gud du sbas pa shin tu gsang ba/ des mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug rgyun khyer/ des mdzad pa'i gong gi lhan thabs/ des mdzad pa'i lha bsnyen pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ 'chi bdag bdud sgrub bzhi'i sgo nas zla gsang bzhi bsnyen gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul/ des mdzad pa'i zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi gab sbas snying dang 'dra ba snod ldan re gnyis las me spel ba'i bka' rgya can/ de'i cha lag sdebs kyi man ngag zur du phyung ba/phyag rgya zil gnon zhi bar sgrub pa'i man ngag zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon du med du mi rung ba 'jam dpal ye shes lta'i)sems dpa' bsnyen (26na)thabs/ 'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin dkon cog phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i (ka)brgyud 'debs rgyal ba klu mchog ma/ yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i ngag 'don man ngag 'khrugs sdebs su bkod pa sgrub pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ (nyi)kun la med du mi rung ba chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i tshe bdag gi mngon (ka)rtogs a kro 'bru bcu gcig gi mtha' can/ des yum chen mo'i don du mdzad pa'i tshe bdag phyag gnyis (ka)pa'i rgyun khyer gyi nyams len snying po gsal ba/ des ngang tshul dpal gyi rgyal mo'i don du mdzad pa'i phyag /(ka)gnyis pa'i zlog pa yang snying 'dus pa/ bla ma spo snod pas stag rtse'i 'tshamasapar gdams pa'i (ka)phyag gnyis pa'i zlog pa yang snying bcud gdams 'bri gung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i yang bzlog gi rgyun 'byer bsdus pa/ yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i (6/ lo3)'phrin las sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma/ las byang nyams len lta'i)(༅)gyi don bsdus zab mo/ drag po'i gtor ma byin (kyi rlabs o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi gsang ba gsol btab (3)dang mnga' gsol 'bri gung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs —36

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa nas khol du phyung ba'i bstod pa chos sku skye med ma/ 'bri gung dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa'i rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed/ des sa stag cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum la bye ri stag rtser mdzad pa'i gtso 'khor lnga'i bstod pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa (26ba tha tog 'phreng 'dzin gtum chen rab 'bar ma/ des mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i (sgru)man ngag /des mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi lhan thabs lag mchod/ des mdzad pa'i bskang (ka)bshags dngos grub snye ma 'og min chos dbyings ma/ 'bri gung spro lung gzhis gar bsrang zlog tshugs skabs glang lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyi ma rtse shar la 'jam dpal yab yum sras gsum zhal gzigs pa'i dus rje 'bri gung zur pas mdzad pa'i 'phrin bcol (( re yo3)thabs mchog bde chen ma/ des mdzad pa'i 'brub khung (6/lo3)bskyed chog /gser skyems phyogs bzhi mtshams(༷re/(nyi)brgyad ma/ mkhyen dgongs gzu dpang dmod bcol lta snyan drug po srog gi spu gri nag po zhes bya ba/gshin rje'i gzu dpang lta'i)dkon cog gsum po ma zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i nang tshan sde brgyad byung tshul gsungs pa ltar drag por bskul ba'i las rim 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i nga ni khro rgyal ma/ sde brgyad rnams kyi sngags bya/ nyes byas drag bskul gyi rjes su bskul ba bla 'gugs mon pa bzhi'i bskul chos dbyings drag po ma/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes byang chub kyi(ni re lo3)lam la 'god par da ni khro rgyal ma/ phur gdab kyi man ngag gud du bkol ba/lta'i)sngags pa hom khung nang nas 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa padmas nyer btags 'bri gung pa sngags dbang dbur smon gyis mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i yang bzlog gi gtor zor 'phen pa la dgos pa'i zlog gzhung lcags sdig las nyung ngur bsdus pa/ des 'bri byang chub gling gi thog kha gser khang du mdzad pa'i bzlog gzhung rgyas pa dur khrod rab 'jigs(27nasgo/ des mdzad pa'i bsrung zlog gsad pa'i mtha' rgyas(nyi)dang dgra bgegasaglo bur du tshar gcod pa la nye bar mkho ba'i gsad pa mthar thug gdug pa me'i las sbyor/ des mdzad pa'i drag po'i sbyin (she sgeg dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ sbyin sreg gi kha bsgyur (ka)la gsad bskrad bsdoms —37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepa gcig /bskrad pa drug /rengs pa gsum/ grong stongs pa gcig /kha 'ching ba gcig /dbye ba gsum/spyo ba gnyis/ nor brlag pa gcig rnams gshed skor gyi rgyud nas rig 'dzin dkon cog phun tshogs kyis zur du phyung ba/ des mdzad pa'i gshin rje'i phur bu sgrub pa'i man ngag /yang bzlog me'i spu gri'am drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag 'khor lo la brten nas sgrub lta'i)pa'i rim pa la btsan po'i mkhar du zhugs nas rdo rje'i go gyon pa dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i sbyor thabs rig sngags 'khrul 'khor phyir bzlog pa steng bcas me'i sbu gri sgrogs gnyis nang phrad na skyogs rdo lam du bcag cing srung ma bdud du dbab pa dang phyag cha rang la bskor te rbod gtong gi g.yul bshams nas dmag dpon g.yul du gsad pa gnyis la brten nas bar bcas me'i spu gri/ byad ma'i stobs gzhom zhing ngan sngags kyi kha bcings nas btson dong rul du btang ba la brten pa'i 'og bcas me'i spu gri ste shin tu zab pa snying nang gi khrag lta bu 'bri gung pa dbur spyon nam rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ 'di snod ldan re gnyis ma gtogs kun la bstan na las kyi gshin rjes snying khrag hub kyis 'thung ba'i bka' rgya yod do/ /des mdzad pa'i nying zlog gi zhal shes shin tu (27ba)gsang ba/ des mdzad pa'i las kyi mtha' rgyas nag po klu la gtod pa'i gdams pa yang bzlog mkhan po kun gyi rna bar ma grags pa/gto kyi dus su rang la mi bzlog pa'i zab gnad/ sngags 'chang dbur spyon gyis mngan spyod kyi gzhung spyi sdom du ma nas(ka)btus pa'i mnan gtad kyi lag len ngag khrigs gsang zhing sba bar bya ba/ gtor ma nan gyi ngag (ka)'don lcags sdig gi 'byung ba gdan bzhi ma/ zla gsang gi 'byung ba (ka)brten zhing ma/ 'di nas lho ltag)phyogs ma/ las byang kha (nyi)stong skyabs sems/ rnam dag ( snyun spyin pa/bsrung dmigs kyi sngon du dgos pa'i (nyi)che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa rgyas bsdus gnyis/ mngon rtogs spyan 'dren bstod pa sogs la sbas/ lta nyin lha gnyis ka 'geng ba'i yi ga /bstod bskul rnams kyi mthug bsrung bzlog gsad (3)gsum gyi kha bsgyur bya thabs/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i ratna las gsungs pa'i thun bskul bskal ba 'das pa/ nyes byas drag bskul (6re/srog gi spu gri urmo so sdeb nas gsungs —38—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i dregs(ne)pa'i bskul zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba/ zod bskul lcags sam bhanta ma/ mjug gi smon lam 'dod gsol gyi nyer mkho nag po gsum dril gyi dgra bgegs gdug pa ma/ dgongs 'dus rta nag gi lha yi lha mchog ma/ rje ratna'i lcags sdig las byang gi bskal pa dpag med ma/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma/ rgya gar slob dpon don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bdag kyang gnod pa las rgyal ma/ nges shes bskyed phyir rtog gsum gyi nam mkha' med pa la sogs pa rnams 'bri gung dbur spyon (28na)gyis phyogs kyis phyogs gcig tu bkol ba/ des mdzad pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la g.yul ngor med du mi rung ba'i mtshon cha zab mo thun sgrub/ yang zlog la brten nas dgra bgegs gsod pa 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor lo (nyi)gnubs ban sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos rgya zhab khrom gyis lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas spyan drangs pa/ 'di ni gser srang gang gi maṇḍal med par mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can no/ /rlung 'khor mkho mthing ma'i man ngag gab pa rnam bzhi'i zhal gdams/(nyi)slob ma snying dang 'dra bar re tsam las kun la mi ston pa'i zab gnad 'bri gung dbur smyon dkon cog phun tshogs kyi zin bris/ dgra'i khams bdag gi khams kyi dgrar song nas phul (ka)'ded bzhi'i sbyor ba slob ma snying 'dra re re tsam las mi ston pa/ yi ge 'byung bar bsdebs (te/pa zab gnad sbas te bris pa/ rlung 'khor gyi bskul mi mngon chos dbyings ma bka' (she srung dbyangs la chags pa'i mtha' can/ long po sngags 'chang nas byung ba'i yang (zur/bzlog me'i spu gri'i rlung 'khor/ las phran sgrub pa'i rim pa la byad ma kha 'phung du 'chi ba/ mi brgyud rtsad nas gcod pa/ spyo 'bog gis 'chi ba rigs gnyis/ bu brgyud rtsad nas gcod pa/ chu grir 'chi ba/ gri khar 'chi ba/ ngag lkugs pa/ bsod nams nyams byed 'go mchog /byad ma rang gshed du skor ba'am rang gshed nang gi rang gshed ces bya (ka)ba sngags nag rnams kyi lag char med du mi rung ba srid pa'i gter khyim nas byung ba/ rje dbur spyon gyis mngon spyod kyi rgyud man ngag rnams las (ka)zab rgu bsdus pa'i ca spyi'i gnad yig /des gter khyim gyi khong bcud phyung pa'i bla (ka)nas rgyu dus rtags phur pa (28ba)gsum gyi gdams pa —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shekhyad par can/ ma grub na 'khor lo spo ba dang grub na 'khor lo 'don pa'i man ngag gshin rje gshed po'i gsang ba drug cu pa'i rgyud kyi le'u so gnyis pa las phyung ba/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud khri drug stong pa'i le'u stong tham pa nas gsungs pa'i mnan gtad rdzas kyi thod pa dang sa dmigs kyi kha bsgyur shin tu zab pa/ bshad rgyud khri drug stong pa'i le'u lnga brgya brgyad cu pa nas gsungs pa'i mnan gtad kyi 'tshol zab mo/ mnan gtad kyi dmigs kher 'ded srid pa'i gter khyim las logs su phyung ba zab pa'i mthar thug pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i (ka)las gshin lha bcu bdun ma'i 'phrin las/ des mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi gter byon nas btus pa'i las (di)gshin gyi rgyun gtor gnam lcags kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ des sa yos cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes drug la mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg lag len dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ de'i lhan thabs chu rta snron gyi zla bar 'bri gung gzims chung lcang lo can du mdzad pa/ des sa pho stag lo bye ri stag rtser zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra la brten nas mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga /des mdzad pa'i arga'i cho ga /des sa stag spre'u'i zla bar bye ri stag rtser zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra la brten nas mdzad pa'i sgrib sbyong gnas spar gyi cho ga /des zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra la brten nas bye ri stag rtser mdzad pa'i phung po sreg sbyang gi cho ga /des mdzad pa'i sātstsha gdab pa'i lag len/ des zla gsang gi rgyud la brten nas lag len du bsdebs pa'i char 'bebs sad bsrung gi skor/ zla gsang char 'bebs kyi zhal gdams/ de la nye bar mkho ba rlung lha mnan pa la brten pa'i (29na)rlung gnon/ khyi dkar sna dmar gyi thob pa'i rlung gnon/ dar ljang la brten pa'i rlung gnon/ thog ser shwa bung bsgyur ba'i gdams pa/ yi ge bcu bdun pa la brten cing pad 'dab la phyogs skyong bcu'i sngags bkod pa'i rdo 'khor chen mo/ gshin rje'i chu bsgyur stobs chen 'dus pa zhes pa pad 'dab la khyung sngags bkod pa/ ya ma'i pa ṇi bzlog pa rtsibs la yang bzlog gi sngags bkod pa/ rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas zla gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten nas shing sprel rtse ba gzhis gar mdzad pa'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i rdzogs rim/ des mdzad pa'i rdzogs —40—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarim sbas (ka)don rnam gsum rim lnga btsan thabs su nyams su blangs pa des mdzad pa'i thun mong (ka)gi rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ des mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba (ka)rnam snang bzhi sgrom snying mdzod nas padma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal gyis spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal don gyi gsang tig gi man ngag yang tig gces sgron gyi dgongs 'grel/des mdzad pa'i rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len rgyun khyer (ka)mgo na nang par snga bar ldang ba dang spyang mo drug gi sngags kyi mtha' can/ rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi sher dbang du chos kun 'dus tshul (ka)paṇa chen rin po che'i gter gzhung bcos med/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra las le'u re bzhi pa rtsa dang 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag (ka)ston pa zur du phyung ba/ rnam dag dran pa lta ba ston pa zla (ka)gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra las phyung bas/ zla gsang nag po me lce'i 'phreng ba las/ (ka)lta ba bstan pa'i le'u gnyis pa zur du phyung ba/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog phun tshogs kyis gshin rje gshed kyi (29ba)rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i dam tshig rnam bshad dpe ris skor la/ bsrung 'khor steng 'og /bzlog 'khor steng 'og /zlog pa drag po'i ling 'khor/ gsad pa'i ling rkyang / de'i ling 'khor/ lus ngag yid gsum so so gnon pa'i ling 'khor/ sgo gsum cig car gnon pa'i ling 'khor/ las mtha' klu gtad ling 'khor/ dkyil 'khor/ mchod rten dkar nag / phugs gtor/ sgrub gtor/ sman raka srog phur/ bla phur/ snying phur/ thun gtor/ zor gtor/ thun rdzas/ mnan snod/ sbyin sreg gi thab/ steng gcod rlung 'khor mkho mthing ma'i pho 'khor mo 'khor/ ling rkyang / sgrom dang bca' bzhi/ kha bsgyur la bzlog 'khor/mnon pa srog las/ 'byed pa/ dkrug pa/ bskrad pa/ drag po thun gyi dkyil 'khor dang bca' gzhi/sman gtor rakta 'khor lo/ char 'bebs chu 'khor gyi pho 'khor mo 'khor gyi dpe dang bcas pa rnams kyi dbang lung phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid du legs par thob pa las g.yung drung gi rtags can gnyis ma gtogs pa'i dbang che chung gnyis dang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sdud mdzad rdo rje rnon po/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ 'phung —41 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebyed shinti garbha/ slob dpon ye shes snying po/ slob dpon kha garbha/ rgya gar khrag las nag po/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyal ba bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ lha rje gnubs chung pa/ rje mi las mas slob sa/ mtshur ston rin cen rdo rje/ sku zhang dpal ldan/ bla ma tshul khrims rin cen/ sngags 'chang byang chub mgon po/ mkhas grub nam mkha'i mtshan can (30na)rigs 'dzin tshul khrims zhabs/ rgya ston dpon po nam mkha' rigs 'dzin gsang ba bar las pa/ lha sras rgyal po'i rnam sprul 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs sam mkha' grol glong yangs/de sras 'bri gung pa cho the/rgyal phun tshogs de sras 'bri gung pa bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan/de'i gcung 'bri gung pa dkon cog phun tshogs sam dbu ru spyon pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba dkon cog lhun grub/ sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa nas/zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /'khon gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje rin cen phun tsho gos nas/ rgyal sras padma chos rgyal/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ gsang ba'i bdag po rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor gyi bande la'o/ /rlung 'khor ma gtogs pa'i zur gyi rtags yod pa rnams dang bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi man ngag gi yi ge dang dpe chung rnams sgo bstun te phyag len dmar 'khrid du lan gnyis kyi bar smin rgyas su thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje rin cen phun tsho gos nas/ snang gsal ba po shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur rsā chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /phyag len zhib cha'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ du ma rang grol nas/ zur chen gawo nu don grub/ des rje chos dbyings rang grol la gnang ngo / /rlung 'khor long po lugs ni/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal yan (30bsngar ltar la/ de nas rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku stobs ldan shugs 'chang rtsal/ sgam po sprul sku phyag —42

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganardor nor bu/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /rlung 'khor mkho mthing ma gtogs pa'i shrī'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'bri gung pa dkon cog phun tshogs nas/ dpal ri bla ma bsod nams rin cen/ sprul sku dkon cog ngag dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /rlung 'khor mkho mthing ma'i gri'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgya ston nam mkha' nas/ spo bo'i sngags 'chang drag po'i ming can la rje dbur spyon gyis chig brgyud du gsan/ de nas dpal ri bla ma bsod rin man gcig go /rdzogs rim rnams dang mkho mthing ma ma gtogs pa'i ma'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pa nas ka btsal bla ma sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rlung 'khor mkho mthing ma ga'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/ spo bo'i sngags 'chang nas chos kyi grags pa la brgyud de rdzogs rim rnams ni yi dam gyi lhas rje dbur smyon la dngos su gnang ba stsal bas 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon/ gang des rjes bzung dkon cog phun tshogs/ ka btsal ba dkon cog lhun grub man gong ltar/ yang steng bcas/ bar bcas/'og bcas kyi 'khor lo ting 'dzin sngags dmigs rdzas sogs kyi man ngag yongs la ma grags pa'i zhal shes zab pa las kyang ches zab pa phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje zur ba nas/bla ma btsan yag sprul sku/ rje bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sngags (31na)nag dbu ru spyon pa/ des bdag za hor bande la sbas bsris med par stsal to/ /bka' ma'i brgyud pa ni/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes yan gong ltar la/ de nas gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo ston lcags dpe/ me ston dran chung / dran ston mtha' bral/me ston dkon cog rin cen/ slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma mthar phyin lha sgom/ mthu chen gangs pa shākya 'bum/ gra phyi rgyal ba g.yung ston/ sngags 'chang rgyal ba rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin dar ma 'bum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug /ston pa sangs rgyas mgon/ bla ma khams pa/ rgya ston nam mkha'i mtshan —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()can/'bri gung zur pa man gcig go/bal mon sogs kyi gter kha sprul pa'i gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i gter chos kyi skor/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/o rgyan gyi rgyal po padma thod 'phreng rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po gsum gyis gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud dang man ngag rnamasakyi nang nas shin tu zab pa 'jam dpal rigs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yi dam chos skyong dbyer med du sgrub pa gshin rje khro chu dug sdong gi skor rnams slob dpon bal po'i rgyal po la gnang snyo de yang gzhung las/mu stegs ston pa 'di nyid kyis las sbyor gshin rje'i ngan sngags 'di gshin rje nag po'i rgyud nas btus:lcags kyi par pur bcug nas ni bal yul 'bum thang gter du sbas phyi rabasadus kyi mtha' ma la las can gcig dang phrad par shog las can gcig gis thon nas kyang :gdug pa'i dgra bo sgrol bar shog ces smon lam dang bcas te bal yul 'bum thang ke rur gzhung yig sogasagater du sbas/chos skor rnams mig brgyud kyi tshul du 3ba ) gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang /de yang las rab rgya mtshor slob dpon 'di nyid kyis mu stegs rnams 'phung bar mdzad pas mu stegs slob dpon du grags par bshad do//der ma zad/spung ngan sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rgya gar gtsug lag dpal dge la bal yul yam bu'i dgon du zhus:bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gshin rje nag po'i zhal gdams sbyar gtsug lag dpal dge'i bkar nyan pas su la'ang mi spel gter du sba:zhes bal po'i rgyal por ma zad gtsug lag dpal dge la yang gsan zhing slob dpon rnam gnyis las byung ba'i shog dril zhal gdams kyi skor rnams gnubs kyis mon yul ༷༷ma thang ke rur bse sgrom smug po dang byang spra dun

dam pa 'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)rtser yang shog dril 'ga' zhig sbas pa'i bal mon sogs kyi gter kha sprul pa'i gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i chos skor la/ thog mar sman sdong nag po'i byin rlabs dug gi srog dbang zhes bya ba'i steng nas sku gzugs bum pa la brten nas sku gsung thugs 'gyur ba med pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang / sku sngags phyag mtshan la brten nas snang grags rig gsum gyi chos thams cad lha sngags ting 'dzin du la4 ba'i dbang / gtor ma bo ti bsrung skud bdud rtsi srog 'bor la brten nas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang dang / dam bsgrag cing mnga' gsol ba'i dbang /drag po'i sgrol dbang / bsreg 'bang mnan gsum gyi dbang rnams 'khrul med kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa yid ches par nod de/ lung la/ rtsa brgyud/ sgrub thabs gzhung / man ngag shog dril/ rgyab rten mtha' dpyod/ dbang chog /kha skong 'phrin las (32na)kyi skor dang drug /dang po ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje khro chu sman sdong chen po'i rgyud le'u sum cu so lnga pa/ gnyis pa la/ kha byang gsal ba'i me long / yid ches bskyed par shin tu zab pa'i lo rgyus byung khungs/ khro chu dug sdong gi bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi sgrub gzhung byad ma sgrol ba'i mtshon cha spu gri reg gcod mu tig srog gi spu gri byad ma 'bum gyi srog gcod rnga thogs stong yang rlag par byed pa'i man ngag tu grags pa/ de'i 'grel pa lag len gsal ba'i sgron me lha tshangs pa yin kyang skad cig la brlag nus pa'i che ba can/ 'di gter ston la gnubs ston dar dbang gis zhug pa'i skabs rta 'brug gshog ma/ gser srang gang / spyang thul gcig rnams phul bar grags/gsum pa man ngag shog dril skor la/ bsrung ba/ bzlog pa/ gsad pa/ bsrung bzlog gsad gsum la nyer mkho'i thems med/ sbyin sreg /mnan pa/ gnad dbab/ las tshogs thor bu/ bya lam bsrung ba dang dgu/ dang po la rten dang bsrung ba dngos gnyis/ dang po la/ rten bca' ba/ lto 'khor shin tu zab pa srog 'khor bca' thabs/ gri phur gyi rten bca' ba/ gtor chen dang rgyun ('bri)gyi 'dzin gtor bca' ba/ gnyis pa bsrung ba dngos la rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ dang po la/ tshe —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebadud mnan pa'i steng du mchod rten dkar po la brten nas bsrung ba/ rten phur bcas te bsrung ba/rdzas phur gyis bsrung ba/ bsrung ba yid bzhin nor bu/ rma bya ha la ( 'i bri/nag po'i bsrung ba/ gtor ma la gtad ('bri)pa'i bsrung ba/ dri chu'i bsrung ba rnams/ gnyis pa sngags kyi bsrung ba la/ 'gro 'du bsrung ba'i zhal ('brid shes drag sngags chen po'i shog dril/ gser gyi ral (32ba)gri tre la brten nas('i bridang ga 'grol zhing bsrung ba/ ngag dgrol bsrung ba'i tsakra mnan bzlog nag po'i bri yig rab gnas dang bcas pa/ sa kyi bsrubs zhar lang ba'i das mdzad par sna pa/sngags bzlas te bsrung ba rnams/gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bsrung ba la phyi gur khang ('brin brgyad kyi bsrung ba/ khro bo dkar ('brinanag gi bsrung ba/ lha bsgoms te lta 'bri)bsrung ba/ 'od dkar rdo rje'i lta'i brid bsrung ba/ rigs gsum mgon po'i bri ) bsrung ba/ rdo rje 'od lnga'i bri ) bsrung ba/ ya : hūm̐ gsum gyi bri ) bsrung ba/nā dar tshe phur gdab ste lta'i brin bsrung ba/ dregs pa dbang du bsdus te lta 'bri ) bsrung ba rnams/gnyis pa bzlog pa la/ nang gi thun bsrung gsum dang ldan pa'i khang par thod pa zhal dbye nasa'abrul 'khor bcas te bzlog pa/ dbu rgyan dang sgo srungs bsgyur te bzlog pa/ bsam gto nyal chog gi lta 'bri ) bzlog pa/ zor 'phangs te bzlog pa/ mchod rten nag po la brten nas bzlog pa/ bzlog 'khor btags te bzlog pa/ phyi'i thun bsrung bzhi dang ldan pa gsad khang bco lnga 'khor lo dang bcasate bzlog pa/ ri rab mthar dbyung gi bzlog pa/ ting nge 'dzin nag po zhagi la 'khor gyi bzlog pa/ pho nya skyogs dang 'brul 'khor spo ba drag sngags nag po'i bzlog pa rnams/gsum pa gsad pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ bzlog pa'i khang par 'khrul 'khor bcas te gsad pa/ sdig pa nag po snying la ru 'dzings rtags te gsad pa gshin rje yab yum brgyad kyisagasad pa/ gshed 'khor kha 'thab nang rgyas su gsad pa seng ge kha 'thab/ gan sbugs/ lta'iX)thog mdel ngar glud kyis gsad pa/ sdig pa'i snying khar liṅga bsgoms te phyi bsdams nang gtu bas kyis gsad pa/ ral gri phub (33na lo la ltar 'khor te gsad pa/ yar sdud mar sdud kyis gsad pa/ phar 'phro —46

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganatshur 'phyis gsad pa/ gsad sngags dang thun sngags kyis gsad pa/ mchod rten dkar po go ldog ste ltos med ar la gtad de gsad pa rnams/ gnyis pa bye brag tu gsad pa la/ seng ge kha 'thab sdig pa snying 'dzing gi man ngag ces pa rdzas kyi rang gshed dang lha'i stobs kyis mnan pa sngon du btang nas bye brag tu/ rang gi slob dpon gsad pa/ btsad po gsad pa/ slob ma gsad pa/ mched grogs gsad pa/ sngags nag gsad pa/ bon po mu stegs gsad pa/ sngags sdig drug sngags ( ('i bri ri/dang 'khrul 'khor bsgyur te gsad pa/ byad ma 'bum rdugs spu gri ( 'i ji)reg gcod kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis gsad pa/ ar la ('i bri ) gtad pa/ spyi gtsug khro bo sdib brdeb/ gang la dmigs pa lta'i bri)spyi gtsug bum pa thal rdeb/ dgra bo sna tshogs rdzas ( 'i bri ) kyis gsad pa spyir btsun pa rdo rje po bas brdung ba/ sman mo gsad pa dang bskams pa'i ('bri)skor te bye brag tu sre'u gso ba rnams/bzhi pa thems med la/ yasnro hūm̐ gsum gyi bsrung 'khor chung ba/ bdag bsrung gser gyi ( 'i jinamachod rten zhes pa'i bsrung 'khor bri thabs rab gnas dang bcas pa/ 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bsrung ba/bsrung ba'i lha/ga dril ( 'bri ) dang po dang gsum pa'i zhal shes gur khang gi zhal gdams su grags pa/bsrung ba'i shog dril ro ri zla ba ('khri)rnams kyi zhal gdams gnad kyi man ngag gab yig can/ting nge 'dzin gyi bsrung ba'i gur khang gi zhal gdams gzhung ltar bskyed la bsgom par bya'o'i mtha' can/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsrung ba zhes pa shog dril dang gnyis gnyis kyi don bsdus pa he ru gas rbad kyang rang la 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/ tshe (33ba)bdud 'joms pa'i dmigs rim tshe nyi zla ('i bri ) dang mnyam par bya ba/ bla srog sbas te bsrung ba/ rma bya ha la'i ('khri)bsrung ba chung ba/ dri chu la brten pa'i byad ma gdong bzlog /spyi mgrin snying gsang du lha bsgom pa bzlog pa ri rab khod bsgul/ bdud bzhi spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi shog dril shin tu gsang ba'i gnad 'bebs thun 'go la dran tsam las yun ring ma sgom par gsungs pa/ thun khung dug gi rgya mtshor bsgoms pa'i thun rgyag pa'i shog dril/ byad ma'i rtsa ro brkyangs dbu gsum la phur ba btab ste gsod pa'i snyan brgyud shog dril/ ral gri'i 'khor los —47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegasod pa snying 'byin shog dril/ thod pa zhal 'byed kyi ('bri ) ma na ngag dug ri nag po'i gzhung la brten pa/ mdze bo'i gson ('bri ) gtad spu gri ngar ma/ gcig shur nag po ('bri)'gyur med kyi gtad khram/de'i zhal ('bri ) shes/ zla ba gza' skar thod ling bdud bzhi slong ba gsad ( 'i 'u)sngags mnan gtad kyis dmigs dang bcas pa'i yig chung khyad par can gyi shog dril nag po/ 'gugs dbye gsad pa'i shog dril sman sdod zhal gdams snying gi thigs pa/ lham mthu/ mnan gtad kyi dus tshod lta'i bri ) dpa' bo'i mtshon thogs/ tshogs su rol nas lhag med lta'i lha/du gsod pa'i shog dril las mkhan gyi bskul ('i brid khrug gi rba klong ma/ mar me khrag gsod/ hūṃ sbyor me'i spu ( 'bri na gyis byad ma glo bur du gsod pa/ gnad bskul las kyi gshin rje ma/ dgra bo kha 'phung du 'chi ba/ mi brgyud gcad pa/ bdun brgyud gcod pa spyo 'bog gis 'chi ba/ chu grir 'chi ba/ gri khar 'chi ba/ lkugs te 'chi ba/ dge slong gi chosagos la brten nas 'gom chog byed pa/ gson gtad spu gri ngar ma zla ba gcig nas mdze yis 'dzin pa/ rab dri tshor tshad 'chi ba/ rlung zhen/ 'bring du ba phog tshad (34na 'chi ba/ tha ma lus la gang reg gum pa/ byug pas gsod pa/ gzhan yang du ba rlung zhen bye brag pa mdze nad du ba rlung zhen/ rlung nad du ba hro smo/ rims nad du ba hro wo/ khrag nad du ba hro wo/ mkhris nad du ba rma smo/ smyo nad du ba rma zhen/ rdzas de rnams sbyor ba'i dus su rang la mi gnod pa'i bsrung ba zab mo/ bsrung 'khor zhal gdams snying gi thig pa mjug tu bsrung bzlog gsad gzir gyi sngags byang byad ma ( 'bruna'abum rdugs na ga po srog gi bar du mjug tu ('brin bsrung bzlog gsang ba'i sngags byang can/ gnad bzhi'i zhal gdams khyad par can bka' rgya ('i bri ) ma/ bsrung bzlog gsad mthar mi bzlog pa dang bcas pa gnad bzhi'i gdams pa la/ bsrung bar sangs rgyas stong zhi ba/ zlog par khro bo gsad pa nyi ma mdung gang tsam nas gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrur ba'i thun dmigs/ srin sgo bkag pa'i 'brul 'khor zab khyad can/ mi bzlog pa la 'di phyi gto du mi bzlog pa'i gdams pa dang bcas pa/ bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi zhal gdams zhes pa nang gses kyi phyi nang kun gyi nus mthu bsdu ba'i bsrung —48—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnab 'chi bdag chu srin gyi mgo can gyi lto bar gtum po lcags sdig sgrom pa'i bzlog pa/ dgra bo'i spyi mgrin snying gsang dang yan lag bzhir 'khor lo bskor nas gsad pa/ sman sdong gnad kyi shog dril mu tig 'phreng ba/ ( 'bru)zhes pa bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi gnad thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa nus pa thams cad med par bsam pa'i mtha' can/ bskyed rdzogs chos sku ( 'i bri ) gsum gyi lam khyer dang gshin rje'i 'byul 'khor rdo rje'i gur/ stong pa'i go cha gzhom pa rnams kyi mjug na dgug 'dren 'chi srog tshe gsum gyi mngon rtogs bsrung (34ba)bzlog gsad gsum gyi zhal gdams dang bcas pas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i mtha' can/ 'du byed lha'i zhal gdams zhes pa lcags 'khor me 'khor g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i dbus su gtso bo dang sde drug me 'khor la glang stag bya'i mgo can/ phyi rol bdud bzhi sogs mang du bskyed kyi zhal gdams shin tu zab pa gnubs ban khyad chos zhang khrom snying tig tu (zhub/tha5 pa/lnga pa sbyin sreg ni/ rdzas chen bcu gnyis dang bcas tshang ba'i tshar gcod pa drag po'i sbyin sreg /sbyin sreg gi zhal gdams rang dbang phyug chen por ( 'i ji)bskyed pa/ drug pa mnan pa ni/ gshin rje dug sdong nag po'i las mtha' hur thum nag po'i dgra mnan/ mnan pa'i shog dril me'i rang bzhin be con gyi rgya can/ spyi gshed dug sdong nag po'i ('bri)sgab 'dre mnan pa/ bdun pa gnad dbab ni/bsnyen pa thems nas nang rtags byung phyi rtags ma byung na gnad 'bebs log gnon zhal gdams snying tig /brgyad pa las tshogs thor bu la/ dgra bo la mna' mi bya ba sogs kyi dam tshig bstan pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi gnad kyi za yig tshe sgrub 'bum gyi yang snying du grags pa/ 'chi tshe srog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi za yig bsrung ba khro chu'i gur khang / bzlog pa dug gi spu gri/ gsad pa srog gi spu gri ste bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi za yig /bsnyen sgrub las gsum gang la gal che ba'i ngos 'dzin gyi zhal shes byad ma gsod pa'i lag cha/ sngags thems la bzla ba 'byung bas 'byung ba ( 'bri ) ba shig pa'i stem yig shog dril gnubs kyis mdzad pa/ bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi sngags 'grig dregs pa can bco brgyad —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shekyi gnad stem dang bcas pa snying gi thigs pa/ bsrung bzlog bsad thun lha dbye bla 'gugs kyi sngags rje rin cen phun (35na〉nyanas kyi zhus dag ma/ thun sngags dang bsrung bzlog gi sham bu zur ('phrinadu phyung ba/ dgra bo sde brgyad kyis khram la 'debs pa sha grir the mi tshom pa/ seng mgo can gyis byis ( 'i sbre)pa gsod pa mthong brgyal ma/ tsitta rlung gi 'khor lo dgra bo phye mar 'thag pa'i mar rnon liṅga dang ral gri la brten ('i bri ) nas ser ba gdong bzlog /'go mchog sha ba rgyug 'gyel zhag gsum nasaphung bar 'gyur ba/ jag 'ching chom rkan (lo de khrug byed/ snang ba dgu 'gyur gyi ( 'bri ) gdams pa zab mo 'khon nag zas su za ba gas lta'i bri ) dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos can/ mdza' ba dang 'byed 'brinapa gsang ba'i rlung 'khor bskrad par ('khru/bsgyur ba/ nor sgrub g.yang len ('bru/bsam 'phel rnams/dgu pa bya lam bsrung ba la/ bsrung bzlog gsad mnan dgug bstim gyi man ngag rtags rim tshigs bcad ma/ rtags yig tshig lhug ngan pa rnams bzlog thabs zhar la bstan pa/ bzhi pa rgyab rten mtha' dpyod pa la/ khro chu dug sdong gi rtsa tshig ('bri ) bzhi bcu rtsa drug gi bshad bkrol rin po che'i gter mdzod rgyal sras sman lung pas mdzad pa / khro chu gdug pa kun sgrol gyi don gsal bar byed pa las rab rgya mtsho/ lnga pa dbang mchog ni/ sman sdong nag po'i byin rlabs dug gi srog dbang / gshin rje'i bzlas lung sbyin pa/ drug pa kha skong ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' bzhi lag len gyi (ka)shog dril 'bri gung pa rgyal sras dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa/ des zab pa khol du phyung ba'i las sbyor (ka)lidma'i sngags kyi man ngag /gshin rje tshe bdag dang khro chu dug sdong gnyis kyi las byang bdud dpung gtor byed gnubs chen gyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon padmas(35bsgo dzad pa'i bstod pa phyogs bcu nam mkha' ma/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis zhal ( 'i bri ) gzigs dus bstod pa phyogs phyogs ma/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal gdams sman sdong lta'i bri ) na ga po'i mdun bskyed ces pa bshan pa sde bzhi'i bskul gyis mjug bsdus pa/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i las(3khri)byang khrigs chags su bris pa/ su dha gdug pa kun sgrol dzña ('i bri nan ratna sa mdzad pa/ zhal gdams shog dril gyi gnad 'gag man ngag —50

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnatu bsdebs pa'i las byang shin tu legs pa snang gsal ba rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol gyis mdzad pa/rgyud dang man ngag gi gnad rnams kyis zur brgyan pa'i las byang gdug ('i bri ) pa kun sgrol zhes pa 'bri gung ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ yang gsang rmad du byung ba gsang ba don tig nag mo'i bsgrub thabs/ gshin rje cho so kyi rgyal po chu glang sngon po la chibs pa'i sgrub thabs/ gha na'i skabs su byed pa'i gshin rje'i mdangs skong lho phyogs rab 'jigs ma/ sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i ('i bri ) bskang yig rin cen 'phreng ba/ bskang mdos drag po'i lta'i bri)'phreng ba don gsum gyis bstan pa/ bdag bskyed gtor zor 'brub khung ( 'i bri ) dang bcas pa'i nyams len gyi bca' gzhi rdzogasabyang gi mtha' can/ gnubs chen gyis mdzad pa'i zor gyis las mtha' spu gri ('i bridang ra ma tshig zur tsam yang nyams med du go rim tsam dpal 'bri gung dbur smyon gyis bsgrigs pa/ rigs 'dzin chen po du ma rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i gtor zor la brten pa'i bzlog gsad gnam lcags 'bar ba log 'dren 'joms pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo drag po zor gyi sgo nas bzlog pa dgra (36na)bgegs kun phung mtshon cha phyogs phyogs ma bhyo bzlog gi mtha' can/ spyi gshed dug sdong nag po'i las mtha' ('bru/drag po zor gyis dgra bgegs gsad pa zor rnams 'phang ngo'i mtha' can/ mjug tu ji ltar bya ba gtor ma zor du bsgrub pa (bla bri ) ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khrul 'khor gyi mtha' can/ gdab las kyi rim pa gshin rje'i 'phrin las dgra gshed nag po/ zha'/ bstab ( 'i bri)phyogs phyogs ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/drag po'i lcags phur brdung pa'i rtsad sa gyer sngon bskal ma/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol gyis gter gzhung las ngag 'don cung zad bder btang ba'i lcags phur brdung pa'i rtsangs gyer/ des mdzad pa'i khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bskang gso dngos grub char 'bebs/ dpe'u ris la gong gnon tshe bdag 'khor lo srog 'khor/ gtad 'grol bsrung 'khor chung ba/ bsrung 'khor yid bzhin nor bu/ rten phur/ mchod rten dkar nag /bzlog 'khor/ gsad khang bco lnga pa/ dug gsum 'khor lo/ byad ma lhar bcasa.ar la gtod pa'i liṅga/ sgom chen dang skye bo ar gtod/ dgra bo rgya mtsho'i nang du a ril gtad pa/—51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (netsitta rlung 'khor gyi steng 'og bar 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i snying po tshang zhing 'dir ma 'dus pa'i chos skor kyang re mang yod 'dug pa re zhig de tsam mo//slar yang gnubs bstan 'dzin nges kyi sngags 'chang zhig rnyed tshe mtha' rgya dpyod par bya'o//de ltar 'bri'i rtags med pa'i lung dbang zhal gdams dpe ris rnams sgo bstun te bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi phyag len dmar 'khrid dang bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan 'das 'jam 36bsko pa la gshin rje gshed/thub chen shākya seng ge/nyan thos sde/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/bal po bha su dha ra/gnubasawo sangs rgyas ye shes/ga kho ston ko khrom/sras don yod rdo rje/rigs 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje/sngags 'chang rkarma sidhi/slob dpon sna bzhi pa chen po/nyi ma bas drug pa/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/byang chub dpal mo/gung rad pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/'bri gung zur pa gnam lcags me 'bar/drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog/rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/zur rdo rje lang chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za sto bande la'o//yang na gur rad pa la brtson 'grus ma' can dang /gser pa'i mtshan can gnyis kas gsan/gnyis ka la rje zur pas gas/de man 'dra/yang na gter ston nas/gnubs ston dar dbang /bha ya shākya rdo rje/sngags 'chang a grags/slob dpon a wang a khyo badzra/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/bla ma grags lha/slob dpon a rdor/gyo rsā nam mkha'i mtshan can/'bri gung zur pa man gong ltar ro//'bri'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud nas las mtha' spu gri ngar ma ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ngag dbang ye shes grub pa nas/'bri gung ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pa/sngags long dkon cog lhun grub/khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//yang las mtha' spu gri ngar ma sogs 'bri'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/rje zur pa nas/spo spo bon grong pa sngags 'chang phur pa bkra shis/sngags 'chang padma dbang rgyal/rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa man gong bzhin/ga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni 37na8bur smyon nas/rigs 'dzin

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadakon cog lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rje dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa'i lag len shog dril gyi steng nas sngags 'chang bon grong pa mchog grub rgyal po la yang phyag khrid zhib tu nos so/ /char ga'i thims byang las/ bdag 'dra skye med rdo rje khri gtsug nga : lo grangs brgya dang brgya gnyisalon pa na nga ni byung ba'i nus pa zad pas 'chi dang nye: rgas khar bal po'i yul du 'gro snyam pas:'byung po'i nus pa zad pas ma rtol te: gces pa'i gdams ngag gzhan la ma bstan par gshin rje char ka nag po ma bu rnams/ yon tan rgya mtsho dam tshig gzhung srong yag: rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin 'dzin pa'i bu med pas: sgyu lus 'di dang 'grogs nas sa yi gter du sbas: zhes gsungs pa'i 'chi bdag char ka nag po'i skor rnams nyug gi rdo rje sgrom bu/ rdza lhud mo/ phung po ri bo che/ mon mo gas ru ska sogasal gter du sbas pa'i gter gnas kyi ming btags pa'i sgrom bu ma dang rdza lhud mar grags la/ las sgrom bu ma zer ba bse'i sgrom bu'i bcings nas phyung bas sgrom bu mar grags zhes 'chad par dpyad dgos so/ /de la thog mar 'joms byed 'bar ba'i dbang mdzod la thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis lhan thabs gnang ba ma bu bsdebs pa'i steng nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'joms byed 'bar pa lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la brten pa'i rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sku gsung thugs 'phrin las kyi nus pa sgrub pa'i dbang / lha dbang / drag po zor gyi dbang rnams smin rgyas su nos nas/lung gi skor la/ thems kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa gnyis/ dang po ni thems las/ spyi ru gces pa'i (37ba)rgyab rten rgyud chung bdun zhes pa la/ chu thig sngon mo'i brgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ chu thig sngon mo'i brgyud phyi ma mdos rgyud du grags pa'i ngan sngags phyir bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ char ka nag po'i skye rgyud la le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mon pa nag po sku khros pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bzhi pa/ srin po sgo brdung gi rgyud le'u bcu pa/ gdong zor nag po la gshin rje sngags bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'joms byed 'bar ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu pa/ rgyud 'di rnams gnubs kyis bsgyur ba dang 'gos kyis bsgyur ba'i —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shechar ka sbyin shugs ma yang yod pa mang ngo / /de la dgos pa'i zhal khrigs bdun zhes pa'i tshang ma ma 'byor zhing thob pa ni/ bsrung ba mdos kyi zhal khrigs/ gsad pa mdos kyi zhal khrigs/ mnan pa mdosakyi zhal khrigs/ las mtha' sbyin sreg las kyi spu gri/ sbyin sreg gi rtsa ba rnams/ stod du dgos pa'i theg ga chung bdun zhes pa'i chang ba ma rnyed ngo bo bdun du 'dus kyang zhan byung rnams dang bcas na bdun las mang ba ni/ mtshams ( gonas/gcod/ bdun rnam dag bshags ( gan /pa/ byin 'bebs/ mchod pa byin ( gon se)brlab 'phrin las kyi (rdo rje)sngon 'gro shin tu legs pa rgyal sras rin po ches mdzad pa/las rtogonas)byang / bzlas pa/ 'dzab/ tshogs mchode/ dngos grub blang ba/ gzhi bstod yon tan ma/thugs dam bskul ba gru gsum mthing (gnas)nag ma/ bskul chung bcom ldan (rji rje/'joms byed ma rnams/ smad du dgos pa'i shog chung bdun zhes pa'i gcig ma rnyed cing zhan byung nang gses dang bcas pa ni/ zor gyi sna 'dren dpang gzu/ zor bskul ba/ zor la rbad pa/ zor bzlog /rigs 'dzin bskul ba/ 'joms byed bskul ba/ pho nya rbad pa/ zor gnas bstan pa/ zor (3ni〉ya dbye ba/ zor sna 'dren pa/ dmag dpung bskyed pa/ tshogs lhag /char kha'i byol bzlog gam mdos chog chen mor gragasapa padma nag pos mdzad pa/ mdos glud bsngo ba/ ltas ngan bzlog pa/ nad rims bzlog pa/ dmag dpung bzlog pa rnams kyi 'phyong rnams/ ma tshang ba yi kha skong bdun zhes pa'i gnyis ma rnyed cing lnga po ni/ tshe sgrub kha skong / bdud bzlog /nang brda/ cho 'phrul bzlog pa/ mdos zor bskyed pa dang lnga/shin tu dgos pa'i yig sna phra mo bdun zhes pa'i bzhi ma rnyed de lhag 'ur rdo la rtsis kyi ma bdun bu dang bcas pa bzlog pa/ nor sgrub bum pa'i man ngag /'joms byed 'bar ba'i zor sgrub gshin rje nag po'i sngags bzlog srin po thor gdong nag por sha ri phyi sngags zor bdud kyi byol sngags nag po zhes bya'i man ngag gi zhal 'khrigs gu ru bha su dha ras mdzad pa snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa rnams/ gnyis pa thems kyi ma zin pa la gshin rje nag po'i mthar thug snyan brgyud man ngag sbas pa'i skor dang / smin byed dbang gi skor te gnyis/ dang po la/ sri'u gsob/ nad pa gsob/ 'chi ba bzlog pa/ pha tshan gyi —54

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabyol po bzlog pa/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ mdzes 'pho bzlog pa/ nad rims bsrung ba/ phyugs god bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ shwa bzlog pa/ pho gdon bzlog pa/ mo gdon bzlog pa/ drag po phung 'jug bsdu ba zor ba phyugs god bzlog pa/ dmag bzlog rnams/gnyis pa smin byed dbang gi skor la/ dpal gshin rje gshed 'jom (rdo rje/byed 'bar ba'i dbang mdzod gter gzhung / 'jigs byed sgrom bu ma'i dkyil 'khor (rdo rje)gyi lag len/ dbang gi lag len (rdo rje/sprul sku mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ (38bsdas mdzad pa'i bka' gter (rdo rje/dbang lung gi brgyud pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'chi bdag gi re ba 'jom pa dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las dbang dang rdo rje dang gnas kyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lag na rdo rje/ slob dpon ro langasagasang ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon shākya pra bha/ slob dpon li tsā shad chen/ slob dpon nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rdo rje thogs med/ slob dpon dharma ko sha o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ rog grags pa seng ge /rog shes rab dbang phyug /lte ston mdo sde seng ge /slob dpon jo bo mgon po/ rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ skye med a mar sirnyi/ kun mkhyen 'dzam gling nag po sangs rgyas rin cen/ dpon po a mo dha shrī la/ ram zhang skyabs rdo rje/ bla ma bsod nams blo chen/ rigs 'dzin pa bka' bsrung rgyal po/sngags 'chang rta mgrin rdo rje/ lce ston bstan pa rab gsal/ lce chos bzang bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rong byamasa' rten rab byung pa dma gling pa'i dngos slob yin/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lce ston mdo sde seng ge nas/ lha chos kyi grags pa bkra shis sras shākya dpal/ bla ma 'dzam gling nag po man 'dra/ yang na skye med a gar siddhi nas/ gnubs shākya rgyal ba/ bla ma rin cen rgyal —53—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepo/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis seng ge /rong ri lung sbug pa rgyal ba thugs rdo rje/ lce ban rta mgrin rdo rje man (39na 'dra/ yang na rin cen rgyal po nas/ bla ma chos kyi blo gros/ ri lung sbug pa rgyal ba thugasarje man sngar bzhin no/ /bka' ma'i dbang brgyud ltar na/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon padma nag po/ slob dpon dha na mi tra/ rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can/ lam gos pa'i bha ya lha ra dang gcig/'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ jag shes rab rin cen/ sgom pa lu gu/ gzha ston zer mo/ bre ston chog po/ ring ban gtsang ston/ slob dpon ston dbang / lce mdo sde seng ge man gong ltar ro/ /rdo rje'i rtags rnams bzhag pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas bral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs pa gzhen nu snying po/ gangs pa bal po seng ge /gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shāka 'bum/rgyal ba g.yung ston rdor dpal/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal ba/ sngags 'chang dpal ldan bzang po/ zur shākya mi tra/ g.yung gi skye ba rgyal sras chos rje/ brgyud 'dzin legs pa dpal bzang / lha rigs 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khra tshang ba chen po blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i gshin rje khros pa'i thugs sgrub kyi skor/gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i gshin rje zhing rkang dmar chung rlung sgrub gnam lcags kyi thog 'dra ba gshin rje khros pa'i thugs sgrub la/ bca' ga ni liṅka 'dri tshul/ dmod mo/ sngags ting 'dzin/rtags mnan pa'i dus kyi ma ti rlung sgrub ngag 'don rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun 'khrul med chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis thob rgyal lha rtser mdzad pa'i ljags bsgrigs ma rnams thob pa'i brgyud —56

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)pa ni/ 'phags (39ba)pa 'jam dpal gshin rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhad khrom/ gnubs lcags gtun nag po/ gnubs ston chos grags/ gnubs bya bral ba/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma ke tu rin po che chos kyi blo gros/ gong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la lung phyag len dmar 'khrid shin tu gsang ba'i zhal shes dang bcas stsal zhing las sbyor 'di la brten nas mchog dman bar pa mang po cham la phab pa lags so/ /yang lung rgyun gcig la/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal nas/ gsang bdag rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /kun thub kyi sgrib shing zhwa srung ma'i brgyud pa ni/ ngag gi dbang po nas/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang gshin rje dmar chung rlung sgrub la/bka' ma slob dpon de wa tsant+ra sa pa la pa tra'i rgyud nas btus pa dang sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' gter gnyis ga'i man ngag snying po bsdus pa'i 'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin gnam lcags me 'bar gyi phyag bzhes su bu lod rin bzang gis yi ger bkod pa la brten nas dpal 'bri gung pa sna'i ga kyi grags pas go rim du bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs/ de'i man ngag gab cing sbas pa'i zhal gdams/ ban bon sogs mthu byed nan dur du 'gras na bya ba'i zhal gdams/ 'di (40na)nyid mkhan po nang 'gras na bya ba'i zhal gdams bka' rgya ma/ khrag gi kha bsgyur/ mnan pa/ rtags tshad bstan pa/ rlung sgrub las byang yi dam lha'i gnang ba thob nas dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa spyi ling gnyis/ ngag mnan/ nang 'gras/ bca' gzhi/ gtor ma/ sman raka /thun phur pa/ rten rjes kyi dpe ris bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rje yan gong ltar la/ de nas chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ bla ma rin cen dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin cen/ 'bri gung pa thugs kyi rdo rje/—57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebla ma dkon cog lhun grub/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /bka' ma ltar na/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge /slob dpon de wa tsand+ra shinti garnya dha na dha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ gnubs sangasargyas ye shes lha rje yon to rgya mtsho/ lha rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo ston lcags spe/ me ston dran chung / bran ston mtha' bral/ tshe stone dkon rin/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mthar phyin lha gom/ gangs pa shāka 'bum/rgyal ba g.yung ston/ seng ge bzang po/ skal ldan rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi thugs mdzod gsang ba'i sgrom bu las byung ba 'bum sde'i yang snying o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas dang drag sngags kyi bdag po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dgongs pa'i mthar thug pa zab pa gter dang rnam dag bka' ma'i rgyun gyi zab bcud yang bzlog gser gyi 'bru gtsig ma ban bon bya ma'i rang gshed rno mar las kyi 'khor lo hrī: dmar gshin rje'i gshed kyi yang snying du grags pa sprul sku rgya shad khrom gyi gter ma'i skor la rtsa ba'i yi ge yang bzlog (40bsko ser gyi 'bru gcig nyi zla shel gyi sgo lcog /de'i lag len 'khrid yig rin chen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can gyi ljags sgrigs ma'i nang gses la/ nyal chog bsam gtan bsrung ba/ yang bzlog gser gyi 'bru gcig /gsod byed yig rkang gnam lcags phur bu/ bsreg pa gtum drag 'bar ba/ mnan pa urmo lto sbyor/ zor las gnam lcags thog 'bebs/ rdzogs rim dngos bral ka dag /thal gdab nyi zla'i 'brul 'khor chod 'dzin sob pa bya rog /ltas gsal snying khrag mtsho zhal rnams/ yang dam pa gang des mdzad pa'i bsrung ba rdo rje'i rdzong chen/ bzlog pa gnam lcags spu gri gsad pa dug gsum gnad 'bebs zhes bya ba/ yang des mdzad pa'i bsrung bzlog gsang bsreg mnan pa'i zhal shes gab dkrugs sbas pa mngon du phyung ba rdo rje pha lam gyi mkhar rdzong chen po rnams kyi khrigs rim dmar 'khrid zhal shes gnad 'gag nyams myong tshad ma'i sgo nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni bka' gter gnyis las bka' ma ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshersā—58

dam pa'i chos kya gsan yag gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaganyen/o rgyan padma 'byung gnas gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/gnubasaye shes rgya mtsho/rdo ston lcags spe/me ston dran chung /dran ston mtha' bral/me ston kun rig/slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/bla ma mthar phyin lha sgom/gangs pa shāka 'bum g.yung ston rdor dpal/bla ma seng bzang /badzra rā dza/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos kyi blo gros/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigs 'dzan ngag gi dbang po/zur khyab bdag chos dbyings4na ) rang grol/des bdag la'o//gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/gnubs chen yan gong ltar la/gter ston rgya zhad khrom/lcags gtun nag po/gnubs stan chos grags/gnubasabya bral ba/badzra rā dza man gong ltar ro//man ngag 'di la brten nas sgrogs rdo nam mkha' bcag cing rang mtshon rang la brgyab pa'i nyams myong ma'o//gnubs kyi gong khug zab mo ga kṇi rtse nas snyil ba'i 'phrul skyogs/btsan po rmang nas 'jigs pa'i gzu ba yang bzlog nyi ma mdung gang zhes bya ba sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyi gter chos mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po'i skor la rtsa ba'i yi ge yang bzlog chen po'i mtshon cha/de'i gsal byed chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa la thig 'debs zhal shes thabs shes dmar 'khrid/bsrung ba byin rlabs 'khor lo'i bri gnad/zlog pa nyal chog 'khor lo'i bri gnad/mnan pa ri rab 'khor lo' bri gnad/bsrung skyob dbang gi chu rgyun/zlog pa mdzo cha'i 'bor lo/gsad pa gshin rje'i khong gto dmar po/mnan pa ri rab gling bzhi rgyas 'debs rnams dpe ris dang bcas pa'i steng nas phyag len dmar 'khrid sgom don man ngag zhal shes dang bcas te legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge/rigasa'adzin padma 'byung gnas bal po bha su dha ra/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/gter ston rgya zhang khrom/lcags gtun nag po/gnubs chos grags/gnubs bya bral/sngags 'chang rdo rje rgyal po/rig 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan/bla chen chos kyi blo gros/nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya 4bsgo tsho/paṇa chen padma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dbang rgyal/rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor brnye'i mtshon char stsal zhing nyams myong lag khyer ma'o//sprul rgya zhang khrom gyi gter byon ban bon sngags pas lo brgyad bsgrub pa zhag gcig la med par byed pa'i liṅga ci la brten pa'i lung phyag bzhes kyi brgyud pa ni/gshin rje gshed/'jam dpal bshes gnyen gtsug lag dpal dge/bha su dha ra/gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ston pa mgar/so sgom pa nas rim par mi dbang nor bu dbang rgyal/de sras mi 'gyur rdo rje/dbyangs dpon /zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o//rgya zhang gi gter ma rgya nag kong tshe'i dpyad las byung ba'i gza'i 'gyur dus gdong gtad la mkho ba'i gza' bzung ba'i man ngag/bram ze spu gus bstan pa'i khyab 'jug gza' sngags thems zhar byung bzlog sngags/pho sngags/ngag gnon/sde brgyad 'du ba/bod gsad kyi sngags dang bcas pa lha dbye'i sngags 'dri lugs bya mtsha' lu'i snying dang zangs phur la brten pa'i bla rdo/sgra gcan gyi bsrung ba chen po gsang bdag sto 'khor dang gdong zla sde brgyad kyi 'khor lo brgyad kyi gzhung lag len sngags byang dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /gsang ba'i bdag po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/gtsug lag dpal dge/bal po bha su dha ra/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/gter ston rgya zhang khrom /lcags gas nag po/gnubs ston chos grags/gnubs bya bral ba rdo rje rgyal po/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos kyi blo gros/42na ) na ma mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/chos rgyal ma sgo'i mtshan can/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag za hor bande la'o//gsang bdag lto 'khor gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/pha jo lhun grub rdo rje'i bar le'i/de sras gzhon nu don grub/de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o//mon yul 'bum thang ka ru nas sprul pa'i ༷ra ston rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i gnubs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganakyi gong khug sro ma can gyi shog dril zab mo snying nang gi khrag lta bu shin tu gces pa'i skor la/ lte ba sprel mchongs sogs shin tu gsang ba'i rdzas sna drug /skyobs gcig /kha bsgyur gsum dang bcas pa la brten nas dgra bo'i lo tog /mgo bo'i skra/ lug gi bal/ rta'i spu rnams thal bar rlog pa'i rdzas mthu zab mo rdo rje me'i ser ba zhes bya ba shog dril dang po/ dgra bo bred cing dngangs par byed pa'i ltas ngan sbrul gyi thang ma zhes pa rnam rtog slong ba'i rdzas mthu zab mo shog dril gnyis pa/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bu yang zla ba gcig nas skrod par nus na skye bo phal pa la lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i bskrad 'khor zab mo dgra bo rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro ba shog dril gsum pa/ dgra yul gram ring skya bor gtong ba'i thog ser gyi man ngag zab mo drag po thog gi bu yug ces bya ba shog dril bzhi po/ rje btsun mi las pha yul phung bar mdzad pa'i ser 'bebs bla ma g.yung ston khro rgyal gyi gdams pa zab mo yang 'di yin skad do/ /lan cig 'goms pa tsam gyis dgra bo'i bsod nams lhag ma lus par byed pa'i goms chog srog gi spru gri zhes bya ba shog dril lnga pa/ bag gzan la brten pa'i (42ba)nye 'byed dang shing byang la brten pa'i nye 'byed rigs mi gcig pa gnyis dang bcas pas ji ltar mdza' yang zla ba gcig nas rdo bcag pa bzhin dbye ba'i man ngag zab mo shog dril drug pa/ 'gor oṃ dang mjug na swāhā med pa'i rgya nag po'i sngags rgod bod kyi mde thung gnubs kyi byang ser srog mthu dug gi rgya can zhes bya ba shog dril bdun pa/ mu stegs nag po'i ngan sngags g.yam gtad dang zlog med nag po zhes bya ba shog dril brgyad pa/ 'goms pa tsam gyis sbrum ma 'chor bar byed pa'i 'gom chog 'khor ba rgyun gcod ces bya ba mu stegs sprin gyi shugs can gyi gdams pa shog dril dgu pa/ char gcod khrom lnga phu brgyad ces bya ba shog dril bcu pa/ zhan byung rdzas mthu nag po la brten nas mi dang dud 'gro la ltasang na mngon sum du skye ba'i thabs rnams kyi dpe ris dang bstun pa'i lung phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge 'phung byed shis garbha slob dpon ha na dha la/ rgya gar khrag —61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne'athung nag po/ mu stegs bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ de sras don yod rdo rje/ sngags 'chang rol pa'i rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin na rma gi tu/ bla ma ka bzhi pa chen po/nyi ma bcu drug pa/ bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can/ byang chub dpal mo/ gung rad pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/'bri gung zur pa gnam lcags me 'bar/ mchog sprul mnga' ris legs ldan rdo rje/ byang bdag dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po/ zur kun (43na7khyen chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /drag sngags kyi bdag po gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phan gnod kyi gdams pa thor bu'i skor thob pa la/ zla gsang ngan sngags thams cad kyi snying po dgra bo zhag bdun nas dgra bgegs te 'chi ba'i sdig pa'i gson gtad gnubs khu lung yon tan rgya mtshos nu bo la kha chems su gnang ba/sha tu ko ṭis khyer ba sdig pa'i ro gtad nā ga 'bru bcu bzhi ma/ dgra bo nam mkha' lding la gtod pa tri su la tri 'bru bco brgyad pa srang gang ri ba'i bka' rgya ma/ 'chi bdag klu'i zla gsang las mdza' bo'i gson gtad sngags nā ga su ru 'bru bco lnga pa/ yang mdze bo'i gson gtad sngags oṃ dug 'bru bcu gcig ma/ sbal pa'i gson gtad sngags nā ga tse 'bru nyer gsum pa/ gtad khram kher 'ded gtong ba la btsan dug lta bu nā ga gur len 'bru so lnga pa lidma'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ gsur gtad ser sbrul ma sbu gri reg gcod du grags pa sngags sbal pa'i gson gtad dang phaṭa yan 'dra ba/ mdze bo'i gson gtad nā ga ling 'bru sum cu pa/ sbal nag lto 'brug klu'i snying gzer slob dpon padmas mnga' bdag la gdams pa gnubs kyi phyag tu babs pa khyi kha gzan bskyur dang ser sprul khur par yang grags pa nag po ti pa tsa 'bru so brgyad pa lidma'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ yi dwags la dgra gtod pa ro gtad zab mo kā la ru pa 'bru bcu dgu pa bha su dha ras gnubs la gnang ba/ srid pa'i klu mo dbang byed ma'i rgyud nas btus pa'i ma mo bdun gyi gtad khram/ so so'i sngags sde tshan bdun dang mjug tu myos long (43ba)sogs 'bru bcu gnyis yod pa bha su dha ras yang dbang gter la stsal ba/ drag po —62

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)sngags rgod de kho na nyid phyir bzlog pa'i rtog te sngags sdeb kyi rgyal po rgyud thod pa nag po'i le'u bdun pa/ gshin rje nag po'i gshor brdabs chog spu gri reg chod slob dpon wo po padmas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ba yab 'khor yum 'khor bar ling phur par ral gri thog ma de la dkyil 'khor thod pa rdo rje rgya gram gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/ zab phu lung gi mtsho mo nag sding gis brag rus sbal 'dra ba'i khog pa nas tso skyong gling las bsto pa zhig yod kyang 'di zab gnad ྾/ /gshor brdabs chog gi bsrung ba'i za yig zab mo lusang ga yid gsum bsrung ba/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon sbrul mgo snying pos rgyal po dran dang bram ze'i bu mo dkrugs pa'i 'byed pa rtags yag gnubs kyis phung po ri bo cher gter du sbas pa rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa rta g.yag 'khor lo'i dpe'i ris dang bcas pa/ khed pa rta g.yag mang yang 'di lag khyer ma/ nye 'byed liṅga mar grags pa tri tsa shag yig 'bru bcu bdun ma/ mu stegs sgyu rtsal nag pos o rgyan chen po la phul ba'i pho sngags mo sngags rlung lha lcam sring gi sngags yod pa'i sel nag /'phung bshig nag po zhes pa khang khyim bshig dang dbye dkrug gi gdams pa/ bya rog lug pa'i 'khor los brten pa'i nyi 'byed se shing ma gnubs kyi gdams pa dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ ra tā gling pas gnam skasabrag nas 'dra zhig ba 'a kyang 'di zab gnad che/ shing stag glang se ba la brten pa'i nye 'byed rlung gi spu gri a ma trag sogs sngags sde tshan bzhi yod pa/ gnubs kyi mu stegs mchod rten nag po'i rgyud nas bkol ba'i ra khyi la brten pa'i nye 'byed (44na)chu rlung 'khrug pa/ rgya nag mkhas pa'i gdams pa gnubs kyi phyag cha bza' mi sogs 'byed pa po pho sngags mo sngags so sor yod pa gshin rje zla gsang gi rgyud nas bkol ba'i lham la brten pa'i nye 'byed rgya 'kho khrom gyi thugs kyi brnag pa/ zla gsang rgyud kyi yang bcud rang gshed gsad pa drug gi man ngag ces pas sdig spyod rgyal po gsod pa/ mched grogs lha sngags gcig pa dang slob ma gsod pa/ sngags pa spyi dang skye bo phal pa gsod pa/ nang par gtogasapa'i btsun pa gsod pa/ bon po dang mu stegs gsad pa/ bud med gsod pa/ rang gshed gsad pa drug gi rdzas sngags mnan pa gab pa gsum gyi gsal byed shin tu zab pa/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebazlog med cog brdung dgongs ka nas nyi ma dmar thag chod pa'i bar du bsgrub pa'i man ngag gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ sang rgya gling pa bya rgod gshongs nas bton pa'i 'dra min zhig yod kyang 'di kha zab/za hor gyi spu gri reg gcod dam gshin rje nyi ma gcig pa'am gshin rje sa thod dmar grags pa gnubs kyi gdams pa ban lugs dang mu stegs lugs gnyis yod pa'i ban lugs steng 'khor 'og 'khor lidma'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ drag sngags urmo'i phyir bzlog gshin rje nag po cog bzhengs sam phyir bzlog drag po'i sngags rgod nyer gcig bklags pas chog pa rgya gar dwa na dha las gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho la gnang ba gshin rje'i gzugs liṅka'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ slob dpon chen po padmas phra men las rgya mtsho'i nang nas phyung ba'i 'gom chog lusang ga yid gsum ga'i nus pa gsod par (44ba)byed pa'i man ngag bal po'i rgyal po la gnang / des gnubs chen la gnang ba'i phyag cha ma lus ngag yid gsum gnon pa'i 'khor lo gsum lidma'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ mu stegs mthong shi reg 'gyel dug chu khol ma'i 'gom chog rgya zhad khrom gyi gter ma dpe'u ris gru bzhi zur bzhir ka khrum dza jom yod pa/ bsrung ba gru bzhi thog mar na ma tsi dha yod pa/ phra men dug mtsho khol ba'i rgyud kyi yang snying gi 'gom chog shin tu zab pa dpe'u ri'i yi ge brtsegs mar shaka tsa sogs 'bru dgu yod dang bcas pa/ 'gom chog
