las kyi 'khor lo sgrub sngags a mal 'bru nyer bdun pa/ 'gom chog shin tu gsang ba'i sga la 'bru gsum gyis bskor ba slob dpon padmas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gtad pa/ dgra la mi shis pa sna tshogs gtong ba mu stegs dza ya nag po pho 'khor mo 'khor liṅka'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa rdo rje u sna'i ngan sngags mu stegs kā la ya ka'i sbyor ba gnubs kyi man ngag snying dang 'dra ba dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ dge 'dun gyi ja thug la brten nas dgra bo bsod nams zad du 'jug pa gnubs kyi gdams pa 'di lag tu lan gsum blangs pa'i myong grub ma yin/ zla ba brgyad tshun la dgra bo brlag par byed pa thed tham 'bru nyi shu rtsa drug pa zla gsang las 'khol du byung ba/ kha ske snying lte 'doms lngar yig 'bru re bris pa'i ngag mnan yi ge lnga par grags pa slob dpon padmas gnubs la gnang ba/ lte —64—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabar yig 'bru drug /khong par yig 'bru nyer gnyis/ phyi nas yig 'bru bcu dgu yod pa'i dgra kha lkugs par byed pa o rgyan chen pos gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la (45na)gnang ba/ phyir bzlog thod pa nag po'i sngags rgyud las le'u bdun pa ngag mnan khol du phyung ba/ gnubs kyi rgyun khyer lham mthu zab mo/ dgra khyim du ltas ngan sna tshogs gtong ba ltas ngan mon pa nag po'i snying dkrugs zhal gdams dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ zas la brten nas bsod nams zad thabs dam nam 'bru zhe bzhi ma/ de kha bsgyur nas zhing sel/ khang sel/ khyi'i kha 'ching / phrug gu skye 'phro gcod pa rnams/ rdzas gcig dang sngags 'bru bdun la brten nas mje mthu langs med/ bran g.yog gnod sbyin nor bsnyegs/ ā tsa ra nag po sgo brdung gnubs ban sangs rgyas kyi phyag cha dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ ratna gling pas thugs rje dzee pog rna bo kyi las rdzas su cha 'dra smo yod kyang 'di thob gnad che/ rdo dkar nag dmar ser sngon po la brten nas bdud kyi rdo char drag po dbab pa/ yugs sa'i lag gi lan tshwa la brten nas bskrad pa gnubs kyi gong khug ma/ bskrad pa'i las dug gsum kha 'byed/ sbos rir gsad pa yig 'bru bcu pa gnyan chen dpal dbyangs kyi gdams pa/ sel nag 'phung bshig ma tse to la brten pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi thugs la gab pa/ 'chang pa gsum gyi rdzas la brten pa'i 'phung bshig zab mo kun la mi spel ba dmag kha 'phung du gtong ba kye ta 'bru so lnga pa slob dpon padmas gnubs la gdams pa/ phug ron gyi thod pa la brten nas shags dang rtsod pa rgyal ba 'go la 'bru drug dang phyi la 'bru bcu dgu yod pa slob dpon padmas gnubs la gdams pa/ chags nyam mo rmi lam ngan pa mi kha kha mchu sogs kha bsgyur mnan pa mi kha gtad (45ba)bsgyur du grags pa dbang phyug chen po la brten pa'i zab khyad can gnubs ban gyi khyad chos pho 'khor mo 'khor bar 'khor gyi dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ khra phrug gnod sbyin khang nasa'adi dang ma 'dra zhig bsam gto bde 'a gling pas ga' nas ba 'a kyang 'di'i zab gnad 'ga' zhig mi 'dug /zla ba bcu gnyis dang lo bcu gnyis la brten nas dgra dang kha mchu 'ching ba rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma/ mnga' bdag nyang gi ga kho mar 'di dang zhus dag 'pher ba zhig yod/ mkha' 'gro ma'i byas pa bshig pa'i 'khor lo zhes pa mnan gtad —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shephra men 'dzul chog sogs gzhan gyi sbyor ngan mtha' dag bshig pa la mchog tu zab pa 'di'i sngags rnams byad 'grol gser gyi lde mig gi stod nas 'ga' zhig blangs 'dug /mu stegs ston pa lnga brgyasargya gar khrag 'thung nag po la ngan sbyor brtsams pa bshig pa'i 'dzul chog gi bsrung ba zab mo dbus kyi yi ge brtsegs mar ka tha sogs 'bru lnga yod pa/ gu ru dha na saṃ zhu tas rta mgrin gyi rgyud nas phyung ste hūṃ ka ra la gtad pa'i ngag 'grol gyi gdams pa zab mo ta ra 'bru nyer gnyis pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'bangs la bka' nan dang bcas te gnang ba/ 'dogs pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa badzra dzi ho 'bru bcu la brten nas ngag 'grol ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gdams pa snying dang 'dra ba ngag 'grol zhing gso ba dang byin gyis brlab pa bod rgya nag po'i rgyud la brten nas bal po bha su dha ras gnubs la gnang ba/ ngag byin gyis brlab cing ngag la nus pa'i ngar blud pa dbang phyug dang u ma nas bee ro tsa na la brgyud pa'i zab khyad can/ rang gi ngag gso zhing 'gro ba gzhan gyi nus pa 'phrog (46na)pa'i man ngag zab mo rje btsun ratna'i thugs bcud chos kyi grags pa'i snying tig sba bzung bsad gsum gyi gdams pa dpal o rgyan chen pos mnga' bdag rgyal po la gdams pa/ klu'i 'khor lo nag po'i 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i rgyud kyi le'u nyer gnyis pa nas bshad pa'i tsha thur gyi bsrung ba zab mo/de'i zhar byung du rdzas dang sngags kyi sgrib shing / mdze nag rgya mtsho'i du ri kha 'phrul gyi me long las bkol ba'i tsha thur dang grang thur gyi rdzas bsrung zab mo/ 'dogs pa'i gto bsrung ling tshe dgu ma nyi zla 'byung ba gzung ba/ gtad bsrung gtad bzlog tshig chod ma nā ga ling 'bru so drug pa gnubs kyi gdams pa/rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la rgyas thebs rtags 'grol thabs dang gzhan gyi phyir bzlog bzhigs pa lha 'dre bsten pa bod rbad gsad gsum bla 'gugs/ lha dbye sogs kyi gnad 'gags gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi thugs kyi brnag pa rnams legs par thob pa las gter gyi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bdes garsā/ 'phung byed shinti garbha/ slob dpon dha na saṃ skṛ/ slob dpon ye shes snying po/ slob dpon kha garbha/—66

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadwa na dha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ gtsug lag dpal dge /o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ lha rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo ston lcags spe/ me ston dran chung / dran ston mtha' bral/ me ston kun rin/ slob dpon bkra shis rgyan/ bla ma mthar phyin/ mthu chen gangs shāka g.yung ston rdor dpal/ sngags 'chang rgyal dor/ rigs 'dzin (46bskor 'bum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug sangs rgyas mgon po/ bla ma khams pa/ rgya ston nam mkha'/ 'bri gung pa gnam lcags me 'bar/ bla ma rin cen dpal pa/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin cen/ mtshudas med bkra shis phun tshogs/ ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pa/ sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/ nyang ston khyab bdag rdo rje me tog rtsal/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na gdubs chen nas/ gter ston rgya/ lha rje ye shes gzungs/ mtshur ston rin rdor/ sku zhang dpal ldan/ rje tshul rin/ sngags 'chang byang mgon nam mkha'i mtshan can/ tshul khrims zhabs/ rgya rigs 'dzin gsang ba/ rje zur pa man gong ltar ro/ /gshor brdabs chog gi lung brgyud lugs gcig dang gter gyi rtags can gyi lung brgyud ni/'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa nas/ dpal ri bla ma bsod nams rin cen/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /slob dpon shinti garbha la 'jam dpal tshe bdag gis dngos su gnang ba'i sngags pa 'khon sbyong lag pa'i 'du byed bskyod pa he kho ha phaṭa sogs yod pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i gdams pa rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po/ slob dpon shis garbha/ bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom nas rim par/ mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ rje btsun chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /—67—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonesprul sku rgya'i gter byon gtad rul skyes bu zangs gling gi gter ma dang 'dra ba'i brgyud pa'i skor/sprul sku rgya'i gter byon gtad rul skyes bu zangs gling gi gter ma dang 'dra ba'i brgyud pa ni gshin rje (47na)gshed/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gtsug lag dpal dge /bha su dha ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya shad khrom/ bral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs pa bkra shisadang / gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shāka 'bum/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ phag ston shāka mgon/dpal ldan mgon po/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dpang ston chen po/ rtse ston rje/ mgon po zla ba/ mnyam med chen po/ dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /bee ro tsa nas bsam yas ka gzhu la sbas pa'i rbod gtong kha 'ching dgra bo snying rje'i rtsal gyis sgrol ba'i ting 'dzin 'khor lo dang gtor ma liṅga med pas khyad par 'phags pa rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge /o rgyan chen po/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya shad khrom nas rim par/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i dbang sdud za yig 'gor oṃ ka dang mjug na ga sa yod pa'i gling bzhi ma/ ya ma'i za yig 'gor gya dang mjug na chu yod pa'i gling gnyis ma/ yang 'go na ya pa dang mjug na ha yod pa'i gling gsum ma/ srin gyi za yig 'go na gya dang mjug na chu yod pa gling gnyis ma 'dra min zhig /yang 'go na gya dang mjug na cha yod pa'i de dang 'dra min gcig /mna' bsrung ba'i za yig 'go na ta na dang mjug na pa da yod pa'i phreng gnyis ma/ sri'u gso ba'i za yig 'go na ya bha dang /—68—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogan(47ba)mjug na rā yod pa'i gling gsum ma/ tshe sgrub za yig mjug na tra nyis gshibs yod pa/ tshe bsring ba'i za yig 'go na oṃ ba dang mjug na nya yod pa'i gling gnyis ma/ nor 'phel ba'i za yig 'og na a ha dang mjug na ba yod pa'i gling gnyis ma/ 'go na gsum a ma phreng bris kyi 'og tu thur brtsegs yod pa'i bsrung ba/ 'og na oṃ me yod pa'i gling gnyis ma'i bzlog pa/ brda yig phreng gcig ma'i 'gor rgya yod pa mthar yi ge kha shas thur du brtsegs pa'i mjug as byas pa'i gsad pa/ yang a ka ma gsum phred la byas pa'i 'og tu thur brtsegs bris shing a ka ma'i mthar mkha' 'gro'i yi ge yod pa bsrung ba rdo rje'i go cha/ yig 'phreng gi 'go na a yod pa mjug tu 'thur sel gnyis yod pa'i sngon ma'i 'go mjug na a gsum rjes ma'i mgo 'jug na oṃ lā yod pa bsdog pa bar snang gi sgrogs chen/mkha' 'gro'i yi ge phreng gnyis su byas pa la 'og ma'i 'go bor oṃ 'khrid nyal mjug tu rā yod pa gsad pa khrag 'thung nag po spu gri ngar ma ste thugs gtsigs su mdzad pa rnams kyi lung lte ba lugs kyi phyag bzhes sogs dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon padma/ bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhad khrom/bral te sam sto ṭa/ gangs ban bkra shis dar/ gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shāka 'bum/ g.yung ston rdor dpal/ bla ma seng ge bzang po/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma ka sa chos kyi blo gros/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ zur gyi sngags 'chang lhun (48na)grub rdo rje/ zur gzhon nu don grub/ de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la sna(/ /rgya zhang gi gter ma'i phag thod la brten pa'i khang sel/ ga'u la brten pa'i zhing sel/ sbyang thod la brten pa'i nor sel/ rabs chad thod pa la brten pa'i dur sel/ mu stegs kyi ngan sngags goms pa cam gyis sbrum ma brlag pa/ rma bya'i sgro la brten nasang ga gnon pa/ khrag 'gyed zab mo/ mi gzugasabazhi la brten nas chu bzlog pa/ lham sgrogs la brten nas khyi'i kha 'ching ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/—69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('aslob dpon bal po'i rgyal po/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ sprul sku rgya zhang khrom nas rim par brgyud de chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o /gnubs kyi gong khug sro ma can du grags pa'i zhag gsum dag gis nges par 'grub pa'i rgyal po byed chas ka tu bka' gter gnyis ldan gyi skor la/ nang gses kyi bca' gzhi/ bod pa/ bod pa/gnad 'bebs/ ming dang kha bsgyur gyi zhal shes/ spyi gtsug tu gu ru bsgom pa'i zhal shes/ rang bla mar bsgom pa'i thugs gar ye shes sems dpa' sgom tshul dang srog la gtod pa'i zhal shes/ bla rdo/rbad gsad kyi sham bu/ sgab 'dre gnon pa/ sgos gsol sngon bskal ma/ gser skyems dang 'phyi bsamachod thabs shar phyogs ma/ shel 'phreng dkar po'i rgyud las btus pa'i bskul steng phyogs ma/ ri rab/ gtor ma/ gsang phyi/ rā dza'i sku 'bag /bla rdo'i 'bor lo/ sgab 'dre'i lidma'i dpe ris dang bcas te phyag (48ba〉spen dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/lha rje gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ lha rje gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ lha rje gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/gnubs padma dbang rgyal/ gnubs lha rje 'jam dpal/ gnubs rgya gar rdo rje/ lha rje chos kyi ye shes/chos sgo mkhan chen pa/ sngags 'chang bkra shis rin cen/ bla ma byang chub dpal ba/ bla ma grags pa lha 'od/ sngags 'chang grags pa bsam grub/ rje dpal 'byor grags pa/ bla chen 'jam dbyangs grags pa 'bri gung zur pa rin cen phun tshogs/ de sras 'bri gung pa chos rgyal phun tshogs/ mi nyag stong 'khun rgyal po'i brgyud las sngags 'chang bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /slob dpon padmas bsam yas ka pa'i chol du sbas pa'i shel 'phreng dkar po'i rgyud kyi yang snying shin tu zab pa rā dza'i man ngag nor snyeg 'than srog sbrags ma rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pas phyag len du bsdebs par sngon 'gro bcas dngos gzhi'i bod rbad gsad gsum/ mtha' sdud mnan —70

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagatad 'phang ba/ dam tshig 'khu ldog bsrung ba/ myur rtags thon pa gnad 'bebs 'gyu dus dang bcas pa'i bka' rgya ma/ gtor ma/ ri rab/ gsang phyi/ thun gtor/ thun/ rakta/ chang rgod kyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/ bskul steng phyogs rnam dag ma rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gnubs chen yan gong ltar la/gter ston rdo rje 'od 'bar/ gnubs lha rje 'jam dpal nas/ rje chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi bar 'dra ba la/ de nas bla ma sbyin (49na)pa phun tshogs/ dbur smyon thugs kyi rdo rje/ mkhas grub dkon cog lhun grub/ khra tshang pa rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /gnubs sngags long ro zan nag posadagra bo'i phyogs su brdzangs pa'i 'phrin na 'phung sa dgra la sgos bskyal 'go na oṃ mi oṃ swa mi sti/ bkra mi shis par gyur cig zer ba yod pa/ zhes pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gnubs nag po ro zan nas rim par brgyud de yug nor bu dbang rgyal/ dang ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ gu ru dbyangs dpon pa/ zur kun mkhyen chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gsang tshig spyi'i gnad rgya yig shog dril gcig la btab pa rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ dang por bsnyen pa/ bar du sgrub pa/ mthar las la sbyor ba dang gsum la lnga gsum bco lngas gtan la phab pa shrī sedhis gsungs pa/ drag po'i rgyud mtha' dag gang zag gi bye brag gis chos lnga dang ldan par dpyad dgos pa'i man ngag de wa tsa spros gsungs pa/slob dpon bha su dha ra'i nyams kyi gsang tshig la sgrub pa'i rtags phyung rtags med/ 'phrin las dang /bla'i rtags bstan pa slob dpon chen po ka ma la shi la'i gsang tshig la/ 'khor 'das kyi srog /bod bod gsad gsum gyi 'dzab dgongs bzla lugs/ bla srog rnam shes gsod gsad/ spyi la gces pa'i drag sngags/ 'khon sbyang nang 'gras rnams rtags spyi dang bye brag bla rtags bstan pa bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gu ru shrī sidha/ rom bu gu ༅ de wa tsand+ra/ slob dpon bal po'i rgyal po/ ka ma la shī la/ gnubasachen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang (49bsgo sbom nas rim par brgyud de rigs 'dzin gnam lcags me 'bar/ drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje du ma rang grol/ zur lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gzhen nu —71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsādon grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis phung po ri bo che nas spyan drangs pa'i btsan rgod srog bdag yam shud dmar po'i skor la/ srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags kyi lo rgyus khas nyen stobs chung zhig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'di lha rje gnubs sa gis skyer chu mgon po'i dbu nas btone zer ba 'dug /yam shud dmar po'i gsang sgrub mar khrag skyug gi drag sngags 'jam dpal drag sgrub rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ btsan yam shud srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags spu gri dmar po las tshogs tshad ldan rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'jam dpal dmar po zor ba spu gri'i rgyud las phyung ba'i 'jam dpal dmar po drag po btsan du sgrub pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'jam dpal dmar po btsan du bsgrub pa gsang ba gri rgod kyi las/ srog bdag dmar po'i bskang bshags bdag ni rigs 'dzin ma/ bskul srog gi mnga' bdag ma rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ gtsug lag dpal dge /o rgyan chen po/ bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sku sprul rgya zhang khrom nas rim par brgyud de rigs 'dzin rgod ldem yab sras nas se nyi bzang / se mgon bzang / se rin cen rgyal mtshan/ spyan tshab rje/ nub dgon rje/ dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /dra nga rdo rje kun grags ni/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches nyug (50na)gi rdo rje sgrom bur du beng ma'i skor/ phung po ri bo cher tri ya dze) skor/ rdza lhud mor drug gi spu gri'i skor rnams gter du sbas pa'i dpal mgon stag zhon nag po'i chos skor gter ston rgya zhang khrom dang dge bshes dra nga rdo rje kun grags gnyis kyis spyan drangs pa'i gter kha snga phyi gnyis gar gtogs shing / de'i nang nas gter gnas ri bo che dang gter ston dra nga kun grags gtso bor byas pa'i srog gi bshan pa stag zhen nag po lha bcu gsum ma'i sku gzugs bzlas lung / tshar chen gyi gsan yig ltar na rjes gnang lha lnga gtso cher snang / thar rtse ba'i mngon rtogs na lha mang 'dug kyang lha bskyogasum rang gi nges tig the tshom gyi gzhir snang ngo / /phyag mtshan gtod pa sogs yig rnying dang / thar rtse bas mdzad pa'i gsar ma'i gzhogs dud/ gtor ma tsa ka li la brten —72

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i rjes gnang dang / lung la/ rgya'i gter ma gtso bor byas pa'i dpal mgon po nag po dngos grub brtan par gzigs pa man ngag rgyud chen po le'u bcu gcig pa gu ru bha su dha ra dang / yang dbang gter gyi 'gyur/ dpal mgon po nag po snying gi dngos grub brten par gzigs pa'i rgyud rtog pa lnga pa spu gri lta bu snga ma las sngags ma tshang ba kha bskangs pa'i rgyud gnad du phyung ba padma thod 'phreng gis bha su dha ra la gnang ba/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso rgyas pa 'phrin las lhun grub/ bsdus pa gtor chog gyer sgom ma rnams thob pa las/ dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ phung byed shirnya garbha/ rom pu gu tho tsand+ra/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye (50bskos/ gter ston dra nga rdo rje kun grags/ so'i bande 'bum grags/ skyo'i bande mthu chen/ lce btsun mdo sde seng ge /mtshungs med rong pa ba rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ lce btsun blo ldan seng ge /bla ma sri'u chung pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang / dbon ston chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ mdong gi sngags 'chang drin can pha rgod bla ma chos skyong rin cen/ mdong ston tshar pa chos kyi rgyal po/ 'a zha kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mthu chen dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ 'a zha khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'a zha rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang lugs gcig la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas/ zha lu byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang / brang ti mkhas btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan man sngar bzhin no/ /gter gzhung sor gnas kyi steng nas nos pa'i dbang chung ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rje bka' 'gyur ba nas/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lce blo ldan seng ge nas/ dge slong rin cen dpal/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ bla ma chos grags pa/ rje chos rgyal dpal bzang / rje rin cen seng ge /paṇa chen bsod nams blo gros/ shambha ba gsang bdag kun dga' sangs rgyas/ tshar chen man 'dra/ rgya —73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhang khrom gyi gter ma ltar na/gsabs chen nas/rgya zhang khrom/rog grags seng /rog sher dbang /lce mdo sde seng ge/rong pa rgya lo/rong pa sher seng /bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/bla ma kun dga' 'phel/bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/bla ma 51na ji pa la ldan legs dbang /bla ma rgyal dbang /bla ma bkra shis ye shes/bla ma chos bzang rgyal po/bla ma chos kyi 'od zer/'jam dbyangs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/rje bsod nams blo gros/shambha ra kun dga' sangs rgyas man 'dra/yang na rong pa sher seng nas/sras a ka ra sirnyi/dge slong rin cen dpal man 'dra/bka' ma ltar na gnubs sangasargyas ye shes nas/gnubs ston yon tan rgya mtsho/gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/gnubs mchog gi snying po/gnubs rgya gar rdo rje/dkon cog brtsegs pa/khro bo 'bar ba/dar ma rgyal/hūṃ wo la/rtsab lung gi jo bo 'byung gnas/shākya bzang po/stag sde 'jam dpal/bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/grub chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/bdag chen grags pa blo gros/kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang man 'dra/yang na dpyal kun mkhyen yan 'tshol/de nas yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs rgyal mchog/bdag chen grags pa blo gros man 'dra/yang na 'jam dpal khros pa/ye shesakyi mkha' 'gro ma/slob dpon padma/dha na saṃ zhu ta/bha su dha ra man 'dra/rgyud gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/gdubs chen nas sprul sku rgya shad khrom/gter ston dra nga kun gragasanas bzung ste 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan gyi bar brgyud pa sngon ma ltar la/de nas khyab bdag khra tshang pa wo po/des bdag za hor bande la'o//skrun las dang gtor chog gi brgyud pa ni/mthu chen bsod nams chos 'phel bzhugs pa'i dbang brgyud dang gcig go/thar rtse pa'i yi ge'i lung ni/thar rtse khu dbon/mkhan dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen 51bsko lu pa/des bdag la'o//rgya phur bu ni/gnam lcags rdo rje klu btul dang gtum mo thugs kyi rgyud nas 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku brnyes padma 'byung gnas kyis bcud phyung ste brag dmar phug pa tshal du rje mnga' bdag khri srong sde btsan gyi sku'i bsrung bar gnang ba lha btsan ltas phyi rabs kyi don du mon yul bum thang dge

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gnas dang sgyer chur gter du sbas pa las gter gnas la gras te mtshan btags pa dug khrag bum thang ma dang / nus stobs che bar bsngags pa'i lcags sdong ma ste rwa bsrung bum lcags gnyis zab chos gter ston chen po rgya phur bus spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ deng sang sngags rlom la la khrag rlon par btsan dug cig btab nas dug khrag yin zhes smra ba dang / rdzas bskam rwa cor bcug ste 'phyang drags su byed pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams ring du spangs nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdzas rgod sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis legs par bsgrub pa tshad ldan gyi snod du gtams pa la brten pa'i rwa bsrung bum lcags thun mong gi rjes gnang rdzas rgod dbang bskur khri stong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi ljags bsgrigs ma'i steng nas bskyed rim phog cing bzlas lung sngon du 'gro ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang legs par nos nas/ lung la/ bum lcags gnyis/ thun mong gi skor/cha lag tu nye bar mkho ba'i skor dang bzhi/ dang po la mnga' bdag gis slob dpon la zhus tshul gyi gleng gzhi dang zhus lan rgya gar rgya nag bal po sing nga'i yul sogs gang du yang 'di las lhag pa'i bsrung ba med ces bsngags pa brjod pa/ dug khrag sbyor ba'i bsrung ba ni/ zhes pa'i rdzas sbyor thabs/ sngagasakyi 'bru thems (52na〉pas tshogs mdor bstan pa'i mjug tu dam med la mi spel ba'i bka' rgya btab pa rnams/ de dag la dgos pa'i gnad drug gi rgyu mtshan mnga' bdag rgyal pos slob dpon la zhus tshul/ zhu lan la ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa rdzas kyi sel/ snod kyi khyad par/ sngags kyi ngar gso/ 'khor lo skor thabs/ las kyi mtha' bsgyur bstan pa mdor bsdus pa/ de'i 'phros las slob dpon gyis mnga' bdag chen po zhes bos nas dus kyi mtha' ma'i tshe sems can rnams tshe thung zhing nad rigs mang ba bsrung ba'i khyad par mchog tu zab pa dug khrag bsres dang rdzas dang ril bu'o/ /zhes bsrung ba'i gnyen po skor gsum gyi man ngag mtha' bsgyur khyad par 'phags pa'i chos drug yin zhes rdzogs tshig dang bcas te bstan pa rnams/ gnyis pa lcags sdong ma ni/ dug brgyad/ khrag brgyad/ sha brgyad/ dri brgyad de rtsa ba'i rdzas gnam lcags urmo bzhi sbyor du grags pa 'di las zab pa'i bsrung ba ni rgyal —73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nepos btsal kyang mi rnyed ces rdzogs tshig dang bcas te gsungs pa/ mtsho gsum gyi grogs skyobs kha gsog mchod rten la brten nas rang gzhan bsrung ba'i khyad par phyir bzlog rdzogs byang dang bcas pa rnams so/ /gsum pa thun mong gi skor la rdzas bsrung la brten nas skrang lhog /ro khur/ ban bon dang 'grel pa/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa bsrung thabs/ ser ba ri gtibs pa tsam 'babs pa'i kha bsgyur/lha lnga dgyes par byed pa/ rwa'i ngar 'don/ mtsho gsum la brten nas dug khrag sbyor thabs kyi gnad/spyod lam dang rdzas kyi ngar 'dogs pa/ las can snying 'dra'i slob bu la rjes su gnang ba'i yi ge de'i gsal byed lag (52ba〉spen gsang bdag rje drung bstan pa rgya mtshos bskul ba la brten nas chos rgyal dbang po'i sde mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i thob yig rin cen gter mdzod bum sdong gi rgya can/ desamadzad pa'i rdzas bsrung gi zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs pa chu srin gyi rgya can nam rnam par dbye ba rin chen ke ta ga'i phreng ba zhes pa/ 'khor lo snod/ u stir/ rkang dong / thun sa phur pa rnams kyi dpe'u ris rnams dang phyag len zhal shes rdzas kyi spyir btang dmigs bsal ngos 'dzin khyad par mtha' 'khob mu stegs pa'i skad du ha la dza ya zhes pa spyang dug gi 'khrungs dpe brtag thabs rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma dang bcas pa 'khrul med yid ches gdeng khel du thob pa las/ rdzas dbang dang las tshogs mdor bstan yan chad kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas/chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston chen po rgya phur bur rim par gdams pa'i bka' babs gter ston rgod kyi ldem phru/ mthu chen se ston mgon po bzang po/ mkhas grub chen po se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje spyan tshab pa mgon po zla ba/ mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na rigs 'dzin rgod ldem nas sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam —76

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamakha' rgyal mtshan/ rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong ltar/ (53na〉nga na thugs sras nas dran mchog dpal ldan blo gros/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can man gong bzhin no/ /sa bcad gsum pa yan gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bzhi pa cha lag tu nye bar mkho ba'i skor la/ bum thang skyer gnas nas rgya phur bus gdan drangs pa'i sngags kyi thems yig rgyas pa/ rtsa ba'i rdzas sna nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ngos 'dzin/ so sor phye ba gdon gyi 'jug sgo dang de sreg pa'i las sbyor/ ngar gso'i lhan thabs/ rang bsrung 'khor lo'i gsal byed/rdzas rgod bco lnga dang 'khor lo la brten pa'i bsrung ba ril bus bsrung ba rnams/ rwa dong gi snyan brgyud zur du bkod pa'i zab gnad yig chung la/ rdzas gtange mi gtang gi dbye ba/ phur ba'i bskyed chog gsang ba'i rdzas ngos 'dzin/ snod dang sngags kyi khyad par/ 'khor lo'i man ngag rnams bla chen chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rdzas kyi khyad par/ ting 'dzin med thabs med pa'i rdzas ngos 'dzin/ rdzas 'khor gyi rang bsrung / sham bu kha bsgyur gyi 'khor lo 'dogs tshul/ liṅga la brten nas gdon gnon pa/ zho chang bsrung ba/ rbod gtong bzlog pa/ ser bsrung / nad rims bsrung ba/ sri'u gso ba/ shwa bsgyur ba rnams o rgyan chen pos mnga' bdag la gdams pa'i gnad 'gag man ngag gi gser lta bu'i snying po phyung ba bu la phan phyir bsdebs pa/ des mdzad pa'i snod gsum/ rdzas sna/ skam sgrub rlon sgrub kyi zab gnad rwa dong snyan brgyud yang des(53ba)mdzad pa'i snod dang rdzas dang dngos gzhi gsum gyi gsal byed rwa thun snyan brgyud zin bris las can la phan thogs pa'i smon lam gyis mtha' brten dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku padma dbang chen/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar/ chos rgyal bo dong rin cen/nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal chen po/ rnam mkhyen yon tan 'byung gnas/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge /rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ byams pa —77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med dkon cog dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugasasras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can man gong ltar/ yang na bla chen nas/ chos rje rgyal mtshan seng rga grub thob gu ru sha ra/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rje man gong bzhin no/ /yang na rgyal mtshan seng ge nas rtsa brgyad pa blo gros bzang po/shrī pa mnyam med kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po man gong ltar ro/ /padma yang gsang yang gter ston ma brgyud par grub thob 'dar phyar gyis o rgyan la dngos su gsan pa ltar 'di skor yang de dang 'dra'am snyam mo/ /lha rje gnubs chung gis lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas yang bzlog me'i spu gri yang tshar gcig spyan drangs pa gong du song zin pa ltar dang / gzhan yang bum thang mgon po'i thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i phra men gyi las 'jig rten phung bar byed pa'i thabs nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang phyi pa mu stegs pa gnyis ka dang 'gal ba'i zab (54na)gnad la brten nas phyi nang gi bzlog pas kyang bzlog par mi nus pa'i dbang phyug sel nag gi rdzas 'khor mi nor zas gsum 'joms pa'i tho ba la nang gses kyi rdzas ngos 'dzin/ spang bya phan yon/ 'khor lo'i bri thabs dang bcas pa phyag len man ngag dmar 'khrid du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ rigs 'dzin padma 'byung gnas/gter ston lha rje gnubs chung / gnubs lha rje chos dar/ sgregs ban chen po/ la mo phug pa ba/ sras byang rgyal/ sangs rgyas dar/ glan rdzing bying pa/ gu ru sangs rgyas/ g.yung ban phug pa rin cen bzang po/ yongs ston rdo rje rin cen/ sngags44 dkon cog pa/ mnga' ris legs ldan rje/ yug mi 'gyur rje/ gu ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ de bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rje bla mas 'di phyag thog tu bkal bas zla ba dgu thog tu mtha' mi dpung bcas shig rjes med thal ba rlung khyer dngos su mthong ba'i nyams myong ma lags/ /rgya ston brtson 'grus seng ge dar ni —78—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul pa yin zhing / des spa gro cal gyi brag dmar stag tshang khol ma nas spyan drangs pa'i gshin rje gdong bdag bshan pa lag rengs sam/ rdo rje brag btsan nam jo bo a brag ces zhag bdun gyis bstan dgra tshar gcod par byed pa'i chos skor la/ 'byung khungs gleng gzhi lo rgyus/phyi rabs chad pho mo'i thod pa la brten nas bod rbad gsad gsum dril te bsgrub pa/ nang lug dmar gyi mgo la brten te bsgrub pa/ gsang ba ngang pa'i sgo nga la brten nas bsgrub pa/ spyan 'dren (54ba)mchod bskul gyi 'phrin las shar phyogs dur khrod ma/ gong gi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa thod pa/ me rdo rje/ dug khrag /sprul gyi rgya lnga yod do/ /sgrub pa'i lag len la dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi/ liṅga pho mo'i 'khor lo/ bla rdo rnams dus kyi mtha' ma la rnal 'byor pa chos byed du mi ster ba'i tshe dgra bo myur du phung ba'i thabs mnan gtad kyis btsal ba kong yul mthil gshin rje dong kha'i gnas lugs dkar chag slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ gdong bdag bshan pa lag dmar dbyar dgun ston dpyid rgyal sogs ri mtsho gang la gnas dang / thebs bzlog ngos 'dzin/ bal po gu ya tsanda'i 'khor lo'i zhal gdams sngags byang / ral pa tshar dgu'i mngon rtogs/ las rdugs na bya ba'i sngags byang rab tu gsang ba rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni mu stegs kyi ston pa bshes gnyen phung lung gi ā tsarla nag po/ bal po gu ya tsand+ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dar/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rin po che chos kyi blo gros/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ sngags 'chang rnam rgyal rdo rje/ 'bri gung zur pa rin cen phun tshogs/snang gsal pa bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/ zur mthu stobs dbang phyug gzhen nu don grub/ de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dngo na 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes man gong ltar ro/ /gnyags ston lha 'bar gyi gter chos ni ma thob bo/ /(55na)—79—

gangs bar phug mo che nas rgya ston padma dbang phyug gis spyan drangs pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i skor/gsol 'debs las/rgyal mchog dbyangs sprul padma dbang phyug dang //gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan snye mo ba//grub thob dngos grub dge bshes dri 'dzin tshes/gru gu yang dbang zhes rnams la gsol ba 'debs/zhes pa'i rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sprul pa padma dbang phyug ni/thang yig las lha khang nang du 'bri yis rta chu blud zho klung nang du me yi 'jigs pa dang 'byung :dpal mo'i thang du mtshon gyi char pa 'bab gangs bar phug mor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung :gter ston padma dbang phyug ces bya 'byung :zhes e gangs bar phug mo che nas rgya ston padma dbang phyug gis spyan drangs pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po ོ po gur gyi mgon po'i skor la/slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas mchims phur mdzad pa'i dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabasadregs pa zil gnon/gshin rje pra khog snang gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam can srung ma chos skyong la ru mtshon 'dzugs thabs o rgyan mkhan pos gud du bkol ba zhar byung 'phrin bcol mchog gsum ma dang bcas pa/dam bdar 'phrin bcol gyi rim pa slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis jo mo mkhar rṣa bza' la gdams pa/dam can nang mi zhabrug pa'i phyir snying chu bsre thabs yon to rab rgyas slob dpon padmas bkod pa/chos skyong gi srog 'phrog pa/bcing ba/khyi bzhin 'khrid pa/mi 'bren pa/rtsal 'gran du gzhug pa'i zab pa'i gnad lnga'i man ngag slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi gdams pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang 'phags55ba ) mchog klu sgrub/slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ga lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ga kho rsā rgya padma dbang ༷༷/lho pa rsā nyi/rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yi ga gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaphyug/mkhas pa yon tan khri/mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/rnal 'byor dbang phyug seng ge rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/yab 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/bdag wo rdo rje la4 blo gros rgyal mas/mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/tshar rsā chosakyi rgyal po/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/rdo rje 44 dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba rṣa po/rigs 'dzin chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//bla ma sog bzlog pas bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa'i mgon pod me 'bar ma'i zab gnad mtha' dag gangs bar phug mo che'i gter ma yin zer ba ni me 'bar nang gi rgya bod kyi bla ma so sos mdzad pa'i sgrub skor rnams gter ma min pa mngon sum gyis grub cing /gcen bdag chen rgya dkar ba ni phur pa gtso bor mdzad pa las mgon po la man ngag thun mong ba las rdzogs par gsan 'phros mi 'dug/mgon po'i skor la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa ni gcung rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan yin zhing me 'bar ma la rdo rje 'chang gis dkar chag mdzad nas bsgrigs pa yin pas sku mched su yin kyang rtsad ma chod par gdams pa'i gnad rnams rtogs rgyu'i lugs kyi rdzun zob 'di ka khyod kyis brtsamasachos kun la yod na snag shog gi gron tsam du zad do//gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan ni/mtsho rgyal gyis mdzad 56na ) pa'i thems las/las can shes rab snying rje can gyi mi rgyal ba mchog dbyangs skye mtha'i sems dpa' ni phag sbrul stag sprel lo pa gcig la sprod ces pa ltar/ngan lam rgyal ba mchog gi sprul sku 'di'i gter chos kyi nang tshan bla ma zhi drag gi chos skor ni/thems yig las/chos sku yang dag rtsa ba'i mtshan rgya dang :'gag med longs sku mtshan mchog brgya rtsa brgyad mtha' yas sprul pa'i mtshan ni stong la sogs gang la gang 'dul skur bstan brjod las 'das de ltar mtha' yas mdzad pa'i sku re la'ang :sgrub thabs re dang las tshogs bsam 'das kyang :dril nas bstan na sgrub thabs gsum du 'dus phyi ltar dge slong tshul du sgrub pa dang :/nga ltar rdo rje 'cha du sgrub pa dang :gsang ba ltar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedu rta phag zhal sbyor ro de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa yi bla ma nang sgrub yang gsang don gyi skor sgrub thabs 'di la chos sde nyi shu bdun sgo 'byed dbang gnyis phyi nang las byang gnyis sgom pa'i lha brgyad mtshan brgyad sgrub thabs dang : spyan mang drag sgrub gsang sgrub thugs sgrub dang : bla ma rigs 'dus bla ma yang gsang dang : rin cen gter spungs la sogs nyer bdun no: zhes gsungs pa ltar mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i man ngag zab cing 'dus pa shin tu zab pa'i skor rnams ji skad du/rin cen gter 'di chu mo phug tu sbas smon lam mthu btsan ma 'ongs dus mtha' la las can zhig dang chos 'di phrad par shog ces dang / lar ni chu phug mo yig gter chos rnams shā gi ye shes 'tsho rgyal gter kha yin gzhan du ma sbas mon gyi chu phug mor yid bzhin (56ba〉dor bu yan lag tshang bar sbas zhes pa ltar o rgyan chen po'i 'phrin las kyi sprul pa gter ston chen po shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis mon gyi brag mtha' phra ma dpal gyi chu mo phug lha mo wā phya gar byed pa 'dra ba'i gsang gnas nas spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ thog mar zab rgyas gter chen tshe dbang bcud len dang zab rgyas tshe dbang / phyag mtshan rdzas kyi dbang phyag mtshan gyi dbang chu ma rnyed pas bsdus pa'i lugs bskur tshig sngags kyi steng nas/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ bum dbang rig pa'i rgyal po/ phyag mtshan rdzas dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / spyan mang / bzhi pa tshig dbang / dam tshig rjes su gnang ba/rdo rje rgyal po mtha' rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par thob/ rtsa gsum gtor dbang gi dbang chu/rtsa gsum gtor dbang zhal gdams gnyis kyi steng nas gtor dbang / drag sgrub kyi da brnga chog rdo rje 'phreng ba'i steng nas/ drag po ya ka me dbal dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa lha bco brgyad kyi dbang thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa tshe 'gugs gnyis kyi steng nas tshe dbang thob cing / lung gi skor la/ thems yig /dbang gi skor/ kha skong skor/ sgrub thabs skor/ las tshogs skor/ sku gsum gab pa mngon phyung / jo mo'i sgrub skor/ bstod 'phrin mdos skor/ gshin don skor/ sme brtsegs sgrub skor/ tshe sgrub skor/ gter bdag skor dang bcu gnyis/ dang po ni/ chu mo phug —82

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnagi thems byang bsdus pa/ gdams skor gyi thems yig rgyas pa/ gnyis pa dbang gi skor la/ rtsa gsum gtor dbang padma'i gtor dbang yin/ zhes pa ltar/ rtsa gsum (57na skotor dbang gi dbang chu/ de'i thems med la/ rtsa gsum gtor dbang zhal gdams/ rin cen tshe dbang bla ma'i spyi dbang yin/ zhes pa la/ zab rgyas rin cen tshe dbang / gter chen de'i thems med la/ zhal gdams zab rgyas tshe dbang 'cho chen rnams/ gsum pa/ kha skong skor la/ phyi'i kha skong dang nang gi kha skong gnyis/ dang po ni/nor bu rgya mtsho phyi yi kha skong yin/ zhes pa ltar bla ma'i las byang nor bu rgya mtsho gu ru'i phyi sgrub thor bu thems med la/ mngon rtogs nor bu sgron ma/ mngon rtogs rin cen sgron ma/ nang sgrub thod 'phreng rigs lnga'i sgrub pa gtsug gi nor bu/ thod skul la brten nas rigs lnga so sor sgrub pa/ bsrung skud kyi las tshogis/ thig le bsrung ba/ mtshon bsrung ba/ 'byung po bskrad pa/ cang te'i las tshogis thod 'phreng rtsal rigs lnga'i mngon rtogs bde ba'i 'khor lo rnams/ gnyis pa nang gi kha skong ni/ thugs kyi las byang nang gi kha skong yin/ zhes pa ltar gsang ba thugs kyi las byang / slob dpon padma'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rtags rim dang bcas pa/ de'i sgrub bsnyen yang gsang snying gi sgrub pa rtags rim dang bcasapa/ mthar thug lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs rig gsal sgron ma rnams/ bzhi pa sgrub skor la/ mtshan brgyad sgrub pa/ spyan mang sgrub pa/ gu ru drag sgrub/ thugs sgrub skor gsum dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mtshan brgyad mngon rtogs rang lus tshags 'dzud yin/ zhes pa ltar gu ru padma rgyal po'i mngon rtogs/ blo ldan mchog sred kyi mngon rtogs/ thugs rje rṣa po kun khyab nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi mngon rtogs/ shākya seng ge'i mngon rtogs/ padma saṃ bha'i (57bsgo rga rtogs/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i mngon rtogs/ gu ru seng ge sgra sgrogs kyi mngon rtogs/ gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyi mngon rtogs rdo rje pha lam/ mas brgyad du sgrub pa zab pa'i khyad chos yin/ zhes pa la/ padma rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rtags rim dang bcas pa/ de'i lasatshogs la/ rgyal po/ btsun mo/ mi nor zas gsum rnams dbang sdud/ dug nad gi zhi byed/ rimasand bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba las kyi mtha' rgyas rnams so/ /gu ru blo ldan mchog sred kyi sgrub —83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shethabs rtags rim dang bcas pa/ de'i las tshogos la/ nyams rtogs spel ba/nyen mongs zhi byed/ chu la mi bying ba/ mes mi 'tshig pa/rdo la grub rtags 'jog pa/ rkang mgyogs sgrub pa/ rkang pa la ser ga mi 'byung ba/ rdzas kyi gtum mo/ rims bsrung ba/ dug nib/ gzhan sems shes pa/ mtshon bsrung ba phur kha ngan sngags bsrung ba/ mig mthong sgrub pa/ mig mi phyid pa/ mig gi rab rib sel ba/ rna ba mi 'on pa'i thabs/ tshe bsring pa/ longs spyod sgrub pa/ nad pa mi 'chi ba/ bsam tshad 'grub pa/ bar chad bsrung ba/ sman ma bslabs par shes pa'i thabs shes bya mtha' dag la mkhas pa/ ser ba bsrung ba/shu ba zhi byed/ dbang sdud srid spel ba/ bu tsha gsob/ sbyin sreg dang gtor ma la brten na stobasadang nus pa spel ba/ dgra bgegs brlag pa/ char 'bebs/ lha srin sde brgyad kyis mi mthong ba'i sgrib shing / stag dang sprul gyis mi tshugs pa rnams so/ /gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyi sgrub pa rtags rim dang bcas pa/ de'i las tshogis la/ dag byed stobs chen chu'i sgrub pa/ 'gro ba'i tshe sgrub pa/ 'gro ba byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i thabs/ shākya seng ge'i sgrub thabs rtags(5ni)rim dang bcas pa padma saṃ bha wa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje sgrub thabs thig le kun gsal rtags rim/ bsnyen pa'i bzlas thabs kyi sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal thabs dang bcas pa bde ba lhun grub tu grags pa/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrog gi sgrub thabs rtags dang bcas pa/ 'di'i las tshogs la/ mu stegs ru tra gdul ba/ pha rol nus pa zhi ba/ ngag mnan pa/ mu stegs ru tra bran du bkol ba/ mu stegs ru tra'i dpung bzhig pa/ mdun gros bshig pa/ dgra bgegs rengs su bcug pa/dgra bgegs lha dang phral ba/ dgra bgegs bskrad pa'i man ngag /mu stegs kyi ngan sngags bsrung ba/mu stegs 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pa/ rtsod pa rgyal ba rnams so/ /gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyi phyi sgrub nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang / drag po thog mda' lta bu'i sngags rgod bstod pa/ de'i las tshogs la/ rdzas mchog bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa bsrung ba rnams/gnyis pa spyan mang sgrub pa ni/ spyan mang sgrub thabs gnam lcags spu gri yin/ zhes pa ltar spyan —84

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ rtog)mang zhi ba'i sgrub thabs thugs rje kun gzigs/ spyan mang zhi ma khro'i sgrub pa/ de'i las tshogos/ me sto/ chu sto/ chu'i lha mo sgrub pa/ lam gyi dgra dang 'jigs pa bsrung ba/ 'gro ba dbang sdud/ sri'u gsob/ phur kha bsrung ba/ gtor ma gtang ba rnams so/ /spyan mang khro bo'i sgrub pa gnam lcags spu gri las sbyor dang bcas pa/ de'i las tshogs me lto/ chu lto/ tshad nad zhi ba/ chu la mi bying ba/ chu gdon pa/ mi rgod bcing pa/ mi nor zas gsum dbang sdud/ (58ba)sri'u gso ba/ phur kha bsrung ba/ mdze rgyud gcod pa/ gri 'thab gcod pa/ sri brgyud gcod pa/ skye brgyud gcod pa/ sde brgyad bsrung ba/ rims bsrung ba/gtor chog rdzogs rim rnams so/ /gsum pa gu ru drag sgrub ni/ gu ru drag sgrub kun 'joms rdo rje yin/ zhes pa ltar drag sgrub kyi dbang chog rdo rje'i 'phreng ba ya ka me dbal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'di'i las tshogs la/ rgyal 'gong gdul ba dang 'khor los rgyal 'gong bsrung ba/ bdud rigs gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ btsan rigs gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ ma mo gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ sa bdag klu gnyan gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ gshin rje gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ drang srong gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ klu bdud gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ klu btsan gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ gshin 'dre gdul ba dang bsrung ba/ rims nad bsrung ba/ ser ba gcod pa/ chu bzlog pa/ phur kha bsrung ba/ gzhen sri bsrung ba/ rang lus sgrib pa/ thog bsrung ba rnams so/ /gu ru drag po ya ka me dbal du sgrub pa le'u bcu gcig pa/ ya ka me dbal gyis las sgrub reg chod ma'i spu gri zhes pa 'di la tshe'i bar chad sel ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi nad rims bsrung ba/dug sbyor bsrung ba/ mtshon bsrung ba/ smyo bog gdul ba/ rbod gtor byad kha bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ thog bsrung ba ri bong byi ba 'bu bsrung ba/ sri can gnod pa bsrung ba/ sri rkun bsrung ba rnams so//slob dpon padma'i drag sgrub rtags rim gtor 'bul dang bcas pa/ ya ka me dbal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa/ de'i las tshogis la/ g.yul las rgyal ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ chu sna sgyur ba/(59na skoṇa gnon/ lam gyi 'jigs pa bsrung ba/ che sri chung sri bsrung ba/ mi nad phyugs nad bsrung —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheb/ rkun po bsrung ba/ sha ma 'don pa/ zho chang nyes pa bsrung ba/ 'gong po'i nyal rogs bsrung ba/bsam pa 'grub pa/ lha mi byams shing yid du 'ong ba'i thabs/ rdzogs rim rnams so/ /bla ma drag po lcags sdig tu byon pa'i sku thog gi 'phreng ba'i sgrub thabs rtags rim dang bcaspopa/ 'di'i las tshogos la/ sri'u gsob/ dkor 'gong bskrad pa/ nor la rgyal po bsrung ba/ srid largyal po bsrung ba/ thog dang ser ba bsrung ba/ pe dkar sde brgyad gdul ba rnams so/ /bzhi pa thugasasgrub skor gsum ni/ thugs sgrub skor gsum gsang ba'i man ngag yin/ zhes pa ltar thugs sgrub rang byung don gsal/ phyi spros bcas rdul tshon la brten nas sgrub pa thugs sgrub nor bu'i snying po/ nang spros med tshom bu la brten nas sgrub pa thugs sgrub nor bu'i snying po/ gsang ba shin tu spros med gtor ma la brten te skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed pa thugs sgrub nor bu'i snying po/ sgrub thabs 'di gsum tshe 'dir bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag yin no/ /'chi khar bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag /bar dor bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag /thugs sgrub nor bu snying po lha lnga las tshogs dang bcas pa/ thugs sgrub gter gyi snying po/ rtags rim gtor 'bul dang bcas pa/ ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas sbyor/ 'gro ba dbang sdud/lung pa dbang sdud/shes rab ma 'gugs pa/ sri'u gso ba/ ser ba bsrung ba'i man ngag /srid btsal ba/shwa bzlog pa/ phur kha bsrung ba/ 'gom chog bsrung ba/ khyim gyi dgra bsrung ba rnams so/ /(59ba)bla ma rigs 'dus sgrub pa/ slob dpon padma'i gsang sgrub chen po/ 'di'i las tshogs la/ stong gsum pho brgyud dbang sdud/ mo brgyud dbang sdud/ sbyin sreg /gsang sgrub nang gi rgyun gyi gtor ma/ tshwa tshwa/ser ba bsrung ba/ rims bsrung ba/ god kha bsrung ba/ thog bsrung ba/ phur kha bzlog pa/ ngag 'grol ba/ sri'u gsob/ gu ru gsang sgrub rta phag zhal sbyor gyi sgrub pa/ de'i las tshogos/ nad gdon zhi ba/'bu srin bsrung ba/ rims bsrung ba/ tshe bsod rgyas pa/ rigs brgyud spel ba/ lha mi byams shing zas nor dbang du sdud pa/ dgra dpung zhi ba/ sde brgyad sgrub shing / phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba rnams so/ /lnga pa las tshogis skor la/ rta mgrin las tshogis/ bla ma yang gsang gi las tshogs dang —86

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)gnyis/ dang po ni/ rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon gyi las tshogs brgya pa zhes pa gong bsnyen la brten nas don kun 'grub pa/ 'phreng ba byin brlab/ zas sgom bdud rtsir bsgyur ba/ chos dbang du 'du ba/sku dbang du 'du ba/ mchod rdzas dbang du 'du ba/ bza' btung dbang du 'du ba/ lo stong thub pa/ mig gsal ba/ rna ba gsang ba/ rkang lag la ser kha mi gas pa/ dug sprul khyi spyon gyi dug mi ldang ba/ chang gi mi gzi ba/ zhing gi 'bu bsrung ba/ char 'bebs pa/ rlung gnon/ sris rkun bsrung ba/ ser bsrung /ri bong sogs ri dwags kyis zhing mi za ba/ mngal khrag 'byams pa gcod pa/ thig le bsrung ba/ shwa 'od bsrung ba/ shig bsrung ba/ khyi bsrung ba/ zhing gi 'bu bsrung ba rigs mi gcig pa/ dug zhi ba/rims bsrung ba/ phur kha bsrung ba/ 'brum pa dang bal nad bsrung ba/ cham pa (60na)bsrung ba/ srid mi chags pa/ lusang ga yid gsum bcings pa/ 'grol ba/ mdze rigs gcod pa/ rgyal 'gong 'don pa/ spur nag ma bsrung ba/ lud med par lo skye ba/ gcan gzan bsrung ba/ sro long sel ba/ dam sri 'don pa/ srid ngan 'don pa/ srid ngan bsrung ba/ khye'u chags pa/ lam bsrung ba/ dgra reng ba/ pho 'dre bsrung ba/ lha 'dre mi gsum sgrib pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyis mthong bar byed pa/ /mna' chad bsrung ba/ zhakhyu ba gcod pa/ phyugs nad bsrung ba/ lug nad bsrung ba/ chang 'dre bsrung ba/ dkar 'dre bsrung ba/ ba mo bsrung ba/ sad bsrung ba/ bya rgod dar ma'i nyin lam re chod pa/ khyi shig bsrung ba/skad thams cad shes pa/ dus thams cad du rgyan rgyal ba/ gshin rje bsrung ba/ lha gdon bsrung ba/ma mo'i gdon rims bsrung ba/ bdud bsrung ba/ yi dwags bsrung ba/ btsan bsrung ba/ 'byung po bsrung ba/ mi dang mi ma yin bsrung ba/ ngag lkugs pa/ mig mthong dbang po mi ldang ba/ zhag nyer gcig la gsod pa/ mkhar 'jigs pa/ gnyen dang bral ba/ bkra shis shing don 'grub pa rnams/gnyis pa bla ma yang gsang gi las tshogs ni/ bla ma yang gsang snying po rgyun 'khyer yin/ zhes pa ltar bla ma yang gsang thugs sgrub snying po rgyun 'byer/ rin cen gter dpung tshogs gsog kha skong yin/zhes pa'i gu ru'i las tsho gis rin po che'i gter mdzod 'di la/ bla ma'i thugs rjes sems nyid chos—87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neskur sgrub pa/ gu ru shākya seng ges mtshon zhabrugs zhi byed bsam 'phel rdo rje/ gu ru shākya rdo rjes mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun zhi byed/ gu ru shākya rin cen gyis tshe (60ba)dang bsod nams rgyas par byed pa/ gu ru shākya dri med kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ gu ru shākya bdud 'dul gyis gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gdul ba/ gu ru shākya rnon pos mtshon bzlog cing g.yul las rgyal ba/ gu ru shākya kun skyob kyis 'gro ba kun la skyabs sbyin pa/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhis sems can bde bar skyong ba/ gu ru shākya seng ge 'khor dang bcas pas 'gro ba bde bar bya ba/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyis 'gro ba'i dug lnga zhi ba/ gu ru tshe dbang rgyal pos 'gro ba'i tshe 'phel ba/ gu ru bde ba'i myu gus 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum bde bar bya ba/ gu ru ya ka me dbal gyis brgyal rengs spyo bog 'byung po gdon kun zhi bar bya ba/ gu ru padma rdo rjes chung sri bsrung ba/ gu ru padma ka ras lha srin ma lus rlag par byed pa/ gu ru thor cog dgu pas 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi ba/ gu ru dri med snying pos 'gro ba'i grib dang mi gtsang ba zhi bar byed pa/ gu ru 'bar ba'i me tog gis mdze nad rab tu zhi ba/ gu ru 'gro ba yid la bcags kyis phyugs nad rab tu zhi ba/ gu ru padma rgyal pos 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpal dang byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba/gu ru mthong na dga' bas bza' bsang bsgrub pa/ gu ru gter bzhad rtsal gyis nor dang longs spyod sgrub pa/ gu ru nyi ma'i 'od ldan gyis srid gsum snang ba gsal bar byed pa/ gu ru srid gsum rgyal pos rang lus yid bzhin nor bur bya ba/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis mche ba can kha bcing ba/ gu ru 'jigasapa thams cad dang bral bsal ma gyi 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba/ padma mtsho skyes rdo rjes shes rab mas nyan par bya ba/ gu ru ya ka rdo rjes dpe dkar brlag par bya ba/ gu ru ro langs bde (61na)bas dam sri mo brlag par bya ba/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyis btsan gyi gnod pa zhi ba/ gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis bdud 'dul ba/ gu ru rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis klu bdud 'dul zhing klu bdud kyis mi mthong ba/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug gis gshin 'dre bsrung ba/ gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyis lha 'dre rgyu srang gcad pa/ gu ru blo ldan mchog sred kyis shig bsrung ba/ gu ru blo ldan mchog sred kyis shes rab thogs med —88—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabasgrub pa/ mi pham rdo rje gru gzings mi rdib nor bu rnyed pa/ padma dri med rtsal gyis char pa dbab pa/klu'i dbang pos lung pa skam por chu dbab pa/ ratna thod 'phreng rtsal gyis 'bru'i char pa dbab pa/ padma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis srid btsal ba lte bsgyur ba/ da rma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis dgra bo rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad pa/ burnya thod 'phrong rtsal gyis dgra bo lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa/ rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal gyis rang gi lusang ga yid gsum nus pa dang ldan par bya ba/ gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyis ser bas lo tog gzhom pa/ gu ru seng ge sgra sgrogs kyis dgra bo'i khyim bshig pa/ gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyis dgra bo'i zhing la lo tog mi skye ba/ rdo rje gro lod kyis dgra bo mthun pa 'byed pa/ rdo rje gro lod kyis dgra bo spyo zhing 'bog par byed pa/ seng ge sgra sgrogs kyis pha rol lkugs pa/ blo ldan mchog sred kyis sho rgyan rgyal ba/ rdo rje 'jigs med rtsal gyis thog bsrung ba/rdo rje rnon po rtsal gyis ser ba bzlog cing rgyu srang gcad pa/ padma don grub rtsal gyis sad bsrung ba/ padma zhal gyis kha ba bsrung ba/ 'khor lo zhabs kyisamagyogs par bya ba/ padma snying po rtsal gyis mig kha bas mi phyid pa/ bdud rtsi rtsal gyis skyes (61ba)bu chang gis mi gzi ba/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis 'gro ba'i don thams cad rab tu 'grub par byed pa/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang / drag po rnams kyi sbyin sreg re re/ gu ru padma /bha was 'khor ba thamasacad spang bya 'dzin dor med par bla ma sgrub pa'i las tshogs rnams so/ /drug pa sku gsum gab pa sngon byung la/ 'dod chags lam 'byer sprul sku'i sar 'khrid pa'i gab pa sngon byung zhe sdang lam 'byer longs sku'i sar 'khrid pa'i gab pa sngon byung / gti mug lam 'byer chos sku'i sar 'khrid pa'i gab pa mngon phyung rnams rtsa dang thig le sbyang spel zab pa mthar thug /bdun pa jo mo'i sgrub skor la/ mkhar chen mtsho'i sgrub thabs/ mkha' 'gro yang gsang gtsug rgyan/ 'di'i las tshogs la/ mes mi 'tshig pa/ chu la mi bying ba/ sal 'bigs pa/ rdo la rdzob/ mo rigs 'du ba/ pho rigs dbang sdud/ zas nor dbang sdud/ mi rgod gcan gzan gyi zil gyis gnon pa/ dmag dpung 'bros pa/ zho chang nyes pa bsrung ba/ chang spel/ srid 'phel ba/ ser ba srung ba/ 'bu srin byi ba —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ri bong bsrung ba/chom rkun bsrung ba/dgra'i phyugs gas pa/dgra bo brgyal zhing rengs nas 'gum pa/bum sgrub/sku gsung thugs rten la me rtag chags pa/gzhen sri bsrung ba/rbod gtong bsrung ba rnams/brgyad pa bstod tshon mdos skor la/slob dpon padma'i bstod pa rin cen gter dpung 'di la 'bus bstod/1gu ru la lha lcam mas ra bas 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas bstod pa/2khyad 'phagasalnga'i sgo nas bstod pa/3gu ru la ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis yon tan drug gi sgo nas bstod pa/4rtags bstod/5gu ru padma 'khor 62na khong bcas pa la mtsho rgyal gyis bstod pa/6 slob dpon rṣa po la o rgyan gyi rgyal po pra wa ga rtis bstod pa/brjod bya mas gyis sgo nas bstod pa/ma ra bsadangos grub kun 'byung gi sgo nas bstod pa/gu ru la dur khrod kyi bdag pos bstod pa/gu ru la ind+ra bo dhis bstod pa/ma gcig bkra shis skyid kyis skyon spangs yon tan ldan pa'i bstod pa/sku la bram ze dhe ba shrīs bstod pa/gu ru la mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis thugs rjes tshogos kyi 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/gu ru lha srin sde brgyad kyis dngos grub brnyes pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/gu ru la bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis bstod pa/gu ru la chos rgyal khri srong lde btsun gyis bstod pa/gu ru la btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bstod pa/gu ru la sras mu tig btsan pos bstod pa/gu ru la ma gcig shel dkar bzas phren las zhu gsol/gu ru la chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis 'phrin las su gsolab/gu ru la mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyis 'phrin las su gsol pa/gu ru'i sgrub mdos/rigasa'adzin gyi bskang mdos/mkha' 'gro ma'i grib mdos rnams/dgu pa gshin don skor la/gshin don thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ro sreg snang gsal sgron ma/me bkra gsal ba'i sgron ma sbugs bshig rnams/bcu pa sme brtsegs sgrub pa la/khro bo smre brtsegs chen po'i sgrub thabs/'di'i las tshogis la/nad grib/dme grib/dam grib/nal yugs kyi grib/nyamasagrib/gos stan gyi grib/gnas grib/zas grib/snod grib/gzhan don du grib sel ba khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i 62bsgo ngon rtogs kyi las byang /༷sa/bcu gcig pa tshe sgrub la/tshe sgrub bdud rtsi

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogana'akhyil pa/tshe sgrub rgyun 'byer rdzogs rim dang bcas pa/gsang sgrub tshe dbang gi nyams 'a/tshe sgrub yang gsang snying bcud hrīḥgacig ma/'di'i las tshogs la/mi'i tshe 'khor/phyugs kyi tshe 'khor/'chi ba brtag pa/bzlog pa/bye brag tu bzlog pa/tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i dbang chog 'chi med tshe'i gdams pa 'od lnga dril ba'i tshe sgrub rgyun 'byer/ngo mtshar bdud rtsi mar khu/'di la rdzob/ril ma/rus pa/rdo lham rnying rnams kyi mar khus nad sel/bcud len bdud rtsi'i 'phreng ba/'di la gtum mo'i bcud len/cung zhi/sa/bdud rtsi tshan/bye ma/dbang lag/'om bu/bdud rtsi chen po/utpal/chu/rdo/glang sna/spang sa/lce dza' bas len re re yod/'jam dpal shes rab 'dzin rpā rnams/bcu gnyis pa gter bdag skor la/gter bdag sgos sgrub srog gi spu gri reg chod/gter bdag gi mdos/rab gnas bde legs lhun grub ma rnams kyi dbang lung yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i zhi ba'i skor gyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/sprul sku tshe brtan rgyal mtshan nam chos kyi blo gros/tsa ri ba shis pha la/zur pa shākya 'byung gnas/'brom ston tshe dbang rgyal po/mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/sngags 'chang legs pa dpal bzang /nyang ston chos kyi dbang phyug/gnubs ston rin cen dpal bzang /bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang /yabs sa gras padma yang zer/paṇa 63na ) chen padma dbang rgyal/rje btsun sprul sku ོ po padma rgyal po legs ldan rje/drin can tshe ring dbang po/klu grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/mkhas grub khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag za hor bande la'o//drag po'i skor gyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku padma dbang chen/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas man sngar bzhin no//drag po ya ka me dbal gyi dbang dang las byang gi lung bskyar ba'i brgyud pa ni/klu sgrub pa nas/bkra bzang pa rtse ston nam mkha' rigs 'dzin/bkra bzang pa rtse ston rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal/khra sgo pa wo po blo ma rdzo rdo rje/des bdag la'o//spyan mang zhi ba zhi drag byed ma/drag po rnams kyi sgrub thabasaXs tshogs kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig la/klu sgrub

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje nas/rdo rje gong mgon po bsod nams ma rdzo ldan/kho stod blo ma rdzo rdo rje/des bdag za sto gyi bande la'o//chos sde 'di'i gral du mi gtags pa'i ga kho kha gcig pa la/mar bsrung rdo rje'i go cha/sgrol ma u pa la'i 'phreng ba zhes pa la/lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/sgrub pa'i bar gcod rgyal po'i chad pa/dug sbrul gyi 'jigs pa/chu'i 'jigs pa/me'i 'jigs pa/sha za'i 'gas pa/lce 'a pa ge lcagasasgrog/gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa/lam gyi 'jigs pa rnams bsrung ba/byis pa gsob/dbul phongs sel ba/mar bsrung /thog ser bsrung ba dang cas thob pa yang klu sgrub rje nas/ zur rsā ngag dbang phun tshogs/mkhas grub khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//sprul sku tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis rong gi dzo lhud mo nas63ba'i na drangs pa'i rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung gi dmag bzlog mi mthun kun sel la nang gses kyi bsnyen pa/las sbyor la lung pa chen po bsrung ba/gang zag sgo gcig bsrung ba/rnal 'byor gar 'gro'i lam bsrung ba/lag len rgyas par bstan pa la rin cen nyi zla'i gnad/mnan bsregs bzlog pa'i gnad/bskul tshig dam bdar gyi gnad/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dusapa'i rta gnas kyi gnad/mi phyugs bsrung ba chu gtsang gi gnad/sgrib shing gi gnad/rtags kyi gnad de bdun gyis bstan pa rnams phyag len dmar 'khrid dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/legs ldan rje yan gong ltar la/de nas chos rgyal ma sgo'i mas can/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/zur ོ chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//ga kho kha 'di'i bskyed pa bzhi ldan gyi bsrung ba yang zur rtsa ba'i bla mar zhus so// 9

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagater ston snye mo rgya gong ri pa sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis gter du bzhes pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgub kyi chos skor/gter gzhung las/kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung :padma 'byung gnas bdag gis ni 'gro ba'i don du gter du sbas skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog ces gsungs pa ltar rta mgrin gyi rgyud brgya dang brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las btus te lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang khyad par rgyal po dang dpe dkar dkor 'dre 'dul ba'i gnyen por sgrub thabs man ngag tu bsdebs pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi chos skor snye mor gter du sbas pa las can gyi gter ston snye mo rgya gong ri pa sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis snye mo gzhu yas gnod sbyin 'bar ga kho ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs na zur du mi 'dug pasa'adi dang ga mi kha'adra/spyan drangs shing dpal ldan shangs pa bka' 64na ) brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyasa'adebs brgyud pa rin cen sna bdun du grags pa'i nang tshan gyi lnga pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ges shing rta dgun zla ra ba'i tshe bcu bdun gyi tho rengs yi gu'i rmi lam la brten nas slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang mjal te rgyal gdon gyi gnyen po'i dpal rta mgrin zhig zhusapas 'di gnang ste gsang sgrub zab mo//deng sang gter nas thon yod pas zhus shig pa'i lung bstan byung bar brten gsan pa'i shog ser chig brgyud dang rmi lam 'od gsal gyi brgyud pa gnyis ka tshang ba'i skor la/dkyil 'khor gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku padma dbang chen/sprul sku padma saṃ bha wa/gter ston rgya gong ri pa sangs rgyas dbang wo/skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/sangs rgyas gnyan ston/'gro mgon chos rje ston pa 4sa rtsa tha' tsong ra/gtsang ma shaXs ston/mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/khyung po

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (netshul khrims mgon po/ri khrod pa sangs rgyas seng ge/sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang /drin ༅ sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/rdo rje 'chang sgo pa chos rje/thams༅ ma' pa khu brtse'i dbang phyug/'khor lo'i mgon po dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams ma rdzo ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na rje dbang rab nas khyab bdag zha lu ba rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub/des bdag la'o//yang na mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum nas/'jag rṣa pa/mkhas btsun 64bcud zer ba/byang sems kun dga' chosayi/mon rdzongs ras pa/ma' rab chos rje/rje gzha rdo rje ring pa/sgo wo man 'dra/yang na rgyal mas 'bum nas chos rje byams pa dpal/'jag wo blo gros dpal bzang /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal po/kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/rje rin cen rnam rgyal/paṇa chen dngos grub dpal 'bar/bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/yang na khyung po tshul khrims mgon po nas 'jam dbyangs thugs rje chos rgyal/pha rgod don yod rgyal mas/de sras rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/de sras thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/chos rje yon to mchog/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/gyer lha btsun lha dbang rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'gro mgon chos rje ston pa nas/bya bto ri khrod ras rsā/bya bto tshul khrims shes rab/khyung po tshul khrims mgon man 'dra/rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho yan chad rang bstan la rta mgrin 'di'i dar so med 'dug pas brgyud khungs sna tshogs 'dren pa gas 'drid kyi go tsam mo//yang na ri khrod pa sangs rgyas seng ge nas shangs dkar ba rin la rgyal mas/kung lung pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang /rab brgyan chos lung pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog/bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/sger pa ba ngag dbang nyi ma rigs man nga skru dbang po yis brgyad gas pa' gsang 4'a dbang ོ tshab grub rtse la zer//la sku bsod nams dbang phyug zha lu pa chen po/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)des 65na thad ga la'o//lung la/mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i man ngag bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal (༅)po'i gsang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs gter gzhung /bde gshegasargyal ba rgya mtsho'i (༅)thugs kyi bcud thig ces bya ba la nang gses kyi sgom rim bsdus pa/'dzab kyi dmigs pa la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa/bar gcod bgegs dpung gzhom pa/khyad par lha srin sde brgyad gzir ba/liṅga 'khor lo la brten pa'i las sbyor rtsa sngags sde brgyad dbang sdud sham bu'i sngags rnams bstan pa mjug tu skal ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi smon lam yod pa'i gter gzhung zhabrul med/dpal rta mgrin rgyal po'i dbang bskur (5)ba'i cho ga gter byon/gtor bsngo bstod pa rgyal kun ma/rgyal po ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyis bas pa'i man ngag/'khor lo dang rma bshad kyi byug pa la brten nas rgyal po 'dul zhing gnon pa/bsrung 'khor 'dogs pa/bsrung mdud/dpon ston skyer sgang pas gsang sgrub kyi skor 'di rnams o rgyan chen po la zhus tshul gyi lo rgyus dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/gtsang ma shangs ston yan gong ltar la/de nas mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /bla ma rdo rje ga cho ne nu/mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po/brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan/'dren mchog dpal ldan dar po/rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/rje ngag dbang nyi ma/lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug/zha 65ba ) lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchag grub/des bdag za hor bande la'o//lungs yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/sa rgyas ston pa yan gong ltar la/de nas 'jag chen shes rab tshul khrims/'jag chung rgyal mtshan 'bum/khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims lhu 'a rgyal mas yang zer/mkhan chen zla ba blo gros/mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin cen/mkhas btsun yon tan rin cen/bsam gtan gling pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/g.yung rin chen mgon po/ba le ba rnam rgyal dpal bzang /stag lung ngag /bang rnam rgyal/'ol ba pa ngag dbang chos grags/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nekhyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar gcod kun sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yan dbang dang 'dra ba la/ de nas mtshungs med dgon gsar ba sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man gong bzhin no/ /deng sang rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'di rang gzhan kun la rlung ltar grags kyang phyis kyi bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs tsam la re ba 'cha' ba las gter gzhung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob cing nyams su len pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma'o/ /grub thob dngos grub ni chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos thugs rje chen po'i chos skor las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la bstan zhing yi ger bkod de mdo skor nas lo rgyus chen mo dang sgrub skor dang zhal gdams kyi skor rnams gtsang khang byang ma'i (66na)rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbas/ gab pa mngon byung sogs kha shas dang mdo skor rnams gnod sbyin nā ga ku be ra'i dar sham 'og gi brla g.yas par sbas/ dpal o rgyan chen pos mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan la nyid kyi mes srong btsan sgam pos ra sar gter 'di ltar sbas zhes legs par bstan pas thugs ches nas thugs rje chen po stong rtsa'i sgrub thabs/ gab pa mngon phyung / sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i bskyed rdzogs/ thugs dam mthong ba'i phan yon srong btsan 'da' kha'i bka' chems rnams la thugs dam du mdzad pa yin la/ de yang thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa grub thob dngos grub ces bya ba mi yul du lo sum brgya tsam bzhugs pa des sgrub skor rnams gtsang khang byang gi rta mgrin zhabs 'og nas spyan drangs te tshangs pa lha'i me rtag gi skye ba mnga' bdag nyang la gnang / mnga' bdag gis kyang zhal gdams skor rta mgrin zhabs 'og nas brtan/ dbu ru lha sa'i ston pa shākya 'od dam bzang po'i mtha' can gyis gnod sbyin khang pa nas gab pa mngon phyung sogs mdo skor rnams spyan drangs pas chos skor 'di la gter ston gsum du yod kyang / gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas grub —96

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganathob dngos grub zhabs kyi gter mar grags shing / 'dir yang de'i dbang du byas te gter ston gzhan gnyis kyi chos skor gyi khrod du ma bris par skabs 'dir phyogs gcig tu bkod pa la/ smin grol rgyab rten lung dang gsum las/ dang po ni zhal gdams skor las byung ba'i dbang chog dang dbang gi ngo sprod kyi yi ge la brten nas thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang (66ba〉lnga/ bdud rtsi ril bu la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang / byang chub sems la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / sngags dbang / rig pa rtsal gyi dbang / tshig dbang rin po che dang bcas pa/ yang gangs ri ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'gro 'dul gyi las byang dang rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog gi steng nas smin byed kyi dbang tshar gcig /lha rje dge 'bum gyi gter ma'i bka' srung dpal lha'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa legs par thob/ gnyis pa grol byed 'khrid ni/ khri sgong rnam sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung rgyun ltar sras shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig nas nyams len smin rgyas su mnos/ gsum pa rgyab rten lung la/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rang bzhin gdod dag ma/ nye brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs zhig 'dun pa ni ma thob/ dkar chag kha byang rin po che'i gter du sbas pa las can gcig dang mthar phrad shog gi smon lam dang bcas pa/ de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ mdo skor/ sgrub skor/ zhal gdams kyi skor dang gsum/ dang po la spyir mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig yod cing /de dag dang khyad par mdo sde za ma tog bkod par spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor dang yi ge drug pa'i yon tan mang du bshad na'ang so sor lta ba'i dbang du byas te deng sang rgyal po bka' 'bum du grags pa'i glegs bam 'dir med la gter byon gyi mdo skor la/61 rgyus chen mo'i le'u sum cu rtsa drug dkar chagatu le'u bzhi bcazhe gcig zer ba 'dug kyang dngos bstan so drug las mi 'dug pas tshang ma sgo dpyad/ pa chu dar sngon po la gser dngul gyis bris nas khra 'brug dkor mdzod du rgyal po'i bla gter du sbas (67na)gcig rgya shog la shog dril du bris pa thugs rje chen po'i lha khang gi rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbas pa grub thob kyis spyan drangs/ da lta mdo skor ni lo rgyus chen mo za ma tog —97—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebakod pa'i gzungs/ phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs dang gsum la ngos 'dzin yang phyi ma gnyis glegs bam khrod du mi 'dug /lo rgyus sprul sku shāka 'od kyi gter ma yin dgos rgyu 'dra zhig 'dug kyang da lta grub thob dngos grub kyi gter mar mdzad cing gter gnas la dpags kyang yin nam snyam mo/ /sangasargyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos mdzad pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus dang /rtog te re/sangs rgyas gzhan gyis bstan pa la srong btsan snyam pos mdzad pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus/ rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang phyug gi skyes rabs zhes pa sbyin pa la dga' ba'i rnam thar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rnams/ lo rgyus 'di rnams mdo skor gyi khrod du 'dren rigs par chos kyi spyan ldan rnams gsung / 'di dag la gter gnas dang gter ston gyi gsal kha ma byung yang rje btsun shāka 'od kyi gter ma yin nam snyam gang ltar phyogs 'di la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par mdzod cig /gnyis pa sgrub skor la/ sgrub thabs mu mo dang sgrub phran gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba dang las tshogis gnyis/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ 'brel ba gcad pa/ gnas 'tshol ba/ yo byad gsog pa/ 'khor g.yog gi 'brel ba gzhug pa/ bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i byin rlabs rnams re re la'ang phyi nang gsang ba don rtags(67ba)mtshon pa ste nang gses kyi drug yod pa'i drug tshan drug go/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'khor lo/ 'byer so/ /bsdu ba/ bar do/ gnad/ mi bden pa dang drug /dang po ni/ bskyed rim dam tshig pa/ rdzogs rim ye shes sems dpa'/ ngag sngags/ sems stong nyid/ zas bdud rtsi/ spyod lam bag yengs kyi 'khor lo dang drug /gnyis pa 'byer so ni/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ yid chos nyid/ snang ba sku/ grags pa gsung / dran rtogs thugs kyi 'khyer sodang drug /gsum pa bsdu ba ni/drug /gsum/ sku gsum/ g.yung drung 'khyil pa/ thig le dmar po/ gnas lugs bzhi'i ngang la bsdu ba dang drug /bzhi pa bar do ni/rang bzhin gnas pa/ skye 'chi/ shes pa snga phyi/ rmi lam/ 'chi kha ma/ srid pa'i bar do dang drug /lnga pa gnad ni/ gang zag lta ba sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu/ ga dmasang ga gi gnad dang drug khrug pa mi —98

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabaden pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje/ sems can gyi las/ 'phral gyi rkyen/ byas pa'i chos/ bsgrub bya'i lam/ thob pa'i 'bras bu mi bden pa ste drug rnams/ gnyis pa las tshogis la/ drug skor/ gsum skor/ tshig skor/ bshad 'brel dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rten gyi chos drug /gson la phan gdags pa'i cho se drug /gshin la phan gdags pa'i chos drug /'phrin las drug /gsang sngags kyi gnad drug /thun 'tshams kyi chos drug ste drug /dang po ni/ rab gnas/ mchod pa/ bstod pa gsol gdab/ sus sku ga spus so/ /gnyis pa gson la phan 'dogs pa'i chos drug ni/ dbang bskur/ tshe sgrub/ byin rlabs/dbyug bcos/ bsrung 'khor/ nad 'don no/ /gsum pa (68na)gshin la phan 'dogs pa'i chos drug ni/ ro khrus 'di par dang bris ma gang du'ang zur du mi bog /bum chog ro sreg /mtshan byang sbyang ba/ dur chad du gzhug pa/ ro zan gtong ba'o/ /bzhi pa 'phrin las drug ni/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang mngon spyod/ sbyin sreg /brtul zhugs so/ /lnga pa gsang sngags kyi gnad drug ni/ rtsa rlung / 'pho ba/ grong 'jug /sgyu lus/'od gsal/ gtum mo'o/ /drug pa thun 'tshams kyi chos drug ni/ bdun rnam dag /maṇḍal/ khrus chab/bskor ba/ gtor ma/ chu gtor ro/ /gnyis pa gsum skor la/ 'brel pa gsum gyis nges shes bskyed pa/ thugs rje che chung gi sgo nas shan 'byed gsum/ gsal ba gsum/ phyi nang gsang gsum drug tshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yi ge drug pa'i don bshad pa/ dag pa rnam gsum gyi nyams len srang du gzhug pa/spyi gnad rnam gsum/ dbyer med gsum gyi ngo sprod/ zung 'brel gsum/ spyod lam rnal 'byor gsum/spyod lam rnam gsum/ phan yon gsum dang bcu gcig /dang po ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ srong btsan sgam po gsum gyi snyan du rim par brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag dang 'brel ba/ sems can/ chos/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje gzhan don dang 'brel ba/ 'dod pa/dang ba/ yid ches kyi dad pa byin rlabs dang 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis pa thugs rje che chung gi sgo nas shan 'byed pa gsum ni/ 'dzin med/ rig med/ skye med gsum gyi nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs rje/ rig pa gsal dang stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug /des ma rig pa sel ba nyi zla lta bu'i thugs rje/ dgongs pa —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gechos dbyings las (68ba〉pe g.yo ba/ rig pa'i ye shes rgyun mi chad pa/ rig pa'i rtsal kha ye shes so ma rgyun mi chad pa chu bo lta bu'i thugs rje'o/ /gsum pa/ gsal ba gsum ni/ rnam pa/ brda rtags/ngo bo gsum gyi sgo nas lus lhar gsal ba/ mdo sde/ gsang sngags/ mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi brda gsum gyi sgo nasang ga sngags su gsal ba/ gzengs bstod/ lhod de/ shig ge /rang shar rang grol gsum gyi sgo nas yid chos nyid du gsal ba'o/ /bzhi pa phyi nang gsang ba drug tshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yi ge drug pa'i don bshad pa la phar phyin drug /sdom pa/ sgrib sbyong la brten nas mdo sde ltar sbyar ba/ thub pa drug /yab yum drug /ye shes drug la brten nas gsang sngags dang sbyar ba/ chos nyid don gyi gnad/ chos nyid kyi don lta sgom spyod gsum la brten nas chos nyid la sbyor ba'o/ /lnga pa dag pa rnam gsum gyi nyams len srang du gzhug pa ni/ dkon cog mchod pa/ yig drug bzla ba/ dge sbyor rang lugs su byed pa gsum gyi sgo nas nyams len dag pa/ dus kun lhar sgom pa/ nyen mongs skyes grol du snyam pa/ nges shes gdeng ldan gsum gyi sgo nas spyod lam dag pa/ gang snang lha/ 'gro kun byang chub tu 'dren pa/ rang byung rang shar gsum gyi 'bras bu dag pa'o/ /drug pa spyi'i gnad rnam pa gsum ni/sangs rgyas logs na med pa/ 'khor ba spang du med pa/ 'khor ba ka nas dag pa gsum gyi lta ba thag bcad pa'i gnad/ ye nas rang la gnas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa blang dor bzang ngan med pa gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin nyams su blang pa'i gnad/ mthun 'jug thabs kyi spyod pa/ rang byung shugs kyi spyod pa/rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gsum gyi (69na〉spyod pas la 'dor ba'i gnad do/ /bdun pa dbyer med gsum gyi ngo sprod pa ni/ snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ snang stong dbyer med gsum gyis phyi'i snang ba bzhig pa/ rig pa stong pa/ stong pa chos nyid rig stong dbyer med gsum gyi bang nang gi rig pa bshig pa/ sems nyid gsal la ma 'gags pa/ stong pa ma bsgribs pa/ gsal stong dbyer med gsum gyis bar gyi nyams len bshig pa'o/ /brgyad pa zung 'brel gsum ni/ snying rje dang stong pa zung du 'brel bas 'khor ba las grol nus pa/ ma 'brel ba'i skyon gsum gyis snying rje stong —100—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa 'brel bar bstan pa/thabs rkyang bas 'tshang mi rgya ba/shes rab rkyang bas 'tshang mi rgya ba/gnyis gzung 'brel gyis dbang po mtha' ma'i lam 'khyer 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi zhal gdams/ mtshan thos pas 'tshang rgya ba/ snying po bzlas pas 'tshang rgya ba/ btags pa 'tshang rgya ba rnams/ bdun bzab pa rang don gyi zhal gdams ni/ gzigs tshul/ yul drug /spyan drug /tshul drug /thugs rje drug /che ba drug gi rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs ngo sprod kyi gdams pa/ phyi nang gsang ba bar gcod gsum las/ phyi gnod sbyin pho mo 'dul ba brtul zhugs kyi gdams pa/ phyi gnod sbyin pho mo zhi bar byed pa'i zhal gdams/ nang na tsha zhi bar byed pa'i zhal gdams/ gsang ba dug lnga zhi bar byed pa'i zhal gdams/ 'gro drug rang shar rang grol g.yang sa gcod pa'i zhal gdams rnams so/ /gnyis pa zab pa rang don du gdams pa'i skor la zhal gdams nyi shu rtsa bdun dkar chag tu byung ba gong gsal rnams kyi khrod du don gyis tshang na ma gtogs da lta glegs bam du ma bzhugs pa lung rgyun ma rnyed do/ /gsum pa gter gnas mi gcig pa'i (75ba tshe na la gdams kyi skor la/ gnod sbyin nā ga ku — 109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonebe ra'i brla g.yas pa'i dar sham gyi 'og nas sprul sku shākya bzang po'am dkyil mtha' can gyis spyan drangs pa la/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i rgyal po'i ma cane rtogs/ phyi bskyed rim/ nang snying po/ gsang ba rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i bskyed rdzogs/ thos pa/ mthong ba/ gusashing gsol ba btab pa'i yon tan brjod pa thugs dam mthong ba'i phan yon du grags pa/ khrus chab kyi byed tshul dang phan yon/ 'gro la phan par bya ba'i phyir 'gyur shog gi smon lam/ chos nyid don gyi thugs rje rgyal ba'i thugs la mi gab par ston pa zhal gdams gab pa mngon byung rnams so/ /rgyal po yab yum gsum thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar thim shing bang so yar klungs mthil du btab tshul/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bod khams spyi mthun du zhal chems kyi tshul du ma 'ongs lung bstan yang gter gnas mi gcig kyang 'di'i cha lag tu mdzad pa bsam yas kyi shing yum 'bog gi rtsa bar slob dpon chen po la rje 'bangs bzhis zhus pa'i lha sa bsam yas gnyis kyi 'jig rkyen (gte re/dang de bzlog thabs dang bcas pa'i lung bstan bla ma mnga' bdag chen pos lho brag mkho mthing gi snang mtha'i phyag nas spyan drangs pa dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pas/ dbang gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku srong btsan sgam po/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ gter ston grub thob dngos grub zhabs la god pa sngag pa ral spu ska/mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/ sngag dkar lcang lo can/ la stod pa mi (76na)bskyod rdo rje/ rje btsun shākya bzang po/ rten dge slong / bla ma lha rje dge 'bum/ sngag dkar lcang lo ༅ skyid shong ljangs pa/ drin can sangs rgyas lcam mo ye shes mchog /byang sems chu sgom zhig po/la stod pa dge bsnyen sgom thags/mtha' bzhi bya bral chen po/ dbu porab byung ṣka/'jam dbyang bsod nams seng ge stod pa rab byung —/ bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/dbu pa ra phung 4/'phags mchog nor bu bzang po/ mkhas grub bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mdo sngags chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin cen rdo rje/ snang ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des—110
