dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dbang chog gi steng nas thob pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ mkhas grub bzang po rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ stas sga ngag dbang grags pa/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /bla ma chos skyong rgyal po/ rje nam mkha' rdo rje/ mtshungs med rnam rgyal dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan chos 'byor/lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ gling stod chos rje dkon cog dpal 'byor/ rigs 'dzin mchog sprul padma 'phrin las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gter gyi rtags ma gtogs pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun dga' tshe mchog yan gong ltar la/ zur chen gzhen nu don grub/ de sras zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /thun mong gi las tshogs zhi ba nas rna ba 'byed pa'i bar (76ba)gyi las phran don brgyad pa dang gter gnas mi gcig pa'i zhal gdams dang gter gyi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud lugs gtso che ba gcig ni/ rje blo gros rgyal mtshan nas/ 'khrul zhig dbu thum pa chen po/ sdom brtson 'dul ba pa/ byang sems dpal ldan gzhon nu/ rje dkon cog skyabs/ paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ lha rigs legs ldan rdo rje/ 'brog spa lung chos rje/ yar 'brog yon po do'i bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang nam mkhas grub bzang po rgyal mtshan nas/ bla ma dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ gu ru dpal ldan seng ge /rje dkon cog skyabs ma na 'dra/ gter gyi rtags can gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chu ragasapa blo gros rgyal mtshan nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas don grub/ rje btsun rin cen shes rab/ mar ci ston shes rab bzang po/ thugs sras yon tan bzang po/ dzo sna pa grags pa dpal 'byor/ paṇa chen chos kyi shes rab/ don grub legs pa dpal 'bar/ dbu mdzad don grub dpal ba/ rje bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mkhas mchog mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ mang thos dam chos bzang po/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /—111—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neyang na sna tsho gos rang grol nas/thugs sras kun dga' grags pa/mdo sngags bstan 'dzin man 'dra/nyams 'khrid dang de'i yi ge rgyal sras shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/bzang po rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/bla ma dpal ldan sangs rgyas/rje dpal ldan seng ge/sngags 'chang dkon cog skyabs/mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che/77na ) rgyal sras shes rab rgyal mtshan/yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal/gangs ri ba skyes mchogo mi pham mchog las/gangs ri ba rin cen don grub phun tshogs/gangs ri ba sprul sku rin cen rdo rje/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la nyams 'khrid smin rgyas su gnang zhing 'khrid 'di la yig 'bru bye ba gtong dgos pa'i dam bca' dgos kyi 'dug pa ltar rang byon 'phags pa'i drung du bla ma mnga' bdag gi 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i las byang la brten nas legs par song ba'i skal bzang thob bo//ma gcig dpal lha rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/chu sgom zhig po yan gong ltar la/de nas bla ma dge 'dun dpal bzang /rje sangs rgyas seng ge/rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rje btsun sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas bde chen/bya tshang pa rin cen dpal 'byor/mkhas grub padma sangarsārgyas/rigs 'dzin wo po nyi zla sangs rgyas/rdo rje 'cha pha bong kha pa/drin can chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o/grub thob dngos grub kyi gter ma'i sngags pa 'khon sbyong lag pa'i 'du byed bskyod ba lag mthil du pa tsa na ti zer ba dang /yang su tu kha hi zer ba'i rigs mi gcig pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/snang ba mtha' yas/thugs rje chen po/padma 'byung gnas/grub thob dngosagrub nas rim par/chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/zur kun mkhyen chen po/des bdag la'o//dge bshes dri 'dzin tshe'i gter chos ni ma thob//gru gu yang waṃ ni mdo khams su sku gcings pa'i 'brul med kyi gter ston mthu 77ba tshe stobs nus pa'i dbang phyug cig yin zhing /de yang phyi nang kun gyi gnyen por gyur ba'i 'jam dpal gshin / 'joms byed raka nag po zhes bya ba/dgra sri

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs ma gsum pa/ rtoganamatha' dag gnon pa'i man ngag zab mo mu stegs rgyud gsu nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyis btus te 'om bu tshal gyi brag dmar la zab mo'i/gter du rgyas btab pa gter ston chen po des spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ thog mar gter gzhung gi ḍa bka' gtad la chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can gyis ljags bsgrigs su mdzad pa'i nyi zla'i gdams gtad snyan brgyud phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i lde mig dang / mthong brgyud kyi phyag len la brten nas 'jam dpal gshin rje 'joms byed dang dbang phyug zla ba nag po'i spu gri gnyis kyi bka' gtad ḍā gas par thob/ bka' gtad 'di ma thob par las sbyor byas na lha 'dre dregs pa can rnams kyis rangs srog gzan ltar mthong nas bar gcod kyi dbang du 'gro bar bshad pas/ sngags 'chang mtshan nyid da pa ldan pa cig byed na chos phyir du dka' ba legs par spyod dgos so/ /lung gi skor la/ ma yig /bu yig /nyer mkho lhan thabs dang gsum/ dang po la/ nang gses kyi thog mar rgya bod kyi skad shan sbyar te brag dmar 'om bur gter sbas tshul dang bcas te sa bcad drug sngon du btang pa'i dgra sri mnan tha bas mjug tu bu yig so sor gsal ba'i mtha' can/ dgra bo bsgral phyir rlung 'khor bca' ba bu yig tu gsal ba'i mtha' can/ mthun gnyis nang dkrug 'byed thabs dang 'gom chog rdzas rgod za yig rnams kyi rtsa tshig phrad shog gi mtha' can no/ /gnyis pa bu yig gi skor la/ 'joms byed rtsal (78na)ce na nyi zla nag po'i man ngag /gsal byed gser gyi 'phreng ba zhes rim chags su yod pa la dgra sri ga sna pā na pa'i man ngag gsal byed rū pa ba 'dri ba'i 'khor lo dmigs pa dbang phyug gi sngags dang bcas pa :skros byang du tshang ba/ nang ltar sgrub pa gshin rje dmar po'i ting 'dzin sngags dang bcas pa gser srang gang gi bka' rgya ma/ 'joms byed kyi bstod pa 'phrin bcol bskal me ma/ dbang phyug gi bstod pa 'phrin bcol mtshon cha sna tshogs ma/ma 'ongs dus mthar log spyod 'byung ba'i lung bstan dang bstan dgra dar ba'i dus su mu stegs spu gri'i rgyud gsum nas padma bdag gis btus tshul/ dgra byang bzlog phyir 'ur rdo dang kong zor bca' zhing 'phen tshul rno myur thog 'dra'i man ngag gser srang gang gi bka' rgya ma mjug tu sbas byang phrad — 113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag nga blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/shog gi mtha' can/ dgra bo bsod nam chu bcad pa bzhin du 'gro ba'i 'gom chog sku gsung thugs kyi rgya can gnubs kyi mchod rten sa nya' ma zhes grags pa mtshon grir gsod nges pa gser rang lus tsam byin pa'am rigs kyi bu yin na ma gtogs mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/stag seng kha 'thab spong ba la med du mi ༈ ba yig rgod gsum gyi dpe ris gril thum tshes dus phyogs rnams so sor brda sprod sbyar ba/ dgra gzung 'joms mdzad nyi zla nag po'i dgra mnan rgyud khungs sogasaliṅga phyi nang sgrub pa gang byed kyang gtor ma bshams mtshams bcad spang blang la brtson par bya zhes pa'i mthar thug pa/ de nas rang nyid dbang phyug chen por bsams zhes sogs dmod mo grub rtags rnams bstan pa mu stegs zla ba nag po'i sru (78ba)gri gser srang gang gi bka' rgya ma/ 'jam dpal dang dbang phyug gnyis kyi bka' gtad bya tshul gser srang gang gi bka' rgya ma/ dgra bo blo bur du 'byung ba'am byad kha mtshon gyi 'jigs pa sel phyi/tshor mu stegs drag po'i sngags rgod gsum gyi dgos byed bzhi dang phan yon bstan pa/ dgra bo bsgral phyir rlung 'khor bca' ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang sgrol bar 'gyur pa/rdzas rgod nag po gnam lcags spu gri gang la brgyab kyang thog rdug med pa bu min pa gzhan la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can/ mthun gnyis nang dkrug mu stegs 'bar ba'i mtshon cha mjug na/ gter ston thugasal 'dris gyis la shog ser 'byung ba'i yos la bskur sogs kyi zhal gdams yod pa/ gzhung de rnams su bskungs pa'i yi ge gsal byed brda sbyor yang yig gi tshul la yig rgod kyi zhal shes tshes 'gyur dmigs gnad ston pa/ pho mo gnyis sbyor gyi bar 'khor nyi zla g.yung drung rlung la 'phyar ba so sor byed pa'i gnad/ rdzas rgod snod la sbyor ba'i yig rgod dkrugs yig gsal byed shin tu gab pa rnams gter byon/gsum pa nyer mkho lhan thabs la/ mi nyag byang pa bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i phas rgol 'joms byed kyi man ngag gru gu yang waṃ gi gter thos tshul gyi gsan yig nyi zla'i 'od zer/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs 'gro ba'i nyi ma/ des mdzad pa'i sgom lung 'bogs pa'i cho ga tsha grang nyi —114

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)zla'i gdung sel/ bka' gto dngos gnim thob na ba pa byed mkhan la 'di mdzad srol yod/des mdzad pa'i nyi zla'i gdams gtad snyan brgyud phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i lde mig /des mdzad pa'i 'joms byed rtsal chen man ngag rtsa sdom zhal gdams tshigs bcad ma/ des (79na)mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje ra ka'i las byang tsha zer nag po'i gdung byed/ des mdzad pa'i 'joms byed rtsal chen gyi man ngag nyi zla nag po'i smad las zangs lcags ngar ma'i dbal thog /des mdzad pa'i ma hā de wa'i las byang zla ba nag po'i sbu gri/ ratna sha ras mdzad pa'i lha chen ma hā shwa ra'i sgo nas dgra bo mnan pa'i man ngag /'khor lo bca' gzhi'i dpe'u ris zhal shes phyag len dmar 'khrid lan gsum gyi bar du dogs sel ba dang bcas zhus pa rnams kyi rgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas/bde chen ye shes bskyed mdzad mkhar chen gza'/ sprul pa'i gter ston gru gu yang waṃ/ bla ma tshul khrims rdo rje/ bal po rin cen rgyal mtshan/ ston chung grags dbang / sngags 'chang tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ bla ma dbang phyug rdo rje/ nus ldan rin cen seng ge /rigs 'dzin mi bskyod rdo rje/ nags phu pa rin cen bzang po/ tre bo chos bzang / rong po seng ge rdo rje/ pha jo 'jigs byed nag po/ sngags 'chang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor pa rin cen dbang phyug /mthu chen mdo sde rgya mtsho/ rje padma dbang phyug grub brnyes bkra shis dbang phyug /khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor sngags spyon gyi mtshon char gdams pa yin no/ /'di'i 'khor lo'i skor gyi phyag len shin tu zab pa 'ga' zhig gi lag 'khrid ni/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas gru gu yang (79ba〉ji gi gdung 'dzin sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ de la kho bos thos so/ /rjes 'brang mang pos gsung rgyun ma zin pa'i 'bru bshad dang phyag len dpyad mi bzod pa kha yar 'dug pa 'di skor gyis bka' gtad dang lung rnams rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po cher phar phul — /15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zheskabs phyag len khungs thub bzhugs 'dug pa mthong nas/ zhal shes dmar 'khrid kyis mdzub tshugs 'khrul med du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ brag la sngags 'chang don grub rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku mchog padma 'phrin las/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ nam mkha' snying po'i sprul pa dpal rgyal mtshan/ nyi zla sangs rgyas zla nag gzi brjid 'bar/ lho yi bande rog ban 'bog po dang / sar ston phyogs med ces rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i gter ston byang chub gling pa'am dpal rgyal mtshan du grags pa ni/ sprul pa'i gter ston tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi mon gyi brag mtha' phra mo chu phug dpal gyi phug ring lha mo wā phye gar byed pa 'dra ba'i gsang gnas nas/ spyan drangs pa'i lam yig don byang las/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs shed na g.yas ru chu klung 'bab pa'i lho mang yul rgyal po'i shar phyogs logs dpal mo thang gi dkyil stod na lha mtsho srin mtsho nub phyogs na slob dpon padma'i dgongs pa'i bcud: nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs gter yod lnga bcu khar la snyigs ma'i dus rang gter blangs nas 'gro don byed gsang sngags dar la ma smin dus skal ldan kun gyi chos skal yin dran par gyis shig bod 'bangs kun zhes gsungs pa ltar gnubs kyi (80na po ge slong nam mkha'i snying po zhes dpal yang dag gi grub pa brnyes nas rgya gar nas bod la zhag gcig la byon nyi zer la chibs pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba gang de'i rnam sprul gter ston chen po dpal rgyal mtshan gyis dpal mo'i dpal thang gi bya mang po'i phug pa nas chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis sku gsung thugs rten bye ba gcig bzhengs pa'i rdo rje bcu gcig pa mthong grol gnam lcags rdo rje dang lhan cig tu kun bzang thugs gter 'khor 'das rang grol gyi chos skor spyan drangs pa la dbang chog rin cen bum bzang gi steng nas sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / gsang dbang shes rab ye shes/spros bral tshig dbang / mtha' rten rjes gnang gi rim pa dang bcas pa/ dbang chog (6)dngos grub rgyun 'byung gi steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i kun bzang sogs zhi ba rigs lnga yab —116

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)yum gyi phyag rgya dang phan pa'i dbang bcu yan gyi rdzas dbang / khro bo yang dag gi bhanta/ lha sku/ tsitta/ mar me/ dbu rgyan/ bum pa/ phyag mtshan/ dur khrod dang dpal gyi mas dbang / sngags dbang / sras mchoge phur pa'i gtso bo khro bsto phra phyag /rdzas dbang / las sbyor gyi dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / dbang bzhi pa dang bcas pa/ srog dbang gi yi ge dngos su med kyang rakṣa (6)ma hā ka la dang lha mo rang byung rgyal mo gnyis kyi gtor ma mgo bor 'jog pa'i dbang / srog (༅)bdag sbu gri rnam gsum/ rdor legs (6)gtso bor gyur pa'i ging spu gri reg gcod gtso 'khor rnams kyi gtor ma lag gtod kyi bka' gtad/ gsang ba'i bdag po gnod sbyin (80ba〉lag na rdo rje'i sku/ sgrub thabs sngags 'phreng phyag mtshan la brten pa'i dbang gu ru drag po ( )rtsal gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bum gsang shes rab rig pa'i rtsal dbang dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob/ rgyab rten lung gi skor ni/ thems byang gsal sgron las nam mkha'i snying pos gsol ba/ ma hā gu ru chen po lags ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus dag sa yang rab skal ldan don gyi phyir bdud rtsi lta bu thugs kyi bcud: 'khor ba'i nad sel bdud rtsi sman dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che: ma rig mun sel 'od po che dam chos sgrol ma rnam drug gnang :ma 'ongs bstan pa'i btsas su 'jog las can bu yi rjes ma sug sa rmongs pa gtum po log shes can:yang dag don gyi blo med pas tshig la dbri bsnan mi byed dam don la rmongs par mi 'gyur ram dam chos bdud rtsi lta bu la tshong 'dus 'o ma ltar bslad na/ phung byed gnyis ka bsregs 'gyur pas themasabyang gsal ba'i man ngag zhu zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyi tshom/ nang gter rwa skor/ lte skor/ lte skor gyi rings/ rwa phrag gi skor dang lnga/ dang po la/ gter chen gdan 'dren pa'i lam yig gsum ni sprul sku tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis chu mo phug nas bton pa'i don byang gsal ba'i me long kha byang dang snying byang gnyis dbu zhabs su tshang ba/ de'i le lag gter kha snga phyi lung bstan gung mthun pa ltar bka' 'grol gsol btab kyi zhu yig bla ma shākya dpal pas mdzad pa/ gnyis pa nang gter rwa skor la/ spyir dgos pa dang / sgos kyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la/ gsum yod pa'i lag len dmar byang 'og tu bstan —117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenas/ zhu lan gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes pa o rgyan chen po la gnubs (81na)nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa sbas byang du tshang pa/ gter ston lag dmas pa gnad kyi zhal gdams zhes bya ba sbas byang du tshang ba'o /gnyis pa sgos kyi gzhung la/ bla sgrub byin rlabs kyi sgron ma/ thugs dam yang gsang gsal ba'i sgron ma/ rdzogs chen rang lugs lta ba'i sgron ma/ bka' brgyud gsal byed theg pa'i sgron ma/ 'phrin las yongs rdzogs thugs rje'i sgron ma/ drag sngags bstan srung sgron me dang drug /dang po la bla ma kun 'dus kyi rgyud ces pa le'u bcu drug pa brgyud tshul gtad rgya mtha' rten rdzogs byang du tshang ba 'khor lo padma rdo rje'i rgya can/ phyi sgrub dag snang skyed byed ces gleng gzhi sngon du 'gro bas phyi rgyud sde gsum ltar bla ma sgrub pa las can la phrad shog gyi mthar tshang ba/ nang sgrub dbang gi ngo sprod ces pa gsang sngags ltar bla ma sgrub thabs thugs sprul la phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ gsang sgrub bla ma'i don 'khrid ces pa bla ma kun bzang yab yum gyi rnam par sgrub thabs phrad shog smon lam gyi mthar tshang pa/ dbyer med sku bzhi'i sgrub pa zhes pa gu ru za hor ma g.yon du yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro phyogs bzhin rigs bzhi mtshams bzhin gsang yum bzhi rnams dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs gzugs skus 'gro don byed pa'i mtha' can/ las tshogs thugs rje 'phrin las zhes pa bla ma'i rigs drug gi sgo nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub thabs smon lam mthar tshang ba/ byin rlabs dngos grub sgrub pa zhes pa sgrub thabs gong ma rnams kyi kha skong du bla ma mchod pa'i rim par rang byin rlabs zhu ba slob bu byin gyis brlab pa/ grub mtha' bla ma'i ngo sprod (81bskong bcas pa mkha' 'gro gto rgya mthar tshang ba/ dbang chog rin cen bum bzang zhes pa smin byed rab 'byams bka' dbang gnad yig sbas byang du tshang ba/ gu ru'i las byang yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa gu ru rigs lnga sogs lha so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga sbas byang du tshang ba/ sbyin sreg ye shes rang 'bar zhes pa zhi rgyas dbang drag yongs rdzogs lhun grub lnga'i lag len rdzogs byang du tshang ba/ dngos grub rgyun gyi sbyin sreg gam mkha' 'gro gsang ba'am kha skong sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg ces pa bla ma yab yum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sde bzhi la brten pa sbas byang du tshang ba/ gshin don thugs rje'i lcags —118

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)kyu'am rigs drug gi sgrib sbyong thugs rje'i chu rgyun nam thugs rje yongs rdzogs rang gnas zhes pa 'dren sbyong gnas spor sogs smon lam mthar tshang ba/ ro sreg dug gsum mun sel zhes pa gshin don gyi cha lag sbas byang du tshang ba/ tshe 'das la zas gos gto de pa tshad med bzhi ldan zhes pa gshin don gyi cha lag sbas byang du tshang ba/ gri 'grol gsang ba'i man ngag ces pa grir shi ba'i bag chags las 'grol bar byed pa'i thabs sbas byang du tshang ba/ sbubs bshig log pa mtha' sel zhes pa gshin don gyi cha lag sbas byang du tshang ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa thugs da bska/nga gsang gsal ba'i sgron ma la/ kun bzang don gyi sgrub thabs gsang ba'i man ngag don gsum da sa pa yang dag zhi khro phur gsum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa snod ldan las can gyi slob bu lung bstan gyi mtha' tshang ba/ dbang chog dngos grub rgyun 'byung zhes pa yang dag zhi khro phur gsum sbrags pa'i phan nus rol pa'i dbang sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ mchog (82na)dbang gsum gyi phyag len zhes pa dbang gi chu rgyun ma nyams pa'i nges byed dbang rdzas ril bu'i lo rgyus dang bcas pa mtshan byang brda yig gi mtha' tshang ba/ kha skong 'phrin las kyi las byang zhes pa sangs rgyas tshe 'dir ster byed gu ru'i gsung bzhin nam mkha'i snying pos bkod pa brda yig gi mtha' tshang ba/ bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i rim pa zhes dpal chen po thig le ye shes gcig pa'i sgom byang bsnyen pa'i man ngag ru lu bzlas pa'i 'phreng ba sbas byang bsngags brjod kyi mtha' tshang ba/ sgrub byang dngos grub gter chen zhes pa las can dang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub nad sel bdud rtsi zhes pa khrol bu phye ma ril bur sgrub thabs dngos grub bskul blangs sogs lung phyag len bar ma chad pa'i gtan tshigs smon lam gyi mthar tshang ba/ bam sgrub dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dngos grub bam gyi sgrub lugs brda yig sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ tshe sgrub yang gsang 'chi med sgrub pa'am tshe sgrub gsang ba yang 'khol zhes pa tshe'i bcud len rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum bdud rtsi bzhi sbyar thabs dngos bzhi tshe dpag med lha nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i cho ga dbang za tshul phan yon bcas pa dang / ā lu nang ltar nyams su blang thabs yang gsang bla med zhar byung rtsa rlung tshe sgrub sogs —119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebarda yig gi mtshan byang mthar tshang ba/ rgyud drug grol mdzad ye shes rang gnas sam khams gsum yongs sgrol rigs drug 'dren pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba brda yig gi mtshan byang mthar tshang ba/ sbyin sreg 'phrin las lhun grub ces pa kha skong 'phrin las bzhi phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi sbyin sreg sogs sbas byang du tshang ba zhan byung phung (82ba)po sreg sbyang dang bcas pa/ chos spyod rgyun gyi lam 'byer skor la tsitta chos sku'i gzugs mtsho ni gdab pa'i man ngag gter rtsal gyi mtha' tshang ba/ skor ba chu sbyin gtor ma rnams so so'i mtha' tshang ba/ bsrub pa phyog sgrub pa/ gnam lcags me 'bar zhes pa o rgyan dhu ma tha la'i gtsug lag brgyud kyi gu ya༄kyi pa rten /dpal yang dag yang gsang thugs sgrub sangs rgyabs lag bcangs zhes pa'am sangs rgyas lag bcangs gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes gter rtsal brda yig mthar tshang ba/ 'bru brgyad nyams len ru lu'i brjed byang zhes pa nam mkha'i snying pos yi ger bkod de skal ldan gyi btsas su bzhag pa/ dgongs(nyams dbyangs drug gi rim pa gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i bu'i don du bkod pa/ yang dag gsang 'grel bkra shis rnams so/ /gsum pa rdzogs chen rang lugs lta ba'i sgron ma la rang grol rtsa ba'i rgyud dam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang dbyings snying po gcig dang tha dad las grol ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa zhes pa'i rgyud rdzogasabyang gi mthar tshang ba/ thugs rje gsang rgyud dam sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba chen po'i rgyud ces pa rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba/ yig drug gnad kyi lag len zhes bya ba don gsal rgyud kyi snying po thems med dang drug /gsang ba 'khor lo'i yi ge so so'i dag byed dang bcas pa/ rdzogs chen kun 'dus gsang ba'i man ngag ces pa don bcu bdun bye brag tu phye nas bstan pa slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa dang gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur ba/ rdzogs pa chen po don gyi ngo sprod rig pa'i rtsa dbang zhes pa las can gyi slob dpon gnyis kyi lung bstan dang bcas pa rdzogs (83na)chen gnas lugs ngo sprod gsal ba'i me long rnal 'byor nyams kyi rim pa zhes slob dpon padmas gnubs nam snying la —120

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagadams pa/ rdzogs pa chen po ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa spra 'khrid man ngag ces pa ye shes gsal ba'i man ngag gter bdag la bcol dam gyis mtha' tshang ba/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan nyams kyi sgron ma zhes pa shrī sidhi dang padma saṃ bha was bsgyur ba/ rnal 'byor cha rkyen gnad gdams don gsum ma zhes bya ba rnams so/ /bzhi pa bka' rgyud sde gsal byed theg pa'i sgron ma la/ rnal 'byor lam rim theg pa gsal byed ces bya ba theg pa'i rim pa gsal bar bstan pa/ dbang bzhi'i nyams len bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes pa bskyed rim sngags dang bcas pa gzhi lam sbyang ba'i man ngag bum gsang shes rab ye shes gsum gyi nyams len tshang ba/ rgyud don gsal byed rnal 'byor lam rim zhes bya ba lta spyod man ngag bstan pa sbas byang du tshang ba rnams so/ /lnga pa 'phrin las yongs rdzogs thugs rje sgron ma ni/ o rgyan bka' nan rab brjid don grub ces pa gang du bya ba'i dus gnas so so'i sngon 'gro yo byad kyi gzhom dngos gzhi dam bdar 'phrin bcol/ rjes kyi bya ba tshar bcad phan yon sbas byang du tshang ba/ de'i cha lag tu dgosapa byang bdag dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i slob dpon padma'i phyag mtshan gnam lcags rdo rje'i bka' 'grol byin rlabs rab gnas mnga' gsol smon lam dang bcas pa kun bzang dgongs bcud rtsa mtshan rnams so/ /bka' nan rab brjid 'di'i phyag len bod 'bangs bde thabs su dmigs te kho bos bsam yas hal po rir lan gnyis dang (83ba〉sdong la'i la khar gcig ste lan gsum du bgyis pa yin no/ /drug pa drag sngags bstan srung sgron ma la/ raka ma hā kā la'i snying sgrub kyi sgrub par nang gsesakyi sngon byung / sgrub pa dngos/ drag po'i las sbyor shinti ga lha'i man ngag / spogs chog sogs sngagasabadun gyi gsal byed shinti ga lha'i 'phreng bsdebs man ngag gdams pa/ rang rgyud pa'i las mgon zil gyi gnon pa/ dam tshig sogs brda yig sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo bsgrub thabs zhes par ro kha ma/ nam gru ma tsa mu sgri/ srin mo ce spyang ma bdun sogs gtso 'khor bcu gcig gi sbrags sgrub/ bstod bskul don dam chos dbyings mthun bskul bzhengs shig ma deng bcas — 121 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepa rnams gter rtsal gyi mtha' tshang ba/ srog bdag spu gri rnam gsum gyi sgrub pa'i nang gses la/ dam la btags tshul/ rten bca' ba/ bod pa/ rbad bskul/ gsad pa/ bka' nan dang bcas pa gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos gter rtsal las can sprul pa'i bu la gces gdams kyi mtha' tshang ba/ ging sbu gri reg chod kyi sgrub thabs zhes pa gtso bo rdo rje legs pa ljang nag /nang blon gzhog rgod 'bar ba/ gtsang bu lha rje/ gan mo the dkar po/ dbu bshi rdo rje brtse to bzhi/ nag po snying 'phrog /raka kha 'bar 'thomasapa sha zan sogs las byed mon pa gsum/ sring gcig sha med gangs dkar ma sogs gtso 'khor dgu'i rten bshams bod pa/ drag po gsang ba'i las/ lo tog gzhom pa/ bdud sngags dmod pa dang bcas pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i bstod bskul bhyo bhyo de ni ma/ ging gi bla sngags/ dam tshig /rdo rje legs pa gsang ba dam tshig (84na tshe khungs dang phan yon/ sgrub thabs kyi che ba'i yon tan bsten thabs sogs sba byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ zhar byung 'byung po thams cad kyi dam tshig gi sngags dang bcas pa rnams so/ /rwa skor gyi khrod du don gyis tshang ba thugs gter 'khor 'das rang grol gyi thems byang gsal ba'i sgron me spyi'i tsho mes gsum dang khrigs med shog dril thems byang sogs gser gyis dris te rab tu sba ba'i dam tshig gi mtha' can no/ /rtsa ba'i sa gcad gsum pa lte skor la/ thugs gter gyi kha byang lag len dmar byang zhes pa la nang gses kyi slob dpon padma'i phyag mas rdo rje rtse dgu'i rnam thar/ bram ze dri med snying po'i lo rgyus dang / sku sha'i phan yon/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma dam la btags tshul/ phyag mtshan gyi phan yon che brjod/ sgron drug rwa sprag gter skor dbang rdzas ril bu skye bdun sha ril dang bcas pa'i zhal gdamasaphyi sgrib sbyong rdzas kyi ril bu sgrub pa'i lag len/ rang gi lus las byung ba'i zag pas yi dwags kyi tshogasatshim par bya ba'i thabs sogs brda yig sbas byang mthar tshang ba/ mkha' 'gro gsang sgrub ces pa'i nang gses la yang gsang dpa' po mchog sgrub yab yum phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgrub thabs don gyi man ngag /gdams pa zab mo snying gi bcud sogs las can sgrub thems mthar tshang ba/ phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag ngo sprod 'phrul tshig ces pa rigs bzhi ṭā zhi'i ngo sprod/ ṭa gi sidha mu kha badzra girti —122

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarim pa bzhi sogs/ mkha' 'gro gsang tshig 'phrul gyi ngo sprod ces pa gsang ba'i man ngag mthong bas grol ba'i gsang chen dam pa rdzus skyes padma 'byung gnas kyis 'di skor (84ba)gsan pa'i lo rgyus nyams len mthar phyin gyis mthar tshang ba/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub ces par nang gses kyi gtum po drag po khyung lnga pa khro bcus bskor ba'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sngags rtags rim dang bcas pa/ phyag mtshan kha bsgyur gyi las tshogs la/ tshe sgrub/ steng gdon dang 'og 'don 'don pa gnyis/ ser bsrung / rbod gtong bzlog pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba/ dbang sdud/ dgra bo gsod pa/ byis pa'i 'khor los bsrung ba/ bsrung skud/ 'byung po gzar ba rnams/ drag po'i las sbyor/ 'grub rtags/ glo bur ser ba 'bebasapa/ rig sngags bzlog pa/ ser bsrung / tsi tsi dzwa la gso ba'i sngags dang rdzas bzhi'i lag len rgyasapar bstan pa/ bstod pa chos dbyings ma/ bskul thugs rje dbyings bzhengs ma/ dbang gi cho ga sogasasbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ der dgos pa'i gtum po drag po sgrub thabs khrigs chags mtshan dang bcasapa gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ gu ru drag po ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal dbang rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ 'di 'og tu li ga bdun bas grol yang gsang zhes pa'i lung mthob/ btags grol yid bzhin nor bu'i dkar chag gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ 'di'i rjes su brda tso lde mig gsal byed sgron ma ḍa ni pra 9 brda yig ka dpe 'dogs 'brel 'khod yig gi grol dang bcas pa ma thob/ thugs dam lha'i srog rten zhes pa lha'i srog gzungs sku rten bzhengs pa'i lung bstan phan yon dang bcas pa/ 'di'i rjes su 5rten bsod nams dpal 'bar 4khos tshur gyi lung ma thob/ ril bu yon tan kun 'byung gi dkar chag gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ ril bu myong ba don ldan gyi dkar chag (86na)kong yul bya rgod gzhong gi brag ri rta mgo ljon rtse mo nas sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas gdan drangs la stod du gter ston byang chub gling pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan la brten nas dkon cog bzang po blta bar btang ba dpal mo gter ston dang gnya' nam dben gnasasu mjal bas yid ches so/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa lte skor chings kyi chos skor la/ rje rgyal btsad pos zhus pa'i lung bstan gsal — 123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogaba'i shog dril 'di'i shog ser 'bebs 'gro la ji tu ba shog ser bsnams nas mas na cungs da ma tshang zhing / phran bu blo nas gang thon bris pa0'du yod par grags/ gces pa'i man ngag rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba nang gses kyi sprul pa'i gang zag lung bstan bar gcod bdud kyi 'byung lugs/ gung thang du khri bkra shis lde la ched du bsngags pa/ bstan pa spyir gces pa phyi dmag bzlog thabs sngon ge sar hor gyi sprul pa'i rgyal po la gnam gyi lhas byin pa'i rnga bo che dang 'jigs pa'i sgom dung yod pa la dpe byas te bca' thabs/ g.yin yang dmag bzlog gi rten 'brel man ngag /bod kyi chos khrims la phan thabs/ ge sar 'dug pa'i hor dmag bzlog thabs/ sprul pa'i gang zag khyad par can byung yang nag phyogs kyi mthus rten 'brel 'grig mi 'grig sogs kyi lung bstan rgyas pa slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gsum gyis rgyas btab ste sbas pa rnams so/ /rtsa ba'i lnga pa rwa sprag gi skor la/ thugs sgrub gsang ba snying tig ces pa rdo rje drag po rtsal bsgrub pa'i man ngag gsang ba'i thugs sgrub rdo rje'i bzlas pa sems nyid lha'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs 'di'i lo rgyus sogs yang tig gsang ba'i (85ba〉skog dril tshang ba/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs zhes par nang gses la/ bde ba can gyi bsngags brjod/ 'pho ba/ tshe sgrub/ shes rab bskyed pa/ phyag bstod gsol btab dang bcas pa sbas byang du tshang ba/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin 'khor ( ba zhal gsum phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/'di'i las phran la lung ston pa/ bde ba can du skye ba/ mim yin gyis mi 'tshe ba/ byad bzlog pa/ bsrung ba/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas las thar ba/ ngan song las thar ba/ bar do'i sdug bsngal sel ba/ sri'u gsob/ zhing gi 'bu srin bsrung ba/ me 'bras zhi ba/ klu nad zhi ba/ sdig pa 'dag pa/ mtshams med lnga 'dag pa/ rna nad zhi ba/ nad thams cad zhi ba/ 'byung gtor la brten nas/ bsrung ba rnams phan yon dang bcas pa sbas byang du tshang ba/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul byed lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabasal/ gtso bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i ma lnga zhe rtogs gsang sngags rig sngags/zung mchog /rta mgrin/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ /padma rgyal po/ sa la bzhi'i mdzo rtogs shin tu zab —124

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig /las tshogs la ril bu bum chu bye ma/ bdug spos/ tshe long / sgra/ gzugs/rdo/ nyi zla sogs la brten nas sgrib pa sbyong ba/ rus pa la brten nas bde ba can du skye ba/ bzlas pa la brten nas gzhan phan bya ba/ yig drug gi phan yon/ 'od dpag med kyis tshe dang ye shes 'phel ba/ gsang ba'i ye shes me mchod/ rta mgrin gyi dregs pa dbang du bsdu ba/ nga las dbul ba sel ba/ lha drug gi bstod pa/ slob bu smin par byed pa/ lha bcu'i 'phrin las bsdu chog (86na)sogs mtha' yongs su tshang ba/ 'byung ba'i lo dgra bsrung bzlog ces pa nang gses kyi skad gnyis shan sbyar nas mngon rtogs dang bstun pa'i chos spyod rtsom par dam bca' ba 'byung ba'i rgyud dang ltas dang sbyor chos/ dngos gzhi ārya lo ke shwa ra drag po chen po 'od zer 'bar ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po ltas ngan thams cad 'jig par mdzad pa'i sgom thabs dang de'i rig sngags kyi sgo nas bzlog cing zhi bar byed pa/ sdigs mdzub kyi las sbyor/ pheg rdob kyi bsrung ba/ gzhan gyi ser gta'i sbyor ba la ched du bsngags pa'i gdong bzlog nag po rgya gar khrag 'thung gi dgongs pa/ thog bsrung / ser ba bzhu sngags/ gza' thog gnyis ga'i bsrung ba/ pha rol byad stems bzlog pa'i drag sngags bzlog pa'i mtha' gter rtsal du tshang ba/ mtshon bzlog rdo rje'i pha lam zhes pa gang zag sgos dang yul khams mtshon gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa dang / bod khams yongs su dmag mtshon gyi 'jigs pa zhi bar bya thabs/ byang bu la brten pa'i nor phyugs kun la god kha bsrung ba/ sher shing gi phur bu la brten pa'i lam bsrung / sgo gsum lung tang la brten pa'i sgrib shing / chu gtsang la brten pa'i mi nor rgyas 'debs su tshang ba rnams/dbul sel gter mdzod chen mo zhes pa ārla sa la dang yum nor rgyun ma la gnod sbyin pho mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs ga'u ma bstod pa nang mchod chu sbyin gtor 'bul dngos grub blang thabs sogs dbul ba dang mu ge'i 'jigs pa las thar bar bya thabs rin cen dbyig /mi phyugs nad rims bsrung bzlog ces pa la gong gnon bsnyen pa/ spyir gzir sngags/ bye brag tu tshad rims/ cham pa/rgyu rims/ byin log /mig ser/(86ba)gab lhog /'brum nad rnams la bsrung sngags/ srog sngags—125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neganyen po gsum gsum/ spyir mnan pa bya ba/ lha bzhi bye brag dang / spyi dril gyi sgom bzlas/ dri dang gzugs gu ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi sgo nas bsrung ba/ bstan mas phul ba'i man ngag la nang gses kyi lo rgyus/ rten 'brel/ rdzas/ nus pa sngags/ khyad par brtag pa gsum gyis bsrung ba/ yor nad byung na bcos thabs rdzas brgyad sngags dang bcas pa'i nan tan gyis bsrung ba spyod lam bstan pa sbas byang mthar tshang ba/ gzhan yang rdzas sngags kyi rim pas yang po'i gnod pa las gyur pa'i ser ba dang rims nad bsrung ba/ rdzas kyi thig les mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ phur ma dang du bas bgegasarigs 'byung po dang 'go ba'i nad rims bsrung ba/ rdzas kyi ril bus nad bsrung zhing gso ba/ rig sngags kyi bsrung ba rnams rgya gar khrag 'thung gi gdams pa mthar tshang ba/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdud rtsi dri chen/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cung zhi dang ra mnye/ rin cen 'byung ldan gyi bdud rtsi ma hā me sa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi bdud rtsi/ padma rakta phyi nang / don yod grub pa'i bdud rdzi dri chu ste dam rdzas lnga'i bas len kun la dgos byed rgyu brtag pa dang sbyar zhing sgrub pa'i thabs rjes phan yon dang las can la phrad shog gis mtha' tshang ba rnams so/ /gzhan yang glegs bam 'di'i rjes su 'brang ba'i yig sna gter ston byang chub gling pa la gsol btab rnam thar dang sbyar ba bsam 'phel mos gus kyi nga ro zhes bya ba kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ yang ngag zhi ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs dang yang phur gyi 'phrin las sgrub gzhung dang las byang gab dkrug bklag chog tu gter ston (87na8ngos kyi phyag len ji lta bar mchan btab pa dngos slob nam mkha' chos grub kyis bsdebs pa dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las g.yung drung gi rtags bor ba'i sgron ma dang po'i dbang lung dang sgron ma bzhi pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ byang sems phyag na rdo rje/ yum rdo rje phag mo/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ gter ston chen po byang chub gling pa/ dpal rgyal mtshan/ de nas sras brgyud slob brgyud gnyis kyi dang po ni/ thugs sras bsam grub rdo rje/ de —126

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)dpon rin cen bsam grub brtan pa/ de sras o rgyan dpal bzang / yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/gter chen legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin mchog sprul ngag gi dbang po/ mtshungs med kun dga' bzang po/ dri can bla ma khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor gyi bande la bka' drin du stsal to/ /gnyis pa slob brgyud ltar na/ gter ston nas ngos chen pa rgyal mtshan bshes gnyen/ sngags 'chang nam mkha' bzang po/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha' dpal bzang / chos rje o rgyan dpal bzang man 'dra/ sgron ma gnyis pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang / longs sku rdor sems/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon hūṃ ka ra/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas man gong ltar/ de'i nang tshan phur pa'i sgos brgyud ni/ rdo rje gzhen nu/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i 'khor lo/ slob dpon pra wa ha sti/slob dpon padma man 'dra/ tshe sgrub yang (87bskosang 'chi med kyi sgos brgyud ni/ tshe dpag med/ lha mo tsaṇḍali/ slob dpon padma man 'dra/ sgron ma gsum pa'i lung brgyud ni/ kun tu bzang po/rdo rje semasadapa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sidhi/ o rgyan chen po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ sgron ma lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal mya ngan med/yum chen rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon padma thod 'phreng / gnubs nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ sgron ma drug pa'i lung brgyud ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ shinti garbha/ padma thod 'phreng / nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ nang tshan lha mo'i sgos brgyud ni/ dpal chen he ru ga phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ padma 'byung gnas/ nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ lte bskor gyi brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ rdo rje phag mo/ gu ru padma mkhar chen bza'/ nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ nang tshan phyag rdor gyi dbang lung gnyis ku'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/ padma 'byung gnas/ jo mo mtsho rgyal/ na mo mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ nang tshan myong ba don ldan gyi dkar chag gi brgyud —127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepa ni/ gu ru padma/ yum mtsho rgyal/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ bla ma dkon cog bzang po/ gter ston byang chub gling pa man 'dra/ lte bskor chings kyi brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan chen po/rdzo mo mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ rwa sprag gi lung brgyud ni/ chos sku 'od dpag med/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ gnubasanam mkha'i snying po man 'dra/ phyag rdor gyi dbang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter (88na〉ston nas/lung zin rgyal mtshan bshes gnyen/ mkhas grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan chos nyid shesarab/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha' grags pa/ spang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan/ se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/ spyan tshab mgon po zla ba/ mnyam med gnubs dgon po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ byang pa rigs 'dzin dbang po'i sde/ thugs srasang ga god bang po/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ sprulasku phyag rdor nor bu/ zur kun mkhyen chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i dbang rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ yol mo sprul sku/ yab sras gnyis la rigasa'adzin dpal 'byor grags pa'i dbyangs/ de nas chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas kyis mtsho maṇḍal nag po nas spyan drangs pa'i bde ba can gyi 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i skor/gter ston chen po nyi zla sangs rgyas kyis mtsho maṇḍal nag po nas spyan drangs pa'i 'od dpag med chos longs sprul gsum la brten pa'i bde ba can gyi 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i nyams 'khrid dang de'i yi ge'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po 'od dpag med/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas/ mtshungs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rtogs ldan seg bha dra/ pha rgod dri —128—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamed blo gros/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ma ti'i mtshan can/ yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal/rje 'bri gung pa chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog /snang gsal ba ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku nyi zla sangs rgyas de nyid tshur mthong rnams kyi snang ngor rlung yan pa lta bu la don du dag pa'i snang bas zangs mdog dpal rir byon nas o rgyan rin po (88ba ji la dngos su gsan pa'i 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma shin tu zab pa sngon chad yi ger ma 'khod pa'i nyams 'khrid legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ sprul sku nyi zla sangs rgyas/rgya btsun nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ bla ma surya ra smi/ rje bsod nams dpal/ gter ston phyag byang chub gling pa/ mtshungs med sna tsho gos rang grol/ de sras kun dga' grags pa/ bla ma kun dga' rdo rje/ rje btsun mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi thugs sras karma gling par gnang / des chos rje gling par gnang / de gnyis ka sku tshe thung bas rgyun 'phel ba ni med/ la la mtsho maṇḍal nag po nas brtan par 'chad pa ni 'od dpag med kyi 'pho ba dang nor ba 'dra'o/ /brag dkar rdo rje'i rtse nas zla ban gzi brjid 'bar gyis spyan drangs pa'i drag po'i sngags sdebs snying gi me long zhes bya ba zla gsang srog 'dug nag po bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ drag po sngags sdebs kyi lde mig rin cen sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge mdzad pa gnyis kyi lung brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/rigs gsum mgon po/ sdud po bram ze mchog sred/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shanti garbha/ gtsug lag dpal dge /gu ru padma/ bee ro tsa na/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ zla ban gzi brjid 'bar/'byom srid 'dzin/ bla ma ye shes rgya mtsho/ lung nag pa sangs rgyas rdo rje/ rdo rje seng ge /bkra shis seng ge (89na)bkra shis bzang po/ rgyal mtshan seng ge /dpang blo gros bzang po/ gur phug pa tshe mchog — 129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherdo rje/ sngags 'chang dkon cog rdo rje/ dga' thang pa nyang dge 'dun chos grags sprul sku nam mkha' brgya byin dang sku 4 ne yin/ zur dang ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ rma mi 'gyur rdo rje/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ chos gter 'phrin las lhun grub/rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na rtsa brgyad pa rdo rje seng ge nas bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ rtsa brgyad pa bkra shis seng ge man 'dra/ lho yi bande reg ban 'bog po gnyis kyi gter chos ni ma thob/ gsar ban phyogs med ni slob dpon chen pos stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug gi rdo ba g.yu phra can du gter sbas tshul rgya gsum gyi 'grol thabs las/ mi nub rgyal mtshan padma 'byung gnas kyis thugs kyi klong las me shes chen po bkrol phyi rabs las can 'gro ba drangs phyir du rgya dpe bod du bsgyur nas sa'i sgo phye ste: 'jam dpal rgyud kyi ngo sprod dpe chung rgyud 'grel dang :rnal 'byor brgyags skyel gnod sbyin a pa ra rje'i bla gser nyi ma 'phros pa dang : bstan pa bsrung ba gsang ba rin cen dang : rin cen dgos 'dod 'byung bas mkha' 'gro lung ston dang : stong rtsa gcig dril sangs rgyas dgongs pa dang rtsa rlung thig le mkha' 'gro'i lung ston dang : zhes tshig gcig la nges par chos kun nas dag ste ye shes 'od lnga'i klong du grol bar nus pa'i zab lam mkhas pa bzhi'i gdams pa 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen por grags pa'i chos skor rnams ni/ ji skad du/ 'gos kyi phag ri skye (89ba〉pa thing brgal ba'i 'og grub pa thob pa'i stag tshang seng ge phug gnas kyi ming ni bkra shis dpal phug sa grub thob gsum gyis gdams pa bcud phyung ba'i snying du gdams pa'i ngo sprod rnam bzhi dang : ma tshang med pa ma bu bcas nas sbas: zhes pa ltar stag tshang seng ge bkra shis dpal phug gi rdo ba g.yu phra can du gter du sbas pa/ ji skad du/ tshe rabs sngon du sbyangs pas dus 'dir chos dang phrad smon lam dag pas bstan pa stong bar nges dad par ldan pa'i skyes bu las can de:ji srid 'khor ba 'di la skyo ba'i blo skyes nas thabs mkhan khyod la mos pa'i blo gzhungs nas 'byor bshams yon 'bul mnyes par byed pa la rgya gsum bkrol la ngo sprod tshang mar gtad : ces pa ltar —130

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)jo mo shes sgron gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar gter ston sar ban phyogs med kyi spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi skor la/ thog mar 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang dpal gtor zur bzhi la brten nas dbang gi chog bsgrigs dang zur 'debs kyi nang bzhin rigs lnga'i dbang / gtor dbang / rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang gi smin byed rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag len ma nyams pa legs par nos nas/ lung la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi sku che ba'i yon tan dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bka' brgyud 'di rnams ji ltar babs pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus nam mkha' la gshegs so mthar tshang ba/ 'jam dpal gyi chos kyi 'byung khungs khog 'bubs gzhi lam 'bras bu bshad pa'i 'phros las mtshan brjod kyi lo rgyus dang slob dpon padma'i rnam thar gter ston tshul 'chos kyi 'jug sgo slob dpon dgos tshul grub mtha' dang bcas pa gu rus mdzad pas mthar tshang (90na)ba/ 'jam dpal gyi mchod pa'i las byang dbang chog bkra shis smon lam gtor ma gtong ba sogs sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ 'jam dpal dbang gi zur 'debs kyi dbang dang ngo sprod bya rgod phung ri padma spungs ri shel ri spungs ri gsum gyi 'phros don las man shel gyi lo rgyus dang bcas pa thugs su chud pa'o mthar tshang ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i don rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod thabs chings rnam pa drug gis bstan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gnyis med/ gsang sngags yon tan che tshul gsum gyi sgo nas 'don thabs rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba/ bskyed rim gang zag dbang po rab 'bring mtha' ma'i 'don thabs phan yon dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal rgyud kyis gcad don gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ de'i los las sku gsum gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ a skye med rang byung byang chub sems su la zla ba/ 'byung ba phung po nyon mongs dbang po rnams rnam pa nyi shur snang ba don rtogs pa'i dus na rigs lngar 'char tshul te yig sna phra mo gsum/ /'jam dpal khri drug stong gi le'u sum brgya go dgu'i 'o/ na bstod pa glur blangs kyi le'u yod tshul gyi don bsdus btags — /31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negrol gyi gzungs dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal mas brjod kyi don 'grel o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs gsum dang mthun par mdzad pa/ glo rdeg gtam rgyud sa gcad kyi sdom tshig mthug tu yig sna phra mo rgyud gzhan gyis kha 'dzin mi dgos par bstan pa/ bka' 'grol blo rdeg gi gtam rgyud lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa mdo sde nas bsdus pa sbas byang (90bsko mthar tshang ba/ mjug tu brgyud pa 'og ma rnams la gnang tshul dang ngo sprod thob pa'i gang zag gis zhes sogs chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i phan yon tshigs su bcad pa'i yig sna phra mo/ khams gsum gyi grong khyer chen po gnas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ngo bos khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ngo sprod kyi gdams pa mjug tu gcig shes pas kun grol bar byed pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa yang dag mthar thug pa'i che brjod dang bcas pa/ shin tu zab pa 'khrid yig gsang 'grel la nang gses kyi 'don thabs lnga/ snying po hūṃ gi sgrub pa sku gsum lam du 'byer nus pa/ mtshan dpe'i bshad pa/ nyan thos kyi sa brgyad/ byang sems kyi sa bcu/ thabs lam sngags kyi sa bcu gnyis/grol lam de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa lnga rnams bshad pa/ rtsa rlung thig le'i gdams pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du 'jam dpal gyi chos 'dis sems can rnams grol ba'i khyad par 'phags lugs/ khams gsum gyi sems can bshad pa/ dge 'dun gsum bshad pa/ spyan lnga bshad pa/lam gyi yan lag brgyad rig tshul/ zhi ba'i lha tsho gis kyi ngo sprod bcu gsum pa/ zhi ba'i lha'i dag sbyor/ khro bo'i lha tshogasabazhugs tshul/ sku gsum du grol tshul/ snod bas kyi chags 'jig dang phung po zhig 'brel du ngo sprod pa/ a ti'i lta ba sgom pa spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi nges tshig dang bcas pa bstan pa/ gzhi 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba bstan pa/ she bza' sgron gyis gu ru la zhus pa'i tshig rkang bcu bzhi pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rgyud kyi yang snying / de'i ngo sprod lta sgom spyod pa'i zhus lan gu rus she bza' sgron la gnang ba/gsang 'grel dngos (91na〉pa thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba sogs tshig rkang bzhi pa gu rus mnga' bdag la gnang zhing jo mo la yang gnang ba'i 'jam dpal gyi gsang 'grel don gsal bar byed pa'i —132

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/sangs rgyas dang sems can 'byung ba ni:zhes sogs sgrub pa'i man ngag don skor dgu pa she bza' sgron gcig la gdams pa/mi nub rgyal tshab padma 'byung gnas kyis chos skor 'di rnams stag tshang seng ge bkra shis dpal phug gi rdo ba g.yu phra can du gter du sbas tshul rgya gsum gyi 'grol thabs/gter bdag brag skyes sogs la bka' gtad pa kha byang 'ga' zhig dang bcas par dha ni ka ya rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/de yang dran mchog dpal ldan blo gros kyi drung du se'i sngags 'chang bla chen bkra bzang pas 'jam dpal skor 'di gsan par byon te/bde grol gyi phyag dpe tshang ma'i steng nas spyan tshab dang sbrags zhus pa'i skabs gsang 'grel 'khrid skor 'di rnams yem rnyed cing rjes su btsal bas kyang mi 'dug tshul gsan yig tu btab na'ang /slar chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis dpe de ga'i steng nas gsan skabs 'phral du rnyed pa ni mkha' 'gro gter srung gi bka' rgya grol ma grol gyi khyad par yin zhes ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud yod do//gzhan yang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor gyi gsan yig shes rab ral gri'i rgya can/des mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi chos skor 'chad thabs lag len dran pa'i gsol 'debs zhes bya ba stong nyid gzhu'i rgya can/des mdzad pa'i yid ches lung rig nges ster las gter ston sar ban phyogs med kyi gter chos 'jam dpal 91brdzogs chen gyi chos skor nos tshul byang sems༄thala'i rgya can dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa las dbang dang gter gzhung gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/longs sku 'jam dpal rigs lnga/sprul sku shākya thub pa/rdo rje ḍā kirin cen ḍa gi/padma ḍa ki/rkarma ḍa gi/de bzhin ḍa gi/o rgyan ḍa ki/'jam dpal dbyangs/rdo rje sgyu sgyu la'i /'jam dpal bshes ga'/shrī sidha/o rgyan chen po/rje khri srong lde bas/jo mo she bza' sgron/ga kho ston byu po sar ban phyogs med/lung bris sa ra ban nyi ma'i snying po/sngags la 4 dbang dar/mgar ston rin cen 'bum/ri pa sangs rgyas dpal/rgya ban bla ma/bla ma sba ston dpal/rigasa'adzin rgod kyi ldem phru/sngags 'am pa rdo rje mgon po/mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/drin ༅ sangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shergyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dran mchog dpal ldan blo gros/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ klong chen rab 'byams gsum pa sha gzug pa bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang dme gsang sngags pa/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /ljags bsgrigs brgyud pa ni/ ngag gi dbang po nas/ rigs 'dzin kun bzang dbang po/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ bi mā'i rnam 'phrul ldang ma lhun rgyal dang / rtse ston nag po zhang ston bkra shis rdor/ tshe lo me rdo rje dung mtshor sa pa dang / sgom pa g.yu sgom rdo rje lagasol ba 'debs/ zhes gsungasapa'i nang tshan gnas brtan chen po ldang ma lhun rgyal gyi gter (92na)ma'i bla ma snying tig gi skor ni/rgya gar gyi grong khyer ser skya'i rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti chung ba zhes bya ba'i bla mchod paṇa chen lnga brgya'i gtso bor paṇḍi ta bi mā la mi tra bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po zhes bya ba lo bdun zla ba bdun gyi bar zhi gnas la gnas pas sha'i spyan rnam par dag pas gling bzhi dus gcig tu gzigs pa des rje khri srong lde btsan la paṇa chen 'di lta bu zhig yod pa gdan 'dren par gsol bas/ ska cog rnam gnyisapho nyar mngags te gdan drangs nas thog mar rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / slar g.yu sgra snying posabaskul ba la brten nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur zhing / khyad par gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud lung rnams rje blon gsum gyi thugs dam mnog chos su mdzad nas rgya dpe las bod kyi yi ger bsgyur ba rnams rje blon gnyis la'ang ma gnang ste/ snang ba rin po che spra 'khrid kyi mthug gi yig 'phrin las/ gsang ba'i man ngag bdag gi khong snying 'di rgya yi dpe las bod kyi yi ger bsgyur bstan zhing bshad pa'i rje blon gnyis pa yang : dam tshig gzhung dang ldan zhing dad ldan yang : snying gi man ngag mchog 'di blos ma thongs bstan pa'i btsas su sa yi gter du sbas 'di nyid nam zhig phyung ba'i dusabyung na skal ldan snying gi bu dang phrad par shog mchims phu brag btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal bka' —134

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogana'adi srungs la bstan pa'i bdag po gyis: chos skyong mgon po legs ldan nag po khyod bka' 'di gtad do khyod kyis thub par srungs smug nag khros ma'i rgyal mo sngags kyi bdag bka' 'di bcol lo khyod kyis dam du zungs zhes pa ltar bsam yas(92ba〉5chims phur gter du sbas/ de dang 'brel ba'i rgyud man ngag gzhan rnams mnga' bdag yab sras nyang ting 'dzin bzang po ska cog rnams la gnang zhing bsgyur/ khyad par nyang snying tig la bogs thon/ khams su rdo rje legs par ser ba phab nas 'bru rnga mo'i khal lnga brgya sogs mi ma yin gyi rdzas mang du phul ba la gzhi byas nas dbu ru zhwa padma dbang chen gyi lha khang bzhengs te bshad rgyud snying tig gi bka' brgyud skor gsum ke'u tshang rim gsum du sbas/snyan brgyud yi ge'i rigs kyi dpe rnams shog dril rdza ma gang sgo khang gi steng du sbas gsang ba bla na med pa'i gser gyi snying po nyi ma rab tu snang byed ni ka ba'i bsam le'u gsum gyi khong gseng la sbas pa'i zhwa lha khang gi gter chos rnams dus ring zhig na sprul pa'i gter ston ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis spyan drangs snod ldan gyi slob ma lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la gnang / lce btsun gyis slar yang chos skor rnams la 'gro chad pa stag 'drar yang gter du sbas shing / gsang ba snying tig gi skor rnams lus la bcangs nas yod pa'i tshe rmi lam du paṇḍita zhig gis/ bdag ni bi mā mi tra mkhas pa ste: skal ldan snying po'i yang bcud don 'dod na mchims phu brag dmar dge gong yang ldebs la gsang ba snying tig snying dang 'dra ba yod kyis long : de dag khyer la 'u yug phyi skong rdza'i ra ba sa sus kyang mthong ba med par lo bdun sgoms des ni zag bcas phung po mi snang ba yin no: zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar mchims phu nas gter spyan drangs/ 'u yug tu lo bdun gyi bar bsgoms pas chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mthong nasasnying tig gi skor rnams phyal gyi phu'i (93na)brag dkar po them pa 'dra ba la sbas shing tshig brgyud dang snyan brgyud rnams lce sgom nag po dang rgyal ba zhang ston sogs la gnang ste rim par brgyud pa'i chos skor la/ thog mar kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'i spros bcas bum dbang tshangs pa'i dra ba gnad yig dang bcas pa'i steng nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa lnga —135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne la brten nas bum dbang / bdud rtsi la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang / shes rab ma la brten nas bha ga'i dbang / tshig don ngo sprod brda'i dbang / spros med kyi dbang chog rin cen dra ba gnad yig dang bcas pa'i steng nas chos dbyings skye mched rang byung gsum la brten nas yi ge 'khor lo'i dbang /bde chen spyi blugs/ rgyas gdab tshangs pa/ rig pa rtsal dbang / kun bzang chos dbyings lhun grub bzhi la brten nas chos nyid don gyi dbang / shin tu spros med dbang chog padma'i dra ba gnad yig dang bcas pa'i steng nas bla ma'i gsol 'debs sngon du btang ba'i a drug gis byin dbab ste thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas ye shes lnga dbyings su thim pa'i dbang / rab tu spros med kyi dbang chog 'od kyi dra ba gnad yig dang bcas pa'i steng nas sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i dbang / longasasku'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i dbang / legs par nos nas/ lung la/ spyir rgyud bco brgyad man ngag brgya bcu dgu/ zab pa pod bzhi/ yang zab kyi yang zab phra yig can dang bcas pa'i chos tshan brgya zhe gnyis yod par bshad pa'i rgyud kyi skor dang man ngag gnyis las/ dang po la/ dbang rdzogs pa rang byung chen po'i rgyud le'u nyer lngas spros pa la dga' ba rnams smin (93ba) par byed pa dbang gi rim pa bstan/ gsang ba yi ge med pa'i rgyud chen po rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi rgyud rgyal ba'i gdung brgyud mi 'gyur ba lta ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bstan pa'i rgyud le'u drug gis smin zin grol bar byed pa'i man ngag gi gnad bstan/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dngos su bshad pa ye shes 'dus pa'i mdo theg pa chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gsang sngags gcig pa'i ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i don gsal bar byed pa'i rgyud rig pa rang shar chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba ston pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan gyis dur khrod me ri 'bar bar 'khor rnams kyi rtog pa bsal ba ye shes lag phrad du bstan pa le'u brgyad cu rtsa drug pa slob dpon bi mā la mi tras sgra mi mthun pa sum brgya las bsgyur ba 'di rje ma gtogs nyang la yang med pas shel gyi glegs shing du bsdams nas dngul gyi ga'ur bcug gzer chen — 136

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)po bzhi btab ste/ re nag gis gril phung byed kyi ngan sngags yin pa skad du byas nas rje mnga' bdag gis nyang gi gter gyi zlar sba ru bcug pa/ rgyud 'dis lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i brjod bya khyad par du gsal bar byed/ ston pa stobs ldan chen pos dur khrod chen po me ri 'bar bar 'khor rnams kyi rtog pa bsal ba rgyud kun gyi lde mig tu gsungs pa'i rig pa rang grol chen po thams cad grol ba'i rgyud le'u bcu pa bi mā las bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ 'dis ma'i sa gcad dmigs kyis bsal bar byed pa rin po che spungs pa yon tan chen po ston pa rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lngas yon tan rang rdzogs su ston pa/ rin po che (94na skyo/ gdung 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po las gsang ba yang bsdus kyi snying po rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi pa las khyad par du phyung ba dpal nam mkha' med pa sku gdung 'bar ba chen po'i rgyud le'u gsum pa mkhas pa bi mā la mi tra dang lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ 'dis rtags rnams gsal bar bstan/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po sho lo ka 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi pa las khyad par du bkod pa rin po che 'byung bar byed pa sgra thal 'gyur chen po chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar bstan pa'i rgyud le'u drug gis sde snod kun gyi rtsa ba ston/ bkra shis mdzes ldan chen po rgyud dpal nam mkha' med pa chen po zhes bya ba le'u lngas 'brul pa bzlog tshul ngos 'dzin/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long zhes bya ba yang gsang gab sbas pa'i rgyud rdzogs pa chen po gtan la 'bebs pa gzhen nu dpa' bo stobs ldan gyi dur khrod me ri 'bar bar gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pa rnams la rang rang gi don dngos su bstan pa bka' dam pa gsang ba'i rgyud chen le'u brgyad pa mchims phu brag dmar dge gong gi tshal du slob dpon gyi bi mā las sgra mi mthun pa gsum las bsgyur ba ska cog gnyis kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa nyang gis zha'i mgon po gri thod can la gnyer du gtad nas gter du sbas/ 'dis ngo sprad pa dang dbang dam tshig gi man ngag ston/ kun tu bzang po thugasakyi me long gi rgyud le'u bzhis goms sgrib shan 'byed ston/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rgyud las phyung ba ngo sprod rin po ches spras pa'i zhing khams bstan pa'i rgyud le'u gsum — 137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gegyi dpe don gyi yid ches skyed/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa (94bsgo zha po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las phyung ba mu tig rin po che'i 'phreng ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad kyis man ngag tha dad pa'i thabs kyis grol bar ston/rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bcud phyung ba kun tu bzang po slong drug gi rgyud le'u drug gis rigs drug gnas su dag par ston/ rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug sto rtsa bzhi'i bcud phyung ba las gser gyi me tog mdzes pa'i rin po che sgron ma 'bar ba'i rgyud le'u bzhis sgron ma bzhi ston/ nyi ma dang / zla ba kha sbyor ba chen po gsang ba'i rgyud le'u bzhis bar do ston/ kun tu bzang pos 'og min gyi gnas su 'khor rnams la rig pa'i thabs bstan pa gsang sngags kun gyi rtsa ba'i don ma nor bar ston pa'i rgyud ye shes lag phrad du bstan pa dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su bstan pa'i rgyud seng ge rtsal rdzogs chen po le'u bcu gsum gyis lta ba phyogs ris med par ston/ nor bu phra bkod rang gi don thams cad gsal bar byed pa'i rgyud le'u bzhis lam srol du 'dzud par ston/ bka' srung khrosam nag mo gsang ba snying gi rgyud dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mos gsungs pa le'u sum cu so gcig /khros nag gis tshangs pa gdong bzhi par sprul nas gsungs pa'i rgyud le'u zhe gcig /yang sprul mu stegasabadud du sprul nas gsungs pa'i le'u lnga rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags gtso bor ston pa'i bka' srung gi rgyud 'dis sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs shing bdud bshan pa lag dmar gyis bka'i sdud po byas nas gter du sbas pas rgyud bcu bdun gyi gras su mi 'os so snyam na/ phyag na rdo rje gzi brjid kyis dregs pa rang gi srog snying rgyud brtan nas phul ba/ gsang bdag gis rgyud bcu bdun gyi bka'i srung mar gdams pa'i (95na skrag sngags khyad par can yin pas so/ /tshangs pas gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi las kyi grangs bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i thems rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ drag po'i ngan thabs dgra glo bur du byung na brdeg pa rdzas kyi yang tig /ngan sngags gsang ba'i man ngag 'byung bzhi'i sdeb yig bka' srung dpang du btsugs la sbyi ni no'i mtha' can rnams/ de yang mu tig 'phreng ba las/ rgya mtsho dang ni nyi ma dang : seng ge dang ni ri rgyal dang : 'bor lo dang ni lde mig dang : ral gri dang ni gsal shing dang :—138

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las sgrogs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gser zhu dang ni ma bu 'brel me long dang ni mu tig dkyus: sbrul mdud dang ni khyung chen dang : chu rgyun dang ni sbu gri dang : rgyal po dang ni bang mdzod dang : de dag rnam par phye bas na tshig rgyud gsal bar byed pa'o de yi don rnams rnam dbye bas: ngo bo nyid kyis mthong bar 'gyur zhes pa ltar dpe bco brgyad rim pa bzhin du rig par rang shar/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long / seng ge rtsal rdzogs/yi ge med pa/ bkra shis mdzes ldan/ sgra thal 'gyur/ kun bzang thugs kyi me long / sgron ma 'bar ba/ nor bu phra bkod/ nyi zla kha sbyor/ngo sprod spras pa/ mu tig 'phreng ba/ rig pa rang grol/ klong drug pa/ rdzogs pa rang byung / nag mo khros ma/ sku gdung 'bar ba/ rin cen spungs pa rnams rim par sbyor zhing / yang de nyid las/ rgyud kyi snying po gsum shes na rgyal blon 'bangs gsum 'dzom pa 'dra: rgyud kyi dwangs ma gsum shes na ri gsum rtse mor phyin pa 'dra rgyud kyi me tog gsum shes na mkha' la nyi ma gsum shar 'dra rgyud kun sdom gcig shes pa na mkhar gyi 'gram rdo legs tshugs 'dra: snang ba gting rdzogs(95ba)rgyud shes na rtse mo 'byongs pa'i mkhar dang 'dra ye shes g.yul bzlog rgyud shes na phyogs bzhi skar khung dod pa 'dra yan lag rgyud chen gnyis shes na ngos bzhir ba gam btags pa 'dra rnal 'byor grol ba'i rgyud shes na rgyal po mkhar gyi rtser bzhag 'dra: snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud shes na de la sgo mo dam bsgrigs 'dra gsang bar rang gzhung rgyud shes na mtha' ma lcags ris bskor ba 'dra mtshon cha lta bu'i rgyud shes na go zhub ldan pa'i sgo drung 'dra: zhes snying po gsum ni rang shar rang grol/ yi ge med pa/ dwangs ma gsum ni/ nor bu phra bkod/ rdor sems me long / kun bzang me long / me tog gsum ni/ mu tig 'phreng ba/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs/ bkra shis mdzes ldan/ sdom gcig ni rdzogs pa rang byung / snang ba gting rdzogs ni/ ngo sprod spras pa/ ye shes g.yul bzlog ni/ nyi zla kha sbyor/ yan lag gnyis ni/ rin cen spungs pa/ sku gdung 'bar ba/ rnal 'byor grol ba ni/ sgron mo 'bar ba/ snying dang 'dra ba ni/ klong drug pa/ gsang ba rang gzhung ni/ sgra thal 'gyur/mtshon cha lta bu ni/ nag mo khros ma ste rgyud bco brgyad po 'di dag theg pa kun gyi yang rtse bla na med pa — 139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dba'i blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'o//gnyis pa yang zab man ngag gi skor la/rgya che ba dang zab pa gnyis/dang po ni/kha byang gi rgyal po nyi mas brgyan pa las/brgya dang bcu dgu man ngag dam pa rnams:zhesaman ngag brgya bcu dgur gsungs pa'i dang po dum dum 'khrigs nas mtha' ma padma kha 'byed kyi bar yig sna brgya bcu dgu yod pa dus dbang gis phal cher rgyun nub cing /'ga' zhig bzhugs pa'ang kho bo'i spyod yul du ma gyur la/'on kyang 96na ) rgya che ba'i phyogs tu gtogs pa rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gi lo rgyus chen mo zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi lo rgyus rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa'o//zhes mthar tshang ba/rigs 'dzin gyi gnas 'byed bdun pa dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi bar khang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa mthar tshang ba/gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i lo rgyus skal ldan yid ches kyi gnad bstan pa rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba/lce btsun gyi mgur sangs rgyas yid ches ma rnams/gnyis pa zab pa'i skor ni/kha byang las/e ma/gsang mchog dam pa gzhan du ma bstan pa'i snying las lhag pa'i man ngag snying thig la:kha byang rnams su bkod par ma phod pa'i rtsa rnams mdud pa snying la 'dus pa ltar brgya dang bcu dgu man ngag dam pa rnams yang gsang snying dang 'dra ba bzhi la 'dus zhes rgya che ba'i chos kyi snying po mtha' dag zab pa pod bzhir 'dus par bstan pod bzhi'i rgyu mtshan yang sgron ma rang gsal las snying po nges pa'i rang bzhin 'di lta bu phyis kyang 'byung ba shin tu dkon pa'o:de yi don gyi tshad ni 'di lta bu gzhan gyis bsgyur zhing bshig par dka' ba'i phyir shog tshad snod kyi bye brag 'di lta ste zhes byang bu'i rgyu dang tshad yi ge sogs gsungs pa ltar/thog mar chos kyi bka' mi 'chal zhing yid ches kyi go ba bskyed pa'i ched du rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi man ngag zab pa pod bzhi'i kha byang gi rgyal po nyi mas brgyan pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po bi mā la mi tras lho phyogs bhe ta'i yul rin po che snang bar mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i shog tshad nges pa'i kha byang sgron ma rang gsal zhes bya ba/kha byang de dag las 96ba ) gsungs pa ltar/rgyud dang man ngag gi ma bu nges pa'i kha byang gnyis yod par grag pa ni mthob/gser yig can/dung 4༷ga can/zangs yig can/g.yu yig can dang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabazhi/ de yang la lar phra yig can logs su 'dren na'ang / zangs yig gi skor du 'du zhing / dung yig dang zangs yig 'dren tshul snga phyi ma nges pa mang du byung na'ang / kha byang las/ dum bu nges pa'i grangs ni du yod pa ma bu nges pa nyid ni 'di lta ste zhes bstan pa'i skabs dung yig can sngon du 'byung bas de'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin la/ de yang dang po gser yig can la ma bu gnyis kyi dang po ni/ kha byang las/ bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i bu gcig pu sus kyang byas pa med pa'i yi ge nyid rang byung kun gyi thog mar byung bsan skad dang brda rnams mi mthun med pa'i phyir skal ldan rnams kyis mthong zhing blta ba'i tshe yi ge rang rang mthun pa nyid du shes zhes dang / de'i 'phros las/ 'di nyid su la gnang ba'i mi de ni: skal dang ldan pas nges par grol ba'o: zhes btags grol gyi rgyud 'di la kha byang du/ bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i bu gcig bu dum bu gcig ste ma bu gnyis yod do: zhes pa'i ma yig bstan pa bu gcig gi rgyu dam sangs(rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pu gsang ba gcod pas sa bon gyi rgyud rang byung gi yi ge sprul sku'i sa bon 'phel bar byed pa 'jig rten na rab tu dkon pa'i tshig rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba sho lo ka nyis brgya dang phyed dang brgyad pa le'u bdun du phye ba/ gnyis pa bu yig la btags srol dang 'das rjes gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha byang las/ rdo rje 'chang gi tshig gnad nges pa med na mchod pa'i dus mi shes (97na8 ltar ma dang bu gnyis bsdebs pas bstan pa bu gcig 'grub:ces sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig gi rgyud kyi gsang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba mchod pa'i dus gnad nges pa rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba/ thems med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig bu gsang ba gcod pa sa bon gyi rgyud kyi don gsal bar ston pa'i 'bru 'grel chen po slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ de yang btags grol 'di ni gser yig can gyi khongs su gtogs par kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams kyis grub mtha' mdzod du gsungs shing / de'i rjes su 'brangs na'ang / sgron ma rang gsal las/ rin cen lnga yi rang byung byang bu ni sus kyang byas shing bzo yis ma bsgrub pa 'byung ba'i dgra dang bral ba'i byang bu ni bzhe bcu — 141 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )brgyad de sus kyang bshig tu med rang byung yi ge skad kyi rigs ltar snang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasa'abrangs kyi mi lang ba'i byin rlabs nyid la rang snang nyid du shar rin cen shel gyi glegs shing bar du stem rnam bdun rin cen gzer chen bzhi yis bsdams: zhes yi ge yang gdul bya so so'i snang ngor de dang de'i yi ger 'char bar gsungs pa dang / gsan yig rnying pa la lar gser yig can la kha btags grol gyi tha snyad gzhag rung ba lta bu byung yang de ltar ma grags zhes pa ltar na dpyad dgos par snang ngo / /gnyis pa 'das rjes kyi skor ni/ sgron ma rang gsal las/ rin cen mthing sngon byang bu bcu drug la rin cen gser gyi yi ger spras pa ste: zangs kyi dra ba'i nang du bcug pa ni 'das rjes gsum po nyid de rab tu (97ba)gsang : zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi 'das rjes gsum gyi dang po e e e ma rigs kyi bu zhes sogs dga' ldan 'tsho byed gzhen nu'i sdum rar babs pa man ngag rnams kyi rtsa ba dga' rab rdo rjes rtogs pa'i gdeng rnyed do zhes pa mthar tshang ba/ de'i 'grel ba'i tshul du zhal chems gnyis pa e ma ho rigs kyi bu zhes sogs gsang chen rol pa'i dud khrod du babs pa mkha' 'gro mas gnas su snang bar byas so mthar tshang ba/ de'i 'grel ṭīka gi tshul du zhal chems gsum pa zag pa rang zad ces sogs bya rgod phung rir babs pa dngos grub kun gyi rtsa bar 'byung mthar tshang ba/ thems med skor la de dang 'dra min sangs rgyas kyi zhal chems dang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa rdo rje 'chang zhes sogs dga' rab rdo rje rtogs pa gdeng dang ldan par gyur tos mthar tshang ba/ 'digs yig gas na med bawo bos pa dpyad/ 'das rjes gnyis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i stobs zhes sogs bstan pa thams cad kyi bcud bsdus shing bu gcig par bstan pa'o mthar tshang ba/ 'das rjes gsum par rang grol rdo rje 'chang zhes sogs bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig par bkod pa 'os mthar tshang ba sang rgyas kyi 'das rjes ga po kha byang ro twa snang byed du brgya bcu dgu'i nang phywa du bshad kyang kha byang nyi ༅ na zab pa pod bzhi'i gras su gsungs shing grub mtha' mdzod kyi kha byang dang —142

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganayang mas no/ /rigs 'dzin gyi 'das rjes bzhi las dga' rab rdo rje tshig gsum gnad du rdeg pa dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du babs pa chu bo dan tig gi 'gor snang ba byas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skad cig la grol bar byed pa'i man ngag rdzogs byang (98na)gi mthar tshang ba/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi sgom nyams tshig drug pa dur khrod so sa gling du babs pa rig pa sbar zin gyi gdams pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ shrī sidha'i gzer bu bdun pa bkra shis khri sgor du babs pa long ba'i sna 'khrid dang 'dra ba rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ ye shes mdo'i gzhag thabs bzhi pa dur khrod bha sing du babs pa mun khung gi sgron me dang 'dra ba rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ mkhas pa bi mā la mi tra'i zhal chems rang rig gsal ba'i sgron ma lce btsun la dngos su gnang nas byang phyogs sdig rgyal gyi don du mkha' la rlung ltar gshegs pa na ra skan gyi mthar tshang ba/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug gi zhal chems gsang bya'i gnang 'dus pa gnad gsum gyi man ngag sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston la gtad pa rnams/ gnyis pa drung yig can ni/ sgron ma rang gsal las/ ra gan glebs pa'i byang bu lnga bcu la dkar po dung bzhusayi ge btab pa ni gsang ba dung yig can te 'di yang gsang : zhes gsungs pa'i skor ni thems byang las gsang ba rgyud kyi khog snying man ngag nyid dung yig can la dum gcig ma bu bdun zhes pa ltar rgyud kyi yong don bsdus pa sgron ma snang byed ces bya ba bam mdo rgyud kun gyi don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba ma dum bu gcig la rgyud bcu bdun nag mo khros ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad kyi so so'i nges tshig dbye ba dgos pa mtshon dpe khong bas le grangs te don tshan bu bdun du bstan pa dur khrod bha sing du bi mā las mkha' 'gro rnams kyi don du mdzad pa long ba'i sna khrid lta bu las can gcig dang phrad shog (98na)gi mthar tshang ba/ thems med skor la rgyud kyi gnad tshig gsang ba zhes bya ba rgyud bcu bdun khros ma nag mo dang bcas pa'i rgyab yig mkhas pa chen po bi mā mi thos mdzad cing sgra rang 'gyur/ dung yig can gyi gnad yig rgyud kyi khong snying bsdebs pa gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen du bsdus pa gsal ba mig gi lde mig ces bya ba rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba rnams/ gsum pa zangs yig can ni/ sgron ma — 143—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherang gsal las/ra gan glebs pa'i byang bu drug stol/dmar po zangs zhun yi ger btab pa ni/rin cen mchong gi glegs shing bar du stem rin cen lnga yi gzer chen gnyis kyi bsdams brtse yi sgrom bu khog nag nang du stsal:gsang ba'i man ngag zangs yig can de ni:rab tu gsang bas rnal 'byor don rab 'grub ces pa'i skor la thems byang las/yang gab zangs kyi yi ge can la ni spros bcas rnams la dum bu bcu drug yod:spros med rnams la dum bu gcig gis ston bu brgyad ma dang dgu yis don gnyis 'grub ces gang zag spros pa la dga' ba'i don du ming gi nges bzung ma bu gnyis las/dang po ma yig gi skor la/spros pa gcod pa'i sgron me phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/goms par bya ba'i gnad kyi gdams ngag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong bar byed pa rdzogs byang dang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun de dang 'brel bar chags med rlung chags can rig ma la brten nas bsgom thabs rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/lta sgom 'byed pa'i lde mig sbas pa ming 'byed ces pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/sgom pa bsdus99na ) pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/lta ba bsdus pa'i sgron me rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/'bras bu bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/nyams su len pa'i gcun thabs rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba lus bcos pa'i gnad kyi man ngag gsang ba mchog tu zab pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/mjug tu lung dang ldan pa'i spyon pa lce btsun bdag ces so gos gter byang gcig/lta ba 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu rgan mo mdzub gtsugs su bstan pa'i man ngag mchog tu zab pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/snang ba'i 'char lugs su bstan pa snying po bsdus pa rig pa spar zin gyi man ngag rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba mjug tu bstan pa'i snying po dar tshul dang bcas pa/rig pa'i rgyab rten bcud rnams bsdus pa'i snying po zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/'gal ba bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/gzhan don bsdus pa'i bcud phur zhes pa rdzogs byang dang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/rig pa bsduX pa'i sgron ma zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)rig pa sku gsum du gtan la dbab pa sku gsum bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang dang bcas pa/ lta sgom bcud bsdus sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ thig le nyag gcig tu gtan la phab pa nyag gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ rig pa dge sdig las 'das par gtan la phab pa dge sdig bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba rnams/gnyis pa bu yig gi skor la/ chags can gsang sngags la sbyar bar bya ba'i spra 'khrid rdzogs (99ba)byang gi mthar tshang ba/ rin po che rlung gi spra 'khrid ces bya ba thig le phyi ma la bslab pa/ chagasabral gyi 'bras bu phrad lha/ga mthar tshang ba/ nyams len bsdus pa'i sna khrid yang gab sbas dum mam yang gsang sbas pa'i ti ka gsang ba yi ge dmar ru'i yang tig gnad yig chen mor grags pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ mjug tu 'di min gzhan la spyod pa'i sgom chen yi re chad ces sogs bi mā la'i gsung sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba/ man ngag mdo byang bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes pa thams cad kyi don 'grel chen mo phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ man ngag rin po che'i dems shis dmigs gtad gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma sgom khrigs chen mo rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ nyams su len pa rnams kyi rtags yig bsdus pa'am rtags yig gsang ba rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba bi mā las sgra mi mthun pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsgyur ba/ gsang ba chen po tshad kyi yi ge sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ mngon sum snying thig gsang ba'i yi ge dmar ru'i rgyab yig phung po mi snang bar 'tshang rgya ba'i mtha' can te brgyad po 'di rnams bu yig brgyad du grags shing grub mdzod du rlung dang chags pa'i spra 'khrid yang gab tshad rtags lnga phra yig tu ngos 'dzin mdzad/ thems med skor la yi ge dmar ru'i yang 'byed sbas pa'i lde mig gsal ba chen po snang 'byed sgron ma zhes pa bi mā las sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba mjug tu bdag 'dra bi mā la mu tra rgyal rigs zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad lce btsun gyis phyung zhing sbas pa'i mtha' can/ 'di gsan yig rnying pa 'ga' na sems dmigs drug pa'i gzhung (100na)dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa dang / de'i rnam bshad bi mā las mdzad pa'i don dril bar 'chad cing — 145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shezangs yig skor min pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa brtag go /lha sras mu tig btsan pos zangs yig brag tu sbas pa'i yang snying bcud kyi dum bu zhes bya ba gsang ba snying gi don bstan pa 'dzam gling gzhan na med nges pa/ 'di khu ru rdzo rtse spyan drang pa yin 'dug zhal ldan nyams su len pa'i rgyab brten yang snying 'phrul gyi dum bu zhes pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ gnyis po 'di phra yig can gyi khongs su mdzad/ bi mā las mdzad pa'i gsang ba bla med sgron ma dgu skor gyi nang tshan sku gsum bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ sems nyid bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ stong nyid bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ dbyings dang ye shes kyi don bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ phyag rgya bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ shes rab bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ ye shes bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrad shog mthar tshang ba/ rig pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma rdzogs byang phrang shog mthar tshang ba/ dbang gi skor la spros bcas dbang gi phyag bzhes dang po'i dpe las/ dbab mi skor rnams bsags gu'i ldebs su byed pa bo gan ne zang mig khongs su 'dren pa 4da par sems mod slar yang dpyad do/ /lag len khrigs su lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ spros med kyi dbang bskur ba rin po (100brdzi'i bkod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ yang de dang 'dra min mthug tu rin cen dbang gi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ spros pa med pa'i dbang gsal bar byed pa'i ti ka bi mā las mdzad pa/ dbang bskur rin po che bkod pa'i gnad kyi yi ge rdzogs byang dang bcas pa/ spros med kyi bum thig dag pa sbyar ba byar med klong yangs kyis mchims phur mdzad pa/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i skal ldan gyi dbang gi rtsa ba bi mā las sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa dbang gi lag len spra 'khrid bi mā las mdzad pa/ rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang bskur ba'i rtsa ba sngags kyi rgyal mo la srungs shig pa mtha' tshang ba/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor —146

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagyi dbang bskur ba'i sgron ma snang byed bkod pa rin po che'i phra tig dum bu gsum pa dang dum bu bzhi pa bi mā las mdzad pa/ rab tu spros med ye shes 'char ba'i dbang 'brel spyod pa dag tu nus pa yin gyi mthar tshang ba/ dbang rnams kyi phra tig rnam par phye ba rnal 'byor pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga smra ba'i ti ka zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mkha' 'gro ma brtse ba'i blo gros kyi don du mdzad pa/ dbang gi rim pa bstan pa skyes bu rdo rje legs pa la bcol ba'i mtha' can/ dbang bskur 'jug dus bstan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ dbang gi skor 'di kha byang du pod bzhi'i gang du gtogs kyi gsal kha ma byung yang zangs yig can gyi skor du gtogs pa gsung rgyun du 'dug la/gsan yig rnying pa'i rigs na logs su 'dug pas brtag go /bzhi pa g.yu yig can po ti smug (101na)chung gi skor ni gsan yig la lan zab pa pod bzhir ma bgrangs par 'das rjes dang btags grol gnyis so sor bgrangs te pod bzhir ngos bzung ba 'dug na'ang grub mtha' mdzod du 'di zab pa dbang pod bzhi'i ya rgyal du bshad pas 'thad dam snyam/kha byang nang gsu yig can dang po ti smug chung so sor bshad nas yang gsang bum 'khrigs sogs smug chung du ngo bzung ba mkhas pa la la'i bzhed par nga bas slar mang phyogs 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes 'dra rnyed na dpyad par bya'o/ /mdo byang las/ sgra dang tha snyad bkod pa chen po las snying po 'di ni yongs su bsdus pa'o/ khren tu dkon pas sngon pa'i g.yu yis bris gzhan dang thun mong dag tu ma byas la: 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba'i yi ge'o: zhes gsang skor sogs gzhan mtha' dag las shin tu zab pa g.yu yig can po ti smug chung gi skor 'di la'ang 'dra min zhig yod na'ang ngo bo 'di ni bse rin po che'i byang bu dmar po la g.yu'i yi ger bris nas sog po g.yu'i smin ma can gyi yul nas bsgyur ba la/ kha byang las/ gsang ba yang zhun po ti smug chung la chos kyi sde dang grangs ni gsal bya'i phyir gsang ba'i dems 'di lhag dang chad med par yid chesa'ajug phyir yi ge 'di la ltos zhes sogs las gsal ba ltar/ ma yig rin po che rmongs pa'i gdung ba gcad pa/ bu yig rin po che gser gyi sgrom bu/ thor bu'i skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bkod pa chen po dum bu'i rgyud las rmongs pa'i gdung sel lo rgyus bstan par zhugadon bcu gnyis kyi nang gses — 147—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()brgyud pa gsum pa'am dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pas brgyud pa'i tshig don zhes pa ston pa'i byon tshul zhus don dang po/bstan pa'i
