chos ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshig don bstan te 'jug sgo gsal ba zhus don 101bgi nyis pa/gcad par bya ba'i 'bras bu'i don tshig gi gzhung don la dbri gzhug med pa zhus don gsum pa/bstan pa'i chos rnams kyi sde dang grangs gtan la phab pa zhus don bzhi pa/tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyis gzhud rnams gsal ba zhus don lnga pa/gsang ba snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud rnams bsdus te bstan pa zhus don drug pa/phyi rabs skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag 'byung bar lung bstan pa zhus don bdun pa/bstan pa'i snying po'i 'byung khungs bstan pa zhus don brgyad pa/bstan pa dam pa'i 'phel 'grib ji ltar 'byung ba lung bstan pa zhus don dgu pa/nges pa'i 'bras bu thob pa 'byung bar rang dengs su song ba'i grangs lung bas pa zhugadon bstob/bar dor la'i rgya bar lung bstan pa zhus don bstogacig pa/rang bzhin sprul skur dbugs 'byin bstan pa zhu lan bcu gnyis pa ste rmongs pa'i gdung ba rnam par bsal ba rgyud gsum du gtan la phab ste/shā ri'i bu dme 'od bzang gis ston pa 'od srungs nyid la zhus pa'i lan mtha' rten rdo rje legs pa dang mgon po dres thag can la gter rgya phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/de'i 'phros las rgya gar nub phyogs glang po sgang gi grong zhes sogs gter byang dang bcas te paṇḍita chen po :mā la mi tras rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba/gnyis pa bu yig rin po che gser gyi sgrom bu'i nang gses la/bkod pa chen po las sems kyi gnad gtan la phab pa skabs don gnyis bu yig la skabs don dang po mi yong ba ma yig skabs don dang por ngos bzung ba yin no//pa/rgyud lung gsal ba'i me long skabs don gsum pa/lha sgom lugs gnad kyi man ngag skabs don bzhi pa/skye med kyi man ngag 102na gi tan la phab pa skabs don lnga pa/chos sku cog bzhag tu gtan la phab pa skabs don drug pa/'brul pa gong pa'i gal mdo skabs don bdun pa/nyon mongs rang dag gtan la phab pa skabs don brgyad pa/lhag pa'i bsam gtan gtan la phab pa skabs don dgu pa/rang bzhin zhing khams kyi gnad gtan la phab pa /bas don bcu pa/lusang ga gi bya byed gtso bor

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabyed pa gtan la phab pa skabs don bcu gcig pa/ bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa skabs don bcu gnyis pa ste bkod pa chen po 'bum tsho drug pa le'u stong phrag bzhi pa las rim pa mngon bstan gsang ba snying gi le'u zhes bya ba le'u sum brgya pa las 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis phyung ba so sor rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba rnams/gsum pa thor bu'i skor la/ chos thams cad kyi mdo gces pa'i snying po slob dpon 'jam dpal bzhes gnyen gyis kha che'i yul du rang don du gtan la phab pa mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ral pa can la gdams pa rdzogos byang gi mthar tshang ba/ dpe rnams bsdus pa'i sgron ma'am ngo sprod rin po che'i 'khor lo zhes pa rig pa'i ye shes dpe du ma'i sgo nas bshad pa sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes gzhan don du gtan la phab pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ de'i mthug tu rgyud med rnam par dag pa'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang:zhes sogs rgyud kyi che ba dang bka' rgyas btab pa dga' rab rdo rje'i gsung / 'chi ba brtag pa'i gal mdo zhes pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis rang gzhan gnyis kyi don du mdzad pa/ de'i 'phros las sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa nges pa'i bka' (102ba)zhes sogs che ba dang lung bstan gto rgyar bcas pa/ 'chi ba blu ba'i man ngag slob dpon shrī sims rang don du mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ de'i 'phros las/ sangs rgyas dgongs pa mthar thug nges pa'i lung : zhes sogs lo rgyus gter srung gtad rgya sogs bi mā las sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba/ lta ba'i snying po la nang gses kyi stong pa'i yul dngos po lam du byed pa ngo mtshar gyi gad mo bcu gnyis pa/ ngoms pa'i tshig dgus gzhi'i bcud phyung ba/ gzhi thams cad kyi bcud phyung nas lung kun gyi rgyan du bkod pa khyad du 'phags pa'i tshig dgus gtan la phab pa/ dran pa rang yal gyi thabs bzhi'i don gtan la phab pa che ba bcu drug pa/ gos bu'i rang nyams gtan la phab pa khyad med bdun pa/ mjug gdams dang bcas pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po ye shes mdos rgyud kun gyi khong don du mdzad pa so sor rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/de'i 'phros las sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud: ces sogs rang gi lo rgyus rgyas btab dang — 149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bcas pa ye shes mdo'i gsung bi mā la mi tra'i rang 'gyur/snang ba 'dus pa'i bcud phur ram snang ba rin po che'i spra 'khrid ces bya ba mkhas pa bye ma la mu tras dur khrod chen po rab tu snang byed du mkha' 'gro bde ba'i yid can gyi don du mdzad pa rdzogs byang mthar tshang ba/de'i 'phros las dam pa sangs rgyas kun gyi zhal mthong ba bdud rtsi'i ro ldan pa'i zhes sogs mchims phu brag btsan dang khro mo rag gdong mar bcol dam/gsang ba yang zhun bo ti smug chung gi thems byang man ngag dum bu'i dems mkhasapa bi mā las mdzad pa/lte btsun gyis103na ) gter nas btan cing slar yang sbas pa'i smon lam rtselha byang chub la gnyer gtad dang bcas pa 'di'i dbang du jong nags yig rdzigazha khona'i rang ga kho cu zhin swagapa grub mtha' mdzod du ldang ma'i gter ma yin par bshad pa dang ma mas pas the tshom gyi gzhi cung zad snang ngo /rnams/gzhan yang zab pa pod bzhi'i thems med ngo bo nyid kyi gdams pa grol bar byed pa'i yi ge bsdus pa rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/smug nag khros ma rag gdong ma'i dus gnad nges pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba rnams so//gzhan yang chos skor 'ga' zhig yod tshod du 'dug kyang kho bos thob pa ni re zhig de tsam mo//gong smos rnams legs par thob pa las dbang dang rgyud bcu bdun gyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/longs sku zhi khro 4 'phas/sprul sku rdo rje la4 rsā/rdo rje sems dpa'/gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/rigs 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/mkhasapa shrī sidha/slob dpon dzña na su tra/paṇa chen bi māl mi tra/nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal/lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug/sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston bkra shis rdo rje/mkhas pa nyi ma 'bum/chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber/'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab ba/grub chen me long rdo rje/rigs 'dzin kum rā dza/kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/mtshungs med bya bral chos rje/sangs rgyas dbon po/stag mgo yon to dpal ba/bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/stag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa kun dga' dpal bzang /chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin 103ba༄na phun tshogs/ras chung rnam sprul 0snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganachen po du ma rang grol/snang gsal pa ngag dbang ye shes 'grub pa/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//bka' srung khros nag gi rgyud rigs 'dzin ratna gling pas yang gter nas spyan drangs pa ma gtogs rgyun gzhan shin tu dkon yang rje 'phrin las lhun grub kyis snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa lta bu'i 'bad rtsol chen po la brten nas chog brgyud bzhin bzhugs pa rnyed pa'i lung brgyud ni/'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po yan gong ltar la/de nas gser gling pa chos dbyings grags pa/yang rdzong grub wo byang chub dpal mo/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/rgyal sras 'phrin las mtshan can/sngags 'chang rin cen phun tshogs/mtshungs med rin cen dar rgyas/rje btsun 'phrin las lhun grub/sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/des bdag za hor bande la'o//rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dzas rgyud 'di rno zhing zab drags pas gzhan la gnod dogs phra mo brag gi shug pa rkang gcig la gter du sbas pas dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir dpe rgyun tsam yang med par grags pa'i dus sngags srung rang gis lung bstan nas chos rgyal ratna gling pas spyan drangs pa'i nye brgyud ni/gter ston nas/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/dkar dbang las 'phro gling pa/bi mā'i rnam sprul nor bu yongs grags/de sras nor bu dbang rgyal/chos ldan ba ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa nor bu chos brtan/chos gter 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/dbang brgyud lugs 04na tshe/rtseg la/klong chen pa nas/'jam dbyangs khyab gdal lhun grub/mkhas grub grags pa 'od zer/rje nyi ma 'od zer/ma tsos med cha rje/rje chos dbyings grags pa/bla ma dkon cog dpal bzang /dkar chen kun dga' grags pa/rab stims pa dge ba'i blo gros/bla rma bstan 'dzin nor bu/rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas/gdung brgyud padma 'phrin las/gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na stag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nas/sman rtse ba ma ti dhwa dza/sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol/mkhas grub bstan 'dzin grags pa/thugs sras padma 'phrin las man gong ltar ro//zab pa pod bzhi'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/sprul sku rgyal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtorsāb zhang ston yan gong ltar la/ bsam yas mchims phu'i tshe mtshams pa skal ldan sher rdor/ sangs rgyas nyang ston dbon po/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje/ dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje/ gnyan ston ye shes rdo rje/se sdings pa sangs rgyas dpal/ se sdings pa yon tan bzang po/ gu ru chos sku 'od zer/ mtshungs med dpal 'byor dbang phyug /drin can nam mkha' gu sa rtse le ba rigs 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal/dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ rigs 'dzin ga rma gu sa rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / khra tshang pa khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang yongs grags kyi brgyud pa gcig ni/klong chen pa nas rje dge legs rgya mtsho/ bla ma yon tan dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin cen/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan (104ba)g.yag pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rje padma 'od zer/ rtse le ba rigs 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal man gong bzhin no/ /yang na klong chen pa nas mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/ bya bral chos rje bkra shis 'byung gnas/ bla ma gzhan phan rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha'i mtshan can/ mkhas grub 'od gsal klong yangs/ mkhas grub byams pa chos dbyings/ rdzogs chen pa bsod nams rin cen/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma/ ri stengs pa po glu don yod/ sangs gling gdung brgyud snying phu ba rigasa'adzin snying po/ mkhas grub khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'de rnams 'brel zhes gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud zung 'brel gyi brgyud pa dwags ston gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs ltar lce btsun nas/ grub thob lce sgom nag po/ gzad chu shur ba drang srong sngon po/ gtsang pa ya rings brag se/ thag ston padma/ 'phyong rgyas spen mkhar gyi sha ston rdor 'dzin/ nyang ston brtson khrus seng ge /sangs rgyas nyang ston dbon po man sngar bzhin no/ /sgron ma snang byed las/ phyi skor lusadang 'dra ste tha snyad rgya cher ston nang skor mig dang 'dra ste mthong ba brda yi chos: gsang skor snying dang 'dra ste dran byed zungs kyi chos: 'di ni lus kun rdzogs pa'i skyes bu 'dra: zhes pa ltar rdzogs chen phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang skor dang bzhi'i nang gi gsang skor la/ yang zug pa rtsa ba/ dril ba sdong bu/gyes pa yal 'dab/ gsal ba me tog /smin pa 'bras bu'i tshul lnga'i nang nas/ smin pa 'bras bu lta — 152

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabu'i gdams pa rdzogs chen thig le gsang skor gyi man ngag snyan (105na)brgyud 'od gsal sgron ma drug pa'i skor nyang ting 'dzin bzang pos bka' mi chad pa'i ched 'phan yul ba sbas blo gros dbang phyug skal ldan du gzigs nas gnang / de nas rim par brgyud pa la bka' ma dang / dpe brgyud rnams nyang gis zhwa'i ke'u tshang du sbas pa ldang ma lhun rgyan gyis btan nas brgyud pa la gter mar grags pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug gi skor la/ rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal gyi 'khrid yig gi steng nas pad 'dab mar me'i dkyil 'khor lta ri)du skyabs sems/ sdom gzung / rigs 'dzin bskul ba/ byin 'bebs sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor mar brten pa'i bum gsang sher dbang / rkang 'khyams rgyal po'i ngo sprod la brten nas bzhi pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang dang bcas pa smin rgyas su nos nas/ lung la/ yid ches skyed pa lo rgyus/ rtsa brgyud/ rgyab brten lung / man ngag zhal gdams/ lag len dmar 'khrid dang lnga/ dang po ni/ thig le gsang skor snyan brgyud (ka)brgyud pa'i lo rgyus don gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa/ gnyis pa rtsa brgyud la/ spyi rgyud thig le kun gsal chen po zhes bya ba man ngag gi bshad brgyud/ lta rmi rnyi/le'u dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa/ sgos rgyud la nang gses kyis bstan pa thams cad kyi snying po sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas rang chas chen por bzhugs pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ ngo sprod spras pa zhing khams bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ ye shes mar me'i rgyud dam sgron ma rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ sangasargyas rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa tshig gsum (105ba)pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa rnams/ gsum pa rgyab rten lung ni/ man ngag snying gi dgongs pa rgyal ba'i bka' zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ bzhi pa man ngag zhal gdams la/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje'i snyan brgyud dbye ba lnga'i gdams pa/ sangs rgyasango sprod dgongs pa thig 'debs kyi man ngag zhal gdams snying gi sgron ma zhes bya ba ā tsarla gnam chag pa'i dum bu rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal gyis sgra rang bsgyur du mdzad pa/ lce sgom nag po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'chad/ sangs rgyas lag bcangs su ston pa'i snyan brgyud (ka)gsang ba gnad kyi me long bi — 153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mā la'i gser chos/'chi khar 'tshang rgya ba khug pa lnga'i man ngag rdo rje sems dpa' la gsang bdag gis zhus pa/dbugs ma chad par 'tshang rgya ba'i khug pa lnga'i 'pho ba (ka)gter yig mkhyid gang pa/zhi khro'i sgom khog skye med chos dbyings yem ma rnams/lnga pa lag len dmar 'khrid la/sngon 'gro thugs kyi me long la thun mong gi sngon 'gro rgyal la srus rdo rje thugs mchoge rtsal gyis mdzad pa/thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'tsho chos 'a)spyod rin cen rtsar phreng ngag dbang nor bus mdzad pa/dgasaston gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 9)sa de bas bla ma yi dam ma/sngon 'gro'i gsol 'debs rig pa'i 9)gnas lugs ma dam pa'i zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa/gzhi lam 'bras gsu ma dang yan lag bdun pa'i (ri)gsol 'debs skabs bzhi ma/bla ma dran pa'i dus su gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud lta ri)pa gnas sbrags ma/brtan bzhugs lta ri)sngon tshe dpag med ma/rgyal sras thugs mchag rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i skyabs lta ri)sems mthong ba don ldan/des mdzad pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag byed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas06na ) kyi (ri)'khrid bu chung /des mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyud grol byed bla ma bsten (rin tshul rnal 'byor sgom thabs dang bcas pa/des mdzad pa'i maṇḍal 'bul ba'i (ri)'khrid yig tsho gis gnyis zung 'jug/des mdzad pa'i gab dkrugs 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i thad 9)g.yi rṣa mo/des mdzad pa'i spyi don dgu pa zhing khams kyi brdas9)sa thul grol shan 'byed zhing khams ngo sprod/des mdzad pa'i 'brul grol 9)gsal byed mun sel sgron me rnams thob pa las ri'i rtags yod pa'i dbang lung dang rtags gang yang med pa'i chos skor rnams kyi bka' ma'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun bzang yab yum/longs sku rigs lnga yab yum/sprul sku sems dpa' bcu drug/ston pa dga' rab rdo rje/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes garsā/gu ru shrī sidha/dzña na su tra/paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/sbas blo gros dbang phyug wor byangs mtshe ge'i gas yig na 'di'i mos la rtse bas 'dug pa phyag bri nor ba las gas pa'i gnad yod med dpyad/snod ldan rin cen 'bar ba/ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/lce btsun seng ge dbang /ga/gu ru shangs pa ras pa/bla ma zab don chos

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)'bar/ dam pa dge ston yab sras/ gnyan ston shes rab rtse mo/ drin can sprul sku mched gnyis/ rgya sman mig bzhi'i bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ thugs sras dge 'dun bzang po/ ri phug rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal/ mkha' spyod gtso mo don grub bzang mo/ sprul sku kun skyong gling pa/ zur lha rgyal ba dpal (106ba)bzang / 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris paṇa chen dbang rgyal rdo rje/ gcung rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ ri phug rgyal sras kun mkhyen 'byung gnas/ de sras 'jam dbyangs legs ldan/ bla chen don grub rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za thong bande la'o/ /gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po nas/gter ston ldang ma lhun rgyal man gong ltar ro/ /yang rgyud lnga'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug nas/ rgyal ba zhang ston/ bla ma nyi 'bum/ gu ru jo 'ber/ seng ge rgya pa/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ sprul sku klong chen rab 'byams/ drin cen chos dbang bzang po/ byang sems chos nyid rang grol/ gu ru shākya bzang po/ gu ru burnya shrī/ gu ru chos kyi dbang po/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rje man gong ltar ro/ /yang na mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje nas/ pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ don grub bzang mo/ rdzogs chen pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje/ legs ldan rje man 'dra/ yang na lce btsun nas/ lce sgom nag po/ sras rdzo sras rgya bo/ la stod pa gzhon dga'/ dbon lce ston rdo rje bzung / mkhas btsun 'od bzung / lhun grub rdo rje/ rong po sgom rṣa/ skal ldan ye shes/ lha rje jo skyid/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin/ lcog ro rdo rje rtse mo/sangs rgyas dbang gi rdo rje/ lce ston kro ta rā dza/ dga' rab rdo rje/ zur lha chos rje/ dam pa dpal bzang /zur shākya mi tra/ sog po dpal ye/ skrul ston kun bzang dpal/ ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ka thog pa rnam grol bzang po/ legs ldan rje man sngar bzhin (107na〉sko/ /yang ga'i rtags yod pa dang rtags gang yang med pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ gzhen nu dpa' bo stobs ldan/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo —/55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje/'jam dpal bshes gnyen/shrī sidha/padma thod 'phreng rtsal/bi mā la mi tra/nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/sbas blo gros dbang phyug/'brom rin cen 'bar/ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug/be sgom shākya/lce sgom nag po/gzad chu shur ba drang srong sngon po/gtsang pa ya ring gragasagase/mkhar steng pa thag ston padma/'phyong rgyas spen mkhar sha ston rdor gling pa/chos phug pa nyang ston brtson 'grus seng ge/dbon rin po che skal ldan pa/sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje/dgas ston dbang phyug rdo rje/gto ston ye shes rdo rje/se sdings pa yab sras/gu ru chos sku 'od zer/mtshungs med dpal 'byor dbang phyug/de sras nam mkha' gu sa klu ba zhabs drung chos dbang dpal 'byor/rigasa'adzin kurma gu sa chos dbang bstan 'dzin nyi ma/khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o//yang na sba lung ba dpal 'byor dbang phyug nas/lha bro chos kyi dbang po/rkarma gu ru man gong bzhin/yang na nam mkha' gu ru nas/rtse le rigs 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal/rtsen o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ga rma gu ru man 'dra gter ma ltar nyang gis zhwa lha khang du sbas pa ldang ma lhun rgyan gyis bton nas lce btsun la bshad/des gtsang la'ang 'gro'i chod pa stag 'dra la sbas pa lce sgom gyis bton/de nas drang srong sngon po man sngar bzhin no//manta'i rtags can spyi brgyud kyi brgyud 107ba pa ni/dpal kun tu bzang po/rdo rje sems dpa'/dga' rab rdo rje/'jam dpal bshes gnyen/shrī sidha/bi mā la mi tra/nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/sbas blo gros dbang phyug/'brom ye shes 'bar/ldang ma lhun rgyan/lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug/bsgom klu po/shes rab grags pa/la stod rje btsun zla ba/rgyal ba zhang ston/zhang chen nyi 'bum/gu ru jo 'ber/'gos dngos grub mgon/bla ma shākya rgyal mas/bla ma dpal bzang pa/bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/bla ma bde legs pa/'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/mes sgom bsam gtan bzang po/chos rgyal ratna gling pa/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/gcung ngag dbang grags pa/thugs srasang ga dbang nor bu/de sras nor bu yongs grags/gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang rgyal/gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje//ba bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o//yang

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)na kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje 'od mi 'gyur/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs bgres po/ thub pa'i dbang po/ sdud pa po phyag na rdo rje/ rigasa'adzin dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sidha/ bi mā la mi tra/ dzña na ku mā ra/ khri srong lde btsan/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ sbas blo gros dbang phyug /'brom rin cen 'bar ba/ ldang ma lhun rgyan/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /lce sgom nag po/ sras jo sras rgyal po/ bla ma la stod gshon dga'/dbon lce ston rdor bzung / mkhas btsun 'od bzung / zhig po lhun grub rdo rje/ rong pa sgom chen/ skal ldan ye shes/ lha rje jo skyid/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin/ cog ro rdo rje (108na tha mo/ sangs rgyas dbang gi rdo rje/ lce ston khra bo rgyal po/ grub chen dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas grub zur lha chos rje/ dam pa dpal bzang / shākya mi tra/ sog po'i mtshan can/ kun bzang dpal ba/ mkhas grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rnam grol bzang po/ chos kyi seng ge /sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru ga rma chos skyong / bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /lce btsun gyis bsam yas mchims phu nas g.yu yig can gyi skor rnams spyan drangs/ des phyi nang gsang ba'i skor rnams 'u yug nub ma'i brag seng ge 'dra bar sbas pa lce sgom nag pos brtane/ zhang ston bkra shes rdo rjes gsang ba bla med skor rnams byal gyi phu'i brag dkar them pa 'dra ba nas bton pas gter ston gsum po 'di'i gter chos kyang don gyis thob bo/ /kha byang lo rgyus las/ dzña na su tra drin can gyis bi mā la mi tra bdag la gtad: bod du gdan drangs snying la bcangs bstan pa'i gnad med sems la rnogs rgya nag 'gro khar zangs kyi ga'u phu bcug ste sgrags kyi yang rdzong dag tu sbas las can zhig gis rnyed par sgo(ga ces rdzogs chen thugs kyi snying po bstan pa'i rgyud la brten nas nyams len mdo don du bsgril pa mkhas pa shrī sidha sa slob dpon ye shes mdo la gsungs/ bi mā la mi trar gnang ba rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'byon dus rmog gzhu kha sbub pa 'dra ba'i sgrags kyi yang rdzong gi phug par gter du sbas pa/ lo rgyus las/ kun bzang dgongs pa'i bcud 'dril ba'i rigs 'dzin lhag med — /57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonebasnog pa'i chos: bi mā mi tra thugs kyi gter: yang rdzong dag na yod (108ba)pa yi gter yig ston pa dbang mes kyis bdag la byin te las lo sad ces pa ltar ston pa dbang phyug ye shes kyis kha byang gtad pa la brten nas grub thob me long rdo rjes 'brug lo dgun zla 'bring po'i gnam stong la spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po gnas la btags pa yang rdzong snying tig /gter ston la btags pa me long snying tig /sku gsung thugs kyi rgya la btags pa āḥ/ ma glegs bam gyi tshad la btags pa bi mā la'i gong khug mar grags pa'i dbang lung nos pa la rmi lam rdzun gyi yang zhun steng nas pad 'dabs bzhi pa sgo bzhi'i dbyibs 'ja' ris can gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas skyabs sems/ gsol gdab sngon du song ba'i bla ma zwa lung pas bum pa dang dgon rtse bas me long gis bum dbang / sangs rgyas ras pas gsang dbang / phag mos sher dbang / zhakhrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po dang gu ru jo 'ber gnyis kyis mar me dang shel gyi dbang bzhi pa/ mthar rdo rje sems dpas sku gsum ngo sprod kyi dbang / rin po che dbang gi 'phreng ba'i steng nas ye shes 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor gtor ma mar me la brten nas bgegasaskrod/ gsol gdab/ dam tshig khas blang ba/ byin dbab rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ chos gos/ lhung bzed/ gseg shang gis nyan thos kyi dbang / keng rus thod pas rang rgyal/ gdugs/ dung / po tis byang sems/ khrus bum gyis kri ya/ 'phreng bas yu pa/rdor dril gyis yo ga /rus rgyan/ gri thod/kha ḍi gyis ma hā/ yab yum dang byang sems kyis a nu/ tshig gis ngo sprad pas a ti/ man shel/ sgra/mar me/ sku gzugs/ me long dang bcas pa'i ngo sprod legs par (109na shos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ 'gor bdag 'dra bi mā mi tra mkhas pa ste zhes yod pa'i gter yig kha byang lo rgyus sngags srung rgyal mo nyid la gto pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ ā hūṃ/ bdag 'dra me long rdo rje nga zhes yod pa'i gter brtan tshul shāka thub bstan pa'i sangs rgyas lags kyi mtha' can/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa sa manta sa rang byung du gsung tshul dang bcas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ drin can gyi bla ma dang bi mā la/ gnyis med du bsgom pa bla ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi —158

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnamatha' can/ smin byed dbang gi rim pa'i rtsa ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ tshogs dang gtor ma'i rim pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rdo rje sems dpa' la brten pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgrub thabs mjug tu e ma bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi zhes sogs/ tshems/ shangs khrag /gsang chab las ring bsrel byung tshul sogs mjal shog gi mtha' can/ theg pa rin po che thams cad kyi 'khrid phreng a ti kun gyi yang tig ni/ las can zhig dang phrad par shog gi mtha' can/ rin po che dbang gi 'phreng ba phyi rabs snying la brda thim dza sa ma ya dzaḥ.au āḥlha dzaḥ'i mtha' can/ 'gor spros med shin tu rab tu spros med ces yod pa'i dbang gong ma bde mchog 'di la yol rang mo byung ka tu grags pa tsitta brda thim gyi mtha' can/ bya lo dbyar zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga la me long rdo rjer mnal lam du byung ba'i rdzogs rsā dbang rdzogs rmi lam rdzun gyi yang zhun mdor bsdus gsang chen dkon pa zhes bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can sangs rgyas kyi (109ba 'das rjes dang po dga' rab rdo rjes rtogs pa'i gdeng rnyed do'i mtha' can/'das rjes gnyis pa rab tu gsang ngo'i mtha' can/ 'das rjes gsum pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig pu rdzogs byang dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chen mor grags pa'i nang gses la sku gsum gyi byon tshul zhal chems rnam pa gsum/ dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal chems tshig gsum gnad rdeg 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi zhal chems dgongs nyams drug pa/ shrī sidha'i zhal chems gzer bu bdun pa/ dzña na su tra'i zhal chems bzhag thabs bzhi pa/ bi mā la mi tra'i zhal chems ri bo rtse lngar bzhud cing bzhugs so'i mtha' can/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i zhal chems 'das grongs mi mnga' bar bzhugs so'i mtha' can/ ldang ma lhun rgyal gyi zhal chems gdams shing bkod de'i mtha' can/ seng ge dbang phyug gi zhal chems gsang ba'i gnas gsum bya bar bzhugs nas 'dug skabs kyi mtha' can/rgyal ba zhang ston gyi zhal chems bkod pa'i mtha' can mjug tu grongs lugs dang bcas pa shad nyi ma 'bum gyi zhal chems dbyings su yal lo'i mtha' can/ gu ru jo 'ber gyi zhal chems mya ngan las 'dasaso'i mtha' can/ seng ge rgyab pa'i zhal chems lu gu rgyud du yal lo'i mtha' can/ me long rdo rje'i zhal — 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gechems yang rdzong du bkod pa'i mtha' can/ 'gor e ma skal ldan snying po'i don la yid ches pa zhes yod pa'i snying tig yid ches skyed pa las can zhig dang 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las khyad par phyung ba gsal byed shel gyi nyi 'od ces bya ba rdzogs (110na)byang gi mtha' can rgyud thams cad bsdoms kyi bstan pa'i le'u ra ba'i le'u hol 'don brgyad pa zhig yod/ 'gor oṃ āX hūṃ zhes pa ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i snying po oṃ zhes yod ba'i ti ka gsal byed kyi sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rin po che gser zhun 'dra ba'i brtag yig gsang ba skal ldan yid ches par bstan pa 'o'i mtha' can/ rin po che gser zhun 'dra ba'i tshad kyi yi ge dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ āḥlha dus gsum bla ma rigs 'dzin sku zhes yod pa'i snying tig gi ngo sprod stong gsum yungs 'bru rang dang 'dra ba byung na byin gyi mtha' can/ 'gor rang gsal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes yod pa'i sangs rgyas rang chas kyi ngo sprod de bas snying gi dkyil du cho mes kyi mtha' can/ theg pa'i bshag ral bco brgyad bzhugs kyi mtha' can/ ngo sprod bzhi ston pa zhes btab pas thebs pa yin no'i mtha' can/ 'gor oṃ u/ nyan thos kyi ston pa shākya thub pa zhes yod pa'i theg pa rim dgu'i rgyab chos ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pas 'bras bu 'phags so'i mtha' can/ snying tig gi bka' srung ngan sngags bsam le ma zhes pa/ ltas ga/ mdze/ long ba/ zha ba/ khrag 'dzag pa/ mnan pa/gsad pa/ mdze phol/ sde chod/ skya chod/ spyo ba/ gshed bsgyur/ rang bsrung dang bcas pa/ zhi khro'i 'phrin las nub gcig mar grags pa zhi khro don gyi 'phrin las me long rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni chos sku kun bzang / longs sku zhi khro/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen (110bsgo khas pa shrī sidha/ slob dpon dzña na su tra/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston/ mkhas pa nyi ma 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ gter ston zla ba mun sel/ me long rdo rje yang zer/ mtshungs —160

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)med nam mkha' rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin ku mā rā dza/ klong chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bde legs rgya mtsho/ rje ma ti me ga /slob dpon yon tan dpal/ sprul sku bsam grub rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha' gzhon nu/ bka' brgyad pa mkha' klong yangs pa/ rje blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rang grol bsod nams rin cen/lha phro ba ga rma gu sa mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ de sras bstan 'dzin chos dbang / drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor gyi bande la bka' drin stsal to/ /nye brgyud ni/ bi mā la nas/gter ston me long rdo rje'o/ /lho brag mkhar chu'i khyab 'jug gi skor me long rdo rjer bka' babs shing kun mkhyen pa'i khyab 'jug skor kyang de'i gdams pa'i zab gnad snying por bsdus pa yin pas 'di pa'i gter gyi cha lag tu 'brel bas/ de yang grub thob me long rdo rje de nyid la khyab 'jug gis srog snying mdong gsol du phul ba'i gdams pa rnams lho brag mkho mthing gi brag lcang lo thur du brgyugs 'drar gter du sbas pa mkhar chu'i bla ma phyag rdor gyis bton pa'i drag sngags thog dang 'dra bas snang srid sil bur gtong ba'i skor la nang gses kyi bla rdo/ bsrung ba/ sgom kyi thabs lus kyi (111na)gnas tshulu/ sgrub pa'i gnas/ gtor ma/ liṅga / mnan pa/ zhal gdams/ tho byang / zhal gdams snying gi lto tshil 'dra ba/ dug 'byin/sngagasang byang / liṅga bri ba'i dus/ dug bsrung / zhud kha sel ba/ bsrung ba bstan pa/ lo rgyus bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan chen po/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ mkhar chu'i bla ma phyag rdor/ ston pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dbon chos dpal bzang po/ bla ma brag mkhar pa nas rim par rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /— /61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gter ston dung mtsho ras pas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa'i skor/ga 'a ston dung mtsho ras pas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/chosasku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku tshe dpag med mgon/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/gter ston dung mtsho ras pa/bla ོ nyi ma rang grol/rigs 'dzin su rla tsand+ra/mtshungs med sangs rgyas 'od zer/dran mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/bye tshang pa mtshungs med rin cen dpal 'byor/rgyal sras sangs rgyas bde chen/'khrul zhig padma sangs rgyas/nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam 'phrul rigs 'dzin nyi zla sangs rgyas/rdo rje 'cha pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin du stsal to//sgom pa g.yu sgom rdo rje'i ga kho chos ni ma thob/gsol 'debs las/bdud 'joms skye sprul rgod kyi ldem phru can/ba mkhal smug po 'jam dbyangs bla ma dang /dbyil ston ye shes khyung grags sangs rgyas 'bar/g.yu ston mgon po rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs/zhes pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po ni/snyan brgyud 1bajug gi tho byang las can lung bstan las/lnga brgya snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus g.yas su stod yul zang zang mthar ri rgyal rin 'a spungs 'dra yod de yi shar mgul nang 'dabs su pha ni brtul zhugs bzang spyod rigs ma ni mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ma rdo rje gzhen nu yab yum gyi ting 'dzin ngang du sbyor ba las las dang thugs rje'i smon lam 'dzom rigs ldan gsang sngags zab mo'i chos:skye ba gsum du bsgrubs pa'i mthar rdo rje phag mo'i thugs kyi sras khro gtum rig pa'i ye shes rgyas padma 'byung gnas gsung gi sras nga yi gsung la the tshom med:rdo rje bdud 'joms sku yi sras khro bo'i cha byad gzi brjid che grub thob rgyal po lung bstan can gnas der skye ba'i tshul bstan nas lus kyi spyod pa ma nges te ngag tu / rtag chos 'chad 'gyur yid la yang dag snying po

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabasgrub nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa'i tsha ya mtshan rtags dang dngos grub mthong : byang phyogs gnyan yul zang zang nas gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgo rnyed 'gyur chos sgo lnga brgya phrag gcig 'don zhes dang / sprulasku o rgyan gling pa'i lung bstan las/ sku sprul nyi ma 'od zer yin gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug yin:thugs sprul rgod kyi ldem phru yin yon tan o rgyan gling pa yin: 'phrin las tshe brtan rgyal mtshan yin:'di lnga padma 'byung gnas dngos zhes zhang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can zhes pa ri rgyal bkra bzang gi shar 'dabs su sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du byon te zab gter spyan drangs pa ni/ mdzod gsum (112na)gyi lung bstan las/ byang ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i rtse la rdo rje'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas gtad pa'i gter gyi lde mig yod des bton pa'i gter thams cad bod la bstan pa yun bsring ba'i gter yin te 'gro don du spyad par bya'o:zhes ri bo bkra bzang nas gter gyi lde mig dang gter phran 'ga' zhig bzhes shing gter chen ni lung bstan kun gsal sgron ma las/ lha sras gdung brgyud gung thang 'dzin pa'i dus ri bo bkra bzang zhesabya'i shar 'dabs su sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rgod kyi ldem phru can brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa yis lha sras gdung brgyud skyob pa'i chos skal rnams zang zang lha brag brag la sbas pa len zhes pa ltar byang phyogs gnyan ri zang zang lha brag nas bod kyi blon po lta bu'i gter dpal o rgyan chen pos pod khams sems can gyi sdug bsngal skyob pa'i phyir du sku gsung thugs kyi tshab tu mdzod lnga bzhag pa byang gter zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa spyan drangs pa yin la/ dgos don gtso bo yang bskul byang chen mo las zang zang lha brag gi sked pa na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun bsring ba'i gter yod de/ de dusal babs pa'i tshe thon na bod la mi lo brgya dang rtsa gcig bde skyid 'byung : phyir nur na mi lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga bde skyid 'byung : zhes snyigs ma lnga chos cher bdo ba'i dus kha ba can pa'i 'gro rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las skyob pa'i dpung gnyen yin zhing / gter chos ni zhal chems bdun pa las gter chosazab mo'i man ngag rtsab bzhi shar na dung mdzod dkar po 'bras bu'i chos: tshe 'dir sangs rgyas lag — /63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebacangs gtad thabs(112ba〉thod rtsa ba rgyud gcig man ngag rnam pa bcu: de la phran bu'i man ngag bcu bcu yod so sor phye bsam na ngag brgya rtsa gcig: lho na gser mdzod ser po bsnyen sgrub chos:lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i sgrub thabs yod yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs rtsa ba bcu: de rnams re re la yang man ngag bcu: so sor phye bsam na ngag brgya rtsa gcig nub na zangs mdzod dmar po rten 'brel yod zab lam thabs kyi dngos grub gnad tig yod: rtsa ba gcig la man ngag brgya rtsa gcig byang na lcags mdzod nag po ngan sngags kyi reg gcod sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig yod ma bu lnga lngar phye bas brgya rtsa gcig dbus na shog dril rgya can gsum yod pas las can snod brtag dam med spang ba dang : gdong dmar lho bod mtshams kyi gdul bya'i gnad skyes bu khyod la dgos pa'i chos drug yod dug sprul lto ba gshags pa thun mong gi sgrub thabs zab mo gnyis dang zhal chems gcig dbus na rtsis rgyar ma bzhag gab pa yi gang zag gcig la dgos pa'i chos tshang ba zab la gnad 'dus shin tu gces pa yod yes gsungs pa'i chos tshan lnga brgya phrag gcig bzhugs pa'i la la ni shog ser las ma phab pa dang / la la yang gter du sbas pa sogs kyis tshang ma'i rgyun mi 'dug cing / grags che ba phal cher bzhugs pa rnams kyang yul dus kyi dbang gis dpe ma 'byor ba sogs nas rigs 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig dang bstun na 'ga' zhig ma rnyed mod/ phal cher rdo rje 'chang dang zhal gnyis pa drin can bla ma mchog gi bka' drin las thob pa'i tshul ni/ mdzod lnga so so'i (113na)rjes su ma 'brangs par rdzogs chen gyis thog drangs theg pa'i 'jug sgo dang mtho dma' 'phrin las zhi drag sogs kyi dbang du byas te bkod pa la slob dpon padma'i snyan brgyud gnyis kyi dang po spros pa'i mtha' dpyod pa'i snyan brgyud dam mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin gyi snyan brgyud du grags pa ni rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud las/ de don thab kyis dril ba na shes pa rang byung gnyug mar gnas chos nyid don gyi gnasalugs yin ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes bya de nyid 'khrul bsam dag pa ma 'khrul pa yis rig pa'o rtogasapas yang dag sangs rgyas byung ma rtogs pa yis sems can byung zhes pa'i don gyi snying po sprul sku rigs — 164—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)'dzin chen pos shar dung mdzod dkar po nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar zhes kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po mngon sum rang ngo sprod de rtogs grol dus gcig tu 'byung ba'i zab chos theg pa kun gyi yang rtse'i skor thob pa la/ thog mar rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar gyi dbang chog snying po bsdus pa rig pa'i dbang gi steng nas 'od lnga'i 'khor lo mthar 'ja' rim dgu pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor sman gtor ra ta bum pa la brten nas rigs drug /rtag chad/ nyan rang / dbu sems/kṛ yog sde gsum/ ma hā a nu'i bar gyi lta sgom spyod pa las rnam par grol ba kun rig sems kyi rgyal po'i dbang gis smin par byas nas/ rang byung rang shar gyi snying po'i bcud bsdus pa'i gnad khrigs rim gyi gzhung la brten rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun nyams pa med pas brgyan te ka dag blo 'das kyi dgongs pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye (113ba〉zhes rang byung rang shar gyi gnas lugs rig pa cer mthong du ngo sprod pa'i nyams 'khrid smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ sngon 'gro rin po che gnad kyi gzer lnga la go rim mi mthun pa 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang lam dman log pas ldog pa skyabs sems kyi gzer/ tshogs gsog pa maṇḍal gyi gzer/ sgrib sbyong bshags pa'i gzer/bskul 'debs mi rtag pa'i gzer/ byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gzer/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon du mtsho rgyal gyis bstod pa'i gu ru kye kye ma/ chos rgyal gyis zhus pa'i las rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba mun sel sgron me le'u lnga pa lha sras mu khri btsan pos dkar chag tu btab pa/ rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum rdzogs byang gtad rabs kyi mtha' can/ sangs rgyasardo rje sems dpa'i kun grol yangs pa'i rgyud le'u dgu pa gtad rabs sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba rang byung rang shar gyi 'khrid yig snying po bcud bsdus lam gyi gnad 'khrid kyi rim pa rdo rje sems dpa' nas brgyud tshul dag las can dang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis zhug pa'i bar do lnga'i snyan brgyud sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse dang ba po bzang pa sogs kyi gsan yig na mi snang yang rgyal sras padma chos rgyal gyi gsan yig 'dug go/rdzogs pa chen — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepo rig pa rang shar rang grol dbang gi phyag len snying po bsdus pa rig pa'i dbang bstan ma bcu gnyis la gnyer gto kyi mtha' can/ rang byung rang shar rgyud las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro'i nyams myong rin cen gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes pa 'tsho rgyal gyi zhus lan dmar 'khrid nyams len (114na)brgyad par grags pa 'di la thog mar gleng gzhi nas 'go brtsams te le'u bdun pa yan gyi nyams rtags dang po dang / le'u brgyad par nyams rtags lhag ma bdun po tshang zhing ka dag gi nyams len phul du phyin pa ches zab pa yod/ 'di dang cha 'dra zhig gter kha 'og ma'i jo mo'i nyams len skor dgu'i nang na'ang 'dug /'di'i le'u gnyis par zab mo gnad kyi thems bcu bstan zer ba 'dug kyang gsan yig rnying pa tshor gnad thems bcu logs su 'dug pa dang mi gcig pa 'dra zhing / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig 'khrid gzhung la gnad thems bcur gsungs 'dug pas dpyad dgos so/ /o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi zhal chems rin cen gzer bu zhes pa blta ba/ rigs 'dzin rsā po dang sam dbyangs ma bu'i gas yig tu ma rig yi sel tho me zhes pa yo 2ga /chos spyod/ mi rtag pa/ 'chi dus kyi nyams len/ yang dag pa'i chos bya tshul/ dge sdig sems bskyed/ sdom pa/ khengs grags 'du 'dzi spong tshul sogs bsdusate bstan pa smug nag khro bo'i gzugs can zhig 'byung ba'i don du sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas bsam yas mchims phur bzhugs pa'i tshe jo mo nyin 'jig rten gyi snang ba bag tsam dang mtshan rmi lam gyi 'khrul ba sel ba'i don du gsungs pa zhu lan gnad kyi yi ge /ngo sprod rang rig rang gsal zhes kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa zangs thal du bstan pa'i man ngag skor gsum du gsungs pa bstan ma bcu gnyis gnyer bskos kyi mtha' can/ slob dpon chen pos shrī sidha la zhus pa'i ngo sprod gnad tig zhal gdams zab (114ba)mo las can dang phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ jo mo mkhar chen bzas zhus pa'i mtsho rgyal lam gyi gegs sel nor bu'i bang mdzod las can la gtod pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la bka' bsgos pa'i mtha' can/ gter bdag mchod pa'i las rim e ka dza ṭi'i gsol ka bskal pa me 'bar ma bstan srung gi khrod du bris kyang wo mod 'dir ni gnad yig mthug — 166

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagi thems nang khrug pa ltar bris so//de yang sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/legs ldan rje yab sras/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/bkra bzang pa sogs kyi gsan yig khungs btsun tshor chos sde'i bzhugs tshul mi mthun pa shas che zhing /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig dang zhu lan gnad yig mjug gi thems gnyis mthun la/'dir ni bkra bzang pa'i gsan yig ltar bris pa yin no//da dung the tshom gyi gzhi cung zad 'dug pa phyogs 'dir tshad mar gyur ba rnyed na dpyad par bya'o//las rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba mun sel sgron me ma gtogos pa'i dbang 'khrid lung gsum yongs rdzogasalegs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/rigs 'dzin shrī sidha/o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru/rigs 'dzin nam mkha' grags pa/dpang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan/se ston mgon po bzang po/se'i sngags 'chang rin cen rgyal mtshan/spyan tshab chos rje mgon po zla ba/nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/15na ) rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra/rdzogs mu rnal wor kun bzang rnam sto/zur rdo rje lang chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za sto bande la'o//las rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba mun sel sgron me'i brgyud pa ni/gter ston yan gong ltar la/de nas sras rnam rgyal mgon po/sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/chos rje sangasargyas dpal bzang /rig 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/gter ston shākya bzang po/rig 'dzin legasaldan rdo rje/chos rgyal ba po shis stobs/rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/yol mo sprul sku 'dzin nor bu/rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//byang chub sems spyod dbang gi skor 'di rig 'dzin chen po dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal sogaX kyi gsan yig khungs btsun mang por logs su

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shemadzad pa'ang 'dug cing / nub dgon phyogs kyi rgyun la'ang zangs thal dang sbrel ba'i bar bkab mi 'dug na'ang / bla chen bkra bzang pa'i gsan yig na thog mar theg pa rim dgu'i dbang zhes ngos bzung 'dug pa/ spyod pa legs pa'i skabs su phyi'i spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma spyod dbang skor dang / nang gi spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma rnam gsum du bshad pas 'brel mtshungs pa nas phal cher bse sgrom smug po nas spyan drangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod dbang gi skor la/ rnam snang lha so gsum gyi rasabris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i dbang lnga sngon du 'gro ba can gyi nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/kṛ ya u pa me dzig /ma hā a nu a ti (115ba〉ste theg pa rim dgu'i dbang ngam byang chub sems dpa'i spyod dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ rnam par snang mdzad rgyud kyi sgrub thabs le'u bcu pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje gdan gyi rtse mo sde byang ma'i srog shing la sbas pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis btan nas o rgyan chen por gnang ba brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'drar sbas byang dang gnyen chen thang lhar bcol dam gyi mthar tshang ba/ rnam par snang mdzad sku'i rang chas dgongs pa ru bstan pa le'u bkod pa rnam gsum zhes pa'i mthong grol gsang sngags thugs kyi man ngag bdun pa/lha mo phyag rgya chen po rnam par gzigs ma'i rgyud tshe dang ldan pa dga' bos rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su sbas pa klu sgrub kyis brtan nas o rgyan chen por gnang ba bod du gdan drangs nas gter du sbas te rdo rje legs par gnyer du gtad pa/ bde gshegs mchod pa'i cho ga /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod dbang gi dbang chog shākya'i bstan pa mtha' rgyas phyir gter du sbas nas thang lhar gtad tshul/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma zhes pa smon lam yid bzhin nor bu/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i gtor bsngos/dus ngan snyigs ma mthar thug gi tshe sdig sgrib sbyong thabs dus chen dgu'i gso sbyong / dus khrims kyi lag len sprul sku shākya bzang pos mdzad pa/ dus chen dgu'i phan yon/ mnga' bdag gis slob dpon chen por zhus pa'i gtan khrims dus khrims kyi khyad par dang len tshul/ phyi nang gsang ba'i spyod pas bdag gzhan dge ba'i lam la gzud pa gtan khrims bsrung bya phan yon nyes dmigs bcas pa zangs —168—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamadzod dmar por rgyas btab ste (116na)gnyan chen thang lhar gnyer du gtad pa/ dus khrims kyi phyag len bzhin dus dgu'i gso sbyong yang legs par blangs pa rnams las dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ rigs 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin/kun dga' bo/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ gu ru shākya sidha/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston dngosagrub rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ mtshungs med rdo rje dpal/ bla ma rdo rje mgon po/mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ cho se rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /rigs 'dzin kun dga' don grub/ sngags 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/ gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen/ gcung legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigasa'adzin ngag gi dbang po/ sprul pa'i gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ dran mchog sangs rgyas dbon chen/ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ sngags 'chang shākya bsod nams/ kun dga' don grub man gong ltar ro/ /yang na bcom ldan shākya thub pa/ 'khor rnam bzhi slob dpon klu sgrub man 'dra/ dus dgu'i gso sbyong dus gcig la blangs pa'i brgyud pa ni rtsa ba'i bla mas rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po dngos la gsan no/ /rigs 'dzin chen pos dbus snying mdzod smug po nas spyan drangs pa'i kun bzang dgongs pa zangs (116ba)thal zhes theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse tshe 'dir chos nyid zad sar 'byol nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mngon du byed nus pa'i zab chos rgya bod rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal gyi drod rlangs nyams pa med pa'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las la brten nas rig pa'i dbang lnga/ kun tu bzang po rig pa rtsal gyi dbang / bum dbang / brda dbang / don dbang / dam tshig gi dbang ste spros bcas bum pa'i dbang / byang sems la brten nas spros med gsang ba'i dbang / shes rab ma la brten nas shin tu —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shespros med kyi dbang / sis ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas chos skur ngo sprod pa rab tu spros med kyi dbang / slob dpon chen po bi mā las mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa chen po dbang gi cho ga'i steng nas sta gon dang phung po rgyas gdab sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thun mong gi dbang bskur bcu gcig /zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas snying po thugs kyi dbang zhes pa rang byung btags pas grol ba rig pa ye shes lngar 'gyur ba rig pa rang grol gyi dbang ngam btags grol gyi dbang rgyas par grags pa/ rdzogs pa chen po nges don lta ba'i dbang rdzas thabs sbyi byug gi da yang zer/zhes pa don bstoganyis kyi sgo nas bskur ba/ rig pa rang gsal gyi dbang zhes pa lta sgom spyod 'bras bstod pa dam tshig ste don rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas bskur ba/ ye shes spyi blugs kyi dbang zhes pa bar dor rang sar grol ba'i dbang 'od lnga thig le'i dkyil 'khor bum pa man shel ka pā la 'dra 'bag la brten pa slob dpon padma'i rig pa'i rtsal dbang / de'i mtha' rten mngon sum ye shes kyi rang mdangs zhal phye na (117na)ston pa'i yon tan ye shes kyi rtsal dbang / skal dman thugs rjes bzung ba bstan pa bu gcig nas gsungs pa'i btags grol gyi dbang rnams thob/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mthar kun gzhi gtan la phab pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dngos gzhi sgra 'od zer gsum/ brkyang 'gyel/ sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs/ 'greng tshugs rnams la brten nas rim bzhin sku gsum/ dbyings rig /snang bzhi'i ngo sprod/ khyad par bka' gter gyi rdzogs chen gzhan la grags pa rnams las khyad du thon pa'i chos nyid zad pa'i myur lam rdos bcas phung po tshe 'dir mi snang bar 'ja' lus sgrub byed thod rgal gyi rang rtsal rjen par ston pa lhun grub dgongs pa zangs thal gyi nyams 'khrid smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ de yang snyan brgyud drug gi tho byang las/ dbus kyi shog dril rnam gsum dang zab mo sum cu rtsa drug chos: rang min gzhan la bstan mi bya: zhes dang / 'gro ba gzhan don dgongs pa'i phyir snyan brgyud rtsa ba'i chos rnams bstan sum cu rtsa drug 'di lta ste rdo rje phag mo'i zab rgya drug:padma 'byung gnas snyan brgyud drug rdo rje sems dpa'i slong chen drug rtsa ba'i chos sde bco brgyad yin — 170

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)yan lag thun mong bco brgyad ni spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma drug snyigs ma dngas pa'i man ngag drug dus la dgos pa'i sgrub thabs drug ces gsungs pas zab rgya/ snyan brgyud/ slong gsum por drug tshan du phye bar rtsa ba'i man ngag bco brgyad dang / spyod pa/ snyigs ma sgrub thabs gsum la drug tshan du byas par yan lag thun mong bco brgyad/ de gnyis bsdoms (117ba)pas sum cu rtsa drug gi steng du tshar gcod drag po gnam lcags kyi khang bu lnga bsnan pas snyan brgyud man ngag bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tu grags shing go rim gyi dbang du byas na thog mar thun mong ba bco brgyad dang de nas rtsa ba'i chos bco brgyad dgos la gong 'og 'khrugs shing rtsa ba'i chos sde la yang gdul bya blo rab 'bring mtha' ma gsum gyi dbang du byas nas zab rgya thog mar byung na'ang 'dir bsgrigs rim rigs 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyi zab chos spel ba'i go rim dang gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig sogs dang bstun nas snyan brgyud tho byang gi go rim 'di shas cher lugs ldog tu 'god pas/ de yang 'gro ba'i don byed pa la snyigs ma'i dus na sems can rtog pa shig cing shin tu mgu dka' bas sgo gsum tha mal du shor na rang gzhan la bar gcod 'byung bas de'i gnyen por spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma drug /chos byed par grib drug bsrung dgos pas de'i gnyen por snyigs ma dngas pa'i man ngag drug /nyams su len pa'i gang zag la bar gcod drug 'ong bas de'i gnyen por sgrub thabs drug dgos par gsungs pa rnams sngon 'gro'i rgyab chos dang / dbang po rab la rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi slong drug de'i char gtogs dang bcas pa/yang kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ rigs gsum mgon po rnams kyi slong so sor byas par slong chen drug /dbang po 'bring la rdo rje slob dpon gyi snyan brgyud drug ces pa 'grel tig chen mo'i don ltar slob dpon padma la snyan brgyud gnyis/ mkhas pa bi mā lar gnyis/ lo chen bai ro tsa nar gnyis te snyan brgyud drug tu bshad pa dang / yang snyan brgyud drug gi tho byang nas slob dpon padma rang la snyan (118na)brgyud drug byung bar gsungs/ dbang po mtha' ma la rtsa rlung gi gdams pa rdo rje phag mo'i zab rgya'i skor brgya drug tu bstan zhing / chos tshan zhe gcig 'dren pa'i skabs drag po — 171 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shetshar gcod gnam lcags kyi khang bu lnga logs su byung yang brgya lnga pa'i nang du 'du bas don gyi chos tshan sum cu rtsa drug gis tshang ngo de yang yig sna rnams kyi go rim rtogs sla phyir 'khrugs bsdebs su brjod na/ sngon 'gro'i rgyab chos dang dngos ga sto rgyab chos gnyis/ dang po la/ gto ston rang gis mdzad pa'i ga kho wo bsto pa'i lo rgyus sna mo lung (tshu)gi sgrub khang du sbyar ba/ khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i bkra bzang gter byung lta'i)dngos grub sgo 'byed dgos pa kun 'byung gi rgya can/ se'i sngags 'chang bkra bzang pa padma dbang chen gyis mdzad pa'i byang gter chos skor /bee na rnams kyi spyi chings/sprul pa'i gter ston rgod kyi ldem phrus mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs brda 'bange/chen bco brgyad ma/rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal lhun grub kyi gsol 'debs rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ma rnams/ de rjes gong du bshad pa'i sngon 'gro yan lag gi chos sde bco brgyad las phyi lus kyi spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod dbang gi skor song zin/ nang lus kyi spyod pa ston pa'i sgron ma ston pa dung mdzod kyi chos sde nas byon pa'i gter ston rgod ldem la gdams pa sgron ma rnam gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan brag ri dmar nag srin po las la chas pa lta bu'i rtsa bar gdug pa'i sems can du 'khrungs pa gnas sbar ba sogs skye brgyud phyi lus kyi sgron ma/ sku'i (118bsgo tshan rtags skyon yon nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi bya ba sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang / de la dam log 'byung tshul zhag gcig la bcu drug dbye ba'i nyams len sogs ston pa nang spyod pa'i sgron ma/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rtags rgya 'chang lugs/ bdud 'dul ba sogs ston pa gsang ba rig pa'i sgron ma rnams lusang ga yid gsum gyi spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma drug /dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i man ngag drug /dus la dgos pa'i sgrub thabs drug ste yan lag gi chos tshan bco brgyad cha mnyam du ston pa snyan brgyud zab mo sde drug gi sngon 'gro/ 'di la nang gses kyi bdud rtsi chu'i bca len/ sa rdo shing sogs kyi dngas ma la brten pa'i sman gyi bcud len/ rlung dang rig pa la brten nas tshe bsgrub pa'i bcud len/ sdig sgrib/ gnas grib/—172

dam pa'i chos rkya gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnagos grib/grogs grib/spong thabs rnams kyi dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i man ngag drug bstan/na bza' sku rags/stod g.yogs/rtags rgya/ber chen/mnyen zhu/phyag mtshan sogs phyi ltar mdzes pa'i lus kyi spyod lam gyi rgyan bdun dang /nyin 'gro 'chag sogs kyi rgya las mi g.yo bas nang ltar mdzad pa'i rgyan bdun bstan/gzhan gyi stod smad sogs la lan brjod tshul lngas legs pa'i tshig dang /nang sgra mnyen por sbyor ba'i ngag gi skyon bcos te spyod pa legs pa/'gro ba rnams kyi las snang tshig la brten pa'i chos brgyad kyi rtog pa mtha' dag rbad kyis gcod pa'i mnyam gzhag gis yid kyi spyod pa legs pa'i sgron ma drug mdo tsam dang /jag 'ching /bdud gzhom/tshe sgrub sogs kyi don bsdus dus la dgos pa'i sgrub thabs drug rnams bstan/rtsa ba'i chos bco brgyad dang 9na〉na lag gi chos bco brgyad po thams cad kyi thems ston pa snyan brgyud drug gi khog 'bubs o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' chems/sngon 'gro dang khog 'bubs gnyis padma'i snyan brgyud gnyis par gtogs kyang chos kyi bzhugs tshul gyis 'dir bkod pa yin/dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i chos drug gi nang tshan zas kyi snyigasam sbyang ba zur bkol bcud len skor la sto gos lhun grub gtum mo'i bcud len/zhi byed dkar mo'i sbyor ba cung zhi'i bcud len/rgyas byed ser mo'i sbyor ba sa'i bas len/dbang sdud dmar mo'i sbyor ba mtshan gyi bcud len/bdud 'joms ljang mo' sbyor ba bye ma'i bcud len/stobs ldan ma'i sbyor ba dbang lag gi bcud len dpal 'phreng ser mo'i sbyor ba 'om bu'i bcud len/rngam pa mo'i sbyor ba bdud rtsi chen po'i bcud len/nyi ma spyan gcig sbyor ba lug mig ma'i bcud len/seng gdong dkar mo'i sbyor ba chu'i bas len/stag gdong ser mo'i sbyor ba rda'i bas len/khyung gdong dmar mo'i sbyor ba glang sna'i bcud len/phag gdong sngon mo'i sbyor ba spang rgyan bcud len/phyi nas 'tshol mi dgos pa lce chung bcud len rnams ston pa bcud len rin cen 'phreng ba/de yang gong du bstan pa thun mong gi chos bco brgyad ni/snyan brgyud drug gi khog 'bugs las/snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i don la dgongs pa brda'i skyes bu de la grib drug phog pas spyod pa ma dag pa drug gi skyon 'byung de spyod pa la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsāsnyigs ma dngas pa'i man ngag drug dgos dus mtha' ma'i skyon gyis phyi nang gi bar gcod drug 'byung :de bzlog pa'i man ngag drug dgos so bdag gzhan thun mong la dgos pa'i phyir (119ba〉〉da pa legs pa'i sgron ma drug dgos so zhes gsungs pa'i thun mong gi man ngag bco brgyad po 'di gtso bor sprul pa'i gter ston nyid kyi thugs nyams su blang byar bstan zhing / de yang zhib tu bshad na dkor skyon bsrung ba bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung / grib skyon bsrung ba sman gyi bas len/ nyams skyon bsrung ba rdo rje'i go khrab/ grib gnas spang ba phyag rgya'i rgyan gsum/ grib gos spang ba bsrung ba'i rtags gnyis/dam nyams spang ba gtsang ma'i grogs btsal ba dang drug /jag chom/ bdud ldang 'byung zhabrugs/ dbul phongs/ tshe tshad thung ba/ grogs kyis bslu ba drug gi gnyen por/ jag 'byung / du ba rlung shon/ nad bdag stobs 'joms dang sman dpyad skor/ dzam la/ mnga' dbang / tshe dpag longs sku'i skor/ glang chen bcas chog rnams la kha 'phangs pa dang lus ngag yid gsum la spyod pa mdzes pa gnyis gnyis bshad pa rnams sgron ma rnam gsum/ zhal gdams bdun pa/ sems rig dbye ba'i rgyud rnams la blta bar gsungs pa'i chos tshan rnams ni mdzod lnga gang la gang babs kyi skabs su 'byung ba yin pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i gnas dam pa'o/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags nang gi spyod pa ston pa dam tshig dbye ba'i cho ga zhes pa rdo rje slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ bla ma mched lcam la dam tshig nyams tshul dang gso thabs/ dus kyi mtha' ma 'dod chags zhe sdang dbang gis log par spyod tshul dam ldan gyi slob mas dam tshig khas blangs pa dang mna' chu blud pa sogs bstan pa gser mdzod ser po sbas byang gi mtha' tshang ba/ rdzogs pa 0 po'i stong thun spyi chings zhes pa o rgyan rsā pos mnga' bdag dang jo mor (120na)gnang ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ ston pa gsang sngags bstan pa rnam gsum gyi chos 'byung zhes pa zhus pa'i lan du gsungs pa snyan brgyud ratna'i 'phyong / rtsod med kyi theg pa ston pa zab mo chos kyi lung byang zhu lan dkar chag yi ger btab pa/ las can gyi slob ma dang dam nyams mkha' 'gro dang bdud mo sogs 'dra min lung ston pa snyan brgyud drug gi thob byang o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' chems —174

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganalas can lung bstan du grags pa/ 'di gsum padma'i snyan brgyud gnyis par gtogs kyang sngon 'gro'i chos su mdzad pas 'dir bkod pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rgyab chos la/ gzhan la mi ston pa rtsa ba'i shog dril/ dbang po rab la rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi slong drug /dbang po 'bring la rdo rje slob dpon gyi snyan brgyud drug /dbang po mtha' ma la rdo rje phag mo'i zab rgya drug /mtha' rten gtad rgya'i skor dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi shog dril rnam gsum la rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba ston pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i ye shes rang rtsal rig pa 'od du 'bar bar bstan pa'i rgyud dam dgongs pa zangs thal gyi rgyud chen le'u nyi shu rgya bzhi'i thems dang bcas pa rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ bstan pa thams cad kyi snying po sems can thams cad kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa zangs thal du bstan pa'i rgyud chung le'u brgyad pa rigs 'dzin rim par brgyud tshul rgya gsum gyi mtha' can/rgyud 'di gnyis dka' ba bcu gsum dang du blang nus pa'i skal ldan ma gtogs rang min gzhan la mi ston par gsungs pa/ gnyis pa dbang po rab la rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi slong drug /rtsa ba'i rgyud/char ga rtags(120ba)kyi rgyud/ khyad par btags grol gyi skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems dang rig pa dbye ba'i rgyud khyad par can le'u drug /yi spu zhan chud skor gyin pas/ 'di phyag na rdo rjes gsungasapa'i slong du gtogs/ rig pa rang gsal ma rig pa'i ye shes rang la gsal ba'i rgyud le'u gsum pa rigs 'dzin rnams kyi thugs dgongs rim par brgyud las 'phro can la phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/dbying snang sbubs zhugs kyi nang phywa/ 'di rdor sems kyis gsungs pa'i slong du gtogs/ rdzogs pa chen po ye shes rang la gnas pa'i rgyud le'u bdun rten med kyi rig pa gzhag thab ngo sprod kyi nang 'a/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i slong du gtogs/ ye shes chen po bstan pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs nas brgyud tshul rgya gsum gyi mtha' can/ rten med kyi rig pa gzhag thabs ngo sprod kyi nang 'a/ 'di spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa'i slong du gtogs/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dgongs pa rang shar gyi rgyud le'u drug pa rigs 'dzin rim par gtad tshul e ka dza ṭi bka' bsgos pa'i mtha' can/— 175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nedabyings snang sbubs bas kyi nang sa/ 'di kun bzang gis gsungs pa'i slong du gtogs/ bar do rang gi snang ba thams cad nges pa bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ bar do rang snangs pa'i nang wo/ 'di rdo rje 'tshang gis gsungs pa'i glong du gtogs/ gnyis pa char gtogos kyi rgyud la/ 'khrul pa sems rgyud dam ma rig pa'i sems phyin ci log tu kha 'byul pa'i rgyud dam 'khrul pa rtsad gcod du grags pa le'u bdun 'khrul pa shan chud kyi nang 'a/ 'di phyag rdor gyis gsungs pa'i glong du ga rta gos/ 'byul pa sems dang rig pa dbye ba'i rgyud dam phyi mar grags pa le'u lnga rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gtad rabs e ka dza ṭi spun drug la (121na po tad rgya'i mtha' can/ lha tshol shan khed kyi nang phywa/ 'di 'jam dpal gyis gsungasapa'i slong du gtogs/ rdzogs pa rsā po rin po che phreng ba'i rgyud le'u drug /7rna ma' su rkan pa'i nang phywa/ 'di kun bzang gis gsungs pa'i slong du gtogs/ ye shes rang la shar pa'i rgyud dam rig pa ma g.yeng par rang la shar pa ye shes lnga ru bstan pa'i rgyud le'u gsum dang shog gi mtha' can/ dbyingasasnang bas sa kyi nang phywa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i glong du gtagos/ gsum pa btags grol skor la/ btags grol gyi nang gses sangs rgyas kyis dga' ldan gyi gnas su gsungs pa'i zhal chemasadang po zhes pa rigs 'dzin khyad par can rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ sangs rgyas kyis dga' ldan du gsungs pa'i zhal chems gnyis pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rang las byung ba'i yi ge gsang ba/ sangs rgyas kyis dga' ldan du gsungs pa'i zhal chems gsum pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rang las byung ba'i yi ger byon pa kun tu bzang po nas rigs 'dzin rnams la brgyud tshul mthar phrad shog smon lam rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pa'i rgyud dam gsang ba'i sgrib pa gcod pa sa bon gyi rgyud/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i rdzogs pa chen po btags grol chen mo'am ma bcos pa'i shes pa skad cig ma zhes pa rgya bzhis bcad pa gces par bzung ba'i man ngag /'di dang 'brel bar btags grol gyi rang gnas dang dbang chog /btags grol yid bzhin nor bu'am btags grol rgyud drug tu grags par nang gses kyi btags grol snying po'i rgyud/ gcig —176

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnashes kun grol gyi rgyud (121ba〉pang tig ser gyi 'bru gcig pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas sras gcig pa'i gcod pa sa bon gyi rgyud/ rang byung rig pa'i rgyud/ 'bras bu ye rdzogs chen po'i rgyud yang gsang le'u dang po rdzogs byang gi mthar tshang ba/ mjug tu dus dmigs phan yon/ 'byung ba gzhan la brten nas 'gro don bya ba/ bcad thabs rnams/ btags grol rgyab yig mkhyen par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ gnad kyi yi ge dkar dmar gnyis/ man ngag gsang ba'i gnad 'grol/ bstan pa bu gcig gi thems yig /rdo rje 'chang gi gnad kyi yi ge gnad 'grol btags grol byon tshul rgyal po rtog pa can blon po zhe brnag nyan thos theg pa dman par gsang ba'i bka' rgya can/ thos grol yig drug pa'i don dang dpe'u ris lha rti sa mā ya mtha' can/ 'di rnams snang bzhi mthar ma phyin par nying mtshams sbyor dgos byung ba rnams la dgongs shing dka' ba bdun spyod nus pa dang 'chi kha'i sems can ma gtogs gzhan la cung zad ston par ma gsungs so/ /gsum pa dbang po 'bring la rdo rje slob dpon gyi snyan brgyud drug la/ slob dpon chen po padma'i snyan brgyud/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra'i snyan brgyud/ lo chen bee ro tsa na'i snyan brgyud dang gsum/ dang po la/ spros pa'i mtha' gcod pa'i snyan brgyud/ chos nyid ngo sprod kyi snyan brgyud gnyis/dang po ni/ rdzogs pa wo po rang byung rang shar gyi skor gong du bstan zin/ gnyis pa chos nyid ngo sprod kyi snyan brgyud la/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i mchod 'bum ma rdzogs pa chen po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i 'phrin las/ rdzogos pa chen po yang gsang bla na med pa'i zhi khro'i 'phrin las rgyud dang mthun par mchod thabs dga' rab rdo (122na)rjes mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams bsod nams kyi tsho gos rgya chen gsog pa tsho gos 'khor rgyas pa/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las dur khrod du rgyu ba'i tshe len pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ dga' rab rdo rjes rdzogs wo 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rgyud nas btus pa'i 'phrin las nar mar gtong ba'i lhag ma'i gtor ma/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis khros nag rgyud las btus pa'i bka' srung gi gsol mchod sangs rgyas rdor 'chang ma/ 'jig rten mchod pa'i rgyud nas slob dpon padmas gas pa'i gter — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )bsrung mchod pa gter mdzod bse sgrom ma/ slob dpon wo pos ri bo mgrin bzang rgyud nas bcogapa'i zhing skyong gzhi bdag mchod pa yul gyi ming ni ma/ spros bcas bum pa'i dbang chog /spros med gsang ba'i dbang chog zhan tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang chog /rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che'i dbang chog /slob dpon ོ po padma'i rig pa rtsal gyi dbang btags grol snying po'i rgyud nas blangs pa rig pa dbang gi sgron me/ rig pa rtsal dbang gi 'grel pa/ rdzogs pa chen po gleng gzhi ston pa skye med ma bcos rang byung rang shar rin po che 'phrin las kyi rgyud le'u drug /rdzogs pa rṣa po ye shes rang snang gi lugs skal ldan gyi slob bu 'khrid thabs dgongs pa zang thal du bstan pa'i 'khrid yig /ka dag lhun grub kyi nyams 'khrid thar gling chos sku'i zhing khams su bgrod pa'i nye lam chen mo zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa chen po bla na med pa man ngag thams cad kyi (122ba yo yid dril te ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gsungs pa/ 'dir ngo sbyod 'kho du bta'i 'i nang phywa/de'i rgyab chos su dgongs pa zang thal gyi ngo bo dang dbyibs bstan pa gnad gyi yi ge chen mo le'u lnga pa/'di gnyis padma'i snyan brgyud gnyis par dngo su ma bshad kyang ngo sprod nyer gcig pa'i rgyas chos kyi dbang du byas te 'dir gis pa yin/bar do ngo sprod kyi man ngag snying gi dgongs pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ nyams len mthar 'don pa'i gnad kyi yi ge gsang ba'i sgron me/ rtags kyi yi ge gsang ba zhes pa le'u gsum/ gsang ba chen po tshad kyi yi ge dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'di gsum gsan yig la lar slob dpon gsum ga'i thun mong gi man ngag tu yang bshad/ yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud kyi nang gses la kun tu bzang po dgongs pa zang thal du bstan pa'i rgyud kyi sgron ma/ 'di dbus kyi shog dril rnam gsum du gtags/ rigs 'dzin shrī si snaga.o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la man ngag snyan brgyud du bshad pa man ngag khyad par 'phags pa'i snyan brgyud gang zag rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi grol tshul bstan pa zab rgya can/ padma bka' yig dang po snying gi dgongs pa'i rgyud le'u drug pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa gter spyan drangs nas lo bco lnga song ba dang nyang stod rkyang po rta dkar zhes par shog ser las phab pa/ yang dag —178

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnadon gyi snyan brgyud rin po che las gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba thugs kyi dgongs pa yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud mthong ba tsam gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i chos/ slob dpon rṣa po rang la snyan rgyud drug tu brtsis pa'i ya rgyal/dur khrod so sa gling du shrī sidha sa o rgyan la gdams pa'i snyan brgyud gnad du dril ba'i man ngag le'u gsum pa nyams len gyi mtha' can/ 'di la (123na)dum bu gsum las le grangs mi 'dug / ye shes mngon sum du bstan pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo yi ge med pa'i skor slob dpon rang la snyan brgyud drug tu brtsis pa'i ya rgyal/rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam yang dag don gyi snyan brgyud rin po che nam shi 'tshang rgya sgyu lus bor chog gi ga dmasang ga lan gcig mthong bas grol ba'i man ngag /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud ma bcos pa'i shes pa skad cig ma zhes pa shog ser las 'bri mtshams su go tshang du bsgyur bas go tshang mar grags pa/ snyan brgyud rin po che lung byang ye shes thugs kyi lde mig ces pa chos rnams ston pa'i snod du rung mi rung maṇḍal gyi khyad par dang grangs sogs gsungs pa/ slob dpon rang la snyan brgyud drug tu su pa'i ya rgyal/ gnyis pa paṇa chen bi mā la'i snyan brgyud la bshad thabs kyi sgo nas go bar bya ba dang nyams len gyi sgo nas grol bar bya ba ste gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa chen po bi mā la mi tras mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan la snyan brgyud du gnang ba da lta nyid du 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i 'grel tig chen mor grags pa/ gnyis pa la/ slob dpon chen po bi mā las mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang thog ma'i dbang chog gam thun mong du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /des mdzad pa'i snying po thugs dbang zhes pa btags grol rgyas pa'i dbang chog /des mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa chen po nges don lta ba'i dbang zhes pa rgyal tshab spyi blugs kyi dbang chog /des mdzad pa'i rig pa rang gsal gyi dbang chog /des mdzad pa'i ye shes spyi blugs kyi dbang chog /phyi mtshan ma la brten pa/ nang ye shes la brten pa/ nyams len snang gsum la brten pa ste 'khrid yig (123ba)gnad kyi gzer bu gsum zhes pa mnga' bdag gis lha sras la bka' gdams par mdzad pa/ khug pa lnga'i man ngag ni rdzogs chen 'od gsal snying tig nas 'chi kha'i ngo sprod la dgongs nas 'dir gter ston gyis bzhes pa ma gtogs lha brag gi gter — /79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shem min/ 'di'i cha lag tu bi mā'i snying tig nas chos tshan kha shas len pa'i phyag srol byung 'dug na'ang kho bos ni de 'dra bsnan pa'i rgyun ma thob/ bar do 'od gsal sgron ma zhes pa phyi rabs kyi don du bi mā las bkod pa gsum pa lo chen bee ro tsa na'i snyan brgyud la sems dang rig pa dbye ba dang gzhag thabs rnam pa lnga'i snyan brgyud gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus gsum gzigs pa'i padma 'byung gnas/ rgya gar mkhasapa bi mā mi tra/ rgya bod sgra bsgyur gyi mchog lo tsā ba bee ro gsum la mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyis zhus pa'i snyan brgyud dang por grags pa/ paṇa chen grub thob lnga brgya'i snyan brgyud du brgyud ba'i man ngag grub thob phyi ma gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig dril bee ro tsa nas dgung lo bco lnga nas lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i bar shrī sidha'i spyan sngar bzhugs nas zhus pa snyan brgyud bar par grags pa/ cho me thams cad kyi mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po 'di la gegs sel gyi man ngag mthar thug gi nyams len bee ro tsa nas shrī sidha la zhus pa snyan brgyud phyi mar grags pa/ gnyis pa ni rgya gar gyi yul brnya'i pho brang dgu rim na shrī sidha bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bee ros zhug pa'i snyan brgyud las tshes lhag pa thugs rgyud du dril ba bee ro'i gong khug mar grags pa rnams/ bzhi pa dbang po mtha' ma la rdo rje phag mo'i zab rgya drug ni/ dgyes pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud las/rdo rje lta bu lus kyi rgya rgya mtsho lta bu rlung gi rgya nam (124na)mkha' lta bu lta ba'i 7nyi zla lta bu sgom pa'i tso gnam lcags lta bu spyod pa'i sa nor bu lta bu man ngag tso zhes gsungasapa'i zab rgya rnying pa'i skor la/ rdo rje phag mo dgyes pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud le'u bcu smon lam phrad shog gi mtha' can/ de yang le'u bzhi pas rdo rje lta bu lus kyi rgya/ le'u lnga pas rgya mtsho lta bu rlung gi rgya/ le'u drug pas nam mkha' lta bu lta ba'i rgya/ le'u bdun pas nyi zla lta bu sgom pa'i rgya/ le'u brgyad pas gnam lcags lta bu spyod pa'i rgya/ le'u dgu pas nor bu lta bu man ngag gi rgya rnams mdor bstan du bstan zhing /rgyas par yi ge so so las ston zhing dbang dang rtsa rlung gi skor mi gsal ba zab rgya gsar ma dang gung sgrig rgyur dgongs/ rdo rje lta bu lus kyi rgya ston pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa gnad lus kyi 'khor lo la nang gses kyi rtsa rlung spyi'i gnad shes pa'i man ngag /lus kyi gnad —180—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)thams cad 'dus pa lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ dran pa 'dus pa'i 'khor lo/ ro rnams 'dus pa'i 'khor lo/ rtse mo rnam par bkod pa'i 'khor lo/ spyir lus kyi gnad bstan pa rnams/ rgya mtsho lta bu rlung gi rgya ni slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa rlung gnad kyi sgron me la nang gses kyi rlung byung tshul/ gnas tshulu/ nyams su len tshul/ 'chi ba brtag blu/ gegs sel rnams/nam mkha' lta bu lta ba'i rgya ni zab rgya rnying pa 'dir yi ge logs su med par chos tshan kun gyi gnas lugs su go bar byed/ nyi zla lta bu sgom pa'i rgya ni mkha' 'gro lnga'i mchod pa'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa tshogs mchod (124ba)bskul lhag gtor dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro'i las rim la nang gses kyi gleng gzhi/ bstan pa'i dus slob dpon padma dang mnga' bdag gnyis zhu ba zhugal na gyi yi ge ḍā ki gsang ba'i man ngag dngos grub thob pa'i mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro'i zab rgya dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ o rgyan padmas mdzad pa'i zab rgya gsum gyi gsang 'grel dang bcas pa/ 'di'i nang du/ gtsang ma'i rgyu ni sdig sgrib dag byed rtags rin cen dbyibs gyi 'di phyi'i don grub rtags btso ma'i mdog ni ston pa'i 'khor gyi rtags dkyus su khru bzhi rtsa bzhi srung byed rtags zheng du sor bcu dge bcu spyod pa'i rtags rdo rje bzhis mtshan tshad med bzhi spyod rtags thugs kar rgya gram thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rtags g.yon nas brgyan pa tshul khrims gos kyi rtags rtags 'di dran mthong bcang dus log spyod dor: zhesabyang chub sems dpa'i chos gos phyi'i rtags rgya/ nang gi rtags su rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan mi 'bral rang gi snying gar sbas shing gab rdo rje theg pa chen po'i don ldan rtags rtse lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin rtags thugs kar brgyan pas 'gro ba brtse ba'i rtags sbas pa'i gsang sngags gab cing spyod pa'i rtags rtags 'di dran reg mthong tshe gsang sngags gab ces nang gi rtags rgya dang / gsang ba'i rtagasargya rang gi spyi gtsug snya ral pa'i thor cog rdo rje rtse lnga'i dbyibs bla ma'i byin rlabs sgrub chen sman dang rdzas rgyun du bcangs pas yon tan bsam mi khyab: spyi gtsug bde ba chen po'i don mtshon rtags ral pa rdo rje'i dbyibs su bsgrengs pa yis gsang sngags rdo rje (125na)theg pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng :—181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shechos kyi dbyings su skal ldan bgrod pa'i rtags rang rig bla ma'i byin rlabs rdzas bcangs pas dngosagrub kun 'byung rdo rje slob dpon dang : mos gus dad pa mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs gnyis med don rtogs rol pa wo po'i rtags rtags 'di dran reg mos gus gdung shugs bskyed rgya 'di chongasposhig skal ldan rigs kyi bu zhes phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags rgya ston pa'i man ngag khyad par can gter kha gzhan rnams la ming tsam yang ma grags pa'i byang gter ba'i khyad chos ya mtshan du 'dug pas lung dang bcas te cung zad spros pa'o/ /zab rgya drug gi dang po la rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i las rim dam bca' dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor la nang gses kyi rtsa ba'i dam bca' rin cen khang bu/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i lam rim gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dus rtsis rgya drug gi man ngag la nang gses/ rgya gar gyi yul ltar 'jig rten bstan pa'i rtsis o rgyan gyi yul ltar lus kyi rtsa gnas brtsi ba mkha' 'gro'i ri gnas ltar gsang ba rlung gi rtags brtsi ba/ phyi nang gsang gsum dril nas rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i chos spyod bcu bstan pa/ gsang dbang dang sher dbang thob nas dgos pa dam bca' gsum pa/ dbang bzhi rdzogs nas dgos pa dam bca' bzhi pa/ dam bca' dang po rnams yod/ zab rgya'i sems rlud rig pa gsum so sor dbye ba'i gnad zab mo'i man ngag le'u bzhi pa phrad shog gi mthar tshang ba/ gnam lcags lta bu spyod pa'i rgya gsang ba med byung ni logs su 'dri/ lnga pa (125ba)mtha' rten gtad rgya la/ gtad rgya dang po dka' spyad mthar skyel zhing bla ma mnyes pa gsum sgrub nus pa la chig brgyud du bya ba'i rgyal tshab spyi blugs kyi dbang dang de'i lung / gtad rgya phyi ma las can gyi thems byang zhes pa rigs 'dzin nyi zla 'od 'bar gyi sgrub thabs bstod (su)pa dang bcas pa/ lung byang bka'i thems yig rnams thob pa las/ rtags yod pa rnams ma ga rtags dbang 'khrid lung gsum lo mes rdzogasakyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ rigs 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes ga tshe/—182

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnamakhas pa shrī sidha/o a sangs rgyas gnyis pa/paṇa rsā bi mā mi tra/lo rṣa bee ro tsa na/chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/sprul pa'i gter ston dngos grub rgyal mas/srasamachog rnam rgyal mgon po/rdor 'tshang bsod nams bzang po/mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mas/mkhasabatsun chos kyi rin cen/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/bya btang shākya dpal bzang /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mas/thugs sras blo gros rgyal mas/mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mas/rdzogs mu pa 'brug sgra bzang po/kong smyon he ru dpa kun bzang rnam rgyal/zur wo chos kyi rgyal po chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang lugs gcig la/sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po yan gong ltar nas/gsang bdag bde chen lhun grub/rtogs ldan gragasapa'i mas can/grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po/sprul sku bde ba 126na ) bzang po/dran mchog rigs 'dzin chos rdor/sprul sku tshe ring rdo rje/gsas med kun grol rdo rje/bla ma cha dbang gragasapa/rang grol chos dbang lhun grub/lha ge mi kun bzang rnam rgyal man gong ltar ro//yang na thang stong rgyal po nas byang sgos kun dga' nyi ma/dran mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/rgyal sras padma sangasargyas/rigs 'dzin nyi zla sangs rgyas/rang grol ratna'i mtshan mā/mkhas grub rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin/lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal man gong bzhin no//shin tu nye brgyud ni o rgyan rṣa po la thang stong rgyal pos dngos su gsan pa yin/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis ca sde gter ston la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung pod dbang dang bcas gnang ba'i byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa ni chos btso tsha ma sngar rmi' pa smo la byin gas ga byed du gnad du gnang ba las ci yang ma thob pa'i rigs la 'di 'dras go chod byas nas gnang ba min pas rjes 'jun rnams kyis go dgo so//gter ston yab sras nas/sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis drin can sangs rgyas dpa' bzang /thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mas/rigs 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ca sde ga kho ston/bang ri ga kho ston wo' rsā snying po/lha gzha kun bzang rnam 8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyal man sngar ltar yang na nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/chos rgyal bkra shis stobasargyal man sngar bzhin no//btags grol gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan nas/yol mo ga kho ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/khyab bdag chos 26brko byings rang grol/desabadag la'o//de yang zhib tu byas na padma 'byung gnas kyi snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun bzang yab yum/longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po man gcig/bi mā la'i snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/shrī sidha yan spyi ltar la paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/rje khri srong lde bzhi/rigs 'dzin rpā po man 'dra/bee ro snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/shrī sidha nas lo wo bee ro tsa na/lha sras khri grong lde ba 'a/rig 'dzin wo po man gong ltar ro//zab rgya'i nye brgyud ni/kun bzang yab yum/yum srid pa bde 'gro ma/rdo rje phag mo/o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/rgyal yum 'tsho rgyal/gter ston man gcig khre'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigasawon ngag gi dbang po/sprul sku bska won nor bu/zur chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//su'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/gter ston yan gong ltar la/sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/mas ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigasa'adzin ngag gi dbang po/sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o//dbang gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ga kho ston nas/sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/rigs 'dzin nam mkha' grags pa/sprul sku 'jam dpal 'od zer/sngags lasang chos rgyal bsod nams/rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa/'khrul 27na tsā kho dkon cog bzang po/byams pa rin cen rdo rje/sngags la4 tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/zur wo ngag dbang phun tshogs/khyab bdag khra tshang pa ོ po/des bdag la'o//yang na ga kho ston nas/rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas byams bzang /se ston mgon po bzang po/se ston rin cen rgyal 8༷tshan/spyan chab pa mgon po zla ba/snyag phug pa

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganasangs rgyas bstan pa/ 'khrul zhig dka' bzhi man gcig /yang na gter ston nas/ rdo rje mgon po ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / shākya bzang po/ legs ldan rje/ rje gzhon nu stobs ldan/ tshe ring dbang po man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ thugs sras tshe ston/ gnubasangag dbang rgya mtsho/ skye ston tshe ring pa man gcig go /se'i rtags bkod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rtse ston padma dbang rgyal/ skyi ston sngags 'chang man 'dra/ rgya drug gi nang gi gnam lcags lta bu spyad pa'i rgya: zhesapa dang / snyan
