brgyud man ngag bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tu byed pa'i skabs kyi tshar gcod drag po gnam lcags kyi khang bu lngar grags pa snying mdzod nas byon pa'i phag mo gsang ba med byung gi skor la/ spros med don gyi dbang chog gi steng nas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rdzas la brten nas spros med don gyi dbang dang dmigs rim nyams 'khrid smin rgyas su mnos nas/ lung la/ gsang ba med byung gi brgyud 'debs kun bzang ma rigs 'dzin yol mo pa gsum pas mdzad pa/ de'i phros las gnyan sa dur khrod du blang ba'i glu nga ni rdo rje phag mo ma/ snyan brgyud kha byang padma 'byung gnas kyis mdo (127bsngags chos kyi bcud byung las can la phrad shog gi smon lam can/ chos 'di'i brgyud ston par byed pa'i lo rgyus bka' srung la gtad rgya'i mtha' can/ gleng gzhi nang gses kyi chos 'di'i mtshan gyi gleng gzhi/ stong thun spyi mthun gyi gleng gzhi/ rtsa ba bogs 'don 'bras bu gsum gyi gleng gzhi/ slob dpon chen por lha sras mu tig btsan pos zhus pa'i gsang ba med byung gi lde mig ces pa sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs nas 'phros te gnas chen 'tshol ba'i gang zag la bdud kyi bar gcod 'byung bas de dus thabs kyi nyams len dmigs pa ting 'dzin gyi mtha' can/ spros med don gyi dbang chog /sa dmigs 'tshol ba bdag nyid rig pa dar dang bcas te dur khrod du 'gro tshul/ dang po spros bcas kyi spyod pa/ gnyis pa spros med kyi spyod pa/ gsum pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa/ de'i dus dgos pa'i log gnon mjug tu las can gyi sbas yul bdun gyi sgo 'byed tshul don gyi mdzod du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ phyi rabs las can gyi don du log gnon gnad kyi man ngag le'u lnga/ gsang ba med byung gi gdams pa nyams su blang ba'i —183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shergyun khyer yol mo sprul pa'i skus phag gru'i rgyal khab tu mdzad pa dpa' po'i 'gying glu rol pa chen po'i zlos gar/des mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang brgyud 'debs 'og min gdal khyab ma/rgyun gyi nyams len khrigs chags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs nyams len dngos dang bcas pa sprul sku phyag rdor nor bus mdzad pa/rang snying phag mor bsgoms pa'i gdams pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun bzang yab yum/yum kho srid pa bde 12zha'agro ma/rdo rje phag mo/gnod 'du tha lha'i rgyal po/lha mo mdzes ldan ma/lha mo grub ldan ma/lha grags ldan phyogs skyong /lha mo yongasargyud bde ma/slob dpon shinti rgyal po/gu ya : ba tsand+ra/rgya gar rgyal po chos skyong /mkha' 'gro padma can/chos rgyal de wa rā dzā/mkhan po bsam 'phel ma ti/brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgya rtsa gcig/de'i nang nas brtul zhugs mthar phyin pa'i slob dpon drug ni/slob dpon 'jam dpal gos gto/'jam dpal bzang po/grub rsā birnya pa/slob dpon nag po spyod pa slob dpon ḍi bhi he ru ga slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/de la las can dag pa'i 'khor lngas zhus/de nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /me ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/yol mo gter ston bstan 'dzen nor bu/sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu/rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings4 grol/des bdag la'o//yang na gter ston nas/grub byu don grub dpal bzang /rtse ston nyi bzang /rtse ston mgon bzang /rtseston rin cen rgyal mtshan/spyan tshab rje/mnyam med rje/byang bdag man gong bzhin no//yang na gter ston yab sras nas/rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang po/mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/mkhas btsun chos kyi rin cen/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/bya btang shākya dpal bzang /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/thugs128ba ) sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/nub dgon shākya rgyal mtshan/yol mo sprul pa'i sku man gong baX/ no//rdzogs chen gyi cha lag tu mdzad pa'i mkha'

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)'gro'i bsu bzlog gi gzhung / zhu ba zhus lan/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdan 'ding / brtan bzhugs don brgyad ma/ smon lam snang srid 'khor 'das ma rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje phag mo/ padma 'byung gnas/ dag pa'i 'khor lnga/ gter ston rgod ldem/ rdo rje dpal/ byams pa bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / glo bo chos rgyal bsod nams/ sangs rgyas bstan pa/ sngags 'chang shāka bzang / legs ldan rje/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ sngags 'chang tshe ring pa/ mkhan chen klu sgrub pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos spyan drangs pa'i rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub bam rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs kyi skor/rigs 'dzin rtsa ba'i thems las/ dbus kyi snying mdzod smug po na: bla ma rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub thabs yod: ces pa ltar dbus snying mdzod smug po nas sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos spyan drangs pa'i rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub bam rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs kyi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas slob ma sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i bum dbang / lha dbang / rdzas dbang /rgyan dbang / gsang dbang / rab mas bka'i dbang / bu mo pa/ thod pa/ me long / gtor ma bcasabazhi la brten nas rigs 'dzin rtsa ba'i dbang ngam zlum po bzhi dbang du grags pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gtor dbang gi smin byed dang shin tu gces pa'i thems byang gi dgongs don ltar ka dag gi dmigs rim ye shes lnga'i (129na jo sprod kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ rigasa'adzin rtsa ba sgrub pa'i thems byang / bla ma'i thugs kyi sgrub pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba rin po che 'bar ba zhes pa rigs 'dzin 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi/ rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs rab 'byams bka'i —187—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nedabang chog /rigs 'dzin yongs rdzogs rtsa ba'i dbang chog ces pa zlum po bzhi dbang gi smin byed gu ru zhi ba'i gtor dbang thob chog blo bde/ sku gsung thugs kyi gtor ma'i dbang chog /gu ru zhi ba rigasa'adus kyi dbang chog dbang lung thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin tshul dang dbang thob nas snying po brgya rtsa chag med dgos tshul gyi mtha' can/ rigs 'dzin zhi ba rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs chos rgyal rje 'bangs nyer lngar gdams pa'i snyan brgyud/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi thugs sgrub las/ phyi sku 'bag la brten nas sgrub pa sku 'bag bzhed tshul/ rab gnas/ dngos gzhi rlung sbyor la brten pa'i nyams len/ nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ gtor ma bca' tshul dang spyan 'dren/ gsang ba dza gad la brten nas sgrub pa bcas dang / dngos grub bskul ba rje 'bangs bdun gyis gsol ba btab nas gnang ba/ slob dpon chen por rgyal po ind+ra bhu tis 'phrin las gzhi'i sgo nas bstod pa/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi snying po thugs kyi sgrub pa rje 'bangs bdun la gnang ba gsang mtshan thugs kyi snying po mnga' bdag la gnang zhing mjug tu slob dpon chen por bka' drin che tshul gyi bstod pa phul ba/ rigs 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub pa'i thog mar rigs 'dzin rnam bzhi spyi sgrub kyi go rim nges par (129ba)byed pa/ phyi sku 'bag la brten nas sgrub pa'i gsal byed kyi sku bri ba le'u dang po/ rab tu gnas pa le'u gnyis pa/ bsnyen pa'i le'u lta gsum gyis bstan pa/ 'di'i skabs nang gtor mar brten nas sgrub pa logs su 'byung zhesapa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'phrin las chen mor ngos 'dzin/ mtshan brgyad bye brag tu sgrub pa la padma 'byung gnas la brten nas mchogo gi dngos grub bsgrub pa/ padma /bha la brten nas yon tan sna tsho gis sgrub pa/ blo ldan mchog sred la brten nas shes rab bsgrub pa/ padma rgyal por brten nas 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba/ nyi ma 'od zer la brten nas 'gro ba 'dul ba/shākya seng ge la brten nas bdud bzhi gzhom pa/ seng ge sgra sgrog la brten nas mu stegs rtsod pa bzlog pa/rdo rje gro lod la brten nas dgra bgegasatshar gcod pa/ 'dzab kyi dgongs pa la phyi ltar gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla ba'i 'dzab dgongs/ nang ting 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du'i 'dzab dgongs/ gsang ba bde ba chen por bzla ba rigs 'dzin bla ma'i rdzogs —188

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarim khyad par can/yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs rang rig kun khyab ma/bla ma mchod pa'i 'phrin las chen mo/byin 'bebs chos dbyings ma/brgyud 'dzab rang bzhin rnam dag ma/rtags bstod sku gsum yongs rdzogs ma/gtor ma'i bstod pa ma bcos ma/bshags pa ma bcos spros bral/smon lam bla ma yi dam ma/shis brjod dus gsum bla ma/gshin po rjes 'dzin/rigs drug nas 'dren pa'i gnas lung /rab gnas kyi cho ga bse sgron ma/las tshogs nor bu'i 'phrong ba la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sbyor/phyogs 30na / nga na gza' skar bsrung ba/zas nor/'gro ba/dam chos rnams dbang du bsdu ba/mngon shes 44 ba/bla ma dgyes pa/shes rab bskyed pa/bud med dang mi spyi dga' ba/zas rnyed pa/mi thams cad rang la nyan pa/dgra dbang du sdud pa/rgyan dang zhal lce rgyal ba/skad sman don thams cad 'grub pa/gru mi rdib pa/chus mi 'byer ba/gsang gtam thos pa/lha 'dre mthong ba/bar chad bsrung ba/mi rgod 'ching ba/gcan gzan bsrung ba/lam bsrung /spyang kyi kha 'ching /ra lug bsrung ba/ser bsrung /char gcod/char 'bebs/khams bsrung ba/rlig skrangs 'chos pa/pho mo dbang sdud/byis pa thon pa/rdel nad 'don pa/chu bsdams pa 'grol ba/tsha grang nad rnams byang thabs/pho skran ma zhu ba zhi ba/glo snying na ba brang tsha ba/rlung gi nad rnams sel thabs/mig gsal ba/rna ba 'on pa 'chos pa rnams legs par thob pa las gtor dbang bsdus pa dang nyams 'khrid ma gtogs dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun bzang /longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/sprul sku gsang ba'i bdag po/skal ldan rgyal po dza/rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti/sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje ste mchog sprul lnga/slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes garsā/slob dpon nā ga rdzun/slob dpon hūṃ ka ra/paṇa rsā bi mā mi tra/slob dpon pra bha ski/slob dpon dha na /skyi ta/slob dpon rom bu gu ya tsand+ra/paṇa chen shinti garbha ste dpal gyi sprul pa rnam brgyad/she rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/jo bo ye shes mtsho rgyal/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/lha sras mu tig btsan po/gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/sna nam / / 30ba ) bdud 'joms te dag pa'i 'khor lnga/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (shegater ston dngos grub rgyal mas/sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/dran mchog sangs rgyas dbon wo/mtshan ldan byams pa bshes garsā/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang /sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa/yol mo sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/mchog sprul legasaldan rdo rje/i sa bkra shis stobs/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/zur rdo rje lang chosadabyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//de yang sprul sku rigs 'dzin ོ pos zlum po bzhi dbang gis chos sgo phye nas dgung lo don brgyad kyi bar rab mas bka'i dbang ma gnang bar don dgu'i thog dran mchog sangs rgyas dbon rṣa rdo rje dpal gyis gsol ba bto ste dbang che ba 'di gnang ba yin pas rdo rje dpal nges par brgyud dgos shing /yang rab 'byams bka'i dbang ma snam gtagasapa dbang gi brgyud pa gcig la/gter ston nas sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/rigs 'dzin gsang sngags sdong po/bla ma dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/chos rje rgyal mtshan 'bum/sngags 'chang bsam grub rgyal mtshan/mtshungs med dpal ldan seng ge grub chen dkon cog skyabs/mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che/legs ldan skud loms rdo rje pha sngar bzhi no//yang na sras༅gonas/rdor lang bgo nams bzang po/gu ru dbang phyug mgon po/bla ma rdo rje rgyal mas/rigs 'an chos rgyal bsod nams ma na sngar dang 'dra/sku gsung thugs kyi gtor dbang dang 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ga kho ston nasasngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/mtshan ldan byams pa 3na bshes gnyen/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang /thugs sras na mo mkha' rgyal mtshan/ga khu bas chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho/skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/zur rsā ngag dbang phun rdzos/zur༄mas cad mkhyen pa chos dbyingasarang grol/des bdag la'o//zlog byed gyad kyi 'khor lo'i lo rgyus las/phyi yi 'chi bdag gshin rje de rgyad kyi man ngag 'di yis bzlog nang gi dbang po srog gi rten bas len rdzas dang sman gyis gsogs nga ba tshe yi dwangasam de bskyed rim dbang dang rma gis gso de / 0bag gas dag par 'gyur zhes pa'i zab chos

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganasprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos dbus snying mdzod smug po nas gdan drangs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med nang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chos skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du gter gzhung gi sgrub thabs padma'i 'phreng ba dang 'phrin las gnyis gter ston gyis bsdebs pa'i chog bsgrigs kyi steng nas smin byed dbang dang / snyan brgyud 'chi med 'od snang gi steng nas phyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe bsring ba/ nang rtsa khams yi ge'i bzlas pa la brten nas tshe bsgrubs te sku gsum myur du sgrub pa'i thabs/ gsang ba srog mi shigs pa thig le la brten nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku sgrub thabs thod rgal snang bzhi'i nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ bcud len gyi sgrub skor/ longs spyod rdzogs skur brten pa'i sgrub skor/ shin tu zab pa snyan brgyud kyi skor dang gsum/dang po la/ bdud mi tshe'i sgrub thabs la nang gses kyi sman gyi bcud len sbyor thabs/ sgrub (131ba)rdzas bshams thabs/ rgyal ba rigs lnga la brten pa'i sgrub pa dngos/ rtags mtshan thob nas bdag don du bcud len gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga /gzhan don du dbang bskur ba'i kha bsgyur/ dam tshig bstan pa/ bcud len man ngag bdud rtsi sbyor thabs rlud la brten pa'i tshe sgrub bam bcud len rnams/gnyis pa nang longs spyod rdzogs skur brten pa'i sgrub skor la/ tshe'i gzungs sgrub tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes pa theg pa chen po'i mdo gzungs/ tshe'i gzungs kyi 'phro 'du bsgom pa'i man ngag khyad par can/ tshe'i 'khor lo 'dri thabs dpe ris dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med longs skur sgrub pa'i tshe sgrub rtsa ba/ de'i sgrub thabs dang dbang gi cho ga padma'i 'phreng ba/ 'di la sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa yang zer/ sgrub thabs kyi 'phrin las/ tshe bkra brtag pa/ sgrub thabs dang 'phrin las sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos chog bsgrigs su mdzad pa/ rmi lam/ dbang po'i yul/ tshe gzugs la brten nas 'chi ba brtag glu/ zlog byed rgyad kyi 'khor lo'i lo rgyus/ 'tshe bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga gyad kyi stobs chen 'byung lnga'i'akhor lo glud bca' ba dang gyer gzhung / 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga stobs chen rgyad kyi man ngag ces pa bca' gzhi dngos dang gyer gzhung / srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dri ba'i yi ge dpe ris dang bcas pa —191—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nernams/gsum pa shin tu zab pa snyan brgyud kyi skor ni/thugs sgrub tshe'i snyan brgyud 'chi med 'od kyi snang ba zhes pa ri bo ma la ya'i bkra shis zla gam phug par kun bzang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang bcas pa slob dpon chen pos dngos su zhal mjal te zhus pa'i zab chos rnams 32na༄gas par thob pa'i dbang dang gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i chog bsgrigs kyi lung brgyud ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/mgon po tshe dpag med rigs lnga/'chi med padma 'byung gnas/rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal/gter ston rigs 'dzin yab sras/dbon rdo rje dpal/mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang /sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/rigasa'adzin sangs rgyas bstan pa/zhakhrul zhig dkon cog bzang po/tshar rsā rdo rje 'chang /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan/rtsa ba'i bla ma kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang na rigs 'dzin chos rgyal bsod nams nas/de sras sngags 'chang rpā po chos skyong bsod nams/'jam mgon mkhyen brtse man gong bzhin/nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ga nubasang ga dbang rgya mtsho/sngagasa'achang tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//gter ston gyi chog bsgrigs ma gtogs pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/gter ston yan gong ltar la/dpal ldan nam mkha' grags pa/'jam dbyangs ba nams rgyal ma/mkhas grub bya bral chos rje/bla mkho cog blo gros/dpang ston blo gros dbang 32ba ) po/bya btang shākya dpal bzang /nub dgon pa chen po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/thugs sras rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol des bdag la'o//yang na gter ston nas/rdo rje mgon po/༷mas pa bshes garsā/sangs rgyas dpal bzang /

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal mtho'i mtshan can man gong bzhin no/ /yang 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i skor gyi lung brgyud gcig la/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal nas/ rigs 'dzin gzhen nu don grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /rigasa'adzin rtsa ba'i sgrub pa las/ lho phyogs gser mdzod ser po na: bla ma dpal chen he ru ga rgyal po'i tshul du sgrub pa yod ces dang / sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus las/ lha yi bye brag rang bzhin bsam yas kyang : lha yi ngo bo rdo rje slob dpon yin: 'di la lha tshogs gang yang ma 'dus med sngags kyi bye brag rang bzhin bsam yas kyang : sngags kyi snying po yi ge hūm̐ la 'dus: bde gshegs snying po ma 'dus gang yang med thugs kyi dgongs pa brjod bral bsam yas kyang : kun bzang dgongs pa stong gsal 'dzin med ma chos nyid 'od gsal gang la'ang bsam du med: ces pa ltar gsang ba las kyang ches gsang zhing zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i man ngag sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos phal cher lho gser mdzod ser po nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rigs 'dzin thugs sgrub drag (133na)po rtsal gyi chos skor la/ thog mar ras las byang rgyas 'bring gang rung gzhung bsrangs pa'i mngon rtogs dbang chog sgo so'i dbu na yod pa ltar mdzad/bris kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba sta gon dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i steng nas sta gon gyi rim pa sngon du 'gro ba'i che ba sgrub chen brgyad kyi rtsa ba dril ba drag po rtsal gyi dbang chog rṣa mo'i steng nas bum dbang ba po bzang ba'i phyag len la stan na dang 'dug pa rang rang shar nas kha 'geng / gsang dbang / gtum mo'i me dbang / sher dbang bkra bzang pa'i phyag len 'di dbang chu nas 'a/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang / gtor ma'i dbang ste sgrub pa bka' brgyad dang 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi lan bzhi ba po bzang ba'i phyag len la 'di lagator dbang gnad kyi shog bcug ma sbyor/ 'bring po dbang chu'i steng nas sgrub pa sde drug dang 'brel ba'i bum pa/ gsang ba/bkra bzang pa'i lugs la dbang 'bring po 'di mi bskur tshe gsang dbang man dbang rgyas pa la sbyor srol yod/ shes rab ye shes/rig pa rtsal gyi dbang rnams lan gsum/ chung ba sku 'bag /yig 'bru me long / gtor ma la brten pa'i byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang lan gsum/ gter gzhung sor gnas la se ston chen po'i dbang — 193—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negi zin tho dang phyag len ji lta ba'i tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma'i dbang brgya rtsa/ bkra bzang pa chos skyong bsod nams kyi phyag len ltar tshe dpag med rigs bzhi yum bcas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong dang sgo ma bzhi'i bskyed chog yod pa'i lcags sdong ma'i dbang / las kyi bya khyung nag po'i gtor dbang rnams mnos shing / yang tig gces pa'i sgron me rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun gyis brgyan nas nyams (133ba tshe dze khrid lus lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / ngag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor phyi dmigs rim sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sems chos nyid kyi dkyil 'bor rang bzhi rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs gto la phab ste ka dag gcer mthong du ngo sprad/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ chos 'a nyer lnga 'dir thems dang thems med gnyis yod pa'i dbang gis rigs 'dzin wo po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ chos rgyal mtho'i mas ༅ sogs gong ma mang po'i gsan yig tu so sor 'dug na'ang / rtse ston chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgyun bzhin mtsho smad mkhan chen dang bla chen bkra bzang pa'i gsan yig tu thems dang thems gnyis 'khrugs bsdebs su snang ba rtogs sla bar ma wa zhe zhing / de dag lamathun mi mthun ci rigs 'dug na'ang zhib mor dpyad cing che 'bring gi dbye ba yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses tshar rsā dang bkra bzang chos skyong bsod nams gnyis la gsan tho dang / rigs 'dzin rṣa po'i gsan yig /chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can gyi gsan yig rnams su mthun mi mthun ci rigs byung ba blo mig chung ngus legs par brtags te bkod pa la/ thugs sgrub (byang/kyi thems(li)byang / lo'i /de las/ dang po sngon byung gleng gzhi'i khungs gsal bar bya phyir lo rgyus yod ces pa'i thems can bu tshal gser khang gling du bdud blon rnams btul tshul dang chos rgyal gyi mnal lam du ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa bstan pa sogs kyi gtam rgyud thugs sgrub rnam gsum gyi lo rgyus lta yold(se)su grags pa 'bring thems med la/ thugs sgrub rtsa ba brgyud pa'i lo (134na)rgyus rdo rje phur pa he ru ka las kyi rgyal po thugs kyi sgrub thabs zhes pa bla ma phur pa dbyer med kyi lo rgyus rkarma mā le 'phrin las kyi rgyud dam (yild/dru)gsang ba rin cen 'dus pa'i lo rgyus su grags pa/tshong /'di mtsho smad mkhan chen shākya —194

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadabang phyug gi gsan yig na chos tshan gnyis par ngos bzung 'dug pa thems yig gi brjod bya dang 'gal bar mngon/ de dang brjod don cha 'dra'i rdo rje thugs kyi sgrub (bya nge lo bee)pa'i lo rgyus chung lasacan min pa su rung rung dang nga'i thugs sgrub 'di mi phrad pa'i mtha' can/ byang khog lus dang dpe mthun pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus yod ces pa'i thems can sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus la rdo rje he ru ka thugs kyi sgrub thabs yang tig (byang)9 se)gsang ba gser gyi 'bru gcig ma phreng /'di sngags 'chang bkra bzang pa'i gsan yig na thems med du mdzad pa'i zlar dkyil 'khor bcud dril dang / thems can la sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus zer ba zhig 'dug par da lta dpe rgyun la lar phal cher he ru ga'i thugs sgrub 'di dang zhus dag pher ba'i ming mi gcig pa gcig dang / gsang ba rin chen 'dus par mjug tu 'dra min cung zad yod pa'i bcud dril du ming btags pa zhig 'dug pa de gnyis ni ma dag pa'i rgyun 'byams 'khyar ba 'dra las brjod don lhag po gang yang ma mthong zhing /de las gzhan pa ma rnyed 'on kyang bkra bzang pa chen po phyogs 'dir tshad thub kyi mkhas par 'dug pas dpyad par bya'o/ /tsitta snying dang dpe mthun pa'i gsang ba rin cen 'dus pa yod: ces pa'i themasacan gyi bla (134ba)ma'i thugs sgrub chen mo (bya/sa pā)gsang ba rin cen/ 'bring / 'dus pa zhes pa snang srid lha 'dres bkar nyan srog snying 'bul zhes pa yan gyis tshang nas bar du brda yig kha shas bris mthar de ltar thugs kyi bsnyen pa'i rtags rdzogs nas: zhes sogs dkyus gcig tu bris pa dpe rnying phal cher la yod/ zhing don gyi chos tshan gcig /'on kyang so sor phral ba yang 'dug pa thems ngos 'dzin dang bstun na gsal bar mngon/ 'di ga'i gzhung du dkyil 'khor gsum gyi nyams len bcud du dril zhes pa byung bas dkyil 'khor bcud dril yang ming gi rnam grangs su mngon/ 'on kyang dpe khungs btsun mang por dkyil 'khor bcu dril zhes logs su bgrangs pa mthong bas slar yang phyogs 'dir tshad thub kyi mkhas pa rnyed na dpyad par bya'o/ /de yang sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus las/nyin zhag re la thugs kyi snying po 'di nyi khri chig stong sngon du bsnyen pa'i gnad gsang sngags lto tshil — 193—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesnying tig kun gyi srog dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi thugs khams gsum sems can ma lus kun gyi sems: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kun gyi srog bstan pa'i dam chos ma lus kun gyi chings 'di nyid yin no nam zhig dus kyi tshe: zhes dang / dngos grub blang thabs las/ lan gsum bsgrubs na dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob: rigs 'dzin gral la the tshom yod ri skan: zhes bde gshegasakun gyi dgongs pa rigs 'dzin padma'i thugs kyi nying khu phrad 'tshengs shin tu zab pa'i gsang lam mthar thug pa'o/ /thems med la thugs sgrub gsang ba rin cen 'dus (135na)pa/ (byang/dos/zhes bla ma yum can dang dpa' bo ging bzhi yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub zab pa'i mthar thug pa thugs sgrub gsang ba'i gter mdzod/ che/ las sbyor gnad kyi man ngag (bya/lo3n zhes pa snang srid yon tan thams cad bsdu ba dang zhar byung 'phrin las 'di gong gi 'phros dang sbrel nas yod zangs mdzod nas byon/ bzhi'i kha bsgyur dang bcasapa/ che/ gsang ba rin cen 'dus pa thems can drag po rtsal gyi nyams len dngos gzhi dang thems med ni drag po rtsal gyi gsang sgrub yin pa'i brjod don mi gcig pa ma go bar byang gter bar rlom pa 'gas gsang ba rin cen 'dus pa tshar gnyis yod zer/ rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi bsnyen pa'i man ngag snyan brgyud bla ma'i zhal gi drod ldan (gnas)zab khyad can mchog sprul padma bzhad pa rtsal gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i dmigs pa'i ( gon rme)gnas bogs 'don gegs sel/ thems can gsang 'dus kyi nyams len gab pa mngon phyung mkha' 'gro'i srog snying shin tu gnyan zhing gces pa chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can gyi (nyol)ljags bsgrigs/ bsnyen pa lam du gzung pa'i thabs gnad thems man ngag rnam grangs brgyad ces thems can thugs sgrub hūm̐ gi dgongs (bya nge lo pā)pa'i gnad du grags pa 'di la nang gses yi dam lha'i gnad kyi dgongs pa lta ba/ 'bring / lam/ dngos grub/ spyod pa/ dam tshig brtson 'grus/ dkyil 'khor/ lha/ dbang / tshig ste zab mo'i gnad bcu/ padma 'byung gnas thugs kyi dgongs pa drag po rtsal gyi sgom don ka dag gi ngang nas lhun grub tu rdzogs tshul/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dgongs pa/ tshig gnyis gnad kyi 'grel pa/ hūṃ (135ba)gi gzer bzhi nam mkha'i snying por sems — 196

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganakyi gter du chongs shig pa gdams pa rnams yin cing / de yang yi dam lha'i gnad padma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ nam mkha'i snying por gdams pa gsum gyi steng du gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang tshig gnyis gnad 'grel gyi don rnams so sor bgrangs pas gnad thems man ngag brgyad tshang zhing / 'di rnams bsnyen pa lam du gzud par shin tu gal che ba yin/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig zab mo gnad kyi thems bcu dang sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus gnyis rnam grangs su gsungs pa dang / mtsho smad mkhan po'i gsan yig tu 'di skor rnams sku gsung thugs kyi gnad 'dus su bgrangs 'dug pa se brgya mkhar ba phyogs kyi gsan yig la de 'dra yod tshod yin 'dra ba thems yig dang cung zad ma 'grig mod/ 'on kyang bla ma de rnams lugs 'di la tshad thub kyi dpang por 'dug pas slar yang brtag dgos so/ /thems med la ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i hūm̐ gi 'dren (blal)(se)thabs nyer gcig /che/ bsrung 'khor bsgom thabs bdag nyid ba brlab pa/ bcings mnan gyi rtags/ ngag 'grol ba/ byug rdzas kyi zab gnad/ ngag la ngar gzung lta yoshe(se)ba'i man ngag tshong / sgo gsum lha dang dam 'dres dus rtags mthong dngos grub blang thabs ngag dbang grags pa/drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang /thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ga nubasang ga dbang rgya mtsho/skyi ston sngags 'chang man gong bzhin no//sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos lho gser mdzod ser po nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar ni rgyud las/zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs ni shes pa tsam gyis choge pa yin dran pa tsam gyis lam sna bgrod:ye shes nang nas khyad par che lha yi nang nas lha mchog yin de la bsnyen dang sgrub pa dang :mchod dang bstod pa thams caX ༷na 146ba ) chos kyi dbyings su mngon la'i rgya:

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)zhes ches cher bsngags pa'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sgrub gzhung gi steng nas sta gon dang /rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud nas padma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis logs su bkod pa'i rtsa ba'i dbang ngam bsnyen pa gso ba'i dbang chog gi steng nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ me tog 'phreng ba/ nus pa'i dbang /rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sman ra kagator gsum/ phyag mtshan rgyan dbang / lha dbang / byang sems la brten nas gsang dbang / phyag rgya la brten nas sher dbang / brda dang ngo sprod la brten nas tshig dbang / lta sgom spyod pa'i dbang / mtha' rten sgrol dbang dang bcas pa/ tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / bya khyung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / nor lha yongs rdzobs kyi dbang rnams legs par mnos/ rgyud dang 'khrid gzhung rnams kyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i 'khrid/ gyes pa yal ga lta bu'i 'khrid/smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i 'khrid yig bka' brgyad kyi dgongs pa snying tig thams cad kyi srog ma tshang ba med par skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du rgyal dbang padmas rgyud las gud du phyung ba la gzhi byas/ khri srong rnam sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i rim lnga gdan thog gcig tu sgom pa'i 'khrid yig rang lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i brag ri dug lnga'i sbrul gyis kun nas spungs pa'i dbus nas dgongs gter du byung ba dang / gter byon gnam zhal don 'khrid gnyis sdebs rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun gyis legs par brgyan te dbang po mtha' ma'i rim pa gsum la nyan rang dbu sems kyi 'khrid (147na rko bang po 'bring gi rim pa gsum la byang sems spo yog u pa gsum gyi 'khrid/gnam zhal don 'khrid nas gsungs pa'i yo ga gsum la brten pa'i lha 'khrid/ dbang po rab kyi mtha' ma la gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rtsa rlung gi 'khrid/ dbang po rab kyi 'bring la sher dbang dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi 'khrid/ rang byung rang shar le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba lus dben/ ngag dben/ semasadaben/ sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug /dbang po rab kyi rab la ye shes zang thal dang yang mthun pa sgom mi dgos par mthong bas grol ba 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po snod bzhi'i 'khrid rnams smin rgyas su mnos/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ thems byang las/ rgyud chen gnyis kyis thog drangs nas —213—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebaskyed rim chos tshan brgya rtsa brgyad rdzogs rim chos tshan bcu gcig yod shin tu gces shing dam par bcad rtsegacig sgrubs la nyams su long : zhes pa ltar/ rgyud kyis thogs drangs pa'i bskyed rim gdams pa'i skor/ rdzogs rim gyi grol byed kyi skor dang gnyis las/ dang po la/ rtsa rgyud kyi skor/ sgrub pa 'phrin las/ smin byed dbang rim/ nyams chags dag byed skor/ rang gzhan phan bde 'byung thabs/gshin la phan gdags pa/ nad gdon bar gcod bzlog thabs/ bsod na mas tshogis gsog /thun mong chos spyod/ phan gnod las phran/ chos skyong bstan srung / yongs rdzogs rnam gsum/ nyams len lha 'khrid kyi rim pa dang bcu gsum/ dang po la/ drag po rang byung rang shar chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u nyer drug par rgyan gyi mkhan po padma nga gnas kyis rgya gar dang / (147ba)yo rgyan gyi sgraganyis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ rang byung rang shar rtsa ba'i rgyud dam/ rgyal tshab rang byung rang shar du byon pa le'u nyer lnga pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgya can/ zhi khro bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i sngags rgyud rin cen 'phreng ba le'u bco lnga pa/ rgyud le'u nyer drug pa'i grangs nges mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ de mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi las rim rtsa ba gsal byed/ des mdzad pa'i gsang rgyud rtsa ba sdom gyis bsdus pa rnam par phye ba rnams/ gnyis pa sgrub pa 'phrin las kyi skor la/ thems byang zhal gdams le'u brgyad pa/ zhi ba gsang chen rigs gcig gi sgrub pa/ rtsa ba sdong po lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ gyes pa yal ga lta bu'i sgrub thabs/rgyas pa lo 'dab lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ mdzes pa me tog lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ smin pa 'bras bu lta bu'i sgrub thabs/ bde gshegs rtsa ba dril sgrub snying gi gter/ rtsab yang dril gyi sgrub thabs/ rang byung rang shar rgyud mchog snying po'i gan/ zhi khro'i dril sgrub rang byung rang shar wo po'i bas/ bka' brgyad brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs khyab bdag mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs 'og min chos dbyings ma/ drug po rang byung rang shar rsā po'i sgrub gzhung rsā mo/ bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i sgrub gzhung zur 'debs/ sgrub pa rgyas pa'i lag len bka' babs spyi don chen mor grags pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi gsung / sgrub pa'i yum brtag pa'i yig —214

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)chung / sgrub chen skabs mnga' gsol bya ba'i yig chung / dam bca' bkol ba/ rgyun bshags nar ma/mchod skong bsdus pa/ bar chad myul le rgyas par brtags te bzlog pa/(148na sko brgyad yan lag stong gi bshad pa/ bdud rtsi rtsa ba sgrub pa'i zur 'debs/ dngos grub yongs rdzogs bskul ba/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad dus gsum rgyal ba yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las sngon 'gro/ drag po rang byung rang shar chen po'i 'phrin las 'bring po/ gsang ba sgrub chen las 'khrid yi dam rgyun 'byer du grags pa sngags /kyi sgrub pa/ bka' brgyad 'phrin las kyi skabs su mkho ba'i sgom khog /bstod pa chos sku skye med ma/ bka' brgyad gdan gyi rnam par dbye ba/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis lho brag tu mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i lha bskyed pa'i gdan lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi tshul zur du bkol ba rnams/ gsum pa smin byed dbang gi rim pa la/ bka' brgyad kyi dbang gi chu bo'i babs so chen po/ rang byung rang shar chen po'i rgyud kyi nyams len lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu mdo 'gag tu dril ba nyon mongs dug sprul spungs pa'i sgyu lus kyi brag ri chen po'i nang nas lha rigs padma dbang rgyal gyi dgongs gter du phyung ba/ rang byung rang shar gyi dbang gi lhan thabs don gsal sgron ma nyi zla'i rgya can/ rtsa dbang bkol ba'am/ bsnyen pa gso ba'i dbang du grags pa dpal sngags kyi srung ma rdo rje khro gdong mar gnyer du gtad pa'i mtha' can/ bka' brgyad dbang gi bum sgrub/ dus bsnyen sgrub dbang gi khrigs sam sgrub dbang chen mo'i cho ga'i sdom du grags pa/ slob ma sta gon bkol ba/ lha gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag mtshan rnams kyi lha bkod rnams/ bzhi pa nyams chags dag byed skong la/ phyi'i bshags pa na rag dong sprug /dam tshig gso ba'i bskang gso bkol ba'o/ /lnga pa (148ba'ang gzhan phan bde 'byung thabs la/ 'gro ba'i bsod namasatshogs rdzogs par bya ba sku gsung thugs rten gyi rab gnas bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud las byung ba/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg yongs rdzogs rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud las byung ba/ sku gdung / las rim zhes pa ngo bo nges tshig /dbye ba dgongs ched bzheng thabs 'bras bu rnams bstan pa las/ nam mkha' rlung chu ma'i sum zhi ba'i sum rgyas pa'i la dbang gi la dag po'i sum sdig —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepa sbyong ba'i la gshin po'i don byed kyi la 'chi bdag bzlog cing sri'u gso ba'i sum bsod nams rgyas pa'i sum rgol ba 'joms pa'i sum phur kha dang zor kha bzlog pa'i sum khrims nyamasagaso ba'i la nyams chags gso ba'i byu mdze 'phro gcod pa'i sātstsha rnams/ drug pa gshin la phan gdags pa la/ bdun tshigs/ zas gtad/ tshe 'das dgug cing gshed dang dbral ba/ gnas spar ba/ ro sreg rnams/ bdun pa nad gdon bar gcod bzlog thabs la/ rang byung rang shar gyi rigs 'dzin spyi bskul 'og min chos dbyings ma/ bstod bskul las bzhi lhun grub/ bskul chung ba mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dkon cog spyi bskul lam bskul chen mor grags pa mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rnal 'byor bar gcod bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig pa'i mtha' can/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi drag las bkol ba'am bsgral las don brgyad ma gsad pa'i las bzhi shin tu gsal ba/ bden bdar chen mo rdo rje theg pa'i lha tsho gis spyi la mkhyen par gsol ba/ ral gri byung rdeg ces pa nang (149na)gses kyi snyan gsan/ gzu dpang / dgug gzhug /ye shes kyi lha tsho gos bzheng par gsol ba bla ma yi dam rnams bskul bar dpe tshan gcig /tshe lung khrus lus/ khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog gi rtsa ba/ sa bcad/ zlog gzhung chen mo'i tshig bar dgu ma/ 'debs kha dgu ni/ gshin rje/ma mo/ rgyal po/ klu/ the'u brang / btsan/ gza'/ bdud/ srin po bzlog pa/ las phran bcu ni/ shi kha gcod pa/ bse rag kha 'ching / spyo 'dul/ ser bsrung / nad kha gcod pa/ tshe sgrub/ nad pa bsrung ba/zho chang bsrung ba/ sde brgyad kyi gshom rnams/ brgyad pa bsod na mas tshogos gsog la/ rgyud lasagasungs pa'i phyi gtor/ nang gi gtor ma/ gsang ba'i gtor ma/ thun mong chu sbyin/ cha gsum gtor ma/ spyi don drug pa/ cha gsum bsdus pa rnams/ dgu pa thun mong chos spyod la/ ldang ba/ khrus/ phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇḍal/ bza' tshogs/ sgom gos/ 'gro chag /nyal ba/ 'dug pa/ skor ba/ sbyin pa/ nad gdon gzhom pa rnams yod cing chos spyod nyer gcig gsungs pa'i 'ga' zhig ni chos tshan gzhan du kha 'phangs pas don gyis tshang ngo /—216

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)ngag gi nus 'don sgrib tshogs 'dag pa'i cho ga rnams/ bcu pa phan gnod las phran la/ shes rab bskyed pa dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub pa/ dug khrag yongs rdzogs sbyor ba/ bsrung bzlog gnam lcags me 'bar/ bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i drag sngags/ de'i las rim brgyad la drag sngags bsnyen pa skyel ba/ rnal 'byor sgrib pa sbyong ba/ chos skyong las la bskul ba/ sde brgyad bran du bkol ba/ rigs bzhi'i klu rnams gdul ba/ gdug pa'i (149ba)dgra bgegs gdul ba/ bar gcod bgegs dpung gzhes pa/ ba ling gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /de'i 'phros las/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs drag sngagasakyi bsnyen pa'i rtags yig /dam can srog 'khor bskor ba/ sde brgyad gnad dbang / mdze gsob/sbyin sreg /rbod gtong bzlog pa/ rang 'khor bsrung ba/ sri'u gso ba/ smyon pa gdul ba/ zho chang bsrung ba/ nag po dgu sbyor mi gcig pa gnyis la brten nas mdze lhog shu 'brum bsrung ba/ zor dang sbyin sreg mnan pa'i las/ thub chod kun dril gyi bzlog pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i drag sngags kyis dgra bgegasathams cad sgrol zhing bzlog pa seng gdong dmar mo'i skor la/ rtsa sgrub/ tshe sgrub/ dbang sdud/ nor sgrub/rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa/ rims bsrung ba/ gshags 'gran pa/ phyogs ngan bdud gcod bsrung ba/mtshon bsrung / 'khrug gral du 'gro ba'i dus na bsrung ba/ gtor ma/ bstod bskul rab 'jigs dur khrod ma rnams/ sngags sdeb kyi lag len snying gi ti ka yongs rdzogs skyin thang dbab pa/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi sgrub pa shi rnye garbha dang slob dpon padma'i thugs kyi brnag pa rnams/ bcu gcig pa chos skyong bstan srung skor la/ sde dpon sum cu sgrub pa'i las byang ngam snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi ngan sngags sgrub pa'i las byang o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa/ mnga' bdag sde dpon sum cu'i bstod bskul rgyas pa dbang phyug ma hā de wa ma/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i phyi sgrub mdos kyi man ngag /phyi sgrub mdos kyi bca' thabs sam mdos byang chen mor grags pa gyer gzhung sogs rgyas pa gtor ma'i bgom/ sde dpon sum cu'i nang sgrub mchod pa gsol da gsang (150na〉skrub srog snying rnams bstan pa las tshogs lnga bcu par grags pa/ sde dpon sum cu'i sgrub gzhung zhes pa'i nang tshan la bdag nyid chen po'i sbyor —217—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheb/ thabs shes/ gnas su 'dug pa/ 'gro ba/ 'thon pa/ 'bod pa/ ma byung bar 'bod pa/ bskyar zhing 'bod pa/ dmigs rten/ lha dang dbral ba/ gshags/ thun/ 'khrul 'khor/ rdzas/ las bkye/dmag mi/ cha gsum du bgo ba/ gtad/ bro/ spogs pa rnams ston pa/ 'di gsan yig gzhan phal cher la mi 'dug kyang rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig na 'dug pas nges gnas so/ /gzhan yang rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po pho nya yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las rnams/ klu bdud nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can mu stegs kyi ngan sngags dbang phyug chen po'i bzlog pa/ dbang phyug chen mo'i bzlog sngags dngos/ u ma'i snying tig dbang phyug ro langs phyin ci log rdo rje dme bzlog rnams kyang thob/ bcu gnyis pa yongs rdzogs rnam gsum la/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs su bskur ba'i dbang chog /tshe sgrub yongs rdzogs/ tshe dbang yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las/bstod pa bas ldan mgon po ma/ la〉med tshe'i bkra brtag pa/ phyi sgrub 'a mi med bdud rtsi yongs rdzogos/nang tshe sgrub kun gyi don bsdus nas bsgrub pa/ gsang sgrub hrī gcig ma/ yang gsang nam mkha' rdo rje/khyung chen gdug pa gdul ba'i rgyud chen/ bya khyung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur/ rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs sgrub pa/ gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las/ nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur rjes gnang zab mo/ nor lha (150bangs rdzogos kyis sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ nor bdag las mkhan dzam dmar gsang ba gsum dril gyi sgrub pa rnams/ bcu gsum pa nyams len lha 'khrid kyi rim pa ni bka' brgyad kyi lha 'khrid bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgom pa'i gnad o rgyan rpā pos phyi rabs kyi don du mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rdzogs rim grol byed kyi skor la/ rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid gzhung ye shes zang thal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam chen mo/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'tshang rgya bar byed pa 'pho ba/ bar do gsum gyi zhal gdams/ rdzogs rim snying tig gi skor la/ sgrol lam gshin rje'i snying tig /gsung mchog padma'i snying tig /thugs mchog yang dag snying tig /bdud rtsi yon tan snying tig /'phrin las phur pa'i snying tig /chags lam ma mo'i snying tig /rig —218

dam pa'i chos kya gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)'dzin bla ma'i snying tig/'jig rten dregs pa'i snying tig/drag sngags dmod pa'i snying tig/spyir dril snying po'i snying tig/gnam zhal don 'khrid zab mo/rtsa ba sdong po gyes pa/yal ga smin pa gos bu lta bu'i 'khrid thams cad tshang ba tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du rgyal dbang padmas rgyud las phyung ba/mnga' ris paṇa ོ gyi dgongs gter rang byung rang shar gyi le'u bco lnga pa las phyung ba'i rdzogasarim gyi rgyal po rim lnga gdan gcig ma dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar gyi dbang dang rgyud chen gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/kun bzang che mchog he ru ka/longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma/15na ) rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti/dpal gyi sprul pa rnam brgyad/o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/rgyal sras rnam rgyal mgon po/sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/rigasa'adzin sangs rgyas dpal bzang /sdong gi sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/rje btsun sprul sku chen po legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang po/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na gter ston yab sras nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig ltar na rtsab rgyu'i dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa 'di gtso che bar mdzad do//rgyal sras bsod nams bzang po/grub chen dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/skye med rdo rje grags pa/sngags 'chang sangs rgyas skyabs/'khon ston byams pa dpal bzang /rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man sngar ltar/yang dbang gi brgyud pa ni/gter ston nasathugs sras legs bzang /sngags 'chang lha dpal bzang po/grub chen don grub rin cen/de gnyis ka la bla ma dkon cog blo gros/de la se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/mnyam med spyan tshab chen po/nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal man gong ltar ro//tshe dbang yongs rdzogs khyung rsā yongs rdzogs/nor lha yongs rdzogs gsum gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/sngags 'amang chos rgyal bsod nams yan /nga /ra la/de nas thugs sras chos skyong bsod nams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bkra shis/gnubs chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho/15bab ba mchog tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mas/zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/drin can chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na bsod nams bkra shis nas/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/skyi ston tshe ring dbang po man gong 'dra/nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams yan gong ltar la/de nas yol mo shākya bzang po/paṇa wo padma dbang rgyal/bla ma don yod bzang po/skyi ston tshe ring dbang po man sngar bzhin no//yang na chos rgyal bsod nams/thugs sras chos skyong bsod namasabakra shis/sngags 'chang ngag dbang rgya mtsho man gong 'dra/gnod sbyin gyi brgyud dang 'phrin las ma gtogos pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/gter ston yab sras nas/zur tsho pa rdor 'amang bsod nams bzang po/gnya' nang pa gu ru dbang phyug mgon po/ban 'brog rdo rje gling pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/bka' brgyad zhal gzigs glo bo dzar pa sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/de sras chos skyong bsod nams/grangasaso sprul sku shākya bzang po/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal mtho'i mtshan can/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/paṇa chen mkhyen rab dbang phyug nas legs ldan rje la brgyud do//gnod sbyin nag/ po'i rgyud dang 'phrin las kyi brgyud pa ni/zur chen ngag dbang phun tsho gos yan yongs rdzogs skor gsum dang 'dra ba la/de nas khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//sprul sku 52na rigs 'dzin chen pos nub zangs mdzod dmar po na spyan drangs pa'i thugasarje chen po 'gro ba kun grol ni grub thabs las/gu ru phyi ltar bsgrubs pa yis rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas par 'gyur gu ru nang ltar bsgrubs pa yis rgyal po'i sku tshe mtha' ru thon gu ru gsang ltar bsgrubs pa yis rgyal po sdug bsngal thams cad bral zhes dang /chos skyong rgyal po'i don phyir du yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bzhag:ces rgya cheX bsngags pa phyi 'gro ba kun grol/nang nyen slongs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)rang grol/ gsang ba chos nyid rang gsal du grags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis gdul bya'i zhing dbang du sdud pa rten 'brel chos bdun gyi nang tshan gyi gdams skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'gro ba kun grol gyi dbang chog gi steng nas mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi phyag len bzhin thugs rje chen po rigs lnga'i dbang / gter gzhung dkyus ltar sku 'bag yig 'bru bum pa lha dbang / lhan thabs su rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bcas pa tshar gcig /gter gzhung sor gnas kyi dbang gcig ste lan gnyis dang / thugs rje chen po'i 'khrid gzhung gsal ba'i sgron me la gzhi byas brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun gyis brgyan te rtsa snang ba blo gsum sbyang ba'i nyams len/ phyi bskyed rim gyi nyams len/ nang rdzogs rim chos nyid rang gsal don gyi nyams len rdzogs pa chen po/ gnas lugs ka dag rig pa gcer mthong gi ngo sprod dang zhar byung 'pho ba'i nyams 'khrid bcas pa smin rgyas su mnos shing / rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ sgrub (152)ba thabs/ sgrub chen/ gshin po rjes 'dzin/rdzogos rim/ rang gzhan phan bde sgrub pa'i las tshogs kyi skor dang drug las/ dang po la/ phyi ltar 'gro ba kun grol gyi rgyud le'u bcu pa gtad rgya dang bcas pa 'di la thog mar rgya skad bod skad shan sbyar med/nang ltar nyon mongs pa dug lnga gnas su dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rang grol chen po'i rgyud le'u drug /gsang ba chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don kun 'dus pa rang gsal ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa rnams/gnyis pa sgrub thabs la/ phyi sgrub yon tan rgyas pa snying po don rgyud kyi sgrub thabs le'u bzhi/ nang nyon mongs rang grol rgyud kyi sgrub thabs/ gsang ba chos nyid rang gsal rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams/ gsum pa sgrub chen la/ sgrub chen las kyi rim pa'i spyi khog chen mo/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/ gter gzhung gi dbang chog /gter gzhung dbang chog la slob ma sta gon/ 'jug pa/rigs lnga'i dbang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin bsnan pa mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi ljags bsgrigs/ mtho zhe rtags yid bzhin nor bu/ thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las/ brgyud 'debs nub phyogs bde ba can ma/ zhing khams yon tan ma zhes pa bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam/ zhi —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsārgyas dbang drag gi las gang byed kyang kha bsgyur chog pa'i sbyin sreg rnams/ bzhi pa gshin po rjes 'dzin la/ gnas lung / zas gtad/ tshe 'das phung po sbyang ba rnams/ lnga pa rdzogs rim la/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / gsol 'debs rigs 'dzin legs ldan rje'i gsung / 'khrid gzhung gsal ba'i sgron me/ 'pho ba rnams/ drug pa rang gzhan gyi phan bde (153na/skrub pa'i las tshogs kyi skor la/ snyan brgyud yi ge med pa zhes pa 'phags pa'i zhal mthong gsung thos pa'i man ngag /snyigasam lnga bdo ba'i dus su bod nang 'brug byed pas de'i tshe zhe sdang gi ngar bsad nas 'thab rtsod zhi byed las sbyor thugs rje rtse gcig ma/ 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa la nang gses kyi ming byang dri ma sogs la brten nas sku'i las sbyor/ thos grol gsung gi las sbyor/ ting 'dzin thugs kyi las spyor/ myong grol yon tan las sbyor/ chu bo la brten pa 'phrin las kyi las sbyor/rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i skye bdun ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ su tsā'i las rim/ thugasarje wo po'i tshe sgrub/ gi dkar thugs kyi sgrub pa o rgyan padmas ratna khros wo gyi rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa rnams thob pa las dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ dge slong nam mkha' snying po/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu tig ba 'a po/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ gangs can sangs rgyas bstan pa/ de sras sangs rgyas byams bzang / mnyam med sangs rgyasadapal bzang / ldong gi sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa/ yol mo shākya bzang po/ paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shisastobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ rdo rje la4 chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na mnyam (153ba thad sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ rje bsod nams bzang po/spyan tshab chos rje/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal man gong 'dra/ gter gzhung sor gnas kyi dbang thob pa'i —222

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabargyud pa ni/ gter ston yan gong ltar la/ rgyal sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ kun spangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ brgyud 'dzin bsod nams mchog bzang / grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ byang sems kun dga' nyi ma/ dran mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ bye tshang pa rin cen dpal 'byor/ rgyal sras sangs rgyas bde chen/ rigs 'dzin padma sangs rgyas/ nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa nyi zla sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud ni/ thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas rigs 'dzin ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ desabadag la'o/ /yang na sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams nas/ grub mchog chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ sngags 'chang gzhen nu stobs ldan/ rje tshe ring dbang po man gong ltar ro/ /rje bka' 'gyur bas mdzad pa ma ga rta gos pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /rje bka' 'gyur pa'i skye bdun ril sgrub ni de nyid la bdag gis mnos so/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos (154na)gter nas bzhes pa'i phur pa lugs gsum gyi nang nas/ brgyud rim las/ phur pa che mchog ces bya ba 'di phur pa kun gyi nang nas zab 'di dang su phrad skal ba can nyams su blangs pas mngon 'tshang rgya 'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po yin 'di ni man ngag nying khu yin 'di ni lung gi bla ma yin dper na yid bzhin nor bu ltar: dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'o: zhes shin tu zab pa lho gser mdzod ser po nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje phur pa che mchog gam phur pa dbu dgu dang lha khra sogs gzhi gcig la mtshan gsum du grags pa'i chos skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du che mchog gi dbang chu rin po che dbang gi mdzod kyi steng nas slob ma'i sta gon/dngos gzhi la bum pa/ rin po che dang padma'i phyag rgya/rdor dril/ rgya gram/ bla ma rigs 'dzin gyi dbang rnams bum pa nas brgyud pa'i nus pa'i dbang lnga/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i gsang dbang /—223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()phan pa'i dbang bcu/lha dbang /drag po'i grol dbang /shes rab ye shes sam sbyor ba'i dbang /bde ba nyams su blang ba bzhi pa'i dbang rnams dang /srid pa phur pa'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi tshe zad pa bsring par byed pa'i tshe dbang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par mnos/grol byed che mchog gi lta 'khrid zab mo nyams 'khrid du bstar nas/rgyab brten lung gi skor la/mi 'gyur thems byang rin cen mdzod kyi thems/thems byang de nyid las/rgyud dang 'phrin las dbang chog gsum rtsa ba yin pas dam par snangs zhes pa rdo rje phur pa'i thugs gsang ba sku'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu pa/'di chos154bslob nyer lnga'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang gcig/'phrin las kyi mtshams gcod bkol ba phur pa'i bka' bsgor grags pa gī la ya'i sngags dang /bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje zer ba yod pa rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/rang byung rang shar las rin po che mdzod kyi 'phrin las chen mo padma bdag gis bsdus te brtsams pa/'dzab bskul chos dbyings pho brang ma/gtso bo dang khro bcu phra thabs kyi bstod pa bskul gru gsum mthing nag ma dngos grub stsal du gsol gyi mtha' can/bskul dam tshig chen mo'i dus la babs dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ga zhes 'gor yod pa khug las shog gi mtha' can/phur srung gi bskul 'gor shwa na mi kha'i dus la babs:sku ni lcags sgrog bsgril ba 'dra:zhes yod pa sman raka sbreng ngo rdzogs0 mtha' can/rin po che dbang gi mdzod rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud nas phyung ba rnams/dkar po lam gyi sgron ma dang :bkari nyan lcags kyi ber na dang :nag po dug gi 'khor lo gsum bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum du gdams zhes pa ltar stod dkar po lam gyi sgron ma la brten nas bla med byang chub bsgrub pa/bar bka' nyan lcags kyi ber na la brten nas dam can gnad la stim pa/smad nag po dug gi 'khor lo la brten nas bsgral ba'i zhing bcu rtsad nas gcod pa rnams/zor dang sbyin sreg mnan gto gsum drag po las kyi 'thud dkar bstan:zhes pas/zor las/sbyin sreg/mnan pa bya ba rnams/tshe sgrub nor sgrub za tsho gis gsum rnal 'byor can la phan phyir bstan zhes pas/phur pa 6lce 'phreng ba'i rgyud ༷sa le'u 155na tshe kho gcig pa tshe'i snying po mchog

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganasbyin pa khol du phyung ba/ rang gzhan gyi tshe zad pa bsring ba'i ched du rdo rje phur pa'i tshe sgrub dbang dang dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa/ phur bu tshe'i las byang / 'di'i rjes su nor sgrub dpe ma wor bsam thob za ba rgyun gyi ting 'dzin/ phur pa'i za tshogs rgyas pa'am phur pa'i zas kyi rnal 'byor slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rnams/ sātstsha brgyud rim zur 'debs gsum 'phrin las phur pa'i kha skong yin zhes pa ltar su tsā'i las rim bdag gzhan byang chub sgrub pa'i don du sātstsha gdab pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ brgyud rim gsang ba rin po che dngos grub blang ba/ zur 'debs la nang gses kyi sku bskyed pa dpal chen che mchog ma/ spyan 'dren srid pa phur bu ma/ bzhugs gsol khro rgyal ma/ phyag srid gsum gdug pa ma/ bstim pa sangs rgyas kun sku ma/ sman raka gtor gsum sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa/ bden pa brjod pa/ bstod pa chos dbyings ma/ rigs 'dzin bskul ba byang chub mchog sems la/dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bskul ba bcom ldan dpal chen ma/ dam can srung ma'i bskul nam srod ma rnams so/ /che mchog gi chos skor 'di la sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug / bkra bzang pa nam mkha' rigs 'dzin gsum gyi gsan yig na drag po dang chos nyid kyi bzlas pa spyod lam rnam brgyad sogs bsnan pa'i mi mthun pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa phyogs 'dir mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yin pas mi 'thad pa ma yin na'ang (155ba)'dir rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig dang bkra bzang pa padma dbang chen gyis mdzad pa'i spyi chings rin cen 'phreng ba gnyis mthun par byung bas de don bzhin bkod pa'o/ /rigs 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub pa las/ byang phyogs lcags mdzod nag po na bla ma khrag 'thung he ru ga drag po'i tshul du sgrub pa yod ces gsungs pa'i phur pa drag sngags sam sbu gri/ lha thams cad sku mdog nag por yod par lha nag tu grags shing / rdo rje phur pa rig pa mchog dang / bi drotta ma la 'bum sde'i yang snying gsang ba drag sngags su bsdebs pabyang lcags mdzod nag po nas btan pas lcags khang mar grags pa ni/ khyad par 'phags pa'i lo rgyus las/ mtha' mi mgon brtson bzo po khyad par can bse sgrom nag po snod kyi khyad par can: bi to —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nem la 'bum sde'i bcud phyung nas man ngag snying dang 'dra ba dril ba 'di srog gi spu gri drag sngagasakhyad par can zhes gu ru padma'i man ngag ches shin tu zab pa'i skor la/ thog mar rdo rje phur pa spu gri nag po gsang ba'i dbang chog dang / der ma 'dus pa rnams tshe mchog gi dbang chog nas kha bskangs te/ sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bgegs 'dul yungs kar gyi dbang / dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i dbang / rig pa'i dbang lnga/ rang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang / sbam phur gyi dbang chog dang / rigasa'adzin brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs dang bcas pa'i gtor dbang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / dur khrod mas brgyad za tshogs kyi dbang / gsang dbang phan pa'i dbang bcu/ sgrol dbang / shes rab me shes tshig dbang dang bcas pa byang (156na)pa rigs 'dzin chen po dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyag len bzhin tshar gcig dang / yang sbu gri'i dbang chog sor gnas thengs gcig ste lan gnyis su thob/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ rdo rje phur pa spu gri nag po rab tu gsang ba'i rgyu'i le'u bcagacig pa/ phur pa drag sngags kyi 'phrin las chen mo sgom don sgrub yig ma drag po'i 'phrin las rdzogs so'i mtha' can/tshogs mchod don bdun ma lhag ma'i mgron bskul dang bcas pa lhag ma'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i 'phrin las 'bring po 'khor gyi lha rnams lus dkyil du bkod pa tshogs mchod dang bcas pa dpal rdo rje phur pa'i 'phrin las rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rigs 'dzin yol mo'i ba'i las byang de 'di la brten pa yin 'dug /phur pa phra phyag dang bcas pa'i bstod pa bskal pa me 'bar ma slob dpon chen po padmas mdzad pa'i rdzogos byang gi mtha' can/ dam can srung ma bcu gnyis rtsa ba gsum du dril te bskul ba dang / gying chen nyi shu rtsa gcig bse lcags dung gsum du dril te/ bskul ba/ bskul bsdus pa rdzogs byang gyi mtha' can/ dam can ma mo'i rkyang bskul 'gor shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas zhes yod pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ phur pa spu gri'i sgo nas gdab las skabs dgos pa gru gsum mthing nag ma phur pa spu gri'i pho nya dgug 'dren gyi las byang rdzogs so'i —226

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamatha' can/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus mdzad pa'i phur pa drag sngags kyi 'phrin lasasgrol (156ba)byed drag po'i rno mtshon/ khams pa shes rab kyis bskul nas des mdzad pa'i phur pa gong khug ma'i bsnyen sgrub byed tshul/ des mdzad pa'i rgyun 'khyer gtor bsngo/ des mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bskal pa'i me dpung / rdo rje phur pa spu gri nag po'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par bi drotta ma la las gsungs pa'i rgyun gtor gyi rim pa/ drag po'i bzlas pa 'phro 'du las kyi bsnyen pa/ gī la ya chos nyid du bzla ba/ bza' ba/ btung ba/ gos/ rgyan/ nyal ba/ldang ba/ 'gro ba/ 'dug pa ste spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor brgyad/ bi drotta ma la 'bum sde'i bcud phyung ba phur pa'i las thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i rtsa ba/ phur pa drag sngags kyi spu gri'i ti ka bse sgrom nag po ma/ 'di'i 'bum thang gi brag rin cen dge gnas su sbas pa rgyal po khri ral pa dang phrad pa'i smon lam btab pa dang bris bshus gcig /gung thang rgyal po'i don du zang zang lha brag tu sbas pa'i khri bkra shis lde dang phrad pa'i smon lam can yin no/ /phur pa srog gi sbu gri/ man ngag 'di dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i phur pa zab chen gyis dril te rgyal po'i sku lus la bcangs pa'i phur pa bka'i sgye chung mar grags/ phur pa zor snod yon bdag gnas sogs kyis khyad par 'phags pa'i lo rgyus/ phur pa'i rgyud man ngag mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa rnams gter kha bdun du sbas pa las phur pa gong khug ma zab pa'i lo rgyus/ phur pa drag sngags kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer byang pa rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi phyag len zhal shes ma 'gor rdo rje phur pa drag sngags kyi sgrub pa nyams su bstar ba la zhes pa dang mjug shis brjod dang bcas (157na)pa skabs dang bstun par bya ba'i mtha' can/ phur pa khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog /phur bzlog dbus phyogs 'khor lo ma/ sde brgyad bsrung zlog spu gri'i sodang 'dra ba/ ser ba'i gdong bzlog sde brgyad kyi kha 'ching yin pas rang gi za kha 'gag par gsungs pa/ rdzas kyi mthu chen bco brgyad/ mtshon 'dra thog 'dra'i man ngag brgya dang brgyad kyi nang nas khol du phyung ba'i ltas ngan gtong ba/ me than/ khang sel/ skye ba go log /skye ba rgyun gcod/ phyugs kyi skye ba rgyun gcod/ zhing —227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesel/ long byed/ gso byed/ 'on byed/ gso byed/ 'khrum byed/ gso byed/ sbos byed/ spyo byed/ zha byed/ mtshan ma skrang byed/ 'byed pa gnyis/ gzer nad kyis 'chi ba/ rengs pa/ sre long la brten nas ltas ngan gtong ba/ mu stegs shrī ral pa can gyi dgra bo gsod pa'i man ngag /mtshan ma dang nu ma skrang par byed pa rnams so/ /rtsa dum las/ rtsa dum yang snying phur pa'i bcud phyung ba 'di ni kun tu gragasapa ma yin pas spel ba'i gnas med sa yi gter du sba zhes o rgyan chen pos g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu mi lo bcu gnyis bar bsgrubs pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa phur pa lha 'dus zhes pa tshan che la sgrub thag myur ba lha thams cad ngo bo gcig tu dril nas bsgrub pas phur pa dril sgrub tu grags pa'i skor la/rdo rje phur pa'i rtsa ba thams cad dril nas nyams su len pa la yang snying dam pa'i mtha' can/ las la sbyar ba'i man ngag shrī sidha'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gtad pa/ mnga' bdag gis slob dpon chen po la rdo rje'i sku 'jigs pa thams cad (157bskong bral bzhin du lcags phur 'di dang mi bral bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa las 'phros te phur pa'i rgyu dang tshad dbyibs gter du sbas tshul bcang thabs mnga' gsol las la sbyor ba'i dus tshod sogs bstan pa byin rlabs nor bu rin chen ltar 'byung ba'i mtha' can/ thugs kyi sgrub pa gsang ba phur gcig ma'i sgrub thabs zhes pa slob dpon shrī sidha sa o rgyan chen po la gdams pa/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu lo bcu gnyis bsgrub pa'i dril sgrub gdams pa'i man ngag rtsa thung yang snying phur pa'i bcud phyung ba/gsang ba phur gcig ma dang rtsa thung 'di gnyis rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig dang bkra bzang pa'i spyi chings su drag sngags kyi chos tshan du bkod pa dang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig na drag sngags dang dril grub kyi skor bsres 'dug cing / rigs 'dzin yol mo ba'i drag sngags kyi las byang yang / spu gri 'bar ba'i las gzhung chung ba sor gnas kyi khro bcu lus la bkod pa sogs nas mkhas grub de rnams kyi gsung tshad mar 'dug na'ang / sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ bkra bzang pa nam mkha' rigs 'dzin gsum gyi gsan —228

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnayig na dril sgrub kyi chos sder 'dug pa las byang rgyas 'bring gi khungs dang brgyud rim so sor dbye ba sogs la dpags na 'thad dam snyam nas de'i rjes su 'brangs te bkod pa yin la/ phyogs 'dir mkhas shing grub brnyes de dag bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mtha' gcig tu 'thad mi 'thad kyi kha tshon ma chod par slar yang mkhas grub kyi sngags 'chang 'dra dang phrad na dpyad par bya'o/ /(15ni)o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu mi lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsgrubs pa'i phur pa gsang ba dril sgrub kyi 'phrin las chen mo/ de'i 'phrin las 'bring po rdo rje ga 'one nu'i 'phrin las khyad par can du gragasapa 'phrin las bsdus pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs la nyams len rgyun 'byer rgyud dang 'phrin las nas bkol ba bdag nyid rdo rje srin po ma/ mtshan brgyad kyi bstod pa la brten nas phur pa bskul ba rnams legs par thob pa las/ phur pa che mchog gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje phag mo/ o rgyan dus gsum sangs rgyas/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gnubs chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/ rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/ se ban nam mkha' rigs 'dzin/ bkra bzang pa thugs mchag 'od 'bar/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na thugs sras nas/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ sprul sku legasaldan rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog legs ldan/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang rigs 'dzin/ se ban nam mkha' rigs 'dzin man gong ltar/ lung gi brgyud pa ni/ sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje nas/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur thams cad mkhyen (158ba)pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na drin can sangasargyas dpal bzang nas/ se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/ spyan tshab mgon po zla ba/ nub dgon pa byamasapa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong bzhin no/ /—229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shetshe dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub dbang po nas/ spang ston dbon po ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /lha 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bkra shis/ gnubs ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ skyi ston chen po/ klu sgrub rje/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o/ /rdzas kyi mthu chen bco brgyad dang mtshon 'dra thog 'dra ma gtogos pa'i phur pa drag sngags kyi dbang chog la che mchog dbang chu nas kha bskangs te spu gri'i dkyil 'khor du thob pa'i dbang dang lung yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po/ smu nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdong gsum pa/lha dbang brgya byin/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ rgyal po dza/ mkhas pa shākya prabha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa nas bzung ste rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje nas chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal la brgyud pa gong ltar/yang na gter ston nas/ rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas byams bzang / sebargya mkhar ba nyi ma bzang po/ se ston mgon po bzang po/ se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /yang spu gri'i dbang dang (159na〉rung brgyud lugs gcig ni nub dgon rje nas/ byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong 'dra/ spu gri'i dbang chog sor gnas steng nas dbang mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas/ ga nubasang ga dbang rgya mtsho la brgyud pa dang / legs ldan rje nas/ dkon cog legs ldan la brgyud pa sor gnas yin no/ /yang lugs gcig la thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas dran mchog nam mkha' bsod nams bkra bzang pa padma dbang chen/ bkra bzang pa tshe dbang rigs 'dzin/ bkra bzang pa nam mkha' rigs 'dzin/ bkra bzang pa gathugs ma chag 'od 'bar man gong 'dra/ rdzas kyi mthu chen bco brgyad dang mtshon 'dra thog 'dra'i lung brgyud ni/ gu ru khrag 'thung nag po/ o rgyan chen po/ lha sras mu khri btsan po/ gter ston rgod ldem yab sras se ston nyi bzang / rtse ston mgon bzang / rtse ston rin rgyan/ zur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ zur bde legs rgyal —230—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamatshan rting ma/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na byams pa chos rgyan nas/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'dar nag rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ des bdag la'o/ /dril sgrub kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ yang sprul shrī sidha/dran mchog o rgyan chen po man chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal brgyud par bzhugs pa'i brgyud tshul lugs gnyis sor gnas so/ /(159brdzing na nub dgon chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang bdag yab sras man sngar bzhin no/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas spyan drangs pa'i mnga' dbang rin po che'i skor ni/ lo rgyus las/ chos skyong rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i mnga' thang rin cen 'bar ba yod ces sogs kyis mnga' dbang gi zhan byung du thugs sgrub kyi nga la'i skor rnams bstan pa'i dngosadon mnga' dbang gi rim pa thob par/ mnga' dbang rin cen 'bar ba'i dbang dang / lung la mnga' thang rin po che'i lo rgyus zhes pa 'di'i brjod don bang mdzod bca' ba/ nyams su len tshul don gsum du bstan pa/ dbang gi bka' babs lo rgyus thems byang lung bstan sku gsung thugs kyi gdul bya zhal chems dang bcas pa sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba/ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi chog: snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag 'di 'byung po gdul byed rgyud las btus: zhes pa'i mnga' dbang rin po che 'bar ba dngosakyi yi ge la phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu btsal ba/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung pa'i rdzas gsag pa/ chos skyong rgyal por mnga' gsol ba dngos te don tshan gsum du bstan pa thang lha la gnyer bcol gyis mthar tshang ba/ rgyud la le'u lnga ru bstan zhes pa 'di'i bshad khungs srog gi snying po btus pa 'byung po gdul byed kyi rgyud la gleng gzhi/ dus dang gza' skar brtsi ba/ srog gi yi ge 'dri ba/ nor bu sngags kyi lesagatad rgya sbas byang bka'i dam bsgrigs dang bcas pa le'u lnga pa/ chos khrims bstan pa'i sgron me le'u bcu gnyis pa/ bsam yas dbu rtser slob dpon chen po la mnga' bdag gis (160na)gser gyi maṇḍal —231 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ri rab gling bzhi la dpe byas pa phul nas zhus pa'i chos skyong rgyal po'i mnga' thang bskyed pa'i lung byang sgrol ( )ma bstan pa'i bar gcod sel thabs rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/shākya thub pa/kun dga' bo/shākya pra bha/yang na dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/gter bdag srid gsum dbang gi rte kyim/o rgyan gyi rgyal po thor cog can/chos rgyal/gter ston rigs 'dzin ོ po/gangasa'acan sangs rgyas bstan pa/rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas byams bzang /rtse ston mgon bzang /rtse ston rin rgyal/byams pa kun dga' don grub bkra bzang pa'i gsan yig na mthu chen rgyal po zer ba snang /sngags 'chang shāka bzang gsang sngags rdo rje/'dzam gling chos grags/gzhen nu stobs ldan/sngagasal4 tshe ring dbang po/klu sgrub rje/zur rpā ngag dbang phun tshogs/khra tshang pa wo po/des bdag la'o//yang na do chen sangs rgyas bstan pa yan gong ltar la/rdo rje dpal/byams pa bshes gnyen/sangs rgyas dpal bzang /thugs sras rin po che/yol mo shāka bzang /rigs 'dzin wo po/rigasa'adzin chos dpal bzang /sngags 'chang kun bzang nyi ma/zur chen ngag dbang phun tsho gos man gong bzhin no//yang na gter ston nas rdo rje mgon po/ngag dbang grags pa/sangs rgyas dpal bzang man 'dra/yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/chos rgyal bsod nams/bsod nams bkra shis/ngag dbang rgya mtsho/tshe ring dbang po man 'dra/lo rgyus dang dbang chog gnyis kyi lung rgyud lugs gcig la rigs160ba 'dzin chen po nas/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigs 'dzin kun bzang nyi ma man gong ltar ro//yang na zur spang ston dbon po/kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//g.yung drung gi rtags ma ga rta gos pa'i dbang lung gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/tshe ring dbang po nas/klu sgrub dbang po/sgon ma mkha' rigs 'dzin/se thugs mchoge 'od 'bar/sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/des bdag la'o//yakṣa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis par sgrub pa bsnyen pa'i yi ge/yas rdo rje dbu nyer gcig/phyag zhe gnyis par sgrub pa sgrub pa'i yi ge/yakṣa rdo rje'i thems byang /gnasachen btsal nas 'dzin pa'i lung bstan rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/rigs lnga/rigs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gsum mgon po/ dbang gi mkha' 'gro/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po/ lha dbang / klu rgyal/ rgyal po dza/ shākya pra bha/ o rgyan yab yum/ sna nam pa/ gter ston/rdo rje mgon po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyasadapal bzang / me ston chen po/ yol mo shāka bzang / legs ldan rje/ bla chen sgro phug pa/ sngags 'chang tshe ring pa/ klu sgrub rje/ spang ston dbon po/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ chos rgyal bsod nams/ chos skyong bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ drang srong dka' bzhi pa'i sras gzhon nu stobs ldan/ sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ rje btsun gshong chen pa/ thugs sras bsam gtan rgyal mtshan/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs man gong bzhin no/(161nasgo gro bo bcu'i dmigs pa dang gdong gcig ma'i dmigs pa la brten nas gdong dmar hor gyi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i lung phyag bzhes thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ legs ldan rje yan gong ltar la/ de nas chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rgyal sras thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ zur thamasacad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /zab mo rten 'brel gyi chos bdun ni/ 'od dpag med la rang snang dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ spyan ras gzigs la gdul bya'i zhing dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ gu ru padma la khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i chos/ khro bo rta mgrin la dregs pa dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ lha chen ma hā de wa la khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ yum u ma de wa la mo brgyud dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ rdza bha la 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dbang du sdud pa'i chos dang bdun yod pa mtha' dag ma thob cing / thos bsam gang byas kyi rim pa ni/ dbang gi sgrub thabs mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu sbas pa'i dbang chen yongs rdzogs kyi thems byang / 'od dpag med ye shes rang gsal gyi sgrub thabs thugs rje chen po'i yi ge bcu pa la brten nas 'gro ba gdul ba me long mthong grol gyi man ngag rnams kyi lung / rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi skor la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang / lung la/ bsam yas brtsig dus lha srin kha langs par gu ru dregs pa kha chings sde brgyad zil gyis mnan pa'i rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud g.yas gzugs khams —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebardeg cing g.yon 'dod khams gnon pa'i sgrub thabs las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dregs pa dbang sdud kyi phrin las/ dbang chog bstod (161ba)pa dbang chen las rngams ma/ sde brgyad gnad 'bebs/ man ngag rtsa ba'i thems byang / cho 'phrul ston pa/ bka' nyan pa/ gang bcol byed pa'i rtags/mtshan ma brtag pa/ dgra la rbad ba/ dam 'gong 'dul ba/ sri'u gsob/ phyag rgya ma 'gugs pa/ tshe 'gugs pa/ zas nor spel ba/ drod tshad/ dpa' bo pho tshogs mo tshogs kyi sgrub pa rnams/ 'od dpag med kyi las mkhan lha chen dbang phyug chen po stobs 'dus nag po'i skor la/ lha chen dbang phyug la nor lha brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ gnyen po stobs kyi sgrub pa zhes pa o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub pa/ nor lha dgu'i phrin las sum cu rtsa gsum ma/ nor lha dgu'i dbang bskur gyi yi ge 'dod khams kyi bdag po dbang phyug chen pos 'od dpag med/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ slob dpon chen po gsum gyi chos srung mdzad pa dang / slob dpon chen pos mu stegs dbang phyug btul ba sogs kyi lo rgyus chen mo rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bsam yas mchims phur slob dpon chen po dang mchims kyi rdo rje spre chung lhan cig tu bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros nas bsnyen sgrub dril ba skyon spong yon tan sogs bstan pa/ ma hā de was thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i rlung zhags la/ srid pa'i mes po bla rdo gtor ma sogs phyi nang gsang gsum du dbye ba'i spyi sgrub/ yab yum gyi 'khor lo rkyang pa/ yab yum gyi 'khor lo sto 'khor ma/ zla gam shog dmar ma/ phur mo'i me'i sbyin sreg 'di'i sngagasa'agor oṃ de wa sha ra zer ba 'dug /rgyal po dbang sdud/ 'di'i sngags(162na)kyi 'gor oṃ dbang phyug lha chen zer ba yod mi brtag thog mar rnga chen brdung ba 'dug yab yum gyi 'khor lo chung ba/ dbang phyug chen po snang ba dbang sdud kyi sngags byang / dbang phyug yab yum gyi srog 'khor/ rgyal po dbang sdud/ 'di yi sngags 'gor tshe rā dza khug zer ba 'dug /seng ge dkar mo'i rdzas thod la brten nas yul khams dbang sdud/ phur mo'i sbyin sreg 'di'i sngags 'gor chad bang phyug chen po zer ba 'dug /rmi ltas/thog mar ri la 'dzeg pa 'dug /pha wang long bu la brten pa'i bla rdo bcang thabs/ 'jig rten dbang —234

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)sdud/ srid pa'i mes po la brten pa'i yul khams dbang sdud/ mchil ba'i klad pa la brten nas btsun mo dbang sdud/ mda' bya rgod ma la brten pa'i dbang sdud/ tsan dan gyi srid mes la brten pa'i bla rdo/dbang gi zhal gdams dang po/ sngags rkang pa thung la sgrub thag nye ba/ sngags ring la dbyings che ba/sngags ring la brten nas khrorme dbang du bsdu ba/ sngags thung la brten nas khrom dbang du bsdu ba/ gnam skabang can gyi brag la sbas pa/ phyi rabs sngags 'chang rnams la zhas chems su bzhag pa'i srid mas sked 'ching ma/ las grub nas rten de gzhan la reg pa'i thabs/ yi ge gcig 'don 'jug gis dbang phyug gtan la dbab pa myur mgyogs sngags kyi sgrub pa/ lha chen gnad la bor ba/ byi ba kha sprod kyi 'khor lo zab mo/ rgyal po bzhi mo blon po rnams dbang du sdud pa/ 'khor lo la brten nas yul khams dbang du sdud pa/ thod pa tshad ldan la brten nas 'dod khams dbang du sdud pa/ gsang ba lag bsgul gyi 'khor lo la brten nas (162ba 'jig rten gyi mi nor longs spyod dbang du bsdu ba/ gsang ba snying bsgul gyi 'khor lo la brten nas mi nor sdud pa/ zangs kyi srid mes la brten nas khrom dbang du bsdu ba/ril bu la brten nas khrom dang bud med dbang du sdud pa/ zas nor ri ltar sprungs pa'i dmigs sngags/lha chen dbang phyug dang mu stegs dbang phyug gi sgrub skor gter du sbas tshul/ rgyal mtshan la brten nas mi nor zas gsum dbang du sdud pa/ sngags kyi thems yig mchims kyis dbri bsnan ma byas par gter du sbas pa rnams rigs 'dzin padma'i bka' nyan 'jig rten dbang phyug gam mu stegs dbang phyug bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi skor la/ gong gnon o rgyan padma'i rjes gnang / mu stegs dbang phyug chen po'i rjes gnang / dbang phyug nor bu bsam 'phel gyi rjes gnang / dbang phyug snang ba dbang sdud kyi rjes gnang / mu stegs dbang phyug mkha' 'gro bzhis bskor ba'i spyi dbang rnams mnos nas/ lung la sngon 'gro rnam gsum gyi byin rlabs zhes pa spyan ras gzigs rta mgrin/ dbang phyug gsum phyi nang gas nga gsum gyi tshul du sgrub pa/ dbang chen mchod pa'i phrin las 'jig rten dbang du bya ba'i thun mong gi dngos grub 'di las myur ba med pa slob dpon chen pos mchims la gsungs pa/ gong gnon dang dbang phyug —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shephyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge dbang gi rdzas dang dus bstan pa'i rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/dbang phyug chen po yang khol gyi sgrub pa gter kha bdun las lha brag gi bse sgrom nas byon pa/ snying byang zhal (163na stan gas skor la phyi nang gsang gsum nor bu bsam 'phel dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa'i zhal khrigs rgya bod gzhan na med pa'i khyad chos/ snying po sngags kyi thems yig rkyang 'ded byas nas 'gugasathabs/ sngags gsum sbrel nas bzla tshul/ gsang ba yang khol gyi sgrub pa'i ril bu rdeg pa'i man ngag /zangs kyi pho tshan klad la bskor nas gzir ba'i man ngag zhal khrigs rdzogos so'i mtha' can/ bla rdo gzung ba gnad kyi man ngag rje padmas mchims kyi rdo rje spre chung la gnang ba'i mtha' can/ bla rdo mal 'og bcug pa'i gnad 'bebs/ nor rdzas mi 'dzad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i thabs/ mi 'du 'phro la tshad na gegasasel bya ba/ rig pa mi gnas pa'am snying mi dga' na gegs sel man ngag snying gi nor bu/ mchims kyi rdo rje sbre chung shin tu dbul ba la gdams pa rdzogs par gnang ba'i lo rgyus/ dbang phyug bsam rgyud du grags pa mjug na padma nga'i dbang phyug thun mong sgrub na 'di las lhag pa med par bstan pa/ gsang ba yang khol gyi zhal gdams slob dpon padma'i bka'/ mtshims kyi rdo rje spre chung gis zhus pa rlung zhags snying byang gi mtha' can/ sngags byang 'phrul gyi zhal khrigs snying gi byang bu bse sgrom du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ sngags thems mchims kyis gsang nas ma thub par rje la gtad pas brtse sgrom du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ gnad kyi ti ka gsal byed dam spogs chog tu grags pa/ u ma de wa'i rlung 'dzin nor bu/ u ma de wa'i dbang sdud yid bzhin nor bu/ 'di'i lo rgyus rgya gar na skar ma tsam (163ba〉ltad kyang man ngag nyi zla tsam las med skad do/ /gzhan yang gter lha nor bdag gi sgrub skor sgrub pa phyi thag sring pa zhal gdams yin zhes pa'i mtha' cad rnams las rta mgrin gyi skor ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ dpal rta mgrin/ o rgyan yab yum/ mchims rdo rje spre chung /gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/ sngags44 rdo rje mgon po/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ drin —236

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rigs 'dzin ngag dbang rgya mtsho/sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rdo rje 44 chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa/ 'khrul zhig dkon cog bzang po/byams pa rin cen rdo rje/ tshe ring dbang po man gong 'dra/ spyan ras gzigs mthong grol gyi brgyud lugasagacig la/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ gzhon nu stobs ldan 'od zer/ tshe ring dbang po man gong bzhin no/ /rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang de'i yi ge phrin las/ pho tsho gis mo tsho gis dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston yab sras nas/ bsod nams bzang po chosakyi rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' grags (164na)pa/ dkon cog blo gros/ blo gros dbang po/ shākya dpal bzang / byams pa chos rgyan/ dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ yol6sprul sku/ ngag dbang phun tshogs/zur thams cad mkhyen pa / des bdag la'o/ /sgrub stod 'phrin las la brten pa'i las tshogos ni/ zur thams cad mkhyen pas yol mo sprul sku dngos la gsan no/ /thun slong rten 'brel sgrig byed lha rnams mnyes par bya ba sangs mchod kyi brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan yab yum/ sna nam pa/ rigs 'dzan yab sras/ rdo rje dpal/ byams pa bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / chos rgyal bsod nams/ yol mo rje/ legs ldan rje/ dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gzhan yang man ngag kha 'thor shing brgyad kyi sgo nasasde brgyad sgrib pa gzugs sgrib pa'i bsrung bar grags pa mjug na khyim du rgyal 'gong chags pa
