'don thabs dang bcas pa'i sgrib shing nag po/ rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ skye ba bdun gyi bar klus mi tshugs pa'i rdzas bsrung mi gtsang ba dang dam sel gyi grib bsrung ba'i man ngag grib bsrung bsam gtan khang bu/ mnga' bdag la klus phul ba'i dregs bcos rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ khrag 'thung nag —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nepo/ o rgyan chen po/ mu khri btsan po/ gter ston yab sras/ se ston nyi bzang / se ston mgon bzang /zur ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ zur bde legs rgyal mtshan rting ma/ bla ma ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /lung bstan dang sbas yul lam yig skor la/ ma 'ongs lung bstan padma'i bskul byang chen po lusakyi gzhung shing 'dra ba bod kyi sngags ban rgyal blon 'bangs rnams kyi ngan spyod dar ba dang de la brten nas sdug bsngal 'byung tshul dang thems byang bdun yod tshul sogs bstan pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i lung byang thems byang bdun pa zhes pa bdud dmag sde dgu g.yo ba'i dus su mi brtag bskul ba'i thems byang /rtsa ba brlag pa'i bdud gsum g.yo ba'i tshe zlog bsgyur bsrung ba'i thems byang / nang 'brug g.yo ba'i tshe btsan sa bsnyen pa'i thems byang / tshe thung bde skyid med pa'i dus 'khor bar skyug log gi thems byang /bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i thems byang / mtha' dmag dang po gsum gyi dus rong sgo bsnyegs nas sgomatshams bzung ba'i thems byang / mtha' dmag chu ltar lug pa'i tshe sbas yul du 'gro don bya ba'i thems byang / ma 'ongs lung bstan gu ru padma'i zhal chems brjod don gyi gtso bor mtha' dmag bzlog thabs rgyas par bstan pa re zhig rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ slob dpon chen po la mnga' bdag gis bstan pa/ dam chos gtsug lag khang / rgyal khrims rnams kyi gnas tshad zhus pa'i lan du skye 'gro rnams kyi ngan spyod la brten nas rgyal khrims chos khrims 'jig pa dang / dusangan nyer brgyad 'char ba dang mtha' dmag bzlog tshul sogs kyi zhal chems rnams spa gro brag dmar khrul khur sku gshegs khar sbas nas smon lam btab pa/ du ru kha'i rgya thems rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis gu ru padma la bsam yas mchims (165na)phur zhus pa/ o rgyan chen pos bod kyi mi rnams mi dga' gsungs nas gsheṭa par brtsams pa'i dus mnga' bdag gis bzhugs par gsol nas gdamasapa brgya rtsa brgyad dang lung bstan che 'bring chung gsum sogs gsungs pa'i dus tshogs mchod brgya rtsa mdzad pa'i tshe mtha' dmag sde dgus bod 'joms pa'i dus 'bros pa'i yul gyi sbas yul rnams don —238

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabasdus te bstan pa le grangs med kyang mjug tu le'u drug pa zer ba yod/ gter chen 'di gdon pa'i dus bod kyi rgyal po dang dge 'dun 'bangs rnams ji ltar 'byung dang bde sdug sogs kyi lung bstan mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa/ zab gter 'di nyid kyis bod la phan pa'i rten 'brel dang dus rtags sogs bstan pa'i lung byang brgyad cu par grags pa/ bod rnams sbas yul du 'gro ba'i dus la babs pa'i lung bstan/ sbas yul spyi'i thems byang zhes pa slob dpon chen po mchims phur ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i skabs mnga' bdag gis bsam yas su spyan drangs nas tshogs brgya mdzad pa'i dus gsungs pa'i sbas yul du 'gro ran pa'i phyi nang gi dus rtags bdud kyi dug mda' bsrung ba dang sbas yul nges par rnyed pa'i thabs sogs bstan pa'i mjug tu o rgyan rgyal po padma ngas: sa rong btsan pa'i yul phran rnams sa btu pa byin brlabs gter chen sbas sgo ba sgo srungs bka' nyan bskos de phyir sbas pa'i yul kun na sgrub gnas re dang gnas chen re bka' rtags yin pas gzhag (165ba)par bya nga yis byin rlabs sgrub gnas su nga yul bu yis 'dzin pa ltar the tshom med par 'dzin du bzhud: skye ba 'di yi phyi ma la nga dang phrad par the tshom med bka' 'di'i dus na bod kyi lasang na gyi:shisang na gri ru 'chi bas lung 'di nyon: zhes sogs yod pa/ sbas yul 'bras nor ljongs kyi lam yig 'dis gsang ba med byung gi cha lag tu gtogs kyang thob yig tu chos kyi sde tshan du mi 'bri 'dug /le'u drug pa mjug tu chos kyi blon po brgyad kyis lung rtags bka' bgros pa 'phags pa zab mo'i lung bdun par yang grags la/ lha sras mu khri btsan pos slob dpon chen po la rin cen ga'u 'di rnams kyi brda'i ngo bo dpe don zhug pa'i lan sbas yul bdun gyi thems byang the tshom med par rnyed par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/ 'di la yang gsang ba med byung gi lde mig zer/ yul gter du sbas pa skyid mo lung gi kha byang legasapar grub pa'i mtha' can/ sbas yul skyid mo lung ngam gung thang skyid du grags pa'i lam byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mchims phu brag dmar la rgyal po'i bla gter sbas pa'i tshe gu ru chen por mnga' bdag gis zhus pa'i sbas yul skyid mo lung gi snying byang bstan ma bstoganyis dang / gnyan chen thang lha la bcol —239—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheba'i mtha' can/ skyid kyi yul gyi nang sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ skyid mo lung gi lde mig gsal ba'i sgron me/ 'di'i mthug na kha byang rdzogs zer ba yod kyang brjod don la gong ma dang mi 'dra ba skyid yul dpal gyi lung sgron 'byed ran pa'i dus tshod dang skyid mo lung gi yul gyi gnas tshul ku thang gi yul gyis bskor tshul bshad/ skyid mo lung gi ming (166na)gi rnam grangs bstan pa 'gor slob dpon padmas phyi rabs kyi don du zhes yod pa gzhi bdag ma dga' na rnyed dka'o zhes pa'i mtha' can/ skyid mo lung gi gnas kyi gegs sel ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sgo 'byed par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/ yol mo gangs kyi ra ba'i lung byang snying gi ti ka mdzod gsum gyi gab pa bkrol ba dang bcas pa 'gor spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal ba dang mjug tu lo sum brgya bsring nus par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/ bu li'i gangs dang rong la 'bros sa rtsal ba las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la mnga' bdag btsan pos zhus pa'i bstan pa dang bod kyi dar rgud zab gter ji tsam gyi dus la 'don dang 'don pa'i gang zag de'i tshe rgyal brgyud gang du dar bod kyi bde sdug zhus pa'i lan gsungs pa las 'phros te ri kun tu gzigs kyi lung bstan bod kyi sde khol bur dar ba'i thabs bstan pa'i mtha' can/ gtsang gi stod bde bar byed pa'i gnas ri kun tu gzigs zhes bya ba lung bstan pa'i sa'i gnad/ sgrub pa'i gnad/ las sbyor gyi gnad gsum gyi zhu ba zhus lan zangs mdzod dmar por sbas shing thang lhar bcol ba'i mtha' can/ mnga' bdag gis o rgyan chen por gser gyi pa tra bdun phul nas zhus pa'i ri kun tu gzigs kyi sa gnad dang gang zag gi gnad tig gi man ngag thams cad rgyas par bstan pa'i lung gi sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ sbas yul mkhan pa lung gi thems byang dkar chag yi ger thob las shog gi mtha' can/ slob dpon chen po la rgyal pos za 'og (166ba)yug gzhig phul nas zhus pa'i rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung gi phyogs mtshams 'gro ba'i dus tshod 'gro ba'i thabs rnams ston pa'i lam byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos 'bras gshong gnas sgo phye ba'i gnas kyi yon tan yongs su bstan pa rdo rje thod pa rtsal gyis kha ba —240

dam pa'i cho nga kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnacan ljongs pa rnams la springs yig btang ba/ rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis chu mo glang gi lo 'bras mo ljongs nas btang ba'i springs yig rnams thob pa las bskul byang chen mo dang thems byang bdun pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan yab yum/ mnga' bdag yab sras/ gter ston chen po/rdo rje mgon po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rigs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub/yol mo shāka bzang / legs ldan rje/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ ngag gi dbang po/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /padma'i zhal chems man chad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ thugs sras rin po che/ gnubs chen/ skyi ston chen po/ klu sgrub rje/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /chos skyong gi skor la/ bka' brgyad kyi bka' srung mgon po bstan srung dregs pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang chog la brten nas/ bum gsang shes rab ye shes tshig dbang dang bcas pa'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ gtor ma la brten pa'i gzi brdzid stobs kyi dbang / mtha' rten dam bsgrag /phyag mtshan gtod pa sogs mtshan ldan byams pa bshes (167na)gnyen gyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin mnos/ lung la/ dpal ldan mgon po bstan srung dregs pa yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ dpal ldan mgon po bstan bsrung yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs dpal ldan ye shes mgon po bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las/ dpal ldan mgon po bstan srung dregs pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang chog /dbang gi zin tho sngags 'chang rdo rje'i mtshan can gyi phyag len/ byams pa bshes gnyen gyis bkod pa/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi bskang bshags dgongs shig ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/sgrub chen bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi bskul gyi rim pa ma g.yel ma dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod kyi mtha' can/ bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi srung bskul bsdus pa mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi bla rdo srog 'khor gser chos su bslus na zhu ba'i mtha' can/ chos skyong —241 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (shebastan srung yongs rdzogs kyi sbyin sreg/chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi gdab las kyi rim pa dus gsum ma mjug tu mnan pa bya tshul dang bcas thob pa las dbang gi brgyud pa ni/kun bzang he ru ka/zhi khro rab 'byams/phyag na rdo rje/dbang gi mkha' 'gro/rgyal sras in dra bhū ti/sprul sku grub ོ brgyad/o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/sprul sku rigs 'dzin yab sras/sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/mas ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/ 67basnran can sangs rgyasadapal bzang /glo bo dzar pa sngags lang chos rgyal bgo nams/de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkrashis/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/rigs 'dzin kun bzang nyi ma/zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o/yang na chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis nas/ga nubs rsā ngag dbang rgya mtsho/skyi sku tshe ring dbang po/rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/zur mu ngag dbang phun tsho gis man gong bzhin no//dbang chog zin tho/sgrub thabs gsum ma gtogs pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/gto ra yab sras nas/rdor 'tsho bgo nams bzang po/gu ru dbang phyug mgon po/ban 'grog rdor gling pa rdo rje rgyal mas/sngags 'amang chos rgyal bsod nams nas/bla ma ngag dbang phun tsho gis yan gong ltar la/thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//gong gi dmigasabasal gsum po'i lung ni khra tshang pa chen pos bla ma ngag dbang phun tsho gos la gsan no//'phrin lasadang bskang bshags lugs gcig/legs ldan rje nas/dbang po'i sde/ngag gi dbang po/kun mkhyen chos dbying rang grol/des bdag la'o// 4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung dpal mgon legs ldan nag po stag gzhon lcags khrab can gyi skor sogs/sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob nas/ lung la/ mgon po nag po gsang ba thugs kyi spu gri'i rgyud le'u bcu pa/ lo rgyus/ rjes gnang gi yi ge sgrub thabs kyi thems byang / mgon po nag po las kyi (168ba/bro bo spu gri nag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs sam gsang ba ging gi sgrub pa/spogs chog /drag po thun gyi 'khor lo/ dpal ldan mgon po'i sgrub thabs zhes pa stag zhen gyi sgrub thabs chig dril sngags kyi don bstod dang bcas pa/ dpal mgon po'i 'phrin las gsang ba'i las byang du grags pa/ dpal mgon po'i phrin las bsdus pa bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ dpal ldan mgon po'i bskang bshags rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mchod 'phreng legs ldan nag po ma/ legs ldan nag po'i dgra bo sgrol ba'i las sbyor/ mon nag mched gsum gyi sgrub pa/ stag ga chen gyi bskul chos skyong mgon po ma rnams legs par thob pa la rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ dpal rdo rje gzhen nu/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon shinti garbha/ dran mchog o rgyan yab yum/ rdo rje bdud 'joms/rigs 'dzin chen po/rdo rje mgon po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs srasarin cen/ gnubs chen ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ rje klu sgrub pa/ bkra bzang pa thugs mchog 'od 'bar/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor benda la'o/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje klu sgrub pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /chos sde spyi dang khyad par rdzogs chen zang thal gyi bka'i srung ma dpal sngags kyi bdag mo e ka dza ṭi'i skor la/ gtor ma la brten pa'i rjes gnang / gtor ma/ phyag mtshan/ rakta/ bla rdo/ sku gzugs/ bka' gtad bzlas lung la brten pa'i e ka dza ṭi'i srog dbang ngam rjes gnang bar ma/ gtor ma la brten —243—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenas rigs gtad cing dam bsre ba thob nas/lung la/e ka dza ṭi gsang 168bab yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud le'u dgu pa/rdzogs chen sku gsum gyi dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge/e ka dza ṭi'i rjes gnang bar ma dang kun bzang yab yum gyi dbang gi yi ge/e ka dza ṭi gsang ba yang snying 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mjug na mtshan gyi rnam grangs/dus bzhin gnas tshul/mkha' bzhi dbyings lnga sogs bstan pa/gtor 'bul ma kun tu bzang po ma/bstod pa bskal me ma dang bcas pa/e ka dza ṭi gsang ba yang snying 'dus pa'i 'phrin las bskul phyogs phyogs ma dang bcas pa/bka' srung chen mo'i bskangs bshags dgongs shig ma/bka' srung chen mo'i mdos dbus kyi brtse mkhar ma/sbyin sreg/zor/mnan gtad/smug nag 'bar ma'i phan gnod las phran gsol kha mchod bstod la brten nas kha bsgyur chog pa dang bcas pa thob pa'i rigs gtad lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/rigs lnga zhi khro/rdo rje lang/rdo rje sems dpa'/dga' wo rdo rje/'jam dpal bzhes ga/shrī sidha/o rgyan chen po/bi mā la/bee ro tsa na/khri srong lde btsan/mkhar chen bza'/sna nam pa/gter ston/rdo rje'i mtshan can/ngag dbang grags pa/sangs rgyas dpal bzang /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/legasaldan rje/dbang po'i sde/ngag gi dbang po/tso mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang na gter ston nas/sangs rgyas byams bzang /se ston wo po/spyan tshab rje/nub dgon pa/chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong bawo no//rjes gnang dang thog gto gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/sangs 169na ) rgyas dpal bzang yan gong ltar la/de nas chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras gnyis/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje lang mgon po bsod nams ma ma ldan/drin tso chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras gnyis/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man gong dang 'dra/dur khrod ma gsum gyi gsol kha dur khrod 0 mo ma/ri ma ti'i gsol kha phyogasaphyogs ma gnyis kyi lung brgyud ni/chos rgyal daX po'i sde bzhugs pa'i e ka dza ṭi'i brgyud pa bzhin

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganano//dur khrod ma gsum gyi gsol mchod kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/gter ston nas/dpang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan/rtse ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/spyan tshab mgon po zla ba/nub dgon byams pa chosargyan/chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can man sngar dang 'dra/gter bdag skor la/shar dung mdzod kyi gter srung bstan ma brgya gnyis kyi skor ni/gter bdag bstan ma brgya gnyis mchode pa'i lo rgyus/skyin mthing gangs sman dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/skyin mthing ma dam la brtags pa'i sgrub thabs/ltasang na cho 'phrulagatong ba drag sngags kyi thems dang bcas pa/gter srung bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod pa'i phrin las nga ni pad 'byung ma/gsang sgrub chen po'i bstan pa'i las lde/bstan pa bcu gnyis kyi sgos mdos rnams thob pa'i sgos mdos ma gtogos pa'i brgyud pa ni/69ba ) phyag na rdo rje/o rgyan wo po/mnga' bdag rje/gter ston chen po/sngags 'chang rdor mgon/ngag dbang grags pa/sangs rgyas dpal bzang /chos rgyal bso de nams/chos stong bsod nams bkra shis/tshar wo chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/byams pa skal bzang /rdo rje 'cha dbang rab/sngags 'cha tshe ring dbang po/klu sgrub chos rgyan/spang dbon ngag dbang phun tshogs/khyab bdag khra tshang pa/des bdag la'o//mdosani/byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po la kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyis gsan zhing gsol mchod nga ni pad 'byung ma yang gsan pa byang bdag brgyud par bzhugs pa'i e ka dza ṭi ltar dang yang brgyud lugs gcig ni/gter ston nas/spang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan/se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan/mgon po zla ba/mnyam med nub dgon pa/chos rgyal ma rgo'i mtshan can man gong bzhin nor/lto gser mdzod ser po'i gter srung ging wo rdo rje legs pa'i skor la/sku gzugs/bla rdo/phyag mas/gtor ma la brten pa'i srog dbang mnos nas/lung la/srog gzer nag po sbu gri'i 'khor lo ging gi gsang rgyud le'u drug pa/ging chen rgyal blon lnga'i sgrub pa drag sngags su sgrub thabs man ngag khrigs chug zin pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/rjes gnang gi rim pa bstan pa'i yi ge/bla rdo bca' ba'i man ngag/dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa'i nor sgrub mngon shes sgrub ༷ snang srid gsal ba'i me long /mngon shes gto

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nel 'bebs pa rgya'i gsang sgrub bam rdo rje legs pa'i mig mthong / gri khrag gri snying la (170na tha rten pa'i mngon shes sgrub pa/ rdo rje legs pa dkar po dung gi mi chung bdun gyis bskor ba'i mngon shes sgrub pa/ mngal khrag 'dzag thabs/rdo rje legs pa gsang ba btsun thabs kyi sgrub pa/ bstod pa khamasagasum ma/ slo bur las bcol/ thems sbyor bdun pa zhes pa gsang ba'i yang snying rdo rje legs pa gsang ba ging gi snying po'am sgrub pa/ sha za gri thogs/ ging chen bshan pa gri thogs/ ging chen rdo rje legs pa'i man ngag mthar thug /gsol kha dam can rdor legs ma/ dam can mgar ba nag po bskul ba'i pho nya ma g.yel ma/ dam can gyi gsol kha hūṃ ka ra/ gu ru padma bho dhi satwa gsum gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i dam bsgrags dang bcas te spyan 'dren pa/ gsol mchod phyag rdor ma/ rdo rje legs pa'i bskang mdos kyi mdos byang gu ru padmas mdzad pa rnams thob pa las gsol mchod phyag rdor ma ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ o rgyan chen po/ chos rgyal/ rigs 'dzin chen po/rdo rje mgon po/ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ldong chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras gnyis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol mchod phyag rdor ma'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal bzhugs pa'i a ka dza ṭi'i brgyud pa bzhin dang / yang na gter ston nas/ spang ston rje/ se ston chen po/ spyan tshab rje/ mnyam (170ba thad chen po/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong dang 'dra/ nub zangs mdzod kyi gter srung dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa'am gnyan chen thang lha'i skor la sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dam bsre ba dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ gnyan chen thang lha dang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan smon lam dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus/ gnyan chen thang lha'i phyi sgrub bam srog sgrub tu grags pa/ lha g.yag dkar po la brten nas spyo 'dul rgod kyi 'grims shul mjug tu zangs mdzod kyi srung mar bskos tshul/ slob dpon chen po la gnyan chen thang lhas srog snying phul ba'i —246

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yag gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnalo rgyus las 'phros te mdzad pa dri za zur phud lnga pa'i mchod sprin ye shes gzhal yas ma/slob dpon chen pos gnyan chen thang lha dang mnga' bdag gnyis lhan cig par rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sogs gsang sgrub kyi lo rgyus/sgrub rdzas bshams pa/rjes gnang gi yi gegasang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs gtor bsngo/bstod pa dpal ldan lha yi lha mchog ma/las chags yang gsang snying sgrub skor la/pe har gyis bod phung ba'i dus de'i gnyen po yin tshul dang bcas nas dngos grub thams cad yid bzhin du 'byung thabs/sde brgyad dang smyo 'dre gdul ba/nad yams dang rims bsrung ba/nor longs spyod rgyas byed/las kyi phyag rgya dbang du bsdu ba/dgra bo 'joms shing g.yul las rgyal thabs/tshe sgrub/mthu gtad byur phung sogs bzlog thabs/srid dang rigs brgyud spel ba/thog ser chu 'od gtong ba/gtad khram bcas chog nag po/log lta 'gran sems can zil 71na ) gyis gnon cing snyan grags dang 'phrin las spel ba/rten gtor bla rdo bca' ba/pra brtag/rgyal gzer dang gnam dgra bsrung ba/las kun sgrub pa la nye bar mkho ba dus gtor mnga' gsol gyi phrin las sngon tshe ka dag ma/zab chos 'di nyid chog brgyud las mang por mi spel ba'i bka' rgya gsang sgrub las tshogosardzogs so'i mtha' can/gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso bod yul phyogs bzhi ma/rigs 'dzin yol mo bas mdzad pa'i thang lha'i mchod sprin yid bzhin sprin phung des mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol yid bzhin rgyal mtshan rnams thob pa las rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/phyag na rdo rje/o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/paṇa chen pi5la/bee ro tsa na/khri srong ldebatsan/5khri bsdo po/mkhar chen bza'/gter ston yab sras/sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis/drin can sangs rgyasadapal bzang /sdong ston chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/'phags mchoge byams pa skal bzang /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje 'am pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//yang na gter ston yab sras nas/bsod nams bzang po/dbaX phyug mgon po/dpal ldan bzang po/bde legs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyal mtshan/chos rgyal bso de nams ma na 'dra/yang na chos rgyal bsod nams nas/sprul sku shāka bzang /chos skyong bsod nams man 'dra/yang na chos skyong bsod nams nas/sprul sku shāka bzang /chos skyong bsod nams man 'dra/yang na chos skyong bsod nams nas tshar chen 71ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse man gong bzhin no//lung gi brgyud pa ni/gter ston yab sras nas rdor 'chang bsod nams bzang po/mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/dpal ldan nam mkha' grags pa/rje dkon cog blo gros/rje blo gros dbang po/rje shākya dpal bzang /nub dgon pa byams pa chos rgyan/dpal bkra shis stobasargyal/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/gter ston yol mo ba chen po/zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag la'o//yang na gter ston nas/dbon rdo rje dpal/chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba/rje chos dpala'abyor/mtshungs med rin cen gzhon nu/sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/lha btsun bdud 'joms rdo rje/chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong 'dra/yang na drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang yan rjes gnang ltar la/de nas thugs sras rin po che/sngags 'chang shāka bzang man gong bzhin no//dbang gis ma mo bdun gyi gsol kha dmar nag ma'i brgyud pa yang chos rgyal dbang po'i sde bzhugs pa'i e ka dza ḍi'i brgyud pa ltar ro//byang lcags mdzod nag po'i bka' srung srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po'am legs ldan nag po dang stong dpon du grags pa don du pe ko rgyal po la ngos 'dzin pa 'di'i skor la/li yul lcang ra smug po nas srung ma spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus/srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/bstod bskul steng phyogs rnam dag 'phul gzhal ma/'khor lo'i bri yig/mchod 'phreng steng phyogs snang 'od ma rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/gsang bdag/padma 'byung gnas/mnga' bdag yab sras/gter ston chen po/bsam gling pa 72na skom mkha' bsod nams/zhal phu ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rin cen nam mkha' rdo rje/grub mchog ngag dbang chos rgyal/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/'khon ston kun dga' bsod nams/de sras bsod nams dbang phyug/khyab bdag zha lu ba rin cen bsod namasamachog grub/des bdag la'o// 48

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)chos sde spyi'i srung ma bkra bzang zhing skyong gi gsol mchod yul ming bod yul ma'i brgyud pa ni legs ldan rje brgyud par bzhugs pa'i thugs sgrub drag po rtsal bzhin no/ /srog bdag yam shud dmar po ni gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i yab mes kyi chos srung yin pas gter srung gi khrod du mchod pa'i gsol mchod srog gi mnga' bdag gi lung rgyun ni/ gter ston nas zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi bar chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal bzhugs pa'i e ka dza ṭi'i brgyud pa dang gcig /'di'i chos skor ni sprul sku rgya zhang gi gter ma yin pas gang thob rnams de skor gyi thob yig na gsal lo/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyis bsam yas rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i dug dbang rdo rje'i pha lam lcags yos hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi dgongs ja snga bsu'i dus dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung rab gsal du tshar gsum dang / chu rta hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes la gzims chung mgon khang du lan cig rnams thob pa'i dbang dang / de'i dbang chog lag tu blang ba'i rim pa snyan brgyud yi ge med pa la byang ri khrod dgon par zhang sher (172ba tsher bum gyis yi ger btab pa/ lag len go bde bar bsdus pa dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shrī gung lang / o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ gter ston rigs 'dzin rgod ldem/zhang shes rab 'bum/ brag lung rtogs ldan gzhen nu rin cen/ brag lung pa sems dpa' chen po rin cen dpal bzang / mkhan chen byams pa rin cen/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge /'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ brang ti stas rgyal rdo rje/ chosarje bsod nams seng ge /gnubs nyi zla grags pa/ thugs sras blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na zhang sher 'bum nas/ slob dpon rang byung rgyal po/ rdo rje rang rig rgyal po/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dbu mdzad bkra shis bzang po/—249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()slob dpon tsitta shrī bha dra/sems dpa' chen po brag dkar ba/mkhan chen gtsug gi nor bu/bya btang grags pa rgyal mtshan/gnubs ston nyi zla grags pa/byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan man gong ltar/yang na sems dpa' chen po brag dkar ba nas/brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/gnubs ston yab/gdung sras nyi zla ba/byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin/sprul sku gter ston rgod kyi ldem phru can sna mo lung gi gzims khang du mnal ba'i tshul 173na ) gyis snang la rigs 'dzin chen po lngas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe gur sbrags ma'i dbang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi ljags bsgrigs ma dang phyag len gsal 'debs gnyis kyi steng nas legs par mnos shing /ljags bsgrigs dbang chog 'gro mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'chi med rgya mtsho'i dpal byin dang phyag len dran pa'i gsol 'debs bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun bzang yab yum/longs sku zhi khro yab yum/sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/lha lcam manda ra ba/mkha' 'gro ye shesamatsho rgyal/gter ston rigs 'dzin yab sras/mtshan ldan sprul pa'i yum chen/byang sems dge ba'i blo gros/grub rṣa ma brtson 'grus bzang mo/dran mchog dpal ldan blo gros/khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs rgyal/thugs sras rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/bka' drin mtshungs med chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o// brda don lam zab padma'i snying gtam dngos grub byin 'bebs rgod ldem thugs tig tu grags pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/o rgyan ོ po/rigs 'dzin rgod ldem/sras rnam rgyal mgon po/dbon rdo rje dpal/sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/rigs 'dzin ngag dbang grags pa/rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang /me ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/khri thong rnam sprul dbang po'i sde/rigs 'dzin ོ po ngag gi dbang po/rdo rje la yo chos dbyings173ba'ang grol/desabadag za sto bande la'o// 0

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gter ston ba mkhal smug po'i gter byon bar chad lam sel dang slob dpo no chen po mngal skyes kyi rnam thar gnyis kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ jo mo mtsho rgyal/ gter ston nas rim par chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ sprul sku padma phrin las/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi sku'i skye ba dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs bla ma gnas rnying gi grwa sar bzhugs skabs nyang stod khro sgang du chos 'khor la phebs te gtsug lag gi 'gram gseb tu so phag chen po 'dug par pha gi gcog rgyu byung na dgongs te/ grwa pa gzhan rnams med shul du so phag bcag pas nang nas shog ser zhig rnyed par brten nas/ sgrol byed nag po'i mkhar gsang mdzod mkha' 'gro phug nas spyan drangs pa'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub skor la/ las byang rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa dang dbang chog rjes gnang gi yi ge'i steng nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du gsol btab bgegs skrod byin 'bebs sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor mas lus sprul skur byin gyis brlab pa/ bdud rtsis ngag longs skur byin gyis brlab pa/ me long gis sems chos skur byin gyis brlab pa/ gsum gyis zung 'jug dbyer med du byin gyis brlab pa rnams kyi rtsal dbang / me long / dril bu/ shel/ mda' gzhu rnams kyi rjes gnang / dngos grub blang ba bcas pa mnos nas/ lung la/ lo rgyus/ chos la ras gtsod kyi nyes sel/dbang sgrub/ kha (174na〉skong bkol byang / gter srung dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub gter nas spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus/ gnyis pa chos la ras gcod kyi nyes sel ni/ sgrub lung yi dam lha la blang ba'i man ngag khyad par can o rgyan padmas mdzad pa/ gsum pa dbang sgrub la/ rtsa gsum gsol 'debasamakha' spyod rigs 'dzin ma/ dbang chog rjes gnang gi yi ge rtsa gsum dril nas sgrub pa rig pa rtsal gyi dbang o rgyan chen po'i gsung bzhin mkhar chen bzas yi ger bkod pa/ 'di nang sgrub tu ngos 'dzin pa bog pa'ang dpyad/ bla ma phyi sgrub sprul sku sku rdo rje'i las byang rigs 'dzin gtso bo mkha' 'gro 'dus pa/bla ma sku gsung rdo rje 'phrin las kyi las byang mkha' 'gro kun 'dus phyi nang gnyis 'dra sa ba 'dug kyang 'di —251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shel gzhan pa'i nang sgrub gsan yig khungs btsun tshor mi 'dug cing yi ge 'dra ma rnyed/ bla ma gsang sgrub chos sku thugs rje'i las byang rigs 'dzin bla ma 'dus pa/ de kho na ṣka kyi sgrub pa'ang zer/ lam zab mo gu ru ye shes rdo rje rigs 'dzin gyi gsang sgrub bla med bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gsang mchog kun bzang don gyi 'phrin las rnams/ bzhi pa kha skong bkol byang la/ byin dbab bkol ba gnas mchoge o rgyan ma/ bgegs bskrad bkol ba bla ma yi dam ma/ spyan 'dren bkol ba dbus phyogs 'khor lo ma/ gtor byang bkol ba snod kyi 'jig rten ma/ bsgral mchod bkol ba 'jigs tshogs lta 'joms ma/ bstod byang bkol ba yul ming chos dbyings ma/ mar me bkol ba banta rin cen ma/ smon lam bkra shis bkol ba sku bzhi'i dbang phyug ma rnams/ lnga pa gter srung la/ gter (174ba)srung sgrol byed nag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga che mchog bde chen ma/ gter srung gi gtor zor 'phen pa rab 'byams dbyings bzhugs ma rnams thob pa'i dbang lung gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag thugs kyi rdo rje/ yum chen 'di rje mam bu'i gas yig na mi2ga /ye shes mkha' 'gro/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston 'jam dbyangs bla ma/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ gnubs ston rgyal srasapadma/ nam mkha' ngag dbang grags pa/ dge slong bkra shis rnam rgyal/ gzu ston rgyal ba'i sras po/rigs 'dzin padma bdud 'dul/ bla ma chos rgyal rdo rje/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /dbang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter ston nas/ mtshan ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro/ pha rgod chos kyi rgya mtsho/ lce pan rigs 'dzin rdo rje/ lce pan brtan pa rab gsal/ lce chos bzang bkra shis gyo mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen zha lu ba khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ grub brnyes khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na mtshan ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro nas/ sprul sku zil gnon rdo rje/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang phyug /me tshor ba rin cen nam mkha' bzang po/ lce pan brtan pa rab gsal man 'dra/ dbyigasaston gyi chos skor ma thob cing / brag rdo rje tshe brtan gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyis spyan drangs pa'i spos —252

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnadakar la brten pa'i dbang sdud/sbrang rtsi la brten nas smras tshad 75na ) dbang du bya ba'i rgyud pa ni/snang ba mtha' yas/zhi khro rab 'byams/o rgyan chen po/gu ru rin po che ye shes khyung grags yab sras/zur lha shākya bshes gnyen/pha jo ra mo nas rim par brgyud de/rdo rje la yo dpal 'byor lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag la'o//sangs rgyas 'bar dang g.yung ston mgon po rgyal gnyis kyi ga kho chos kyang ma 'tshal lo//gsol 'debs las/ma mo'i mdos sogs mkhas pa'i ra shag gter/zla ba rdo rje badzra ma ti dang /khyung po thig le bal po bha ro ba/shud bu dpal grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs/zhes pa'i ra shag gter ston ni/thang yig las/mchims phu mkho mthing sbas pa'i gter kha 'di zhes dang /ra shag gter ston mdos la mkhas pa 'byung:zhes lung gis zin pa'i 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes kyi skye ba yar 'brog nyan gyi ra shag gter ston chos 'bar ram bsod nams rdo rjes ma mo sgang shar sogs shog ser stag sgrom gang gis mtsho ni pa'i mang du spyan drangs kyang deng sang chos rgyun da rkan par 'dug pas ma rnyed/thugasarje chen po'i thugs mdos ni mnga' bdag gi 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i chos sder bzhugs pas 'dir ma bkod/rang gter du/nag phyogs klu gnyan phra ma la dga' bas dam ldan sngags pa dkar po'i chos skyong la mi bsrung bsam sbyor mdze nad sna tshogs gtong:de dag don du zab khyad gdams pa 'di rdo rje bya khyung klu 'dul nag po'i rgyud gtad bzlog nag po'i rgyud las khol du phyung 0175bzhes pa'i gtad bzlog gi man ngag shin tu zab pa sgo brag rnam snang gdan khra'i 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i gdams pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po/o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/mkha' 'gro ye shesamatsho rgyal/'byog mi dpal gyi ye shes/ra shag gter ston chos 'bar/sras g.yung drung rgyal mtshan nas rim par brgyud de/sngags nag khro rgyal 'bar/nya ri ban grong pa sngags nag gsang sngags rdo rje/gur phug pa tshe mchog rdo rje/mnga' bdag dge 'dun chos grags/zur gyi sngags 'chang bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/yug pa mthu chen nor bu dbang rgyal/de sras mi 'gyur rab brtan dbang po/rigs 'dzin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shengag dbang sri gcod/bya'i sngags 'chang tshe ring rdo rje/gnyos dar sdings pa rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/zur thams cad cho pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//zla ba rdo rje'i gtor chos ma rnyed/rgya gar gter ston badzra ma tis bal yul li shanta nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs chen mkha' slong 'od 'phro'i las tshogs klu dang sa bdag gi gnyen por gyur pa o rgyan chen po sku mdog mthing kha phag nag la chibs pa'i bzlas bsgom dang /sman sngags bsdebs nas rims tre tre ho sogs snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i nad rims rnams bsrung 'chos kyi gdams pa zab mo zhal shes dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/o rgyan dus gsum sangs rgyas/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/gter ston badzra ma ti/gung thang ku mā ra/rlung ban lha lung pa/rigs 'dzin bde chen lhun grub/sngags 'chang bkra shis dpal/byang bdag 176na ti pa la bkra shis stobs rgyal/thugs sras rigs 'dzin 'phrin lasarnam rgyal/rdo rje 'dzin pa rin cen dar rgyas/dran pa nam mkha'i rnam sprul dar sdings 'phrin las lhun grub/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//khyung po thig le/bal po bha ro ba/shud phu dpal gyi grags pa gsum gyi gter chos ni ma 'tshe po lo//gsol 'debasalas/rigs 'dzin padma'i rnam sprul a ti sha/lha btsun byang chub rdor 'od 'brom chos snying /'brog mi lo tsā sgra pa dar ye dang /lha btsun sngon mor grags la gsol ba 'debs/zhes pa'i dpal a ti sha ni/ratna gling pa'i bstan pa spyi lung du/nga yi sprul pa rgyal po dge ba'i sras phal chen sde pa di paṃ kā ra zhes:byang chub sems dpas bod rnams dkar por byed ces slob dpon chen po rang gi sprul par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i mnyam med jo bo chen po lha sar phebs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mi'i gzugs can gyis lung bstan pa ltar ka ba bum pa can gyi gdung 'dom phyed gsum gzhal ba'i sa nas spyan drangs pa'i blon pos bkod pa'i lo rgyus zla ba 'dod 'jo/bas mo bkod pa'i dar dkar gsal ba/bka' chems dngos dang shog dril gsum byung ba'i bka' chems ka bkol ma'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugaXrje wo po/sprul sku srong bzha sgam po/o rgyan

dam pa'i chos kya gsan yog gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)padma 'byung gnas/gter ston di paṃ kā ra/dge bshes rnal 'byor pa/spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/bshes gnyen 176brgya yul ba/'dis mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i bu yig gdung rten dang ma phyi slo 'bur gyi rta mgrin lder sku la bcug skad/de nas rim bzhin rje sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/sangs rgyas bde chen/bye tshang pa rin cen dpal 'byor/padma sangs rgyas/nyi zla sangs rgyas/khyab bdag snang mdzad rdo rje/zur thams cad mkhyen pa/des bdag za hor bande la'o//lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis bsam yas kyi ka ba'i chol nas spyan drangs pa'i mon bu pu tra'i sgrub thabs pod rbad gsad gsum gcig tu dril ba ka bkol mar grags pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje lang /mgon po klu sgrub/o rgyan padma thod phreng rtsal/gter ston lha btsun byang tso 'od/lo wo rin bzang /bla ma brag steng pa/mal lo tsā ba/rje btsun brtse ba chen po/slob dpon rtse mo/rje btsun grags pa/chos rje sa paṇa/'phags pa rin po che/dam pa kun dga' grags/bla ma bdag nyid chen po/bzhi thog mkhas btsun smyon pa/chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/padma'i rnam sprul nam mkha' rgyal mas/rdo rje lang blo gros rgyal mas/rje rdo ring pa wo po/tshar pa rdo rje 'chang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za sto bande la'o//rdo tre 'od/'brom chos kyi snying po/'brog mi lo tsā ba/sgra pa dar ma ye shes rnams kyi gtor chos ni ma thob/177na sko btsun bu dhi rā dza'i sras lha btsun sngon mos sgrags yang rdzong gsang phug nas lcags stag lo la spyan drangs pa'i nad rims gdug cing shin tu dar na gnon thabs kyi man ngag thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/o rgyan padma thod 'phreng /mnga' bdag khri srong lde bas/gter ston lha bas sngon mo lha dbang rgya mtsho blo gros/de nas rim par brgyud de bla ma ngag dbang phun tshogs/mkhas grub rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/des bdag la'o//gsol 'debs las dregs pa'i bka' babs sum pa byang chub 'od/se ston ring mo kha la me

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ rtoge'abar dang /rgyang grags 'od zer 'od zer ston pa dang /mnga' bdag mol mi chal rnams la ga'i ba 'debs/zhes pa'i sum pa byang chub blo gros ni mdo khams sgang brgyud rnam gsum las dmar khamasalho brgyud sum pa zhes bya ba'i yul du sku 'khrungs pas yul la btags pa sum pa/mtshan dngos byang tso blo gros/bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mas bsod nams rgyal mas du 'bod pa slob dpon 'a po padma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi sprul pa zab gter gyi bdag po bka' babs pas gnod byed dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag pa'i dregs pa nyi shu'i rlung 'khor cha lag dang bcas pa rnams dpal bsam yas kyi gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhabs kyi mthe bong 'og dang yig phran 'ga' zhig gnas de'i dbang phyug chen po'i sku'i dpral ba thugs ka sogs nas zangs sbubs sor bsto snod dang cas spyan drangs pa'i skor la/man ngag zab gnad cha lag tshang ma tshang gi dbang 77bgi brgyud tshul phal cher la yongs su grags pa/zab gnad cha tshang ba chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi bzhed pa/shin tu zab myur dregs pa khamasabyon mar grags pa gsum las/yongs grags kyi skor la/'byung ba rlung la las 'chol ba nyams pa tshar gcod pa'i las sbyor dregs pa nyi shu'i rtsa ba gzhung gi sngags byang dregs pa'i mthar thug rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/slob dpon ོ po la mnga' bdag gis bstan srung zhus pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros te zhal gyi gdams pa spyi thems phyag rdor gyi zhabs mthil g.yon par sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba/byang pa'i phyag dper 'dra yī sa da 2ga/man ngag 'di rgyud dgu nas ba yis tshul/byang pa'i phyag dpe'i sa shan nam bam lngo tu gragasa'i sa kha khrug/ltas ga srog gi skru gri zhes bya ba 'khor lo 'dri ba'i dus/'dri bdangos/rdzas/sa gnas/gtor ma/bskor pa/las kyi mtha' sdud pa rnams rsā pa zhal gdam snying lta bu'i mar cha sngags btsun dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/sngags 'go ga 'a phyogs dang bskor lugs kyi zab gnad/ming gi 'don 'jug/skad brtag thabs/bskor ba rnams kyi gnad bstan pa tshig brgyud las mi ston pa'i bka' rgya sbas byang gi mtha' can/dpe rgyun 'dir 'di ga chos 'a sgo ba gcig gi lugs su snyug na4 byang lugs kyi myur mgyogs glon gis4sgyu4'i yigs thos da tho bo/// brgyad kun 'dus srog gi spu gri zhes pa thums

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnashun nam bam log tu grags pa'i zhal gdams rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ byang pa'i phyag dper 'di'i mjug tu gong gi rgyud dgu na bsdu lugs de 'thud 'dug /zhal gdams gab pa mngon (178na)phyung / lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog yig bam log tu 'byung ba rlung la bskor nas dgra bo gri thabs sum brgya drug cus gsod pa thog mnga' rlud the zhe du grags pa/ byang pa'i phyag dper bam log gi sngags rlung chung ba zer mjug nas yig 'phreng gcig tsam zhig ma sgo / steng 'khor tshe bdud mnan pa rlung bskor gyi bkra brtag pa rgyal po shin tu dgyes pa'i mtha' can/rdzogs sog ho byang pa'i phyag dper mi 'dug /dgra la ltas ༅ char du 'bab nges pa'i zhal shes/ 'di byang pa'i phyag dper ba la go non pa'i ma su kan khrug /rlung bskor sgrib shing dang bcas pa las thums shun yan thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'di byang ba'i phyag dper mi bog /rgya gar ram bu gu ya tsand+ra/ bal po bha su dha ra/ o rgyan sangasargyas gnyis pa/ gter ston sum pa byang chub blo gros/ rigs 'dzin ku mā sidha/ gtsang pa legs grub bzang po/ sngags 'chang shes rab dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma chos kyi rin cen/ bla ma sangs rgyas/ rje tra ya bha dra/ bla chen legs pa'i shes rab/ grub chen blo gros/ rigs 'dzin sangasargyas rin cen/ lha rigs 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ gsang bdag rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyung man gyi lung brgyud ni/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gung ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'di'i yig cha dang (178ba)phyag len gyi rgyun 'bri gung chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs nas brgyud pa'i dpe'u ris dbang phyug /drag po sde gsum/ rā hu la/ rdor legs/ bdud nag rang rgyug /mgar ba bya bzhen/mon pa sgo brdung / bshan pa khus 'debs/ rlung nag 'tshub ma/ sha med nag mo/ mon pa khrom rgyug /gnod sbyin srog bdag /ā tsarla srog 'khor/ seng stag spyang gsum/ the'u brang nor snyeg /sngags rgod dug gi lde'u thung / sa srin pho mo/ klu bdud nag po/ rkan ma mgo 'khor/ lkugs pa kha 'tham/ steng 'og —257—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gi 'khor lo/thog mda' rlung shon/sha stan/bam log/thums shun sogs dbe'u ris kyi steng nasaphyag len dmar 'khrid gnam sa bar gsum dkrug pa sogs kyi zhal shes dang bcas thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/rje rin cen phun tshogs/snang gsal ba kun dga' tshe mchog/zur lhun grub rdo rje/zur gzhon nu don grub/de sras chos dbyings rang grol gyis kho bo za sto sngags spyon gyi marsā 4 bto pa yin no/khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i 'khrul sel gnad thems las/dregs pa nyi shu'i rlung 'khor zhes grags pa//gnad zab gdams skor 'di 'don skyes bu ni//byon gnas mdo khams sgang brgyud rnam gsum las//dmar khams lho brgyud sum pa zhes yul ming //dang po rab byung byang chub blo gros dang //bsnyen par rdzogs tshe bsod nams rgyal mas no//padma'i rnam sprul de yis dpal bsam yas//gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhabs kyi mtheb 'og dang //yig phran 'ga' zhig gnas de'i dbang phyug gi/sku yi dpral ba thugs ka'i gsang 179na tshe sgo gas nas/zhes pa ltar/sum pa byang chub blo gros kyi gter ma'i dregs pa nyi shu chos rgyal mtho'i mtshan can gyi phyag len 'khrul med 'di ni/'khrul sel las/dpe rgyun mi gcig sna tsho gis legs par brtag/gcig lam chen mang po'i dgongs pa blangs/dgongs don bsdebs bsnyems rtsa ba'i don ma dor//zhal bzhes yin zhes dngos 'gal ngom pa min/tshig la sbas dkrug spom yor bzhed pa min//yi ge nag po'i thug phrad 'jog pa min/zhabrul med rtogs 'gyur bdag gi bzhed pa 'di//zhes pa'i shin tu dpyad bzod pa'i man ngag gser zhun lta bu la/gter kha 'di la klu gtad tshul bskor ba/byad zlog gshin rje'i rlung bsgor/bshad bya dregs pa'i skor dang gsum yod pa'i phyi ma dregs pa'i chos sde ni/khyad par 'di la rgyud gzhung man ngag gsum zhes pa'i o rgyan chen po rgya gar du 'byon khar mnga' bdag gis gser gyi lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang nas zhus pa'i gleng gzhi dang bcas pa'i rgyud snying po kha bsgyur thugs la gab pa dang mkhyen snang gzigs nas ston pa sa mā ya'i mtha' can/skad shan sbyar 'byung ba rlung la las bcol nas gsad pa'i las rtsa ba gzhung gi sngags byang /༷nga phyug chen po srog gi sregs brdar nas bzung

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnalhags pa kha 'tham gyi 'khor lo bstan pa nyi shu po'i mtha' can/ o rgyan chen pos khrag 'thung nag po la zhus pa'i man ngag me dang 'dra ba'i zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyung logs su gab pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/ bam log che chung glog gi zhags pa gsum/ zhes pa skad shan sbyar ba'i (179ba)sde brgyad srog gi spu gri'i rlung 'khor zhes pa mu stegs spu gri reg gcod nas rten 'brel snying po bzlog pa'i bar gyi rgyud dang dgu'i khungs dang bcas pa'i las mkhan rlung la bcol nas dgra myur du gsad pa'i bam log chen mo mnga' bdag gis rgya nag rgyal po la bskor bas rgya'i grong khyer mang po brlag par brten zab par dgongs te dbang phyug gi dpral bar sbas pa/ skad shan sbyar yod pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog yig bam log tu 'byung ba rlung la bskur nas dgra bo gri 'thab sum brgya drug cus gsad pa'i man ngag ces pa bam log chung ba/ yu mo rgyug 'gyel/ pho rog lding lhung / me kha'i sbrang bu sogasamyur ba'i dper mang dzon pa myur mgyogs glog gi zhags pa zhes yi ṅga lha sngags 'di rtsag kho yi ngu zhin lag kho ston gyi rgyas par mdzad pa 'dra ba'i dogs slong 'brul sel na 'dug /tshad/ bris/ bskor lugs sogs gnad kyi ti ka shin tu gcesang/ rnams/ sha gdan sgab 'dre mnan dang rtags yig gsum/ zhes skad shan sbyar lha srin sde brgyad kyi hre/rdzog bam log tu dgra bo rlung la bskor nas gsod pa sha gdan gyi 'khor lo zhes pa mu khyud gnyis pa'i sdo sngags phreng bris skor bstan pa/ myur mgyogs sgab 'dre mnan pa'i 'khor lo'i gdams pa/ dgra (spru ltas ga char ltar dbab pa 'than srog dril ba'i rlung 'khor gyi thebs zlog rtags yig rnams/ shing bcas sa bon zhal shes lag len thems zhes shing lnga'i bcas kyi ngos 'dzin/ sa bon nyi shu'i zhal the/sa/ myur mgyogs rlung nag 'tshub ma lag tu blang ba'i rim pa'i lag len gyi themasazhes 'then srog sa/tso bor gsal ba spu gri reg gcod rnams/ rang bsrung (180na sgom gsum bod rbad gsad gzhung gsu ma/ dregs pa nyi shu'i bla rdo 'khor lo'i bri yig la brten pa'i rang bsrung / rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rang pa bsrung / phyag rdor 'khor lo'i rang bsrung rnams/ dregs pa nyi shu 'bod pa'i 'gugasapa'i 'phrin lasang ni srid rgyud ma dbang phyug thugs kanas spyan drangs pa/ dregs pa nyi shu bong pa'i 'phrin —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()las sngon bskal ma/dregs pa nyi shus gsod pa'i 'phrin las sngon bskal ma rnams/chu klung bskul pa gnyis dang gnad bkang gsum zhes chu lha'i bskul bdag nyid dpal ldan ma/de'i zhar byung gshin rje chos rgyal dang srin po dha sha ghri ba'i bskul bdag nyid dpal chen ma/rlung lha'i bskul ri rab rṣa mo dang 'jig rten dregs pa ma/lha 'dre'i gnad bkang sngon bskal ma slob dpon padmas mnga' bdag la gdams pa rnams/sgrib 'tshol gnyis dang tsha gsum dpe ris bcas/zhes pa'i dang po ni me rlung gi lhar brten pa'i sgrib shing yin 'dug pa gter kha 'di kha'i lung ma thob cing /phyi ma gnyis ni sngon chad spyod yul du ma gyur bas slar khungs ldan 'dra dang phrad na 'tshol dgos yod/dpe ris la/dbang phyug chen mo/dregs pa sde gsum/rā hu la/dam can/bdud nag rang rgyug/mgar ba bya bshon/mon pa sgo brdung /btsan dmar khu 'debs/mon pa rlung las/sha med ma/mon pa khrom rgyu/gnod sbyin dkor bdag/ā tsarla srog 'khor/seng stag spyang gsum/the'u brang nor bsnyeg/dug gi mde thung /sasrin pho mo/klu bdud pho mo/rkun ma mgo 'khor/lkugs pa kha 'tham/thums shun/glog zhags/rlung lha 180ba〉tho mo/sha gri sha gdan/gshin rje'i ya khebs ma khebs/ling rkyang /sgang 'dre/rang bsrung /sdig pa dmar nag/phyag rdor brda yig nyi shu pa dang bcas pa rnams te/dang po'i yig rnying khungs thub der 'dus la/tshe bdud mnan dang ling yo la sogs pa//mthong thos kyi kyang 'di yi ga kho skor du//mi bzhed sngags nag ral pa can smra'o//zhes yig rnying khungs thub sngar bshad pa kho nar ngos bzung zhing tshe bdud mnan pa sogs 'di'i skor min par gsungs pa ding sang lung rgyun dang chos sder bzhugs shing phyag len du yang mdzad pas dgongs pa can yin nam slar yang dpyad do//'khrul sel thems su mi gsal ba'i chos skor ni/mnga' bdag gis slob dpon chen po la rang la 'jam zhing /dgra la rtsub pa bya sla tshegs chung ba'i rlung 'khor zhig zhus pas rgya gar du bzhud khar ngan sngags thams cad kyi bcud btus nas gnang tshul dang bcas pa'i zhal gdams spyi thems su grags pa/sngags 'chang ratna shwa ras mdzad pa'i ltas ga phyog gi sbu gri don bdun gyis bstan pa/dregs pa'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang mu khyud 60

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaphyi nang gi ka rta drag po gsum dril dang bcas pa med du mi rung ba/ bod rbad gsad gsum gyi sngags byang logs su bkol ba/ liṅka'i lto bar 'dri ba'i sngags rten 'brel bcu gnyis bcas pa mjug na dmod tshig yod pa rlung 'khor rtsa ba'i ling sngags thems yig /bla 'gugs sngags dang gsad sngags hab gsod ma/ sreg thal gyi man ngag /klu bdud kyi sa bon 'dri ba gser srang gi bka' rgya can/ dregs pa nyi tsu'i 'khor lo'i gzugs 'bri tshul dang rdzas kyi khyad par (181na)rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ liṅga la lo skor bcu gnyis kyi kha bsgyur bya tshul/ 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor lo'i zhal gdams rdzas kyi gab yig mthug tu 'byung ba chu la las 'chol zhal gdams rgyab yig gdab pa dang 'than srog la byed pa'i dmod mo bcas pa 'dri bar bya'o'i mtha' can 'than srog so so dang sbrags ma'i dbye ba gab pa gsum gyi 'dri lugs dang bcas pa'i zhal shes tha ram 'phrul gyi lde mig /cho me rgyal ma bla'i mtshan can gyi zhal gdamasazab pa'i mthar thug /de'i phyag bris las byung ba'i lag len brjed tho/ srog rkyang dang sbrags ma'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi khyad par/ sngags 'dren lugs/ phyi blta nang blta'i 'dri lugs/ lha'i thugs srog gi sgom don/ spyi gnad/ lha dbye/ tshon skud 'dren lugs rnams kyi zab gnad ston pa'i zhal shes/ rtsa yig rang 'dra min gyi lha srin sde brgyad kun gyi srog gi spu gri las mkhan rlung la las bcol nas dgra myur du gsad pa'i bam log thums shun gyi zhal gdams/ rtsa yig dang 'dra min yod pa'i dgra bo gri 'thab sum brgya drug cus gsod pa'i bam log chud pa thog mda' rlung zhen gyi gdams pa/ tshe bdud mnan pa'i 'khor lo'i sngags byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sngags 'chang dzñā nas mdzad pa'i sdig pa dmar nag gi bcas la brten nas mi zlog bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i bri yig /brda yig nyi shu'i rjong mkhar 'di dang mi ldan na go med g.yul du 'jug pa lta bu/ dregs pa dam la 'du zhing mi 'da' ba'i gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo bu ma gtogos mi ster ba/ bla rdo bcu bdun gyi ngos 'dzin zhal shes khungs thub ma/dregs pa nyi shu'i man ngag bri ba/ rab (181ba)gnas/ bskor ba gsum bstan pa'i gdams pa gnad yig ma/ dregs pa nyi shu'i gnad kyi man ngag gzer bu bzhi pa sngags kyi nus pa ston pa srog gi snying po —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bskor ba/dregs pa'i jur bzlog pa'i gtor bsngo chos rje dbang chen lhun grub kyis bskul nas mthu ldan dbang po'i zhes mdzad pa dgra 'joms dug gi spu gri sngags nag gi mtshon cha/sngags btsun ratna shwa ras mdzad pa'i bskang ba srid brgyud ma/so so'i srog snying bzla dus/mthun rdzas bsham tshul/dmigasapa'i zab gnad gsum ston pa o rgyan rlung gi shog dril gzhan la mi spel ba gser gyi maṇḍal dang tshogs 'khor med par lung phyag 'khrid mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can/bca' gzhi rnam pa bzhi ru bstan pa'i nang gi bzhi pa gtor ma bzlog pa'i zor 'phen sngon dus ma bsam yas brag dmar gyi gter ma/rigs 'dzin dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i 'khrul sel gnad thems dmar 'khrid rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /gsang ba'i bdag po/rom bu gu tho tsand+ra/bal po bha su dha ra/o rgyan padma thod phreng /jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ga kho ston gsum pa byang tso blo gros/rigs 'dzin gtso nu seng ge/gtsang pa legs grub bzang po/sngags 'chang shes rab dpal/bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/rje chos kyi rin cen/gu ru sangs rgyas/tra ya bha dra/mtshungs med legs pa'i shes rab/grub chen blo gros/sangs rgyas rin cen/'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po thugs rje dbang grub rtsal bla ma ngag dbang don grub rgyal mtshan/khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen 182na ) po/des bdag za hor bande la'o//yang na sum pa byang chub blo gros nas/nyang nyi ma 'od zer/sras mi bskyod rdo rje/bla ma bsod nams seng ge/rje bsod nams 'od zer/gu ru shāka yang ba/bla ma rdo rje 'thum/gu ru rgyal mas rdo rje/bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/rigs 'dzin kun dga' bsod nams/bla ma dge mtshams pa/bla ma tshul khrims seng ge/slob dpon rnam rgyal/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin legs ldan rje man 'dra/yang na sras mi bskyod rdo rje nas gnyos sgrom smo po/gnyos sgom rdo rje/rin rṣa a mas/blo gros seng ge/yon to rdo rje/bla ma pad 'byung /rje rin wo grub/sngags44 bkra shisabazang po/legs ldan rje man gong bzhi no//262

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadregs pa khams byon mar grags pa'i shin tu zab pa rig sngags 'chang phal cher gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i rno myur can gyi skor la/ slob dpon chen po la mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde btsan gyis zhus pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bsam yas phyag rdor gyi zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil du sbas byang gi mthar tshang ba/ mnga' bdag rgyal pos gu ru padma la gser gyi maṇḍal phub tsam gyi steng du g.yu phug ron tsam brgyad kyi tshom bu bkod nas zhug pa'i 'byung ba rlung la las bcol nas nyams pa tshar gcod pa'i gdams pa yang gsang bcud du phyung ba dregs pa nyi shu'i gzhung dngos gser srang re'i bka' rgya can/ myur mgyogs sgab 'dre gnon pa dpe'u ris 'og tu gsal ba'i mtha' can/ myur mgyogs sha stan 'khor lo bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon (182bsko'i mtha' can/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog gi yi ge bam log tu bskor nas dgra bo gri 'thab sum brgya drug cus gsod pa padma'i zab don bsdus pa bka' rgyas btab pa'i mtha' can/ mu stegs yu mo rgyug 'gyel pho rog lding lhung du grags pa nyams pa rlung la bskur nas myur du gsod pa kun la gsang zhing rang nyid la nam dgos pa'i tshe spyad do zhes pa'i mtha' can/ myur mgyogs glog sa sa kyang zer/ 'than gzugs bca' tshul than srog char ltar 'bebs shing bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ zhal gyi gdams pa gnam lcags thog mda'i bsdus don spu gri reg chod khrag sna tshogs tshal bsre dgos so'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo nyi shu'i rdzas kyi man ngag /ming gi 'byin 'jug /rlung khang sgrom shing bca' lugs/rab gnas/ mi zlog pa'i gnad/ las khungs na bya tshul sogs bstan pa rlung nag 'khrug pa 'khor lo chen mo'i man ngag phyogs gcig tu dril nas bris pa sde brgyad dregs pas chad pa chod cig pa'i mtha' can/ rlung 'khor sgrib shing o rgyan padmas mnga' bdag rgyal po la gdams pa/ 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo 'dri tshul mnga' bdag rgyal po la slob dpon gyi gdams te g.yu ru khra 'brug gi phu na gter du sbas pa/lha ling gi lto bar sbyar rgyu'i snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad kyi man ngag sa bon dam pa gu ru padma'i srog thig dregs pa rnams kyi snying khrag dgra bo'i srog gcod par byed pa'i mtshon cha 'khor lo nyi shu pa'i sa bon —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'khor lo nyi shu'i gnad yig khyad par zab pa'i 'khor lo 'di kun la yod pa ma yin pa o rgyan padmas phyi rabs don du lho brag (183na)mkhar chu'i phugs su gter du sbas pa mnga' bdag gis bton pa/ du tri sha mgo can gser srang gang gi bka' rgyas btab pa/ gza' gdong dmar nag gi 'khor lo lo bdun du 'grogs pa'i slob ma snod ldan las mi spel ba'i bka' rgya can/trig dmar nag gi rgyud las btus pa'i gsod byed gnad kyi 'khor lo/ sngags ma tshang ba'i kha skong bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha/ rang gshed dbab pa srog thig dmar nag nyang sras kyis bsam yas mchod rten nag po nas bton pa sa bdag gtad mnan byed pa'i 'khor lo nyang gis bsam yas nas mchod rten nag po nas bton pa/ 'khor lo nyi shu'i myur khyad bshan gri 'bar ba'i gdams pa khol bur sbas pa nyang gis brtan pa/ sde brgyad 'dus pa'i rlung 'khor gyi thums shun sde brgyad srog gi bam log rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rlung 'khor nyi shu brtsig pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa zhan byung du 'khor lo sgrub pa chu dang rlung la bskor ba las mtha' bsdu tshul sogs rlung nag 'khrug pa 'khor lo nyi shu pa'i gzhung man ngag lag len dang bcas pa mnga' bdag nyang gis gter nas gdan drangs pa/ rlung 'khor gyi bkra ltas rmi lam brtag pa rgyal po yang thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i mtha' can/ than ltas char ltar dbab pa dang than srog myur du 'ong ba'i yig chung / mngon rtogs spyan 'dren/ mchod gtor 'phrin bcol/ bskang bstod bskul dang bcas pa tshang ba'i dregs pa'i las byang chos rgyal 'bri gung rin cen phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ dregs pa nyi shu'i sgo nas dgra bo dgug pa'i lcags kyu nga ni srid brgyud ma bsam yas dbang phyug chen po'i thugs(183bskos brta zhe pa'i gter ma/ dregs pa nyi shu'i sngon byung gi dam dar zher pa gtor ma zlog pa ru bstan pa zor du 'phang ba'i man ngag 'jig rten dregs pa'i gdug rtsub dgra la bhyo zlog gi mtha' can/ dpe'u ris la/ rnam 'joms dang snang brgyad kyi 'khor lo/dbang phyug than gyi 'khor lo/ srog gi 'khor lo/ than srog sbrags ma/ dregs pa sde gsum/ rā hu la/dam can/ bdud nag rang rgyug /mgar ba bya zhen/ mon pa sgo brdung / bshan pa khus 'debs/ mon —2yo

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)pa rlung las/sha med/ mon pa khrom rgyug /gnod sbyin dkor bdag /ā tsarla srog 'khor/ho shang nag po/ the'u brang nor snyeg /dug gi mde'u thung / sa srin pho mo/ klu bdud nag po/ gnams go /lkugasapa kha 'tham/ sgab 'dre gnon pa/ sha stan/ thog mang rlung thon/ yu mo rgyug 'gyel/ 'byung bzhi/ gnad yig sha mgo/ gza' gdong / gnad 'khor/ srog thig dmar nag /mnan gtad/ sha gri/ sgrib shing /thums shun dang bcas pa ma bu ngo sprod zab gnad nyams myong du legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dregasapa zil gnon padma thod 'phreng rtsal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ gter ston sum pa byang chub blo gros/ gnubs byang chub rgyal mtshan/ khra tshang pa byang chub 'od zer/ 'ug lung rdo rje dpal ba/ gnubs nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ bla ma nam mkha' 'od zer/ drin can ye shes rgyal mtshan/drin can bsod nams phun tshogs/ sngags 'chang nyi ma 'od zer/ sngags 'chang 'phags pa rgyal po/ bla ma padma dbang phyug /sngags 'chang dkon cog skyabs/ 'bri gung ratna gnyis pa chos kyi grags pa/ bla ma (184na)bsod nams rin cen/ sprul sku dkon cog ngag dbang 'phrin las/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/ des bdag za hor sngags smyon la bstan srung du gnang ngo / /dregs pa'i skor 'di sum pa dang mnga' bdag gnyis ga'i gter kha la yod cing man ngag phran bu ma gtogs zhus dag pher bas man ngag phyogs gcig tu bsdebs dgos pa'i dbang gis mnga' bdag gi gter phran 'dug pa rnams 'di ga'i dkyus su bris pa yin zhing gter kha gong ma'i brgyud lugs mi gcig pa rnams ni de khar yod do/ /se ston ring mo'i gter chos ni ma rnyed/ bal po'i yul gyi tshong 'dus su zangs kyi ga'u nas bla ma khams ston kha la me 'bar gyis spyan drangs pa'i rgyal po sgo gcod kyi bsrung ba shin tu zab pa rā dza rgyu mi nus pa'i gdams pa snying gi khrag lta bu myong grub ma thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugasarje chen po/ padma thod 'phreng / mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston kha la me 'bar nas rim par rigs 'dzin gnam lcags me 'bar/ grub brnyes bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog /pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/—265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shezur chen gzhon nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rgyang grags 'od zer/ 'od zer ston pa/ mnga' bdag mol mi 'khyil rnams kyi gter chos ma 'tshal lo /gsol 'debs las/ stobs ldan bka' babs du gu rin cen seng / /dbu ru lha sa'i ston pa shākya 'od/ /gtsang gi gtsang ring shes rab la stod kyi/ /sprul sku dmar por grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i du gu rin (184brdzing ni spa gor bee ro tsa nas mnga' bdag rje 'bangs la gdams pa/ /bdag gi snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa rnams mkhas pa shrī sidha'i thugs slong dam pa 'di lasacan rgyal blon bcas pa khyed la gtad: bstan no byin no phyi ma'i las can rnams 'di phrad gsang zhing kun la bstan mi rung : ci phyir bdag gzhan thams cad brlag par srid 'di ni dug gi spu gri dag dang mtshungs zhes bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char shin tu zab cing rno ba drag sngags rdo rje gtsug lag gi nang nas kyang 'phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i skor 'di rnams/ e ma ho/ chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang : dpal gyi seng ge la sogs lnga po yis phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gtsug lag khang dag snya bstan pa 'jig dus snyigs ma'i dus su yang : las dang ldan pas rnyed pa'i smon lam thob gtad gnyer cad ma por gyis la gter du sbos kho bo bdag ni da 'gro las kyis bdas 0mo tshab rong sa khyed lnga dag gi zhal bgros zhabs la mgos btud nas sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs gdamasangag gtan par bcangs zhes pa ltar bee ro tsa na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du 'byon khar gdams pa 'di nyid rje 'bangs lnga la gtad nas ma 'ongs bstan pa'i btsas su gter du spos shig par gsungs pa bzhin mnga' bdag rgyal pos byang spra dun rtse'i gtsug lag khang gi byang shar na lo paṇa mkhas pa'i mchod rten yod pa'i bum par sbas pa/ ji skad du/ nam zhig las ldan da lta'i bag chags kyis 'di dang phrad de bstan pa bsrung bar nges su phrad 'di don khong du chud (185na7sa sngon las sad pa'o: de phyir nan tan spyod par smon lam gdab ces pa ltar gter du sbas nas lo nyis brgya skor 'das pa na dbus pa du gu rin cen seng ges bsam yas nas kha byang rnyed de stag lo la gnam lcags rngur mo'i yig chung drag —266

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)po 'phrin las kyi rgyud dang bcas pa byang spra dun rtse'i mchod rten gyi bum pa dang / rgyud snga phyi kun dang de'i sgrub yig bcas pa mchod rten gyi rmang nas spyan drangs pa'i rgyud la le'u dang po gleng gzhi/ gnyis pa slob dpon slob bu brtag pa dang dam tshig /gsum par dbang / bzhi par las gzhung dang gsod pa po'i gang zag /lnga par gsad bya dgra bgegs/ drug par rten rdzas dang bla rdo/ bdun par gnas/ gza' skar/ thebs zlog /brgyad par 'brub khung / 'khor lo liṅga bca' thabs/ dgu par bla rdo/ gzir rdzas/ dus tshodi/ bcu par sngags kyi rgyu/ bcu gcig par shes bya'i sngags/ bcu gnyis par sngags kyi so/ bcu gsum par sngags kyi so kun 'dogs lugs/ bcu bzhi par sngags dang yig 'bru dang srog gi gnas lugs/ bco lnga par 'khor lo dang liṅga rang gnad kyi yi ge dgod lugs/ bcu drug pa bsnyen sngags dang gnod byed dregs pa gzir ba/ bcu bdun par sngags bzla thabs dang ban dgra rang gshed dbab pa/ bco brgyad par rang bzhin drag po btsan thabs dkrug zlog me chu 'gal bas 'ur long / bla 'gugs/ bcu dgu par 'byung lnga'i 'khor lo/ ye shes lha'i gnas tshul lta spyod rigs 'dzin gyi dam bsgrag pa/ nyi shu par 'byung ba'i 'khor lo dang dug lnga gshed du dbab pa/ nyer (185ba)gcig par ting nge 'dzin/ nyer gnyis par sgrub pa spyi'i skya chod/ nyer gsum par bsnyen sgrub drod tshad/ 'jig rten pa'i rtags/ phar zlog cing gnad la 'bebs pa/ tshur gnod pa/ rang dang dam can dang dgra'i bla rtags/ nyer bzhi par lha bskyed pa ting nge 'dzin/ bstod pa bskul/ nyer lnga par phan gnod gnyis kyi mdos/ nyer drug par dregs pa dbugs dbyung ma/ nyer bdun par sbyin sreg /nyer brgyad par zor 'phang ba/ nyer dgu par lha srin yongs la gtad pa/ sum cu par klu la gtad pa/ rjes gcod bsrung ba/ sogacig par mnan gtad kyis dmigs/ soganyis par klu'i rtags mtshan smod tshig /thebs zlog 'byams/ 'gor na gnad 'bebs/ thebs bzlog brdzi pa/ sogasum par 'pho 'jug gnas spor/ so bzhi par phan gnod spyir gces/ sngon 'gro/ dug dbyung / rgyan gdags/ so lnga par phyag cha rang la bskor ba/ gnod byed dregs pa gdul ba/ dgra bo gsad pa/ so drug par yul khams 'joms pa ser —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtorsāb/ so bdun par thog dbab pa/ so brgyad par thog ser spyi'i lo zla dus tshod/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor/rdzas sngags ting 'dzin skya chod/ gta'i 'khor lo zor sgo lam bstan/ thog bsrung / ra rog gdamasapa/ dregs pa gnad dbab/ mdo sbyor tshig bcu sogs thog ser spyi'i gdams pa rnams/ so dgu par ltas pha cho 'phrul dbab pa/ bzhi bcu par thog ser gcod pa/ zhe gcig par snying gzer drag po/ zhe gnyis par srog dmar 'byin/ zhe gsum par gnam lcags jur mo'i spyi thems/ zhe bzhi par mchod rten gyi rdzas/ tshad dang 'khor lo/ tog nang du (186na)chos sku'i rten dang byin rlabs gzungs sngagasagazhug tshul/ zhe lnga par brel longs sku dgod pa/ zhe drug par bum par sprul sku gzhug pa btsan po'i mkhar du gzhug pa bsrung ba'i las/ zhe bdun par ka ṇi la zlog gsad mnan pa dang srog shing phur bu bca' ba/ zhe brgyad par ka ṇi'i dgongs pa bstan pa dang 'dra ba bcu bdun dpe don dang bcas pa/zhe dgu par ka ṇi rab tu gnas pa/ lnga bcu par bsrung zlog gsad mnan bzhi'i sngags dang / de bzhi po'i 'khor lo bri ba/ nga gcig par rang gshed rnam pa drug /nga gnyis par sngags kyi brda sbyor 'phrul yig /rang gshed bris chog /'khon zas bsrung ba/ kho rang la gshed du gtang ba/ 'khor 'das phan gnod thams cad sems su bstan pa/ sems ye nas sku gsum lhun grub tu bstan pa/ nga gsum par lha dang dbye ba/ nga bzhi par dug gsum gyi ngan sngags/ skyes pa dang bud med gsad pa/ chu mig skemasapa/ rmig zlum dang kha dbrag gsod pa sogs las thor bu/ nga lnga par zhi ba'i las/ nga drug par rgyasapa'i mdos/ nga bdun par dbang golas/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi 'phrin las/ 'byung pa lnga'i sogadagasapa/ nga brgyad par bdud kyi skya chod/ gzir ba po/ gzir bya/ gzir byed bstan pa/ de gsum gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa/ nga dgu par gzir byed grogs kyi skya gcod/ drug cu par man ngag spyad pa'i dus bstan pa dang / gang zag blo chung ba la phan gnod bstan pa/ drug sto rtsa gcig par rgyud yongs su gtad pa/ re gnyis par skal ldan la bkas gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang sdong grogs (186ba)bya bar bstan pa/ re gsum par 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang ba dang bcom ldan 'das chos sku'i ngang la sangs rgyas—268

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i le'u rnams dang / dpe'u ris kyi skor la/ stobs ldan drag po'i 'khor los rwa hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ badzra ku mā ra'i tsa kras rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ badzra pā ṇi'i tsakra sa rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ ha ya gi wa'i tsakra sa rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ ya manta ga'i tsakra sa rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ ga ru ḍa'i tsakra sa rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ ye shes kyi rā hu las 'jig rten pa'i rā hu la dbang du bsdu ba/ 'jig rten las kyi rā hu las dregs pa bco brgyad bye brag thams cad gzir te las la bskul ba/ dregs pa bco brgyad kyi thog mar 'chi bdag gshin rje'i 'khor lo rtsibs mchan ma/ las kyi rā hu la'i 'khor lo spyil po bya tshul/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i 'khor lo spyil po bya tshul/ liṅga la yang spyil po dang rtsibs can 'dam kha/ liṅga spyil por bri ba/ khyab byed nam mkha'/ gtor byed rlung / sreg byed me/ rlan byed chu/ gnon byed sa/ 'byung ba so so'i 'khor lo'i rgyab tu 'bri rgyu/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus kyi 'khor lo/ me 'khor chung ba/ chu 'khor chung ba/ tsha ba me/ grang ba chu/ stobs ldan dregs pa gtso 'khor bsnyen sgrub kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'bor/ rten gtor/ bla rdo/ mar gtor/ gto gtor/ sman raka /mdos/ zor/sreg thab/ mnan ling gtad 'khor/ ser ba dbab pa'i 'khor lo/ thog dbab pa'i 'khor lo thog ser ltasang na gsum ga'i ling rkyang / ser ba'i gta' ma'i 'khor lo/ thog gi gta' ma'i 'khor lo/ thog bsrung gong 'og /ltasang na dbab pa/ thog ser gcod pa (187na)srung 'khor/ zlog 'khor/ gsad 'khor/ rang gshed drug gi dang po rdo rje slob dpon dgrar langs na rdo rje dme 'thab tu gsod pa/ dam tshig gcig pa'i slob ma dang mched grogs gsod pa/ ban dgra dang sngags pa spyi gsod pa/ btsun pa spyi gsod pa/ mu stegs dang bon gsod pa/ sdig spyod rgyal po gsod pa/ bud med gsod pa/ lha dbye/zhi ba rdo rje 'chang gi tsakra/ rgyas pa tshe dpag med/ dbang 'dod rgyal/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi 'jug snod/ rdo rje gtsug lag nas dngos su ma bstan pa'i zhan byung bde gshegs zhi khro'i rang gshed/ rigasadrug rang gshed/ byad ma rang gshed/ sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi'i dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das stobs ldan nag po zhu ba po gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ 'phung —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebyed shirnya garbha/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ sba gor bee ro tsa na/ yang na 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas/ gru gu yang dbang gser slag can/ des bee ro la gnang / bi mā la dang bee ros mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan la gnang / gter ston dbus pa du gu rin cen seng ge rang bsrung dang ga4bdud khal gi 'thor lo mo byas shing gter srung la mchod pa zhan pas 'tshub kyis gtsang gi lum tsho gru khar 'di gnyis ma mthun par gcig gis gcig gri khar bkrongs/ gtsang pa rin cen shes rab/ g.yas ru shangs kyi zla 'od grags/ gnas po yin pas ga' ston dpon slob gnyis grongasashul shog ser rnams 'di la byung / de'i sras mo'i 'od lde/ jo sras ma 'di las 'phro sad cing snying ru che bas grub pa thob ste chos 'di spel lo/ /(187ba)rje btsun bram ze smyon pa/ dam pa bdag po/ gur mo lo tsā ba shes rab rtse mo/slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ lha sgom dam pa/ de gnyis ka la mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum gyisagasan/ de nas gra phyi g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ 'gro mgon tshe bdag pa/ sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po/ mnga' ris lha btsun legs ldan rdo rje/ mi nyag byang pa gter ston dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po/ gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ drin can rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor sngags smyon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyi mtshon char gnang ba ni byang chub kyi bar du bka' drin gzhal du med pa'o/ /dbu ru lha sa'i ston pa shākya 'od dam shākya bzang por gragasapas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gnod sbyin khang pa nas rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi cha lag gab pa mngon phyung sogasamado skor rnams spyan drangs pa ni grub thob dngos grub kyi gter kha gtso che ba'i dbang du btang nas de'i chos sder bgrangs pas 'dir smos ma dgos/ g.yu 'od brag gnas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma sku gsum rol pa'i las phran rnal 'byor ba grib kyis nyen pa la shin tu zab pa'i yang snying srog 'dzin rdzas la rten pa'i grib bsrung zab mo/ lha lnga dang 'go ba'i lha srung rnams mi dgyes pa dgyes par byed pa'i bsrung 'khor 'khon grib mi gtsang ba sel byed/ bal/ dus tshod/ mdud pa gsum la brten nas bsrung skud brtag thabs dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma 'byung gnas/—270

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnajo mo 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston shāka (188na khod nas rim par brgyud de zur gzhon nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston shāka 'od kyis ra sa 'phrul snang nas spyan drangs pa'i dgra bo phye mar 'thag pa 'khrug byed rgyal po'i rgyud las btus pa'i srog mchan pa nag po'i rlung 'khor ma yig la nang gses kyi 'byung khungs gleng gzhi/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ spra 'khrid lag len/ sngags kyi spra 'khrid thems yig /nang rtags/ phyi rtags/ ma 'grub na spogs choge /'grub na las kyi mjug bsdus te le'u brgyad/ man ngag bu yig 'khrug byed rgyal po'i le'u bco brgyad pa nas rlung lha las la bkol ba'i drag sngags bcud bor/ 'khrug byed rgyal po'i rgyud las zlog pa mkhan gnad la 'bebs pa'i man ngag /srog mchan pa nag po'i zhal gdams gnad kyi man ngag don bdun pa/ lag len man ngag yig chung gsang ba snying gi ti ka /rlung 'khor gyi skad brtag pa/ rnal 'byor rang bsrung thun mong ma yin pa'i yig chung dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/mu stegs kyi ston pa kha 'phung nag po/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ gter ston shāka 'od nas rim bzhin lha rigs 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ rab 'byams rigs 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ zur dang ma pa bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ yug rlung rigs mi 'gyur rdo rje/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na mnga' ris(184)paṇa chen nas/ nyang tsha chosakyi dbang po/ yug rdzong nor bu dbang rgyal/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med man gong ltar/ rje bla ma zur rṣa gyis rma 'khor 'di la brten nas zla gcig tso la hor stod rta'i dpon rnam sras dang lo khongs su mi gces drug cu tsam 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba'i ral gri phyung rgya ma yin no/ /gter ston gtsang pa la ba ring mo'am gtsang ring shes rab kyi gter ma'i gtad khram gyi tshe don dam pa'i bsrung ba/ kun rdzob la tshe 'di dang phyi ma nam gzhag gtan du mi zlog pa'i thabs/ klu rigasalnga'i sgrib shing / bskal pa stong du klu nad bsrung ba/ mdze 'phro gcod cing gtad zlog pa/ gtad 'dre —27/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/dang klu gdon bsrung ba/ ma he glang rgod kyi bsrung ba/ lha 'dre'i gnod pa yong mi srid pa'i thabs klu dang sa bdag nye mi nus pa'i thabs/ gtad kyi rjes gcod chu mig 'dru thabs rnams chos tshan gcig tu byas pa'i gtad khram gyi bsrung ba rdo rje'i go khrab thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ o rgyan chen po/ gter ston lwa ba ring mo nas rim par yab 'jam dbyangs chen po/ sprul sku ye shes rol pa rtsal/lha btsun nyi zla 'od zer/ rigs 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ rlung mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku dam pa dmar pos sba gro bcal gyi brag nas spyan drangs pa'i bdud rtsi chen po'i bcud len skor/sprul sku dam pa dmar pos spa gro bcal gyi brag seng ge'i khog pa 'dra ba'i pha bong sdig ru can gyi rtsa ba nas spyan drangs pa'i dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba bdud rtsi chen po'i bcud len gyi skor la/ bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs (189na)legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u nyer gcig pa/ 'gor slob dpon chen po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'i bdud rtsi'i lag len rin cen 'phreng sbyor/ bdud rtsi dri chen gyi sgrub thabs tshe'i gdams pa khyad par 'phags pa'i man ngag mi shes 'phrang sgrol gces pa'i lag len mdor bsdus rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bdud rtsi lung 'bogs pa zhan byung mchod rdzas dka' thub kyi dbye ba sbyang bya rdzas kyi sgom thabs bcas ston pa don rtogs shog gi mtha' can/ bcud len lag tu blang ba'i zhal gdams dka' thub dang bsrung ba'i skyobs kyi dbye ba bsrung bar bgegs skrod bya tshul bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bdud rtsi mar du drangs—272—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i gdams pa zhes pa 'jam dpal zla gsang las rdzas kyi bsrung ba dang bcud len bya thabs zhar byung phan yon nag po dgu thub la brten nas bdug pa/ byug pa/ ril bu/ 'phur ma sogs kyi kha bsgyur bstan pa/ bdud rtsi mar khu'i gdams pa rnam par snang mdzad mar khu bcud 'byung ba'i thabs zhes pa lag len/ rdzas sngags kyi kha bsgyur/ spang bya/ za ba'i tshad/ phan yon mdog legs par bya ba dang bcas ston pa/ bdud rtsi mar khu'i gdams pa don bdun gyis bstan pa mkhas khyad man ngag gi yig chung rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gdon dang nad sogs brtags te shegs sel ba'i thabs sman gyi 'phrang bsal rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ zhar byung gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon sku gsum gyi grol tshul dang bcas pa gu (15ba〉rdu padmas mdzad pa 'o'i mtha' can rnams kyi lung man ngag phyag len bcasathob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ sprul sku shākya'i dbang po/'jam dbyangs gzhon nur gyur pa/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i lha mo/ rgyal ba dzi na pa tra/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ka la sidhi/ sprul sku dam pa dmar po/ rigs 'dzin ga rma'i mtshan can/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ byang sems dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ sprul sku rin cen chos rdor/ yongs 'dzin ngag dbang nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa chos dbang lhun grub/ rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub/rtsa ba'i bla ma sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ā tsarla he wa nag po'i ngan sngags bcom ldan 'das kyis ḍā ki rnams la bka' gnang nas byas pa bshig pa'i 'khor los gtums te lcags kyi rdo rje'i bum par bcug nas ri ma la ya'i nub dbang phyug lder bzo'i 'og tu sbas pas mu stegs rnams phung ba tsarla phra ba ri mos rnyed de slob dpon padma la phul ba bsam yas mchod rten sa 'das ga laganod pa bong ba'i rgyu 4zha de yin/ nag po'i 'og tu sbas pa la stod sprul sku dmar pos gdan drangs pa'i 'jig rten phung byed nag po gri thal ma'i skor la/ rtsa ba gri thal gyi rgyud chen po'i le'u dang po lo rgyus 'byung khungs/ gnyis pa rang bsrung rdo rje'i go gyon pa gsum pa bca' gzhi bstan pa/ bzhi pa 'khor lo 'dri ba/ lnga pa sngags kyi rim pa/ drug pa lha sgom (190na)—273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nesngags bzla/ bdun pa rdzas bstan pa/ brgyad pa rdzas gtor thabs rnams/ lag len gnad 'gag gi phreng ba la/ mu stegs kyi ston pa ā tsarla bande nag po dang / ston pa a wa seng ge gnyis kyis gsungasapa'i 'khor lo dang gnad kyi lag len bstan pa/ ston pa a wa seng shes gsungs pa'i lha lnga gshed 'bebs kyi 'khor lo/ mu stegs a wa seng ge dang de wa nag po gnyis kyis gsungs pa'i lha 'dre'i pho brang 'debs pa'i 'khor lo/ mu stegs de wa bzang pos gsungs pa'i sngags kyi dag yig /lha min 'dre min mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma nag mos ā tsarla de wa bzang po la gsungs pa'i rmi ltas brtag cing gnyen po bsten pa/ 'khor lo 'dri ba'i gza' skar/ rang bsrung bya thabs rnams la dbang phyug chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rgya can/ zhal gdams mtshon gri chu gri sogs rdzas sna bsags te sgrub cing sba tshul bsrung 'khor bsgom mo zhes pa'i mtha' can rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mu stegs kyi ston pa bande nag po/ tsarla phra ba ri mo/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ ā tsarla dra ba bzang po/ sprul sku la stod dmar po nas rim bzhin ma ṇi ind+ra rā dza/ mthu chen bla med rdo rje rtsal/ rlung mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag ga hor sngagasasmyon la phyag len zhal shes dmar 'khrid du stsal te bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char gdams so/ /yer pa bya ra sa nas sprul sku la stod dmar pos spyan drangs pa'i lha gcig kong jo'i phyag bris kyi yer pa'i dkar chag (190ba)bstan pa dar rgyas ma'i lung yang sprul sku gter bdag gling pa la thob bo mang mkhar mu gu lung nas grub thob dmar pos spyan drangs pa'i rdzas bdun la brten nas bgegs 'joms pa sra ba'i brag kyang 'gas nus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas rim par sngags 'chang legs mchogo pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rje khra tshang ba/ des bdag la'o/ /—274

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarta mgrin padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag rnams kyi skor/gsol 'debs las/ grags pa gsum pa dbang phyug mtshan mtha' can/ /'bre ban tshul bzang rnam gsum tsho gos pa'i gter/ /bla ma grum dang yon bdag nag po mkhar/ gnyis tshogos gter sgo 'byed rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i gter ston gsum tshogs ni rkyang po grags pa dbang phyug /sum pa byang chub tshul khrims/ 'bre shes rab bla ma gsum gyis yer pa se ba lung nas rta mgrin padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag rnams spyan drangs nas 'bru tshang gi gnyags ston la shog ser steng nas chos rgyun lan cig tsam las spel rgyu ma byung bar gter rngur gyisarkyang po la mdze byung / sum pa 'das/ 'bre smyo bas shog ser rnams rta mgrin gyi grub thob zhu ston bya ba'i lag tu byung yang des zhu sa rtsad ma chod pas las 'phro gter brgyud kyi byin rlabs bka' ma nyams pa yongs grags la med par yun ring 'byams/ ring zhig na grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'dar phya ru ba gtsang jo mo nags rgyal na bzhugs pa'i dus slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas zhang tshe zla grags bya ba'i sngags pa zhig tu sprul nas dbang lung rnams rdzogs par gnang (191na sngags kyi oṃ de khyoḥ ru bsgyur la sgrubs shig gsungs/ 'dar phyar gyis bla ma rgya la gter brgyud kyang rtsad chod nas gsan pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug gi chos skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor tu kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu la lha dbang gi lhan thabs sbyar zhing / bla chen chosadapal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed kyi steng nas zhib cha'i phyag len dang bcas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du gtang sde bum pa la brten nas khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i rig pa'i —275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/dbang / lha dbang / dur khrod chos dbang / gtor dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / bzhi pa'i dbang dang bcas pa rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' srol ma nyams pa yid ches khungs btsun du mnos/ dbus ston pa sogs sa dge'i mkhas rlom g.yin dag gis rig pa'i dbang lnga so sor phral nas bskur bas mtshon te gsang 'dus dgyes
