rdor sogs rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab rang bzo'i dri ma tsam yang ma 'dres pa yin no/ /'chi med tshe'i rdzong chung gi dbang kun mkhyen chen po'i yig cha dang de'i gsal byed tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i nag po 'gro shes kyi steng nas tshe 'gugs 'ang /bsdu ba/ dbang dngos/ sba ba/ spel ba/ tshe rdzas myang ba/ bsrung ba rnams smin rgyas/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i byin rlabs dbang gi cho ga'i steng nas bum pa/ rta mgo /dur khrod chas/ bzlas lung / gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang / bka' srung ging lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang (191ba)zab mo rnams kyang yid brtan du rung ba thob nas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ spyir rtsab rgyud kyis steng du dril ba/ sgrub thabs byang bu'i steng du dril ba/ man ngag las tsho gos kyis steng du dril ba'i tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/ rgyud kyi le'u drug pa yan gyis stod las byang chub sgrub pa rnams ston pas/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ sgrub thabs las byang / bstod bskul/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg /zor sogs sgrub pa chen po'i cha lag tu nges par dgos pas smad las kyi char gtogs pa 'ga' zhig kyang der tshang dgos la/ rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar gyi smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba mngon spyod drag po'i skor ni sgrub chen gyi le lag tu byung ba'i smod pa kha sbyor dbye ba sogs ma yin pa min na'ang / gtso bor sbasapa mig 'byed kyi le'u gsum pa man chad kyi skor dang / gtor ma'i las tshogs bcu bdun gyi nang gi mngon spyod kyi skor sogs 'phrul shes par byas nas skabs gang dang gang du dgos pa de dang der len pa yin/ ga lhas pa ni/ sgrub 'phrin sbyor dngos rjes tshang la brten nas rgyud dang man ngag shog dril sogasaskabs thob gang du dgos pa de bsnan nas nyams su len/ gsum pa ni/ sbas pa mig 'byed kyi skor te/de yang rgyud ltar byed na le'u dang po dang gnyis pas stod las rgyud le'u drug pa yan dang sbyar/ lhag mas —276

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnasmad las rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa man dang sbyor/ man ngag ltar byed na zhal gdams shog dril byang bu sogs stod las dang thun mong gi las sgrub rnams smad las su sbyor/ /man ngag rang rkyang du byed na sman sgrub dang lha sngags dmigs pa'i (192na)nges pa bstan pas stod las/ le'u gsum pa man chad kyi smad las su sbyor dgos pas sdom 'di lta bu shes na chos lugs 'di la nang byan chud par mngon no/ /de yang rtsa ba rgyud kyi skor/ sdong bu byang bu'i skor/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ sgrub pa 'phrin las kyi skor/sbas pa mig 'byed skor/ bde gshegs spyi dril gyi skor/ thun mong las phran shog dril gyi skor/ thun mong ma yin pa mchog lam gyi skor dang brgyad/ dang po la/ padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i rgyud le'u (6)bcu gsum pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag rje la gtad pa lo chen bee ros bsgyur ba/ dpal o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi skor skabs spyod (pa)don 'grel bee ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi sa bcad dbang chen zhal gzigs kun mkhyen mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa piṇa ta tha rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa sdong bu lta bu byang bu'i skor la/ o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang gi byang bu/ 'di rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa'i dbang bgrod dam ldan slob dpon khur zhes pa'i skabs dang sbyor/ sgrub pa'i byang bu/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ tshe'i byang bu/ sbyin sreg gi byang bu/le'u ban pa dang sbyor/ rab gnabs kyi byang bu/ gsum pa dang 'brel/ gnas lung gi byang bu rnams/ gsum pa smin byed dbang gi skor la/ rtsa ba'i dbang byang mdzad pa po slob dpon chen po padma bzang po yin pas slob dpon padma bzang po'i rnam thar lo rgyus zhes pa mdzad pa po/ rgyud/ phyogs/ dgos pa bsdus don te lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab pa gsal ba'i mtha' can/ le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/ sna tre/khungs btsu rgo pa brgyud (192ba)pa'i rnam thar la grub thob 'dar phya ru pa rin cen bzang po'i rnam thar zur tsam bris pa bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje'i rnam thar tshig nyung don rgyas/ le'u gsus pa dang sbyor/chos rje nyan chen pa'i rnam thar 'gor 'khrungs yul dang mjug na gshegs tshul bstan pa legs par gda' bo'i mtha' can/ sgrub chen gyi phyi'i sngon 'gro rgyan mchod pa —277—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgyal mtho/dam sri/sgo byang dang bcas pa sgo gong du gzhag ge'i mtha' can/le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/rgyan dgod pa'i las byang mda' brgyad ma dang bde stong dbyer med pa/chag chag gdab pa drin chen dri chu ma/le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/thig 'debs stong gsum 'jig rten ma/dbang chen sgrub pa'i tho yig bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa seng ge'i mtshan can gyis bkod pa/le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/dam rdzas rnam pa lnga'i rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi ngos 'dzin/kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng shes mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu/le'u gsum po dang sbyor/dbang chog gi lhan thabs lha dbang dang rdzas dbang gi yi ge/le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/rwa ban chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu (re/ma dag pa'i dri ma 'bru byed/rdzong chung tshe dbang gi yi ge rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan seng shes bkod pa/les su mud hwar/tshe'i 'grang rgyas kyi bzang ngan brtag pa/tshe chang gi kha la bzang ngan brtag pa/le'u gas yod ba sbyor/yang gsang khrosapa'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs nag po 'gro shes tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i tshe spel ba 'dir tshogs skal ldan ma rnams/le'u gsum pa dang sbyor/bzhi pa sgrub pa'i 'phrin las skor la/dpal 93na ) ldan seng shes mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub kyi gter mdzod/le' gsum pa bzhe pa lnga pa gang dgos la sbyor/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/rta mgrin dpa' gcig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin brisapa le'u gsum pa bzha pa lnga pa gang dgos la sbyor/yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs bsnyen pa dang mjug tu gdon bgegs sgrod pa'i sngags dmigs dang bcas pa/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i yab yum rkyang sgrub (lha)kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'byer dngos grub myur rtsol/le'u gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gang dgosalasbyor/yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i 'phrin las slob dpon chen po padmas mdzad pa/le'u gtso pa nas drug pa'i bar dang ba nyisapa snams gang dgos la sbyor/'phrin las kyi bsdus don spyi don gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa/khro bo'i rgyal po padma dbang chen gyi 'phrin las ngag 'don ma/na bur btab pa gnyags kyi bande rnam rgyal dpal

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabazang gis mdzad pa/le'u gsum pa na drug pa'i bar dang bstoganyis pa rnams gang dgos la spyor/dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rgyal ba kun bdag ma/le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar gang dgos la sbyor/rtags bstod slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/khyung bstod dbang chen ma/wogatso pa nas druX'i bar gang dgos la sbyor/bkra shisatshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa/bdud rtsi'i byin brlab kyi shog dril 'bru lngas byin gyis brlab pa/le'u gsum pa dang bzhi pa la sbyor/gtor ma byin 193ba ) brlab kyi shog dril 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab pa/le'u gsum pa dang bzhi pa la sbyor/rakta byin brlab kyi shog dril 'bru gcig gis byin gyis brlab pa/byin 'bebs kyi dmigs pa/le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar la sbyor/tshogs mtha' ma'i lag len kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng shes mdzad pa/le'u drug pa dang gas nyas par sbyor/des mdzad pa'i rigs 'dzin 'ad zhi bskul/'khrug pa༄na pa la sbyor/des mdzad pa'i 9)dkon cog spyi bskul/des mdzad pa'i chos skyong khe snyu bskul/'khrug rang gon po zhwar/des mdzad pa'i gser skyems mdor bsdus tshigs bcad ma/des mdzad pa'i gser skyems rgyas pa tshig lhug/le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/gnyen po'i pho nya dam 9)tshig rṣa po ma/yungs dzir gyi pho nya yungs 9)kar rgyal po ma/'bo ga pa dang gon pa la sbyor/sgrol gying (6)sdogs khro bo'i pho nya/yungs thun dbab pa gser sgong (6)bsgril 'dra ma/wo drug pa dang bon pa la sbyor/lha dang (6)dbral ba/khrag zor dgra 9)la 'phen pa/le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/gtor 9)sgo dbye ba/gtor zor 9)bya ba/le5 ga pa dang bdun pa lasbyor/dbang po rab kyi bro dmar 9)nag gru gsum ma/tshong gi bro nub 9)phyogs padma/'a khrug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/mtha' ma'i (6)bro yungs dar ma/le yo ga pa dang tshan pa la sbyor/rta'i brtul bzhugasalta'i)kyi bro/'a khrug stong bdun pa la sbyor/zlog pa rnam par rgyal ba'i lag len mus srad pa byams pa rdo rje rgyal mas gyis mdzad pa/le yi ga pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/zlog pa rnam rgyal ('id stobs kyi ma' cha sangs rgyas bstan pa ma/le'u drug pa dang bdun pa la sbyor/rta mgrin gyi yang phrod re/mdos nag po bsngo 194na tha/dgra bgegs la dmod pa gdab ༷ /ga mtsho khol ma/le yi ga pa dang bon pa la sbyor/padma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ ()dbang rṣa gyi drag po'i sbyin sreg don bcu gcig ma/le'u ri'i la stor/gnas byang gi ṭikka nyi ma'i 'od zer kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa/le'u gsus dang par sbyor/des mdzad pa'i 'phrin lasakyi gsal byed rin po che'i 'phreng ba/le'u gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar sbyor/sgrub thabs kyi sgom khog chen po (sher ban chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rnams/lnga pa sbas pa mig tshod 9 )skor la/sgrub thabasasbas pa mig 'byed dang las tshogs sbas pa mig 'byed gnyis dpe tshan so sor 'dug kyang phyag len ltar go rim du bkod pa la/'phrin las kyi zhal khrigs/le'u bzhi par sbyor/tsho gis mtha' ma'i zhal khrigs/drug par sbyor/pho nya gtong ba'i zhal khrigs/bon par sbyor/bkra shis kyi zhal khrigs/dru lto sur/dbang po rab kyi rta gro'i zhal khrigs/rta gro'i dmigs rim gyi zhal khrigs/drug par spyor/dbang gi zhal khrigs/gsum par sbyor/mngon rtogs kyi zhal khrigs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun/gsum pa dang bzhi par sbyor/sgrub pa'i zhal khrigs rta bdun tsha zer/gsum pa dang bzhi pa lnga pa la sbyor/bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal khrigs/gnasabatsal ba'i zhal khrigs/gsum par stor/lcags mkhar 'brub khung gi zhal khrigs/na par sbyor/rten bca' ba lidma'i zhal khrigs/'gugs pa'i zhal khrigs nyi zer lcags kyu/bdun pa dang bas gnyis par sbyor/mnan pa'i zhal khrigs chu srin lto ba/ba glo par sbyor/drag sngags bdun pa'i zhal khrigs spu gri me 'bar/wo ba glo par sbyor/zlog pa'i zhal khrigs gnam 194bskogs 'bar ba/skyin thang chu 'khyags kyi zhal khrigs/dgu par sbyor/gnam thog gi zhal khrigs/gdon chen gzir ba'i zhal khrigs/༄ par sbyor/me dpung 'bar ba mdze nad 'joms pa'i zhal khrigs/ral gri 'bar ba chung sri gsad pa'i zhal khrigs/ga par sbyor/phyugs nad gcod pa'i zhal khrigs/sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs 'khor ba'i rtsa tshig/gsarasbyor/dngos grub bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/drug par sbyor/sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs me'i sbyor ba/ga khar sbyor/gying lnga dril ba'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/gas rdzi khar sbyor/shel gyi nga dkar po'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/ji par ra/tshangs pa dung thod can gyi drag sngags zhal khrigs/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/༷/khog par sbyor/rdo rje legs pa'i drag sngags zhal

dam pa'i chos kyi gas yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganakhrigs/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/gas rga0ra sbyor/ri nag spungs pa'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/༄ rsāg par sbyor/yab shud dmar po'i drag sngags zhal khrigs/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/gying lnga mchod pa'i zhal khrigs/brdzi kha sbyo/gza' rgod kyi drag sngags zhal khrigs/sto par sbyor/de'i cho 'phrul zhal khrigs/bas khog par sbyor/de'i mchod pa'i zhal khrigs/dbang sdud 'brub khung gi zhal khrigs/ri rgyu par sbyor/'gugs pa ting 'dzin gyi zhal khrigs/gnod byed bgegs dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/༄ spyog par sbyor/gnod byed mi dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/yul khams dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal khrigs/gas:ga par sbyor/zas nor dbang du bsdu ba'i zhal 195nakhrigs/las mtha' sbyin sreg gi zhal khrigs/ga kha6khar sbyor/dgra lkugs par byed pa'i zhal khrigs/brtsa'i spur/gter bdag bdud kyi zhal khrigs/gter bdag drag btsan gyi zhal khrigs/gter bdag klu lcam gyi zhal khrigs/mi phyugs thems kyi zhal khrigs te lnga bcu rtsa gsum rnams/drug pa bde gshegasaspyi dril gyi skor la/rta mgo bde tshogs bos pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgom rim 9)rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/byin mas dbang bskur gyi cho ga rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du gu ru la rjes zhus pa'i lo rgyus las 'phros te bsrung ba bde gshegs thams cad kyi nus pa (phanazhen rme)snyag dril sde brgyad bas bor dregs pa kun sgrol shin tu gsang ba'i mtha' can/hro me'i sa bon la brten pa'i dmigs rim dang seng lding 'ad(gnas)gi phur pas chu dang yungs dkar nag thal rṣa gyis ser ba bsrung gtor 9 )(gnas)ma'i las/gnyen po'i rdzas lus la rtoganagesangs pas klu 'gros shing sdangs bred brgyal bar 'gyur ba/bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rdzas bstan pa/phur pa sbyin sreg mnan pa gsum gyi sgo nas las kyi mjug bsdu ba/slob dpon padma khrung gnas kyis lha sras la gto nas ga kho du sbas zhing las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/bsrung zlog gso ba'i las sbyor slob dpon padma yang gnas kyis khri srong lde ba 'a gyi phyag tu gto pa'i mtha' can/bde gshegs 'dus pa'i drag sngags man ngag bcud sdi nying khu rdzogs byang gi mtha' 195bcan/bde

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negashegs 'dus pa'i las rim rnam brgyad la bsnyen pa/ sgrib pa bsreg pa/ chos skyong bskul ba/ sdebargyad bkol ba/ klu gnyan gdul ba/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba/ bgegs dpung gzhes pa/ gtor ma dbul pa rnams/ yang drag sngags la bsnyen pa skyel ba'i don sgrub rtags dngos grub 'grub tshul las can la phrad shog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dam can srog 'khor la brten nas chos skyong bskul te dgra bo sgrol ba/gnad 'bebs kyi 'khor lo la brten nas sde brgyad bran du bskul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas rigs bzhi'i klu gdon gdul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas dgra bgegs dam sri gdul ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas nod gtong zlog pa/ rang bsrung 'khor lo/ lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa la brten nas sri'u gso ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas smyo 'bog gdul ba/ gu gul dang srin lag bsdams pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis 'dre ngan gdul ba/ 'khor lo dang la cha'i sbal pas zho chang bsrung ba/ mu: bcu pa dang ghi nya dgu sbyor gyis mdze lhog sogs gdon rims bsrung ba rnams/ bdun pa thun mong las phran shog dril gyi skor la/ chu'i bcud len/ 'di gtso bor bsnyen sgrub dang mgo sgrub la sbyor/ nas phye'i dka' thub/ gtor ma'i lasatshogs la lta'i)dngos grub sgrub pa/ dgra bgegs sgrub pa/ zlog pa/ mnan pa/ zor du bya ba/ 'di yan sgrub thabs la sbyar/ sbyin sreg tu bya ba/ byab par byed pa/ dbang bskur du byed pa/ dngos grub tu sgrub pa/tshe sgrub pa/ 'di yan sgrub 'a dang tshe sgrub la sbyor/ rigs brgyud sgrub pa/ sri'u gso ba/ nor du sgrub pa/ lha 'dre'i mi gsum dbang du dbye/ 'byung po sdud pa/ ser ba zlog pa/(196na'i me rims sogs gang gnod par brdeg pa ste bcu bdun/ 'di yan gang dgos su yi na'ang gtso bor sgrub thabs la sbyor/ las thor bu'i skor (6)la 'khor lo bsrung ba/ le'u ༄ par sbyor/ bsnyen tshad/ lnga par sbyor/ gdon brtag pa/ ༄ par sbyor/sngags chu/ bsrung skud/ ༅ par sbyor/ chu dang bye mas bsrung ba nad gdon/ 5par sbyor/ mi ma yin mnan pa/ bas par sbyor/ mig mthong / drug par sbyor/ 'khor lo kha sbyor gyi bgegs gdul ba/ ga par sbyor/ rgyal 'gong gdul ba/ bdud bzhi gdul ba/ ga par sbyor/ zhi bas mi thul na gzir ba/ so par sbyor/ mnan pa/ ༄ par sbyor/ byug pa/ bcu par sbyor/ mdze brtag pa/ ༄ par sbyor/ chung sri gsad pa/ chung —282

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yag gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)sri khang bu gzhug pa/༄ par sbyor/sri'u gso ba/༄ par sbyor/gshin po'i 'dre ru mi yong /༄ par spyor/mkha' 'gro ma'i byas pa bshig pa'i phra men 'dzul chog/0par sbyor/lam bsrung lcags khang ma rnams/zhan byung ser bsrung bka' rgya ma/dgu par sbyor/mtho phur gyi zhal gdams bka' rgya ma/ser ba 'ong mi 'ong /dgu par sbyor/ser lam gcod pa/thun zor gto ma'i las kyis ser 9)ba dbab pa la klu gnad la bor bas dbab pa/sbyin sreg/thabs gzhab/ser gta'/dbyug pa/gtor ma/glo bur drag shul/rdzas rgod/thod skam/thod gsher/chur bu g.yang bzhi/grod pas dbab pa dang brgya gnyisabee ro'i zhal khrigs/dgu par sbyor/rgyud du gab pa'i sngags kyi sham bu sbyor tshul mdze dang sri'u bsrung ba sogs zhan la bstan pa rgyud lha sar bsgyur nas/lnga par sbyor/rje la gto pa bee ro'i zhal khrigs zab pa'i gnad/khyad par gsad thabs gying lnga srog gcod kyi man ngag/bas snyig par sbyor/man ngag 'di 196bsko nyis la rgya gsum btab pa'i man ngag mnga' bdag gis bee ro la dung g.yas 'khyil sogs phul skad do//gying lnga gza' gdong gi ma' 'ad/'ad rtogs yig rnying /ste khrig par sbyor/de'i mdos/9 )'dage chog/gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor 'bul/gas khog par sbyor/wen las myur 'grub tshar wo gyis mdzad pa/ri ri par sbyor/des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i bca' thabs dang phan yon/gas kheg par sbyor/gying lnga gza' gdong gi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams/bsaXg par sbyor/brgyad pa mchog lam skor la/bum dbang gi lam lha 9)'khrid sems bzung gi shog dril/'di man wogasum pa'i dbang bgrod dam ldan slob dpon bkur brtson 'grus ldan pas brtsegacig sgrub ces pa'i shugs bstan gyi dgong par sbyor ro//lha 'grub mi tsā ba brtag 9)pa'i shog dril/gsang dbang dang 'brel pa drod kyi gdams pa gtusamo'i dmigs skor bco brgyad/sher dbang zhal las shes par bya/bzhi pa 'brel ba rta skad thengs gcig(6)ma'i dgongs pa dbu gtsug sprul pa ma/dbang bzhi thun mong gi lam dang 'brel pa bskyed (pha)rdzogs zung 'jug gi shog dril/dngos grub 'a)spyod pa/dug gsum 9)lam slong /sdom pa 9)dam ṣka/dngos 'a)grub/yang dag lta ba rnamaX/9)kyi shog dril/padma dbang ོ gyi rdzogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rim ye shes gsang lam zab mo/rdzogs rim padma gsang lam gyi nyams len gu ru chos rgyal la gsungasapa/dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bzhi'i 'khrid 'gor blo gros mnyam med dang zhes yod pa bla ma mkhas la bzod par mdzod ces pa'i mtha' can rwa ban chos dpal bzang po'i zin bris rnams legs par thob 97na ) pa'i gying lnga gza' gdong gi dbang lung la/bde gshegs spyi dril gyi gnas kyi rtags med pa rnams dang sa bcad lnga pa yongs rdzogs/rwa/dhī/'dar gyi rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogos pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku padma dbang chen/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/lo chen bee ro tsa na/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/gter ston rkyang po gragasapa dbang phyug/sum pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/'bre shes rab bla ma/'brug tshar gyi 'ad ston ga gi brjid ༄'bar/gsang mas dri med zla shar/rta nag gi bla ma rgya/dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phya ru ba/chos rgyal bo dong rin cen/nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/brag ram pa chos rgyal dpal bzang /kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/rnam grol ba rin cen ba po shis/rtogs ldan yon to mgon po/bla wo chos dpal bzang po/mus sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/zhakhrul zhig dkon cog bzang po/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/sngags la4 bsod nams chosa'aphel/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//sa bcad lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/'ad skor mnga' bdag gtso che ba tsam ma gtogs gter ston gsum tsho gis la yang byung ba sbas pa mig 'byed gdusbas rdzus gyi lo rgyus kyis shes/mnga' bdag yan gong ltar la gter ston nyang ral/she ma 'od 'byung /grub thob 'dar phyar/brtson tsos rdo rje/yi rṣa pa/chos rgyal dpal bzang /nye gnas chos kyi rgyal mtshan/bla ma blo gros seng ge/bla ma sidhi sidha/bla chen chos dpal ba man gong ltar 97brwa'i rtags can gyi brgyud pa ni/bla chen nas/chos rje nor bu phun tshogs/sngags 'chang sangs rgyasagrags pa/ḍā rṣa chos kyi rgyal po man gong ltar ༷//lha'i rtags༅ gyi brgyud pa ni/'jam dbyangs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)mkhyen brtse nas/ 'phags mchogo byams pa skal bzang / rje dbang rab man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud du byed na/ slob dpon padma la grub thob 'dar phyar gyis dngos su gsan pas/ slob dpon chen po nas grub thob 'dar phyar gyis kyang 'thus/ yang dbang dang lung pha'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge yan gong ltar la/ chos rje bsod nams bzang po/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ rje nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus srad pa blo gros rin cen seng ge /gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bde legs nyi ma/ shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/chos rje rin cen bshes gnyen/ bla ma 'phrin las lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na rje btsun chos rgyan nas/ yang dgon spyan snga ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ bla ma 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ brgyud lugs 'di'i sbas pa mig 'byed kyang chos rgyal dpal bzang nas dpal ldan seng ge la brgyud pas chog go /rta mgrin bde gshegs gcig dril gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang 'dar gyi rtags can gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan yan gong ltar la/ de nas mnyam med dkon cog dpal bzang /nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub byams pa bzang po/ nub dgon sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ 'dar nag rgyal sras bde ba bzang po/ des(198na)bdag la'o/ gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'khrul zhig dkon cog bzang po yan gong ltar la/ de nas nub dgon pa nyi zla bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun bzang nyi ma/zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba rin cen bzang po la khyab 'jug gis dngos su phul ba'i las ci bcol nyan/ mi zlog /dug mi phog /nad pa myur du bsos pa sogs phan yon shin tu che ba'i chos skyong gza' mchog chen po'i gtor dbang zab khyad can/ de la dgos pa'i khyab 'jug gza'i spu gri nang ltar bkang ba'i las rim la spyan 'dren gdug pa tshar gcod/ bzhugs gsol srin khros ma/—285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shephyag 'tshal 'jig rten ma/ gtor bsngo phyag rdor ma/ sman mchod rtsa brgyad ma/ dam bsre 'bru gsum ma/ mchod bkang rā hu la/ bskul nam mkha' g.yu 'od/ las mkhan bskul ba 'jig rten mthu chen/rgyun gyi gtor bsngo padma'i rgyal po ma gtor sngags dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba rin cen bzang po/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ yi rṣa bsod nams brtan pa/mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge /dpal ldan ratna kirti/ gu ru dug gsum nad sel/ sngags 'chang chos skyong mgon ba/ yar 'dren nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal po/ rig 'dzin grags pa rdo rje/ bla ma gu ru rin cen/ rgyal sras bde ba bzang po rig pa ye shes/ des bdag la'o/ /nags rgyal lha chu'i brag phug gong mar grub chen 'dar phya ru bar rā hu las mdzes pa'i gzugs bstan nas srog gi snying po phul ba'i gser chos 'khor lo'i (198bskod mas pa la nang gsesakyi brtag pa/ bsrung 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum rab gnas dang bcas pa/ rgyab bcos/ sman bcos/ sbur chog /yig chung skor la gser chos mags pa'i 'di la phyag 'a la lung sa med/don snod gang la babs kya bcos/ rang bsrung / spu gri glog dmar/ lkugs pa kha 'byed gsum/ gza'i rbod gtong bsrung ba/ spang bya/ bsdu sman/ slong sman/ zhugs lhung rgyab gsum gyi dbye ba/ rang la brtag pa dang rdzas kyi brtag pa rnams kyi lung dang phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ grub thob chen po 'dar phyar/ 'dar mgon pa chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gu ru dug gsum nad sel/ wongs med bsod nams ye shes/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bzang po/ sngags 'chang chos skyong mgon ne/ yar 'dren nam mkha'i mtshan can/ 'dar ston gu ru rin cen/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal po/ rig 'dzin grags pa rdo rje/ bla ma gu ru rin cen/ 'dar nag bde ba bzang po'am yi dam lhas lung bstan pa rig pa ye shes/des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /kun mkhyen mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge la khyab 'jug gis dngos su phul ba'i ser bsrung —286

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabasam gtan nyal chog la smar zong gnyis yod pa'i smar dang thog bsrung 'brug skad gcog pa zab khyad can gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge /dpal ldan ratna kirti/ gu ru dug gsum nad sel/mtshungs med rin cen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon to mgon po/ rwa chen chos dpal bzang po/ gab chag pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mthu 'a dkon cog bzang po/ mnyam med nub dgon pa/ byams pa blo grosargyal mtshan/ rje byams pa bzang po nub dgon sprul sku/ 'dar nag bde ba bzang (199na)po/ desabadag la'o/ /gza'i rjes gcod la/ rdzas sngags chog gsum gyis gcod pa/ yul dang gang zag la gza' lam gcad pa/ de dag rnams kyi steng 'og gi 'khor lo mchod rten phur pa rnams kyi dpe risabacas pa dpal o rgyan chen pos khyung 'dab ka ba sprul mgor gter du sbas pa lo tsā ba khams pa khra mos btone pa dang / gser chos lugs kyi khyab 'jug 'gyu lam gcod pa rigs gsum mgon po sogasadape ris bzhi dang bcas pa/ rgya nag stong khun gyi lugs srol mi nyag mkhas pa ā tsarla'i gdams pa lo tsā ba zhwa ser can gyis bsgyur ba'i gza' mdos gsal ba'i sgron me/ yab yum sras gsum gyi sku dang bcas pa'i gza' bsrung la hril ma rnams kyi rjes gcod man la lung rgyun mi 'dug / phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa yang gser chos bzhin no/ /rgya gar ke'u tshang dgu'i bdag po rig pa glong du shar ba slob dpon shrī si lhas mdzad pa'i gza' rgod spu gri drag sngags bar snang hom khung mar grags pa slob dpon chen po padma lho nub srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs kha'i dus spa gro skyer chu'i lha khang du khyung rum smug po'i chu nang du bse'i ga'ur bcug nas sbas pa bla ma grum dang spa gro'i yon bdag nag po mkhar gnyis kyisalhan cig tu spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ yid tshes khungs btsun pa byung tshul dang che ba'i lo rgyus/ gza' rgod dug gi sbu gri'i mā ra ya gsod pa'i sbyor ba bar snang hom khung ma'i sgrub thabs la nang gses kyi bca' gzhi/ bzlas pa/ rtags rim/ lam du zhugs pa/ ar gtad/ mnan bsreg 'phang gsum dang bcas pa'i don lnga (199ba)bstan pa/ bar snang hom khung ma'i yig phran la dgra la rbad pa/ thugs dam bskang ba/ rang gi hom khung dgag pa/ dgra'i hom khung dbye ba ste don bzhi pa/ dgra glo bur du byung na —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheye 'brog drag po gtong ba/ gnad kyi gdong gtad rgyud don bas du dril ba spu gri reg chod phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gshin rje mi yul du dngos su rgyu ba gab pa'i gdong gtad mngon sum cog 'gyel bu la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ ar gtad lam zhugs kyi 'khor lo liṅga dpe chung bcas pa'i steng nas phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rin cen snying po/ rdo rje 'a zang / thub pa'i dbang po/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston bla ma grum/ yon bdag nag po mkhar/ khyung lung gi bya tsa gnubs ban ston pa/ dge bzhes ga ska go pa pu rang gi sngags pa skrun drug gi dpon yin zer/ 'dan ston pa/ gnyos 'bum khri ston pa/ skyog bya zhu can/ ratna shwa ra/ sngags nag gsang sngags rdo rje/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ legs ldan wo pos 'di gcig bu'i don du'ang lho brag phyogs su dka' bsgyud tshul dang yos gnang skad/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nus mthu'i mnga' bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za tor sngags nag la bstan pa bsrung ba'i chos skyong du stsal to/ /yang na ratna shwa ra nas/ bla ma mdo sde rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin padma dbang phyug /mtshungs med bkra shis dbang phyug /byang bdag rig 'dzin man gong bzhin no/ /gsol 'debs las/ skye ban rdo rje bande chung ngu bzung / khyung rgod mi nyag (2yin)dbu mar 'gar ston dkar/ /a wa sgru ti pa sogs tha dad bzhi/ zung du bcas pa de rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa rnams kyi gter chos ni sngon chad mthong thos su ma gyur la/ mi nyag grags 'byung gis bum thang gtsug lag khang nas bton pa'i thog ris zur lnga pa la brten pa'i thog bsrung gi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas rim par/ 'phyong rgyas chos rje bya dkar ma/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ sgom chen 'brug pa gnyan ston nga la/ /don grub seng ge padma gragasapar bcas/ /tha dad gnyis 'dzom chos kyi dbang phyug gi /bka' bzhin nyer sgrub de dag la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i sgom chen 'brug pa ni sras mkhar chos drug ma gter nas 'don mkhan de yin —288—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapas chos dbang gi gter kha bcu par ngos 'dzin yang kho bos ma thob/ gnyan ston nga las ni mkho mthing lha khang gi gshin rje gshed dmar po'i thugs ka nas 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi skor sogs btan pa chos dbang rin po che'i gter kha bdun pa yin pas de'i gras su bkod phyir logs su smos ma dgos/ don grub seng ge dang padma grags pa ni tha dad gnyis 'jom zhes pa'i nus pas gong ma gnyis kyi 'don grogs yin par mngon no/ / shar gter sprul sku pad ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas ston pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gsol 'debs las/ /lha lcam padma gsal las 'brel ba'i rtsal/ reg ban legs ldan zangs ri ras pa dang / /dbang shāka nyi 'bum khri dang bran dun pa/ /nyi ma shes rab grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i dang po dpal o rgyan chen po'i zab (200ba)gter la dbus gter zug pa rtsab lta bu/ lho gter dril ba sdong po lta bu/ nub gter gsal ba me tog lta bu/ byang gter rgya ba'i pa gal pa lta bu/ shar gter smin pa 'braba'i bu lta bu lnga las/ shar gter la bka' ba babs pa'i las ldan gyi gtso bo ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan gyi thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul zhing ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rdo rje snying po'i ngo bo zab gter gyi mnga' bdag dpa' bo sgang pa sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor ram gsang mtshan sprul sku las 'brel rtsal ni/ rang gter snying tig lung bstan las/ skye ba de'i 'og tu rdo dang mon bod mtshams 'bring thang zhes bya bar skyes te/ snga ma'i bag chags kyis rab tu 'byin par 'gyur ro ḍā ki ma rnams kyi bar chad bsrungs te: nga'i zab gter dang phrad de gter sgo gsum 'byed par 'gyur ro: de'i dus su 'gro don mi 'byung ste sbas pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa'i dus yin no: nga'i zab chos kyi bdag por 'gyur ro: 'on kyang chos kyi 'brel pa —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (se/bdun cu 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i mjug gi lung bstan las/ ku su lu pa'i gdams pa'i skor ldang lhung ldang lha'i brag la sbed da lta ston pa'i dus ma babs tshe lo drug cu kha ral dus gsal rje gangs kyi shar phyogs ngos lcags sgrom lta bu'i yul gyi stod 'brong po nyal 'dra'i spyi steng du mkha' 'gro sde lngas byin brlabs pas chu khams 'brug gam sprel yos lo spro ring theg chen chos la mos sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin ma 'gags spyod pa sna tshogs sbyor da lta'i lha lcam padma gsal: snyigs ma'i dus (201na)su de ltar skye de dus gdams pa 'di dang phrad ces pa ltar mnga' bdag sras mo'i sprul pa rin cen tshul rdor gyis dwags po ldang lha'i phra mo brag nas chu mo glang lo ston zla'i nyer brgyad la spyan drangs pa'i zab chos mkha' 'gro snying tig blun sgom yid byed dang phral nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mngon sum rang thog tu gtan la 'bebs pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di bod ma dag pa'i snang ngor sba bzhed ltar slob dpon gyi sprul pa gcig phyir ldog pa ltar mdzad nas sku dngos kyis gzho stod gter sgrom du bzhugs nas mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal la gnang ba'i skor la thog mar snying tig dang yang tig gnyis don la khyad par med cing phyag len 'khyer bde ba'i dbang du byas nas kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i yang tig gi dbang chog rin po che dbang gi 'phreng ba'i steng nas sngon 'gro snod khyad par can du sgrub cing sdig sgrib dag byed spyi khrus chen mo mdo tsam sngon du btang ste/ dbang dngos ni/ dang po tshogs gtor la brten nas byin rlabs dbang gi sgo dbye ba bar gcod sel zhing dngos grub kun 'byung mkha' 'gro brda'i dbang / gnyis pa ras brisakyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas lus kyis sgrib pa sbyong zhing sprul pa'i skur grol bar byed pa spros bcas bum pa'i dbang / gsum pa gsang ba rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nasang ga gi sgrib pa sbyong zhing longs spyod rdzogs skur grol bar byed pa gsang ba'i dbang / bzhi pa mtshan ldan phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas yid kyi sgrub pa sbyong zhing bde ba chen po'i skur grol bar byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / lnga pa bdud rtsi me long chos (201ba po khyung sngags 'khor la brten nas sgrib pa kun sbyong —290

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganazhing chos sku rdzogs pa chen po'i zab don mthar thug pa tshig dbang rin po che/ drug pa 'dab brgyad 'od ra bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas srid zhi'i legs tshogs mtha' dag bsam pa tsam gyis lhun gyis grub par byed pa byin rlabs bla ma'i dbang / bdun pa 'od ra bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas ye shes kyi sgo 'byed cing snang srid thams cad chos skur 'char bar byed pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang /brgyad pa 'od ra bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas byin rlabs mthar phyin par byed pa mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang / mtha' rten rig 'dzin gtor ma la brten nas gzhan don la gnang ba byin pa g.yin bka' bkrol ba/ sku gsung thugs rten la brten nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs su gtad pa'i gtad rgya/bka' rgya/ bka' srung dpal gtor la brten nas bar gcod bsrung ba'i bka' bsgo/ de yang mkha' 'gro'i don dbang man chad kun la mi spel bar snod ldan la chig brgyud du mdzad srol bzhin dbang yongs rdzogs kyi smin rgyas dang grol byed la kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pas mdzad pa'i yi ge steng nas thun mong gi sngon 'gro/ rdzogs chen rang skad thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi ka dag chos zad du la zla ba khregs chod/ lam lhun grub 'od gsal du 'gag bsdam pa thod rgal du ngo sprod pa/ brtson 'grus 'bring la bar do bzhi'i ngo sprod dang bcas nyams 'khrid du mnos nas/ lung gi skor la/ kha byang dang de las 'phros pa/ las 'phro can ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba btags grol gyi rgyud ma bu yig phran dang bcas pa'i skor/ ma smin pa smin par byed (202na)pa dbang sgrub ma bu'i skor/smin zil grol bar byed pa thod rgal gyi 'khrid yig ma bu'i skor/ lam gyi kha skong bar byed pa rgyab chosam bu'i skor/ le lo can srid pa bar mar grol byed bar do ma bu cha lag dang bcas pa'i skor/ snying po'i bstan pa bsrung ba bka' srung gi skor dang drug /dang po la/ ma yig kun bzang yab yum slong nas rang byung ba btags grol snying po'i rgyud tshig bdun pa/ chos sku thig le nyag gcig slong nas rang byung ba yang snying bcud kyi thigs pa gcig shes kun grol gyi rgyud/ yang tig snying po gser gyi 'bru gcig pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas sras gcig spyod pa sa bon —29/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegyi rgyud/ rang byung rig pa'i rgyud/ 'bras bu yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud/ bu yig la 'bras bu yongasardzogs btags grol rgyud kyi ti ka gsal byed don gyi snying po/ yang snying bcud kyi thigs pa kun grol rgyud kyi ti ka gsal byed don gyi me long / 'bras bu yongs rdzogs yang ti'i rgyud kyi ti ka gsal byed shel gyi snying po/ sras gcig rgyud kyi ti ka gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba/ 'bras bu yongs rdzogs rang byung rig pa'i rgyud kyi ti ka gsal byed dung gi sbar bkab/ yongs rdzogs ti ka gsal byed dri med snying po/ thems med/ 'bras bu yongs rdzogs btags grol thugs kyi snying po'i dbang thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang rig pa'i rtsal dbang du ngo sprod pa'i ti ka rig pa'i sgron ma/ yig phran la yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus mdo tsam bstan pa/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhes pa 'bras bu yongs rdzogasabatags grol rgyud dri med snying po mthar thug don gyi mchog yang gsang le'u gcig pa/ btags grol snying po'i rgyud kyi (202ba)bcad thabs lag len bstan pa/ rgyud kyis sems can gyi don rgya chen bya ba/ rgyud kyi rtags dang 'bras bu thob tshul/ rgyud bcangs pa tsam gyis yon tan 'byung tshul/ rgyud kyi che ba/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las rang shar ba gsang sngags thams cad kyi thugs yang bcud bstan pa thams cad kyi snying gzer rdo rje 'chang gis dga' rab rdo rje la gdams pa sangs rgyas kyi 'das rjes dang po sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lho phyogs 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i sdum rar babs pa/ byin rlabs chen po mchog gi yi ge sangs rgyas kyi zhal chems gnyis pa me ri 'bar ba'i shar phyogs shā gi ma 'du ba'i gnas su babs pa/ bstan pa thams cad kyi rang rtsal rang byung byin rlabs mchog gi yi ge sangs rgyas kyi 'das rjes mtha' ma rgyal po dza ba ri'i khab kyi lho phyogs bya rgod phung po'i rir babs pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig par bkod pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'bras bu yongs rdzogs btags grol snying po'i don 'khrid mngon sum snying tig gi man ngag rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ dum bu nyi shu rtsa gsum dag gis btags grol tshang: de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces zhes so/ /—292

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaganyis pa ma smin smin par byed pa dbang sgrub ma bu'i skor la/ bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga phyi ltar bsgrub par rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rigs lnga nang ltar bsgrub pa sbas byang gi mtha' can/ phyi spros bcas slob bu thun mong du smin par byed pa bum dbang don gsal sgron me/ 'di'i 'og tu das mkhekhodangos su ma zin pa'i dbang gong ma gsum gyi bskur thabs dbang bzhi gnad kyi 'phreng ba zhes pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/(203na)dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len dbang 'khrid nor bu sgron gsal/ de'i sa ma 'grel zhes pa bsdus don sa bcad sku gsung thugs kyi rgya can/ ḍā ki rigs lnga lus dkyil la dgod pa'i mngon rtogs mkha' 'gro ma thod rgal du sgrub pa gcig las spel na snying khrag thang la 'pho zhig gi mtha' can/ rig pa ye shesalnga tshan du ngo sprod pa'i gdams pa dbang gi rgyab yig gsang ba'i dum bu bkod pa/ khyad par dbang lnga zhes pa dbang bzhi rig pa'i rtsal dbang dang bcas pa bskur tshul/ bsod na mas tshogis chen rdzogos phyir bde gshegs rigs lnga'i mchod 'bum/ rigs kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i las byang spyi don bcu bzhi pa/rta phag gi lus dkyil/ the pas med/ bu yig la/ phyi nang gi dbang sgrub rin cen dbang gi 'phreng ba/ bum pa bsgrub pa rim pa'i mtha' can/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag bshad pa ci rigs spros so'i mtha' can/rigs lnga'i tshogs mchod bsod nams tshogs chen gsog pa lag len bsdus po'i mtha' can/ ḍā ki la gtor ma dbul ba'i lag len/ ye shes ḍā ki yab yum tsho gos mchode don bcu ma/ snying tig gsang ba bla med kyi dbang don gsal ba'i rgyab yig tho yig tu bkod pa/ gsang dbang gi lhan thabs/ sher dbang gi lhan thabs/ ḍā ki thod rgal du lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ thems med/ ṭā gi srog tig gam srog gi snying po'i gnad yig rten 'brel gyi gdams pa jo mo'i don du mdzad pa/ sa zhi'i sngagasakyi lde mig /'di gnyis thems med/ 'khor ba blos btang gi rnal 'byor pas ḍā gi gnad la dbab cing shi sa(203ba tha stan pa/ spyi gnad gcig tu bstan pa/ bla rdo rin cen thigs pa/ mkha' 'gro'i nor sgrub rin cen gter gyi bum pa/ gter ston la 'dud byed kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa 'byung tshul gyi lung bstan gsang zhing sba ba'i mtha' can rnams/ thems med/ de ltar nyi shu rtsa gsum lag len ma bu —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne'agrub de las mang nyung byung na chad lhag yin de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces zhes so/ /gsum pa smin zin grol bar byed pa thod rgal gyi 'khrid yig ma bu'i skor la/ snying tig gsang ba'i yang bas thod rgal lam gyi don 'brid nor bu'i snying po/ sku gsum don 'brid ces bya ba don 'khrid nor bu'i snying po'i ti ka gsal byed sgron me slob dpon padmas mkhar chen bza' la gdams pa/ 'khrid rgyab lung gi 'phreng ba/ sku gsum lam gyi 'khrid kyi lag len spra khrid dam nyams su len pa'i 'kho khrigasasu grags pa/ thems med/ skal ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa 'khor ba blos btang nas yang gsang bla med mkha' 'gro snying tig nyams su len pa rnams kyis 'byung gnas 'gro gsum la blta ba'i sku gsum ngo sprod yang gsang mthar thug mkha' 'gro snying tig /thems med/ nyams su len pa'i rtags yig zur tsam bkod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ nyams su len pa rnams kyi don du 3 kyi yi ge zur tsam bkod pa 'o'i mtha' can rnams/ ma gsum bu gnyis lnga yis 'khrid kyi lag len rdzogs de las mang nyung byung na gdams pa 'chal: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces zhes so/ /bzhi pa lam gyi kha skong rgyab chos ma bu'i skor la/ 'gor skad shan sbyar (204na)ba'i mkha' 'gro snying tig ces pa yod pa'i snying tig rṣa mo don mchog man ngag snying bas/ rtog te dbu nas zhabs su don bcus gtan la dbab pa rgya bod gnyis na med pa'i gdams pa khyad par can smyo rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi gnad thams cad gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du gtan la dbab pa bstan pa thams cad kyi khong snying ( go te re)long ba'i sna 'khrid dang 'dra ba mya ngan las 'das pa dngos la skad cig gis sbyor bar byed pa mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i yang bcud snying po gsal ba'i me long / lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi lam 'khyer rnal 'byor bzhi'i man ngag gi gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhus ga gser gyi 'phreng ba/ ḍā zhi'i zhal gdamasagasang ba'i dum bu/ chos 'di theg dgu mtha' dag las khyad par 'phags tshul tshem skal ldan ma/ sgomimed/ skal ldan lam du la jug pa'i gnad kyi zhal gdams khregs chod kyi ngo sprod/ rig pa lnga tshan du ngo 294

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ (gnasprod pa'i ti ka/nus 'kho/ḍā kyil ma 'bras sam zhal gdams yang zab gnad kyi dum bu/rigs brgyud gzhag pa'i 'kho gdams gnad kyi man ngag/thems med/phral bde ba la lam myur ba phyag rgya dang thig le la spang bya dang bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/rigs brgyud gzhag pa la nyes pa mi 'byung tshul zhal gdams gnad kyi 'phreng ba/thems med/ḍā ki gnad kyi man ngag gnad ti ka spyi don rnam pa lngas bstan pa/phyag rgya ma lam du byed pa rdo rje chu 'dren chu 'thung gi man ngag/snying du sdug pa/dbang 204bdu bya ba/'bral mi phod pa dang gsum gyi dbang sdud snying bskul gyi gdams pa/thems med/gegs sel mo gdon bsrung ba/bud med kyis skyes pa dbang du bsdub/4sar/zil gnon seng ge'i tsakra/'du byed pho dung gi tsakra/mdzes byed rma bya'i tsakra gsum la brten pa'i dbang du sdud pa yang khol gyi gdamasapa rnams/sku mir/ma lnga bu bzhis chos kyi rgyab yig tshang:de las mang nyung byung na gdams pa 'chal:de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces zhes so//lnga pa le lo can srid pa bar mar grol ba bar do ma bu cha lag dang bcas pa'i skor la/rdo rje lam gyi mas nyid rtog te re cis pa zhi ba'i bar do/bar do gnad kyi sgron ma rtog kho)zhes pa khro bo'i bar do/bar do'i zhal gdams 'byung ba 'dus (rgo te ge pa dang bral ba'i rtags rim/bar do'i zhal gdams rtog te re)gnad kyi dum bu/bdag la skye gnas bar do shar dus 'dir zhes ( gte sogasakyi bar do lam 'khyer gyi gnad yig tshigs bcad ma/phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ba brtag thabs/themasamed/phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'chi ba blu thabs/tshe gzugs brtag cing tshe sgrub bya ba/thems med/phyag rgya mtshan ldan tshe lam can la brten nas 'chi ba blu ba/bya sla /na che tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum chung/themasamed/bde ba lam du 'byer ba mkha' 'gro'i gtum mo ( gtegs nga 'khrid rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ku su lu'i cha rkyen rdo'i snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud len khyad par can rnams/ma gnyis bu gsum 205nadag gis bar do 'grub de las chad lhag byung na gdams pa 'chal de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces de yi cha lag gas mo'i gdams pa dang 9 rdo rje'i bas kyi bdud rtsi'i bas len gnyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shelto dang gos la zhen pa gcod phyir dgos zhes so/ /drug pa snying po'i bstan pa bsrung ba bka' srung gi skor la/ mu stegs srog sgrub nag mo'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ gsod byed srog sgrub nag mo'i sgrub thabs/ srog sgrub gnad kyi spu gri 'gyu dus thun drug sogs spyi don lngas bstan pa/ mu stegs khros ma nag mo'i man ngag logs su gab pa bla rdo cho 'phrul dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang 'brom bza' byang chub sman la 'khrungs pa'i lha lcam padma gsal lo brgyad pa'i steng du gshegs pa'i tshe mnga' bdag gis slob dpon la zhus pa'i gter ston gyi lung bstan zhar la kun mkhyen klong chen pa dang padma gling pa'ang zur tsam bstan pa/ snying tig sbyin zhing spel ba'i gnang ba byin pa'i lung bstan ci phyir de yi thugs rjes nges par skyob kyi mtha' can/ thems med/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po nyams su len tshul snying tig kun gyi dgongs pa gcig tu btus nas zur thamasacad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyis zin bris thems med/ sbar bcangs su btab pa rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las gter gyi rtags yod pa ma gtogos pa'i dbang 'khrid lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ (205ba)sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ yang sprul rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes garsā/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyisapa/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha lcam padma gsal/ sprul sku padma lasa'abrel rtsal/ sho'i rgyal sras legs ldan/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa/ mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ chos rje sangs rgyas dbon po/ stag mgo yon tan dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa/ mtshungs med bkra shisargya mtsho/ rig 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ kun dga' tshe mchog nas/ pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter —296

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ rgyal sras legs ldan nas/ ga rma pa rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ sprul sku chos kyi rdo rje/ gu ru nam mkha' rdo rje/ bla ma tshul khrims 'bum/bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rje 'phrin las 'bum/ paṇa chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ rdza yig pa kun mkhyen chen po/ rtse le rig 'dzin/thugs sras rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rje 'phrin (206na)las mtshan can/ rje kun bzang dpal 'byor/mtshungs med mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen klong chen pa nas/ ye shes rab 'byams/ bsam gtan pa/sbyin pa bzang po/ zab lung sprul sku/ rdzogs chen pa bsod nams rin cen/ rtse le rig 'dzin chen po man gong bzhin no/ /mnga' bdag sras mo'i skye ba rin cen tshul rdor gyis phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i gsang ba'i bdag po dregs pa kun 'dul gyi skor la gtum po thugs kyi sgrub pa'i las byang dbang bka' rin cen 'phreng ba gnyis la brten nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sku'i dbang la/ dbu rgyan gyis rigs lnga'i dbang / bum dbang gis sna drangs pa'i lha dbang / dpal gyi chas dbang / phyag mtshan gyi dbang / zhabs kyi dbang / klu chen brgyad kyi dbang / glegs bam la brten nas bsrung dbang ting nge 'dzin gyi thugs dbang / mtshan ldan phyag rgya la brten nas yon tan gyi dbang / sku gsum ngo sprod la brten nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum sangs rgyas kyi dbang / 'phrin las gtor ma'i dbang dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/ lung gi skor la/ thems byang las/ kun 'dul rgyud dang sgrub thabs dang : las tshogs rnams kyi tho byang bstan zhes dang / yi dam khyad 'phags dregs pa kun 'dul la 'chal gyis dogs nas thems byang bstan pa 'di ma 'ongs las can gcig dang phrad par shog:ces pa ltar thog (206ba〉par thems byang de las 'phros pa rtsa ba rgyud kyi skor/ sgrub thabs las tshogs kyi skor dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ nā ga bdud 'dul nag po'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa rdzogs byang phrad —297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheshog gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa la phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ sku sgrub/ gsung sgrub/ thugs sgrub/'phrin las kyi sgrub pa/ yon tan gyi sgrub pa/ kha stong / thems med skor dang bcu/ dang po la rtsa sgrub dang las tshogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub sbrel ba man ngag gi sgrub thabasasam phyi sgrub gnad kyi gdams pa phrad shog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa las tshogs la khyad par dang thun mong gnyis/ dang po la glo bur skyin thang 'bebs pa/ gzhan gyi rbod gtong zlog pa/ tsi tsi dzwa la bsrung ba gsum las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa thun mong la/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg /sa bdag klu gnyan gdul ba/ liṅga la brten na spos bdag klu gnyan/ rgyal po/ gza' rnamasagasod pa/ drag po'i thun bdun gyis gsod pa/ drag po'i zor bdun gyis gsod pa/ mi mthun zlog pa'i las mtha'/ rta rmig la brten nas gnod byed dgug cing gsod pa/ drag po'i tho sar 'bebasapa'i las mtha'/ thog ser zlog pa'i las mtha'/ gdug pa klu'i gtad khram/ rdo rje'i las rim zhesapa klu gzir ba/ mi 'gul ba/ 'bros pa/ dbang du bya ba/ sad ser dang rlung zlog pa/ gdon brlag pa/ bsrung ba/ sa rdo na/ shing 'bru gcod/ gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa rnams/ gnyis pa nang sgrub la rtsa sgrub dang las tshogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtum po'i nang (207na tshe skrub snying gi dum bu rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa la/ bum pa'i las mtha'/ khyad par nad pa gsob/ gtor sgrub dbang bskur gyi las mtha'/ gnam lcags spu gri reg gcod ces man ngag khol chung lha 'dre kun gyi snying gzer dregasapa'i srog thig las mkhan bskul ba'i lcags dug can bcud phur sngags zlog la nang gses kyi btson bu dong du gsad pa/ ngag 'byed gyi ling sgrog 'grol/ sgrogs rdo lam du gcag pa/ sdig phrug ma la shed 'bebs/ gzhan yang phar thebs tshur mi zlog pa/ nyung la tshang ba/ lag len bde ba/ lta ba mtho ba/gdeng gsum/ tshad gsum/ gsal ba gsum/ gnad gsum/ dpa' ba bzhi/ 'khor lo dang bcas pa ste spyi don bcu bzhis bstan pa/ gza' rgod 'jig rten pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba dug gi spu gri la/lo rgyus bca' gzhi/ dmigs bzlas/ rtags sbyor/ 'chi dus btab pa/ zhar byung cho 'phrul/ thog ser/—298

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganargyun gtor/ bla rdo dang bcas pa/ drag sngags 'dus pa'i mtshon cha sde brgyad wa thod nag po spyi don rnam drug gis bstan pa mjug tu lo rgyus/ tsakra 'dri tshul/ gong gnon dang bcas pa/ bskrad pa'i 'khrul 'khor dom lag ma zhan byung dus tshod 'jug thabs bstan pa/ nye 'byed se shing sbu gri zhes pa mir ma zad lha mi dbye ba/ rja dmar thugs sgrub spyi don gsum gyis bstan pa zhar la dbang sdud 'khor lo/zas/ nor/ slob ma/ bu/ bud med/ mal gos/ khrom rnams dbang sdud dang rta phyugs spel ba/ god kha bsrung ba dang bcas pa las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'gom chog phra (207ba)men 'khor lo gsum ma bsod nams rgyun gcod/ de'i 'khor lo'i zhal khrigs spyi don drug gis bstan pa dang bcarsāpa/ phung byed khang sel ra dom nag po rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dam log sngags pa ngag gnon rang 'og ma/ rang gshed sde brgyad gnad 'khor rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa gsang sgrub la rtsa sgrub dang las tshogos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtum po mchog gi sgrub thabs gsang ba zhan byung dngosagrub bsgrub pa dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa la/ las bzhi'i me mchod rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ bstod pa dmar nag gru gsum ma/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi zhal gdams 'di 'phyong rgyas kyi 'ching bar stag rtse'i mchod rten na na ponas thos zer ba ga /bzhi pa sku'i sgrub pa la rtsa sgrub dang las tshogs gnyis/ dang po la/ gtum po klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ de'i 'phrin las rdo rje gtum po'i las byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnyis pa ni/ gsang phur las tshogs nyer gcig pa bzhed pa/ klu bsrung / sad bsrung / shwa zlog /sdum zhing gi sems can gsod pa/ 'bu btsa' bsrung ba/ zhing la lo mi skye ba/ rta phyugs 'chi ba/ dgra 'chi ba/ sa bkra ngan pa bsrung ba/ lha 'dre zil gnon/ spyo bog gdul ba/ mdze gsob/ zlog pa/ sri'u gsob/ nad pa gsob/ gdon gdul/ zho chang bsrung ba/ngag gnon/ mdzes 'dzin pa/ kha phung du gtong ba/ ngabs gcod pa rnams klu gter gzhug pa/ klu'i rten spo thabs/ klu byad dgrol ba/ klu gta' sdom pa/ de bzhi pa'i bum gter bca' thabs thems med zhi drag po shin tu drag po gsum gyi sgo nas 'bebs pa'i char chog phrad shog gi mtha' can/ klu'i —299—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negadon dgrol ba'i cho ga (208na)bsam yas sa 'dul gyi don du slob dpon rṣa pos mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa gsung gi sgrub pa la rtsa sgrub dang las tshogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gtum po nā ga bdud 'dul gsung gi sgrub thabs rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa la/drag po thun gyi klu gsod pa/ yungs dkar gyi las mtha' la/ sad ser/ rlung char/ mdze gdon bsrung ba/ char 'bebs/ klu 'dul/ ral gri'i las mtha' la klu dang 'byung po gdon gdul ba/ sad bsrung /ser 'bebs/ rdzasang na las mtha' la/ gdon bgegs 'bros pa/ ser 'bebs/ rang bsrung / sri'u dang smyo bog gso ba/ zho chang / rims/ lhog skrangs/ shu 'bras bsrung ba/ 'khor lo'i las mtha' la brten nas bskams nas 'chi ba/ pha tshan 'thab pa/ mdzes 'dzin pa/ lkugs pa/ grong khyer 'khrug pa/skyod pa/ smyo byed/ dbang du bya ba/ gsod pa/ zas nor spel ba/ gdon bsrung gnyis/ rbod gtong zlog pa/ sri'u gso ba/ lhog bsrung / ngan thabs las mtha' la/ mdzes 'gas pa/ dbugs ma bde bar 'gum pa/ rgyu zhags 'khol nas 'chi ba/ mtshan ma skrangs nas 'chi ba/ mdzes khyer ba/ dam log sngags pa ngag gnon rnams 'di thems la nang sgrub la yang 'dug pa gnyis ga'i las mthar 'das dgos pa zhig yin nam 'di dang mi 'dra ba'i ngag non yod dpyad do/ /drug pa thugs sgrub la rtsa sgrub dang las tsho gos gnyis/ dang po ni/gtum po chen po khro rgyal 'dus pa'i thugs sgrub bam hūṃ sgrub rgya bdun btab pa'i mtha' can/ gnyis pa la/ rdo rje gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig ma zhes pa gdab las kyi (208ba)rim pa bsam yas bzheng dus lha 'dre 'das btul ba mnga' bdag la gdams pa'i mtha' can/ rdo rje gtum po khro bo bcu'i las byang don gsum pa/ tshogs mchod rgyal po dang 'tsho rgyal gnyis la gdams pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/bdun pa 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa ni/ dregs pa kun 'dul 'phrin las gtad kyi gdams pa/ brgyad pa yon tan gyi sgrub pa ni/ gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rdzas chen rgas pa sra zhing tshe nyi zla ltar 'gyur ba phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dgu pa kha skong skor la/ sgrub chen gyi khog phub las can la phrad shog dang rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dbang bka' rin cen 'phreng ba phrad shog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dregs 'dul —300

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)khyung rgod kyi gdams pa la/ sngags la brten nas rang bsrung / rdzas la brten nas klu/ rgyal btsan/ ma mo/ 'gong po/ rims rnams gzhan la bsrung ba/ 'khor lo la brten nas bsrung ba/ gdon bskrad/gzer/ gsod pa/ bsreg mnan/ gdon btul nas gso ba/ ser zlog rnams phrad shog gi mtha' can/bcu pa thems med skor la/ dregs pa kun 'dul khros pa'i dril sgrub zhar byung sngags dang rdzas la brten nas sde brgyad brlag pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum gnon pa/ dregs pa kun 'dul snying po bsdus pa'i sgrub pa rtags yig las sbyor bstod pa dang bcas pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ burnya'i ngag 'byed khyad 'phagasaphrad shog gi mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes phyi nang gsang gsum du sgrub pa/ gcig chod gnad kyi spu gri gtad khram kun gyi yang snying zlog med gser phug gi las rang la mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i bri yig phrad (209na〉skog gi mtha' can/ gter bdag ldang lha'i sgrub pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ lha btsan gying gi cho 'phrul phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ dpe'u ris skor la/ phyi sgrub la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang ser 'bebs kyi bcas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor/ klu/ klu btsan/ klu bdud/ sa bdag /klu srin/ gnyan/ rgyal po/ gza' rnams gsad pa'i liṅga / dgug zad gi bcas/ thog ser dbab pa'i bcas/ thog bsrung / klu gtad 'khor lo/ sbal pa'i gson gtad rdo rje'i dpe'u ris/ nang sgrub/ bum pa'i dkyil 'khor/ gtor ma'i dkyil 'bor/ ba 'a bu dong du gsod pa'i 'bor lo/ rbod gtong zlog pa'i 'khor lo/ rang bsrung 'khor lo/ spu gri reg gcod kyi zlog gsad kha bsgyur/ dkyil 'khor liṅga/gza' rgod dug gi spu gri'i bcas rnams gzhud gi dngos bstan dang / gsang rten bla rdo/ ol dgag /rang bsrung stod gnon sgab 'dre gnon pa sogs gzhung gi tshig zin la med kyang gza' rgod dug gi spu gri nas kha bskangs pa'i lag len 'phrul shes par 'dug /sde brgyad wa thod ma'i bca' gzhi liṅga nang 'gras ngag gnon/ dom lag ma'i bcas/ rtse shing rma 'i liṅga / rjo dmar/ 'gom chog /khang sel gyi bcas/ ngag gnon gyi ling 'khor/ sde brgyad gnad dbab/ lha srin srog gzir gyi dkyil 'khor/ rgyal po dang 'gong po gnad dbab/ bdud dam gtad/ bse rag kha 'ching / btsan gnad dbab/ gtsang —301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebatsan rengs pa/ gza' brgyad klad kor/ 'gong po brdung ba/ gnod sbyin/ bgegs/ yul lha/ srin po/ klu bdud/ ma mo gnad dbab/ gnad dbab (209ba 'di rnams gzhud gi tshig zin med kyang gnyen po lha gsum nas 'phrul shes pa yin/ sku sgrub la/ seng phur/ klu gter/ char 'bebs skor gyi bcas/bsrung sgrub/ ral gri/ 'byung po zho chang brku ba'i gzungs/ lus skams pa rus sbal 'khor lo/ 'thab pa bsgrub bya'i 'khor lo mdzes khyer ba sprul 'khor/ lkugs pa lug 'khor/ grong khyer 'khrug pa rta drel lor lo/ yul 'don rnga 0 'khor lo/ smyo ba phug ra 'bor lo/ dbang sdud bha ga'i 'bor lo/ 'ong ba spre'u'i 'khor lo/ zas nor 'phel ba glang 'khor/ gdon zhi ba zla ba'i 'khor lo/ bgegs zhi ba rgya gram 'bor lo/ rbod gtang zlog pa seng 'khor/ sri'u gso ba sre mo 'bor lo/ gdon thub rma bya'i 'bor lo/ lhog bsrung phag 'khor/ ngan thabs kyis mjal bskur ba/ dbugs mi bde bar 'gum pa/ rgyu zhabs 'khol ba/ mtshan ma bskrangs pa rnams kyi bca' gzhi/ 'phrin las sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi 'khor lo/ khyung sgrub bsrung 'khor/ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dpe ris/ gcig chod gnad kyi spu gri'i bca' gzhi 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ drin can o rgyan rṣa po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston rin cen tshul rdor/ sho ban rgyal sras legs ldan/ sprul sku klong chen rab 'byams/ mkhas grub chos rje gter ston padma gling pa/de la drin can gsang sngags rdo rje dang sprul sku chos kyi dbang pos gsan/ gnyis ka la mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje (210na)chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog /ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / bkra shis rgya mtsho man gong ltar/ yang na rje rin cen phun tshogs nas/ chos rje nyi zla sangs rgyas dkar rṣa lan pu a mi/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ des bdag la'o/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog nas/ rig 'dzin gzhen nu —302

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnadon grub/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sho ban nas rim par/ gu ru nam mkha' rdo rje/ rgod 'brug snyan brgyud ras pa/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gzhon nu don grub man gong bzhin no/ /sprul sku las 'brel rtsal gyis phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin gnyen po lha gsum gyi skor la/ byin rlabs dbang gi 'phreng ba'i steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/lha dbang / klu chen brgyad/ sngags/ gtor ma/ khrus/ yungs dkar sogs rten 'brel rdzas dbang dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ rtsa brgyud/ de las 'phros pa'i phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub/ sgrub pa gsum gyi cha lag /smin byed dbang / bsrung brtag phan byed/ gnod byed gtad/ man ngag thor bu/ gter srung / chos bdag lung bstan dang bcu gcig /dang po ni/ nā ga klu 'dul gyi rgyud le'u so bdun pa/ gnyis pa phyi sgrub la/ phyi sgrub klu dgus bskor ba'i sgrub thabs bu la spel yang mna' lan gsum bya ba'i mtha' can/ de'i las byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ seng ldeng phur (210ba)pa'i las tshogs nyi shu rtsa ga ṇi ga pa/ 'di dregs 'dul na yod pa dang gcig kyang tshig zhus dag mi pher/ gsum pa nang sgrub la/ sgrub thabs rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rta mgrin lha gsum la gtor ma gtong ba'i rim pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can gza' klu gdul ba'i sgrub pa bsam yas sa 'dul dus slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa/ gsad pa las kya man ngag drag po thun bdun gyis las bstan pa/ 'go mjug tsam ma gtogs dregs 'dul dang mthun/drag po gsum dril gyi sbyin sreg gi las rim bstan pa/ mnan pa mtsho nang rdo skyur/ 'phung byed ser ba'i las mtha' spel bar ma phod pa sbas byang gi mtha' can/ gtad kyi las mthar/ mdze nad 'khor lo/ bsrung ga bor rdo rje'i go rgyan/ bsrung skud 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/seng lcags tsandan gsum la brten pa'i phur bsrung phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bgegs dpung zil gnon bsrung ba kun mchog rnams/ bzhi pa gsang sgrub la/ sgrub thabs klu rigs bzhis skor ba drag sngags gnad kyi phreng ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bum pa'i las tshogs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ yungs gar las mtha' gang byed las la tsam chog /dregs 'du po dang don 'dra yang tshig zhus su pa mi pher/ seng phur las mtha' —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsālas kun 'grub byed/ ral gri'i las mtha' nad gdon kun las thar byed/ dregs bol na yod pa dang don 'dra spungs khag mi pher/rdo rje'i las mtha' 'dzam gling bod yul na dkon pa/ lcugs ma'i las mthas sad ser dang sri'u bsrung ba/ klu dbang du bsdub/ klu nad gsob/ rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog bgegs kun gdul ba bsam pa kun 'grub/ gu gul las mtha' gdon/ dregs 'du pa dang phal cher (211na tshe rtsa dag pher/ rims/sri'u zho chang bsrung ba kun la med pa/ 'khor lo'i las mtha' las bzhi sgrub pa'i kha bsgyur can/ dregasakhrul na yod pa dang si zhug mi pher/ngan thabs las mtha' zab mo thun mong ma yin pa/ dreg phrul dang rdzo zhusami pher/ las mtha' de rnams kyi gnad yig rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa sgrub pa gsum gyi cha lag la/ lung bstan gleng bslangs ma ti sgom pa dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags rim bcas pa'i bskyed rim le'u bzhi pa/ ting 'dzin khyad par 'phags pa las can 'phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gnyen po lha gsum gyi sgrub thabs bsnyen pa'i cho ga /bzlas pa bya thabasamajug tu lha thams cad gcig tu bsdu ba'i man ngag /las byang tshogs mchod dang bcas pa/ zhal gdamasalogs su gab pa kun la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya can rnams/ drug pa smin byed dbang ni/ khro bo lha gsum gyi byin rlabs dbang gi 'phreng ba phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bdun pa bsrung brtags phan byed la/ drag po sngags kyi 'phreng ba phrad shog gi mtha' can/ khra bo bsrung ba'i 'phreng ba zhes pa dgongs pa/ phyag rgya/sngags/ 'khor lo/ rten 'brel rdzas/ mi mthun rdzas rnams kyi bsrung ba/ brtag pa gsal ba'i 'phreng ba le'u bcu gsum pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dkar po sman rtog te re/gyi 'phreng ba/ nā ga klu 'dul ba'i ( go te je)nyams len man ngag gi 'phreng ba le'u bcu gsum pa/ klu gdul zhing lha srin sde brgyad 'gag bsdams pa'i nag po rdzas 'phreng kun thub rgyal po/ za ba/ byug pa/ bcang pa/ bdug pa/ dus tshone dang sbyor ba/ kha yar gyi bsrung ba ste nag po rdzas phreng le'u (211ba)bdun pa/ spyi gnad lnga dang srog gzer gcig gi sgo nas sde brgyad srog dang dbral ba/ rgyal po gnad la bor ba/ 'gong po gnad la dbab pa/ bdud dam la 'dogs pa/ bse rag kha 'ching / btsan rgod dru gu thul du gsad pa/ gtsang —304

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabatsan rengs su gzhug pa gza' brgyad klad la kor ba/ 'gong po shi sa bstan pa/ gnod sbyin gnad la dbab pa/ yul lha gnad la dbab pa/ srin po gnad la dbab pa/ klu shi sa bstan pa/ the'u brang shi sa bstan pa/ ma mo dbang du bsdu zhing rdzu 'phrul srog dang dbral ba rnams la pho gnad bcu gsum dang mo gnad bdun par grags pa/ gnyon po lha gsum gyis gdon grol ba rnams/ brgyad pa gnod byed gtad gyi skor la/ sa bdag gza' klu'i gnyen po sgrub pa le'u bsrung ba drag po gsum dril bstod pa chu klung rab 'khrug dang bcas pa/ gtad rgyud gsal sgron gyi thems byang / rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul gtad rgyud gsal ba'i sgron me le'u bcu gnyis pa/ chu rlung rab tu 'khrug byed btsan dug drag rtog te re/reg gcod kyi le'u drug pa/ las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i leg tsakra dang lidma'i bca' gzhi bstan pa le'u bdun pa/ ( gte re/khol du phyung ba bca' gzhi'i le'u rgya gsum mtha' can/ gsur gtad dran phung nag po/gsur gtad dug sbrul khug pa/ gsur gtad kyi kha gzan skyur/ rtags mtshan ma byung na klu'i rtsa(gter)sngags srog snying bzla thabs/ gsur gtad kyi 'grel pa snying gi dum bu zhes pa gnyen po'i lha ma bsgrubasapar gtad na rang phung tshul/ bskam gtad gshed gtad kyis dmigs kyi les las sbyor gtad kyi rim pa shin tu rtsub par ( go te re)grags pa'i sa 'tshol le'u brgyad pa/ dngos (212na loms rmi ltas chu mig gi mdog /gtad len mi len/ bzlog rtags la ting 'dzin rdzas kyis lam spyod pa klu'i sar 'gro dus kyi dmigs bzlas sogs ston pa zhal gdams rtog te re/snying dang 'dra ba logs su gab pa nyams kyi 'phreng bar grags pa/ sde brgyad kyi rtog te re/thun sngags/ gsang gtad kyi dus (gte gi klu slong ba'i gdams pa/ gtad kyi spyi thems rtog te re/gsal ba'i sgron me snying la bstim pa'i gdams pa/ slob dpon rṣa po la spa gor bee ro tsa nas zhus pa'i rtog te shegato kyi spyi don zhus lan 'phrul gyi me long rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gtad rgyud gsal sgron gyi gnad kyi spu gri zhes pa bca' bzhi rang la mi bzlog pa 'khor lo 'dri thabs gsum bstan pa shin tu gsang ba'i mtha' can/ gtad rgyud gsal sgron nas logs su gab pa sa gsung dur dri nag po zhes pa mnan gtad kyi thems med mi rung / gtad —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shekyi khong snying las sbyor thams cad kyi kha skong cog brdung srog gi sbu gri zhes pa gsal sgron gyi 'grel pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ gtad bzlog nag po'i 'khor lo/ gtad bzlog bande nag po'i gshed chen/gtad bzlog gshed nag las kyi mthar thug /g.yin gyi tshur gtad bcug pa (gte re/bzlog pa dang gtad mkhan rang gshed ( go te re)la 'bebs pa gsal sgron gyi zhal gdams ma bu ma lus pa/ gsang sgo rnam pa bcu bdun/ 9te ge gyi ngos 'dzin gto bsrung rdo rje'i go cha/ rdo rje gcig thub bsrung ba/med thabs med pa'i rdzas bsrung / bskyed rdzogs bzlas gsum gyis bsrung ba/ lam bcad pa'i man ngag gzhan la yod na dkon cog dpang por bzhugs pa/ sgo dgu 'gag pa'i bsrung ba/ rigs bzhi'i (212ba/klu la nyam nga med pa'i bsrung ba/ spyi mgrin lte ba gsang gnas bzhi rdzas kyis bsrung ba/ klu gdon gyis mi tshugs pa'i rdzas sbyor/ dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa'i rdzas sbyor/ 'di phyi gto du mi bzlog pa'i gtad bsrung / lgang phug nang du khrag sna sogs sdugs pa/ mchod rten/ bsod na mas tshogos gsog /rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog sogs ston rtog te re)pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ rdo rje sems la brten pa'i khrusartog te re/chog rnams/ dgu pa man ngag thor bu la/ o rgyan chen pos slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gser srang brgya phul nas/ zhug pa'i spu gri cog brdung rang gshed 'bebs pa'i las/ slob dpon chen pos so sa gling du mkha' 'gro ma su kha sirnyi la zhus pa'i drag po cog brdung thog dang 'dra ba'i spu gri/ dbang chen lto 'khor sde brgyad kyis bsrung ba yid bzhin nor bu/ gshin rje bsrung ba/ klu dang sa bdag bsrung ba/ bdud bsrung / rgyal bsrung / ma mo bsrung ba/ sde brgyad spyi bsrung / go ldog 'khor los chu dang ser ba sde brgyad bzlog pa/ nad 'gras bzlog pa sngags pa stong dang 'gras kyang nyam nga med pa gza' bdud gshor ba nag po'i drags ser 'bebs pa'i rgyud le'u drug pa rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang mtshams nas slob dpon chen pos spyan drangs te phra mo brag tu sbas pa/ gza' rgod gzhor ba nag po'i drag ser gyi gdams pa bskal pa zhabrugs kyang khar mi dbyung ba rnams/ bcu pa gter srung la/ldang lha spun gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub (gi te re/las gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum spu gri cog brdung —306

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnam/ bskul lha yi ( go te re)dge bsnyen ma/ lha btsan ( gte re)ging gi cho 'phrul/ lha dang phral ba (gter)bya lug la brten pa/(213na7chod rten la brten pa'i ( gte shesgo dbye/ sel (gter)gtong ba/ gsol kha bdud (gi te re/yul ma rnams/ bcu gcig pa lung bstan la/ chos bdag lung bstan padma'i thugs sras la sprod pa'i mtha' can dang bcas pa/ dpe ris la/ lha gsum gyi bsrung 'khor/ zlog 'khor/gsal sgron 'jam gtad kyi 'khor lo/ sbal pa dkar nag gi gtad 'khor rgyas bsdus gnyis/ ling rkyang mi gcig pa gnyis/ chu rlung zhabrug byed kyi pho 'khor mo 'khor/ sgrom shing / gtad zlog rang gshed dbab pa'i 'khor lo/ mchod rten/ 'brub khung gi dpe/ rang bsrung lto 'khor ma/ gsal sgron lasasbyor le'u las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor rnams legs par thob pa'i gter gyi rtags can rnams dang gdon dgrol ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha lcam padma gsal/gter ston padma las 'brel rtsal/ ston pa shākya byang chub/ gu ru chos rgyal rdo rje/ grub chen kun dga' 'byung gnas/ bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ sprul sku nam mkha' lhun grub/ yongs 'dzin shākya snying po/bla ma shākya don grub/ grub chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ thog yag pa bla ma brtson 'grus bzang po/ sprul sku o rgyan dpal 'byor/ rdzogs chen pa lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal/ dar sdings rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter gyi rtagasacan rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub nas/(213ba tshe sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gdon dgrol gyi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas/ rgyal sras legs ldan/ dri med 'od zer/ thar pa gling pa/ padma gling pa/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje/ mchog sprul legasaldan rdo rje/ 'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje du ma rang grol/pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gzhon nu don grub yab sras nas brgyud do/ /gter ston padma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter gyi gter ma'i thugs rje chen po'i 'jig rten dbang —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nephyug dmar po sgrub pa dbang phyug rlung gi zhags pa'i chos skor gyi lung mnos pa la/ dkar chag /mdzes ma rgyan 'khor gyi le'u brgyad pa/ gtor dbang gi yi ge /bstod pa rgya mtsho chen po ma/ bskul dbang phyug yab yum ma/ na rī bsten pa'i skor la zla ba brtson 'dzin/ u ma de ba'i thabs lam/ gzhan rkyen gyi thig le bsrung ba/ nal bu sgrol ba/ nus stobs bskyed pa'i sbyor ba/ mngal bsrung mtshan brjod skor la/ mu stegs kyi dgra bo gsod pa'i mtshon cha rlid bu phu 'debs/ sngags kyi dag yig /rkyal bu phu 'debs/ ltas ngan smyo bog gtong ba/ sgab 'dre mnan pa/ mchims rdo rje spre chung la gsungs pa'i log gnon gyi man ngag bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa/ nye byed sna 'bebs kyi skor la/ mngal khrag mi thub pa/skra byi ba/ dri mi zhim pa gtong ba/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gsal mthong dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ mchims kyi rdo rje spre chung gter ston rin cen tshul (214na)rdor/ rgyal sras legs ldan/ mkhas grub dri med 'od zer/ rje thar pa gling pa/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ rje sangs rgyas dbon po/ gnas brtan yon tan dpal ba/ rje sangs rgyas ye shes/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin kun dga' dpal bzang / rje bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin du ma rang grol/ pha jo gzhon nu don grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston las 'brel rtsal gyis phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje zhing dang nag po gshor gsang nyi ma khros kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs gnon pa sto nag las kyi 'brub khung kha la rgyas 'debs kyi skor la/ sa bdag gdug pa'i srog 'khor mu khyud bcu gcig pa kha la rgyas 'debasachen mo dgra mnan bar gcod kun 'joms su grags pa tshe 'di la dgra ldang mi srid pa'i mtha' can/mu khyud bdun pa kha la rgyas 'debs 'bring po phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ling rkyang la brten pa'i kha la rgyas 'debs chung ba lag len ma bsgrigs pa 'o'i mtha' can/ zhor sgrub glang ru la brten nas dgra jag 'ching ba skabs su thun gso 'o'i mtha' can/ de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge gter —308

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogananas gdan drangs pa'i mtha' can/ jag 'ching gi phyogs dang sngags kyi mtha' bsgyur lugs/ dgra phye ru 'thag pa rang 'thag gi 'khor lo/ rang 'thag 'khor lo 'bri tshul gyi yig chung / dgra rlung la 'phyar ba 'phan dar gyi 'khor lo rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i lag len gyi yi ge gter ma yang dag pa'i mtha' can/ shog ser gyi zhal gdams yig chung zhes pa bdag (214ba)dang 'khor lo'i ting 'dzin dang rang 'thag gi rdzas sngags sogs bstan pa shog ser gyi zhal gdams zab mo phra mo brag nas bton pa'i mtha' can/ bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs/ mdun bskyed kyi gsod khang liṅga gtso bo yab yum la ya ma rā dza/ e ka dza ṭi/ btsan 'gong yab shud dmar po/ bdud po skos rjes 'brang dkar rnams kyis bskor ba'i mngon rtogs nya bo 'dri pa'i spyod lam/ lha dbye gnad lnga ma/ bla 'gugs/ liṅga sgril ba'i dmigasapa dang mnan pa bya tshul du ru ga'i dmag kyang bzlog pa'i mtha' can/ sgab 'dre gnod sbyin sbrang chags spun gsum gnon pa/ ngag gnon lirsha'i bri yig /dgra spyi'i liṅga 'dri tshul/ thod pa'i yi ge /lte ba'i gnad/ ling khrus/ 'grol med/ rdzas mig dgu/ mun gling / rjes gcod dang bcas pa'i zhal gdams/sde brgyad gang la gtad kyis dmigs ngos 'dzin/ bla 'gugs mnan pa gsad pa gsum gyi sngags byang / mnan bskul de ring mo dgra bo ma ldang zhig gi mtha' can/ dmod bcol ring mo rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ zhal gdams chen mo zhes pa la gong gnon gyi sngags/ gsang mnan gzir ba'i ting 'dzin/dbye rdzas thun rdzas dngos 'dzin/ 'grub rtags/ sa dmigs/ 'jug snod thod pa'i dbye ba/ rgya 'bri tshul/ byad thag tshon rdo chu'i rno 'don/ 'khor lo'i sprod lugs/ gto len gshin rje'i dmigs rim/rgyas 'debs lag len sngags 'byin 'jug /'khor lo'i bri gnad/ sham bu bsgyur ba dang bcas pa rgya gar bram ze dug nag gi gdams pa padma 'byung gnas kyi snying khrag las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rgyas 'debs tsho pho wor mo 'khor dang ling rkyang / 'bring (215na)pho pho wor mo lor dang ling rkyang / chung ba'i ling rkyang / sgab 'dre'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje lang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ ya ma rā dza/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes—309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neganyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge/ dpal o rgyan chen po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston rin cen tshul rdor/ grub chen legs ldan pa/ mtshudas med rang byung rdo rje/ mkhasagrub nor bu bzang po/ sprul sku mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje nyi zla 4sa rgyas/ de dbon nyi zla chos rje/bla ma nyi zla chos rje/ bla ma nyi ma zla ba/ drin can ku mā ra tha/ drin can ya du badzra/ lha sras rnam sprul 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs/ ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho/ g.yu sgra'i sprul pa kun dga' tshe mchog /rigs 'dzin kum rā dze'i rnam sprul gzhen nu don grub/ gnyags dzñā na'i rnam sprul chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor sngags spyon gyi mtshon char gnang ngo / /yang kha la rgyas 'debs 'bring po/ chung ba/ sngags byang / dmod pa mngon rtogs dang 'i bcas pa brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'bri gung zur pa nas/ lha sras rgyal po'i sprul pa chos rgyal phun tshogs/ gsang bdag rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi rnam sprul rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ des bdag la'o/ /khyab 'jug thems byang las/ e ma/ dregs pa kun gyi nang nas rdzu phrul can: rno ngar ldan pa'i spu gri cog brdung 'di dus kyi snyigs ma bstan pa 'jig pa'i dus chos 'khor gtsug lag 'jig cing kun la 'tshe:ma rungs gdug pa'i ru tra sdig spyod can (215ba)de dag sgrol phyir bdag 'dra padmas bsdebs zhes dregs pa'i sde dpon rnams kyi nang nas mthu dang rdzu 'phrul shin tu che zhing myur ba drang srong khyab 'jug rā hu la dug gi spu gri'i chos skor phra mo brag gi klu mo stag gdong gi sto ba nas sprul sku las 'brel rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs dbang / phyag mtshan gyi dbang / gza' chen brgyad phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i dbang / rnam dag gi dbang / gtor dbang bka' gtad bcas pas smin rgyas su mnos nas/ lung gi skor la/ thems can dang thems med gnyis/ dang po ni/ tho byang dngos/ de las byung ba'i gdams skor rtsa ba sgrub thabs skor/ man ngag gnad kyi skor/ mchod pa bstod bskul skor/ spa bkong cho 'phrul skor/ dag yig 'byin 'jug skor/ mdzo spyod las sbyor skor/ sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre mnan thabs dang bdun/ dang po ni/ rtsa —310

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganab drang srong khyab 'jug rā hu la'i gsang sgrub rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa man ngag gnad kyi skor la/ 'khor lo la brten nas gnad 'bebs shi sa bstan pa dang rtsa sngags la brten nas gnad 'bebs shi sa bstan pa'i gza' brgyad klad kor mar grags pa/ gza' bdud bla rje'i tsakra srog gi gnad yig /gces pa'i gnad drug la/ shi sa bstan pa/ bla rdo gzung ba/ zhud kha blang ba/ thugs dam skong ba/ rdzas kyi stod mnon/ rdzas kyi dud dbyung ste log gnon drug ces dpral ba'i mig dang khongasapa'i snying lta bu/ bsrung ba yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa khyab 'jug bka' nyan dang bcas pas sri zhu bran bzhin byed pa/ ༅da la smos kyi lha'i lo yang zer/rten dang tsakra gnyis kyi sgo nas o la sgo dgag pa (216na)rnams/ gsum pa mchod pa bstod bskul skor la/ gsol kha drag bskul dang bcas par bskang gsodug mtsho 'khyil ba/ dus brgyad kyi bskul nub nas shar bskyod ma/ bstod pa khyab 'jug chen po ma rnams/ bzhi pa spa bkong cho 'phrul skor la/ cho 'phrul sprel thod ma lha gnyis la brten nas phrad shog gi mtha' can/ sprel thod lha gsum ma zhes pa 'khor lo bca' gzhi/ bsgom bzlas/ bskul/ dag yig /rtags/ zhal gdams yig chung bcas bstan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa dag yig 'byin 'jug skor la/ dag yig sngags kyi 'bru thems 'byin 'jug dang bcas pa/ gsang sngagasadrag sngags kyi sham bu rnams/ drug pa mngon spyod las sbyor skor la/ rā hu la'i gdab las dug gi spu gri zhes pa drag po phur pa'i thun brgyad dbab pa/ bla gnas brtsi ba'i gdams pa 'di med mun pa'i mda' lta bu yin par gsungs pa/ gza' bdud gnad kyi man ngag zhal du bstab pa'i las rim 'gyu dus brgyad dang sbyor ba/ gza' bdud chen po'i bsreg zor gdug pa'i las 'gyu dus brgyad dang sbyor ba/gza' bdud chen po'i dgra bo mnan pa las kyi rim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yang 'jig na gzhan lta ci smos pa rnams/ bdun pa sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre gnon thabs ni/ med thabs med pa sgab 'gre gnon pa'i man ngag rang dang 'dra ba cig las shor re'i mtha' can no/ /gnyis pa thems med la/ man ngag gnad yig skor/ sgrub thabs las byed mdos kyi skor/ smin —311 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebyed dbang gi skor/ drag po las sbyor skor/ zab gnad zhal gdams skor/ rang gzhan phan (216ba)byed skor dang drug /dang po la/ mtsha' lu'i snying dang zangs phur la brten pa'i gsang rten bla rdo'i man ngag /gza' rgod stod la mnon pa'i tsakra phu las nyan pa'i gdams pa/ rang lus tshags su gzhug pa'i 'khor lo/ gza' bdud chen po drang srong bdun dang bcas pa'i srog thems go cha bgo ba/ bkra shis sirnya zhu ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas te rdzas sngags gsum bco lngas ol dgag pa zhar byung lto bar nor sgrub 'khor lo la brten pa longs spyod spel ba/ rdzas lnga gsum bco lnga la brten gyi rgyur byas te kha lte ba lgang pa rdzas sngags kyis dgag pa dang yum klu mo yin pa la brten nas dgag pa'i thabs cho 'phrul sprel thod ma'i bskul gza' mchog chen mo ma/ sgab 'dre the'u brang lnga'i 'khor lo 'dri tshul dang mnan pa bya ba'i las mtha' rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gza'i the'u brang dang dam sri mnan pa rta rmig ma/nor sgrub rin cen 'phreng ba/ gab gnad zhal gdams skor la/ drang srong shin tu 'bu bzlog chen sngags sdebs kyi gnad 'bebs shi sa bstan pa rā hu la khyi bzhin 'khor ba/ phyag rdor zhabs 'og tu snying khrag skyug pa'i gnad 'bebs/ god kha byung na nor la mi gnod longs spyod che ba'i thabs rbad pa'i dus tshur ldog pa byung na de'i gnyen po gnam lcags thog dang 'dra ba snang srid sil bur gtong ba/sprel thod ri ti'i zhal gdams ral gri phyung rgyag ma/ phyag rdor yab yum la brten nas kha bcings te mi nor gang la gnod mi tshugs pa/ sri'u la gza'i dug bsrung ba/ sri'u dang bud med la cho 'phrul bsrung ba/ nor sgrub 'jig rten rnyed dka' ba zhan byung dbang sdud dang bcas pa/ sngags chu (217na〉pa brten pa'i dug dbyung / spu gri'i so bzhin tshe srog gcod pa'i sngags byang / bzlas pa brgya rtsa la brten nas bran bzhin 'gyur thabs/ 'khor nor la gzan na gnya' gnon bse rag ba'i chings/ rang la ldog na sngags la brten nas ldog mi srid pa'i thabs/ cis kyang 'khu na gzir ba'i gnad 'bebs tshod zin par bya ba'i mtha' can/ 'chun na gso ba'i gdams pa rnams chos rje bya bral bzang po'i gsung rgyun/gnyis pa sgrub thabs las byang mdos kyi skor la/ gong gnon gsang bdag dang rā hu la'i mngon rtogs/—312

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaspyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ sman gtor/ bskul/ gsang ba/ gsol 'debs te don bdun gyis bstan pa'i las byang / las byang drag po'i las kyis gdug pa tshar gcod ma yang dag pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ las byang gza' bdud chen mo ma/ gsol kha bsdus pa chos nyid zhi ba ma/gsol kha sku gsum lhun grub ma/ zi ston rang grol lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsol kha sku gsum lhun grub ma/ des mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig gza' bdud kyi thugs dam bskang mdos dbyings dang ye shes ma/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rjes khyab 'jug zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa'i gsang bskul dpal ldan mgon po ma/ bskang mdos nag po dgu skor zhe sdang me 'bar ma/ zhing gang bu yug ma'i mdos slob dpon padmas mdzad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa smin byed dbang gi skor la/ gza' bdud kyi dbang bskur spyi don gsum gyis bstan pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i gtor dbang gi cha lag bka' (217ba)gtad chos brgyud 'dzin des re re las mi byed pa'i mtha' can no/ /bzhi pa drag po'i las sbyor skor la/ drag bskul dang gdab las chu 'babs su spel ba'i phyag len gyi mtshams sbyar dang bcas pa slob dpon chen po la bee ro tsa nas zhus pa'i zhu lan 'phrul gyi
