me long zhes pa gza' gdong lcam dral stong po hab sha ma'i rgyud bsdoms pa brgya tham pa rtsal ba'i dkar chag dang de rnams so sor zab pa'i ngos 'dzin/ o rgyan chen po la bee ros zhus pa'i khyab 'jug gling bzhi/ phyi nang gsang gsum/ thod rgal yang gsang / yum sprul pa/ pho nya/ phyag brnyan/ sna 'dren ltar 'gyu tshul/ rgyu 'jug gnas gsum/ drag bzlog /'gyus chen/ tshes grangs/ dus/ phyogs/ dum bu/gdong zla/ 'khor dang las bya tshul/ ser ba/ las sbyor/ sprin/ rdzas/ sngags kyi ngos 'dzin gdong gtad bya ba/ 'jug gdon dbang gsum/ zla ba/ phyogs skar ma/ tshes grangs dus tshod kyi gza' gzung ba/ phyi nang gsang gsum/ phyogs chos la dbang ba dang dngos su 'gyu ba/ gza' chen brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin/ lus tshad/ gnam sa bar gsum gyi bdag tshul sogs kyi blang dor ston pa zhus lan rin cen gsal ba'i sgron me/ lnga brgya mtha' ma bsnyen sgrub kyi long med pa'i dug lnga shigs pa'i dus rā hu la'i —313—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (//gdong gtad cog brdung gis dgra bo gsod pa padma'i snying bcud kyi mtha' can sdig can bsgral nas gnas spor ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ o rgyan padma'i brnag pa rā hu la'i phung las gdong gtad las sbyor gyi ti ka sbas byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'gyu dus zab mo 'di'i dus tshod la brten nas dgra bo bam log gcog 'gyel (218na)du gsod pa/ bdud po lcags gzhug 'grol ba dang bsdamasapa phan yon dang bcas pa gshog ser ma/ khyab 'jug gshor du 'dzin pa tshig brgyud las mi spel bar gdams pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'gyu bzlog rdzas kyi dus 'dzin gza' bdun 'dzin thabs zab mo rdzogs so'i mtha' can shog ser ma/ phyi nang gsang ba thod rgal yang gsang gab pa dang bcas par drang srong 'gyu dus kyi ngos 'dzin dus tshodi mtshon thogs/ gri rtsib kyi gzhu tsher can gyi mda'/ gri lcagasakyi mde'u la brten pa'i gdong gtad the tshom som nyi ma byed cig gi mtha' can/ de'i zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa/ lo skor bcu gnyis la brten pa'i bla brtsi lugs/ spyang zhi'i mche bsam de'u byas pa'i mu stegs srog gi spu gri/ 'gyu bzlog gi dus dang dus rtags rdzas la brten nas dus tshod 'phyug med ngos bzung nas mda' gzhu'i gdong gtad pho rog lding lhung sha ba rgyug 'gyel shin tu zab pa shon la las sbyor dus lcags 'grol ba dang zin nas bsdam pa'i sngags/ gdong gtad gnam gyi ga'u dmar po rang bsrung lag len dang bcas shin tu zab pa dgra bo gsod pa'i lag dmar/ de'i thun sngags lcags rgyag 'phrol dang bcas pa/ gdong gtad mda' gzhu'am phur pa la brten pa'i gzhor 'dzin ling bcasaganam gyi ga'u sogs dang 'dra ba'i mtha' can/ las 'grub pa'i rdzas/ rang bsrung / lha dbye'i rdzasasngags zab khyad can/ yang gsang sdig pa nag po'i bsrung ba/ rdzas bcu gsum la brten nas gza' thang la 'bebs pa/ rdzas bdun la brten nas gza' thang la 'bebs pa/ rdzas bzhi (218ba〉pa brten nas gza' thang la 'bebs pa/ gza' rgod khros pa'i drag ser lasacan 'ga'i don byed shog gi mtha' can/ rdzas kyi sgo nas ser ba gcod thabs/ gza' rgod 'jig rten pa'i sgrub thabs dug gi spu gri zhes pa lo rgyus bca' gzhi/ dmigs bzlas/ las sbyor/ dgra la 'chi dus btab pa ste don lngas bstan pa/—314

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganade'i cha lag gsang ba dug gi thog ser/ rten gtor bca' ba/ bla rdo 'khor lo rtsibs bdun ma dang bcas pa/ gza' rgod drag po'i sgrub pa mchog tu gsang ba rgya gar mtshon thung ngan sngags zab mo rnams/lnga pa zab gnad zhal gdams skor la/ 'khor 'das lam gsum rig rtsal du shes pa'i dngos grub bsgrub phyir dregs pa'i srog btsan thabs su 'phrog pa'i man ngag snying po/ lta ba chos nyid/ gnyen po stobs kyi lha sgom pa dgug gzhug lha dbye/ mchod pa/ dam bsre/ gdab las sogs kyi man ngag drang srong sgrub pa'i zhal gdams zab mo shog ser ma/ gza' bdud sgrub pa'i sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang ba lag len dum bu khrigs su bkod pa smi ka nyams 'og tu chud pa'i yig chung zab mo'i tshigs bcad ma/ gza' bdud sgrub pa'i gdams pa khrigs su bkod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can shin tu legs pa/ 'khor lo gzhung du ma 'dus pa dang 'dra min yod pa rnams kyis 'byed pha jo lhun grub rdo rje'i zin bris/ drug pa rang gzhan phan byed skor la/ drang srong gi bcos thabs zhes par nang gses kyi phyi nang gsang ba bye brag gi brtag thabs/ spang bya/ rten 'brel gyi bcos thabs/ spyi dang bye brag dkar nag gi rtags/ bcos lugs spyir (219na tshe sku gil 'khor bcu pa/ phra mo brag dang blon mkhar brag gi gter ma'i gza' bcos zab bsdus la/ rtsal byer sdud kyi sngags ma ṇi ma/ dor rta/ dar/ spos dkar gsum la brten nas lkugs pa kha 'byed/ me chu rlung san ma mkha'i gza' 'joms pa'i sngags/ mgo bo/ mig /rna ba/ snying / yan lag rnams gso sngags/ sla nga chu 'bad kyi gdams pa/ 'chi gsos kyi za yig la gzhe ges g.yas la thebs na 'gor kha ba mjug na ha yod pa'i gling bzhi ma/ g.yon la 'gor kha ba mjug na ba yod pa'i gling gsum/ dpung pa g.yon la 'gor rga sogs 'bru bzhi 'phred bris/ de nas 'gor 'a ṭa mjug na sha yod pa'i gling gsum/ g.yas la 'gor tu dang mjug na ṭa yod pa'i gling gsum/ mgo la 'gor ṣa ṣa mjug na da yod pa'i gling gsum/ srog rtsar 'gor ra na mjug na ha yod pa'i gling gnyis/lus spyir 'gor a he dang mjug na tu yod pa'i gling bzhi/ gdong zla rgyal por 'gor ba pa mjug na ma yod pa'i gling gnyis/ gdong bzlog cha ta na ro gsum brtsegs yod pa gling gnyis/ nyi mar 'gor —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/tsa dang mjug na: yod pa 'phreng gcig /zla bar 'gor bre mjug tu rba yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /mig dmar la 'gor rba dang mjug na ba bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /lhag par 'gor skyi mjug na ba bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /phur bur 'gor rku dang mjug na skyi yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /pa sangs la 'gor ba bu dang mjug na ba bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /spen par 'gor shad med kyi a mjug ba bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /mjug ring la 'gor shad med a mjug na dha yod (219ba)pa'i 'phreng gcig /spyi 'joms la 'gor rba mjug na ra yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /nyin phyed la 'gor swā gha mjug na ā ma yod pa'i 'phrong gnyis/ dgongs mo 'gor gha na mjug na sha na yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /tho rengs 'gor ha mjug na hā yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /nam langs 'gor pha dang mjug na ra yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /nyi shar la 'gor a dang mjug na hā yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /nyi dros la 'gor sa dang mjug na hā yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /de nams kyi 'byug rdzas/ gsang sman la me chu'i kha bsgyur sbyor ba/ spyi'i nad kun sel ba'i sman/ byug bcos/ dud bcos/ mi skyor ba'i rdzas bsrung / yang lci brtag pa/ rdzas kyi khog bsrung rnams/ dug 'byin gyi cho ga thog mar gza' dang rgyu skar mchod pa lcang lo can gyi pho brang ma/dug 'byin gyi bca' gzhi/ dug 'byin dngos gzhi yab gcig ya mānta ka ma/ byab cing bden stobs brjod nas rdzas bsngo ba/ gtor dbang la brten nas dug 'byin pa nad gdon kun dgrol/ gza' bsrung sra brtan rdo rje'i go khrab/ sngags dmigs kyi bsrung ba zab mo mchod rten nag po'i gter ma/grib bsrung lha ri dza ti ma/ grib bsrung bka' rgya ma/ 'di la dmigs pa'i gnad dang bcas te snang srid sil bur gtong ba'i gdams pa zhes gnyan chad pa'i lugs la yang snang ngo / /gza' bsrung gnam khyi pre du ma/ kha la bris pa'i lo thub ma/ zla thub ma/ yig 'bru lnga brgya yod pa'i bsrung ba ge ta ma/ gza' bsrung btags chog yid bzhin nor bu mu n+ya ma/ gza' mchog dkar po'i bum pa'i dug khrus shin tu zab pa'i lag len/ dug dbyung gi mdos chung ba gza' rgod gnod (220na)byed 'bar ba/ dug dbyung gi mdos rgyas pa don lnga pa o rgyan padmas sbyar ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ dpe ris la/ stod —316

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaganon/ bla rdo/ rang lus tshags gzhug /dug dbyung / brtson 'dzin/ rang bsrung yid bzhin nor bu/g.yang 'gugs/ ol dgag /longs spyod sgrub pa/ gnad 'bebs/ gshor la dgos pa btags chog ma/ sprel thod lha gsum ma'i bca' gzhi 'khor lo/ liṅga / thems bzlog /'gyu rtags kyi dpe'u ris dang bcas pa rnams kyi phyag len dmar 'khrid bcas pa legs par thob pa las pha jo lhun grub rdo rje'i 'bor lo'i zin bris ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ slob dpon padma thod 'phreng / jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/gter ston rin cen tshul rdor/ lo ston rdo rje 'bum/ mthing gi bla ma sangs rgyas grags 'od/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin sto ke tu/ rin po che chos kyi blo gros/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ mchog sgrub mnga' ris legs ldan rdo rje/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag gisang ga gi dbang po/ zur kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol/ des pha mes brgyud pa'i bstan srung mchod 'di za hor sngags smyon la stsal to/ /yang na dkon chen nam mkha' dpal ldan nas/ zhad ston tshe bdag rnam rgyal/ sngags nag gsang sngagasardo rje/ legs ldan rje man gong ltar/ yang na kong chen pa nas/ yol (220bsgo sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ legs ldan rje man gong bzhin no/ /yang thems can rnams dang cha ro'i zhu lan rin cen gsal sgron bsrung ba bka' rgya/ pha brag blon mkhar brag nas bsdus pa'i gza' bcos bcas pa'i brgyud lugasagacig ni/ gter ston nas/ rgyal sras legs ldan pa/ klong chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje thar pa gling pa/stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ rje sangs rgyas dbon po/ stag mgo yon tan dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ de sras kun dga' tshe mchog /pha jo gas nu don grub/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o//yang gter byon rags rim gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje thar pa gling pa nas/ rigs 'dzin padma gling pa/ de la sprul sku chu bzang pa dang zab phu sprul sku padma dkar po gnyis gas zhus/ gnyis ka la —3/7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nesngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje man sngar bzhin no/ /'khor lo'i gsal byed ni pha jo lhun grub rdo rje la de sras gzhen nu don grub kyis gsan/ de la rtsa ba'i bla mas gsan no/ /kong po bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal gyis phra brag gtso bor gyur pa'i gter chos rnams las zab dgu btus pa'i gza' bcos skor la/ gza' yum dbyings phyug mu kha le srid gsum rgyal mo'i bum pa dang gtor ma'i dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ 'gyu tshul/ brtag pa/ gso thabs/ mthar mi ldog pa ste don tshan bzhi'i sgo nas drang srong gi nad bcos thabs kyi las gzhung bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / dug dbyung gi gtor chog (221na7chad sbyin dri med/ gza' 'phyong glud 'phyong 'od dkar 'phro ba'i gnyen gyur/ byad grol rnam grol thugs rje'i zla ba/ gza' yum gyi bum chog bdud rtsi'i char rgyun/ gud du sbas pa'i yig chung ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i zla 'od/ zlum bcos gsang sman gab pa/ gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bum chog dug dbyung de'i zhan byung du khro bo sme brtsegs kyi mngon rtogs bzlas lung grib bsrung gi gdamasapa 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ za yig skor la/ spyi 'joms 'gor sa dang mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ btson 'dzin 'gor bha mjug na na yod pa'i 'phrong gcig /rjes gcod 'gor gha mjug na na yod pa'i gling bdun/ dam 'dogs 'gor tha na mjug na ba yod pa'i gling brgyad/ nyi mar 'gor gra mjug na the yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /zla bar 'go na tsa mjug na baṃ yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /mig dmar 'gor rba mjug na tha ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /lhag par 'gor rba mjug na tha ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /phur bur 'gor rgu dang mjug na bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /pa sangs la 'gor 'a gu mjug na 'a ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /spen par 'gor tha bru mjug na tha ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /rā hur 'gor rta mjug na ba bha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /khyab 'jug la ()mjug na tha ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /sgra gcan la 'gor nu dang mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ nyi mar 'gor a mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ zla bar 'gor sa mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ mig dmar la 'go mjug gnyis mar hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ lhag par 'gor ka (221ba)mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/—318

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaphur bur 'gor ra mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ pa sangs la 'gor byu mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ spen par 'gor gi mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ mar la 'gor oṃ dang mjug na ha yod pa'i 'phreng gcig /zan la 'gor oṃ mjug na hā yod pa'i 'phreng gcig sha la 'gor oṃ mjug na hā yod pa'i 'phreng gcig zhan tu zab pa 'gor a mjug na la yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ nyi shar 'gor a ha mjug na za tho 'phreng gcig /mun rub 'gor hūṃ mjug na za yod gling gsum/ srod la 'gor ṭa mjug na za yod pa'i gling gnyis/ mgo skor la 'gor shu mjug na hā yod pa'i brtsegs ma/ gza' brgyad mgo skor la 'gor a mjug na tho yod pa'i gling bzhi/ srog gcod la 'gor oṃ mjug na ma yod pa'i gling gsum ma rnams thob pa'i sme brtsegs skor gyi lung ma gtogs pa'i yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ dpal o rgyan chen po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ slob dpon bee ro tsa na/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha lcam padma gsal sogs rje 'bangasamang por bka' babs pa las sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor sogs gter ston so so nas rim par brgyud de/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal/ de sras rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin/ dpal 'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/ (222nasgo nyam med khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /zhan byung khro mo sme brtsegs kyi sgom bzlas kyi 'di gsar mo yin bog pas 'di'i sdeb su mo'os kyang rje 'bri gung pas gza' btsos kyi cha lag tu mdzad 0ltar bkod pa yin/ brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gru spang rtsab/ gru rdo rje seng ge /brag nag pa seng rgyan/ mkhan po bsod seng / bla ma rgya gar rgyal mtshan/ chos rje seng ge ba/ gzhen nu blo gros/ gzhen nu dkon cog /gzhon nu don grub/ gzhen nu chos grub/ rje grol mchog /rdo ring kun rgyan/ mkhan byams pa chos rgyal/ rje 'bri gung pa man gong bzhin no/ /lha lcam skye ba padma las 'brel rtsal gyis shing pho stag gi lo sras phu bla ro brag nag nas spyan drangs—3/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonepa'i phyi ltar gnod sbyin spu gri dmar nag /nang ltar bdud bkrag med/ gsang ba gza' rgod mig dmar/yang gsang sgrol ging gshin rje bshan pa ma ru rtse'i skor la/ thog mar gtor ma/ na bza'/ phyag mtshan/zor dbang / bsreg dbang / mnan pa'i dbang dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ themasayig /gnod sbyin spu gri dmar nag gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ lo rgyus byung tshul/ drag po mthu'i las mtha' dam med lag tu shor ra re'i mtha' can/ stong gsum lo tog 'joms byed ser ba dbab pa/ smyo 'bog cho 'phrul gtong ba/ rab dgra bo mtshams khongs su 'chi ba 'bring dang mtha' ma 'chi ltas dang bstun nas gsod pa drag po'i las sbyor/ bsreg pa me'i las sbyor/ mnan pa'i las mtha'/ zor gyi las mtha'/gnod sbyin la sri'u 'chol ba/(222ba)'dzin gtor dang bris sku la brten bca' ba/ dam tshig bsre ba bdag nyid rdo rje ma/ chig brgyud las mi spel ba'i dbang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge /gsol kha dad pa dam tshig ma/ bstod pa sngon tshe bstan srung ma/ rbad bskul sngon gyi bskal pa ma/ bla rdo gnad 'bebs gnod sbyin srog gi gnad tig /bsnal dkrug mtha' bsgyur phyi nang gsang ba'i sngags sgrom/ thog ma nas gnad 'bebs las kun myur 'grub/ ru tra ngag gnon 'khor lo/ nor sgrub 'dzam gling gi nor bdag tu 'gyur byed/ mdos bdag ni rigs 'dzin ma/ bskang bshags bdag ni rigs 'dzin ma/mdos bskul gling bzhi ri rab ma/ gnod spyin btsan du sgrub pa cog brdung spu gri nag po/ drag bskul 'khor 'das so mtshams ma/ dpe ris la sgrub dkyil/ gtor ma/ srog 'khor/ gnad dbab 'khor lo/ ngag gnon/ nor sgrub kyi tsakra mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyi bca' bzhi sogs phyag ga len zhal shes bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ mu stegs kyi mkhan po rab snang / slob dpon shinti garbha/ dregs pa'i zil gnon padma thod 'phreng / jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan lha lcam padma gsal/ sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor/ lo ston rdo rje 'bum/ mthing ma'i bla ma grags 'od/ bla ma grags pa rin cen/ rje grags pa bzang po/ rin po che chos kyi blo gros/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ lha rigs grub pa'i khyu mchog legs ldan rdo rje/ mthu stobs —320

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)dbang phyug dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ dbon rigs (223na 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ gu ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hong sngags 'chang gi bstan pa bsrung ba'i lag char gdams so/ /yang na sangs rgyas grags 'od nas/ rdo rje rgyal po/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi blo gros man gong ltar/ yang na kong chen pa nas/zhang ston tshe bdag rnam rgyal/ sngags nag gsang sngags rdo rje/ legs ldan rje man gong bzhin no/ /yang na sho ban nas/ rgyal sras dri med 'od zer/ bla ma thar pa gling pa/ rigs 'dzin padma gling pa/ zab phu sprul sku padma dkar po/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje/ legs ldan rje man 'dra/ yang dbang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ thar pa gling pa nas bde legs rgya mtsho/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / lha sras rnam sprul rin cen phun tshogs/grub brnyes bkra shis rgya mtsho/ sras du ma rang grol/ dbon ngag dbang ye grub/ zur chen rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag 'di gzar bsgrub pa/ bdud du bsgrub pa/ btsan du bsgrub pa sogs rnam grangs mang zhing 'di la gza' gdong dmar nag tu yang grags pas la la dag lha 'di ga la sgrub skor rgyas pa gnubs lugs su yod pa de/ rje btsun mi las bsgrub pa'i drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag tu ngos 'dzin pa dpyad dgos shing / rin po che kun bzang rtse pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis yul ma bla ma grags pa'i mtshan (223ba〉5na slob dpon du bsten nas phyag len dmar 'khrid mdzad pa'i zin bris kyang mthong zhing de don khong du chud do/ /padma las 'brel stsal gyis tsa ri zil chen gsang ba'i phug nas spyan drangs pa'i zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi skor la/ dbang chog dregs pa srog gi bcud phyung ba'i steng nas/ bum pa/ sku/ bdud rtsi/ glegs bam/ thod pa/ dpa' bo'i chas la brten nas dbang bzhi/ 'phrin las sgrol dbang / byin rlabs bla ma'i gtor dbang / sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bka' gtad dang bcas pa mnos nas/lung la/ bdud nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can dang ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong can gnyis kyi rgyud le'u bcu —321 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebadun pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ mjug tu dur khrod u tsa la'i pha bong spre'u sum pa 'dra ba'i byang nasa.o rgyan chen pos gdan drangs nas tsa rir sbas tshul/ bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum gyi gsang ba'i srog sgrub rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dbang chog bka' gtad dregs pa srog gi bcud byung ba padmas bkod pa rgya gsum gyi mtha' can/ mgon po'i bskang ba rba rlabs kyi 'phreng ba/ gsol kha bya ba'i bgom dang go rim/ bskang mdos 'phrin las kun 'grub rgyal sras legs ldan pas mdzad pa/ bstod pa dur khrod wo po ma/ dam bdar tshig lhug ho dgongs gsol ma/ kha sbyor dbye ba o rgyan padma dang rol pa'i rdo rje'i rgya gzhung la brten nas sngags 'chang chos kyi bzang pos mdzad pa/ sgab 'dre 'gong po mgo gsum gnon pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sgrub pa la nye bar mkho ba'i zhal gdams skor la/ bla rdo srog 'khor bca' thabs/ sgrub (224na)pa la 'jug pa'i sngon rol tu sgab 'dre gnon pa/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i gnas bca' bzhi/ rtags/ dam tshig bsrung tshul rnams bstan pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ bla rdo'i rta mgo dang seng ldeng gi byang bu bca' tshul mgon po'i 'gyu dus/ spos sbyor la brten nas mgon po dang bgegs brtag pa/ gnad bdun snying gi dum bu zhes pa zla ga khrig la mi 'grub pa zhag gnyag la 'grub pa/ 'khu ldog mi 'ong ba/ kha bsgyur ba/ za kha bstan pa/ snying chu bsre ba/ 'khon nag za ba/ babasablang ba rnams/ par bu thod pa kha sbyor gyi gdams pa/ sbyin sreg me'i spu gri/ sbyin sreg yang zab man ngag /sbyin sreg gi rtsa ba tshigs bcad ma sho lo ka gcig ma/ zhal gdams skor la/ nor rnyed cing stor brlag mi 'ong ba'i gdams pa/ nor sgrub 'khor lo'i rdzas/ dbang sdud yig chung / sbyin sreg gi lag len drag po sbyin sreg zhal hom khung brgya'i las rim mjug zor dang mnan pa'i bar zhal shes yi ger bkod pa rnams gzhan la bstan pa'i don med do'i mtha' can/ gnad kyi zhal gdams zhes pa mi bsrun yab yum dbang du bsdu ba/ pha rol rtsod pa bzlog pa/ las kyi skabs dang sbyar ba'i lha bskyed yul/ sngags pa nang rgyas/ g.yul rgyal ba/ bod 'dre bzlog pa/ zas nor spel ba/ seng gdong mkhan po nang 'gras na spu gri 'khor lo thod pa'i man ngag /nad pa dang sri'u gso tshul rnams tshigs bcad ma —322

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)mjug tu sngags kyi zhal shes dang bcas pa/bdud khyi nag po'i kha gtad/seng gdong dkar po mgon po yid 224ba ) bzhin nor bu'i sgrub pa/de'i sgo nas tshe sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/bsrung 'khor yid bzhi nor bu/zlog pa yid bawo nor bu/seng gdong dmar mo'i sgo nas 'gro ba dbang sdud/za yig bcas cho go ma'i skor la mtshon bsrung /thog bsrung nad ga bsrung ba/byad phur bzlog pa/khyi bsrung /sgrib shing /dug bsrung /mdzes bsrung /sgrub dus myur du 'grub thabs/yugs sa sa bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa/'khu ldog bsrung ba/mi gtsang phud nyams bsrung ba/rbad na tshur mi ldog pa'i za yig rnamasabastan pa las can snying rje can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/dpe ris skor la/sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor/las bum/gtor ma'i 'khor ling /bla rdo'i lto 'khor/rang bsrung lto 'khor/rta mgo seng byang /sgab 'dre/sbyin sreg/par bu'i thod pa/me rlung 'khor lo/nor sgrub/dbang sdud dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /gsang bdag/o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/lha lcam padma gsal/gter ston rin cen tshul rdor/sgo'i rgyal sras legs ldan/rigs 'dzin ku ma rwa dza/kun mkhyen pa/bya btang bsod nams 'od zer/bla ma dharma pa la/bla ma ga ga ke tu/rtogs ldan bsod nams bzang po/gu ru rnam 'joms/bla ma dri med sangs rgyas/rje pu rgya shrī/gu ru byung la/bla ma bha dra shrī/rigs 'dzin bsam grub rgyal po/snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/zur ga smo nu don grub/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za sto bande la'o//sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor gyis spyan drangs 225na ) pa'i drang srong she la ru tse'i snying khrag dam nyams phung byed sa bdag hal khyi nag po'i gtad kyi gzhung gi skor la/sngags pa bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod pa/lus sems dbral ba/tsi tsi dzwa lar bskur ba/rigs brgyud gcod pa/zhing la lo mi skye ba/nor phyugs brlag pa/sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi mnan gtad rjes gcod bcas pa/hal khyi'i mngon rtogs/gtor 'bul/bstod pa/dmod mo/sngags byang bcas pa spel na rang srog 'tshig par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/zhal gdams la pho mo'i 'khor lo/gsad 'khor/steng 'bubs/rnga mo/sdig pa/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherjes gcod kyi 'khor lo rnams kyi zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyung shin tu gsang ba'i gnas/ dpe ris la/ pho 'khor/ mo 'khor/ gsad 'khor phung byed rnga mo/ sdig 'khor/ hal khyi dang rā hu la'i gzugs/rkang 'drud/ khyung / rma bya'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i lung phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ drang srong she la ru tse/ o rgyan dus gsum sangs rgyas/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston las 'brel rtsal nas rim par/ zur pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhen nu don grub/ de sras kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /las 'brel rtsal gyi gtor ma'i kun thub chen mo zhes pa la/ spar sme/ gza' rgyu skar/ sa bdag /lo skor bcu gnyis kyi kun thub chen mo/ lha gdon bzlog pa shāka thub sku 'khor/ gnod sbyin bzlog pa tshe bdag bsrung 'khor/ klu bzlog pa phyag rdor thugs 'khor/ gza' bzlog rnam 'joms(225bsgo mo bzlog pa gshin rje/ bdud bzlog rta mgrin/ rgyal po bzlog pa lo ke shwa ra/ btsan bzlog bdud rtsi 'byil pa/ ma rig pa sel ba yum chen mo/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob sgrol ma/ chom rkun bsrung ba 'od zer can ma/ byad bzlog gdugs dkar/ dpal bskyed sor 'brang / rims bsrung lo ma gyon ma/ tshe bsring rnam rgyal ma/ dgra dang ltasang na bzlog pa lha mo rol pa/ rlung nad sel ba yul 'khor bsrung /mkhris nad sel ba 'phags skyes po/ bad gan sel ba spyan mi bzang / 'dus pa sel ba rnam sras kyi 'khor lo gzhung dpe ris bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ dran mchog o rgyan chen po/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston rin cen tshul rdor/ sprul sku legs ldan pa/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ rje thar pa gling pa/ bya bral rje/ sangs rgyas dbon/ yon tan dpal ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / grub chen bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/ pha jo gzhon nu don grub/ zur wo chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /phra mo brag nas sprul sku tshul rdor gyis spyan drangs pa'i mi thub pa ci yang med pa'i za yig skor la/—324

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarang gi ngag 'grol 'gor oṃ 'jug na na yod pa'i gling bdun/ gser gyi klad kor ma 'gor bi mjug na na yod pa'i gling bzhi/ rang gi nus pa spar te gzhan gyi nus pa bshig pa'i 'gor khyab mjug na mā yod pa'i gling bdun/ rang gshed rang la 'bebs pa 'gor phyi mjug na 'u (226na〉rgod pa'i gling bdun/byad ma srog gcod 'gor khri mjug na khā yod pa'i gling bdun/ sde brgyad byad mar gnad 'bebs 'gor gwa mjug tu khā yod pa'i gling bdun/ byad ma gnod byed bdud 'bebs 'gor oṃ mjug na kwa yod pa'i gling bdun ma/ gshin rje gnad bskul 'gor sra mjug na shwa yod pa'i gling bdun/ klu byad mar dbab pa 'gor de mjug na grwa yod pa'i gling bdun ma rnams dang / gza' bsrung yig 'bru lnga bcu yod pa ke ta ma bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ he ru ga rdo rje chos/ mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ rgyal yum ye shesa'atsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston las 'brel rtsal nas rim par/ bla ma legs pa shes rab/rje nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gcan nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ de bdag la'o/ /dpa' bo sgang pa rin cen tshul rdor gyi gter slob rgyal sras legs ldan pas tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lo zil chen gsang ba'i phug nas yang gter gyi tshul du spyan drangs pa'i zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can gyi skor la/ zhing skyong chen po'i dregs pa srog gi dbang rjes gnang bka' gtad dang bcas mnos nas/ lung la/ rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ zhing skyong gi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i gsang ba'i srog sgrub/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub pa/ tshe sgrub/ bsrung 'khor/ zlog pa/ seng ge gdong dmar mo'i dbang sdud/ gsol kha gnad yig (226ba)bcas/ bskang ba rba rlabs 'phreng ba/bstod pa dam bdar dmod byang / bskang mdos gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ bla rdo/ sgab 'dre mnon pa/spos sbyor/ 'gyu dus/ kha sbyor/ dbye ba/ sgrub pa la nyer mkho'i zhal gdams/ gnad bdun snying gi dum bu/ par bu'i gdams pa/ sbyin sreg /gnad kyi zhal gdams tshigs bcad ma/ bdud khyi nag po'i kha gtad/ stor brlag /nor sgrub/ dbang sdud/ sbyin sreg /zor mnan rnams kyi zhal shes/ za —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yig dgos 'dod kun 'byung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po/o rgyan yab yum/gter ston rgyal sras legs ldan/ku ma rā dza/tshul khrims blo gros/pu rkyu ra smi/bla ma chos bzang /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/pu rtso bha dra/bla ma rnam 'joms/dri med sangs rgyas/bsod nams dpal/dzo la/bzang po dpal/bsam grub rgyal po/bkra shis rgya mtsho/kun dga' tshe mchog/pha jo gzhen nu don grub/thugs sras rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o//zangs ri ras pa/dbang shāka nyi 'bum khri/pra dun pa gsum gyi gter chos ni ma 'tshal lo/zhang lha bzang klu dpal gyis sku 'bag dang lha du bya rgod gzhongs su sbas pa gter ston gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis spyan drangs pa'i rnam thos sras yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba mnos nas/lung la/gnod sbyin dbyug tho can gyi rgyud le'u bdun pa gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur/de'i le'u mtha' ma'i tshe sgrub kyi gsal byed slob dpon bi mā las 227na ) mdzad pa gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis bya rgod gshongs nas gdan drangs pa/rnam sras dmar po'i sgrub thabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung /bla rdo/srog 'khor/snang ba dbang sdud/gtor ma'i 'bor lo'i bri yig rnams las rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang /gsang ba'i bdag po/slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/mkhas pa bee ro tsa na/rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po/chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/zhang lha bzang klu dpal/gter ston gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/snur nyi ma/dbus pa dmar ston/slob dpon gan ston/'od zer bla ma/dzñā na lakṣa/slob dpon thabs kyi blo gros/mkhan po dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/slob dpon nam mkha' grags pa/bla ma bsod nams rin cen/bla ma dpal ldan pa/gnyag phu pa bsod nams bzang po/mkhan chen padma bzang po/mkhan chen chos kyi dbang phyug/mkhan chos grub seng ge thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/'bras spungs pa tshe dbang bkra shis/rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/bod mkhar ba me tri don grub rgyal mtshan/spyan snga mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang dang dbang phyug rab brtan/mkhan rin chen bso/ 6nams mchog grub 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa'

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabo bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o//lung brgyud ni rje dbang rab nas/ sa skya pa yab sras zha lu pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debasalas/ shud bu'i skye brgyud gra pa mngon shes dang / ra mo shes sman sum ston ye shes zung / /brang ti khar bu nyang ri shes rab grags/ /gtsang ston chos (227ba 'bar zhes rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhesashud bu'i skye ba gra pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar ni thang yig las/ skabs su gcig las gcig nyid sdug pa yong : jing dang rgya rnams grog ma tshang zhig 'dra dbu rtsegaso rig rgyud kyi gter kha dang : jo mo gling gsum sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag gdon pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung : gter ston gra pa mngon shes zhes bya 'byung : zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan ltar o rgyan gyi yul lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer du ston pa shākya'i rgyal po sman gyi bla ma'i skur sprul nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'i tshul du drang srong rig pa'i ye shes dang yid las skyes gnyis kyis zhu ba zhu lan gyi sgo nas yid las skyes kyis gser gyi ljang shog la beeḍūrla zhun ma'i khu bas bris pa'i glegs bam bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud kha che'i yul nas paṇa chen zla ba mngon par dga' ba dang lo chen bee ro gnyis ( te chos rgyal la phul/ slob dpon chen po dang mnga' bdag yon mchod kyis bsam yas dbu rtse'i bar khang gi ka ba'i nang du gter du sbas/ chos skyong zhang blon dang gter srung rgyal po shing bya can la gtad pa gter ston gra pa mngon shes kyis spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ sa bon lta bu rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud mdo'i gnas gcig le'u drug pa gang zag dbang po rab kyi don du gsungs pa/ tshig don ma lus sgrib med gsal bar ston pa bshad pa sku'i rgyud la cha dpyad kyi gnas le'u gcig /tha mal nad med kyi gnad la le'u gcig /bya byed sman pa'i gnas la le'u gcig /bya(228nab) spyod lam gyi gnas la le'u gsum/ 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la le'u gsum/ sbyo ra ba sman gyi gnas la le'u gsum/ngos 'dzin rtags kyi gnas la le'u gsum/ gso byed thabs kyi gnas la le'u bzhi/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnasal le'u lnga/ grub pa lus kyi gnas la le'u drug /sdoms tshigs la le'u gcig ste bsdoms pas gnas —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebacu le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa gang zag dbang po 'bring gi don du gsungs pa/ dgos pa ma tshang ba med pa yid bzhin nor bu man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud la nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs la le'u bzhi/ khong nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u drug /tshad pa gso ba'i skabs la le'u bcu drug /lus stod gso ba'i skabs la le'u drug /don snod gso ba'i skabs la le'u brgyad/ gsang nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u gnyis/thor bu'i nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u dgu/ lhan skyes rma gso ba'i skabs la le'u brgyad/ byis pa gso ba'i skabs la le'u gsum/ mo nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u gsum/ 'byung po'i nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u lnga/ mtshon gso ba'i skabs la le'u lnga/ dug nad gso ba'i skabs la le'u gsum/ rgas pa gsoba'i skabs la le'u gcig /ro rtsa gso ba'i skabs la le'u gnyis/ zhus pa'i le'u gcig rnams bsdoms pas skabs bco lnga dang le'u dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa gang zag dbang po mtha' ma'i don du gsungs pa/nad kyi steng du pha lam ltar thogs pa med pa phyi ma 'phrin las kyi rgyud la/ brtag pa chu'i mdo la le'u gnyis/ zhi byed sman gyi mdo la le'u bcu/ sbyong byed las kyi mdo la le'u bdun/ 'jam rtsub dpyad kyi mdo la le'u drug ste bsdoms pas mdo bzhi le'u nyer lnga pa la lag len kho nar dril te gsungs pa/rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i lelā(228ba)rgyud yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste bsdoms pas le'u brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug gi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ston pa sman gyi bla/ gsung ba po drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ sdud pa po drang srong yid las skyes/ des 'tsho byed gzhon nu dang drang srong rgyun shes gnyis la gnang / 'tsho byed gzhen nu nas/ mgon po klu sgrub/ dpal ldan dpa' bo/ kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mngon par dga' ba/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gra pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar/ dge bshes dbus pa dar grags/ rog ston dkon cog skyabs/rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog yon tan mgon po/ sum ston ye shes zung / 'tsho byed gzhen nu ye shes/ g.yu thog mkhas pa 'bum seng / gtsang ston sangs rgyas rin cen/ mkhas pa don grub rin cen/ bstan 'dzin don grub rgyal mtshan/ brang ti dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/—328—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadage slong tshal pa dbang grags/ mkhas mchog phun tshogs bzang po/ zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje/ lag len mthar phyin tshe 'bum/ byar po paṇa chen/ mkhas pa zla ba'i dbang po/ sems dpa' chen po rin cen sdings pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ g.yu thog rnam sprul byang ngos drang srong bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sman sgom ngag dbang don grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed nas/ zul bu sman mo che ba/ sman ston dbang phyug bzang po/ zur mkhar thams cad mkhyen pa man gong ltar/ yang na paṇa chen mnyam nyid rdo rje nas/ kong ston mkhas pa'i dbang po/ mtsho smad mkhan po sman bla shākya dbang phyug /mkhas mchog (229na)bsod nams rgyal po/ rin cen sdings pa sems dpa' chen po man gong bzhin no/ /rtsa rgyud kyi lung zhig mkhan po rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la zhus/ rje nyid kyi mes po drung 'tsho bar gsan gsung / de yan gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed/ bshes gnyen gra pas bsam yas nas spyan drangs pa'i 'phags pa nga la dmar po gsung gi sgrub skor la/ thod pa la brten nas khams gsum snying khrag sdud pa'i dbang / gtor ma rin cen 'bar bas 'dod dgu char 'bebs kyi dbang / chu byin dang lha sgom sngags bzlas kyi dbang mnos nas/ lung la 'phags pa sa la dmar po gsung gi sgrub thabs/ chu sbyin gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ thod pa la brten nas bsgrub pa/ nga la'i sgrub thabasathun mong ma yin pa dbang du bya ba'i 'phrin las/ sbyin sreg la brten nas bsgrub pa/ tshogs mchod/bstod pa bde gshegs ma/ 'khor lo'i bri yig /dzam dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa/ dzam la dmar po'i dbang bskur gyi yi ge dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das byung la/o rgyan dus gsum sangs rgyas/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gra pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na shes rab rgyal ba zer ba 'dug /gra pa thugs rje 'bum/ slob dpon shu la tsand+ra/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan po nyi ma/ slob dpon don bzang dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ la lar dbu gru btsun zer ba 'dug kyang rdo rje rin po che'i gsan yig na 'di bzhin snang / dka' bcu gzhen —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenu seng ge /bla ma shākya grub pa/ rdo ston bsod nams bzang po/ rje rgyal ba dpal/ ya ma lag pa ye shesargyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen (229ba)po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ gur rdzong pa chos 'byor dpal bzang / rigs 'dzin gzhen nu don grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ lce ston gsal ba'i shes rab/ tshe don gsal/ 'u yug dam pa shag po/ dam pa shar rdor/ bla ma bsod nams rin cen/gzhon nu seng ge man gong ltar/ yang na gter ston nas/ gzhung pa rgyan legs/ rong pa chos mgon/bla ma dbang phyug grags/ gra dur ba/ mkhan po kun dga' rin cen/ rje rin chen mchog /dbu ma pa grub brtson man gong bzhin/ slob dpon bee ro tsa nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i dbu rtser gter du sbas pa gra pa mngon shes kyis gdan drangs pa'i lha 'khon sbyong ba'i 'khor lo rdzas 'go ba'i lha lnga mchod thabs phan yon dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longasasku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku o rgyan chen po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ slob dpon bee ro tsa na/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gra pa mngon shes/ nye gnas rga bran nag po/ sprul sku nyi ma 'od zer/ mnga' bdag mi bskyod rdo rje/ gter ston sangs rgyas 'bar/ bla ma nyi ma'i snying po/ mtshungarsāmed 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ rje chos nyid shes rab/ bla ma mkhas grub bsod nams/ sprul sku yon tan seng ge /kun mkhyen shes rab rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas skyabs/sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin chos dpal bzang / sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /(230na)sprul sku gra pa mngon shes kyis bsam yas kyi ka ba bum pa can nas gdan drangs pa'i skor la/mkhan chen padma bzang po'i yi ge'i steng nas zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul phyi ltar gnod sbyin du sgrub pa lha drug /nang mgon po ltar sgrub pa lha dgu/ gsang ba bdud ltar sgrub pa lha lnga'i rjes gnang gsum —330

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamanos nas/ lung la/ gnod sbyin yid bzhin gter gyi rgyud chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud du grags pa le'u bco brgyad pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gsang ba'i bdag po byin gyis brlabs te gnod sbyin rgyal po ya ka ku be ra la bshad pa slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang lo tsā ba bee ro tsa nas bsgyur te gter du sbas pa/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po rin cen sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gsang ba'i rgyud chen le'u bco brgyad rdzogs tshig rtog pa nyi shu rtsa drug pa sangs rgyas kyis gsang bdag byin gyis brlabs nas kun dga' bo la gsungs pa bsam yas steng khang gi seng ldeng ka gzhu nas spyan drangs pa/ zhang blon chen po phyi dar la brten nas gnod sbyin nor du sgrub pa kun la kha lo bsgyur ba sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ las phran la pha rol gyi gnod pa zhi ba/ tshe dang dpal rgyas pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mo bcu drug gis gang la bya ba dbang du bsdu ba/ yum gyi thun sgrub kyi las mtha' zor gyi sbyor ba/ rje grogs bran lta bu'i bsten thabs gsum/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi rim pa dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin chen po nad dam rdzas la brten nas mgon por sgrub pa gdams pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin gsang ba bdud du bsgrubs nas dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa ru dra sgrol bar smon lam (230ba)'debs pa'i mtha' can/ phyi zas sna tshogs kyi gsol khas mchod pa/ nang mdos kyis mchod pa/ gsang ba sha khrag la brten pa'i gsol kha bya thabs/ sgrub skor gsol kha 'di rnams bsam yas bar khang gi ka ba bum pa can nas btan par grags kyang sgrub thabs rang gi mjug na brag ri'i logs la gter du sbas zer ba 'dug pas slar yang khungs dpyad par bya'o/ /'gor rdo rje 'dzin dang dbyer med zhes yod pa'i zhang blon phyi sgrub kyi gtor chog mchod bstod dang bcas pa gter ston gra pas mdzad pa'i las byang dgos 'dod kun 'byung du grags pa/ 'di dpe la lar slob dpon rṣa pos mdzad zer ba'ang snang / lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i las byang dngos grub rgya mtsho/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ mgon po klu sgrub/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/—331 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shelo chen bee ro tsa na/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gra pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar/ desanye gnas rga bran nag po dang pu rang pa bsod nams rin cen gnyis pa la gnang / gas yig sgo mas par 'di bzhin 'dug kyang rnam sras kyi brgyud par yod pa'i bcur bsod nams rin cen yin nam dpyad/ de gnyis la gung thang gi sgom chen smon lam 'bar/ rim bzhin sras gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ she ston yang zer/ dol pa badzra pā ṇi/ rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ nyang byang chub sems dpa'/ brag dkar sman bla ba/ jo sras dkon (231na khog gzhon nu/ sras mgar ston tshul khrims gzhone nu/ rwa chen chos dpal bzang po/ dpal sbas grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen rin cen padma dbang rgyal/ sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje/ bla ma o rgyan rgyal po/ gong dkar ba paṇa rṣa kun dga' bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na bla chen chos dpal bzang po nas/ byams pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag /mnga' ris paṇa chen man gong bzhin no/ /yang na khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje sangs rgyas rin cen/ rta nag sgrol ma ba yin nam dpyad/ 'gos lo yid bzang rtse pa gzhen nu dpal/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon blo gros 'phel/ slob dpon mkhas mchog rgya mtsho/ chos rje dge 'dun lhun grub/ lha chos rje nges legs dpal 'byor lhun grub/'khon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/yang na pha gra pa nas/ gra pa thugs rje 'bum/ shu la tsand+ra/ slob dpon don bzang / slob dpon tshul rgyal/ mkhan po nyi ma/ dbu gru brtson seng / dka' bas pa bkra shis bzang po/ bla ma ye shes dpal/rje chos grags dpal/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal bzang / paṇa chen byams gling pa man 'dra/(231ba)—332

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i las byang dang rjes gnang gi yi ge ma gtogs pa'i lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol nas/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i las byang gi lung brgyud ni/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho nas/ so dpal mgon rgyal mtshan/ so bsod nams rigs 'dzin/ so bdud dul tshe dbang bkra shis/ dbu mdzad ngag dbang bkra shis/ rdzogs chen pa klong yangs 'od gsal/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge'i lung ni rje nyid la bdag gis mnos so/ /ra mo shes sman/ sum ston ye shes/ brang ti mkhar bu gsum gyi gtor chos ni ma 'tshal/khu yug 'bum thang gi srin phug grog po nas nyang ston nam nyang ring shes rab grags kyis gdan drangs pa'i dgra bo dam nyams gza' bdud la gtong pa'i gdong gtad zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston nyang ring shes rab grags nas rim par/ chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gtsang ston chos 'bar gyi gter ma'i mchod rten ston po la brten nas ser ba bsrung ba ni gter ston nas rim par brgyud de/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' rdo rje/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ tho ling gnas nas ngo (232na7tshar bstan srung skor/ spyan drangs stag sde'i gu ru hūṃ 'bar dang / /gu ge 'dam grog mkhar nas chig dril skor/ /rnyed mdzad skal ldan byis pa la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis mnga' ris tho ling gi gtsug lag khang gi dpal rta mgrin gyi thugs skar gter du sbas pa'i gza' mon pa ke ta'i gdams pa rnams las can bon ston hūṃ 'bar gyis spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ gnas bsrung gi gdams pa'i brgyud pa/khungs btsun pa'i lo rgyus/ rdzas dang gtor ma la brten nas bsnyen pa/ 'khor lo ling ga la brten —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenas sgrub pa/ rdza sbal la brten nas las sbyor/ bsam bsgyur chen mo'i zhal gdams zab pa'i mtha' can/ sgrub pa'i bcas dang mdun bskyed kyi dmigs gzhung las byang dug lnga las grub mthu rtsal ma dang bcas pa/ gang zhig 'gras che ba la gsod pa'i las sbyor byug pa yang zor ro'i mtha' can/ tsakra'i 'grel pa gter ston gyis logs su gab pa gdams pa 'di'i 'khor lo 'dri ba lag len slob pa la gal che ba'i mtha' can/ sgrub thabs kyi ting 'dzin/ gnyen po gtor ma'i gnad/ bla rdo/ rtags dang sbyar nas las la sbyor tshul gab gso'i gnad phran rtags yig tu grags pa zab btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gdams logs su sbas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo na gnas pa'i sde brgyad bskyed lugs mjug na gnang tshul yon phul ba'i lo rgyus dad gus dang bcas zhus pa'i mtha' can/ bcas/ sam ti/ sngags/ lha dbye/ 'khor lo/ bskul/ rjes dang bcas pa'i (232ba)gab gso bdun pa pu rang gi gtsang pos bod phung gi dogs nas logs su sbas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lha dbye'i gab gso shin tu gsang ba/ nang rgyas kyi gab gso/ lha dbye'i bskul dug lnga las grub dregs rtsal ma/ 'go ba'i lha lnga 'dri tshul/ mdun bshig chung ba'i zhal shes/ bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i sgom rim khrigs su bsdebs pa bsgral bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ bod sngags rbad gsad cig car bzla ba/ 'khor lo gsum so so'i sgrub sngags/ nyin mtshan gyi khyad par/ so man ngag /lag 'khrid/zhal shes rnams yi ger bkod pa gzhan la bstan na gza' bdud kyi zhal du kha raṃ khā lha'i mtha' can/bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi sngags byang mi mkhyen pa med lags so'i mtha' can/ mi rgod kha bsdam/ ser bsrung / bsrung ba/ dmag dpung rgyal byed/ mon pa 'phrin las la bkol pa lnga'i yig chung / mon thod la brten nas khyim bsrung ba/ cho 'phrul gtong ba/ dgra yul du sprel dmag gtong ba/ sbos rir gsod pa/ bskrad pa rnga mo'i gab gso/ lkugs pa lug gi gab gso/ sgrib pa rus sbal gab gso/ mngon rtogasakyi gab gso/ dpe ris skor la/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ hom khung / sku gzugs/ gtor ma/ phyag rdor/ gza'i yab yum/ khyung gi sku/ khyab 'jug sprul mjug dang zhabs can gyi sku/ wa spyang stag mgo —334

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganacan/ dkyil 'khor gyi bcas/ bla rdo/ lha lnga'i gzugs/ lha dbye'i shog byang / sde brgyad kyi gzugs/rnga mo/ lug /rus sbal gsum gyi tsakra/ ltas ngan gtong ba dang grod pa phu 'debs kyi dpe dang bcasapa rnams kyi lung phyag len dmar 'khrid zhib rgyas lan gnyis kyi bar du zhus pa'i brgyud (233na)pa ni/ ḍā gi ma nyi ma'i spyan/ bram ze bhu gu/ dregs pa zil gnon padma 'byung gnas/ gter ston stag sde'i bon ston hūṃ 'bar/ stag sde grags pa rgyal mtshan/ pu rang gi btsad po lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ skyer phu'i klog ston/ dpal dar/ jo bdud/ grom pa lha mgon/ dran pa zer ba'ang khrug /zhang ston mthu can gangs pa shāka 'bum/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ phyi ma yin/ glan 'jam dpal seng ge /gnubs kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub rgyal sras cho me rje/ sngags 'chang legs pa dpal/ lha rigs 'jam dbyangs rin cen rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris slo bo ma thang pa rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ mi nyag stong 'khun rgyal rigs bkra shis stobs rgyal/ de sras rigs 'dzan ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des za hor sngags smyon gyi chosasrung du gdams so/ /yang na grom pa lha mgon nas/ su tsand+ra badzra yo gi ni de ba ku shi she'u bande blo bde/she'u sngags pa/ g.yu'i ston rdo rje dpal/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal po/ rgyal sras chos rje man 'dra/yang na zhang ston nas/ 'bri mtshams pa bsod nams grub/ bla ma kun dga' 'bum/ 'jag ma lusapa sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnas rnying pa rtogs ldan sher gzhen/ dmu ston padma rgyal po/ sngagasa'achang sa'i snying po/ nyang ston tshe brtan rdo rje/ sngags 'chang dkon cog skyabs/ 'dis gyos rtse khang du zhus/ mnga' ris rigs 'dzin man gong ltar/ yang na bla ma kun dga' 'bum nas/ ri nang pa slob dpon rnam rgyal/ rtogs ldan brag tog pa/ jo gdan (233bskos rab gzhen nu/ dmu ston padma rgyal po man gong ltar/ yang na gangs pa shāka 'bum nas/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal po/ brgyud 'dzin legs pa dpal/ gro ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rngog ston bsod namasashes rab/ dmu ston kun tu bzang po/ dmu ston dkon cog skyabs man gong bzhin no/ /mnga' ris —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/gu ge 'dam grog mkhar nas skal ldan byis pas spyan drangs pa'i gag lhog gzer gsum sogs 'go nad thams cad thub nges pa'i zab khyad ma gcun 'khor lo nag po gu ge chig dril du grags pa'i skor la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus byung khungs/ bsrung bya'i ngo bo/ rdzas kyi rim pa/ rta mgrin/ khyung nag /phag nag /gnya' gnon padma kro ti ma rakṣa'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo mu khyud gsum pa rtsibs brgyad sngon po/khyung ser/ gser rdor/ g.yu'i ral gri/ zhang zhung dmod sngags/ ta du thā swā hā'i mtha' can/ khyung dmar/ bram ze dkar po/ ce spyang / khyung sngags lhang lhang ma swā hā'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa'i rtsibs brgyad ser po/ bram ze dmar nag /bram ze lce sdur rakta'i mtha' can/ khyung nag /ā tsarla/bram ze dkar po/ ce spyang / khyi dmar/ bram ze'i drag sngags hūṃ zhi nan rakṣa'i mtha' can/ 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa rtsibs bzhi sngon po/ mi'i drang srong / rdo rje rgya gram/ mu stegs thal mdog /bho khru srungs shig gi mtha' can/ phag gdong bzhi pa khyung nag /bram ze nag po/ khyung sngags lhang lhang ma skyobs shig gi mtha' can/ 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa rtsibs brgyad sngon po/ phag dkar/ phur pa/ bya rog /bya rog lkog sngags(oṃ ha la ya swā hā'i mtha' can/ khyung nag /khros nag /rtse gsum/ sngagasang ha ba ta swā (234na)hā'i mtha' can/ mu stegs thal mdog /rtse gsum/ khyung dmar/ mu steg ba(drag sngagasa.āoṃ du du srungs shig gi mtha' can/ ga bur gyi phag /nor bu/ khyung ser/ āoṃ bhi sha rakṣa'i mtha' can/khyung ser g.yu shel las grub pa/ phag rog /lhang lhang tser tser swā lha mtha' can/ che brjod rdzogs byang gi mtha' can dang bcas pa/ 'di'i le lag la gsob gzhan du zhal 'phang ba'i 'di la ngos 'dzin/ gnyan nad gag lhog gzer thung bcos thabs (6)la nang gses kyi 'byung khungs/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba rang gzhan bsrung ba/ gso ba'i thabs dang bzhis bstan pa/ rma dang skrangs pa la btab po'i mtha' can rnams kyi lung phyag len thob pa las g.yung drung gi rtags can ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs gsum mgon po/ slob dpon padma thod 'phrong / jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston skal ldan byis pa dbus pa brda sgom/ jo sras bde ba 'bar/ gnyan ston ri gong pa/ mgar sgom —336

dam pa'i cho kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam gsum pa/ rtog)dpon she se rgod mgon po/do sman pa/ bla ma shes rab mgon po nas rim par/chos rgyal ma ba'i ma' ༅/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/kun ri chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/yug rdzong pa nor bu dbang rgyal/dngas ma ba bstan 'dzin gyur med/'jam dpal 'od zer/rje 'phrin las lhun grub/sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/desabadag la'o//gsol 'debs las/rdo rje spre chung smon lam chu glang rtse/gnyal zhig nyi ma seng ge gnyal ston na gshes rab me 'bar khams pa me sgor dang //sna nam thub rgyal zhes rnams la gsol ba 'debs/zhes pa'i chu glang rtse mo'i gter skor la/dbang phyug tshangs pa chen po'i sgrub thabs las phyung ba'i mu stegs nag po tshe 'phel gyi man ngag 234ba glong bcud lha chen stobs 'dus nag po'i sgrub thabs dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo zhes pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rgya gar nas 'khor dus dpal o rgyan 'a por skyes kyi tshul du phul ba zang yag brag la sbas pa gter ston gu ru jo rtse'am chu glang rtse mor grags pas spyan drangs pa'i dbang phyug nag po'i gdams pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/'khor i dpe'u ris zhal shes dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/lha chen ma hā de wa/mu stegs kyi paṇḍita nag po tshe 'phel/gnubs chen sang rgyas ye shes/u rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/jo mo ye shes 'tsho khi/mchos rdo rje spre wo /gto rsā yi ru jo rtse nas/skal ldan rdo rje sto po/rdo rje lang chosakya rgyal mtshan/rigs lon chos kyi blo gros/kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/mkha' spyod rnam rgyal grags pa/pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/de sras ga then nu don grub/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//gter gnas de ṣka nas ga kho ston gu ru jo rtses gdan drangs pa'i sha brgya zan brgya'i lung phyag len dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/o rgyan chen po/jo mo 'tsho rgyal/gter ston gu ru jo rtse nas rim gyis brgyud de dkar 'a kun dga' grags pa/dbon po yon to bzang po/bya lha mchog bzang po/rig 'dzan 'phrin las lhun grub/chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/des bdag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheza hor bande la bstsal to/ /gnyal zhig nyi ma seng ge'i skor ma thob/ bram ze'i sngags rgod mu stegs kyi ston pa a mo li/ kor gyis gdams pa o rgyan chen pos bsam yas mchod rten nag po'i mgul 'bum du gter du sbas pa'i rten gsum 'dril sgrub bam gtsang shug mar grags pa dbang sdud nor bu gcig pa gnyal pa jo sras kyis spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ las kyi phyag rgya dbang du byed pa bram ze'i sngags (235na)rgod kyi lo rgyus (zur/sngags rgod rlung zhags rno myur me dang 'dra ba'i gzhung la rten bca' (zur/thabs/ bla rdo gzung (zur/ba/ sgom bzlas bsnyen pa dang (zur/ bcas pa/ bsnyen pa thengs nas sngags dang rdzas la brten pa'i las sbyor/ rig pa mi brtan pa 'grol thabs/ rang dang 'bral mi phod pa/ bcun thabs/ gnad 'bebs/ mi kha gnon pa/ spang blang zhal shes dang bcas pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dbang phyug ma hā de wa/ mu stegs kyi ston pa a mo li kor/mu stegs kyi ston pa mi pham mgon po/ dpal o rgyan chen po/ rdzo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston gnyal ba jo sras nag po/ ston mi ston bzang / tsha bo don bzang / spyos drung bdag tsho phyag bris mar ston ba4sa zer ba'ang 'dug /sman lung shākya 'od/ sman lung pa shāka gzhen/ sman lung pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sman lung pa sangs rgyas rin cen/ sman lung pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin cen padma dbang rgyal/ mchog sprul legs ldan bdud 'jomasardo rje/ khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs rgyal/ dpang ston rigs 'dzin rkarma gu sa grub mchog chos dbang bstan 'dzin/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za tor bande la'o/ /zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung dang phyag len zhal shes dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal nas/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o/ /yang na dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal nas/ gsang bdag rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/rdo rje lang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter (235ba tshe ston nas rim par/ gnyags ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ glan ston rdo rje mgon —338

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapo/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ rlung mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /rje pha bong kha pa man gong bzhin no/ /lo rgyus rin cen lde mig las/ o rgyan nga yi byin brlabs kyis bu gcig lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus dbus gtsang mtha' dbus 'khrug cing rgyal khams chu ltar 'khol las mi dge ba la spyod spyod ngan rang gis byas nas dus ngan zer zhing: bdud sprul bcu gsum dus gcig 'dzom pas sems can gyi bde skyid 'ja' ltar yal gti mug gi ngo bo nad yams dar 'dod chags kyi ngo bo mu ge dar ba'i dus: skyes bu shes rab kyi ming can zhabs la 'khor lo padma 'dab brgyad pas brgyan pa snying gar phag mo rang byung du bzhugs pa rtsa'i rtse na ye shes kyi sor gnyis su nar re yod pa dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba mkha' 'gro ma lngas nye gnas byed pa zhig skye bar 'gyur ro/ /des de nyid 'don zhes pa ltar kong po spa gdong nas sprul sku shes rab me 'bar gyis spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das rang grol gyi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sngon 'gro gsal ba'i me long nas sta gon dang 'jug pa/ dbang mchog mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas bum dbang gsang dbang sher dbang thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ thebs yig rin chen lde mig gser gyis maṇḍal la g.yu yi phra bcug pa 'dra ba yin pas spel zhig gi mtha' can lo rgyus rin chen lde mig mig 'byed chen mo le'u brgyad rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i snying por gyur pa snang stong dbyer med sku gsum ston pa'i sgra tshigs 'khor 'das rang grol rtsa ba (236na)gnyis med kyi rgyud mkha' 'gro'i srog snying le'u brgya dang brgyad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dbang bzhi'i sngon 'gro'i rin cen gsal ba'i me long rin cen sbar bkab ces bya ba gsal ba'i sgron me rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ theg mchog dbang gi dngos gzhi'i rim pa dbang mchog dang bcas pa bzhi rdzogs chen mo yig rigs brgya rtsa brgyad gtan la phab pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis byang ba bar do gsal ba kun gyi las byang kha skong ston pa sangs rgyas myur du thob shog gi mtha' can/ chos spyod gsol —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'adebs rig pa'i ngo bo ma mu tig 'phreng bar grags pa rnams/ thems byang du/ lha dbang / gtor dbang / khregs chod/ gsang skor/ 'chi ba brtag pa/ btags grol sogs 'dug pa brgyud nas thon pas de gar dgongs sam/ chos tshan logs su yod dpyad do/ /de ltar gong gsal dbang lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos dbyings dbyer med kun bzang yab yum/ bde stong dbyer med rta phag yab yum/rig stong dbyer med mkha' 'gro gtso mo/ skye 'chi mi mnga' padma thod 'phreng / rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston shes rab me 'bar/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa/ gter slob stag tshang ral pa/ thugs sras ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gu ru seng ge dbang phyug /dran mchog nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sman tsha bla ma shākya seng ge /g.ya' bzang dge slong bshes gnyen phun tshogs/ sngags 'chang rin chen dar rgyas/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin chen gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na rin chen dar rgyas nas/ zab lung mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po/ rdzogs (236ba)chen pa nam mkha' 'jigs med/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ de yang bla rgyud du rdo rje gling pa yod pa'i rgyu mtshan sba gdong gi gter ma'i rdzogs chen drag po gsum dril gyi shog ser bod yig yin yang 'khor 'das rang grol sgra rig dang yig rigs mi gcig pa brgya rtsa yod pas 'gor bod yig tu/ sprul sku rnam mkhyen gcig dang phrad par shog de min snyigs dus gzhan gyis khrol ri gan: zhes pa yod cing gter ston rang gis kyang shog ser ma khrol/ stag tshang ral pas skadze rang byung ba sogs mkhas grub mang por bstan kyang 'grol ma thub/ yig rigs bcu drug dang sgra rigs sum cu tsam mkhyen pa'i gter ston bla ma kun dga' bya bas kyang ma 'gyur/ de'i tshe gter ston rdo rje gling pa bee ro'i bag chags sad nas sgra yig gang la'ang thogs pa med pas shog ser las phab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /gter ston shes rab me 'bar gyis stag rtse brag nas byi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la spyan drangs pa'i gza' bdud rā hu la dang lha mo re ma tī gnyis kyi cho 'phrul gnam lcags rgyal po la gca' bzhi/ sgrub pa'i rim pa/ rtags yig /las sbyor dgu pa/ bsad pa/ man ngag zhal gdams/—340

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)dpe ris pho 'khor mo 'khor/ bar 'khor/ sprel thod/ pha wang long bu dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas rin chen snying po/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal/rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston shes rab me 'bar/ sman lung shākya gzhen nu/ mtshar steng pa rang grol rin cen/ tsa ri ba bsod nams bzang po/ lho pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal ma sgo'i mtshan can/ de (237na)sras ngag gi dbang po/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston khams pa me zor gyis brag rgya bo nas spyan drangs pa'i phyugs nad bsrung ba'i skor la/ tsakra bri ba/ rdzas/ rab gnas/ 'dogs tshul te bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa/ yang mang yul spyi lding lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i bres su sba ba/ sgo khyi'i 'jug mar 'dogs pa/ khyu mchog gi mgul du 'dogs pa/ rdzas bsrung ba/ sngags bsrung ba dang bcas pa'i lung dpe ris phyag len bcas zhib mor mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rigs gsum mgon po/ o rgyan padma thod phreng / mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston mkhas pa me zor nas rim par/ pha jo gzhon nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'brog pa sna nam thub rgyal gyi gter ma'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsungs pa'i gtsug lag gi 'khor lo la/ nyes pa thams cad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gsum/ 'byung ba lnga'i 'khor lo lnga/ gnyan pa'i las byed na 'dogs pa'i 'khor lo drug /gdon lnga bsrung ba'i 'khor lo lnga/ rus sbal 'byung lnga'i 'khor lo/ 'byung ba drug 'dus kyi 'khor lo lnga/ srog lus dbang thang rlung rta la dgra dar na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rigs gsum mgon po'i 'khor lo/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'khor lo/ yum lnga'i 'khor lo/ khro bcu'i 'khor lo/ phan dar gyi 'khor lo bzhi/ 'gro ba las bzhi'i 'khor lo/ rnal 'byor pa rang la 'dogs pa'i 'khor lo lnga/ lo skor bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo/ mthu bzlog pa'i 'khor lo lnga/ sa bdag klu gnyan bzlog pa'i 'khor lo gnyis/ srog lus dbang thang rlung rta gud na 'dogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ kha 'ching gi 'khor lo (237bsko/ sku gsung thugs yon —341 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shetan 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo/ ngan pa thams cad bsrung ba/ klu dang rgyal bsen bsrung 'khor gsum/'byung ba bskyed pa'i 'khor lo lnga/ phyogs ngan bsrung ba/ nad rims bsrung ba rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston sna nam thub rgyal nas rim par/ chos rgyal ma ba'i mtshan can/ ngag dbang rigasa'adzin rdo rje/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa padma rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gong gi gsol 'debs tshig sna thungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa'am/ med pa gang ltar yang gter phran 'ga' zhig 'dug pa las rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub bskor padma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi dpal mo dpal thang gi byang phyogs brag nag bya skyibs can du sbas pa bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas gdan drangs pa'i skor la/ g.yas zhal bram ze'i zhal can dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrubs la nang gses kyi bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa las sbyor dang bcas pa padma 'byung gnas kyi mtshon cha/ sing ga la'i dur khrod du padma thod 'phreng la nag po chen po sring mo bzhi'i tshogs kyis dngos su gsungs pa'i yang snying bcud kyi nying khu la nang gses kyi bod sngags/ zhi ba'i las/ rgyas pa'i las/ drag po'i las sbyor dang bcas pa gnad kyi man ngag /gsang las don bzhi ma/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dar khra can gyi gsang sgrub gtor mar brten pa/ bstod pa dpal ldan nag po ma/ bstod pa de'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba'i shog dril/ gu ru'i drung du gdong bzhi pas smras pas sngags byang gar phog thugs 'gyel gyi gnad dang bcas pa/ srog len spu gri'i sngags rgod gu ru padma la phul ba/ steng zhal bram ze'i zhal can nag po chen po(238na)gdong bzhi pa dang zhi ba bram ze'i cha lugs can thun mong sgrub pa las sbyor slob dpon chen por gdong bzhi pas dngos su gsungs pa/ steng zhal bram ze'i zhal can nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i gter mchog bsdus pa gsad pa/ cho 'phrul 'gyed pa/ spra rtags/ gur sogs chos skyong gzhan rnams kyis srog snying phul tshul bcas pa skal ldan cig la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bram ze dkar po'i sgrub thabs gu ru padma rgyal po'i drung du bram ze gzi ldan gyi phul ba rnams thob pa las —342

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)bram dkar gyis sgrub thabs ma gtogos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ o rgyan chen po padma thod phreng / ba smra ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad pa bzang po/ dpal de ba/ bi mā la gupta/ rin cen rdo rje/ rin cen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnam kha'u pa/gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags pa/ lho brag shar gyi gter ston ra shag chos 'bar/ gnyan ku mā ra/mkhas grub pa/ kun mkhyen pa/ shes rab rtse mo/ 'od 'bar ba/ dpal ldan pa/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ bla brang ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan nas rim par/ chos rgyal mo ga'i mtshan can/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /bram ze dkar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po nas/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ rje khra tshang pa/des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje la'i / nag po wo po/ padma thod 'phreng / gnyan lo/ ra shag man 'dra/ 'di deng sang ra shag gter mar grags na'ang gnyan los gter 'di rnyed pa'i rkyen gyis rgya gar du ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma la gsan par byon/ tshur phebs(238bskos bka' ma rnamasaganam kha'u pa dang gter ma ra shag la gnang zhes lo rgyus su 'dug /'on kyang ra shag gi gter ma med pa'i mtha' ma chod do/ /rang gter las/ o rgyan padma bdag 'dra yis bod yul dbus su bsam yas bzhengs gsol mchis bod na dam tshig bsrung ba'i mi med na dam la mi gnas blun po gdug pa che drag sngags cog brdungs thugs kyi reg gcod 'di bod du ma spel bal po'i yul du khyer lan cig chos 'khor 'jigs la phan gdags phyir dpe gcig bod kyi yi ger bsgyur nas ni spra dun rtse yi lha khang de ru sbas zhes pa ltar byang spra dun rtse'i lha khang nas gter ston g.yas ban ya bon gyis spyan drangs pa'i rlung 'khor srog gi spu gri srin mo phyir 'thag ma 'khor lo lto bshags nag po drag sngags cog brdung zhes pa/ bri dus bri gzhi/ 'dri tshul/ rab gnas/ skor ba/ tshad/ rtags/ ngar bskyed/ thun bskul/ rang bsrung / spogs chog rnams bstan pa/ yig chung la/ rtsub pa 'jam du gtong pa/ 'dogs ling / ngar glud/ thun/ so brdar/ gnas 'bebs kyi zhal shes/ dpe ris la/ steng —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsā'akhor/ 'og 'khor/ ling brkyang / rang bsrung / snal ma'i bcas/ gnad 'bebs kyi bca' gzhi dang bcas pa'i lung phyag len dmar khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston g.yas ban ya bon/ lcags gtun nag po/ gnubs ston chos grags/ gnubs bya bral/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma ke tu/ chos kyi blo gros/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal/ (239na/sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ drin chen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na lha chen ma hā de ba/mu stegs kyi ston pa kha 'phur nag po/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ gter ston g.yas ban ya bon nas rim par/ sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku padma dbang rgyal/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rab 'byams chos dpal bzang po/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ yug mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sprul sku padma dbang rgyal nas/ nyang tsha chos kyi dbang po/ yug nor bu dbang rgyal/ dar ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med man gong bzhin no/ /spa gro bcal gyi brag dmar nas 'brug lo ston zla ra ba'i nya la bam po a hūṃ gis spyan drangs pa'i dzam nag srog gi 'khor lo rig pas nor bsdus bcas cho ga yid bzhin nor bu mi nor zas gsum dbang du sdud pa'i man ngag lo rgyus zhal gdams gnad yig 'khor lo gsum gyi 'khor lo dpe chung dang bcas pa/ dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba glang po che la nor bslang ba zas nor rin cen char 'bebs zhes bya ba bcas chog ma zas nor sprin ltar bsdu zhing 'byor pa dmu yang gi mtsho dang sprod thabs khyad par can gyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ḍa ki ma ga ga na sirnyi/ dha na 6go /rgyal po gu ru ka de wa/ o rgyan padma thod 'phreng / mkhar chen gza' 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston bam po a hūṃ/ dpal dga' bo lung pa/ gar ston 'bum dar/ lte ston sras po/zhang ston brtson seng / zur zil gnon rdo rje/ rin cen rgyal ma'/(239ba khol mo sngags 'am pa —3yo

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)shākya bzang po/ mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul klu gter ston 'gyur med rdo rje/ de bdag za hor bande la'o/ /lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas gdan drangs pa'i sman rtag tu ngu dang 'brel ba'i sman gyi skor/gtsang nyang ro brgya ban rdo rje 'od kyi lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring mda' sgro can nas gdan drangs pa'i sman rtag tu ngu'i bcud len pa/ lo rgyus/ brtag pa/ btu ba/ rab gnas/ ril bu/bsten thabs te sman rtag tu ngu za thabs lnga'i sgo nas bstan pa rtag tu ngu lnga sbyar gyi sgo nas za thabs/rtag tu ngu bcud len sbyor ba'i rgyal po zhes pa skye sa dang rtsa brtag pa/ sbyar thabs te gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i rtsa mchog mdangs ldan bcud len mkho mthing lha khang gi snang ba mtha' yas kyi phyag la sbas pa/ rtsa rtag tu ngu rigs gsum gyi ngos 'dzin bla ma'i zhal shes ma/ nas dkar mo la sbyar ba'i bcud len/ mar dang bu ram la sbyar ba'i bcud len/ rlon sbyor du grags pa/ 'bras bu gsum la sbyar ba'i bcud len mchog tu zab pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sgos dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ dran mchog o rgyan chen po/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston rgyab na rdo rje dbang phyug /tsha mo kun dga' bzang mo/ gnubs ye shes rdo rje/ nyang ston shes rab dpal ldan/ bla ma seng ge rdzong pa/ mkhar chu kun 'tshal kun dga' gling pa/ chos rje shes rab bzang po/ spyan sngar zhwa dmar bzhi ba chos kyi grags pa/ mnga' bdag (240na)kun dga' lhun grub/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rigs 'dzan ga rma gu sa rang grol nam mkha' chos —345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedabang / khyab bdag blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin du bstsal to/ /yang na sangs rgyas thub pa chen po/ ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ o rgyan yab yum man gong bzhin/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan gyi gsan yig /dka' ba du mas bsgrubs pa'i dad rdzas dang / /sdug bsngal nyam thag can gyi gshin zas dang / 'bul sdud gzhogs slong brkam chags can gyi zas/ /de 'dra spangs nas dben pa'i brag phug tu/ /'di 'dra'i 'tsho ba'i lus 'di brtas byas nas/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nor la spyod par shog /ces gsungs pa snying la bcangs bar bya'o/ /zung mkhar gyi a jo dpal bos mon bum thang gi ka ba nas spyan drangs pa'i bsod nams me ltar 'bar byed glang po'i stobs bskyed mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i bsrung ba zab mo'i dpe ris dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ spyan ras gzigs/ o rgyan chen po/ jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ tshangs pa lha'i me tog /gter ston a jo dpal bo nas rim par/ zur gzhon nu don grub/drin can chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u'i brag nas zung mkhar gyi a jo dpal pos spyan drangs pa'i jo mo yang gha bza' ma rma ri rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal gyi sgrub skor la/ gnas rdzas/ ting 'dzin/sngags/ las sbyor/ las tshogs dang bcas ston pa'i sgrub thabs/ mdos bca' bzhi bsngo ba/ yang gha pa za'i sgrub thabs sman gyi me long zhes pa rdzas sngags 'khor lo kha sgyur bcas ston (240ba)pa/sgrub pa'i shom/ srog 'khor/ mdos kyi dpe ris dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/dpal he ru ka /o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston a rdzo dpal po nas rim par/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ mtshungs med gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yer pa'i dkar chag lha lung dpal rdo dmar grags pa bla ma zangs ri bas yer pa gso ba'i —346

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadur khrod nag po'i spre'u ser po'i bar khang gi rtsa ba nas rnyed pa'i shog ser rgya yig dang bod yig spel can gyi lung yang sprul sku gter bdag gling par thob/ gter ston sngags 'chang dbang chen bzang pos byang spra dun rtse'i ka gzhu nas spyan drangs pa'i spu gri nag po drang srong khyab 'jug dgra bo zas su gtod pa'i gdong gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rin cen snying po/ rdo rje 'chang / rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ o rgyan rin po che/ mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston sngags pa dbang chen/ ston pa nam mkha' bzang po nas rim par/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ der bdag za hor bande la'o/ /shangs kyi skye ka thang shing brag nas gter ston bem po drag rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'i rā hu la shi sa bstan pa rus sbal nag po'i ser bsrung bcas chog ma za ba'i bka' rgya srog gi rgya can srid pa gsum na dkon par grags pa'i rdza'i rus sbal/ khyab 'jug gi sto 'khor mu khyud bcu pa/ rdzas rab gnas gca' gzhi dam tshig rnams chos tshan cig tu tshang ba'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po/(241na)paṇa chen shi sno garbha/ gu ru khrag 'thung nag po/ gnubs sangasargyas ye shes/ ga kho ston bon po drag rtsal/ rong ston geg dpal/ rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ de sras rdo rje dbang phyug /rngog shākya seng ge /pha ston shākya ston po/ sbug ston dpal ldan mgon po/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zur bde legs rgyal mtshan/ se brgya mkhar ba rin cen rgyal mtshan/ spyan tsha ba mgon po zla ba/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs rgyal/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje grags pa/ mang thos dam chos bzang po/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ mchog sprul gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter ston skyes bu zangs gling dbang phyug gi gter ma'i skam gtad brlan gtad rul bar byed pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje'i las mtha' zab mo'i lung phyag len zhal shes bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/—347—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheslob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ gter ston zangs gling dbang phyug nas rim par/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ ngag dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /rang gter las/ padma 'byung gnas bdag gi kyang phyi rabs bstan pa bsrung ched du: srog mchan nag po'i 'khrul 'khor 'di rta mgrin rgyal po nyid la sbas las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog /ces pa ltar bum thang dge gnas lha khang gi khro bo rta mgrin gyi mchan ma nas sbur po bya'u mgon gyis spyan drangs pa'i srog mchan nag po bum thang srog 'khor la/ srog mchan pa nag po le'u (241ba)brgyad pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'khrugs byed rgyal po'i le'u bco brgyad pa nas rlung lha las la bkol ba la don gnyis yod pa'i drag sngags bcu bor zhes pa rdzas dang bcas bzhi/ sngags dang ting 'dzin/ rtags dang mjug bsdud/ gnad dbab/ bzlog pa mkhan gnad la dbab pa ste don lngasabastan pa/ mgyogs pa/ rno ba/ gzung ba/ gnad dbab/ sgrib shing / 'jam rtsub ste zhal gdams don bdun ma/ mi thebs mi srid pa/ tshur mi ldog pa/ 'jam rtsub/ sna 'dren te don lnga'i yig chung gsang ba snying gi tig /ling 'khor gyi zhal gdams/ 'khor lo'i 'bri thabs phul du byung ba/ skad brtag pa/ rnal 'byor rang srung dang bcas pa/ dpe ris la/ pho mo'i 'khor lo'i lto 'khor yod med gnyis/ spogs mchogo /bzlog pa mkhan gsad pa'i ling 'khor/ ling rkyang / bca' gzhi dang bcasapa'i lung phyag len zhal gdams zhib mor thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ mu stegs kyi ston pa kha 'phung nag po/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston spur po bya'u mgon nas rim bzhin/ lha bcu rin chen rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan 'od zer/ myang tsha chos kyi dbang po/ yung rdzong nor bu dbang rgyal/ zur bla med rdo rje rtsal/ rma mi 4ra rdo rje/ khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na sprul sku yon to 'od zer nas/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rig 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ zur —348

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabla med rdo rje rtsal man gong bzhin no/ /lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas yang bon ri khrod pa seng shes spyan drangs pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin pa la brten nas bstan dgra tshar gcod pa'i skor la/ bsrung ba yi dam (242na)rgyal ba'i zhe gcig mdun rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa/ bzlog pa dug gi spu gri zhes pa 'khor lo la brten nas nang rgyal byad ma bam bzlog tu gsod pa/ gsod pa phar phyin rgyal ba'i bka' mthu zhes pa ling ga la brten nas lus sems bla tshe srog dang phral ba'i gdams pa zab mo/ de'i bsrung 'khor bsgom pa'i man ngag bka' gter zung 'jug sgom don ngag bsgrigs chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs mgon po klu sgrub snying po/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston ri khrod seng ge /'gro mgon mdzes pa/ sras de ston nas rim par chosargyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /phar phyin rgyal ba'i bka' mthu snying po bsdu ba shog cig ma'i lung brgyud ni/sras de ston nas/ bla ma nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rje dbus pa rtogs ldan/ 'bri gung pa gnam lcagasame 'bar/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog /zur gzhen nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dbus pa rtogs ldan nas/ sngags 'chang dbus pa bkra shis/ dge slong kun dga' dpal bzang / zur gzhen nu don grub man gong bzhin no//rang gter kun gsal nyi 'od las/ mi nyag rigs 'dzin mdong gi bu: skyes bu lcags khams glang lo pa: zhes dang padma gling pa'i gter lung las/ o rgyan sprul pa thang stong pa zhes 'byung : de dus bod khams sems can cung zad bde zhes lung gis zin pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i bsam yas mchims phu (242ba)nas zab gter lnga tsam spyan drangs pa las tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku khro rgyal rta mgrin/ sprul sku o rgyan chen po/ gter ston thang stong rgyal po/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po rdo ring pa/—349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog /sprul sku bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na bstan 'dzin nyi bzang nas/ sger pa ba ngag dbang nyi ma bzang po/ sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan man gong ltar ro/ /yang na bstan 'dzin rin po che nas/ sngags 'chang tshe ring dbang po/ klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bka' 'gyur ba bsod nams mchog ldan man gong bzhin/ yang na bstan 'dzin rin po che nas/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gnyal smad brag nag mda' sgro nas lcang sman drang srong don grub dar gyis gdan drangs pa'i mtshon cha las kyi 'khor lo brgya'i dug mtsho 'khol ma phung 'dre ngan thabs kyi rgyud chen po gsal shing nag po las rang gzhan bsrung zhing gso byed kyi bcud phyung ba bdud rtsi 'chi gsos rta ri ma'i sbyor sde khol du phyung ba'i lung brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ drang srong don grub dar/ 'tsho byed bstan bsrung dar/ byar po paṇa chen zla ba'i dbang po/ mkhas dbang 'gro don 'phrin las/ 'tsho byed dmi dar rgyas/ rje btsun 'phrin las lhun grub/(243na〉rga ba'i bla ma 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /yar rje o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa'i pad ma bka' thang sogs bka' thang sde lnga'i skor/gsol 'debs las: o rgyan sangs rgyas rdo rje kun skyong gling : rin cen ratna padma ga me gling :las 'phro bsam gtan bstan gnyis gling pa sogs 'khrul med gling pa bcu gcig la gsol ba —350

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogana'adebs zhes pa'i gter ston o rgyan gling pa'i thang yig las/ rgyal sras lha rje sngon du khrid shog gsungs/ sras 'di'i skye ba yang snga da bar du bdag gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sras yin gsungs lta ba rdzogs chen padma snying thig dang : yi dam bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho dang : bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum la sogs pa rtsis sman kun gyi bdag po 'di yin pas yar klung gter kha 'di la gtad do gsungs gsang mtshan sngags pa mchog grub rgyal por gsol: zhes dang / skye ba gcig ni bod yul gra nub mda' rgyal sras lung pa 'di na nub tu skye sngags pa mthu mkhan sngags rtsis sman skyong rigs chos dbyings mdangs can ye shes kha dog can yar rje o rgyan gling pa zhes bya ba me khams chu mo phag gam khyi lo pa sprul pa'i sras ni 'dam skyes padma 'dra: zhes lung gis zin pa ltar za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin dang rgyal sras lha rje'i skye ba sangs rgyas bla ma sogs gter ston brgyad pa'i skye ba bcu gsum gyi mtha' ma sprul sku o rgyan gling pa mchog grub rgyal pos gter g.yog hor bsgom shākya bzang po dang lhan cig par yar klung shel gyi brag rdzong padma brtsegs pa'i ngogs padma shel phug gi sgo srungs khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyi skye rabs rnam par thar pa padma bka' thang du grags pa le'u brgya dang brgyad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba
