mtha' (243ba 'as/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ rgyal sras lha rje/ gter ston yar rje o rgyan gling pa/ mkhas grub ye shes rab 'byams/ bla ma dpal 'byor pa/ dgyer dpon kun dga' dpal mchog /sngags 'chang shākya rin cen/ she'u kun dga' chos dbang / sngags 'chang legs pa shes rab/ rigs 'dzin nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ de la pha jo lhun grub rdo rje dang / de sras gzhon nu don grub gnyis gas gsan/ sngags 'chang gzhen nu don grub la zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyis gsan/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na o rgyan gling pa nas/ nan ārya/ bla ma yon to 'bum/ bla ma chos kyi rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ rgyal sras dri med 'od zer/ mkhas—331 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegrub thar pa gling pa nas rim par/ sngags 'chang nam mkha' legs grub/ drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/rje du ma rang grol/ de dbon ye shes grub pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston o rgyan gling pas bsam yas dge rgyas li ma gling gi lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i rgyal po bka'i thang yig gam snang srid gtan la 'bebs pa'i le'u bstodagu pa/ dpe la la ni dbu rtsedang lalar rdo'i mchod rten dang rdo'i seng ges nas bton zer ba 'dug pas brtag /khams gsum zangs khang gling gi ka gzhu nas gdan drangs pa'i btsun mo bka' thang le'u nyer gcig pa/ yar klungs shel gyi brag phug nas spyan drangs pa'i blon po bka' thang le'u sum cu pa/ dge rgyas li ma gling nas spyan drangs pa'i lo paṇa bka'i thang yig le'u sum cu so lnga pa/ bu tsha'i gser khang gi sgo mdun rus sbal 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i lha 'dre bka' thang le'u gsan yig la lar nyer bzhi 'dug pa brtag/(244na〉ter gsum pa rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rgyal sras lha rje/ gter ston o rgyan gling pa/ rin cen gling pa bde legs rgya mtsho/ bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho/ byang sems pa sprul sku bsam grub rgyal po/ rje mkha' slong yangs pa/ sman rtse ba blo gros rgya mtsho/ khyung tshang pa blo gros dpal ldan/ mtshungs med ga me gu sa grub mchog chos dbang bsam grub/ nye gnas dge slong kun bzang / rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra/sngags 'chang hūṃ nag me 'bar/ tse le sprul sku padma legs grub/ bsod snyoms pa grub pa rdo rje/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa'i rdzong chen tshe dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku tshe dpag med mgon/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shesa'atsho rgyal/ rgyal sras lha rje/ gter ston o rgyan gling pa/ sman lung pa shākya gzhen nu/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des bla ma shākya dpal ba dang sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis la gnang / sangs rgyas rin cen nas/ de sras blo gros rgya mtsho/ smad mgon lhun grub mtshan can/ rma dgon nam mkha'i mtshan —352—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganacan/ bde gshegs sprul sku'i mtshan can/ slob dpon rin cen mchog grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sman lung pa shāka gzhen nas/ rma mgon pa shākya seng ge /sprul sku byang chub rdo rje/ bla ma thar pa rgyal mtshan/ sman lung blo gros rgya mtsho/ rma dgon pa smon lam rgya mtsho/ rma dgon pa nam mkha'i mtshan can/ dpal 'bar mtshan (244ba༄na/ slob dpon rin cen mchog grub man gong bzhin no/ /sprul sku o rgyan gling pas gra zar po'i zangs mtsho brag ri rin cen gter sgrom nas spyan drangs pa'i rten 'brel yang snying 'dus pa'i skor la/ ri khrod 'grim dus gzung 'dzin gyi zhen pa che na ting 'dzin gyi nyams 'phel thabs/ bying zhing snying mi dga' 'gro 'dod cing dge sbyor la 'tsher na ting 'dzin rnal du phebs thabs/ dur khrod sogs gnyan sar 'jigs pa sel ba/ zas 'chag nad sdang 'gro 'dod na shes pa rnal du 'bebs thabs/ me shing med par sha thug brtse ba/ gnyid sel ba/ zas gos tshegs med du 'byung ba/ 'chi blu/ sprelu sad pa/ khyi smyon/ sbrang bu sogs kyis so btab pa'i dug sel thabs/ skyes pa/ bud med/ khrom/ rgyal po/ btsun mo/ dmangs rnams dbang du bsdu thabs/ bu chung / dar ma/ bud med/ rgan 'khogs rnams kyi nad gso ba/ zas 'du ba/ 'thab rtsod mi 'ong ba/chus mi 'byer ba/ dgra khyi/ stor brlag mi 'ong ba/ ci smras la nyan pa/ grogs dang mi bral ba/ spyo ba/bu tsha brlag pa/ lus la ser kha/ dri/ srog chags mi 'byung ba/ spu byi ba/ 'brum bu/ ngos shig sbre/nongs pa sel ba/ lha 'dre dbang du bsdu ba/ thig le 'dzag pa gcod pa gsum/ lha 'dre gnod pa bzlog pa/ 'byung po 'bros pa/ jag chings/ nyams grib sel ba/ yams nad gcod pa/ zas nor 'dul ba/ rkang mgyogs/ chu cher gtong ba/ kha char gcod pa/ khyi bsrung / gos mi dgos/ bza' btung chen pa gcod pa/ phyag rgya 'gugs pa/ rma/ rna ba/ mig /sna khrag /so/ zhig gu/ brang rgyab gzer pa/ ma zhu ba/ 'khru ba/ glang thabs/ mgo na ba rnams gso ba/ byi ba bsrung ba/ chu gdon pa (245na)rlung gnon/ shig bsrung / mthu bzlog /'chi ba bzlog pa/ lus kyi srog chags bsrung ba/—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neme lcags bzo ba/ go chas mi thub pa/ ser bsrung / mi ma yin bsrung ba/ rmi lam gsal ba/ blo rno ba/skad snyan par byed pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen gza'/ rgyal sras lha rje/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa nas rim par/ rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag chosadabyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston o rgyan gling pas zung mkhar rdo'i mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa'i srog gcod spu gri 'dus pa'i dpal mgon stag zhon nag po'i chos skor la/ thub dbang gi yi ge'i steng nas cod pan/bum pa la brten nas lha tshogs yongs rdzogs kyi bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang dang bcas pa'i mthu dbang yongs rdzogs/ gtor ma/ phyag mtshan/ ling ga sogs la brten pa'i mthu gtad ser gsum gyi rjes gnang mnos nas/ lung la/ them byang 'dzom yig /mgon po'i skye rgyud srog gcod spu gri 'dusapa'i lo rgyus/ bka' babs sgo 'byed mthu dbang gi yi ge /'phrin las kyi rim pa don brgyad la/dpal mgon nag po spu gri gsang ba srog gcod 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs/ las tshogs gzer kha bcu gsum la/ klu dang rgyal bsen/ ser ba/ lam gyi 'jigs pa rnams bsrung ba/ rbod gtong bzlog pa/ngag gnon/ ltas ga cho 'phrul/ mngon shes pra sgrub/ zas nor sgrub pa/ rig ma dbang sdud kyi nang gses la lha mo stangs stabs kyi tshul du 'gugs pa/ phra men man ngag gi tshul du sgrubs pa/ spyo 'bogs ltas ngan tshul du bsgrub pa gsum/ sri'u gso ba/ ser ba (245brkob ba pa/ rang gshed 'beb pa/g.yul bzlog pa rnams/ nyams chags skong ba'i bkang gso chos skyong mgon po ma/ drag po'i bzlog pa sbu gri 'dus pa' gter chen/ sbas pa'i man ngag gnad kyi gzer drug ces par klu gtad/ yul 'byung rtsabs gcod ngag gnon/ nye 'byed/ dbang sdud/ gsod bzlog /kha mchu rgyal ba drug la kha bsgyur chog pa'i sgrog 'grol man ngag /ser bsrungs/ char 'bebs/ hom gyi gsad pa rnams/ dpal nag po chen po mgon po gsang ba srog gcod spu gri'i rgyud le'u nyi shu pa/ spu gri 'dus pa'i g.yul —354

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabazlog gsang mdos chen mo rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/bram ze kha nas me 'bar/ bi ka ma shī la'i slob dpon ārya de ba/ 'phung byed shis garbha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rgyal sras lha rje/ sprul sku o rgyan gling pa ye shes mchoge grub rgyal po/ sman lung pa shākya gzhen nu/ sman lung pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sman lung pa sangasargyas rin chen/ sman lung pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug nyang ston rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/ des bdag za hor brje'i bstan bsrung du stsal to/ /yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i gter byon rā hu la gnad la phab nas dgra bo zhag gcig la gsod pa gnyid log na rang 'chi zhing ma log na dgra 'chi ba'i gdams pa zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan chen (246na)po/ jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston mchog grub rgyal po nas rim par/nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rigasa'adzin ngag gi dbang po/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa ni/ rang gter lung bstan bka' rgya las/ lha sras nyid ni chos kyi bdag po ste gtso bo rdo rje rgyal por mnga' gsol bas ma 'ongs dus kyang rdo rje rgyal por 'byung: zhes dang / 'di phrad dus kyi tshul lugs ji ltar na lusang ga yid gsum smyo thabs zhig tshul lam dge sbyong tshul la rig pa'i ngar dang ldan zhum pa med par snang ba zil gyis gnon char chod bar do'i rnam shes lta bu'i tshe gsang gter 'di phrad ḍā gis las byed 'gyur: thogs brdugs med par rdzu 'phrul sna re ston ma dag skye bos gshe log skur pa 'debs smon lam gang 'brel dad cing 'dun par 'gyur zhes dang / tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi lung bstan las/ lan cig dus kyi mtha' la 'bab pa'i tshe: o rgyan gsung gi sras mchog gdung shugs can snying smi dmar mtshan burnya zhes bya 'byung de la bka' —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'adi thod la stong grogs gyis: zhes dang / don tig las/ rdo rje brag nas skal ldan skyes bu ni:'brug gi lo pa burnya zhes pa'i ming : tsitta sme ba rā ga'i mdog dang ldan skal ldan de la don tig rdzogs par ston: zhes gter kha mang po nas lung bstan pa ltar dpal o rgyan chen po'i gsung gi sprul pa lha sras mu rub btsan po'am/ dam 'dzin skye ba sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa'am sangs rgyas rdo rje grags pas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter phal cher ni yul rigs (246ba)sa phyogs gang du skye zhe na de dus lha sras gdug rtsub dbang che pas blun po'i bu bkums byang kong phyogs su sprugs ma 'ongs bskal ba dus kyi snyigs mar yang : las kyi 'phen pas sa phyogs der skye zhing : gdul bya dag kyang phal cher de phyogs skyong : zhes pa'i don thog tu bab te/ kong yul bla dkar dung gi sgo mo nas brgyud rnams dang pu ri rin cen 'bar ba'i sgrub phugs yangs pa can nas chos sde gzhan rnams spyan drangs pa'i bla ma dgongs 'dus zhes pa theg pa phyi nang gong 'og thams cad kyi 'gag don snying por bsdus te man ngag dbang po rab 'bring mtha' ma kun gyi spyod yul du mang nyung ran zhing gab sbas med pas gzhan la ltos mi dgos pa'i go bde/ bsgrubs na myur zhing bcangs pa tsam gyis byin brlabs kyi tshan kha che ba dpal o rgyan chen po'i dgongs pa'i bzhed phugs sgra rang bsgyur don dgongs bsgyur/man ngag gnad bsgyur/ phrad chog blo bde/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yang gsang rin po che gter gyi mdzod de'i chos skor la/ thog mar ras bris gyis dkyil 'khor la brten nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ bum pa'i dbang bcu/ rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' rab stims sku lha/ rab 'byamasagasung sngags/ rab 'byams thugs phyag mtshan/ rab 'byams yon tan dur khrod kyi chas sogs rgyan/'phrin las gzhan don dang bcas pa'i dbang / rdo rje slob dpon rab 'byams kyi dbang dngos dang de dang 'brel bar kun tu bzang po'i dbang / phyag rgya/ brda/ don/ dam tshig /mtha' rten bcas pa'i dbang / zhan la dbang phyi ma gsum/ rdo rje'i brtul bzhugs/ lung bstan/ rjes gnang / dbugasadabyung / chos rdzas dbang / dregs pa'i dbang dang bcas pa (247na)byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor —356

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganal brten nas spros med gsang ba don gyi dbang / phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / nyi ma'i zer la brten nas rab tu spros med thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang / sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs la brten nas yongs su spros med 'khor 'das bzhi rdzogs rang byung don dbang / mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas chags can lam longs ḍā zhi'i srog dbang / bshad ma thag pa'i dkyil 'khor de rnams la brten nas bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang /rtsal dbang / rtags grol gyi dbang / dngos grub bcud dbang / dregs pa'i srog dbang / bka' gtad rjes dbang rnams tshang ba'i rang byung don dbang / ḍā zhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum gsang shes rab tshe dbang bcas yongs su tshang ba'i spyod pa nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ si/ ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas me long / thod bum/ rdor dril/ 'dod yon/ mar me'i rjes gnang rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i gtum mo'i me dbang / rtsa gsum gyi gtor ma gnas lnga dang lag tu bskur ba'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i brda dbang / glegs bam la brten nas po ti'i lung gi dbang dang / dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang rdzas la brten nas dam la gnas pa'i sku/ bka' gnyan par byed pa gsung / srog gta' mar gzung ba thugs/ dngos grub stsol ba yon tan/ bran du bskul pa 'phrin las/ grogs ltar brtseb dam tshig /rang gshed dbab pa'i las gnon/ mi 'bral ba nyer gtad bcas pa rnams kyi dbang / bka' gnyan gsung bstod yongs rdzogs rjes gnang / zhal zas/ snang gsal/ sngags la brten pa'i 'jam dpal shes rab blo 'phel ral (247ba)gri'i rjes gnang / 'chi med tshe'i dbang / chos khrung bsnol ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ phyag mtshan la brten nas rdo rje phag mo dang mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i bum dbang / gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ mtha' rten rjes gnang dang bcas pa rnams legs par mnos/ lung la/ kun rdzob la a 'thas kyi chen pa bzlog byed bskyed rims kyi skor/ bye brag la thun mong du dgos pa'i skor/ khyad par yang zab mkha' 'gro'i skor/ rtsa gsum spyi dril gnad du gdams pa'i las tshogs dbang sdud skor/ ye shes dbyings su skyed byed rdzogs rim gyi —357—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (neskor/ bka' dang bstan pa bsrung byed chos skyong gter bdag gi skor/ mtha' brten 'gag bsdomasartsa ba'i chings kyi skor dang bdun/ dang po la sgrub pa'i sgrom drug /yan lag bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa drug /khog 'bub spyi don gyi gzer drug /kha skong 'phrin las kyi rgyan drug /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyang gi thems drug /byang chub bsgrub pa'i lam drug /lag len 'khrul gyi las drug /spros bcas yig chung gi dmar 'khrid drug /de nyid gsal ba'i 'gag drug dang dgu /dang po la dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i sgrub pa nor bu dpal 'phreng / de'i lhan thabs yig chung dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sgrub pa thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa'i nor bu'i snying po/ yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa nyi zla kha sbyor zhes pa a nu dang a ti ltar sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ thams cad spyi dril gyi sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ de'i sngags kyi yig chung gud du sbas pa/ thems med/ bye brag so sor sgrub pa 'phrul gyi dum bu/ gud du sbas pa rtsa ba gsum yang gsang rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa thugs sgrub gsal byed thugs kyi nor (248na)bu thems med/ de'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor tsha ba dmar thal/ de'i dpe'u ris/ thems med/rtsa gsum srog 'khor dpe'u ris/ 'phrin las lam 'khyer bsdus pa me tog phreng mdzes/ thems med/bsrung bzlog bsad gsum byad ma stobs 'joms/ dpe'u ris dang bcas pa rnams/ gnyis pa yan lag bdud brtsi'i sgrub pa drug la/ tshe sgrub kyi sgrub pa bdud rtsi'i snying po'i yang zhun/ gzhan don spros bcas kyi tshe sgrub dbang dang bcas pa/ thems med/ sman sgrub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i gegs sel gyi man ngag yig chung / thems med/ bam sgrub bdud rtsi'i yang zhun/ de'i dpogs chog yig chung / them med/gtor sgrub bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo/ gtor sgrub bdud rtsi'i tso mar/ gzungs sgrub bdud rtsi chu rgyun rnams/ gsum pa khog 'bubs spyi don gyi gzer drug la sgrub chen gyi spra 'khrid gsal ba'i me long /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mngon rtogs rin cen 'phreng ba ma hā yo ga ltar bstan pa/ lam khrid gab pa mngon byung mun sel sgron me/ skongs kyi cho ga nyen mongs sreg byed/ las byed rlung 'khor pho nya myur mgyogs/ sgro 'dabs bzhi'i 'dri tshul/ thems med/ de'i sham bu'i yig chung dpe ris la rlung khang —358—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarkyang pa/thes med/gsum brtsegs/byang chub rlung 'khor/pho 'khor mo 'khor/las byed tsakra/sgro 'dabs kyi ling ga dang bcas pa/sbyin sreg cho ga me 'od 'bar ba/dgang blugs kyi byin brlabasadabang bskur dpe ris dang bcas pa them med/rnams/bzhi pa kha skong 'phrin las kyi rgyan drug la/las byang tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bdud rtsi'i 'phreng ba/bstod 'bum chen po tshangs pa'i dra ba/bskul 'bum myur mgyogs slog gi phreng ba/mdangs 248ba ) bskang rin cen 'phreng ba/sman rag gtor gsum bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/kun khyab chos 'phreng me tog char rgyun rnams/lnga pa tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi thems drug la/rab gnas cho ga bkra shis brtsegs pa/chos bshad gdams pa drang don dge bskul gshin chog sgrib sbyong ye shes 'od 'phro/de'i lhan thabs phung po sbyang ba'i yig chung /thems med/sātstsha 'debs chog bsod nams ri bo/dam tshig rnam bshad bsrung bsdoms rgyal mdud/bsngo ba'i rim pa nor bu bsam 'phel rnams/drug pa byang chub sgrub pa'i lam drug la/sngon 'gro'i yan lag bdun pa sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig/nyams len skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rin cen gser gyi gzhi/maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu/'tsho ba zas kyi rnal 'byor bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/bskor ba spyod lam rgyun 'byer/gtor chog bdud rtsi'i kun khyab rnams/bdun pa lag len 'phrul gyi lasadrug la/dkyil 'khor bris thig tshangs pa'i dra ba/dkyil 'khor rnam dag rab gsal nyi 'od/sku gzugs phyag tshad rin chen dra mig/gar 'cham rim pa 'phrul gyis pa tra/dkyil 'khor blos slong rin chen them skas/dbyangs byang spra 'khrid dpe don zung 'brel rnams/rigs 'dzin rje'i gas yig na gsal ba'i me long zer ba 2ga/brgyad pa spros chas yig chung dmar 'khrid drug la/dkyil 'khor lag len dmar 'khrid/mchod pa'i lag len dmar 'khrid/gtor ma'i lag len dmar 'khrid/brda rtags lag len dmar 'khrid/rnam 'byed 'phrul gyi 'khor lo/rten 'brel rgyun 'byer dmar 'khrid/snang stong gsal ba'i gab rtse/chos spyod nyams len dmar 'khrid me long 'phreng ba nor bu'i mdo 'dzin rnams dgu 249na ) pa de nyid gsal ba'i 'gag drug la/༷ skong gtor ma'i de nyid gsal ba bdud rtsi'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/dkor mdzod/ sgrub brten 'phreng ba'i de nyid gsal ba sngags kyi sgrol ma/ dpal skyes zhwa gos kyi de nyid gsal ba thar pa'i 'phrul skas/ longs spyod spyad pa'i de nyid gsal ba rnam rol sprin gyi rgyan/gso bskyed zas kyi de nyid gsal ba byang chub lam gyi bdud rtsi/ sgo gsum spyod lam gyi de nyid gsal ba 'gag don bsdus pa'i snying po rnams/ gnyis pa spyi bye brag thun mong du dgos pa'i skor la/ bskyed rdzogs spyi la gces pa'i skor/ bye brag bskyed rims la dgos pa'i las tshogs skor dang gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud drug /spyi gces kyi par bkab drug /'gag don gyi mdo 'dzin drug /smin byed kyi dbang chen drug /gnas skabs kyi dbang phran drug /skor tshe thems drug ste sde tshan drug /dang po la/ spyi rgyud pad sdong brtsegs pa'i le'u nyer gcig /sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo le'u sum cu pa/ gsung rgyud rin chen 'brug sgra le'u bcu gsum pa/ thugs rgyud nam mkha' klong yangs le'u drug cu pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud bstan pa'i srog shing le'u brgya dang rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud drag sngags spu gri reg gcod le'u lnga pa dang / de rnams kyi zhan byung bla ma gsang rgyud bka'i bang mdzod le'u drug pa/ thems med/ yi dam gsang sgrub bka'i tha raṃ le'u lnga pa/ thems med/ mkha' 'gro gsang rgyud bka'i lde mig le'u brgyad pa/ dad thems med/ brtson ldan pa'i skyes bus rgyud 'chang thabs dang che ba bstan pa rnams/ gnyis pa spyi gces pa'i par bkab drug la/ spyi rgyud 'grel pa me tog rgyan skabs nyer gcig pa/ bskyed rdzogs don bsdus thugs kyi snying po 'gag don dgu pa smin grol(249ba)rtsod spong lung gi bang mdzod/ theg pa spyi'i rnam bshad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rgyab mchod par bkab mdo 'dzin spros pa gcod pa snang gsal sgron me/ yin min 'dra min shan 'byed sun 'byin rin cen gsal ba gab rtse rnams/ gsum pa 'gag don mdo 'dzin drug la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa lo rgyus shel gyi me long / nges shes spro ba skyed pa gtam rgyud kyi 'phreng bar gdams pa/ theg dgu'i chos spyod 'khrid rim 'od kyi 'phreng ba/ kha stong phyag 'tshal brgya rtsa mchod 'bul bshags pa smon lam dang bcas pa/ 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor tshangs pa'i nga ro/ bskyed rim nyin mtshan tshogs drug gi lam 'byer rnams/ bzhi pa smin —360

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)byed dbang chen drug la/ spros bcas bum dbang chen mo/ smin byed snying gi me long / spros med gsang ba don dbang srog rtsa dmar 'byin shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mchog bde stong rab 'byams/ rab tu spros med thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang brda don zung 'brel/ yongs su spros med 'khor 'das gzhi rdzogs rang byung don dbang rgyas 'debs chen mo/ chags chen lam slong ḍā gi gnad kyi srog dbang rnams/ lnga pa gnas skabs kyi dbang phran drug la/ don dbang bsdus pa'i smin byed bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ rigs gtad spyod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ brda don gtum mo'i me dbang bde ba'i gsang mdzod dga' 'khyil/ dregs pa las la bkol ba dregs pa'i srog dbang chen mo gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rgya can chig brgyud ma/ byin brlabs 'jug pa rtsa gsum gtor ma'i brda dbang / bka' gtad glegs bam po ti'i lung dbang rnams/ drug pa skor tsho'i thems drug la/ shan 'byed (250na sgom grangs kyi skor spyi don brgyad pa/ zhal gdams dmar 'khrid kyi skor don bsdus thugs kyi 'phreng ba/ thor bu las tshogs skor nor bu bsam 'phel las phran gya brgyad pa la zhi ba'i las/ dper na zho chang nyes bsrung so sor phye ba lta bas mtsho rna pa'i nang gses dbye na ma gtogs dngos bstan brgyad stolas mi snyug /dbang gi las/ drag las/ gnod pa bzlog pa/ nad gdon bar chad bsrung ba/ rbod gtong rbad 'dre rang bzlog /ser gcod/ byis pa bskyed dang 'dre bsrung / nad rims las 'grol ba/ nad gdon sel ba/ gnyid log gnod bsrung / zas skom 'du ba/ nor 'du ba/ skyes pho mo 'du ba/ mngon shesarten 'brel 'char ba/ bla ma'i byin brlabs dang rten 'brel 'char ba/ skye bo dga' zhing shes rab 'phel ba/ blo rno ba/ gzhan sems shes pa/ rmi lam gsal byed/ bud med kyi yid du 'ong ba/ mi rnams byams pa/ zas rnyed pa/ mi rnams bkar nyan/ dgra dbang bsdud/ rgyan rgyal ba/ zhal lce rgyal ba/ dbyangs snyan pa/ don grub/ gru mi bying ba/ chus mi 'khyer ba/ mis gsang tshig smra ba/ lha 'dre mthong smra/ sa 'og gter mthong / nam mun med par mthong ba/ 'khor bkra shis pa dang mi ltogs pa/skye bo kun dbang sdud/ mgrin snyan dbang sdud/ zas bcud len/ bdag gzhan gnas bsrung / dgon —36/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedang lam du jag pa rengs pa/ gcan gzan 'jigs bsrung / dug sbrul gnod bsrung / lam gyi dgra bsrung / ri dwags khyi bsrung / spyang ki kha 'ching / byi ba kha 'ching / zhing la sbrang bu bsrung ba/ zhing gi btsa' bsrung / zhing la ri bong gnod bsrung / ser bsrung / kha char gcod pa/ sad bsrung / char 'bebs/thig le gdon 'phrog (250ba)bsrung ba/ bud med zla mtshan 'dzag bsrung / skye sgro bskrangs bzhi byed/bud med nu ma bsgrangs zhi/ bud med skyes pa bsrung ba/ skyes pa dbang sdud/ bud med dbang sdud/ bud med bu thon/ rdel nad 'don pa/ chu 'gags dbyung pa/ nad tsha bgrang bya byed/ tshad nad zhi byed/ pho glang ngam skran dmu chu sel byed/ lto ba spos pa dang ma zhu ba sel byed/ glo snying nad sel/ brang tsha sel ba/ rlung mi skye ba/ mig gsal ba/ rna 'on sel byed/ srid 'phel/ yid 'ongs grogs 'phrad/ zho chang nyes bsrung / sris rme/ phyugs kyi zho ster/ gnod byed spyor ngan bshig pa rnams/ spyi chings gal mdo'i skor phyi'i dkar chag thems byang nyi zla'i par bkab/ ma 'ongs lung bstan bka' rgya'i skor la spyi don dang po mnga' bdag rgyal pos zhus pa'i bstan pa spyi'i lung bstan/ gnyis pa lha sras kyis zhus(pa'i gang zag sgos lung / gsum pa 'tsho rgyal gyis zhus pa'i gnas skabs zin tig dang / rje 'bangs kun gyi zhus pa'i 'bras ljongs zab lung gi gnad yig /bzhi pa bar gcod dang 'dra min bdud sprul 'byung tshul thor bu dang bcas pa/ khyad par du lha sras lag la po che la zhal gdams su gnang ba'i lung byang byin rlabs gnas 'gyur gter gyi sgrub pa'i skor gud du sbas pa/ thems med/ dkar chag thems byang gi skor nang gi thems byang dkar chag padma'i 'phreng ba/ gsang ba don bsdus kyi dkar chag gud du sbas pa rnams so/ /thems med/ gnyis pa bye brag bskyed rim la dgos pa'i las tsho gis skor la/ rang gzhan spyi la gces pa'i chos drug /dngos grub longs spyod kyi 'byung gnas drug /'byor pa spel byed kyi nor sgrub drug /rmang (251na)po srid spel gyi gdams pa drug /rnon po ngar gdags kyi yig chung drug /gnas skabs rten 'brel gyi mngon shes drug /'bras bu lo tog la phan byed drug /phan byed las phran kyi kun thub drug /skyob byed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo drug /drag po bsrung bzlog gi las —362

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadrug dang bcu/ dang po la/ zhwa chos rin cen spungs pa dpe ris dang bcas pa/ bsrung 'bum rdo rje'i 'phreng ba la nang gses kyi/ sde brgyad bsrung ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su 'dzin par byed pa/dbang po gsal ba/ rims/ mtshon/ lha khros/ klu/ skyes bu/ mdze/ gnod sbyin/ ma mo/ srin po/ gshin rje/ the'u brang / mo 'dre rnams bsrung ba/ srid 'phel/ bur bsgyur ba/ gson 'dre pho mo/ gre bo pho mo/re 'dre/ mdze 'dre/ btsan/ gza'/ 'byung po/ rgyal bsen/ ltogs 'dre/ ma yams/ dam sri/ grib gnon/ gtad/ bdud pho mo/ sha za/ gnyan/ thab gzhob/ sa srin/ 'brog srin/ gag lhogs gzer gsum/ 'thab mkhon/ rgan sri/ gzhen sri/ dar sri/ dpe har/ the'u brang spun dgu /sde dpon sum cu/dregs pa bco brgyad/ nad 'thab/ mna'/ sa rdo shing gnyan gyi nyes pa/ dug /mi na dgun/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan/ bsam sbyor ngan pa/ 'gom chog /mnan pa/ dbye bskrad/ 'dre ngan/ khyim rkun/sris rkun/ god 'dre/ 'dre rgyu srad/ me/ lo tog la 'tshe ba'i sems can/ byis pa ngu ba/ so nad thog /so dug can/ gcan gzan/ 'brum bu/ spyo 'dre/ mi kha/ khyi/ rkun po/ jag chom/ bla rdol/ sang langs/phyugs kyi dgra kun gcan gzan/ khams 'dzag /gza' skar dang tshes grangasang na pa/ phyogs ga/'dre lnga/ bdud (251ba)gcod/ chu 'dre/ shwa bung / 'grul rdur/ rengs shu gud pa rnams bsrung ba/srog lus dbang thang rlung rta bskyed pa/ don grub tshong rgyal/ g.yul rgyal/ nor/ gza' btung / zhwa gos rnams 'phel ba/ mdzes ma rgyan 'khor/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'byung po kun bsrung ba/ 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo re/ 'byung bzhi kun 'dus/ rang bsrung te brgyad rtsa brgyad/ gzhan don sgron me drug skor la nang gses kyi sa dpyad rin chen sgron me/ 'dze 'joms stobs kyi sgron me/ dug 'joms bdud rtsi'i sgron me/ gza' bsrung thugs kyi sgron me dpe ris dang bcas pa/ smon lam bkra shis kyi sgron me/ nyes pa kun sel byin brlabs kyi sgron me dang drug /sngags 'bum dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes par nang gses kyi drug /gnyan rgod spyi dang khyad par 'bras bskrangs lhog /ya ma/ gag lhog gzer gsum 'joms pa gnyis/ hon/ pho nad ma zhu ba/ glo nad/ nad brgya sngags gcig /'bras —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegand gnyan rigs gsod cing slar mi ldog pa/ sha dug /khyi rmugs pa/ mes tshig pa/ rma mi bskrang ba/khrag gcod/ spyang gi dang gcan gzan kha 'ching / mes tshig pa'i rma gso ba/ chu 'gags/ ban gan skran srin 'bu/ ga 'ad srin/ 'brum gnad/ dreg gnad/ rgyu gzer/ dmar bshal/ dgra jag chom rkun rnams bsrung gso/ rigs gsum mgon po'i bsrung ba/ dmag jag bsrung ba/ nyes pa shun bsrung /sngags kyi nus bskyed de las rim sum cu/ zla tshes kyi re'u mig ling tshe sum brgya drug cu pa/ tshes grangs gza' skar dus rtsis kyi dang po ḍā zhi dus sbyor gyi rtsis dpe ris dang bcas/ thems med/ ldan 'bras bzang ngan shan 'byed rin po che'i spur len rnams/ gnyis (252na)pa dngos grub longs spyod 'byung gnas drug la/ bcud len snying po bsdus pa la nang gses kyi gtum po/ cung zhi gza' thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ sa zhag /tshan/ bye ma/ dbang lag /'om bu/ dri chen/ utpal/ chu/ rdo/glang sna/ spang rgyan/ bdud rtsi wa chu 'jib pa'i bcud len rnams/ dka' thub gdams pa ro snyomasakhyab gdal/ thod pa brtag tshul gnod sbyin nor len dpe chung dang bcas pa/ thod pa brtag tshul yid bzhin bang mdzod/ 'chi brtag rnam gsum dus kyi sgron gsal shog khra dang bcas pa/ 'chi med tshe sgrub rdo rje snying po rnams/ gsum pa sbyor ba spel byed nor sgrub drug la/ lha'i nor sgrub mdzad med gter 'bum/ klu'i nor sgrub chu bo lag 'gul/ gnod sbyin gyi nor sgrub ne'u le'i rkyal ba/ gzhi bdag gi nor sgrub snying 'gul lcags kyu/ skyes bu'i nor sgrub rkun ma ngos len/ rdzas kyi nor sgrub dbang gi rgyal po rnams/ bzhi pa rmang po srid spel gyi las drug la/ srid 'bebs lha'i bu lon dpe ris dang bcas pa/srid 'tsho lcags kyi bum pa dpe chung dang bcas pa/ srid kyi bgegs so/ mdung grol/ srid bsrung g.yung drung 'byer ba dpe ris dang bcas pa/ sri gnon bcog brdungs nag po sri'u tshang bzlog sha za gcig rgyugs rnams/ lnga pa rnon po ngar 'dogs kyi yig chung drug la/ blo 'phel shes rab ral gri dpe'u ris rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bcas pa/ skad sman padma dkar po tshangs pa lha'i gas log gnon dang bcas pa/ mig sman long ba rgyun gcod las kha bsgyur dang bcas pa/ ngag grol ye shes 'od 'phro/—364—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaganyid sgrog ma rig mun sel/ bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin/ zhan byung (252ba)gtad mnan las grol ba/ bcings pa 'grol ba/ bsdams pa gcod pa/ ngag dbang / mthu bskyed/ dpal gso/ngar blud/ spu gri gdags pa/ dug bsku ba/ thog mar bya ba/ nor 'khrul skyon sel/ ngag 'grol 'dzul chog ste bcu gnyis yig sna dpe chung dang bcas pa rnams/ drug pa gnas skabs rten 'brel mngon shes drug la/ rmi lam bzang ngan brda brtag /rna sgrogs khye'u chung dkar po'i sgrub thabs yig chung dpe ris dang bcas pa/ sman gyi lha mo'i sgrub thabs gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long / mig mthong mig gi snang gsal nyi zla'i sgron me/ snang gsal mar me'i brtag pa 'od 'bar/ pra 'bebs rkun ma ngos 'dzin rnams/ bdun pa 'bras bu lo tog la phan byed drug la/ char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i bum chung /de'i lhan thabs yig chung / thems med/ 'phags pa sprin chen mo'i mdo dang bcas pa/ rlung gnon ri rab 'od 'phro/ sad bsrung nā ga 'brug sgrog /ser gcod me'i pra tra/ btsa' bsrung rdo rje pha lam/ 'bu bsrung gdug pa kha sgyur rnams/ brgyad pa phan byed las phran gyi kun thub drug la/ phyogasang na gnod byed kun thub/ sde brgyad 'dre ngan kun thub/ 'go nad yams rims kun thub/ ngan sngags yig sna kun thub/ gud du sbas pa ngan sngags bshig pa'i 'khor lo/ thems med/ thod ngan nag po kun thub/ sna tshogs rdzas ngan kun thub rnams/ kun thub drug gi 'khor lo bri ba'i yig chung dpe ris dang bcas pa/thems med/ dgu pa skyob byed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo drug la/ sde brgyad kyi gdong gtad bsrung ba/ lus phyi nang gi srog chags bsrung ba/ rta phyugs kyi 'tshe ba bsrung ba/ g.yul ngo'i mtshon cha bsrung ba/'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung ba/ gnod byed god kha bsrung (253na)ba rnams dpe'u ris re dang bcas pa/ thems med/ bcu pa drag po bsrung bzlog gi las drug la/ bsrung ba rdo rje'i go cha/ 'khor lo la bri ba'i sngags rnams gter ston gyis dkyus su bkod pa gud du sbas pa/ thems med/ bzlog pa ral gri'i 'khor lo/ de'i yig chung dpe ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ gsad pa 'a las kya spu gri/ mnan pa 'khor lo nag po/ de'i yig chung dpe ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ smyo byed snying 'chus dmar po/—365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegashin rje char ka nag pa'i byol zor dgra 'dul zor las gnam lcags thog mda' ye shes lha/ themasamed/ pho brgyud mo brgyud kyi chad pa bzlog pa'i ga bor lo/ dug gsum 'khor lo/ the khor/ dkyil 'khor gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams/ gsum pa khyad par yang zab mkha' 'gro'i skor la sgrub pa/ las tshogs/ rgyab chos dang gsum/ dang po sgrub pa la drug /phyi sgrub lus dkyil 'khor lo/ srog sgrub rtsaba'i 'khor lo/ rkyang sgrub las phran thor bu/ de'i yig chung gnyis med zhal sbyor gyi 'bor lo bri thabs/thems med/ thod rgal yab yum dril sgrub/ thugs sgrub ga'u kha sbyor/ mthar thug don gyi sgrub pa rnams/gnyis pa las tshogis la/ gsum tshan drug dang / skor tsho drug ste gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan 'bum phyi nang gsang gsum sku gsum lam gyi sgron gsal/ 'gugs sngags phyi nang gsang gsum padma'i zhagasapa/ bsten lugs phyi nang gsang gsum padma'i srog 'dzin/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ 'dra min phyi nang gsang gsum gsal byed 'phrul gyi gab rtse/ skyon spong phyi nang gsang gsum snying gi thur ma/ de nyid phyi nang gsang gsum 'gag don bsdus pa gsal ba'i mdo 'dzin rnams/ gnyis pa skor tshogs drug la/ ḍā zhi'i srog 'dren (253ba)gnad 'bebs kyi skor/ 'byung bzhi dbang sdud grub rtags skor/ gnasaskabs rten 'brel mo rtsis skor/ bar gcod rkyen sel bsun bzlog skor/ sdig sgrib nad sel skor/dgra bgegs bdud 'dul yig sna'i skor dang drug /dang po la/ nang gses kyis khungs pa 'khu ba/las mi grub pa/ cho 'phrul/ stims pa/ phar dbang du gyur pa/ thun mong gi dngos grub la shor ba/nyams chags kyis zhabrug pa/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gros 'tshe ba/ phar bsngags pa tshur bzlog pa/ lasalog gi rkyen/ 'grub 'grub 'dra la g.yel ba/ rgyug rgyug 'dra la 'gyangs pa/ gtor tsho gos la mi 'du ba/ dngos grub ster ster 'dra la sped pa/ nang du mchog gi ltas la thun mong tsam yang mi 'grub pa/'gro ba mi 'du byur kha g.yogs/ 'khor dang phyag rgya phyir 'gyes pa/ bsam pa mi grub cing nyes pa sna tshogs 'byung ba/ las gang sgrub 'gags pa/ 'khu 'khrig dang nyer gcig /gnyis pa 'byung bzhi dbang sdud sgrub rtags skor la/ nam mkha' dbang du bsdus nas grub rtags —366

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnarang sems la dbang 'byor ba/'byung ba gzhan bzhi spyi mnyam dang bcas par phyi dngos can rdzas nang dngos med dmigs pa/gsang ba zung 'jug sngags gsum la brten nas sa'i grub rtags mi g.yo ba/sa 'dul ba/mi shis pa shis par bskyur ba/sa rdo'i las thams cad bgegs med du 'grub pa/gdon 'bros shing nad gsob sogs pa'i dngos grub/chu brtol/shwa bud bzlog pa/'tshe ba med cing lusastobs rgyas pa/nad gso ba/don 'grub pa/chu'i las gang yang yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub/me'i gnod pa bzlog pa/las la bkol ba/sgrib pa sbyar ba/dbang du 'du ba sogs me'i dngos grub/rlung gis gnod pa bzlog pa/ 254na po non pa/bkol ba/rlung gis byin gyis brlabs pa sogasarlung gis dngos grub/'byung ba spyi mnyam la/yul khams bde zhing 'tshe ba dang bral ba/kha 'thor gyi las/'chi bar nye ba'i tshe rig pa mchog gi gdung sgrub pa reg grol/mig gis mdzo shes/ye shesalnga'i mthong snang 'char ba/gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i yon to sna tshogs lasang ba/bye brag gzung mar brten pa'i 'dod yon lnga/'khor ba mi 'phel ba/gnyer ma med pa/gzhen sha chags pa/sri'u skye ba/bde drod 'bar ba/sku gzugs/mar rten/'ja' rsā byung ba/dud 'gros skor ba byed pa/khyi mi yong pa/jag 'ja /mtshon bsrung /sgrib shing /nor 'du ba/char 'bebs rnams dpe ris dang bcasapa/gsum pa gnas skabs rten 'brel mo rtsis kyi skor la/rin cen sgrom bu zhes pa rten 'brel brtag pa dang mkha' 'gro lnga skor gyi mo dang bcas pa/bzhi pa bar gcod rkyen sel bsun bzlog gi skor la/bsun bzlog rpā po spyi don brgyad pa/'bring po/bsdus pa/shin tu bsdus pa dang bcas pa/lnga pa sdig sgrib nad sel gyi skor la/grib sil chen mo spyi don bdun pa/bsdus pa dang /shin tu bsdus pa/grib bsrung 'khor lo/de rnams kyi dpe ris/de dag la gnad du che ba lhan thabs mdos kyi glud 'phyong dang bcas pa/drug pa dgra bgegs bdud 'dul yig sna'i skor la/dgra dpung bshig pa'i las srog 'phrog/'khu 'khrig slong ba/dbye ba/bskrad pa/gtad pa/dbang po nyams pa/mnga' thang longs spyod 'dzoms pa/stobs dang gzi brjid bsod /mas 'phrog pa/nus pa bshig pa/brdab bsnol

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negatong ba ste bcu/ brdab bsnol 'di la (254ba)nga gses kyis lus rengs byed/ ngag lkugs byed/yid rmugs byed/ mig long ba/ rna ba 'on pa/ yan lag 'gum pa/ dgra phrad/ gnyen 'bral/ don mi 'grub pa/ mi kha sdang ba/ zas mi rnyed gos dang bral ba/ rkun sna zug pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba/ rgyun du bor stor 'ong ba/ ngag cal col smra ba/ zag pa mi thub pa/ rmi lam zhabrugs pa/ rgyun du gnyid 'theb bla rdol smra ba/ ma nyes kha g.yogs 'ong ba/ god kha 'ong ba ste nyer gcig /bgegs 'joms kyi yig sna 'dul ba/ bsgral ba/ bskrad pa/ kha spo zhing za lam bstan pa/ nyer mi 'jug pa/ dgug cing brdung pa/ bran tu 'khol ba ste bdun/ bdud tsho gos 'du pa bar dngos dang sprul pa gnyis su 'byung ba'i/ spyir bstan pa'i bdud/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i sgo nas 'dul ba/ bye brag rnal 'byor pa'i chos spyod la 'tshe ba'i bdud dran shes kyis 'dul ba/ khyad par sgrub pa sogs gang dang gang la gnod pa'i bdud rkun po ngos gzung gi sgo nas 'dul ba/ gnod byed lan chags bdud gtor ma sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis 'dul ba dang bzhi/ de dag la gnad che ba las kyis rte zhi'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams/ ru pas med/gsum pa rgyab chos drug la/ byin brlabs dbang gis cho ga bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ dam tshig bsrung tshul rnam bshad las rim bcu pa/ ḍā zhi'i 'gyu gnas bshad pa/ 'phrin las tshogs mchod bsdus pa las byang padmo'i ze'u 'bru/ skyon yon rnam bshad dra ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ bzang ga brtag tshad rnam gnyis 'phrul gyi me long rnams/ bzhi pa rtsa gsum spyi dril gnad du 'gadams pa 'a las tshogs dbang sdud kyi skor la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis (255na)dang po ni dbang sdud thams cad kyi thog mar rang nyid dbang du bya ba/ gnyis pa yan lag la/ khyad par dang thun mong gnyis/ dang po la/ dar sna la brten nas yi dam dbang du bya ba/ rkang gling la brten nas mkha' 'gro dbang du bya ba/ gri snying la brten nas chos skyong dbang du bya ba/ shel 'phreng la brten nas yul lha dbang du bya ba/ nya phyis la brten nas klu dbang du bya ba/ pha wang long bu la brten nas mi ma yin dbang du bya ba dang drug /gnyis pa thun mong la/ bla mchod/ sbyin bdag /longs spyod dbang du bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ rdo rje dril bu la brten —368

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnanas bla ma dbang du bsdu ba/ lhung bzed la brten nas dge bshes dbang du bsdu ba/ lcags phur la brten nas sngags pa dbang du bsdu ba/ ga'u la brten nas rig byed pa dbang du bsdu ba/ 'phreng ba la brten nas btsun pa dbang du bsdu ba/ gling bu la brten nas bon po dbang du bsdu ba dang drug /gnyis pa sbyin bdag dbang du bsdu ba la/ 'khor lo la brten nas rgyal po dbang du bsdu ba/ g.yu 'phreng la brten nas btsun mo dbang du bsdu ba/ 'bru sna la brten nas blon 'bangs dbang du bsdu ba/ 'phyar dar la brten nas mi dpon dbang du bsdu ba/ mda' dar la brten nas skyes pa dbang du bsdu ba/ me long la brten nas mo btsun dbang du bsdu ba dang drug /gsum pa longs spyod dbang du bsdu ba la/ sba lcagasal brten nas yul khams dbang du bsdu ba/ cang te'u la brten nas khrom dbang du bsdu ba/ tshong dpon gyi srin lag la brten nas nor bu dbang du bsdu ba/ thod pa la brten nas zas dbang du bsdu ba/ rin po che'i za ma tog la brten nas longs spyod dbang du (255ba)bsdu ba/ glang po che'i mche ba la brten nas dud 'gro dbang du bsdu ba dang drug rnams/ lnga pa ye shes dbyings su bskyed byed rdzogs rim gyi skor la/ dbang po rab kyi don du man ngag rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun shel gyi bum pa theg dgu'i yang rtse grub mtha' thams cad kyi zhe phugs gtan la dbab pa/ dbang po 'bring gis don du chos thamasacad phyag rgya chen po sku gsum lhun grub theg pa kun gyi don gtan la phab pa/ dbang po tha ma'i don du sher phyin gyi zab don khul du phyung ba rnam rtog thog rdzas bdud kyi spyod yul nyon mongs lam slong gi gdams pa/ gang zag chags chen gyi don du sngags bla med kyi dgongs bcu/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i grol byed mkha' 'gro'i srog snying rtsa rlung rdo rje'i dra mig /rdzogs rim thor bu'i skor dang lnga/ dang po la ma bu gnyis/ dang po ma la lnga ste/ 'khrid gzhung chen mo'i don gsal sgron me/ rigs drug gnas sbyor 'khor ba dong sprug /'khrid gzhung gi rgyab yig khregs chod gdamasapa rgya mtsho slong yangs/ thems med/ dga' rab rdo rje'i dgongs don rdo rje sems dpa'i dmigs drug /ngo 'phrod lag 'khrid gab pa mngon 'byung mu stegs phreng ba/ bar do'i gdams pa nyon mongs 'jigs —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/skyob/ tshod 'dzin rtags tshad nyams myong dmar 'khrid/ gud du sbas pa rtags kyi yi ge dmar chur snying tshil rnams/ thems med/ gnyis pa bu la drug /nyams len rgyun khyer nyin mtshan rnal 'byor bstan pa/de'i lkog yig tsha ba dmar thag mun pa'i rnal 'byor ar gtad gnad yig dang 'brel ba/ thems med/gsang skor snying dgongs lus kyi rnam gzhag spyi sdom dmar 'khrid dang bcas pa/ gol (256na)sa gcod pa bgegs sel snying byang / rang grol btags grol dkar po chig thub bstan pa thams cad kyi yang snying gsang bar spyod pa sa bon gyi rgyud le'u bdun pa dbang dang bcas pa/ de'i tsakra bri ba'i yig chung dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ btags grol gyi man ngag ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i dus gnad nges pa o rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa'i spyi don bsto pa/ thems go/ gzhan don mthong grol 'khor ba sun 'byin/ de'i tsakra bri ba'i yig chung dpe'u ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ rgyab chos/ spyi sdom dgongs don 'dus pa rnams/ gnyis pa dbang po 'bring gi don du chos thams cad phyag rgya chen po sku gsum lhun grub theg pa kun gyis don gtan la phab pa'i skor la ma bu gnyis/ dang po ma la bzhi/sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig /sngon 'gro'i lhan thabs nyi zla'i bar bkab/ thems med/ dngos gzhi nyams len mkhan po rtsad gcod spra 'khrid don gsal sgron me/ de'i lhan thabs lkog yig tsha ba dmar thag / thems med/ rjes kyis gdams pa ngo sprod gsal 'debs sna tshogs rang grol/ gzhi rdzogs gcig dril sku gsum ngo sprod snang srid rgyas 'debs rnams/ gnyis pa bu la bdun/ lta sgom spyod 'bras 'dzin pa rang yan/ de'i yig chung lhan thabs/ thems med/ rgyun khyer nyams len dpe don zung 'brel gol sa sun 'byin/ ngo sprod bgegs sel bdud rtsi'i zil pa/ bogs 'don la zla shel mchod rten/ mthar thug bsre 'pho sgyu ma gsum khug /rgyab chos lung rig rin cen sgrom bu/spyi sdom grub mtha' gnad kyi zin tig don gsal thugs kyi nor bu/ klongs yangs mtha' bral gyi (256ba)dmigs rim gsung rgyun rnams/ thems med/ gsum pa dbang po tha ma'i don du sher phyin gyi zab don khol du byung ba rnam rtog thog brdzis bdud kyi gcod yul nyon mongs lam slong gi skor la ma —370

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)bu gnyis/ dang po ma la lnga/ sngon 'gro shan 'byed bye brag rnam sel nam mkha'i dkor mdzod/ dngosagazhi nyams len stan thog gcig ma 'od gsal nam mkha'i snying po/ rdzas kyis gdams pa log gnon gzer bu nam mkha'i me rtag /lhongs tshad tshar tshad tshod 'dzin shan 'byed nam mkha'i rgyan/ bdud bzhi ngos 'dzin thugs phrad rang grol nam mkha'i rlung / de'i lkog yig bdud bzhi ngos 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams/ them med/ gnyis pa bu la bdun/ ngo sprod lam 'byer 'phrul gyi dum bu nam mkha'i bcud phur/gang shar ro snyoms rtogs pa lam 'byer nam mkha'i me long / nyams myong rgyun 'byer nam mkha'i snying po/ dga' drod gol sa bdud 'byer gegs sel nam mkha'i thog can/ spyod kyi gza' gtad zab mo/thems med/ man ngag thor bu dmigs skor gnad gdams nam mkha'i char rgyun/ sgyu lus mchod sbyin bdud rtsi kun khyab nam mkha'i mchod sprin/ rgyab skyor snying po khog don spyi don spyi phugs nam mkha'i bla re rnams/ bzhi pa gang zag chags pa can gyis don du sngags bla med kyi dgongs bcud bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i grol byed mkha' 'gro'i srog snying rtsa rlung rdo rje'i dra mig skor la/ ma dang bu gnyis/ dang po ma la bzhi/ sngon 'gro sbyang ba rnam gsum mun sel sgron me/ dngos gzhi'i bar gyi nyams len rnam gsum dmar mo'i bcud sdud rdo rje'i zhags pa/ mtha' ma tshod 'dzin drod rtags rnam gsum ye shes spyan (257na)gyi me long / man ngag gnad kyi gab yig rnam gsum rin cen gser gyi sgrom bu rnams/ gnyis pa bu la bdun/ rgyab skyor 'phyug med thag chod rnam gsum gser gyi par bkab/ rtag tu lam 'byer bogs 'don rnam gsum rin chen gser gyi zam pa/ khyad par 'phags pa'i gtum mo rnam gsum me long rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ gol sa skyon 'dzin gegs sel rnam gsum bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ mdo 'gag don gyi bka' rgya rnam gsum gsang ba'i tha ram rdo rje'i lcags sgrog /man ngag 'phrul gyi dum bu gsang ba'i lde mig /zab don gnad kyi rgyab yig rnam gsum snying gi thur ma 'phrul gyis zhags pa gsal ba'i gab rtse/ gud du sbas pa'i yig chung zab mo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rgya can ḍā zhi gsang ba'i par bkab rnams/ sgos med/ lnga pa rdzogs rim thor bu'i skor la bcu gcig /—371 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()lnga wo lnga'i ngo sprod spyi don gsum pa/tshogs drug lam 'byer spyi don gsum pa/nyin mtshan rnal 'byor lam 'khyer gdams pa/rmi lam lam 'byer 'od gsal dang bcas pa/skyid sdug lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams pa/gdams pa kun gyi bogs 'don dmar 'khrid/bskyed rdzogs kyi sgrub pa'i lam 'khyer/thun mong ma yin pa zab mo'i 'phags chos ye shes ral gri me 'bar/de'i 'grel pa nyon mongs 'jomasapa'i tho ba/thems med/de'i gnad yig don skor dgu pa/zab mo hūṃ chos spyi don dgu pa/de'i gnad yig gong du sbas pa'i yig chung /sgo ya a/nyin mtshan bsre ba'i gdams pa/yang zab 'pho ba'i gdamasapa rnams so//drug pa bka' dang bstan pa srung byed chos skyong gter bdag gi skor la/rta nag dregs pa sde brgyad dang btsan 257ba〉skod gnyis/dang po la rtsa ba sgrub skor/yan lag las phran dang gnyis/dang po rtsa ba sgrub skor la bcu gnyis/gtor ma la brten nas lus kyi grib ma ltar 'grogs pa phyi sgrub/dkyil 'khor la brten nas 'du 'bral med pa nang sgrub/rta nag gi tsitta la brten nas srog dang bsre ba gsang sgrub/las la mngags pa las sbyor/'gyur med du byed pa gnad 'bebs/srog ltar bzung ba srog 'khor/dbang med gnad gzir bla rdo bcang thabs/thugs dam stong zhing dgyes par byed pa las byang /dbang 'byor thob par byed pa rjes gnang gi yi ge sngags dag par byed pa sngags thems/las myur bar byed pa log gnon/sdang byed brlag par byed pa srog 'dren rnams/gnyis pa yan lag las phran la bcu/dgra srog 'phrog byed bshan pa rgyug 'gyel/mthun pa 'byed pa phung byed kha 'thab/ltas pha than 'gyed ā tsarla nag po/bskrad pa'i 'khor lon ga po lham krad/ga gnon las sbyor lkugasapa kha tham/yul mkhar rlag byed mdze lag nag po/lo tog gzhom byed skyin thang khrag mtsho/dgra jag 'ching byed gza' rgod sgyid rengs/'gom chog gdams pa mun pa nag po/gto khram nag po dug mtsho khol ma rnams/rjes gnang /thems med/nye 'byed/bskrad 'khor/thems med/ngag gnon/phung sel/thems med/'gom chog rnams kyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/gnyis pa bka' srung btsan rgod kyi

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnaskor la/ phyi gtor ma la brten nas klu btsan du sgrub cing dgra la rbad pa/ nang rang gzugs la brten nas dge bsnyen du sgrub cing cho 'phrul 'gyed pa/ gsang ba srog 'khor la brten nas gnod sbyin du sgrub cing zas nor blang ba/ de rnams(25ni)kyi srog 'khor dpe ris/ thems med/ las byang dang bcas pa rnams/ bdun pa mtha' rten 'gag sdoms rtsa ba'i chings la lnga/ mkha' 'gro thugs khrag yin phyir mkha' la 'gro gtad rgya'i chings/ sngags srog dam tshig yin phyir dam tshig gnang bkag gi chings/bshad pa rgya che yang 'gag don nyams len la 'dus phyir bsrung sdom nyams len gyi chings/ 'gal rkyen bar chad gzhom phyir chos skyong gnyer gtad kyi chings/ zab gter bsrung bar sngags phyir gter bsrung bka' sgo'i chings/ mjug tu gter ston la zhal gdams lung bstan dang bcas pa rnams/ 'di'i nang du las kyi dbang gi dgongs 'dus dar ba'i tshe dpe har snying bzhugs 'dra min gter chos rtsom zhes 'dug pa ni rgyal ba 'dusapa sogs gter khas su grags pa rnams yin par ma' no/ /de ltar thems can rags pa'i dbang du byas nas chos sde nyis brgya gya gnyis dang thems med yig chung gud du sbas pa dang bcas phra mor phye na sum brgya dang bzhi bcu bzhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis ku'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku spyan ras gzigasadabang / o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa/ dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i chos bdag bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge bya khyung pa byams ldan chos rgyal bkra shis/ bya khyung pa mnyam med dpal 'bar dbang phyug /bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal/ gsung snyan sprul sku o rgyan dpal 'byor/lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal/ (258ba)rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang lugs gcig la gter ston nas sras ye shes rdo rje/ de sras snying bu pa sangs rgyas blo gros/ bya khyung pa chos rgyal bkra shis man sngar ltar yang na sras ye shes rdo rje nas/ chos bdag gzhen —373—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/nu seng ge /mkhas grub gu ru 'od zer/ kun mkhyen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rigs 'dzin bsod nams rnam rgyal/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin chos kyi sgron ma/ rigs 'dzin mthu stobs rnam rgyal/grub mchog gsang sngags gter mdzod/ sprul sku o rgyan dpal 'byor man sngar ltar ro/ /'khrid chen bzhi las rdzogs chen gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ rigs 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ lha lcam manda ra ba/ mnga' bdag man gong bzhin/ phyag chen gyi lung brgyud ni/ kun bzang /rdo rje 'chang / rigs lnga/ rdor sems/ spyan ras gzigs/ o rgyan chen po man sngar ltar/ spyod yul gyi lung brgyud ni/ kun bzang / yum chen sher phyin/ thub pa'i dbang po/ kun dga' bo/ byams pa mgon po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ padma thod 'phreng rtsal man gong bzhin/ lam 'bras kyi lung brgyud ni/kun bzang / snang mtha'/ spyan ras gzigs/ padma thod 'phreng man sngar ltar/ po ti lung dbang gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter ston nas/ sras ye shes rdo rje/ bshes gnyen gzhen nu seng ge /kun mkhyen gu ru 'od zer/ mkhas grub tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sgom (259na)brag pa padma seng ge yi/ba thog nam mkha' grags pa/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ gar dbang padma rgyal mtshan/ ka thog pa padma blo gros/zur kun mkhyen chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rlung 'khor pho nya myur mgyogs kyis brgyud pa lugasagacig la/ byams ldan chos rgyal bkra shis nas/ slob dpon bkra shis dbang phyug /gnam gong bla mas sangs rgyas/ bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal phun tshogs/ sngags 'chang nor bu dbang rgyal/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ rlung bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rlung 'khor pho nya myur mgyogs dang bsrung 'bum rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i brgyud lugs gcig la/ sras ye shes rdo rje nas/'jam dbyangs shākya rin cen/ she'u kun dga' chos dbang / sngags long legs pa shes rab/ rje —374

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ pha rdzo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang bsrung 'bum brgyud pa gcig ni/ gnam gong bla ma sangs rgyas nas/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ ba lam bde chen gnyer tshang sde pa chos rje/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje man gong ltar/yang na snying phu ba sangs rgyas blo gros/ de sras sangs rgyas rdo rje/ slob dpon bkra shis dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na bya khyung pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas/ de sras padma bstan 'dzin/ 'bri gung pa rigasa'adzin cho me kyi grags pa/ snang gsal pa ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur kun mkhyen chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na zur chen gyis 'bri gung chos kyi grags pa la ngos kyis (259ba〉na ༅ no/ /bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'bri gung chos kyi grags pa bzhugs pa'i brgyud lugs de ga la rtsa ba'i bla mas 'bri gung pa dngos la gsan no/ /bzlas brjod nus pa stobs 'byin dang mkha' 'gro'i las tshogs dgra bgegs bdud bdul gyi yig sna'i lung brgyud gcig ni/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan yan sngar ltar la/ de nas mchoge sprul legs ldan rdo rje/'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ de sras chos rgyal phun tshogs/ chab mdo rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ des bdag la'o/ /khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i 'char ga'i zor las gnam lcags thog mda'i bsgral las bdud dpung thal bar brlag byed gnam lcags spu gri'i lung ni mdzad pa po nyid la bdag gis nos so/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas kong po ri shod kyi bu rdzong ri nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po'i snying po bsdus pa'i skor la/ 'bru lnga'i sgom bzlas/ man shel/ me long / sku/ bum pa/ rol mo/glegs bam/ brda sprod dang bcas pas dbang bzhi/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs/ lhun grub ngo sprod theg dgu mtha' rdzogs kyi dbang dang bcas pa nos nas/ lung la/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab blo gros kyisamadzad pa'i sngon 'gro gsol 'debs 'khor 'das dbyer med ma/ spros bcas spros med rab tu spros med rtsal dbang dang bcas pa gcig tu dril ba'i dbang chog /sangs rgyas kyis 'das rjes dang po 'tsho —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebyed gzhen nu'i sdum rar 'bab pa gdeng dang ldan par 'gyur ro mtha' can/ 'das rjes gnyis pa me ri 'bar ba'i shar phyogs ḍā ki sna tshogs 'dul ba'i gnas su 'bab pa bu gcig par bstan pa'o'i mtha' (260na7na/ 'das rjes gsum pa bya rgod phung po rir 'bab pa bu gcig par bkod pa'i mtha' can/ 'di'i 'og tu dga' rab rdo rje'i 'das rjes 'khrid gzhung dam rdzas rol chen gyi sgrub pa gnad kyi phur gcig gsum dpe ma byung bsam thob/ ḍā ki gsang ba'i gnad kyi phur gcig ma yang dril ru gdams pa srog tig gab pa mngon phyung zhar byung phan yon spel tshul dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rigasa'adzin sangs rgyas glang pa/ bya khyung dpal ldan seng ge /'jam dbyangs shākya rin cen/ khyab bdag kun dga' chos dbang / chos bdag nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rab 'byams dge ba'i blo gros/ dkar chen bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mtshungs med dkon cog rdo rje/ rigs 'dzin ngag dbang grags pa/ zab lung mi 'gyur dbang rgyal/ lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal/ mtshungs med 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter ston 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams zab cing rgya che ba'i skor/sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams zab cing rgya che ba'i skor la/phyi rabs don du dpal o rgyan chen pos khrims su phye ste gsal bar phyung ba phyi'i rgyal po lus su gdams pa bsam yas mchims phur 'gro ba'i lam kha brag sna seng ge'i gdong du sbas pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog sangs rgyas glang pas spyan drangs pa'i chos sde la/ glegs bam/ sku/ ye ge drug pa la brten —376

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)nas chos kyi bdag por mnga' gsol rjes su gnang ste/ yongs su gtad pa/ rta nag gi thod (260ba)par brten nas gnod sbyin rta mgrin nag po srung mar bskos te 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i bka' gtad legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ lo rgyus dkar chag /de las bshad pa'i chos skor la/mdo skor/ sgrub skor/ zhal gdams skor te gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po gnyis btang snyoms su bzhag ste phyi ma zhal gdams la/ rgya che ba g.yin don du gdams pa/ zab pa rang don du gdams pa/thor bu'i skor dang gsum/ dang po la/ zhu lan/ ngo sprod/ bka' nan/ gsung gi zhal gdams/ lam khyer zhal gdams/ zhal gdams thor bu/ lam rim/ mtshang gi zhal gdams/ phyi nang chos kyi zhal gdams/ bslab bya'i zhal gdams/ 'chi kha'i zhal gdams/ thun mong dang khyad par zhal gdams/srang du bzhugs pa'i zhal gdams/ gzhan don bya ba'i zhal gdams te bcu bzhi/ dang po la/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos thugs rje chen po la zhus pa'i thugs rje chen po dngos kyi thugs rgyud/ rgyal po la yum lha gza' gung btson mas zhus pa'i lan gyi rjes su yi rang ba/ zhal gdams 'di'i skor rgya po po bka' 'bus 'a mo shin tu zab pa nang skor dgu'i khrod du yod kyang da lam gter kha 'di kha'i dkar chag sor gnas ltar yin/ yab gnam ri srong btsan gyis zhus len sgo gsum thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su 'gyur ba/ khab kyi chen ma bal bza' khri btsun gyis zhus len bskyed rdzogs gsum dang bstun pa/ khab kyi chun ma rgya bza' kong jo'i zhus lan kṛ yog sde gsum dang bstun pa/ phyi blon nang blon rnams kyis zhus lan dga' dgu yi rang ba rnams/ gnyis pa ngo sprod la/ yab la gdams pa nyams len thun mong ma yin pa/ yum la gdams pa nyams len (261na)srang du bzhugs pa/ bal bza' la gdams pa don gyi ngo sprod/ rgya mo bza' la gdams pa don gyi ngo sprod/ sras gong ri gung btsan la sku gsung thugs kyi zhal gdams/sras mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan la mdzad spyod zhal gdams/ sa sto ṭa sogs nang blon rnams la ngo sprod du gdams pa/ phyi blon rnams la gdams pa'i ngo sprod rnams/ gsum bka' nan la/ yab yum la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gdams pa/ sras la rgyal srid chos dang bstan par gdams pa/ sras mo la rang —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nedon 'chal bar mi gtong bar gdams pa/ bal bza' la thugs dka' rgyas gdams pa/ rgya bza' snying gtam gal po cher gdams pa/ nang blon rnams la thugs rje chen po nyams su long zhig par gdams pa/ phyi blon rnams la snyigs dus su thugs rje chen po sgrub par gdams pa/ bod 'bangs spyi la yig drug las lhag pa med par gdams pa/ bod kyi skyes pa rnams la yi ge drug pas 'gro drug skye sgo gcod par gdams pa/ nang 'khor bud med rnams la longs spyod kyi snying po yi ge drug par gdams pa/ phyi 'khor bud med rnams la byang chub kyi lam sna yi ge drug pas 'dzin par gdams pa/bud med spyi la yig drug las lhag pas sgrib sbyong med par gdams pa rnams/ bzhi pa gsung gi zhal gdams la/ thugs rje chen po'i gsang 'grel zhes pa spros na drug drug sum cu rtsa drug tu spro zhing bsdu na yi ge drug tu 'dus pa thugs rje chen po rang byung gi yi ge /lnga pa lam 'khyer zhal gdams/nyin mo snang ba/ tshogs drug /rkyen snang / mtshan mo'i rmi lam/ gnyid bsad pa la brten nas nyin nub lam 'khyer/ phyin drug /mdo sde gzungs ltar kha ton (261ba)bya ba/ chos spyod lam 'khyer/rang gi dge ba/ bdun tshigs/ ro sreg /ro rdzong ro gzan/ ro khur te rang don khyad 'phags kyi lam khyer/ phyi nang gsang ba don rtags mtshon pa'i snang ba rnams la brten pa'i snang ba rin cen tshogs kyi lam khyer/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gtor ma la brten nas gtor ma'i lam khyer rnams/ drug pa zhal gdams thor bu la/ zhal gdams gcig tshan drug /gnyis tshan drug pa/ gsum tshan drug pa/bzhi tshan drug pa/ lnga tshan drug pa/ drug tshan drug pa/ bdun tshan drug pa/ brgyad tshan drug pa/ dgu tshan drug pa/ bcu tshan drug pa ste zhal gdams drug cu pa/ mgo gsum/ rnyed pa gsum/ rmang rdo gsum/rtsa ba gsum/ snying po gsum/ byin brlabs gsum la sna gsum/ las 'gyur gsum/ nyal chog gsum/ 'thob bya gsum ste blo sbyong bdun par grags/ 'gol ba gsum/ bdud kyi bcos pa gsum/don la 'dres pa gsum/ bka' las 'gal ba gsum/ gol sa med pa gsum/ lung mthun gsum/rmangs brnyegs pa gsum/ mtho brnyegs pa gsum/ rtse mor phyin pa gsum/ ngo sprod gsum ste spangs—378

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganablang gi chos/ blo dman la gdab pa gsum/ kun la dgos pa gsum/ dam pa'i chos gsum/ dgosapa'i chos gsum/ lo zla gsum/ 'phags pa gsum/ rang byung gsum/ ma bcos pa gsum/ nyi ma shar ba gsum/ gsal la dag pa gsum ste zhal gyis gdams pa/ 'khyer so gsum/ gsal ba gsum/gdengs gsum/ dpa' ba gsum/ brtul bzhugs gsum/ shar ba gsum/ smin pa gsum/ grol ba gsum/ gud pa gsum/ rdzogos pa gsum ste thugs rje chen po'i chos brgya rnams dril bas sum (262na)tshan bzhi bcu par grags pa phyogs kun gyi gnad bsdus/ gnad kyi gdams pa bzhi/ lta ba bzhi/ la gcad bzhi/ shes pa bzhi/ lam khyer bzhi/ rang grol bzhi/ sgom pa bzhi/ spyad pa bzhi/ nyams bzhi/rtags bzhi/ 'khrul pa bzhi/ thabs bzhi/ 'dug pa bzhi/ gnad bzhi/ ma yengs pa bzhi/ mtha' grol bzhi/ mthar thug bzhi/ sku bzhi/ mtshan ma dpe'i ngo sprod bzhi ste zhal gdams bzhi tshan bcu dgu pa/gsar grogs su ma song ba bcu/ mi lho ba bcu/ blun pa bcu/ nor pa bcu/ bya ba bcu/ yid ches bcu/'dus pa bcu/ 'das pa bcu/ yod pa bcu/ 'dug pa bcu/ shar ba bcu/ nus pa bcu/ lung bcu/myang 'das bcu/ mdzad pa bcu/ mi mdzad pa bcu/ rtogs pa bcu/ mnyam pa bcu/ med pa bcu/ yin pa bcu/ med pa bcu/ 'gro ba bcu/ skyon bcu ste bcu tshan nyi shu rtsa gsum pa lta sgom phugs gtib kyi zhal gdams su grags pa rnams/ bdun pa las rim la/ dang por rang la dgongs pa/ bar du gzhan la dgongs pa/ mtha' ma nyams len la dgongs pa gsum gyis dbang po 'bring gi lam rim/rab la rig rtsal/ gab pa mngon byung / rang gzhan thal byung gi chos gsum/ 'bring la ma bcol cog bzhag /mtsho la rjes med/ dmigs pa yul med kyis chos gsum/ mtha' ma la gtod phur/ thug phrad/ nyams kyi chos gsum gyi sgo nas dbang po rab kyis lam rim rnams/ brgyad pa mtshang gis zhal gdams la/ skye bo ma rig pa chos la 'dzud pa zhes par 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ 'phags nor bdun blang ba/ nyon mongs rang gar mi gtong ba/ bshes gnyen bsten (262ba)pa/ las 'bras bsam pa/ ga song sdug bsngal dang zhar byung chos byed lung bstan pa dang bcas pa/ chos pa chos dang mi —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ldan pa chos la 'dzud par 'pha nyan byed pa/gzhung gas spyod pa/blo chos dang sbyar nas ston pa/chos su 'gro mi 'gro chos ma nor bar byas/thugs rje chen po'i chos nyams su len thabs dang bcas pa/sngags pa sngags dang mi ldan pa chos la 'dzud pa la/gsang sngags phyi nang gnyis kar thugs rje chen po'i chos skor gtogs par yid ches pa/'bras bu/khe nyen che tshul/sngags pa theg pa 'og mar smod pa/'og mas gong mar smod skur 'debs/sngags dang du mi len pa/sngags la skur btab/gzhung gzhan ma spyad pa/'chal par bstan pa/nor phyed 'chong ba/kṛ ya/yo ga/ma hā dang a nu/rdzogasachen/phyag rgya chen po rnams kyi dam tshig/nyams skyon/dam tshig gtso che tshul/gsang sngags rigasasngags gzung sngags rnams yi ge drug par 'du tshul dang bcas pa/chos pa chos dang mi ldan pa chos la bskur ba rnams/dgu pa phyi nang kyi chos kyi zhal gdams la/sbyin pa la gnas/rdzas/dus/yon to/skyon/bsngo ba drug/tshul khrims la dge ba chos sdud/nyes spyod sdom pa/sems can don byed/bzod par byed mi snyam pa/sdug bsngal dang len/chos nyid don la mi skrag pa/brtson khrus la go cha/don sbyor/mi ldog pa/bsam gto mi g.yo ba/ma nor bar bsgrub pa/sems can don byed/shes rab la rang spyi/rgyu 'bras/mi dmigs pa/thabs la ma nor ba/bdag g.yin gyis don bsgrub pa/smon lam la ma zhum pa/mi dmigs/sems can don la brtson pa/stobs la bdud 263na'adul ba/tsho gis gnyis rdzogs pa/rgol ba tshar gcod pa/ye shes la chos/gang zag/rnam par mi rtog pa dang bcas pa/bshad thabs drug gis zhal gdams zhes par phyi dbyi mong g.yo 'gul nang ram pa'i rtsa ba/gsang ba khrom rṣa po/yang gsang bya rgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa/de kho na nyid rol brgya gshal ba gcig gis mnan pa/gnad dril lhag ma gcig gis bcings pa lta bu rnams/bcu pa bslab bya'i zhal gdams la/skyabs 'gro la phyi sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun/nang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro/gsang ba lta sgom spyod gsum so sor/ngo bo mas ṣka/rang bzhi/khyad par/bslab bya/phan yon te drug gi sgo nas bstan pa/sdom pa ༷ lusang ga yid gsum chud zos su mi gtong bar

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)so thar gyi sdom pa/ dad rdzas/ chos/ gdams ngag gsum chud zos su mi gtong ba byang sdom/ sgom/brtson 'grus/ yid ches gsum chud zos su mi gtong bar sngags sdom/ bla ma la skye med/ 'gag med/rig med/ spros bral/ stong gsal/ rig pa rang shar te don gyi bla ma drug /snang ba rang shar/ rnam rtog lam long / dug lnga rnam dag /rkyen snang thog 'gel/ rang snang rig med/ 'khor ba rgyas 'debs te rtags kyi bla ma drug /rtsa ba/ dbang bskur/ byin brlabs/ lung 'bogs/ brgyud pa 'dren pa ste mtshon gyi bla ma drug /bla ma la lus ngag yid gsum gyis bkur ba dang dam tshig /bsrung ba'i phan yon dang /ma bsrung pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa/ don gyi thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig drug /rtags kyi thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig drug /mtshon gyi thugs rje chen po'i dam tshig drug rnams/ bcu gcig pa 'chi kha'i zhal gdams la/ bar do (263na〉yun gsal sgron me zhes pa rang bzhin gnas pa'i bar do/ skye shi bar do/ shes pa snga phyi'i bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ 'chi kha'i bar do/ srid pa'i bar do rnams/ bstoganyis pa thun mong khyad par gyi zhal gdams la/ thun mong gi zhal gdams sum cu rtsa drug pa zhes pa sngon 'gro bzhi'i yan lag drug /gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag drug /thugs rje chen po dang tshul mthun pa'i yan lag drug /rang la bzheng bskul gdams pa'i yan lag drug / thugs rje chen po myur du grub byed kyi yan lag drug /thugs rje chen po chos blo thag chod pa'i yan lag drug dang bcas pa/zhal gdams drug gsum pa la/ rang byung gi nyams drug /thabs mkhas pa'i yan lag drug /rang lus bsrang zhing gnod pa sel ba'i yan lag drug rnams/ bcu gsum pa srang du bzhugs pa'i zhal gdams la/ brjod bya'i don la dpe don rtags gsum/ rjod byed tshig la rmongs pa lam gzhug /dad can spro bskyed/ brtson 'grus can chos la gzud pa/ gsum gyi drang don/ yar lta ba la 'byamasasu mi gzhug /mar rgyu 'bras la 'thas su mi gzhug /bar btang snyoms la lding du mi gzhug pa gsum gyi nges ston/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyis snying po bstan pa/ gnad kyi zhal gdams zhes pa nyams len spong ba'i 'dre drug /khar mi gtong ba'i bdud drug /thar bar bya ba'i 'phrang drug /mtshan nyid dang ldan —381 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepa'i 'brel ba drug /the tshom med pa'i yid ches drug /yang dag ltar snang gi 'dra min drug rnams/ bcu bzhi pa zhal gdon bya ba'i zhal gdams la/ sbyor dngos 'jug gsum gyi sgo nas skyabs sems 'bol chog /slob dpon dang rten gyi drung (264na)du sdom pa len pa/ rjes dran drug gis bsrung ba ste bsnyen gnas 'bogs chog /bsngo ba la/ yo byad la spyod pa/ yon tan bshad pa/ yon sbyang ba/ bsngo ba bzhi'i sgo nas bshad pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa zab pa rang don du gdams pa la/ 'khor la gdams pa/ zab pa thun mong ma yin pa/ khyad par gyis zab don/ don bshad pa'i zhal gdams dang lnga/ dang po la/ rgad po la gdamasapa shad blon sna chen por gsungs pa byang chub gnas su blo bde bar 'gyur ba/ rgan mo la gdams la zhang zhung bza' li di sman la gsungs pa mda' kha 'chi brod/ bud med la gdams pa ru yongs bzar gsungs pa thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs su 'tshang rgya ba/ sras kyi yum tshe spong bza' khri lcam la gdams pa sangs rgyas dang zhal mjal ba/ phyi blon bsrung btang gzungs la gdams pa rgas nas chos dang phrad pa/ nang blon mgar stong btsan yul bzung la gdams pa sdig zad pa'i rtags thon pa/'bri bse ru gung ston la gdams pa thugs rje chen po dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba/ sbas 'brongs gshor mdo btsan la gdams pa sdig po che cig car 'tshang rgya ba rnams/ gnyis pa zab pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ lta ba gsum gyi zhal gdams bzhed pa thag ring du 'gro na 'byer rgyu/ gcig pur 'dug na sems/ mang po'i khrod du ngag la blta ba rnams/ zhal gdams don gsum zhes pa'i rigs drug 'khor ba'i g.yang la bskyur ba/ mi rtag pa'i dpe gsum gyis le lo can brtson 'grus bskyed pa/thugs rje chen po'i yon tan gyis skal ldan gyi spro ba bskyed pa rnams/ phar phyin drug gi zhal gdams/tshad med drug ces pa 'gro don/ byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms/ thugs rje dang (264ba)bcas pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ces pa lus sprul pa/ khyim dri za'i grong / 'khor g.yog rmi lam/ longs spyod sgyu ma/ snang srid chu zla/ snyan grags brag ca/ zas skom rmig rgyu/ sems nam mkha' lta ga rnams/—382

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gsum pa khyad par gyis zab don la/ spang blang drug gi sgo nas 'khor 'das kyi 'brel pa gcod pa nyams su blang ba'i zhal gdams/ spyi bor bla ma/ de'i bka' drin/ gdams pa dran pa gsum gyi sgo nas byin brlabs lam gyi bla sgrub/ rnam pa/ mos pa/ nga rgyal gsum gyis lha lam du blang ba/ so thar/ byang sems/ sngags sdom gsum yar ldan gyi zhal gdams/ skyes bu 'dod chags can la thabs lam rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi zhal gdams/ bskyed rdzogs la brten nas mtshan bcas mtshan med kyis zhal gdams/ bdag 'dzin 'gong po sgor dbyung ba bdag med zung 'jug gi zhal gdams rnams/ bzhi pa gnad kyi khyad par zab don la/ sgom pa gnad kyi ngo sprod ces pa thabs kyi sgo nas sgom bya'i yul/shes rab kyi sgo nas sgom byed sems/ gnyis med sgo nas phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa/ zung 'jug gsum zhes pa bskyed rdzogs/ thabs shes/ dbyings dang ye shes kyi zhal gdams/ bar do la dbang po rab la bar do med pa chos sku'i lam khyer/ 'bring la bar dor 'tshang rgya ba'i lam khyer/ tha ma la 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi lam khyer/ mtshan thos pa/ snying po bzlas pa/ 'khor lo btags pa gsum gyisa'atshang rgya ba rnams/ lnga pa don bshad pa'i zhal gdams la thugs rje chen po'i don bshad pa'i zhal spru/dmas zhes par thugs rjes gzigs tshul/ yul/ spyan/ che ba rnams drug drug tu phye ba dang thugasarje la yang skus 'dul ba'i lha drug /gsung gis 'dul ba'i sngags drug /thugs kyis 'dul ba'i dgongs pa 'bras so'i rtags (265na)drug /dgongs pa drug /nyams len drug /mthar dbyung drug /la zla drug rnams/ gsum pa thor bu'i skor la/ chos thams cad thugs rje chen por 'dus tshul snying por dril ba spro na mdo rgyud la lta bar bya'i mtha' can/ li yul gyis dge slong gis chos rgyal mjal ba'i lo rgyus las 'phros te rgyal po spyan ras gzigs dngos su bstan pa/ gye re yas 'phrang gis yig drug rang byon la brten nas gsung skye ba med pa'i sgrar bstan pa/ sras kyi zhus lan ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gi che ba bstan pa/ thu mis zhus lan gtsug lag khang gnas 'jig gi skor/ rgyal po lugs kyi gzung sngags kyi lo rgyus che brjod/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs rin cen 'brug sgra/ phyi rgyal po lugs —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nekyi gtam rgyud/ bka' chems dri med zla ba le'u bcu drug pa/ rgyal po yab yum thugs rje chen po'i thugs kur thim zhing yar klungs su bang so btab tshul/ lha sa chu dang bsam yas me dang bye mas 'jig tshul/ de'i gnyen por klu 'jog pos phul ba'i rin po che'i chu shel bsam yas kyi srog shing dang / tshangs pa phul ba'i rin po che sa'i snying po lha sa'i chu bzlog don du hal po rir sbas pa/ gtsug lag khang gnyis 'jig pa'i snga ltas lung bstan/ chu bzlog lha khang brtsigs tshul/ mes srong btsan gyis sbas pa'i gter rnams slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag la bstan pa/ a skṛ ta'i che brjod/bka' gtad kyi yi ge /chu bzlog dang jo bo'i rten bzhugs gnas brtan gyi gsol 'debs/ gter ston 'dra min brtag pa'i lung bstan/ lde mig gsal ba'i 'khrul zhum zhes pa bu chu/ mchod rten bkra shis mdzes ldan/ gshin rje dong kha/ ne'u ra g.yu mtsho rnams kyi gter byang / brgyud 'debs bde ba can gyi zhing khams ma (265bskoms so/ /dkar chag dang rig 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig sogasal dpags na chos tshan kha shas ma tshang zhing dbang zhig kyang yod tshod du 'dug rung chos rgyun dkon par snang bas chad dam snyam/ yod srid kyang kho bo'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul ni de tsam mo/ /gong smosadabang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku srong btsan sgam po/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ sras mchog ye shes rdo rje/ gu ru sangs rgyas blo gros/ mtshan ldan bsod nams lhun grub/ dris chen dharma dha dza/ rig 'dzin ga rma bzang po/ mtshungs med grub mchog bzang po/ rgyal sras padma rig 'dzin snying po/ rtse le sprul sku padma legs grub rtsal/ rdzogs chen pa lha bas kun bzang rnam rgyal/ zur rdo rje lang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor gyi sngagasadakar ma ṇi pa la bstsal to/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas spu ri phug mo che nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar rgyas pa gser gyi 'phreng ba thar lam gsal byed ces bya ba'i padma bka'i thang yig le'u brgya —384

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadang bcu bdun yod pa'i lung nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ bka' sdud po ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pa/ srasadzñā na badzra/ 'od gsal klong yangs/ dharma ma ti/ bsod nams rin chen/ tha chung dbon po/ gnam gong bsod nams bzang po/ rab 'byams pa dge ba'i blo gros/ dkar chen bstan 'dzin nor bu/ rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje padma 'phrin las/ bon lung gar gyi dbang po/ chos gter 'phrin las (266na tshe kun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa gar gyi dbang phyug rol pa rtsal gyis klu btsan gnas pa'i sa rtse chen brag dmar nas spyan drangs pa'i phur sgrub thugs kyi nying khu'i skor la/ ras bris kyis dkyil 'bor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang / mtha' rten sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang / sngags/ dpal gyi chas/ phyag mtshan/ chos 'chad pa/ sras mchog rnams kyi rjes gnang / rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / mtha' rten lung bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du sher dbang / mtha' rten dbugs dbyung /sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang mtha' rten gzengs bstod/ mjug tu gzhan don yongs rdzogs/drag pos 'gro 'dul phyag mtshan 'bar ba/ rgyan dang longs spyod rdzogs pa/ 'chi med tshe/ zhal zasatshogs/ mar me/ spyod pa/ bar gcod 'dul ba/ dngos grub myur thob/ phyir mi ldog pa/ lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang bcas dbang yongs rdzogs mnos nas/ lung la/ dpag bsam ljon pa'i sdong bu/yan lag /lo 'dab/ lag phran/ me tog /'bras bu/ grib ma/ pags pa'i tshul dang brgyad/ dang po la/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba man ngag lag len thugs kyi snying khu spyi don gsum gyis bstan pa stod las kyi rim pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i bshad 'grel dri med shel 'phreng zhes pa gsang mchog bdud 'dul phur pa'i mngon rtogs kyi las rim gsal bar ston pa lha nye bar bsnyen pa 'o'i mtha' can/ de'i rtsa brgyud rnams dril ba rtsa thung (2slobaskong po zhes pa rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa rdzogs —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheso'i mtha' can/ de'i 'grel pa thugs kyi me long o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i yan lag la/ las byang khrigs byas zhes pa rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor srung ma dam can dang bcas pa'i phyag 'tshal mchod bstod kyi las rim phur bu'i srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi mtha' can/ de'i mjug lhan thabs la rtags bstod/ smad las kyi bskul/ chad mdo/ bstan stong / rta bro dang bcas pa las byang gi go rim o rgyan gyi dge slong padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa 'tsho rgyal gyis zin bris su btab pa'i mtha' can/ slob ma smin byed dbang gi las khrigs padma 'byung gnas kyis phyi rabs kyi don du phye ba thugs kyi sras dang phrad shog dang srung ma bka' sgo mā ra ya'i mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i lo 'dab la/ gdab las kha klong don rab tu gsal ba zhes pa dbye ba/ bcing ba/ smyor 'jug pa/ gsad pa/ bstab pa/ mnan pa ste las drug dang / thems byang 'di ltar 'dug kyang bzhugs tshul chos dbang byang gter sogs dang mthun pa'i mnan pa logs su 'dug go /drag po'i sbyin sreg mnan pa/ zor rnams o rgyan padmas phyi rabs don du mdzad pa 'tsho rgyal gyis zin bris su btab pa/ dam can nye bar bsnyen pa'am mtshan ma 'byin pa'i bzlas pa/ ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa zhes pa lha dang phral ba/gzugs la dbab pa/ yan lag bcing ba/ spyor 'jug pa/ gtun du brdung ba/ zhal btab dang drug 'di gter kha 'og ma sogs dang mthun/ dbye ba sogs ngan sngags drug gi 'khor lo'i 'dri rtog te re/thabs grol bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ lha dang dgra la dngos grub kyi (267na)bcud blang ba rtag chad gnyis ka gong du bkag po 'o'i mtha' can/ gong gi kha spyor zhes pa ngan sngags nye bar bsnyen pa'i gdab kha drug gi 'phrin las/ dkyus na oṃ lo hūṃ lo zhes pa'i don mnan pa las kyi sbyor ba bstan pa/tshar gcod pa drag po'i sbyin sreg /phan gdags zhi ba ro sreg gi cho ga rnams/ dha ti ( go te re)gsum gyi rang rtags srog gi snying po phur pa srog gi spu gri 'o'i mtha' can/ bzhi pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i lag phran la/ klu 'dul las kyi kha tshar/ seng phur la brten pa'i char (gter)'bebs/ khro bcu'i rta —386

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan mig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)mgrin du bskyed pa dang rus sbal la brten pa'i ser rtog te re/'bebs/ khro bo rigs lnga phur pa (gi te re/sras mchog hūṃ mdzad sgo ma bzhi la brten pa'i tshe sgrub/ ro bam dang rdzas la dngos grub tu bsgrub pa'i bam sgrub/ thun gyi las sbyor don gsum (gte re/gyis bstan pas skabs dang sbyar bar bya 'o'i mtha' can/ med po gso ba'i thabs(gter)bri zhing bzlas so'i mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i me tog la dkyil 'khor rnam dag la dgongs te bskyed rtog te re/pa 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chag chag gdab rtog te re/pa bdud rtsi dri chen ma/ 'dzab bstod spros med (gi te re/thig le ma/ rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku mdog phyag mtshan 'khor sogs ston pa rtog te re/phur pa lung gi chings gal tho gser 'phreng / sman phud gal tho bdud rtsi bum pa'i sa ma thi gsad (gte re/nan gyi mtshams zhes bya'o'i mtha' can/ rtogs pas bdag grol ba'i las rtog te re/kha tshar ston pa rnams/ drug pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras bu la/ man ngag gnad kyi byang gcig gam/ dmar byang snying 'grel du bkol ba (267ba/zhes pa sgrub pa lus dkyil la brten nas gsum dril gyi gdams pa ngad ldan byung na sbyin par rigs pa'i mtha' can/ bdag 'jug spra 'khrid don dbang nor bu'i snying po 'tsho rgyal gyi don du gsungs pa/ 'phrin las lam 'byer bsdus pa 'tsho rgyal gyis mkhar rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu mdzad pa/ o rgyan gyi zhal gdams dmar byang du bkod pa'am gnad don du gdams par grags pa rnams/ bdun pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib ma la/ ri ti mched bzhi sgrol ging can gyi drag sngags brlag par gdon mi za 'o'i mtha' can/ bse mo gnad gcod can gyi sngags rtog te re/brlags par gdon mi za 'o'i mtha' can/ sde brgyad spyi dril gyi srog snying gser phur du phyung ba zhes pa/ ston pa/ 'byung khungs skye rgyud/ dbye ba/ rgyu mtshan/ las/ ngo bo/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ las kyi 'phyong ste brgyad kyi sgo nas bstan pa sbas byang gi mtha' can rnams/ rdzas bsrung nag po dgu (rgo te re/sbyor zhes pa rdzas sna nyi shu rtsa lnga la brten pa/ drag po rdzas kyi rwa bsrung (gte re/byug pa rgyan 'khor du grags pa dngos grub rnams dben pa'i mtha' can rnams/ brgyad pa dpag —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebasam ljon pa'i pags pa ni/ thog yig par bkab snying byang gal tho'o/ /thems med bsrung ba rdo rje'i go khrab snying phur du gdams pa/ bstan srung sho na spu gri can sgrub pa rbad bskul byo'i mtha' can/bdud nag po sgro snying can gyi sgrub thabs 'grub par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ dgra bla lcags kyu can gyi drag ( gte re)sngags phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ dpe ris la/ dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor/e khram/ lha dang phral/ gzugs la dbab pa/ yan lag bcing ba/ spyor 'jug pa/ gtun brdung / zhal bstab/ dmar po srog 'khor/ gnad (268na skokhor dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje gzhon nu/ sprul sku o rgyan wo po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston gar gyi dbang phyug /thugs sras ye shes rdo rje gu ru sangs rgyas blo gros/ mtshan ldan bsod nams lhun grub/ slob dpon chos rgyal mtshan/ snying phug dmi bzang po/snying po grub mchog bzang po/ snying phu rigs 'dzin dbang po/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /bya khyung pa chos rgyal bkra shis/ bya khyung pa bsod nams rgyal po/ bya khyung pa padma rnam rgyal/ sprul sku o rgyan dpal 'byor/ lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal/ mtshungs med 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bya khyung pa padma rnam rgyal nas/ de sras padma bstan 'dzin/ lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal man 'dra'o/ /lha sras skye mtha' sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa gar gyi dbang phyug gis kong po rgya la lnga dong bar pa tshe bdag nag po'i thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal dkar nag khra gsum gyi skor gyi zab rgya dang po zhi ba la/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dang gzhen nu chu skyes sbrags pa'i sgo nas dug lnga rang grol sku lnga ye shes su rjes su gnang ba/ lus ngag yid gsum ye shes sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs su rang bzhin du rjes su gnang ba/ mtha' rten glegs bam/ gdugs/ phyag mtshan/dung / 'khor lo/ sgrub pod/ brgyud mar gyi rjes su gnang ba rnams mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ 'jam —388

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadapal dkar (268ba)ser thun mong gi skor/ ye shes sems dpa'i skor/ gzhen nu chu skyes kyi skor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs ma rig mun sel gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa stod cha'i tshul dang rjes gnang gi yi ge smad char byas pa sgrub thabs dang rjes su gnang ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gnyis pa ye shes sems dpa'i skor las dang po/ bris sku la brten pa'i rtsa ba 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i gsang sgrub/ bris sku'i bskyed chog /gnyis pa las 'phrin la/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa la/ brten nas thar pa don du gnyer zhing gnas skabs dang bar do gshin rje'i 'jigs skyob/ rten 'brel snying po la brten nas pha rol chom rkun 'ching zhing gnod pa las grol ba/ ā li bcu drug la brten nas g.yon dbang du bya ba/ kā li so lnga la brten nas tshe bsring ba/ re'u mig zhe dgu'i sbyor ba la brten nas pha rol gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa/ de rnams kyi dngos dang mtshan ma'i brtag pa dang bcas pa/ gsum pa gzhen nu chu skyes kyi skor la/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa/nyes byas 'joms pa/ yon tan sgrub pa/ ngag 'grol ba/ gzhan dang rtsod pa bya ba/ ma sha la brten pa'i las sbyor rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs/ dran mchog o rgyan chen po/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston gar gyi dbang phyug /bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /gu ru chos rgyal
