bkra shis/ bla ma dpal 'bar dbang phyug /bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal/ rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin/ rgyal ba'i sras po dkon cog chos dbang grags pa/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings (269na)rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /zab rgya gnyis pa 'jam dpal zhi drag phyed ma'am dmar po longs spyod tshe 'phel gyi skor la/bkra shis tshe gzan/ tshe rten rdo rje/ srog rten mda'/ srog lus dbang thang rlung rta'i rten bum pa/ dngos grub kyi rten bdud rtsi/ dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa'i dbang legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ tshe bdag dmar po'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i ljon shing zhes pa bca' gzhi/ sgrub pa dngos/ tshe 'gugs/bstod pa/ dngos nyams kyi rtags dang / zhar byung tshe dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang bcas thob pa'i —389—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebargyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma tshe dbang rtsal man gong ltar ro/ /zab rgya gsum pa 'jam dpal nag po yang zab thugs kyi tshal bu bsrung bzlog don gyi mthar thug grib 'joms rdo rje pha lam gsang ba'i yang zhun skor la/ sgo gsum dri ma 'dag pa bum dbang /lha 'grub byed sku dbang / log 'dren 'dul ba phyag mtshan/ yon tan gter 'byung phur dpe/ 'phrin las kun 'grub 'phreng thun/ sgrub pa las sbyor gtor ma 'brub khung / 'phrin las bdag por 'gyur ba rdor dril gyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba mnos nas/ lung la/ gter gnas gong mtshungs dngos bstan dang gter gnas gzhan nas spyan drangs pa'i yig sna ste gnyis/ dang po la/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang lus dkyil 'khor la brten nas bsnyen pa'i las rim/gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ bca' gzhi las byang zhan byung rtags mtshan dang bcas pa 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs sgrub o rgyan (269ba)gsung gi sras la gtod pa'i mtha' can/ gsum pa las sbyor la/bsrung ba rdo rje'i go khrab/ zlog pa ral gri'i 'khor lo/ gsad pa las kyi spu gri/ las tshogis rdo rje'i pha lam zhes pa ltas brtag pa dang rdzas brgyad cu rtsa gcig la brten nas stobs ldan grib 'joms spyi dril bsrung ba/ bye brag grib bsrung / grib 'gos sel ba'i gdams pa dang bcas pa tshe bdag gsang yig gi gzhung nas btus pa/ gsang ba gnad kyi yig chung la/ zlog pa/ gsad pa/ grib bsrung gi 'khor lo dang / dmigs pa'i gdams pa zab pa'i yang snying yig chung dmar byang can/ bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi gshor bcas chog ma gsang ba yang phur du gdams pa zhes par gshor dkar po bsrung ba sku gdung lnga ma/ gshor nag po bzlog pa thod pa bzhi pa/ gshor khra bo gsad pa phur bu gsum pa/ byad ma 'bum bzlog ces pa bca' ba ting 'dzin sngags gsum zhan byung rang bsrung sgrib shing dang bcas pa rang gshed dbab pa'i bzlog yig gshor gyi gdams pa snying gi dkyil du 'chang ba rnams/ dpe ris la/ bsrung ba sku gdung lnga pa'i 'khor lo/ zlog pa thod pa bzhi pa'i 'khor lo/ /—390

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)gsad pa phur bu gsum pa'i 'khor lo/ /bande dang dbon po gsod pa'i ling ga re/ sku gdung / gtor ma/ thod pa rnams kyi shog khra bcas pa/ gnyis pa gter gnas gzhan nas byon pa yig sna'i skor la/dgye'o rong klu bdud kha gnon nas gdan drangs pa la/ gdong gi gshor dkar nag khra gsum gyi yig chung gsang ba thugs phur gyi gdams pa gsang ba dkrug yig gi lde mig gsal ba sgra rang bsgyur du (270na)bkod pa/ rgyal dong kha bar ma'i gter ma'i byad mar rang gshed rang la dbab pa tsakra gshin rje rta ru zhon cing gdan du 'ding ba'i zab thig bshan pa dme ru tse zhes par rdzas/ dus tshod tshes grangs/ tsakra 'dri thabs/ rab gnas/ lteb lugs/ bcang thabs las sbyor/ man ngag kha bsgyur/lag len dmar khrid de don brgyad kyis bstan pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ de'i yig chung pha rol khrag tu skyug par 'gyur ba/ dme ru tsa'i gshor dmar chung rno la zab pa/ gshin rje rta zhen gyi dpe ris/de'i rgyab tu dri ba'i tsakra bcas pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon/ lag na rdo rje/ bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /'phung byed shinti ghanta/ dha na dha la/ o rgyan chen po man gong bawo no/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas kong po rgyal dong kha nas spyan drangs pa'i gshin rje kha la me 'bar byad ma'i gshed ma dam nyams phung byed kyi mtshon cha'i skor la nang gses kyi phyag len bca' gzhi/mngon rtogs las byang sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma/ bsnyen sngags/ mdun bskyed las sbyor/ bskul phyogs phyogs ma dang bcas pa o rgyan gyi dge slong padma 'byung gnas kyis gshin rje thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho'i nang nas man ngag gser phur du phyung ba/ drag po me'i las mtha' gcig gshor nag po 'gyur med log jugs 'khyams gsum mi srid pa snying gi dkyil du 'chang ba'i mtha' can/ gshin rje'i sku/ thab khung / ling ga /gtor ma'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/ yang gter gnas (270ba)de nyid nas spyan drangs pa'i gshin rje'i gzhor phung bshig byang shing dmar po lo ma 'gyangs par grong phung —391

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebar 'gyur ba dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung phyag len dmar 'khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /'phung byed shis garbha/ dha na dha la/ o rgyan padma thod 'phreng / mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /bdud 'dul sngags pa/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ desabadag la'o/ /yang na rje kun dga' tshe mchog nas/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhon nu don grub/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas bsam yas brag dkar seng ge'i gdong pa can nas gdan drangasapa'i mkha' 'gro las brgya rtsa'i skor la/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ gtor ma dang rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang mnos nas lung la/ sgrub pa dang las spyor gnyis/ dang po la/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga rtsa ba'i ri/ lta sgom spyod gsum 'bras bu dam tshig rnams ston pa'i rdzogs rim mdor bsdus/ byin rlabs bya tshul rnams/ gnyis pa las sbyor la/ brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa'i dang po mkha' 'gro dbang sdud/ gnyis pa 'chi slu/ gsum pa tshe sgrub/ bzhi pa gzi brjid bskyed pa/ lnga pa lus stobs 'phel (271na)pa/ drug pa bde drod sbar pa/ bdun pa lus mnyen pa/ brgyad pa lus yangs thabs/ dgu pa rkang mgyogs/ bstopa mig gsal byed/ bstogacig pa mig mi phyid pa/ bcu gnyis pa rkang lag mi nyid pa/ bcu gsum pa lham mi dgos pa/ bcu bzhi pa lus la dri bzang mnam pa/ bco lnga pa mchan 'og gi dri ngan dbyung ba/ bcu drug pa snang ba dbang sdud/ bcu bdun pa rgyal po dang yul khams dbang sdud/ bco brgyad pa khram dbang sdud/ bcu dgu pa ma dad pa dbang sdud/ nyi shu pa bud med dbang sdud/ nyer gcig pa de dag 'grol ba/ nyer gnyis pa pho dbang sdud/ nyer gsum pa nor dbang sdud/ nyer bzhi pa zas dbang —392

dam pa' chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg ba mo gsum pa/ rtoganasdud/nyer lnga pa sris rme ba/nyer drug pa zas kyi sbyin sreg/nyer bdun pa ḍa gi lag bskul/nyer 'bargyad pa don gnyer 'grub pa/nyer dgu pa rmi lam brtag pa/sum sto pa longs spyod phun tshogs/sogacig pa mdzes ma rgyan 'khor/so gnyis pa mi byams pa byams pa/so gsum pa gos dbang sdud/so bzhi pa mi kha mi 'byung ba/so lnga pa skad bde ba/so drug pa snyan grags sgrub pa/so bdun pa rang 'dod grogs phrad/so brgyad pa rtsod pa rgyal ba/sodagu pa tshong rgyal ba/bzhi bcu pa sho rgyan rgyal ba/zhe ka rjeg pa sdig can chos la 'dzud pa/zhe gnyis pa khrom g.yo ba/zhe gsum pa khrom bsrung ba/zhe bzhi pa rlung g.yo ba/zhe lnga pa rlung gnon/ zhe drug pa char 'bebs/zhe bdun pa char gcod/zhe brgyad pa ser bsrung /zhe dgu pa thog bsrung /lnga bcu pa bsrung skud gdags pa/nga gcig pa mtshon bsrung /nga gnyis pa sde brgyad bsrung ba/nga gsum pa spyo 'dre bsrung ba/nga ba ni pa 'dron71bgadon bskrad pa/nga lnga pa 'dre gdon gzir ba/nga drug pa bgegs chen bsrung ba/nga bdun pa mna' ho bzlog pa/nga brgyad pa phyogs ga bsrung ba/nga dgu pa steng gdon bsrung ba/drug cu pa 'ogagadon bsrung ba/re gcig pa gtad 'grol/re gnyis pa the'u brang bsrung ba/re gsum pa gnyan nad bsrung ba/re bzhi pa 'go nad bsrung ba/re lnga pa rigs sngags bzlog pa/re drug pa bsam sbyor ngan bzlog/re bdun pa zho chang bsrung ba/re brgyad pa rkan ma bsrung ba/re dgu pa gcan gzan bsrung ba/bdun sto pa gdong sar phrul bsrung /don gtsig pa shwa bzlog/don gnyis pa nad pa byin rlabs/don gsum jag 'ja /don bzhi pa gson 'dre kha 'ja /don lnga pa shi 'dre mnan pa/don drug pa sha za ḍā gi gnad 'bebs/don bdun pa grib sel/don brgyad pa grib bsrung /don dgu par ga 'grol/brgyad cu pa shes rab 'phel ba/gya gcig pa srid spel/gya gnyis pa lte bsgyur/gya gsum pa skye ba dgag pa/gya bzhi pa ye shes rte kyi brtag pa/gya lnga pa pra 'bebs/gya drug pa la nye brtag pa/gya bdun pa ye shes dbab pa/gya brgyad pa ye shes gshegs gsol/gya dgu pa khyis mi rmug pa/dgu bcu pa mngon shes sgrub pa/go gcig pa rdo la rang ༷byon/go gnyis pa gtor ma 'khol ba/go gsum

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogepa bum chu mi 'khyags pa/ go bzhi pa gtor ma khrag sgyur/ go lnga pa gru mi 'jig pa/ go drug pa dgra bo srog 'phrog pa/ go bdun pa dgra bo bskrad pa/ go brgyad pa mdza' bo dbye ba/ go dgu pa spyor bzhug pa/ brgya thams pa de dag 'grol ba/ brgya gcig pa myos par byed pa/ brgya gnyis pa cho 'phrul gtang ba/ brgya gsum pa de (272na 'grol ba/ brgya bzhi pa bsod nams nyams byed/ brgya lnga pa dgra ngag lkugs byed/ brgya drug pa mi kha gtong ba/ brgya bdun pa sprul pa 'dul ba/ brgya brgyad pa mardzend gtong ba dang 'grol thabs rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang mo longs sku mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ sprul sku padma rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rgyal sras mu rbab btsan po/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ sras ye shes rdo rje/ grub chen dar ma bzang po/ 'phags dpon dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan/ mkhas grub kun dga' dpal blo/ grub chen dpal 'byor blo gros/ bla ma sangs rgyas blo gros/ grub mchog rkarma gsang sngags/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston gar gyi dbang phyug gis pu ri rin cen 'bar ba'i logs mkha' 'gro mngon spyod rnam par gnas pa'i pho brang brag ri 'bar ba ral gri gshibs pa lta bu bu ri phug mo che nas la chas gtums pa'i smyug sbubs nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug lha chen rlung gi zhags pa khams gsum dbang sdud skor la/ rtsa bsnyen sgrub pa/ dmigs bsal rdzasasngags las phran/ sgos sgrub dang gsum/ dang po la/ lho phyogs rgyad yul me ri 'bar ba'i rtser dbang phyug yab yum gyis o rgyan chen po la srog snying phul ba'i lo rgyus tho yig /bsam yas mnga' gsol gyi tshe gza' mig dmar gyi sprul pa mchims rdo rje spre chung gis slob dpon chen por gdams pa zhu pa'i lo rgyus/ dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo zhes par rnam grangs lnga tshan gnyis gsungs pa'i (272ba)nang gi pho dbang sdud kyi bsnyen pa thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ mo dbang sdud bud med lta bu lta ci smos pa'i mtha' can/ dbang sdud 'khor lo drag po zhes pa ma grogs bran gsum las ma —394

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)ltar bsten pa'i gdams pa snying dang 'dra ba gcig la gtod pa'i mtha' can/ phyi rgya skyegs/ nang tsandan/ gsang ba zangs kyi srid mes so sor bca' thabs phyi nang gsang sgrub zab rgya'i mtha' can/rten gsum gcig tu dril nas lha sgom bsnyen pa bya ba dbang phyug la mu stegs ḍā zhi bzhis bskor ba gar byed 'khrab par byung ba'i mtha' can/ gtor ma ri rab nor bu mig gsum pa'i dpe ris/ rten gsum gyi snying po phyi nyi zla rlung gi 'khor lo la brten nas grags pa bsgrub pa/ nang nor bu bsam 'phel gyi 'khor los zas nor bsgrub pa/ gsang ba snang ba dbang sdud kyi 'khor los pho mo bsdu ba/de gsum gyi 'khor lo dang dbang rten gyi dpe ris/ pho mo rkyang 'ded kyi sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ rdzas/sngags gsum brten nas skyes pa bran ltar bkol ba/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gsum gyis bud med dbang du bsdu ba/ ra rdzogakho mar 'di ni ri 'phar du khug zer ba khrug /rdzas dang 'khor lor brten pa'i nor bu bsam 'phel phyi sgrub dpral ba'i mig las gces pa/ sreg pa'i sbyor bas nor bu bsam 'phel nang ltar sgrub pa dngos grub sna tshogs ster pa/ lha sngags rten gsum gyis nor bu bsam 'phel gsang ba ltar bsgrub pa/ snang srid bran du 'gyur ba zhan byung rtags dang bcas pa/ mu stegs rlung gi zhagasapa ma hā de wa yab yum gyi gsang ba'i rten bca' ba/ rin cen gter gyi sgrub pa'i pā dza dbul ba/zhal zas dus gsum phul nas sirnyi(273na)blang ba/ bstod pa bya zhing nga rgyal bskyed pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzla ba ste don lngas bstan pa/ zhan byung dbang phyug yab yum gyi mngone rtogs/ yab yum gyi sku 'bag /dbang rten/ zangs gzhong bcas pa'i dpe ris/ rtsa sngags/ nor sgrub/ dbang sdud spyi/ 'jig rten/ grogs ltar brtseb/ bran du bkol ba/ skyes pa phrog 'phrog /mchod gtor/ dngos grub zhu ba/las sbyor rnams kyi sngags kyi ti ka zhal gdams gab yig ma/ pha wang long bu dang sre mo'i thod par brten pa'i mi 'grub mi srid pa'i gdams pa/ dmangs rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i ti ka gsal byed khol du byung ba tshangs pa chen pos gsungs pa rnams/ gnyis pa mig gsal rdzas sngags las phran la/dbang sdud 'khor lo drag po rnam pa drug gis bstan pa zhes par nang gses kyi skyes pa dbang du bsdu —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )ba la grogs ltar brtse ba/ bran ltar bkol ba/ srog 'phrog pa gsum/ de'i ling 'khor sprel thod/g.yag ru rnams kyi dpe ris/ yul khams dbang du bsdu ba so phag shi tham gyi mtha' can/ de'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/ gzhan yang nor/ rgyal po/ blon po/ dmangs/ bud med sogs gang 'gugs la gong gi pho dbang sdud gsum kha bsgyur ba dang ma 'grub na yul khams dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing sgrub pa thams cad la dbang rten liṅga byed tshul sgrub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa rin cen gter du sbas pa'i mtha' can dpe ris dang bcas pa/ mu stegs rlung zhags kṣe tra pā la'i sgo nas nor dbang sdud/ gang 'gugs liṅga bca' ba/ rgyal po/ blon po/ rje btsan/ bande/ bon po/ phyug po/ dmangs/bud med sogs(273ba tshe pa sngags kyi grangs bstan pa dang / rten lus la bcang zhing rgyun sngagasa'adren tshul sogs bstan pa dus mtha'i 'gro ba dmu rgod bde la dgod pa'i mtha' can/ dbang rten dang lirsha'i dpe ris/ mdze nad gsob klu dang sa bdag gi nad las thar byed/ dung la brag gis ra ma yin zer ba 'dug /thun rdzas kyis yul khams dbang du bsdu ba gsang ba'i yang khol gser phur lag len/rgyal po dbang du sdud pa'i man ngag gser phur mchog tu gdams pa rnams/ gsum pa sgos sgrub la/nor dang bsod nams 'phel ba gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i sgrub pa/ 'bru nor dbang du byed pa sa la'i sgrub pa snying gi nor bu/ zas nor bsod nams longs spyod dbang byed a pa ra tsitta'i sgrub pa/nor dang yo byad dbang du bya ba sogs ma med khye'u sngon po'i sgrub pa/ zas nor dbang du bya ba khye'u chung nor rgyun gyi sgrub pa/ de rnams kyi bca' gzhi dpe ris/ gdams pa'i che ba skal ldan skyes bu'i lung byang gong 'og gter srung gi gtad rgya dang bcas pa rnams so/ /rtse chen brag nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i gdams pa yang zab gud du phyung ba lha chen 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las mar gyi snying po lta bu me lce'i lcags kyu'i skor la/ dbang rten gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang / phyag mtshan gyis srid pa gsum la dbang sbyor thob pa'i dbang /sngags dang gtor ma'i rjes gnang rnams mnos nas/ lung la/ rtsab lag len las sbyor gsum/—396

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadang po la/ dbang sdud yang zab myur mgyogs ma'i lcags kyus gzhung sgrub gab pa mtshan phyung mu tig 'phrong ba/ lha chen drag po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rjes su gnang ba gtad pa'i (274na tshe dzu ga /gnyis pa lag len ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i las phran lag 'khrid mngon du phyung ba rgyun 'khyer gyi ga dmas pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i pho mo'i ling ga dbang rten bcas pa'i dpe ris/ gsum pa las sbyor la/ dbang sdud las kyi mde'u thung / yang zab gnad du dril ba rlung 'khor gyi las sbyor/dbang phyug chen po'i las rlung srog gi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bri yig legs par grub par bya'o'i mtha' can/ rlung 'khor phyi nang gsum gyi 'khor lo'i dpe ris/ dbang phyug chen po'i srog gnad bla rdo'i man ngag /de'i dpe ris/ gnad 'bebs dbang phyug srog rtsa dmar 'byin/ 'khrul 'bor dmigs pa'i las sbyor mde'u thung zab rgya/ dbang sdud gtor ma'i las sbyor/ ri rab nor bu mig gsum dang / dbang rten du 'jug rgyu'i 'khor lo'i dpe ris/ byin rlabs lag bsgul gyi lasasbyor/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon du gdags rgyu'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/ dbang sdud rdzas kyi las sbyor/rten 'brel rgyun gyi las sbyor/ dbang phyug drag po'i mtshon cha/ sdig can sgrol ba'i ngan sngags srog gi skru gri/ sgrub pa'i skab 'dre gnod byed shanta raka gnon pa/ bskrad pa/ ling 'khor gyi dpe ris dang bcas pa rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma thod 'phreng / jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ mchims rdo rje spre chung / gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma chos rgyal bkra shis/ rigs 'dzin dpal 'bar dbang phyug /ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal/ rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin/ 'bri gung pa rigs (274ba 'dzin dkon cog phun tshogs/ de gnyis ka la rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyis gsan/ de la khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas 'od shod rlung sgrom nas gdan drangs pa'i rdzas sngags sku gzugs la brten nas gza' rgod thang la 'bebs pa'i gdams pa gser las dkon pa zhu rten med 397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nepar mi sbyin pa'i mna' rgya can/ yang de dang 'dra min gcig dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po/ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu rbab btsan po/ sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa/ sras ye shes rdo rje nas rim par/ slob dpon tshe dbang nor rgyas/khyab bdag dpal 'byor lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas kong po rtse chen brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rnam sras seng chen gyi skor sogs/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du rjes gnang / rigs gtad kyi yi ge'i steng nas sngon 'gro snod du rung ba sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang / dngos gzhi'i bum dbang / rdo rje/ rin cen/ padma/'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu rnams kyis snang srid thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ba'i dbang / mtha' bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rdzasabargyad/ khye'u pho mo/ lha bsgos/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin cen lnga rnams kyis rgyal po chen po dang mnga' thang longs spyod mnyam pa/ lha dbang gis byin gyis brlab pa/ glegs bam 'phreng ba'i bzlas lung la bka' gtad dang bcas legs par mnos nas lung la (275na)rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi themasabyang dkar chag yid bzhin nor mchog /rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa paṇḍita padma 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu'i rgyud kyi rgyud dam bshad pa'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma nye bar bsdus pa'i le'u gsum pa/ phyi dkar gsum mngar gsum dang rgyal mtshan/ nang gtor ma thang sku/ gsang ba seng ldeng gi seng ge dang khyi dkar gyi snying la brten nas bsgrub pa'i rnam thos sras sam gnod sbyin nor 'dzin gyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs paṇḍita padma 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba/ dar 'dam la brten nas sku bzhengs pa'i man ngag o rgyan snying gi tshal pa/ dzo'i ga'u la brten nas rgyal po rnam thos sras zhi ba nor du bsgrub pa/ khyi dkar thod ling la brten nas drag po mthu ru bsgrub pa/ de'i las phran ltas ga gtong ba pho nya bya mgo ma/ bzlog gsad lha 'dre kha 'ching /—398

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg ba tshigasum pa/ rtoganagrong khyer rlung la bskur ba'i khang sel bla gzhis rlag byed/ phung gtad phag thod ma/ gong gi zhi ba nor sgrub kyi las phran du gtogs pa'i ga'u la brten nas rnam thos sras gnod sbyin brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs rin cen gter 'bum/ rkun lag la brten nas nor sgrub srin po nor len/ sre mo'i rlid bu la brten nas nor sgrub ne'u le rdzas kyi nor bu/ sre mo'i snying la brten nas snying sgrub rig pa'i nor len/ gong du bshad pa'i gdams pa rnams kyi lo rgyus thebs kyi khog 'bubs/ lte bsgyur srid pa'i skye gnas kyi srog shing / rten 'brel gyi che bas srid chags shing de yang phor 'gyur ba'i lte bsgyur/ bsen mo srog mo 'dre 'dul ba/ pho 'dre rgyal 'gong bsrung 'dul/ dbang sdud kyi nang tshan 'khor (275ba)los pho mo dbang du bsdu ba/ thig les pho mo dbang du bsdu ba/ phug ron gyi rdzas kyis bud med dbang du bsdu ba/ mo gsham la bu skye ba yur bskam chu 'bebs/ bu dang sha ma 'byin pa nad thams cad zhi ba/'go nad zhi ba/ mig nad sel ba/ rgyu nad sel ba'i sman sngags/ lhog sngags/ bgegs las rgya'asab/ 'byung po'i 'tshe ba 'joms pa/ rnam thos sras kyi 'phrin las don brgyad ma sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi rigs gta pa'i cho ga don bdun gyis bstan pa/ rnam thos sras kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gter gyi bang mdzod ces pa phyi ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa/ nang gtor ma la brten na bsgrub pa/ gsang ba tsakra la brten nas bsgrub pa/ srog 'phrog par byed pa'i 'dri ba dang sgom pa'i 'khor lo/ dam tshig bstan pa/ gnad dbab la nang gses kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ bla rdo bcang ba/ sbyin sreg bya ba/ gtor mas 'gugs pa/ mde thung skor la/ bris sku'i las mthasagayul rgyal ba/ yams nad rgyun gcod/ 5ge zhi ba/ 'khrug pa zhi ba/ char 'bebs/ shwa bud bsrung ba/ jag pa chom rkun bsrung ba/ seng ldeng be con gyis 'dod don bsgrub pa/ dngos grub kyi bar gcod sgab 'dre shes pa dkar po gnon pa/ rta sngon po'i rten gzhug pa/ phyi bla ri'i rten/ bla rdo bca' ba thi gu dkar po la brten nas 'khu ldog bsrung ba rnams nos/ las rim bcu gsum dang las brgyad ma'i las mtha' sogs kha shas dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ bya rgod gshongs nas spyan drangs pa'i gsang —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheba'i las mkhan mdung dmar can gsang sgrub kyi skor la/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa/ las sbyor nang gses la nyi (276na)zla kha sbyor gyis yul khams dbang du bsdu ba/ lta byed mig gi dbang pos khrom dbang du bsdu ba/ tsitta snying gi dbang pos 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba/ gsang ba rdzas kyi sbyor bas gang 'dod dbang du bsdu ba rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ sras ye shes rdo rje/ mnyam med sangs rgyas blo gros/ rigs 'dzin bsod nams lhun grub/sngags 'amang chos rgyal mtshan can/ bla ma kurma bzang po/ grub mchog bzang po/ mkhas grub rigasa'adzin snying po/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas dgye bo rong bu ri nag po'i klu bdud kha gnon gyi mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa'i gtad khram rus sbal nag po zhes pa sdig can phung ba'i ngan sngags lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog snying rno ngar can gyi skor la/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ gtad khram gyi rtsa ba/ tshigs bcad ma gtad khram rus sbal nag po padmas 'tsho rgyal la gdams pa/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'i bsrung ba'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ rgyud kyi 'phros las gtad khram tsakra bsgrub pa'i dus dang nyams len gyi dus lha rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba ye shes lor lo ma/ sel nag kun thub rang bsrung gtad bzlog sbyor ba bshig pa'i man ngag /le'u gsum pa thig skor dgu pa'i 'khor lo'i bri yig gzhan rgyud ltar ro'i mtha' can/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'i zhal gdams zab pa'i yang zab snying dang (276ba 'dra ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sngags byang zab pa'i rgya ru gdams pa rjes med thong la shog gi mtha' can/ gtad khram gyi drag sngags tsakra 'dri tshul dang bdag bskyed/dgug dbye/ thun brdeg /dmod pa khram 'dabs bcas pa drag po las kyi yang khol bstan pa bsrung bar shog gi mtha' can/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'i man ngag yang khol du phyung ba/ dug gi 'khor lo dug gsum gnad la dbab pa/ khram mtha' gdug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i drag sngags zhes—400—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapar 'chi bdag mgo dgu /gshin rje ma mo gza'/ lha klu bdud/ rgyal po/ btsan/ srin po/ ma yams/the'u brang / gzed/ ya bdud/ ma bdud/ 'gong po/ yul 'dre/ mu stegs/ mi ma yin/ rgyu skar/ pho 'dre/ mo 'dre/ byur 'dre/ gnyan/ sa bdag dang bcas pa'i khram sngags nyer lnga pa/ phyi 'thums khram gyi ling ga zhes pa dgra bo'i gnas nyi shu rtsa lngar khram 'debs pa dang rgyab tu 'dri ba'i khra gtso bor byas te gong gi lha 'dre nyer lnga so sor thod pa sogs 'jug snod kyi ngos 'dzin dang bcas pa padma'i snying tshil mang por spel na bka'i chad pa 'byung ba'i mtha' can/ 'chi bdag gtad khram nag po'i phung byed las kyi spu gri'i so 'chi bdag thugs kyi le'u gcig pa/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po'i gdams pa khyad par can gud du sbas pa/ mgyogs pa'i bya gsum che khas pa gnam sa bar gsum gyi phung byed kyi 'khor lo/ myur mgyogs spyod byed rlung gi 'khor lo/ dpe'u ris la/ rus sbal 'khor lo/ gti mug glang / zhe sdang sbrul/ 'dod chags bya/ pho 'khor/ mo 'khor/ gnad 'khor/ khram ling / khram ris sogs dang 44thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje lang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan (277na 〉 sakyi rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /bla ma byang chub lhun grub/ gnam gong pa bkra shis dbang phyug /mtshungs med bsod nams bzang po/ de sa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rigasa'adzin tshul khrims blo gros/ sngags 'chang bkra shis mgon po/ dbang drag 'gro don rab 'phel/rigs 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po/ sprul sku nor bu rgyan pa/ ratna gnyis pa/ chos kyi grags pa/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas dgye bo rong klu bdud kha gnon mchod rten nas gdan drangs pa'i rgyal sel phung byed lha khang nag po'i skor la ngan sngags dug gi spu gri yang khol du gsal bar bkod pa 'khor lo sgrub pa las sbyor bcas pa bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha/ gsum sbyor/ bzhi sbyor/ lnga sbyor/ drug sbyor rnams kyi rdzas la brten nas rabs gcod cing gyang rol du gtong ba/ rdzas dgu dang —40/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesngags la brten nas khang sel/ dur sel/ nor sel/ mi brgyud gcod pa/ rdzas bcu gcig la brten nas zhing zangs sngar ltar gtong ba zhing sel skye ba rgyun gcod/ lha khang ma'i lag len zhes pa rang bsrung / sgrub pa/ 'jug snod kyi kha bsgyur la brten nas kha phur du 'gro ba/ lo mi skye ba/ mi rnamasa'akhrugs pa/ grong stongs pa/ yul 'bud pa/ bdun brgyud gcod pa/ 'thab 'khrug 'byung ba/ nor la god kha 'ong ba/ dmod ring bka' bsgo nyer gtad dgra rtags sgrub rtags dang bcas pa zhal gyi gdams (277ba)pa'i mtha' can/ rā dza'i ngan sngags bcas chog ces pa 'khor lo la 'god pa'i sngags rnams gsal bar bkod pa dam shi dmar nag gi sngags 'bum/ sel 'bud nag po bcas chog /ma rungs gdug pa'i bcas chog /rang bsrung nag po dgu sbyor/ grong khyer phung byed g.yo ba'i sbyor ba'i 'khor lo bri yig sgrub pa'i lag len 'jug snod thod pa'i kha bsgyur la brten nas yul sel/grong sel/ khyim sel/ dur sel/ mi sel/ zhing sel dang bcas pa/ lha khang ma'i sngags 'bum chen mo dpe ris dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longs sku khro rgyal rta mgrin/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ lha sras mu rub btsan po/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ sras ye shes rdo rje/ de sras sangs rgyas blo gros/ rigs 'dzin bsod namasargyal po/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub rkarma bha dra/ rje grub mchog bzang po/ snying phu rigasa'adzin snying po/ rtse le sprul sku padma legs grub/ rigs 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po man gong ltar/lha sras skye mtha' sprul sku gar gyi dbang phyug gis dgye bo rong klu bdud kha gnon gyi mchod rten nag po nas spyan drangs pa'i nā ga klu'i gsur gtad ces pa 'khor lo bca' gzhi sgrub pa/ las sbyor dang bcas pa klu'i drag gtad snying dang 'dra ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i man ngag gi bcas thabs las can la/ phrad shog dang klu bdud mgo dgu la gnyer gtad kyi mtha' can/ 'khor lo'i dmod pa zur du phyung ba/ 'khor lo/ ling rkyang / 'brub khung / sdig pa rnams kyi dpe'u ris/ yang gter gnas de nyid nas khyi spu ra bal la brten nas mthun (275)gnyis dkrug pa/ khyi phag gi che ba la brten —402

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogananas mkhar skyel ba/ 'khor lo bum pa mche ba'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/ yungs kar la brten nas smyo 'gyed/ yugs sa'i sgra bshad la brten nas dud 'gro gsod pa/ khyi spu ra bal gyi zhal gdams rnams/yang gter gnas de nyid nas srog mthu yud tsam ma rno ngar dang ldan pa/ seng gdong mar brten pa'i rjes gcod zhal shes/ yang gter gnas de nyid nas mu stegs kyi rdzas ser nag po skyin thang dkar po lug 'ded/ phra men khyi sogs ma zhes pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yang sgrol bar byed pa'i 'goms chog rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ dpal o rgyan chen po/ jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras/ gter ston gar gyi dbang phyug /bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge /chos rgyal bkra shis/ dpal 'bar dbang phyug /ngag dbang padma/ padma 'dzin/ 'bri gung dbur smyon/ bla ma dkon cog lhun grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhar skyel ba'i brgyud lugasagacig ni bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge nas/ bdud 'dul sngags pa/ rje mi 'gyur ba/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ du ma rang grol/ pha jo gzhon nu don grub/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston yab sras/ shākya rin cen/ kun dga' chos dbang / legs pa shes rab/ nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ lhun grub rdo rje/ gzhen nu don grub man gong bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas gling pa'i phung thal nag po'i sbyor ba'i lung ni zur rtsa ba'i bla mar nos/ brgyud pa zhu ba ma byung /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas bya rgod gshongs kyi brag ri ljon pa rta (278ba)mgo can nas gdan drangs pa'i drag po rdzas kyi yang zab mthong ba dug sbyor me long gi gdams pa zhes pa kha sgyur gyi sgo nas mkhar snyel ba/ nor dbul ba/ lo mi skye ba/ 'goms cho go /srog las/ bag ma'i skabs khyo 'chi ba rnams bstan pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan yab yum/ lha sras/ gter ston/ dpal seng ba/ chos rgyal bkra shis/ dpal 'bar dbang phyug ngag dbang padma yab sras gnyis rje chos kyi grags pa/ dkon cog lhun grub/ nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pas tsa ri'i gnas sgo rkyen dung la brag srin mo'i ro bcings pa 'dra ba —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebadud po rong btsan spun gsum gnas sa nas spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ klu bsrung dkar po gcig thub me'i 'khor lo zhes pa la/ 'khor lo/ rdzas/ rab gnas/ lteb lugs/ phan yon rnams bstan pa las can bu la gter rgya bkrol ba'i mtha' can/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ tsakra 'dri ba'i gsal byed/rab gnas/ thums dang bsrung ba 'dogs pa ste don bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa dpe'u ris dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma thod 'phreng / jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras/gter ston gar gyi dbang phyug /bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge bla ma chos rgyal bkra shis/ rigs 'dzin dpal 'bar dbang phyug /bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma/ rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin/ rgyal sras dkon cog chos dbang grags pa/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyangs rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma'i 'brum bsrung ra grod ma thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ thugs rje chen po/ o rgyan yab (279na/thum/ mnga' bdag yab sras/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ dpal ldan seng ge /chos rgyal bkra shis/ dpal 'bar dbang phyug /ngag dbang padma yab sras/ 'bri gung dbur smyon/ ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston yab sras/ shākya rin cen/ she'u kun dga' chos dbang /legs pa shes rab/ rje nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gzhen nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas dgye bo rong klu bdud kha gnon gyi mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa'i slob dpon chen pos mnga' bdag gi sku bsrung du gnang ba'i rdzas bsrung nyer gcig thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ o rgyan yab yum/ mnga' bdag yab sras/ gter ston yab sras/ chos bdag dpal ldan seng ge /bdud 'dul sngags pa/ gter ston mi 'gyur ba/grub chen bkra shis rgya mtsho/ de sras kun dga' tshe mchog /pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ de sras chosadabyings rang grol des bdag la'o/ /—404—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnagater ston rdo rje gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas/ gter ston chen po lnga la bran brgyas bskor: zhes gsungs pa'i lnga ni gter kha gong 'og gnyis/ rdo rje gling pa/ padma gling pa/ mdo sngags gling pa rnams yin par spyi bye brag gi lung bstan mang po nas bshad pa'i nang tshan rgyal ba'i sras po rdo rje gling pa ni/ rigs 'dzin rdo rje chos/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ thon mi sa sto ṭa/ lo ོ bee ro tsa na sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba tshar du mngar ba'i bag chags kyis gter ston (279bto|da kyi gsung las/ yig rigs mi 'dra drug cu rtsa bzhi shes/ sgra rigs mi 'dra sum brgya'i skad 'gyur shes/ skad sna mi 'dra stong dang drug brgya shes/ da lta'i dus na kun mkhyen sprul sku yin/ zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa don la gnas pa'i skyes bu chen po 'di/ rang gter las/ ma 'ongasalnga bcu kha ral tshe bsam yas 'di yi lho nub mtshams lung pa dor ma brgyangs 'dra'i nang : gra zhes bya ba'i phu mda' phu rigs ldan sngags 'chang bya khyi lo: chu khams padma rdo rje gling: o rgyan nga rang dngos gcig byung : skal ldan de dang 'di phrad shog ces dang / thugs rje chen po ga song kun skyob las/ dge gong phug pa'i lho nub grar o rgyan nga dngos bya khyi lo rgyud 'jam sbas tshul theg chen spyod ces dang / za yig nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ mdong rus rnal 'byor spyod pa ma nges skyong :dri med badzra drug cu kha ral dus padma'i thugs sprul lcags pho spre'u'i lo las can gter la dbang ba'i skyes bu 'byung : zhes zab gter rgya cher spyan drangs pa'i thog ma ni kha byang chen mo las/ bsam yas 'di yi lho yi phyogs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i brag logs la rta mgrin sgrub phug sgo 'byed bu gu ru rdo rje gling pa zhes: nga sprul de yis 'di spyod do: zhes gnam lcags 'bar ba'i brag gam yongs—405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (//grags dam shog bying o dkar brag gi rta mgrin phug pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus nas rgyal sras rdo rje gling pas lo bcu drug lon pa lcags glang stag gi zla ba'i tshes bcu la thog mar gter sgo phye ba'i o rgyan chen pos dngos su shog dril che chung brgya/ bla dpe po ti bzhi/ tsha(280na)lung thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ man ngag thams cad kyi nges don/ theg pa'i yang rtse/ pha rgyud lta ba klong yangs zhes rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bcud phyung ba'i skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang khrigs rin cen 'phreng ba'i steng nas/ gsol gdab/ sdom bzung / dam tshig byin dbab rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i 'jig rten lha mi/ rtag chad mu bzhi bsal pa/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ kṛ ya/ u pa/ yo ga /ma hā/ a nu/ a ti ste theg pa bcu gcig gi dbang / sgom ston chos rjes mdzad pa'i bum dbang rtsal 'phreng gi steng nas zhu 'bul/ dam bsgrag /skyabs sems/ sdom gzung / bsrung skud so shing / ku sha dang bcas pa'i sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i/ zhi ba'i bum dbang rin cen thems skas nas dngos gzhi'i le'u dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar bzhin gyi 'jug pa dang / zhi ba'i dbang gi phra thig nas gtso bum gyis sna drangs zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha dbang / rin cen thems skas nas/ bum pa/ mda' dar me long / ral gri/ me long / rma bya/ gtor dbang / ye shes spyan gsal ba'i smon lam/ dkyil 'khor ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ khro bo rin cen thems skas kyi le'u brgyad pa nas bcu bzhi pa yan ltar gyis sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i rim pa dang / lha dbang chen mo'i phra thig nas rtags gsum btab rjes khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang / rin cen them skas nas gri/ mda' dar/ phur pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ mar me/ thod pa/ phur pa/ thod tshil/ me long rma bya/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ khro bo/ bum pa/ dam rdzas/dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag dang bcas pa/ gsang (280ba)dbang rin cen 'khor lo'i steng nas/ zhu gsol/ las rgya dbul ba/ mna' chu/ sgom bzlas/ byin 'bebs/ maṇḍal rnams sngon du btang ba'i/dngos gzhi dpa' bo'i phyag rgya dang mkha' 'gro brda rtags kyi dbang / byang chub sems dbang / yab yum gnyis med kyi dbang / rjes kyi rim pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ padma 'bar ba ye shes brtsegs pa'i —406

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganasteng nas zhu 'bul/ dam tshig /sgom pa/ yon tan/ phyag rgya ngo sprod/ brda rtags phyag rgya'i dbang /dngas ma yar 'dren/ gegs sel ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ tshig dbang gi yi ge'i steng nas/ gsol gdab/ dam tshig /maṇḍal/ sdom bzung / byin 'bebs/ sngon du 'gro ba'i tshom bu'i zhing khams dang /'dod yon lnga sogs la brten pa'i tshig dbang ngo sprod/ dbang gi chu bo bzhi babs tshul gyi yi ge'i steng nas yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang la/ gsol gdab/ phyag 'tshal/ gzengs bstod nas dngos gzhi rdor dril/ ze khab/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs chos gos/ yol ba bla bre/rgyal mtshan gdugs kyi dbang / rjes bum pa/ shis brjod/ mchod pa smon lam dang bcas pa/ bka' po ti glegs bam gyi dbang la/ phyag maṇḍal/ dri ba/ dri lan/ longs sku'i mas su bcug nas/ rdo rje slob dpon/ rdo rje rgyal tshab/ 'dod yon lnga/ glegs bam/ sa lam ma 'dres reg bya/ 'gro 'dul 'phrin las kyi dbang / rjes dang bcas pa/ rig pa rtsal dbang la/ sngon 'gro khrigs chags song nas/dngos gzhi shes bya rig byed kyi rdzas/ nor bu/ tshe rdzas/ phyag rgya/ bam/ sman/ bhanta/ tshigs dbang /(281na 'gro don rgya chen byed pa'i dbang / yongs rdzogs phyag rgya chen po'i dbang la/ tshogs chas/me long / sgo byang / sti gon gyi chas/ dkyil 'khor gyi chas/ las kyi chas/ sbyor ba'i chas/ phyag rgya gar chas/ stangs stabs ging chas/ rol mo'i chas dbang rnams/ lta ba spyi 'byams kyi dbang la/ dbang rten la brten nas spyi blugs lta ba'i dbang dang bcas pa/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhi khro'i tshe sgrub 'od zer dra ba'i steng nas/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ral gri /tshe 'gugs/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ tshe gzan/ bum pa/ tshe ril/ tshe chang / spyi dril/ rdzogs rim mtha' rten rtags brgyad kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ padma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i zab dbang la/ bum pa/ thod pa/ gnyis med mnyam sbyor/ me long rma bya'i mdongs rnams la brten dbang bzhi chig rdzogs su bskur ba/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs spungs pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/mkha' 'gro kun 'dus kyi dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa gzugs la brten nas bum —407—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/dbang / thod chang phyag mtshan gyis gsang dbang / me long / thig le dkar dmar bcas pas sher dbang / ngo sprod tshig dbang / 'jig rten phyed 'das phyed ma 'das kyi mkha' 'gro'i dbang ni/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha dbang / chas dbang lta sgom spyod pa/ yon tan thob tshul/ dbugs dbyung /cod pan gyi dbang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ thog mar lta ba klongs yangs kyi thems yig rin cen sgron ma/ de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ lus lta bu brgyud kyi skor/ mgo bo lta bu (281ba〉po rgyus skor/ nang khrol lta bu dbang gi skor/ yan lag lta bu gzhan don skor/ dbang po lta bu blo 'phel skor/ don snying lta bu 'khrid skor/ snying shun lta bu kha skong skor/ lto tshil lta bu mkha' 'gro'i skor/ sor mo lta bu man ngag skor/ snying khrag gi dngas ma lta bu 'das rjes don 'khrid mthar thug skor/ lus bsrung gi go mtshon lta bu chos skyong skor dang bcu gcig /dang po ni/ theg pa thamasacad kyi spyi phud lta ba klong chen yangs pa chen po'i rgya chen 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi las khol du phyung ba le'u lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ gnyis pa mgo bo lta bu lo rgyus skor la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa rdzogs chen babs lugs kyi rab 'byed chen mo'i lo rgyus don gyi lde mig tu grags pa/ lo rgyus rin po che'i mdo byang dri med nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud ces pa shrī sidha dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi ma o rgyan bee ro bi mā la dang dzñā na su tra mjal ba yan la le'u bcu dgu de man la le'u'i par bkab med pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsum pa nang khrol lta bu dbang gi skor la/ dbang bzhi'i sngon 'gro padma'i ljon shing le'u brgyad pa/ dbang bzhi'i spyi chings khyung chen lding ba o rgyan padmas bkod pa le'u sum cu pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'gor bgegs 'dul khra bo chen po bcus zhes yod pa'i khyung lding gi dbang byang gud du bkol ba dpe chung du grags pa 'bar ba me'i skol sbyong kyi mtha' can/ theg pa bcu gcig dbang gi khrigs rin po che'i 'phreng ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ phyi spros bcas zhi ba byang chub sems kyi bum dbang chen mo rin cen them skas bsam yas mchims phu dge gong padma phug gi lho phyogs gnam (282na/lngags 'bar bar gter du sbas pa/ zhi ba'i lha dbang chen mo'i phra thig lo —408

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)paṇa gnyis kyis shrī'i gsung bzhin lhag chad med par bkod pa yig cha dang lag len 'thor ba phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas sgom ston chos rjes mdzad pa'i zhi ba byang chub sems kyi bum dbang rtsal 'phreng / thems med/ phyi ltar zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ nang ltar zhi ba kun bzang rigs lngar sgrub thabs rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsang ba ltar zhi ba rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba chig dril du sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 'di'i shog ser gyi yig mkhan lha lcamanus 'byin rtsal yin zer ba snang / phyi spros bcas bum pa'i dbang khro bo rin cen them skas le'u zhe drug pa rjesakyi le'u gnyis dang zhe brgyad pa'o'i mtha' can/ khro bo rdzogs pa'i dbang mo che rig pa'i ngo sprod ces pa lha dbang chen mo'i phra thig pad 'byung bee ro tsa nas shrī'i lung bzhin lhag chad med par bris pa/ yi ge dang phyag len 'thor ba phyogs gcig tu sgom ston chos rjes bsdebs nas bkod pa'i khro bo'i bum dbang lag len gsal ba'i sgron ma mu tig 'phreng ba/ thems med/ phyi ltar khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad du sgrub pa 61 paṇa bka' bgros nas yi ger btab pa/ 'di'i 'og tu nang khro chen 'dus pa rtsal du sgrub thabs yang gsang tshig dril dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs ge cho ces pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya rdo rje sems dpa' yi ge brgya par dril te bsgrub pa bya sla tshegs chung khyad par can/ dbang rnams la dgos pa'i byin 'bebs chen mo gdod ma ka dag ma byin 'bebs 'phrin las so'i mtha' can/ byin 'bebs kyi phra thig bka' srung gter bdag gi mtha' can/(282ba)gtor dbang gi phra tig rig pa mdung tshugs su ngo sprod pa dga' rab rdo rje'i phyag bzhes/ dbang du su myul le sgrod pa'i ging bskul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i phra tig kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs ma/ ging bskul gyi yig chung zhes pa rtags dang bskul phyogs bcu dur khrod ma/ thems med/ spros med nang gi gsang dbang rin po che 'khor lo le'u bzhi pa/ de'i phra tig bla na med pa don gyi 'khor lo/ 'gor gsang sngags dbang gi ngo sprod skabs zhes pa'i gsang dbang phra thig gi lhan thabs mig tshags rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsang dbang gi gnad byang phyag rgya ma smin byed rigs gso ba'i dbang chog bdud rtsi dri med/ 'gor dga' bzhi'i bde —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shestong stsol mdzad pa'i zhes yod pa'i gsang ba dgyes bstod kyi phra tig zhan tu spros med shes rab ye shes gsang ba'i dbang padma 'bar ba ye shes brtsegs pa le'u brgyad pa dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi phra tig gsal ba'i sgron me/ 'gor til nyag gcig mtha' dbus bral zhes yod pa'i rab tu spros med rig pa'i rtsal dbang tshig dbang rin po ches ni bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi mtha' can/ gud du sbas pa bsam yas dbu rtse steng khang ka ba'i khong gseng nas brtan pa'i rab 'byams bka'i dbang gi skor la nang gses kyi rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' gtad rab 'byams rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dbang gi chu bo bzhi babs tshul gyi lo rgyus/ de'i rgyud las phyung ba yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang la brten nas phyi'i chas brgyad sprul pa'i skur bskur thabs/ bka' po ti glegs bam gyi dbang la brten nas nang gi chas brgyad longs spyod rdzogs skur (283na)bskur thabs/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang la brten nas gsang ba'i chos brgyad chos kyi skur bskur thabs/ yongs rdzogs phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dbang la brten nas dbang gi chas bcu mi 'gyur rdo rjer bskur thabs/ sku lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po lta ba spyi 'byams kyi dbang bskur thabs/ de dag gi rgyab chos su 'gor kun tu bzang po dgongs pa'i tshig 'di ltar zhes yod pa'i mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang bee ro'i glu rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang mo che glur blangs so'i mtha' can rnams/ bzhi pa/ yan lag lta bu 'phrin las gzhan don skor la/ zhi ba'i las byung yang dag don gyi 'phrin las le'u gsum pa/ khro bo'i las byang rin cen zer 'phro sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 'gor bsgral chog gi las rim ni zhes yod pa'i bsgral chog gi phra thig ma bcos lhang nger zhog gi mtha' can/ thems med/ 'gor 'dir sgrol ba'i dgos pa tshe lung dang zhes yod pa'i tshe lung khrus lung gi dgos pa slob bu shangs pa rgya tsho pas bskul ngor gter ston gyis lung nag phugs stod dge ba'i gnas su yi ger bkod pa/ thems med/ zhi khro gnyis kyi tshe sgrub 'od zer dra ba las rim bcu gnyis pa dbang dang bcas pa/ de'i lag len phra tig tshe dbang rin po che'i 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rgyud —410

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganachung le'u bzhi pa/ mtha' rten bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang bskur thabs/ thems med/ rten gsum rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gdams pa ye shes gsum ldan gyi cho ga rgyas par bstan pa/ spros pa nye bar bsdus pa/ spros med don gyi rab tu gnas pa bya tshul gsum chos sde gcig tu bzhugs pa/ 'gor rdo rje 'chang gi bka' (283ba)bzhin du zhes yod pa'i ro sreg phung po 'dul sbyang rgyud las bkol ba shes par bya'o'i mtha' can/ tshe 'das gnas 'dren gyi man ngag gnas lung chen mo thugs rje'i lcags kyu rgyal sras chos rje'i gsung bzhin rin po che bkra shis mtshan can gyis bsdebs pa gnas lung gi cha lag gshin po zas gtad kyi cho ga rim pa nyi shu pa rnams/ lnga pa dbang po lta bu blo 'phel skor ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis lo gsum la sho lo ka drug las ma zin par 'di bsgrubs pas chos sgo kun la mkhas tshul gyi lo rgyus yod pa'i 'jam dpal blo'i mun sel gyi sgrub thabs bla rdo gnad yig dang bcas pa/ drug pa don snying lta bu 'khrid kyi skor la/ sngon 'gro rigs drug dong sprugs kyi 'khrid yig ma rig mun sel sgron me/ rigs drug tu shan dbye ba'i spyod pa la bslab pa'i lag 'khrid rigs drug dong sprugs/ theg pa bcu gcig gi 'khrid yig 'od zer dra ba/ lus ngag yid gsum skye med du grol ba'i 'khrid yig gsal byed me long / lam 'khrid sems kyi rtsa ba gcod byed a ti'i 'khrid mig 'od zer dra ba le'u dgu pa/ rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yang bcud lag 'khrid cig car ba dbang po yang rab grol byed ar gtad lag 'khrid nyi ma'i snying po ma rig mig 'byed/ sku gsum gyi ngo sprod a ti'i khong snying gsal ba'i me long lag len myong bas thebasapar mdzod phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ bdun pa snying shun lta bu kha skong skor la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i bya ba'i rim pa nor bu bsam 'phel slob dpon chen pos ku su lu'i don du mdzad pa/des lo chen bee ro tsa na la gdams(284na)pa'i 'phrul gyi dpe brgyad kyi zhal gdams/ rigs chad thugs rje'i bzung ba btags grol 'khor lo'i rgyab yig phrad shog reg pa don ldan bstan pa'i sgron me gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang po yang rab kyi nyams len 'byung bzhi'i sgra la goms—411 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she par byams nas sprul sku snang rig bsre thabs kyi 'khrid yig /tshe 'dir ma grol na bar dor nyams su blang tshul bar do bzhi'i 'char tshul ngo sprod kyi gdams pa nges pa'i 'bras bu 'dod pa la legs par ston pa/ sku gsum gyi 'bras bu mngon du gtan la 'bebs pa'i thabs mchog rin cen rgyab yig ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa lnga pa nyi ma dang 'dra 'bag gal che'o'i mtha' can rnams/ 'di la ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa lnga bar gragasakyang nyer lnga nyer gcig sogs nang gses su sna tshogs snang / brgyad pa lto tshil lta bu mkha' 'gro'i skor la/ mkha' 'gro'i skor 'di rnams kyi gtog na spa gro stag kṣe yin/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i phyi sgrub man ngag gi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro thams cad gcig tu dril nas sgrub pa dngos grub spungs pa/ mkha' 'gro phag lnga nang ltar sgrub pa la bye brag tu nyams rtogs brgyad la spar ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo sku'i sgrub pa/ zas nor dngos grub spel ba rin cen mkha' 'gro ser mo yon tan gyi sgrub thabs/ lus kyi bde drod 'bar zhing bud med dbang du bsdu ba/ padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo gsung gi sgrub pa/ rten 'brel sna tshogs sgrub pa las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro nag mo thugs su sgrub pa dang lnga/ gsang ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro phag mo (284ba)dmar mo mo rkyang tshig dril du sgrub pa/ de'i las tshogs la rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba/ zas nor 'du ba/ bde drod 'phel zhing bud med 'du ba/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba/ dbang chen rta mgrin pho rkyang du sgrub pa/ de'i las tshogs la mi rtog pa skye ba/longs spyod rgyas pa/ bud med 'du ba/ dregs pa 'dul ba rigs bzhi'i las/ mkha' 'gro yab yum bsgrub pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ mo rkyang 'khor lo lnga'i gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lha rnams re re gtso bor ston pa nang sgrub kyi zhal gdams/ pho rkyang 'khor lo lnga'i lha lnga gcig dang so sor bsgrub pa'i zhal gdams/ rigs lnga khol bur bsgrub pa/ spyi'i gnad yig /rigs bzhi sgo so'i rtags tshad man ngag /'byung lnga gshed 'bebs/ srog 'khor dang sngags kyi gshed 'bebs sgrub pa'i khong snying bla rdo'i man ngag dang bcas pa gser la g.yu yig brgyad pa 'dra ba/ mkha' 'gro'i sngags kyi —412

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganalde mig mkha' 'gro ma nus pa med pa'i man ngag /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dbang chog zab mo nyi zla'i 'og na 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rnyed par dka' ba/ mkha' 'gro kun 'dus kyi zab dbang spyi dril chen mo rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ rtsa rlung bde drod chen mo mchog thun dngos grub spangs pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ lto gos kyi zhen pa gcod pa bcud len gyi nor bu rgya mtsho la nang gses kyi rlung gi bcud len/ rtsa rma 'a mo nas len/ cung zhi/ sa tshan/ bye ma/ dbang lag /'om bu/ dri chen/ utpal/ chu/ rdo/glang sna/ spang rgyan/ lce byung gi sbyor ba rnams mjug tu sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes yon tan dang bzhis bstan pa rnams/ dgu pa sor (285na)mo lta bu man ngag skor ni/ 'jig rten pa tra'i gdams pa me sgrogs mda' dpag chen dpag chung sogs kyi sbyor ba g.yin snang sgyur byed/ bcu pa snying khrag gi dngas ma lta bu 'das rjes don 'khrid mthar thug skor la/ brgyud pa gsum gyi zhal chems bstan pa'i snying po bde gshegs sras gcig mkha' 'gro'i srog snying yang tig chen mo'i skor las dgongs rgyud 'das rjes la/ rang byung gi chos tshig thams cad rang shar pa'i glegs bam sho lo ka bdun pa bstan pa kun gyi thog ma kun bzang dgongs pa'i rgyud bcangs pas dran 'chang rgya pa'i tant+ra/ sku lnga dbyer med da nga shar gyi glegs bam longs sku'i dgongs spyod sras gcig pa'i rgyud sho lo ka bzhi pa/ stong pa'i sgra ru rang byung ba sho lo ka bzhi pa su phrad gdong mar grol ba lnga ldan bu la ston cig pa/ ston pa rdo rje sems pa'i 'das rjes chos thams cad kyi gnad 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa gser gyi 'bru gcig /ston pa khye'u rnam rol gyi 'das rjes rigs drug rang grol/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i 'das rjes sangs rgyas kyi zhal chems dang por grags pa bstan pa kun gyi srog tig /ston pa 'od mi 'khrug pa'i 'das rjes yang tig srog gzer gyi rgyud thugs rje gcer grol ston pa 'jam dpal 'jig skyobs kyi 'das rjes gser gyi 'bru gcig /ston pa dpa' bo stobs ldan gyi 'das rjes sangs rgyas kyi zhal chems gnyis pa bstan pa kun gyi bu gcig bu/ ston pa drang srong khro rgyal gyi 'das rjes sangs rgyas kyi zhal chems gsum pa thugs kyi snying po 'bru gcig pa bstan pa kun gyi srog /ston pa gser 'od dam —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/pa'i 'das rjes sho lo ka (285ba)gsum pa thugs rje dran pas 'tshang rgya pa'i gdams pa/ ston pa brtse ba'i blo gros kyi 'das rjes rdo rje'i tshig drug pa/ ston pa 'od srungs bgres po'i 'das rjes de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs tshig 'khor ba dong sprugs/ ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i 'das rjes sangs rgyas kun gyi gnad thems/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'das rjes rin cen thig le/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud kyi 'das rjes la/ dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal chems tshig gsum gnad rdeg /'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi zhal chems dgongs nyams drug pa/ 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal chems gzhag thabs bzhi pa/ shrī sidhi'i zhal chems gzer bu bdun pa/ o rgyan gyi dgongs pa'i zhal chems sho lo ka bzhi pa/ snyan brgyud gyi zhal chems la/ bee ro tsa na'i zhal chems klong yangs rin cen/ e ma bzhugs stangs sogs lhug pa gnyis bcas bsdoms par srog tig gsungs pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dbang 'khrid skor la kun bzang 'khor ba rtsad gcod kyi lo rgyus dbang 'khrid dang bcas pa dran pas 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa/ rnam snang longs sku'i dgongs pa lhun grub snang ba rang grol mthong bas 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad 'das rjes kyi lo rgyus dbang don 'khrid dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa rag pas 'tshar rgya ba'i lo rgyus dbang don 'khrid dang bcas pa/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa rig pa 'tshang thog tu ngo sprod pa'i gnad gzhi snang rang grol lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ston pa 'od mi 'khrug pa'i dgongs pa thugs rje gcer grol gyi 'khrid lo rgyus dbang dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i mchog (286na)chos/ ston pa 'jam dpal 'jigs skyob kyi dgongs pa byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag drug gi mnog chos thugs rje reg grol gyi lo rgyus dbang don 'khrid dang bcas pa/ ston pa khye'u rnam rol gyi dgongs pa rigs drug rang grol gyi 'khrid gnod sbyin srin po'i mnog chos lo rgyus dbang don 'khrid dang bcas pa/ ston pa rdo rje la4 chen po/ gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan/ drang srong khro rgyal gsum gyi dgongs pa 'das rjes gsum gyi don 'khrid du grags pa klong yangs kyi 'khrid yig dngos gzhi lam zab mthar thug padma thod 'phreng dang bee ro bka' bgros te yi —4/4

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)ger btab pa/ ston pa gser 'od dam pa'i thugs 'khrid reg pas 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa/ ston pa brtse ba'i blo gros kyi 'das rjes don 'khrid 'khrul pa phugs 'ded lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ ston pa 'od srung bgres po'i 'das rjes don 'khrid lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i 'das rjes don 'khrid bstan pa kun gyi nying khu lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'das rjes don 'khrid chen mo zhes bya ba/ lo paṇa rnam gnyis kyi rjes skor gyi thems yig bstan pa rnams/bcu gcig pa lus bsrung gi go mtshon lta bu bstan srung skor la/ khros ma nag mo'i phyi sgrub lus dang 'dra ba gtso mo bzhi'i 'phrin sgrub gab pa tsitta snying gi rgya can/ sngags srung nag mo e ka ṭi'i nang sgrub spyi don gsum gyis bstan pa don snod gsang ba'i yang gsang dam pa/ bka' srung gza' bdud nag po'i phyi sgrub lo nad ser ba'i cog brdung las byang dang bcas pa/ bka' srung gza'i gsang sgrub bsnyen sgrub (286ba〉pas sbyor gsum gyis bstan pa dngar gsum la sogs pa mchod pa shis so'i mtha' can/ gza' bdud gsang sgrub me rlung 'khyil ba zhes pa sku bzheng thabs las sbyor dang bcasagacig gis sgo 'byed shog gi mtha' can/ dam can rdo rje legs pa thig le rtsa ser skya rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi phyi sgrub chen mo gnad yig gsol kha dang bcas pa ngo bo gcig pa so sor bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ dam can rdo rje legs pa'i nang sgrub 'di ltar ma 'chun na nyams su blang ba/ dam can badzra swā dma'i gsang ba yang dag sgrub pa zhal chems dang bcas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams kyi dbang lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa gsum las/ dang po rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku rnam par snang mdzad/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje semasadapa'/ gnyis pa 'od mi 'khrug pa/ gsum pa 'jam dpal 'jigs skyob/ bzhi pa gzhen nu rnam rol/ lnga pa rdo rje la4 chen/ drug pa gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan/ bdun pa drang srong khro rgyal/brgyad pa gser 'od dam pa/ dgu pa brtse ba'i blo gros/ bcu pa 'od srung bgres po/ bcu gcig pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po/ bcu gnyis pa shākya thub pa/ gnyis pa rigs 'dzin brda brgyud ni/ rigs —4/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ni/'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bzang po/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi ma'ang zer/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ gsum pa gang zag snyan brgyud ni/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ rgyal ba'i sras po rdo rje gling pa/ thugs sras bkra shis 'byung gnas/ rtogs ldan chos dbyings rang grol/(287na tshungs med chos rje rnam gsum/ kun mkhyen bsod nams mtshan can/ 'gro mgon bde gshegs mched gnyis/ chos rje 'dzam gling gragasapa/ sras pad ma grags pa/ dmi lung rig rgya mtsho/ bum thang o rgyan chos gling pa ga rma gar dbang bzang po/ sprul sku gar dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ grub pa mchog brnyes chos dbang lhun grub/ rigasa'adzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub/ rdor gling sprul sku 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rgyal ba'i sras po rdo rje gling pas spa gro stag tshang brag nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po'i skor ni/ rang gter las/ de dus rdo rje drag po rtsal o rgyan nga yi sgrub thabs 'di su 'chang 'dzin pa nga rang dngos: de la bar gcod ga la tshugs rdo rje pha lam ral gri 'dra dpal ri 'od kyi rtse mo nas de la g.yengs pa med par skyob ces thugs sgrub drag po'i chos skor kun gyi nang nas shin tu zab pa byin rlabs nus ldan gyi skor la thog mar dbang chog rdo rje spyi blugs kyi steng nas/ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas bum pa la brten nas drag po thod 'phreng rtsal gyi dbang bzhi/ thod pa bdud rtsis sprul sku'i dbang / rdor dril gyis longs sku rigs lnga/ 'jam dpal gyis chos skor kun gyi sgo 'byed pa/ rta mgrin gyis sde brgyad zil gnon/ phyag rdor gyis klu dang sabadag gza' rnams zil gnon/ yakṣa me dbal gyis dregs pa tshar gcod pa/ mkha' lding rigasalngas sna tshogs 'phrin las bsgrub pa rnams kyi dbang / 'chi med tshe dbang / bgrang 'phreng dang lha skus bskyed rim sngags dbang cang te bhanta sa snang ba dbang du bsdud (287bcung mkha' 'gro srog rten/dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang dang bcas pa smin rgyas su mnos nas/ lung la/ lo rgyus/ spyi sgrub/ sgosasgrub/ kun la gces pa/ las tshogs/ dka' srung gi skor dang drug /dang po ni/ gu ru'i lo rgyus chen —4/6

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ rtoganamo zhes pa padma drag po rtsal gyi thugs sgrub la lo rgyus sgrub pa las tshogs gsum gyis phye ba'i o rgyan chen pos bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang 'grub par mdzad nas bod kyi gnas chen ri brag rnams byin gyi brlabs tshul dang khyad par dpe har btul ba'i lo rgyus 'bras mo ljongs kyi brag dkar bkra shis sdings su lo tsā ba bee ro tsa na dang jo mo la thugs sgrub drag po thugs kyi sgrub pa gnang zhing gter du sbas tshul bcas bstan pa snying stobs can dang phrad par shog gi mtha' can/ gnyis pa spyi sgrub la/phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bla ma zhi ba la mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis bskor ba/ nang sgrub nyi zla ga'u gu ru drag po thod 'phreng rtsal la yum bde chen dzñā na 'khril ba/ gsang ba dril sgrub rtsa ba'i sgrub pa drag dmar rigs bdag gsum brtsegs lus dkyil gyi lha 'jam dpal/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ me dpal/khyung rigs lnga/ bsrung 'khor sngags 'phreng can bstan pa/ yang gsang thugs bcud dang 'brel ba bla ma drag po rtsal spyan mang hūṃ gi sgrub pa rnams/ gsum pa sgo sgrub la/ tshe dpag med gu ru tshe'i sgrub/'jam dpal sku sgrub shes rab phyogs med 'bar ba/ rta mgrin dbang chen gsum sgrub dpe har dam sri dregs pa brgyal 'bros dngas pa/ phyag rdor thugs sgrub mchog thun dngos grub thob pa/ me dbal sgrub pa sde brgyad ma rungs gzir ba/ drag po khyung lnga'i sgrub pa mdzes (288na)thu lum du song ba yang bsos pa/ lcags sdig nag po'i sgrub pa gnod byed gtan nas brlag pa/ de'i 'khor lo'i bris yig /them med/ bstod pa chos nyid skye med ma rnams/ thems med/ bzhi pa kun la gces pa la/ brda rtagasagasal ba'i lde mig ces pa bla ma'i rtags/ mkha' 'gro'i rtags/ spyi'i bzang rtags ngan rtags gnyen po dang bcas ston pa gu ru drag po rtsal gyi dbang mo che rdo rje spyi blugs/ bla ma drag po'i las gzhud don gsum ma ma rig mun sel gang mos su bkol chog pa'i mtha' can rnams/ lnga pa las tshogs la/dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg /gsum pa dbang gi sbyin sreg /bzhi pa drag po'i me mchod/ lnga pa me hom rang 'bar/ drug pa chom rkun jag pa 'a mi pa ba/ bdun pa las rgya rigasam 'gugs pa/ brgyad pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ dgu pa rgyal bsen srog 'khor/ bcu pa srid pa'i —417—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonerigs brgyud spel ba/ bcu gcig pa shegs chen shi sa bstan pa/ bcu gnyis pa sde brgyad spyi bsrung /bcu gsum pa rbod gtong bzlog 'khor/ bcu bzhi pa dam sri rgyal bsen gsod pa/ bco lnga pa sri'u gso ba/ bcu drug pa tsi tsi dzwa la gsob/ bcu bdun pa chu 'khyags ser ba bsrung ba/ bco brgyad pa char 'bebs/ bcu dgu pa zas nor bsgrub pa/ nyi shu pa gtor mas dgra bgegs la ba/ nyer gcig pa dgra bo klu la gtod pa/ nyer gnyis pa chu 'khyags ser ba 'bebs pa/ nyer gsum pa drag po thog gis dgra gsod/ nyer bzhi pa kun gyi sngon 'gro chab gtor/ nyer lnga pa byab gtor nad pa gsob/nyer drug pa drag po mtha' 'dul sbyor ba/ nyer bdun pa tshe'i (288ba)rigs 'dzin sgrub pa/ nyer brgyad pa rang dang lha'i dgra grogs brtsi pa/ nyer dgu pa zho chang bsrung ba rnams/ drug pa bka' bsrung skor la/ nang gses kyi yab bka' srung dung gi thor tshugs/ sras rje legs rtsal/ yum tsan ti dmar mo gsum gyi bca' gzhi'i bsnyen sgrub/ gnad 'bebs/ gso ba/ bskul dang bcas pa/drag sgrub thems kyi dkar chag rnams/ de yang thems byang la/ dum bu bzhi bcu zhe drug gis drag po sgrub pa'i bskor rnams tshang: de bas mang bar gyur na yang: o rgyan thugs sgrub bka' 'chal zhing :de bas nyung bar gyur na yang : o rgyan thugs sgrub tshang ba min zhes pa ltar gong gi thems med gnyis ma gtogs pa'i grangs 'grig cing : las tshogs kyi go rim thems byang dang mi mthun pa 'ga' re 'dug cing srid pa'i rigs brgyud spel ba dang gtor mas dgra gsad pa gnyis thems yig na mi 'dug pa chad lhag gi skyon zhig byung ngam snyam pas las tshogs le'u nyer dgu pa 'dir ni chos sde'i bzhugs tshul ltar bkod pa yin no/ /de ltar dbang lung yongs rdzogs ba pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ ngas sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa/ 'gro mgon chos dbyings rang grol/ sprul sku bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ lho brag bsam grub dgon pa ba mtshungs med bo dhi bha dra/ 'di la drag pho zhal gzig byung ba'i gtso bo'i zhal nas khyod kyi yi dam lha nga yin/rdo rje gling pa'i lug su bsgrub bar gyi/ mi rabs lnga 'am bdun gyi bar la khrom —4/8

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadabang ba dang 'gro la gyis zhes gnang stsal to/ /de sras dpal ldan byang chub/ de sras 'gro ba'i mgon po/ de sras ngag dbang (289na)bstan 'dzin/ gter ston bde chen gling pa'i sprul sku ga rma chos dbang rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rgyal sras rdo rje gling pas sham po gangs sman shel phug nas spyan drangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i yi ge nyer gcig ces pa bzlog bsrung gi mthar thug pa'i za yig la/ rang bsrung ba 'gor āoṃ mjug tu na nya yod pa'i gling bdun/gzhan gyi nus pa 'joms pa 'gor tha mjug na ra lwa yod pa gling bdun/ sngags kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba 'gor ba mjug na nya yod pa'i gling bdun/ phan yon rdzas za tshul dang bcas bstan pa mchog tu bsngags pa'i mtha' can/ yang rdo rje gling pas gsal rje brag nas spyan drangs pa'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi za yig ces pa/ sku gsang ba'i las rdo rje bde ldan ma 'gor āoṃ mthar tha tha yod pa'i gling bdun/ gsung gi gsang ba'i las byed 'gor a mthar gyu gcig yod pa'i gling bdun ma/ thugs rje gsang ba'i las 'grub 'gor hūṃ mthar gar yod pa'i gling bdun ma phan yon rdzas sngags ting 'dzin dang bcas pa skal ldan gyi spyod yul gyi mtha' can/ rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma'i bsrung ba nyi zla go cha/ bzlog pa me'i spu gri/ gsad pa las kyi sham bu zhes pa lha sgom sngags bzlas med pa/ bsgrub mi dgos pa'i za yig la mkha' 'gro'i yi ge 'bru drug gi 'og tu 'gor dwa dang mjug na sgril yod pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ padma thod 'phreng /mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston dri med badzra nas rim par/ rje nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhone nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos (2yob)dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston rdo rje gling pas kong po dgye bo rong klu bdud kha gnon gyi mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa'i za yig nor bu'i bang mdzod ces pa la tshe ring bsod nams rgyas shing zas nor longs spyod dgos 'dod 'grub pa/ shes rab me ltar 'bar ba/ rtsod pa kun las rgyal ba/ 'gro ba dbang du 'du ba/ gtad mnan byad kyis mi tshugs pa/ sa bdag gi nad las thar ba/ gza' nad las grol ba/—419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shengag bcings ngag gnon bsrung ba/ phul kha zor kha sogs mthu gtad bzlog pa/ snying gzer spyo 'bog sel ba/ 'brum pa lhog pa rgyu gzer sogs 'go nad bsrung ba/ rmi lam ngan pa bsrung ba/ mtshon bsrung ba/ jag 'ching sgrib shing gnyan sar 'gro ba la tshe sgog gi bar gcod sel ba/ bud med la bu 'byung ba/ chung sri dang 'khru skyug gdon rims bsrung ba/ nyams grib bar gcod bsrung ba/ bshal skyugs mgo 'khor gyis 'chi ba/ ga byed gsum po dpe rgyun la bar 'dir 'dug pa shog ser pa de ka yod dam 'bebasadus gong 'og lkogs pa yin dpyad do/ /bud med mdze mo dang zha bor 'gyur ba/ mtshon gyis 'chi ba dang ltas pha sna tshogs 'ong ba/ de gsum rang la mi ldog pa rdzas la brten pa/ mna' bsrung ba/ rtsod pa dang rgyan las rgyal ba/ gnyan gyi grong khyer 'joms pa/ mi gtsang grib bsrung / shu skom dang sha khra bal ldag me dbal bsrung ba/ lag g.yang rgyal zhing longs spyod sris rme ba ste za yig nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'go mjug tu phan yon che brjod dang bcas pa/ yang rgyal sras rdo rje gling pas gdan drangs pa'i mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i za yig lam bu yan lag dang gsum/ ba rib rgya gar nas bsgyur ba 'di dang 'dra yo zhig yod par (290na〉〉ga /dang po ma la/ sku'i za yig 'gor āoṃ mtha' gyu ā yod pa'i gling lnga/ gsung gi 'gor a mthar nga nā yod pa'i gling drug /thugs kyi 'gor hūṃ mthar ha rā yod pa'i gling lnga/ gnyis pa bu yig la/ lus ngag yid gsum bde legs su bskyed pa 'gor pho mthar nya kha yod pa'i gling bdun/bde gshegs kun gyis khur zhing byin gyis brlab pa 'gor āoṃ mthar a hūṃ yod pa gling bdun/ snyan grags rgyas pa/ lus stobs bskyed pa/ longs spyod rgyas pa/ tshe ring ba/ phyug pa/ bza' btung zhor la 'byung ba 'bul ster mang bas/ rgyu nor mi zad pa/ 'khrug rtsod las rgyal ba/ tshong rgyal ba/ rkus na thob pa/ 'byung ba lnga'i lus stobs bskyed pa rnams mkha' 'gro'i yig rgod 'bru re ma/ gsum pa yan lag la/ nad zhi ba/ gdon zhi ba/ gza' skar dus tshod phyogs ngan bdud gcod dgra byang rnams bzlog pa/ dgra byang phung bsad/ zhan byung thor bu dang lnga/ dang po la/ lusang ga yid gsum gyi nad zhi ba 'gor bhi mjug pā yod pa'i gling bdun/ sgo gsum gyi nad bzlog pa 'gor na mthar dza yod —420

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)brtsegs ma/ sgo gsum gyi nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba/ spyo 'bog rlung nad zhi ba/ grang rlung zhi ba/ lus kyi nad kun zhi ba/ 'dzer pa zhi ba/ mig nad bsrung ba rnams yig rgod/ dug bsrung 'gor nga mthar ba nga yod pa gling gsum/ dug rigs bsrung ba yig rgod/ ya ma zhi ba 'gor a mthar hā 'a yod pa gling bzhi/ gnyis pa gdon zhi ba la/ lus gdon zhi ba sha a ṣa 'phreng bris kyi 'og ma nas nā'i bar brtsegs shing pha'i g.yas g.yon du ṭa ta yod pa/ ngag 'don zhi ba 'phred bris ga da ga'i 'og tu ha nas ba'i bar brtsegs ma ra'i g.yas g.yon du (290ba)tsha nga'i g.yas g.yon du ma yod pa/ yid gdon zhi ba 'phreng bris ma sa ma'i 'og tu la nas tha'i bar brtsegs ma dza'i g.yas g.yon du dza/ sa'i g.yas g.yon du ha yod pa/ gdon rigs kun zhi ba 'gor ka mthar n+ya yod pa brtsegs ma/ yang 'gor ba 'thar mya yod pa brtsegs ma/ dregs pa bco brgyad/ lha 'dre thams cad/ khyim du 'dre gdon zhi ba yig rgod/ gza' yab kyi gnod pa zhi ba 'bru gsum/ klu'i gnod pa dang mdze brgyud zhi ba yig rgod/ klu nad zhi ba 'gor ma mthar a yod pa gling lnga/ yang 'gor nga mthar a yod pa'i gling lnga/rgyal po kha bsgyur yig rgod/ gzhan du skrod pa 'gor ka mthar pha yod pa 'phreng gnyis ma/ bsrung ba 'gor ba mthar la yod pa 'phreng gcig /kha 'ching ba yig rgod srog rtsa gcod pa 'go mjug tu ba nyis brtsegs yod pa 'phreng gshig /rgyal po thams cad kyi snying 'gas pa tsheg bar so gcig ma/ 'dre mo yul 'bud dam 'dogs yig rgod/ de'i gnod pa zhi ba 'gor āoṃ mthar ma yod brtsegs ma/ 'dre mo dam 'dogs 'gor ma mthar dza yod brtsegs pa/ rgyal bsen bsrung ba 'gor kha mjug na sha yod pa gling gnyis/ 'dre dam 'dogs 'gor tha mjug na sha yod brtsegs pa/ the'u brang dam 'dogasadang / bdud zhi ba yig rgod/ bdud dam 'dogs 'gor āoṃ mthar sha yod pa tsheg bar bzhi pa/ the'u brang srog 'bral 'gor tho mthar n+ya yod brtsegs pa / bdud dam 'dogs dang / gnyan dam 'dogs yig rgod/ gnyan srog 'brel 'gor (྅sgo thar hu yod brtsegs pa/ sa bdag /btsan/ 'dre gnon/gson 'dre pho mo/ gshin 'dre pho mo/ rgan sri/ gzhen sri/ chung sri rnams kyi gnod pa zhi ba yig rgod/—421—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she(291na)gsum pa gza' skar dus tshod phyogs ngan bdud gcod dgra byad rnams bzlog pa la/gza' ngan/ dus tshodi tshes grangasang na pa/ gsang na/ bdud gcod/ 'dre lnga/ ltasang na rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog pa yig rgod/ nyams grib bsrung ba 'gor kha mthar hā yod brtsegs ma/ ltas ngan bzlog pa 'gor ko mthar na yod brtsegs ma/ chung sri bsrung ba a ka ma 'phreng bris kyi 'og tu la nas brtsegs mthar yig rgod yod pa/ grib dang gdon/ mi shis pa/ rmi lam ngan pa/ thog lab chol/sang langs/ god kha/ dgra/ rkun ma/ mang bsdebs bsam sbyor drag po/ nad rims/ mi kha khram kha kha smras/ mna'i nyes pa rnams bzlog pa yig rgod/ sman dpyad kyi gnod pa bzlog pa 'gor ka mthar la yod pa gling gnyis/ mdze brgyud/ pho 'dre/ mo 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog pa yig rgod rnams/ bzhi pa dgra byad phung gsad la/ ngag byad dbang du 'dus nas phung zhing srog dang dbral ba 'gor tha mthar ra na yod pa'i gling bdun/ nus pa zad nas ga dang dbral ba 'gor st+woṃ mthar ba gsum yod pa gling drug /rang srog bcas nas phung zhing brlag pa 'gor māoṃ mthar yig rgod yod pa brtsegs ma'i tha la 'go bstan pa'i 'gor a dang mthar brda yig yod pa 'phrong brtsegs/ 'brug cing phung nas srog dang dbral ba 'gor nya mthar tha ta yod pa'i gling bdun/ 'gor chog par bzlog 'gor kha mthar pa yod 'phreng gnyis/ dgra byad thams cad bzlog pa yig rgod/ 'dzul chog phar bzlog chog par bzhi pa/'dzul chog dang 'byed phral phar bzlog yig rgod/ dgra byad thams cad phung gsad byed pa (291ba)'gor pho mthar ma be yod pa gling bdun/ bskrad pa'i rigs phar bzlog pa/ sbyor ba ngan pas mi tshugs pa/ mna' gtad phar bzlog gsum yig rbod/ ban bon sngags gsum gyi rdzas sngags 'khor lo phar bzlog 'gor pa mthar sha yod pa brtsegs ma/ mu stegs kyi rdzas sngags 'khor lo phar bzlog 'gor āoṃ mthar gra ba yod pa gling lnga/ rdzas ngan gyis mi tshugs pa 'gor ༅ mthar dza yod pa gling lnga/dgra byad thams cad 'chi ba 'gor st+woṃ mthar phaṭa yod brtsegs ma mtha' gnyis gter tsheg gis bskor ba rnams/ lnga pa thor bu la/ rang nyid bsrung ba 'gor āoṃ mthar a hūṃ yod pa gling bdun pa/—422

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gzhan gyi nus pa bshig pa 'gor tha mthar da la yod pa gling bdun/ sngags kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba 'gor pha mthar ra nā yod pa gling bdun/ shes rab bskyed pa/ srid bur bsgyur ba/ sbrum nas zla gnyis tshun la bu skye ba bsam pa 'grub pa rnams yig rgod/ nyin gnyid ma log na nyin re'i mtshon bsrung / khyi bsrung 'gor sa mthar pa yod 'phreng gnyis/ mtshon bsrung āoṃ drug ma gling drug las med pa/ mtshon spyi dang khyad par rdo rus shing smyug thub pa 'gor st+woṃ mthar da hūṃ yod pa'i gling hra dgu ma 'di thad 'gor ra mthar dzu yod 'phreng bris/ sde brgyad yab 'gor thi mthar ba yod pa'i gling bdun/ yum 'gor da mthar sa yod 'phreng gnyis/ yab yum 'gor the mthar sha yod pa'i gling bdun/ klu lasabyed 'gor ma mthar ha sa yod pa'i gling drug rnams grib bsrung ba 'bru bzhi bzhi sgrom du bris pa/grib rigs kun bsrung ba 'gor de mthar tha ra yod pa 'phreng bris/ za 'phrug zhi ba 'gor ka mthar ba ba yod pa (292na tsher phreng bris/ so bsrung 'gor so mthar sod yod pa 'phreng bris/ mkhal rtsa grang nad zhi ba 'gor āoṃ mthar ha yod brtsegs pa/ mi phyugs kyi chu 'gags zhi ba 'gor āoṃ mthar ha yod pa 'phreng gnyis ma/ gnyan lhog zhi ba ga bzhi ma/ mi kha gtam ngan bsrung ba 'gor a mthar la yod 'phreng gnyis/ dmar bshal bsrung ba 'gor ka mthar phaṭa yod pa brtsegs ma/ phan yon rdzas ma bu yan lag gi grangs rab gnas bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa/ 'gro mgon sa dbyings rang grol nas rim par/ zur chen lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhon nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa'i rtsa gsum bkang gso ma bcos sa bral ma/ gza'i dug dbyung gis dbang bskur shin tu zab pa lag len padmas sbyar ro'i mtha' can/ gter ston gyi phyag len ma'i gza'i gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel gyi yi ge rnams ba pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan sa kyi rgyal po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston dri med badzra nas rim par/ rigs—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'adzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis bas rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston pad ma kun skyong gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gis skor/padma kun skyong gling pa ni/ thang yig las/ sna bo la khar so pa re mos byed mchod rten dkar por sbas pa'i gter kha ni mi gzhag (292ba)gdon pa'i ltas de bstan nas sing gter ston kun skyong gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes dang / rang gter las/ bee ro khyod kyi sprul pa ni chu khams bya'am khyi lo pa yab med yum bral sngags 'chang rigs o rgyan ming 'dzin shes rab can ma nges spyod pa 'gro ba 'dul gnas med rlung bzhin kun tu rgyu mon bal rtse lnga phyogs su 'da' thugs gter dgongs gter mang zhig 'byed ces pa ltar lo chen bee ro'i rnam sprul rgyal ba'i sras rdo rje gling pa'i sku skye padma kun skyong gling pas mi tshor rdo rje skye brag nas khro las grub pa'i gter sgrom rā hu la'i gzugs mda' gang pa spyan drangs pa'i thugs ka nas byon pa'i theg dgu'i yang rtse rdor sems snying thig ni/ rang gter las/ rgyud mchog 'di nyid la brten nas spros med mya ga 'das na du sprosapa'i tshig mchog kun bsdus nas nyams len gnad kyi gdams pa brtsams 'di nyid bee ro khyod la gtad: da lta spel ba'i gnas med de phyi ma snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus khyod kyi sprul pa shes rab can skal ldan gcig gi don du sped ces snying tig bcu gsum gyi don btus pa dga' rab rdo rjes o rgyan chen po la gnang ba'i rdzogs pa chen po tshig nyung don rgyas gnad kyi gdams skor la/ thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du la jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i spros bcas bum dbang lus la bskur ba/sa med gsang dbang ngag la bskur ba/ shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes sems la bskur ba/—424

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganarab tu spros med rig pa rtsal dbang bar snang la bskur ba rnams smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rdo rje skye brag dang bsam yas kyi gter byung / thems med/ sprul sku (293na)kun skyong gling pa'i lung bstan gsang yig le'u bcu gsum ma/ thems med/ bod kyi bde sdug dus rtag lung bstan padma dran par gyis kyi mtha' can/ thems med/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying thig gi rgyud theg pa kun gyi yang bcud snying gi thig le le'u bcu gsum pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ khungs btsun yid ches bskyed pa rgyal ba dngas brgyud/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud/ thugs rje byin rlabs brgyud pa/mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa/ las go gter brgyud de brgyud pa drug ldan rdo rje semasadapa'i snying thig gi lo rgyus o rgyan thugs sras dngos la sprod pa'i mtha' can/ mnyam med chos legs mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/skal ldan smin par byed pa'i a ti'i yang rtse theg pa'i yang bcud dbang zhes pa spros bcas/spros med/ shin tu sa med/ rab tu sa med/ dam tshig /thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyesadamigs rnams na pa snying thig dbang bzhi'i rim pa gas so'i mtha' can/ thems med/ rdor semasasnying tig nyams su len thabs zhes pa sngon 'gro'i skor phyogs gcig tu gsal bar bsgrigs pa/'phyug med lam la 'dzud pa 'khrid chog 'khor ba dong sprug gi sngon 'gro'i gnad nyams su blang pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ grol byed 'khor ba dong sprug gi dngos gzhi'i gnad rnams nyams su blang pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rdzas kyi rtags tshad 'bras bu dang bcas na pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ byin rlabs 'jug byed rtsa gsum dril sgrub rgyud nas phyung ba las 'phro can la sprod pa'i mtha' can/ tshogs gsog bar gcod sel ba rtsa gsum las byang sngon 'gro dngos (293ba)gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa don gyi gsal 'debs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ las byang chog bsgrigs ma 'gor nga ni ye nas rdo rje sems dang mjug tu slar yang skye med gling du bsdu zhes yod pa/ thems med/ tsho gos ma da/ rigasachad thugs rjes gzung ba 'da' kha 'chi drod rang grol gnad kyi yi ge gtags grol reg pa don ldan —423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shephrad shog gi mtha' can/ rang bzhin skye gnas bar do/ 'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do/ chos nyid 'od gsal bar do/ srid pa las kyi bar do rnams ston pa bar do gnad kyi gdams pa/ bka' srung gza'i gsang sgrub la nang gses kyi bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ rtags/ las ra/ dam tshig /'phrin las bskul ba gza' mchog chen mo ma/ gtor bsngo/ gza' nad gso ba'i bu mchog dang bcas pa/ gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i bka' srung gza'i gtor bsngo ba bde legs kun 'byung / lhag chad the tshom sel ba 'dzom yig chos bdag lung bstan dang bcas bstan pa ste dngos bstan 'dzom yig tu gsal ba chos bcu gnyis dang thems med kha skong chog bsgrigs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo li bee ro tsa na/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa/ thugs sras nyi zla bzang po/ skyes ma ga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub chos legs mtshan can/ rgyal srasachas dbang rgyal mtshan/ gu ru nam mkha' rdo rje/ rgod phrug snyan brgyud ras pa/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/rigs 'dzin 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gzhon nu don grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang (294na)grol/ des bdag za hor bande gang shar rang grol la bka' drin du stsal to/ /padma kun skyong gling pas gnas ma ga dpal gyi za phu lung gi mgon po'i bla mtsho nag mthing ma'i dbus pha bong rus sbal khog pa nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje 'joms byed thog mtha' nag po rab tu khros pa'i rgyal po'i gshor thod pa brdabs chog sbu gri reg chod kyi skor la/ lha dang lha min gyi rtsod pa gas rgyus phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gshor spu gri reg chod kyi 'khor lo 'dri ba sogs gdams skor das gzhi ri gzar gyi rbab dang 'dra ba/ bdag srung ling ga'i zhal gdams yig chung / rab gnas za yig gi yig chung / pho 'khor mo 'khor gyi dpe ris/ ling ga /gri/ phur ba/ thog med/ thod pa/ rgya gram rnams kyi dpe ris dang bcas legs par mas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ sprul sku —426

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnakun skyong gling pa/ brag mi ra phu rtsa/ sngags 'chang kyu kha spyod pa/ drung pa tsha bo/ bla ma a'o sangs rgyas/dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ gtsang pa sngags 'chang dgra phung nag po/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma/ rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin/ dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa/ dpal ri slob dpon bsod nams rin cen/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /gter ston kun skyong gling pas bsam yas mchod rten dkar po nas gdan drangs pa'i nag po bka' bzlog thugs kyi reg chod rbod gtong kha 'ching 'khor lo yang bzlog lcags kyi spu gri zhes pa gnubs (294bskom mkha'i snying pos phyon chen po la gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i maṇḍal phul nas zhus/ de la gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gser ba men gyi rwa gang phul te zhus pa'i rgya gar mkhas pa mi lnga'i yang bcud zab mo'i lung / 'khor lo 'dri ba'i zhal shes bcas mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ na sangs rgyas gnyis pa/gnubs nam mkha' snying po/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston kun skyong gling ba/ srasanyi zla bzang po/ gu ru nam mkha' don grub/ sngags 'chang bde legs rgyal mtshan/ mdongs ston chos rgyal bsod nams/ yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/ gu ru nam mkha' rdo rje/ rgod phrug snyan brgyud ras pa/ mthu ldan lhun grub rdo rje/
