de sras gzhon nu don grub/ de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma sa dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor sngags na gyi bsrung bzlog gi go char gdams so/ /sprul sku kun skyong gling pa'i gter byon ru tra rlag par byed pa'i thabs rgya nag stong gsum dkrug pa zhing skyong gi las tshogs mi hreng nag po'i lung phyag len zhal shes bcas ba pa'i rgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang bdag /padma thod 'phreng / bee ro tsa na/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa/ thugs sras kyi nyi zla bzang po/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos legs mtshan can/ chos dbang rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rdo rje/ sde pa yug pa nor bu dbang rgyal/ de sras mi 'gyur rdo rje/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shephyug /zur gzhen nu don grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na gu ru nam mkha' rdo rje nas/ rgod phrug snyan rgyud (295na)ras pa/ pha rdzo lhun grub rdo rje yab sras man gong bzhin no/ /gter ston rin cen gling pa ni/ rang gter las/ gter 'di dbang ba'i las can skyes bu de da lta skyon nga yi 'khor gyi mchog: rgya gar mkhas pa shes rab 'byung gnas 'di skye ba lnga yi mtha' ma rdo bod mtshams tha mal 'gro ba 'dren phyir mi lus len gzugs bzang skyes mtha'i byang chub sems pa che de nas tshe 'phos phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags tshe yi mjug la dbang po gang rung 'grib skye ba mi len bde ba can du spyod ces dang / o rgyan nga yi thugs sras ratna'i mtshan: thos bsam 'dzin pa rkyang ni don ldan 'gyur sprul pa'i sras ni mtsho skyes me tog 'dra skal ldan bu slob bung ba rtsi 'tshol 'dra nyams grib dam sel dus min sad dang 'dra mkha' 'gro'i gdan 'dren dbang chen snag rgyug 'dra log lta can rnams rlung nag 'tshub ma 'dra: de phyir 'brel tshad 'phrin las rdzogasabya'i don gsol ba gang btab de yis don kun 'grub de la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid yon tan rnams yi ger bkod pas mi lang o rgyan sras rin cen gling pa zhes su grags pa yi las can skyes bu de dang 'di phrad shog ces lung bstan pa'i o rgyan thugs sprul lha sras skye ba lnga mthar sku 'brungs pa gter ston rin cen gling pas rgya gar gyi pha bong klu bdud rus sbal nag po'i sto ba nas spyan drangs pa'i lta ba'i yang rtse/ sgom pa'i rgyal po/ spyod pa'i nying khu/ dam tshig gi rtsab/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug dam chos rdzogs pa chen po chig chod kun grol zhes pa yo ga rnam gsum las/ a ti/ de la rgyud lung man ngag gsum las man ngag /de la sems(295ba 〉 klong gnad gsum las gnad sde/de la phyi nang gsang ba bla med yang gsang lnga las yang gsang / de la thig le dang yang bcud las yang bcud snying gi nor bu'i skor la/ padma 'dab brgyad 'ja' ris/ bum pa dang tsho gos 'khor la brten nas spros bcas snang ba'i brda dbang / me long 'ja' shel rma bya'i mdongs la brten nas spros med —428

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganastong pa'i brda dbang / ting 'dzin kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la brten nas gnyis med rang grol gyi brda dbang / chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rang grol lhun grub kyi brda dbang rnams smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab brten lung la/ gang zag yid ches bskyed pa khog dbub stong thun man ngag ces pa rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud kyi lo rgyus/ rtsa ba don gyi bshad pa/ theg pa rim dgu'i 'byung lugs/ rdzogs chen dgos ched don gyi bshad thabs/ nyams su blang ba'i bshad thabs/ che ba don gyi bshad thabs rnams ston pa bde ba chen por 'tshang rgya par shog gi mtha' can/ spyi khyad rtsa ba rdzogs pa chen po tshig chod kun grol zhes pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa o rgyan gyi skad las bod skad du rang bsgyur thugs kyi sras dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ chos kyi gnad tshang ston pa man ngag thems byang zhes pa spyi thems sgos thems phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dus tshod gnang bkag ston pa gter ston lung bstan chos spel ba'i dus rtag /snod brtag pa/ gtad rgya dang bcas pa 'gro don rdzogs par shog gi mtha' can/ mi rtag pa/ byams snying rje/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa bzhi'i sgo nas thun mong sngon 'gro'i man ngag phrad shog gi (296na〉5tha' can/ byin rlabs brdas smin par byed pa spros bcas snang ba/ spros med stong pa/gnyis med rang grol/ chos nyid lhun grub bzhi'i brda dbang gi yi ge zhag bdun nas chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba'i man ngag dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa tsitta ra bstim pa'i mtha' can/ chos nyid sngon du rtogs pa'i thabs rigs pa mngon sum gyi rang ngor rang thog tu sprod pa/ mngon sum nyams myong gis thag gcig thog tu gcod pa/ nyams myong tshad 'bebs kyi rtsal drod thog tu sbyang ba/ tshad zad sar 'byol bas sku gsum lhun grub tu ngo sprod pa rnams ston pa'i gsang chen gnad kyi don 'khrid shrī si lhas mdzad pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dang por 'khrul lugs/ bar du rtogs lugs/ mthar grol lugs gsum ston pa'i brda don snying thig gsang ba'i ngo sprod dam gsang skor snying thig phrad shog gi mtha' can/ tha mal pa thabs kyis 'khrid par byed pa las bzang ngan med par 'gro ba'i tshig —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne'akhrid gnad kyi sgron me phrad shog gi mtha' can/ nyams len mtha' ru 'don pa rtsal sbyong rjes kyi man ngag gang zag rab 'bring tha ma dang tha ma'i tha ma 'tshang rgya lugs ston pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/'bras bu 'byin pa'i dus tshod nges par ston pa lam gyi rtags tshad shrī sidha sa o rgyan la gtad pa bka' srung la gnyer gtad kyi mtha' can/ rtsol med sangs rgyas lag bcangs a ti gsang ba'i sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rtags grol gsang rgya gtad do'i mtha' can/ thun mong lam gyi cha rkyen dug lnga rang grol lam 'khyer phrad shog mtha' can rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje 'cha 0 / sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/rigs 'dzan shrī (296ba〉sedha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras btsan po/ me ban gter ston rin cen gling pa/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal ba/ chos rje bde chen lhun grub/ rtogs ldan nyi ma'i mtshan/ rje btsun surya tsand+ra/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas 'od zer/ 'brul zhig ting 'dzin 'od/ rje bas sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ bye tshang pa rin cen dpal 'byor/ rigasa'adzin dpal ldan grags pa/ rgyal dbang sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub mdze gu sa rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / khyab bdag nyang ston blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /chos rgyal rin cen gling pas 'bring thang ko ro brag dkar nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru drag dmar gyi ngas bris kyi dkyil 'khor du la jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sku/ bdud rtsi/ me long / bum pa la brten pa'i rtsa ba'i dbang / phyag rdor/ 'jam dpal/ rta mgrin/ me dbal gyi dbang / mtha' rten dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston rin cen gling pa/ mkhasagrub byang 'dzin pa/ rje dkon cog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub bsod nams bzang po/ dpang ston chosakyi rgyal po/ dpang ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpang ston blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ne ring mkhan chen mtsho skyes rdo rje/ sprul sku shākya bzang po/ mchog sprul leg ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rje —430

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam gsum pa/ rtog)gshon nu stobs ldan/ skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/ rang grol klu sgrub dbang po/ zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje (297na)des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /chos rgyal rin cen gling pas 'brin thang ko ro chos 'byung brag nas gdan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal khyab bdag nā ga rakṣa'i chosaskor la chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsan yig na pha bong rus sbal nag po nas chen po bzhi'i nang tshan zhi khro bde ba chen po'i bka' bsrung klu bdud kyi skor zer go 'dug pas gter gnas la dpyad do/ /smin byed sku gsung thugs kyi byin gsar ma'i dbang 'dra rung ba klu chen brgyad kyi tsaka li sogs 'dug pa de ni bo dong padma gar dbang gi brtsams chos las gter gzhung gi khungasadang na sgo med skad do/ /rlabs mtha' rten gtor dbang dang bcas pa mnos nas/ lung la mal gro gzi chen dang mnga' bdag grags mdzad tshul sogs lo rgyus gter srung rnams kyis mgo bo khos kyi mtha' can/ klu rgyud 'bum gyi ti ka gsang ba'i rgyud le'u dgu pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ klu bdud nā ga ra ka'i rjes gnang gi yi ge nyam bag tsha med par longs spyod pa'i mtha' can/ brtag pa rin cen nyi ma'i sgron ma le'u bcu gcig pa rdzogs byang grol shog gi mtha' can/ khyung nag me'i 'khor lo 'di las zab pa yod ri skan gyi che ba can/ byug pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo sa bdag klu'i gshed ma/ mdze gso ba'i man ngag nag po 'dren skems sman gyi 'khor lo/ gsang ba sgom bzlas kyi sel ba zhes pa sgrub thabs/ bsnyen pa dang gsang ba'i rgyas thems rnams ston pa slob dpon gyis rgyal por gdams shing mnga' bdag snyun nad las gdangs nas sku khams bde ba dang ldan pa bstod pa 'khor 'das ma dang bcas pa rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ srin po nā ga raka ti pa tsa shin tu drag po klu bdud mgo dgu'i sgrub thabs/ las tshogs dgu pa zhes pa sman gyi sbyor bsand zhi ba/ bhanta'i sbyor (297ba)bas nor 'phel ba/ rkun ma'i lag pas dbang du sdud ba/ mdze thod kyis bstan dgra nyam thag gcod pa dum pa'i sngags kyis char 'bebs pa/ rdzasang na sbyor bas skyid thang drag po 'bebs pa/ khyung la brten nas ser ba bsrung ba/ che 'bebs kyi sngags byang / gtsang ma khrus kyi brtag pa rnams/ sprul dkar dmar pho mo la brten pa'i char dbab thabs/ chings gsum phyag rgya dgra dang bgegs la sprod —43/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()thabs/gtad kyi tshe sngags dang rdzas la brten pa'i rang bsrung sgrib shing zab mo/gtad kyi tshe pho 'khor mo 'khor la brten pa'i bsrung ba/rab gnas/sngags byang /lha bsgom sngags bzlas pa 'khor lo 'dogs pa gsum gyi zhal gdams/rgya mtsho dug ri klu'i srin po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa tsakra bskor ba'i le'u rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams thob pa las klu bdud mgo dgu'i sgrub thabs ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas 'od srungs/'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/bcom ldan 'das nā ga rakṣa/gsang ba'i bdag po/dge slong rmi lam mthar gzigs/rgyal po ra tā 'bar ba gtsug gi nor bu/sras rgyal po mtha' yas 'od/slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/gter ston rin cen gling pa/bla ma nam mkha' 'od zer/rje chosadabyings pa/bla ma dpal bzang pa/rin po che nam mkha' legs pa/slob dpon phun tshogs/bla ma rdo rje rin cen/rje yon to rdo rje/rigs 'dzin g.yang drung a tsho/te seb bsod nams blo gros/rtse le rigs 'dzin lha dbang rnam rgyal/dpal da rma gu sa grub mchog chos dbang bsam grub/bya btang chos dbang kun bzang /rigs 29ni 'dzan 'phrin las lhun grub/grub chen dme gsang sngags/khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o//yang na rtse le rigs 'dzin chen po nas/byang sems chos dpal/bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/rje btsun nam mkha' dpal 'byor/mtshungs med dran 'dzin rgya mtsho/mang yul ba gu ru rdo rje/spa gro ba chos dbang lhun grub/dar sdings 'phrin las lhun grub man gong ltar ro//yang na ga rna gu ru nas/sngags 'chang kun bzang dpal 'byor/sba gro ba chos dbang lhun grub man gong bzhin/yang na slob dpon phun tshogs nas bla ma rin cen rgyal mtshan/yon tan dpal/nam mkha' rgyal po/bla ma rin 'a/mod byangs chos rje/zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje/gnamagong ba po shis dbang phyug/masasamed bsod nams bzang po/rje dbus pa rtogs ldan/bkra shis mtshan can/sngags 'amang rdo rje/rigs 'dzan 'ja' tshon snying po/ rtse le sprul sku ༷bla legs grub/grub chen na rma gsang sngags man

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gong bzhin/ klu bdud mgo dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyud pa ni/ dmi gu ru yan gong ltar la/ de nas brag sna ba kun mkhyen dbang phyug /khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ gter ston nas rim par rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston chos rgyal ratna gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/ratna gling pa ni/ mnga' bdag nyang gi thugs gter gyi lung bstan gtad rgya las/ lo ni lnga bcu khar la dus nyi ma shar lde'i phyogs dag snya chos kyi rgyal po ratna gling : 'phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa:'tsho rgyal khyod kyi sprul pa'am byin gyis brlabs pa'i (298ba〉skyes bu 'byung : zhes dang / gter kha 'og ma'i sku gsum sgub pa'i lung byang las/ 'di nas byang phyogs shing sgo'i mtshams ri bo khyung chen 'dra ba'i bar lug lo padma dbang chen rtsal bskyed rdzogs don la mkhas pa 'byung : zhes dang /gu ru ngo rtse'i gter lung las mon bu spyi ring skra yi la ba can ri bo khyung chen lding pa'i zhol du 'byung : zhes sogs gter kha mang po nas lung gis zin pa'i gter ston rin cen dpal bzang zhes lang 'gro lo tsā dkon cog 'byung gnas kyi skye ba 'di nyid ni/ rang gter bstan pa spyi lung las/ lnga bcu kha ral dus kyi mtha' ma la da lta'i lo tsā lang 'gro dkon cog 'di smon lam dbang gis skye ba 'ga' brgyud nas de dus ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i lhor lcags khams lug lo padma'i rigs can 'byung :khyung chen ri dang mkhar chu'i zab gter 'don gsang ba'i mtshan yang zhig po gling pa yin gung thang dge re rdzong gsum gter kha 'don gsang ba'i mtshan yang ratna gling par grags bsam yas gnas skas bum thang gter kha 'don gsang ba'i mtshan yang 'gro 'dul gling par grags stobs ldan skyes —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebu shes rab blo gros can don gyi rtags ldan gdul bya'i bka' babs pa 'brel tshad don ldan padma'i rigs can de bu mchog de yis don gnyis spyod par 'gyur zhes gter gnas so so'i dbang gis gter ston gcig la gling pa gsum gyi mtshan du lung gi zin zhing rten 'brel ma 'grig pa'i bar gcod kyi dbang du song na sprul sku tshul rdor ltar gling pa so so'i mtshan can gyi skye ba rim par brgyud dgos rgyu la/ lung bstan bka' rgya chung ba las/ blo gros don ldan (299na skyis bu de so bdun sgeg la ma 'das na gter kha nyi shu rtsa lnga dbang : zhes sogs kyi tshe 'phreng rnams grol te sku tshe mthar phyin pas gter kha nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes pa'i gter ston rgyal po chos rgyal ratna gling pas rong gsum 'dus pa'i ra ba gung thang mkhar ram btsan mkhar ri mo can nas gdan drangs pa'i zab gter bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma theg mchog snying po'i yang zhun/ theg pa rim dgu'i rtse rgyal/ rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa ba/ rgyud lung man ngag kun gyi khong bcud/ snying tig kun gyi nang nas zab tig /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad 'gag /lta sgom spyod pa'i mthar thug /dusagasum rgyal ba'i dgongs bcud/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying / grub thob yongs kyi gsang lam/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal snying tig gi skor la/ thog mar gtor ma la brten nasadabang bzhi rdzogs su (ka)bskur ba chos sgo 'byed pa'i dbang / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rin po che dbang gi (tha)'khor lo'i steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dag byed nyan thos kyi dbang / gsang sngags nang gi dbang zhes pa rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum la brten nas gsang ba ye shes lnga rdzogs/ kun bzang yab yum la brten nas ye rdzogs lhun grub kyi dbang / rigs lnga yab yum gyi spros med dam rdzas gsang dbang / bris sku la brten nas brda dbang ngo sprod/ dbang phyi ma gnyis kyi yi ge'i steng nas ngag sgrib 'dag pa gsang dbang / yid sgrib 'dag pa sher dbang / gtor dbang bzhin nor bu'i mjug las 'byung ba'i rig pa'i rtsal dbang / bla ma tshe dpag med rta mgrin gsum gyi sta gon (299ba tshe sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma'i gtor ma brten nas phyi sgrub padma thod 'phreng rtsal —434

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogan(ka)gyi dbang bzhi yid bzhin nor bu/ gtor ma/ gsang rdzas/ gzung ma/ ngo sprod la brten nas nang (kye sgrub rta phag yab yum gyi dbang bzhi/ bum pa/ tshe chang / sngags/ tshe dgug bstim rgyas btab bcas par brten nas gsang ba tshe dpag (6re/med kyi tshe dbang / bla ma'i sku gter kha 'di ga'i dngos bstan dang rta mgrin tshe dpag med kyi sku gzhan la brten nas khrus gsol ba sogs sku rten gsum (ka)gyi dbang / nyi zer dang man shel la brten nas zhing khams ngo sprod dang / shel dang nyi thig la brten nas(ka)thod rgal gyi sgos dbang / shel dang sku la brten nas rdo rje sems pa'i gsang lam (ka)ngo sprod bar do'i sgos dbang / glegs bam la brten nas sku gsung (ka)snyegs yon tan 'phrin las su grol bar byed pa btags grol gyi dbang rnams smin rgyas dang / grol byed thun mong gi sngon 'gro brgyad/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang ba'i ru shan 'byed pa/ 'byung khamasa'akhrug bas pa sel ba la rnal du dbab cing gsor gzhug pa/ gsol gdab bka' babs/ bsre ba/rang rig don gyi bla ma dang mjal thabs bzhi'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad gcod/ ngo sprod btsan thabs/ rlung rig dbye zhing mtshang btsal ba/ zhi gnas kyis khregs chod kyi gzhi brtsams/ lhag mthong gis gnas lugs kyi ngo bo blta/ rjes spros bral mthar skyel ba ste don drug la brten nas khregs chos kyi ngo sprod/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi 'dug stangs kyis lus gnad gzir ba/ lkugs pa dang mi smra bsang ga gnad gzir ba/ phyi nang gsang ba'i (300na skom mkha' la brten nas yid gnad zir ba/ mtha' rten mi 'gul ba/ sdod pa/ thob pa gsum gyi thod rgal gyi ngo sprod bcas nyams 'khrid du bstan nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rgya mtsho mun 'khrid las/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang gter snying po'i bcud 'di la snying dang snying khrag dngas ma'i skor gsum mchis: slong gsal snying thig thugs srog snying gi tshul: thems yig med rnams gsang ba'i snying khrag ste sbas chos lnga po srog gi dngas ma'i tshul zhes snying dang snying khrag dngas ma'i tshul gsum du gsungs pa ltar/ yid ches khungs btsun pa kha byang lo rgyus dang thems kyi skor sku rten gsum dang 'brel ba bla ma phyi nang —433—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegasang gsum gyi sgrub skor/ snying dang 'dra ba klong gsal snying tig gdams pa gzhung gi skor/ snying khrag dang 'dra ba brjod par dka' ba yang zab thems med kyi skor/ srog gi dngas ma lta bu sbas chos gsang ba yang tig skor/ gdams skor yongs rdzogs spyi'i kha skong ba yig phran gyi skor/ bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba chos skyong skor dang bdun/ dang po la/ mnga' bdag nyang gis srin po spar rjes nas spyan drangs pa'i klong gsal snying tig kha (6)byang lde mig 'di lta ste lung phran gro shul zhes sogs kha byang las byung ba bzhin gdan drangs pa'i mtha' can/ yang gter kha de nyid las gzer 'debs kyi khyi ka lta'i)ni brag mtha' rgya yig 'bru gsum zhes sogs yul phyogs bkra shis pa'i mtha' can 'di dar sdings pa'i gsan yig na gong gi khongs su bsdus nas bkod pa las zur du med/ rang gter mtha' mtshams mon gyi rong gsum mdo brag dmar btsan mkhar ri mo can gyi gnas (pha)yig lung byang gsal ba smon lam btsan pas de la gdod (300ba)pa'i mtha' can/ slong gsal skor gsum gyi spyi thems gsang ba bka' rgya can lo lnga (ka)'grogs nas brtag thub snying gi bu ma gtogs kun la mi spel ba/ bstan pa rin po che'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhes ( 3 )pa rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rigs 'dzin brda brgyud gang zag snyan brgyud gsum gyi byang tshul rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lo rgyus chung ba brgyud pa rim (6)par babs tshul stong thun khog 'bub/ slong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud kyi snying po'i lo rgyus zhes pa (pha)slob dpon chen pos shrī sidha la rgyud bcu bdun gyi khong snying slong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud zhus pa'i byung khungs manta ra bas yi ger btab pa rgya bod kyi skad shan sbyar las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/zab gter gnyan gyi thems (pha)yig snying gi dum bu nyi ma'i snying po/ 'di'i sked par phrad shog gi mthar yang ga rjeg bka' rtsis thems byang bstan zhes ma gcig pa gsal bar 'dug kyang de rnams sbrel nas gcig tu byas pa lta bu yod pa/ de nas shog log gcig tsam na 'di yis zab gter gnyan gyi thems byang rdzogs zhes pa'i tshig nus shig byung rung don du thems byang gsum zhes byung ba'i skabs 'di gnyis so sor brtsi zhing / da nas kyang 'phro 'thud de sku gsung thugs rten sgrub pa'i cha rkyen dang —436

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabacas bse skam dmar por sbas pa gter ston gyis chos bka' 'chal bar mi ston pa/ la bse nag po'i ga'u 'chi med lcags srog 'grub pa'i ril bu sbas tshul dang bcas pa mthar las dang skal ba ldan par gtad do zhes don mi gcig pa yod pas kyang shes nus so/ /thems byang las byung ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa sku rten gsum dang 'brel ba'i bla ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa ni/ sku rten padma mthong grol nor bu'i sku sku rten (301na8 dang thugs sgrub cha rkyen tshang : gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen 'di yis rdzogs shin tu yang zab skal ldan snying la gtad: ces pa ltar/ dngos grub kun 'dus bla ma phyi sgrub padma 'byung gnas kyi gtor dbang (pa)yid bzhin nor bu 'gro don rgyas par 'gyur gyi mtha' can/ 'gor kye ho ma 'ongs chos 'di'i dka' babs zhes yod pa'i chos bdag lung bstan snying rje can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub chen mo phyi ltar padma thod 'phreng rtsal du (pha)sgrub pa bka' 'di ched du gnyer ro srungs kyi mtha' can/ gsung rten rta phag gsang sgrub nang gi sku:sku rten 'di dang gsang sgrub cha rkyen tshang : blo ldan gcig gi nyams len 'di yis rdzogs zhes pa ltar rta phag gsang ba'i dbang chog rtog)padma'i 'phreng ba gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos ye ger bkod pa/ gdul bya'i re ba bskong phyir bla ma nang ltar sgrub pa rta mgrin gsang ba'i thugs (6)sgrub spyi bor slob dpon padma rta mgrin yab yum gyi rnam par bzhugs par mtshan brgyad kyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ slob dpon chen po'i dgongs pa'i bzhi phugs rta phag yang gsang (6)gnad kyi sgrub thabs gzer bzhis gnad la 'bebs pa las 'phro can rnams smin par byed par shog gi mtha' can 'di dar ngas pa'i gsan yig na gong gi khongs su bsdus 'dug /rta mgrin gsang ba dbang gi las(pha)byang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa rgyun spyod bya'o'i mtha' can mon kha yi ring gsang phug nas spyan drangs pa/ thugs rten rigs bdag mgon po tshe yi sku sku rten 'di dang tshe sgrub cha rkyen tshang : las can re re'i cha rkyen 'di yis (301ba〉grub de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub skor la byin rlabs thog 'bebs ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i gnad lam zab dbang gi ṭīka re —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shere bzhugs dam ldan rnams kyi lam 'di gas bgrod ces pa ltar/ bla ma gsang ba ltar sgrub pa mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang lta'i)chog bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes pa skyon chen pos nang gi snying por bskur ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i bu yig tshe byang bkol pa'i dbang (6)sgrub shog gi mtha' can/ skyon mkhan po padma'i dgongs pa'i bzhed phugs tshe dpag med kyi gsang lta'i)sgrub 'chi med rigs 'dzin thob par nges shes skyed do'i mtha' can zhar byung du rgyun 'khyer tshe sgrub lta'i)skal ldan lag tu gtad rgya can/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro dang ye shes(ka)dbab pa'i yig chung bkol ba rjes rim dang bcas pa'i dbang 'khrid mkhar chen bzas bkod pa/ dbang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dpe'u chung (ka)bstan pa phug ring du bkod pa/ bla ma'i gtor chen rin cen 'bar ba'i spra (6)'khrid lag len gi byang bu can/ steng 'khor sku gsum srog 'khor chen mo la 'og 'khor gnad 'bebs bar gcod kun sel yin rgyal chen sgo ba phyogs bsrung sgrom gyi tshul:sgrub thabs gong ma gsum gyi cha rkyen yin rdo rje'i gur chen gnam lcags mkhar dang 'dra shin tu yang zab skal ldan snying la gtad: ces pa ltar/ sku gsum ga'i steng 'khor lta'i)bla re bris yig zab gter gnyan gyi cha rkyen du sbas pa/ bar gcod kun sel 'og gi gnad (6)'khor 'dren pa'i dpal du shog gi mtha' can/ sgrub thabs gsum gyi kha skong gi me (ka)mchod snying rje can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa snying dang 'dra ba slong gsal snying thig gdams pa (302na tshe na zhung gi skor la/ rtsab dang rgyab chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro'i zab gter slong gsal snying thig la sngon 'gro'i chos skor bla ma'i gtor dbang dang : lusang ga sgrib sbyongs 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed khregs chod dmar 'khrid nor bu'i snying po dang : thod rgal lam 'khrid mun sel sgron me ste de ltar ma bzhi rtsa ba'i sgrom shing yin zhes pa ltar/ chos sgo 'byed pa byin rlabs bla ma'i gtor dbang 9)nor bu'i snying po tshig dbang rin po che bskur thabs bcas pa rdzogs so' mtha' can/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa gang zag sgrom du 'jug (ka)pa'i gdams pa las 'phro can dang sprod —438

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganacig pa'i mtha' can/mngon sum rang thog tu ngo sprod pa gcer mthong rig pa'i man ngag snying gi nor bu'i don 9)'khrid dam dmar 'khrid nor bu'i snying po zhes rdzogs byang bka' 'di srungs shig pa'i mtha' can/mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa'i man ngag thod rgal gyi 'khrid (6)yig mun sel sgron me'am don 'khrid nor bu rtsa ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/snying tig gi mtha' rten rjes kyi man ngag ces 9)pa gzhi bca' tshad bzung /gzer btab/rtags bcu gnyis/des thob gsum rnams ston pa slong gsal snying bcud lag 'khrid gsal ba'i sgron me/lus kyi 'dug stangs gsum/gong yodang 'di gnyisachos tshan so sgo dang gcig pa gang du brtsis kyang chog pa' 'then phyogs shag 'dug pa the tshom gyi gzhir snang ba khra tshang pa dang chos rje dbang ོ grub gnyis ka'i phyag dper sbrel 'dun go/spyan gyi gzigs stangs gsum/gnad bcu dgu/brda gsum/bogs 'don gsum dang bcas ston pa phyon snying bcud bla med phrad shog gi mtha' can/'khrid yig yid bzhin nor bu (ka)gter ston 302bgyi sman rtse'i ri khrod du mdzad pa/thems med/des mdzad pa'i chos spyod yid bzhin nor bu 'gor bla ma la skyabs su 'chi'o zhes yod pa/des mdzad them med/pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu dmigs med spros bral ma rnams/gnyis pa rgyab chos la/rang rig bla ma'i rnal 'byor (ka)gsang sgrogs su 'gyur bas sbas par bya'o'i mtha' can/them med/ngo sprod btsan thabs 'dzub (ka)gtsugs su gdab pa snying rje can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/them med/rlung bum pa can la brten nas zhi gnas lhag mthong gi ngo sprod gang zag gi shes rgyud bla ma'i rtogs pas dmigs pa 'khrid pa/thems med/mkhas pa shrī sidha la slob dpon chen po padmas zhus lan snying gi me long (6)slong gsal snying tig khregs chod kyi rgyab chos tshul du bkod pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/thems med/skal ldan smin byed bum pa'i dbang chog rin po che'i dbang (pha)gi 'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu phrad shog gi mtha' can/de dag kun la bu yig rgyab chos ni gtor chen spra 'khrid sgyu ma'i gar mchod dang :sprugs pa klu mchod bdud bzhi mnan pa'i bro phyi nang sgrub thabs gsum gyi rgyab chos yin zhes pa ltar/༷༷nga dang sgrub pa'i cha rkyen gar mchod (6)mkha'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'agro'i 'gying glu phrad shog gi mtha' can/ sprugs pa brda'i glu (pha)mchod dngos grub brnyes pa'i mtha' can/ ngag sgrib dag byed spros med (6)gsang ba'i dbang chog mtha' rgyas shog gi mtha' can/yid sgrib dag byed bde stong dga' bzhis skyed pa (pha)shes rab ye shes kyi dbang chog sgrol bar shog gi mtha' can/ yongs su spros med tshig dbang ni chos sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma'i gtor dbang gi gsham na yod pa de (303na 'dir len pa phyag len no/ /sku rten gsum gyi dbang dang de'i 'phros las de kho na nyid kyi rig pa'i rtsal (6)dbang khrigs cho ga ka dag phyag rgya chen por bskur thabs phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang lnga pa mngon sum thod rgal lhun grub kyi sgos (pha)dbang ngo sprod gnad kyi man ngag phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang bzhi'i bsnyen yig nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes pa dbang sgrub kyi rtsa ba (6)phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bla med dang bcas pa'i gnad yig shin tu zab pa chos bdag bu la gtad pa'i mtha' can/ dbang gsum pa nyams len gsang sngags bla med a ti'i yang zhun bde stong zung 'jug nyi zla kha sbyor chags can chags pas 'grol ba yid bzhin nor bu lta bu dri med bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ de'i yig chung 'khrul 'khor rtsa (pha)tshig gnad kyi zin bris phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rdo rje lus kyi ka ba rang byung dbu ma'i sbas bshad kyi gsang (6)tshig bstan pa snying gi dum bu yi ger bkod pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ them med/ mtshan ldan rig ma brtag thabs mtshan byang bde legs 'dus pa mkho mthing lha (di)khang gi ka ba'i bsam le nas spyan drangs pa/ 'tsho rgyal gyi gnad kyi zhus lan man ngag (6)zab mo sangs rgyas la nyin khugs thub par gda' bar gsungs pa/ lam zab slong gsal 'khrid kyi rgyab chos la gnad gyi man ngag zhugal na chen mo dang : sku gsum ngo sprod gnad kyi zhal gdams yin nges shes can la btags grol btags chog dang : las 'phro can la 'od gsal bar do'i chos: 'khrid rgyab chen mo mun sel sgron me dang 'chi ba brtag blu brtson (303ba〉grus bskul ba'i chos de ltar ma bu'i rkang grangs che long tsam slong gsal snying thig gsang ba'i kha byang rdzogs zhes pa ltar/ 'tsho rgyal dang nam mkha' snying pos —440

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnamachims phu dang mkhar chur zhus pa'i lta'i)'khrid kyi rgyab chos zab pa'i mthar thug thugs kyi zhus lan snying gi me long 'gro don 'phel bar 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ ngo bo ka dag dang kun gzhi dri bcas kyi ngo sprod ces (pha)pa ma dag pa nyon mongs pa'i gnas tshul/ dag pa sku bzhi ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i gnas tshul ston pa le'u bzhi lnga drug gsum yod pa rin cen sa'i 'og tu gter sbas pa'i mtha' can/ ngo sprod mdzub btsugs sangs rgyas lag bcang ma (6)zhes pa 'dug gsum lam long sku gsum ngo sprod/ 'dod yon rgyan shar/ 'da' kha 'chi brod/ 'bras bu phyogs lhung med pa ste lngas ston pa shrī sidha'i thugs bcud phrad shog gi mtha' can/ le lo can sgom mi dgos pa btags pas grol ba'i man ngag ngo mtshar can bstan pa (pha)thams cad kyi bu gcig pu'i rgyud gter ston gyis gu ru chos dbang dang rang gi shog ser las 'bru lan gyis zhus dag pa tshe 'dir g.yeng bas khyer nas snying tig nyams su ma lon na bar dor skad (pha)cig ma'i shes pa ngos bzung ste 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa bar do mun sel sgron me gtad rgya'i mtha' can/ de'i bu yig bar do gnad kyi nyams (pha)'khrid dbang po tha ma'i 'o'i mtha' can/ thems med/ glong gsal spyi'i rgyab yig gegs sel (6)gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i bum pa sgron mer shog gi mtha' can/ thod rgal gyi 'khrid rgyab mun sel lung gi sgron me zhes pa (6)gzhi lam 'bras gsum la lnga lngar phye ste gzhung don bco lngar bshad pa bka' 'di srungs shig gi (304nasgo tha' can/ brtson 'grus bskul phyir 'chi ba brtag pa dang blu (ka)ba'i gdams pa 'gro don mthar phyin shog gi mtha' can rnams/ bzhi pa snying khrag dang 'dra ba brjod par dka' ba yang zab thems med kyi skor la/ sa bcad gsum pa yan thems yig nyi ma'i snying po gtso che bar byas/'dir spyi thems gsang ba dka' rgya can las/ ma 'ongs dus na gdams pa 'thor dogs nas thems yig med kyang 'di ru gud du bkol thog mar chos sde skyed par byed pa'i ma slong gsal 'bar ma nyi ma'i gsang rgyud 'di shin tu gnyan pas bka' rgya dam du bya: zhes pa ltar/ don rgyud kun gyi snying po chos 'di skyed par byed pa'i ma lta bu kun tu bzang (pha)mo gleng gsal thig le snying po —44/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegasang ba'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ de'i gsang rgyud kyi 'grel pa chen po slong gsal (kyi sgron ma'am lam 'bras gser gyi me long padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad dar rgyas chos sdings pa'i gsan yig na sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje zer ba 'dug pa dbyad/ pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ thems med/'od gsal gsang lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa gnyis dad ldan gtong phod nges shes can la byin zab pa'i mthar thug tshe sgrub bka' rgya 'di bu la ster yang bka' rgya lan gsum thob ces pa ltar/mngon sum gyi gnad la brten nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od gsal gsang (6)lam 'od kyi sna thag skad cig ma'i mthus 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i ngo sprod bar do'i sgos dbang phrad shog gi mtha' can/g.yeng bas khyer ba'i rnal 'byor ba snying tig 'di nyams su len long ma byung na skad cig gis 'tshang rgya (6)ba rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam 'pho ba'i man (304ba)ngag 'di kho na 'o'i mtha' can/ zab pa'i mthar thug tshe sgrub bka' rgya lta'i)ma gsang ba'i snying po tsitta'i ga'ur spos shig pa'i mtha' can/zhan byung tshe sgrub shin tu (6)zab pa'i yang zab dang bcas pa/ ye shes dbab rdzas rtsa yi sbas bshad dang : zab lam rgyab yig bcud skyed sha sbyor dang :rdo rje them skas rigs brgyud brtags thabs dang :dbang bskur snying bsgul gsang ba yang gces dang : bde skyid rdzas sbyor srid gcod bka' rgya rnams lo bdun 'grogs pa'i brtag thub snying gi bu tshe 'di blos btang snying nas chos byed pa'i snying gi bu chen lnga las spel mi rung : zhes pa ltar/ ye shes dngos su dbab pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rdzas(6)sbyor brgyud 'dzin gcig las mi spel ba'i mtha' can/ zab lam nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyab yig sbas chog gsang ba'i man ngag (6)rtsa rigs lnga'i sgo nas mtshan ldan phyag rgya brtag pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bde ba lam du byed pa sha sbyor rdo rje gso thabs gcig las mang du ma spel zhig gi mtha' can/ rang lus thabs ldan gyi bde stong nyams su blang ba (6)tshe gcig rdo rje'i sku 'grub zab lam rdo rje'i them skas snying gi yang zhun rgya lnga'i mtha' can/ dbang sdus snying bsgul gyi gdams pa snying la bcang ba'i (ka)mtha' can/ zhan byung mo gdon bsrung ba dang bud med kyis skyes pa dbang du bsdu —442

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)thabs/gsang ba'i yang 'khol (ka)'khor lo gsum gyi dri thabs/zab lam yid bzhin nor bu mkhas pa rnam lngas(ka)nyams su blangs tshul dra mig 'khor lo/'khor ba rtsad gcod rdzas sbyor zab 9)mo sri gcod yid bzhi nor bu phrad shog gi mtha' can/sbrul sha sogs rdzas la brten pa'i srid gcod 30ldan ) bka' rgya ma/lus gyi drod skyed rdzas kyi sbyor ba dang :stobs skyed pa dang sa rdo'i bcud len dang :tshe 'dir lto gos g.yeng ba sel ba'i phyir snying nas chos byed dad ldan dga' la sbyin tshe yi bas du rlung gi sbyor ba dang :mchog tu zab pa 'byung ba'i 'chi blu gnyis dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa 'ga' re las mang du ma spel rang gi snying la chongs zhes pa ltar/gtum mo'i rgyab yig lus kyi drod skyed rdzas (ka)sbyor rigs mi gcig pa lngas gos kyi g.yeng ba sel ba zhan byung zhabasarjen bya thabs/lus stobs bskyed cing zas kyi sred pa spong ba rin cen sa'i bcud len (ka)gter kha gsum las ri mo can du sbas pa/cung zhi sogs rdo'i bstod len la 9)brten nas tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur pa/tshe bcud bsdu ba'i tshe snab bka' 'di gong mdang phal〉 'dra 'dug pas gas yod med brtag/rgya shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa/shin tu zab (ka)pa 'byung pa'i 'chi blu brtse sgam nag por gtamasapa/lung bstan bka' rgya gter bdag sprul sku'i lung :lung byang skor gsum chos bdag slob ma'i lung :bstan pa sbyi lung gang zag sgos lung dang :mtha' dbus 'khrugs tshul gter ston slob ma'i lung :lung skor de rnams rab tu gces na yang :brtag thub snying gi bu rnams ma gtogs pa mang du spel na gshe skur sgrog gzhi dang :log lta can rnams sdig gsod rkyen du 'gyur zhes pa ltar/gter bdag sprul sku'i skyes rabs lung bstan (6)gsal ba'i sgron ma'am lung bstan bka' rgya ma phrad shog gi mtha' can/lung bstan bka' rgya chung ba 9)snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal du shar ba'i mtha' can/bstan pa spyi dang gang zag sgos 305ba ) lung mtha' dbus 'brug pa gter brdzus zog po brtag tshul sogs rgyas par gsal bar (zur/ston pa'i lung bstan chen mo phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/lnga pa srog gi dngas ma lta bu sbas chosaXsang ba yang tig skor la/rgyud bcu bdun/slong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negasal nyi ma'i rgyud mnyam sbyor rgyud rnams kyi bcud dril (pha)ba zab chos gsang ba yang tig thems yig bka' rgya ma phrad shog gi mtha' can/ thabs pha dang 'dra ba khregs chod ka dag gi ngo sprod don gsal snying po'i gsang 'khrid (6)lo gsum gyi gong nas zhu ba phul te gser dang sman gyi maṇḍal tshogs 'khor dang bcas dgos pa bka' 'di thub par srungs shig gi mtha' can/ shes rab ma dang 'dra ba rgya mtsho 'od gsal mun 'khrid lta'i)gser gyi maṇḍal tshogs 'khor zhu ba lan gsum re phul rjes ston pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gces pa bu dang mtshungs pa dus bzhi mnyam sbyor (6)dang 'brel bar khor yug tu nyams su len pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gdams pa 'gro ba dpag med grol bar shog gi mtha' can/ mthong bas grol ba'i gdams pa bar do'i ngo sprod sangs rgyas lag bcangs spra 'khrid srog gzer du bstan pa'i sbas (6)chos don bzhi pa yang gces srog gi dngas ma jo mo 'tsho rgyal dang gnubs nam snying la gnang ba tshogs 'khor dang gser dang 'bru'i maṇḍal lan gsum re dbul dgos pa/ dpral ba'i mig las gces pa spra 'khrid bar do'i zhal (6)gdams nyams su blang thabs gsum gyi sgo nas bar do bzhi'i lam 'byer bstan pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ mthong bas grol ba'i gdams pa gsang ba thig le'i yang zhun (6)mngon sum snying tig (306na)gi man ngag bar do gnad kyi me long dam med la shor ra re'i mtha' can/ de'i bu yig yang gces sbas pa zhi khro'i ngo sprod lta'i)thug phrad sangs rgyas lag 'khrid snying gi dum bu bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog gi mtha' can/rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig pa'i (spyi rgyud rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gter gyi yang snying (pha) mngon shes rang byung rig pa rgyal po'i rgyud rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pa gsang ba spyod pa sa bon gcig shes lta'i)kun grol gyi rgyud rdzogs so'i mtha' can zhar byung du glegs bam bri ba/ bcang pa/ bklag pa/ phan yon bcas bstan pa/ mngon shes rig pa rgyal po'i rgyud kyi don 'grel chen lta'i)mo gter gyi yang snying srog gi dang ma thugs kyi sgron me gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos mkhar chu gsang phug tu —444—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)bris pa/ rig pa gnad dgu'i btags grol shin tu zab (6)pa zhal gdams dang bcas pa bstan pa dar ba dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ btags grol rab tu gnas shing rgyud bcang lta'i)ba dbang bskur dang bcas pa las can mang po grol bar shog gi mtha' can/ rgyud bcangs pa tsam gyis gang zag rab 'bring mtha' dag (6)grol byed rang byung gi rgyud bcang thabs padma'i bka' rtags me yig ma/ rgyud bcangs pa'i skyes bu de 'das tshe gdung 'byung ba (6)dang 'bras bu thob tshul phrad shog gi mtha' can/'gro don rgya chen bya ba'i phyir ji ltar bklag pa'i thabs (pha)bstan pa gsang bar gyis kyi mtha' can zhar la dga' rab rdo rjes shrī sidha la rgyud che ba bdun dang bcas gtad tshul/ mun 'khrid gsang ba mngon sum 'od (306ba)gsal gyi mchog sgom pa'i gnad la (pha)zab pa btsan thabs su rtsa bcing ba dang rlung / bcing ba gud du phyung ste sped par bya'o'i mtha' can/ su yis mthong yang gdod ma'i rang bzhin mngon du rtogs pa snod bcud (6)gsal ba mun par sgron me 'degs pa dang 'dra ba phrad shog gi mtha' can/ nges shes 'phral du skye ba rtags (6)yig gsal ba'i sgron me srid mtsho sgrol ba'i grur shog gi mtha' can/ lam dang 'bras bu'i gsad gzer dus tshod mi 'gyur ba (pha)tshad kyi yi ge ma nor gsal ba'i sgron me legs par dpyad dgos yod do'i mtha' can/ yang gces sbas pa'i yang snying tsha ba dmar thag gi gdams pa ka dag lhun grub zung lta'i)'jug gi ngo sprad sangs rgyas lag bcangs su ston pa'am sku gsum gzhi lam 'bras gsum du ngo spyod pa thugs kyi yang zhun mkhar chen thems med/ bzas bris pa'i mtha' can/ chos sku 'od mi 'gyur gtan la dbab pa (6)gsal byed mig gi lag len phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zhar byung ma 'ongs chos 'di bka' babs kyi las can rjes 'jug slob ma'i zhal gdams phyogs dang lo rten 'brel dus tshod brtag pa/ nyin mtshan kha sbyor 'od dkar ar gtad dang / gnad 'bebs dang 'jug sgra yi chos dang lnga dam gtsang bka' nyan lus dang longs spyod dbul: nyams len sgrub la mna' rgya nus pa yi: bu min gzhan la bstan na dam tshig nyams gsang ba'i gnad yig 'od gsal 'khor lo 'di dam med lus kyi bu la sbyin mi —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherung : zhes pa ltar/ zab pa'i nang nas yang zab thugs kyi bcud sbas pa'i nang nas sbas pa snying gi nang nas kyang snying srog thigs pa gsang ba'i gzer thig yang (6)gces bdun pa phrad (307na)shog gi mtha' can chig brgyud las mi spel zhing sgrub pa'i dam bca' lo gsum gser g.yu'i maṇḍal lan gsum phul nas rten 'brel brtag dgos pa/ mtshan ma rmi lam sbubs su 'jug pa'i gsang ba'i gnad (6)yig 'od gsal 'khor lo gab pa gsal byed bde chen sar bgrod par shog gi mtha' can/ gsang ba'i gegs sel bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang : bogs 'don zab mo gnad kyi yig chung rnams bu la ster bar mna' rgya lan gsum thob ces pa ltar/ rgya mtsho mun 'khrid gsang ba'i gces gnad (pha)gegs sel bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rgya lnga'i mtha' can/ mun 'khrid kyi yang gces bogs 'don gnad (pha)kyi yig chung phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ drug pa gdams skor yongs rdzogs spyi'i kha skong yig phran gyi skor la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang brag dmar ri mo can du (ka)sbas tshul gyi lo rgyus gsal sgron chu yig can/ zhal gdams snying gi dum (ka)bu zhes pa chos rgyal/ 'tsho rgyal/ bee ro tsa na/ gnubs nam snying / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rlangs dpal gyi seng ge /dpal gyi ye shes/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas rnams la gdams pa/ sku rten padma thod grol/ gsung rten rta phag /thugs rten tshe dpag med gsum gyi lo rgyus(ka)rgyas pa gsal ba'i sgron me khyad par can/ tshe'i bar gcod pa bzlog phyir gsang ba srog (pha)gi tsakra'i bri yig phrad shog gi mtha' can/lta sgom spyod 'bras dbang dam tshig gi ngo sprod nyi ma'i snying po zhes pa spros gcod zhus lan gyi gdams pa/ nga (307bsgo phyi nang gsang gsum du sgrub pa tsitta rin po che srog gi sgrub thabs zhes par nang gses kyi phyi chu sbyin la brten nas ser du bsgrub pa/ nang rdzas la 'khor lo bsnyen sgrub la brten nasarjo dmar du sgrub pa/ gsang ba bcas gong ltar gyis las la bkol ba ṭwāṃ nag du bsgrub pa/ dbang sdud las kyi yang khol zhan byung thabs lam padma bcud bsdus kyi dbang sdud dang bcas pa rnams/—446

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnabadun pa bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba chos skyong gi skor la/ thems byang du gsal ba dpal mgon ma ning nag po/ gza' rgod dug gi spu gri /dam can skyes bu chen po badzra thig le rtsal/ phung byed las kyi rlung dmar/ srid gsum dbang sdud lha chen gu lang rlung gi zhags pa/ phan gnon gdams pa kha 'thor skor dang drug /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung ba'i phyir bka' bsrung dam can phan gnod las tshogos skor ma 'ongs don du skyon bdag gi sbas ma ning nag po dril sgrub spu gri 'di gter kha 'di yi spyi srung chen po ste bka' rdzogs lung zin bu mchog ma gtogs pa spel du mi rung gces pa'i srog bzhin bcang : zhes pa ltar gter kha 'di'i chos bka' spyi'i srung ma ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning dril sgrub spu gri'i skor gter gnas kyi dbang du byas thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i chos sder 'os na'ang / thems kyi zin sos skabs 'dir gtso che bar snang bas 'dam khar 'dug pa nas rdzogs chen 'di ratna'i gter chos kyi yang rtse'i dbang du byas te bkod pa ni/ sprul sku ratna gling pas gnyal smad dag ri spyang dmar chos rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'i mthu stobs nus pa 'gran zla bral ba'i bstan bsrung (308na8pal mgon ma ning dril sgrub spu gri'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhu 'bul/ gnang ba byin nas/ gong gnon phyag rdor gyi dbang / bum par brten pa'i dbang bzhi/sku bdud rtsi/ rdo rje gri gug /dar sku bla rdo/ phyag mtshan dang bcas pas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang / bsgral dbang / gtor dbang / byin 'bebs/ rtsal dbang / sngags dbang / zhal gdams lung dbang rnams dang bcas pa/ gtor ma la brten pa'i srog dbang bsdus pa dbang bzhi'i tshul du mnos nas/ lung la/ dbang sgrub/ mchod 'phrin/ yang gces skor dang gsum/dang po la/ ma ning dregs pa'i srog dbang dkyil 'khor bum pa sogs la brten nas rgyasapar bskur ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa'i yi ge /de'i dkyil 'khor/ bum pa/dbang gtor/ bdud rtsi/ thugs yig /dar nag /bla rdo/ phyag mtshan/ liṅga/ gta' gtor/ rgyun gtor —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shernams kyi dpe ris/ srog dbang gtor mar brten nas bsdus par bskur ba'i yi ge /dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i phyi sgrub dar nag la brten nas snang srid zil gnon lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i gdams pa dar nag rten sku'i dpe ris dang bcas dpal mgon srog bdud nag po'i gsang ba rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs srog gi spu gri yang gces gnad yig dang bcas pa/ 'jigasabargyad zhi zhing dgos 'dod char ltar dbab pa sku'i mgon po dkar po zhi bar sgrub pa bar gcod kun sel/ snang srid dbang sdud gsung gi mgon po dmar po/ dbang du sgrub pa'i gsang ba'i yang bcud/tshe bsod nams dpal 'byor spel ba yon tan gyi (308bsgo gon po ser po rgyas par sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol ba 'phrin las kyi mgon po ljang gu drag por sgrub pa srog rtsa dmar 'byin/ gces pa'i nang nas yang gces ma ning gsang ba'i dril sgrub sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis bstan pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i dbul ba sel zhing dgos 'dod char ltar dbab pa ma ning rje nag nor sgrub shin tu zab cing gnad che ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor/ gtor ma rin cen 'bar ba'i dpe risabacas pa rnams/ gnyis pa mchod 'phrin la/ dpal mgon ma ning gtso 'khor gsum pa phyi'i yang khol brgyad dang bcas pa'i las byang dad pa dam tshig ma 'grub pa'i mtha' can/ dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bkang ba'i rim pa bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig ma/ srog bdud ma ning nag po'i dam bdar bcol dam dgongs gsol ma tshig lhug phun tsho gis mdzod kyi mtha' can/ bskul byang logasasu bkol ba lha chen dpal 'bar ma bden pa bdar dang bcas pa rnams/ gsum pa yang gces skor la/ gsang tig bla rda'i man ngag khong nang gi snying dang 'dra ba/ nang 'gras thod gtong lha srin gnad la 'bebs pa stobs ldan zab mo'i 'khor lo/ dam nyams kyi tshe bsod nams nus pa rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pa stag pa'i sgam bu sor bzhi par brten pa gsang ba gnad kyi yang gces/ rgya yig 'bru bdun cu don gsum mar brten pa'i 'khu ldog bsrung ba gsang ba'i yang gces/ yang gshes gnad kyi lde mig drag po rang gshed gnad la dbab pa'i man ngag /sngags kyi 'bru thems zhar byung sngags kyi —448

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ (gna'abyin 'jug dang bcas pa 'chi thebs gcig las spel mi rung ba/ dpal mgon ma ning gnas la chags pa dang gta' ru brten cing gzung ba'i thabs/ dpal (309na7gon ma ning gi phyi nang gsang ba'i rten bca' thabs lang 'gro lo tsā bar gtad pa/ yang gces gnad kyi zhal gdams chig brgyud bka' rgya ma/ yang gces gnad yig snying dang 'dra ba chig brgyud gcig las mi spel ba padma'i zhal gdams shin tu zab pa/ yang gces gnad kyi spyi rgyud sbas pa'i zab gnad ces par nang gses kyi rgya yig gis bsrung ba/ bla rdo/ gnad 'bebs/ las mi 'grub pa'i dogs pa ma mchis pa'i gnad yig /bod pa'i gnad yig /spos sbyor/ gshed 'bebs kyi dmod pa/ gsang sngags kyi gnad rnams ston pa dpral ba'i mig dang khong pa'i snying lta bu/ tsandan gyi beng la brten nas lha srin 'khu ldog spong ba dang snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag rten 'brel gnad yig bcu gnyis mar grags pa/ ma ning bshan nag spu gri phung byed las kyi rlung dmar gnam skas brag nas gdan drangs pa 'brub khung / spyang thog /thun snod/ phur pa/ lidma'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/ srog bdud ma ning nag po'i las mtha' dam sri kha bcing shin tu zab phyir gud du sbas pa rnams/gnyis pa gza' rgod dug gi spu gri'i skor ni/ gza' rgod nag po dug gi spu gri 'di yang gsang snying gi bka' yi srung ma las khyad par glong gsal rgyud kyi bka' srung ngo : zhes pa ltar/ srog dbang gi yi ge las byung ba ltar gtor ma'i rjes gnang phyag mtshan/ sku/ bla rdo/ me long / rtag gtor/bka' sdod/ rtsal dbang / dam bsre/ zhal gdams lung dbang dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/lung la/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa rang bsrung gnad 'bebs srog rtag ol dgag 'khor gyi the'u brang gsum dug 'byin gsol kha bkang (309bsko so la sogs pa brgyud 'dzin bu mchog bstan pa bsrung ba la 'ga' re tsam las mang du spel mi rung : de las gsal kha bkang gsorang bsrung rnams chosabaka' 'di yis brgyud 'dzin 'ga' la spel zhes pa ltar gza' bdud chen po'i gsang (byang/sgrub dug gi spu gri drag po las kyi mthar thug pa/ rang lus tshags su gzhug pa rang bsrung (byang/zab pa'i —slob

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )mthar thug 'di med sdig pa'i phru gu gso ba 'dra ba/rang gshed gnad la dbab pa'i yang gces srog las(byang/ga sa mā ya'i mtha' can/yang gces gud du sbas pa gsang ba'i gnad yig gcesapa dam tshig gi dmigs gnad/stod mnan/gnad dbab shis bzhi'i thog tig slob dpon rom bu gu rgya'i thugs bcud/yang gces snying gi gdams pa ol dgag gi man ngag longs spyod ldan zhing bkra shis pa'i mtha' can/dam can srog phur bca' thabs tsitta ra sa mā ya'i mtha' can/sgab 'dre the'u brang lnga'i mnan thabs gces 'phang rgyas btab sa mā ya'i mtha' can/zhud sel gyi gnad (byang/yig shin tu gsang ba'i mtha' can/gces gnad dug dbyung gi thabs(byi ge bu mchog gcig lasami spel ba'i mtha' can/gza' bdud chen po'i bkang ba dbyings dang ye shes ma mtshon char shog gi mtha' can/mchod bstod khrag mtsho khol ma'i rgyud las phyung ba sangs rgyas bstan skyong ma/bla rdo yang gces stod gnon shi sa bstan gnad thig las sbyor yang gces nor sgrub dang :khyad par gcesagand srog dbang bka' thems bcas pang du sprul byung kha nas me 'bar yang :tshig brgyud yin phyir shi ba'i kha bzhin sdoms tshul bzhin ma bshad rang 310na ) srog nges pa gcod las can bu mchog lnga yis 'di bzung la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du bag yod spyod ces pa ltar/lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa bla (byi ge rdo'i man ngag shin tu gsang ba'i mtha' can/stod la gnon pa 6ge snying 'dra gcig las mang ba ri'i mtha' can/gces pa snying dang 'dra ba log gnon shi sabastan pa'i gdams pa snying la cho nges shig sa mā ya'i mtha' can/g.yang du bkug ste nor sgrub pa'i zab gnad tsitta'i ga'ur sa mā ya'i mtha' can/mchog tu gces pa'i zab gnad grog dbang chen mo bka' thems gnad yig dang bcas pa tshig brgyud bga' rgya ma snying khrag gi dngas ma lta bu/sngagasakyi 'byin 'jug shi sa bstan pa las can gcig la gtad rgya'i mtha' can/'byin 'jug sngags kyi 'bru thams gud du bkol ba tshig brgyud bka' rgya ma/mdo che (bya nge cig mo dgu sgor rnams/gsum pa dam can skyes bu chen po badzra /ga le'i skor ni/dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs pa

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las ga bam gsum pa/ rtog)'di rno myur drag rtsal thog dang 'dra ba'i phyir sgrub thabs man ngag las tshogos spyi srung las khyad par yang tig snying po'i bka' bsrung yin: zhes pa ltar/ sgos thems nas zin pa'i sgrub skor la/ spyi thems las/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs gsol kha bstod bskul dang : bkang gsol sogs las ldan 'ga' la spel zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje legs pa'i gsang sgrub srog gi spu gri zhes pa dang por 'bod pa/bar du rbad pa/ mtha' mar las la sbyor ba gsum bstan pa zhar byung shi sa gnad dbab bcas pa gnubs nam snying gis yi ger bkod pa/ bkang gso gsol kha chen mo phud skong (310bskogosa'adod re skong 'phrin las kyi spu gri la (zur/nang gses kyi gsol kha dgos gsol/ bkang ba kye gsan ma/ bstod pa rgyal ba shāka thub ma/ bskul lho nub mdangs bcas pa gnubs nas snying gi yi ger bkod pa/ gnad 'babs shi sa ar la gto pa dang : nor sgrub mngon shes na da pa brtag pa dang slob ma dang ni yon bdag dam 'gal bsgral dmar nag la sogs shin tu zab pa'i phyir snying gi bu la chig brgyud spel ba las dam med lus kyi bu la 'di mi bstan snying kyi dkyil du sbosashig sa mā ya khyad par yang zab gsang ba'i nor sgrub dang : cho 'phrul la sogs zab chos mthar thug pa bu la tshig brgyud yin phyir a the rgya zhes pa ltar/ dam can srog gi gnad 'bebs shi sa.ar la gtod thabs(ni ge snying gi bu gcig las spel mi rung ba/ dam can gyi nor sgrub rin cen gter mdzod 6)phrad shog gi mtha' can/ pra mo la brten pa'i mngon shes(ra khyu zur / ba pa dang dgra la (thu rtags nam yong gsal ston/ nad pa 'tsho 'chi brtag pa/ slob ma snying ring bsgral (zugeb/ yon bdag dam log (klu ge bsgral ba/ thag ring du 'gro na don rṣa 'grub mi 'grub brtag pa/them med/ dgra la khrag gzer dmar (zur/nad gtong ba/ nor sgrub snying gi dum bu ci bsam grub par the tshom med pa'i mtha' can/ sgo ra/ nor sgrub gnad yig yang bakhres/ 4sar/ jag 'ching zab slo/ them med/ mdos gzhud 'a (klu ge mo zhes pa sri'u gso ba/ thems med/ rbod gtong bzlog pa/ dgra la rbad pa sogs kyi kha bsgyur dang bcas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can sgos thems dang bcas pa rnams/—451

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzhi pa ngan sngags kun gyi mthar thug phung 3na ) byed las kyi rlung dmar ni thems yig las/kye ma phung byed las kyi rlung dmar 'di ngan sngags kun gyi mthar thug 'di yin te rgyud dang gdams pa spra 'khrid man ngag bzhi 'byed pa'i las dang dkrug byed mdze rkang ma bskrad pa dang ni so so'i dpe chung dang :gnad kyi man ngag bsrung ba la sogs te sna res 'jig rten phung las tsā ba pa'i phyir snying bu lnga las 'di nyid spel mi rung :thams cad rdzogs na rgyal khams rlung la bskur snyigs ma'i sems can nyal thag 'dis gcod pas bsam med zhe sdang can la 'di spel na padma nga bslus bka' chad sna dgu 'byung :bstan 'dzin snying gi bu gcig ma gtogs pa spel du mi rung dam tshig sa mā ya zhes pa ltar/rlung dmar gyi sgos thems bka' rgya can/de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/phung byed nag po 'khrugs byed las kyi rlung dmar gyi rgyud le'u gsum pa/'khrugs byed las kyi rlung dmar gyi gdams pa 'khor lo 'a po rgyal khams phung byed/'bor lo 'bring po grong khyer dkrug byed/'khor lo chung ba bza' tshang dkrug byed/dus/sbyor lugs/srog shing /sngags byang skad/thun/ltas rnams ston pa'i zhal gdams spra 'khrid gsal ba/bsrung 'khor/mi rdug pa/khyad par gyi rdzasarnams ston pa yang gces gab sbas gnad kyi man ngag/lha dbye gtor sngags dmod bcol bcas pa zur du bkol ba/spyan 'dren nub byang ma/bskul ri rab 'a mo/'bor lo'i bskul shar nas nub bskyod ma rnams bsdoms par rlung lha'i las byang sbu grir grags pa/gnam the dang 'gong po'i bskul o rgyan thugs kyi brnag pa/'di yan gyis kyang sgrub nus31ba ) pas sgom thems su/rgyud dang gdams pa spra 'khrid man ngag dang so so'i dpe chung 'byed pa'i las lnga yis phung lasahrūb po snying gi dkyil du chongs zhes pas so//log gnon gab pa'i spra 'khrid khyad par can/kha bsgyur las tshogos la nang gses kyi pho rog 'ug pa'i nye 'byed nyi zla thal rdeb bam rgyal po nye 'byed 'bru brgyad ma/grong khyer phung byed gtso bo nye 'byed gzong mchu ma/gza' tshang nye 'byed /na gcig ma/mdza' gnyis khed pa 'thab 'dzings

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnam/ dkrug byed mdze rkang nag po bskrad pa rta rgyugs ma/ bskrad pa mkha' lding nag po rnams ni shin tu gsang ba'i gnas yin pas/ 'khrug byed bskrad pa gnad kyi man ngag gsum gab pa'i gnad yig gces gnad bzhi 'dzom na 'di rnams yongs rdzogs rgyal khams rlung la bskur zhes so/ /dpe'u ris la/ gnam sa chu rlung me'i 'khor lo/ pho rgyud mo rgyud/ sde brgyad/ lha srin tsitta dkrug pa/ 'khrug byed bskrad pa nag po/ yab yum/ bu/ bu mo/ pho nya'i 'khor lo/ rang bsrung / mdze rkang / bskrad pa/nyi zla thal deb/ dom dred 'dre'i khang bu/ rlung sgom dang bcas pa rnams/lnga pa srid gsum dbang bsdud lha chen gu lang rlung gi zhags pa ni/ lha chen gu lang srid pa gsum la dbang : dbang sgrub la sogs ma bur bcas pa rnams bstan 'dzin snying gi bu mchog re 'dod med byams dang snying rje 'brel tshad don ldan pa'i bu la rig brgyud yin phyir u kha tham zhes pa ltar las spyi thems dang sgos thems su chos sde gsal kha mi 'dug cing / de la brten nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa dang rten gsum bca' thabs sogs las 'brel (312na〉mil gyi gter ma nas kha bskangs pa'i bsre bslad rnam grangs mang bas mthun mi mthun sna tshogs yong 'dug pa don la skyon che ba mi snang yang / lha ri ba lte btsun ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin phal cher thob pa la/ srid med kyi snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i sku dbang / phyag mtshan gyis rig pas khyab tshad dbang du 'du ba'i thugs dbang / bdud rtsis snyan grags khamasagasum khyab pa'i gsung dbang / zhags pas lha 'dre mi gsum sdud pa'i 'phrin las kyi dbang glegasabam gyis mi nor zas gsum gyi dngos grub thob pa'i yon to gyi dbang rnams legs par mnosanas/ lung la/ lte btsun ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos thugs srasang ga dbang grags par gsan dus ltar bkod pa'i dkar chag /chag lo rin cen chos rgyal gyis gter kha 'di dang las 'brel rtsal gyi rlung zhags gnyis zhus dag thub par snang gsungs par brten nas dpyad pa'i yi ge lce btsun gyisamadzod pa/ lha chen ma hā de wa'i rjes su gnang ba'i dbang gi cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis—453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (zhebastan pa/ yang gsang gi sgrub pa 'khor lo rlung gi las tsho gos zhes pa nang gses kyi srid pa'i mes po'i rten gcig la brten nas bsnyen pa bya thabs dang rtags yig gsang rten gyi nang bzhugs bca' thabs bcas pa snod min la shor na sa mā ya'i mtha' can/ de'i gnad kyi yi ge gces pa rten gyi yon tan/ las la sbyor lugs/ gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor/ bzlas pa'i grangs/ rten gyi gnad/ dam tshig bcas bstan pa snying gi bu la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bsnyen pa thengs pas zhag nyer gcig tu sgrub pa (312bskong dang 'dra'o sems la brnag gi mtha' can/ thugs rka'i 'khor lo la brten nas bsod nams rgyas par byed pa/ 'khor lo de'i bca' thabs yig chung / 'phrin las kha bsgyur la brten nas mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing tshe bsrung ba/ thod pa rgya gram la brten nas tshe bsod nams rgyas pa/ seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru la brten nas dbang du bya ba/ sngags kyi kha bsgyur te rlung 'khor gyi rtsab lta bu'i gdams pa nyung ngu / gal te ma 'grub 'gyangs na gnad la dbab pa/ rlung 'khor tsakra'i bri yig yang gsang tsakra dbang phyug sto 'khor gyi bri yig rnams dbang byug mthar thug srog rtsa snying gi me long zhes par nang gses kyi sngags thems gsang ba'i man ngag gab pa'i gnad yig 'du long 'dod na 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mtha' can/ phyi nyi zla rlung zhags kyis rgyal khams bsdu ba'i sngags rgod/ mo chagatshodabang sdud kyi rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin/ gsang ba lag bsgul gyi 'khor lo la brten nas lag pa bsgul ba/ gsang ba snying bsgul gyi sgrub pa/ las mtha' shin tu zab pa'i skor la/ rgyal bu phu 'debs la brten nas drag po'i sngags rgod dam nyams bsgral ba'i mtshon cha/ bza' mi 'byed pa'i shog dril/ bud med zla mtshan 'dzag thabs/ dgra bo bu chung bsgral ba/ bud med kyi stu mthu/ nor la me spar nas bsrung ba/ 'jig rten gsal mthong / bud med zla mtshan 'gugs pa rnams gter kha gzhan nas 'di'i cha lag tu mdzad pa/ bstod bskur rgya mtsho glong dkyil ma/ sgab 'dre mnan thabs/dpe dkar bsrung ba chu glang rtse mo'i gter ma rnams/ dpe ris la/ sgrub rten gyi bcang gzhi/ sgom pa'i dbang sdud 'khor lo/ gnad (313na bebs 'khor lo rlung 'khor/ rlung khang rlung g.yab/—454

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gsang ba'i 'khor lo bcas pa rnams/drug pa phan gnod gdams pa kha 'thor sna tshogs kyi skor ni/skyin thang ser ba dbab dang bsrung ba dang :char pa 'bebs bsrung mi rgod jag 'ching dang :dzo la'i nor sgrub lag bskul sgrub pa dang rnal 'byor lus bsrung rdzas rgod spyor ba rnams shin tu zab phyir snod ldan bu la gtad ces pa ltar/dmar 'thab skyin thang gi drag sngags ser ba 'bebs thabs gza' bdud la gnyer du gtad ba/ser ba bsrung pa'i gdams pa sbu gri thog gcod gnad kyi gdams pa don bdun pa/char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu zhar byung yang zab char bsrung gong gi char 'bebs 'kha shes dang bcas pa/phung byed kha 'ching jag pa 'ching ba'i man ngag bstan pa 'dzin pa'i btsas su bzhag pa/gnod sbyin gas la ser po nor sgrub rin cen gter bum rnams/rdzas sbyor dang gzhan yang mdze po'i kha gtad sogs yig sna lnga tsam thems kyis zin kyang rgyun ma rnyed pa slar yang phyogs 'di la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dag las 'bad pas btsal bar bya'o//de yang thems yig rnams dang zhib tu bstun pa ni/de ltar bla med brjod dka' gdams pa'i tshogs brjod par 'phang yang gsang thems 'di ru bkod ci phyir ma 'ongs las can bu nyid dang de yi brgyud 'dzin bka' babs bu rnams don zab gter gnyan gyi bka' rgya 'jigs pa dang :man ngag zab mo zhabrugs shing 'thor dogs nas gzhan du gab nas 'di ru sbas te bzhag:ces so//de ltar rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi 313ba'i bang phran brgyad dang sa bcad drug pa yan gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku tso tu bzang po/drug pa rdo rje 44 rṣa/longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/rigs 'dzin shrī sidha/dran mchog skyon wo po/jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas/gter ston chos rgyal ratna gling pa/des rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa dang 'khrul zhig don grub rgyal po gnyis la gnang /de gnyis la mtshungs med ngag dbang grags pa/de nas rtogs ldan sangs rgyas grags pa/rje ngag dbang nor bu/mtshungs med nor bu yongs 'di'i mtshan la nor ga tshe dbang yong grags dang bo/sa grag rnam rgyal yang ra/grags/de sras 'phrin las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rgya mtsho/'khrul zhig nor bu chos brtan/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/rtsa ba'i bla ma sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin du stsal to//yang ga'i rtags yod pa'i dbang lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub nas/rang grol rkarma gsang sngags/khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o//yang na yongs grags rnam rgyal nas/rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra/skadze gsang sngags man 'dra/yang pha'i rtags yod pa'i dbang lung gi brgyud lugs gcig ni/rje ngag dbang grags pa nas/rje btsun sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/mtshudas med sangs rgyas bde chen/nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa nyi zla sangs rgyas/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/des bdag za hor bande la bka' drin du rtsal ba theg mchog a ti'i zab chos dang 314nasgo jal ba'i thog ma'o//zur gyi rtags yod pa'i dbang lung gi brgyud lugs gcig dang nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa nas/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//dpal mgon ma ning nag po' srog dbang bsdus pa gtor ma la brten pa dang lung yongasardzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku thod 'phreng rigs lnga/thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs lnga/chos rgyal ratna gling pa/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/thugs srasang ga dbang grags pa/gu ru kun dga' grags pa/brgyud 'dzin kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ka thog pa dbang grags rdo rje/rigs 'dzan du ma rang grol/ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/drin can chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//srog dbang rgyas pa'i brgyud pa ni/nor bu yongs grags nas/mkhas grub 'phrin las rgya mtsho/nyang chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzan/rtsa ba'i bla ma gter bdag gling pa/de bdag la'o//gza' rgod dug gi spu gri'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/rdo rje lang /rdo rje sems dpa'/gsang ba'i bdag 4 //ga 'a rab rdo rje/shrī sidha/o rgyan rin po che/ye

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganashes 'tsho rgyal/lang 'gro lo tsā ba/gter ston ratna gling pa/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/thugasasrasang ga dbang grags pa/rje ngag dbang nor bu/mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags/sngags yong dbang chen lhun grub/spel lcog sangs rgyas phun tshogs/chos ldan pa 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/gter ston rigs 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/des bdag la'o//yang byang gi rtags yod pa'i lung 34ba ) brgyud lugs gcig ni rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/dpa' bo mtha' yas grags pa/mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/chos rgyal ba po shis stobasargyal/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//rdo rje legs pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/gsang ba'i bdag po/dga' rab rdo rje/shrī sidha/padma thod phreng /mkhar wo bza'/lang 'gro lo tsā ba/sprul sku ratna gling pa/gnyen tshe dbang grags pa/gcung ngag dbang grags pa/gar dbang las 'phro gling pa/gu ru 'jig rten mgon po/spel lcog sangs rgyas phun tshogs/bya bto nor bu chos brtan/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/thugs sras gter bdag gling pa/des bdag la'o//yang na rje 'phrin lasalhun grub nas/rang grol dme gsang sngags/khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag la'o//zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/dpa' bo mtha' yasagrags pa/rje ngag dbang lhun grub/mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa/snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/rje kun dga' tshe mchog/sngags44 gas nu don grub/drin can chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//gsol kha ni kun dga' tshe mchog nas/ngag dbang ye grub/zur rtsa ba'i bla ma las brgyud do/rlung dmar gyi brgyud pa ni/kun bzang he ru ka/gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul/mkha' 'gro lasakyi dbang mo che/slob dpon rom bu gu ༅ /gu ru padma khrung gnas/lang 'gro lo tsā ba das cog 'byung gnas/gter ston ratna nga pa/de sras tshe dbang grags pa/35na tshe khu kha ngag dbang gragasapa/rje ngag dbang nor bu/mtshungs med nor bu /ngas grags/chos sdings sngags 'a4 dbang wo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shelhun grub/ ratna sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /lha chen gu lang rlung zhags skor gyi dbang / gsang ba snying bskulayan gyi lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ mgon po klu sgrub/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/ sprul sku ratna gling pa/ sras tshe dbang grags pa/rje ngag dbang grags pa/ lce bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bla ma padma gar dbang / gnyag gi sprul pa kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de bdag la'o/ /me long dgon pa padma gar dbang gis lha ri ba bsod nams rgya mtsho la lha chen gyi skor zhusanas tshur byon pas 'bri gung zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi gzigs snang la mi ma gis zangs kyi srid mes thog tshad cig khur 'gro gyi 'dug ces gsungs shing bla ma de la lha chen shin tu 'go ba yin skad/ de'i rjes su bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / du ma rang grol sogs gsan yig mang por 'dug pa ni/dpyad pa ma byung ba'i dkyus shor ma gtogos 'di'i brgyud par med/ padma gar dbang la kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyi sku skye gong ma kun dga' bkra shis sam drung pa dkon cog par grags pasagasan pa yin no/ /lung yongs su rdzogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje ngag dbang grags pa nas/ mtshungasamed ngag dbang nor bu/ bi mā'i sprul pa nor bu yongs grags/ de sras karma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/(315ba)ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ 'khrul zhig don grub rgyal po/ rje ngag dbang grags pa man 'dra/yang na ngag dbang grags pa nas/ rtogs ldan sangs rgyas grags pa/ drin can ngag dbang nor bu man gong bca no/ /yang sprul pa'i skyes mchog rigs 'dzin zhig po gling pas dgung lo sum cu pa la ri bo khyung chen lding ba nas zab gter kun gyi thog mar spyan drangs pa'i sku gsum yongs rdzogs rtsa ba gsum gyi gdams pa 'bras bu'i don 'khrid kyi skor la/ thang mig gi khyung sgo brag la lhas pa 'ag kha ni tshe por 'di ṣka —458

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganado/ /gtor ma la brten nas bla ma'i dbang / bum pa la brten nas yi dam gyi dbang / me long la brten nas mkha' 'gro'i dbang / bdud rtsi la brten nas rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi dbang rnamasalegs pa mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ zab gter snying gi gdams pa'i kha byang thems kyi lde mig /de las byung ba'i chos sde la yang gter rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i skor/ rang gzhan grol byed don 'khrid kyi skor/ kun la gces pa rgyab chos kyi skor dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtsa gsum yang gter gdamasaskor dang po la srog gi dngas ma bla ma'i gsang sgrub dang : kun gyi mthar thug yi dam bum sgrub dang :'gro 'dul dbang sdud dha gi gnad drug dang : dbang sgrub lag len bzhi yis gdams pa tshang :sku gsum rgya yis btab yod sa mā ya zhes pa ltar/ dngos grub kun 'byung srog gi dngas ma pha dang 'dra ba bla ma'i thugs sgrub don bcu gcig gis bstan pa thugs sras khyod dang 'di phrad shog gi mtha' can/ (316na)kun gyi mthar thug bdag gzhan kun grol thugs rje chen po'i chos yi dam bum sgrub sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis bstan pa thang la pho zhig rdo rje legs zhes pa'i mtha' can/ 'gro 'dul dbang sdud ma dang 'dra ba ḍā gi thod rgal gnad kyi sgrub thabs rnal 'byor gsum ldan sgo nas sgrub pa khyung chen brag la a tham rgya'i mtha' can/ gdul bya smin par byed pa dbang chog bdud rtsi bum pa/de'i rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i dbang don du dril ba'i lag len gnad yig phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa rang gzhan grol byed don 'brid kyi skor ni/ rang gzhan grol byed 'bras bu'i don 'khrid la mtha' rten nyams len gol sa bcad thabs dang : dkyil 'khor gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs lam mchog 'khrid kyi gdams pa de yis tshang : zhes pa ltar/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum ga tshe gcig gis mngon 'tshang rgya ba lam mchog sku gsum 'bras bu'i don 'khrid/ mtha' rten gyi man ngag ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i gol sa gcod thabs sangs rgyas lag bcang mkhar chen bzas slob dpon la zhus pa/ skal ldan yang rab thug phrad thems med/ du 'tshang rgya ba'i don 'khrid lag bcang zhes pa bu tshal gser khang du lha sras kyis zhus te gnang ba 'tsho rgyal gyis dkar chag yi ger 459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebatab pa/rdzogs chen 'bras bu don gyi 'khrid gzhung tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag bcang gter bdag gtsang btsan brag btsan la gtad pa/yang bcud snying po sgril ba don bsdus nor bu'i gsang them med/'khrid bcud kyi yang bcud snying po phyung ba gter ston gyi mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i 316ba ) brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs/thems med/chu rgyud nang dmigs med spros bral ma/dkyil 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs zab mo srog gi dngas ma/lta sgom spyod 'bras rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdamasa'aphrad chog mthong bas rang grol o rgyan nga'i snying tshogs chung don che tshig tshogs nyung ngur bsdus pa rnams ni/gsum pa kun las gces pa rgyab chos kyi skor ni/de dag kun la gces pa'i rgyab chos ni tshe sgrub 'pho ba bar do ngo sprod dang :spyi gnad bla rdo la sogs gnad 'bebs dang :lag len tho yig ga kho ston skyes rabs dang :dam yi rdor legs dug gi reg gcod dang :brag btso dmar po cog brdung sbu gri sogs gdams skor bco brgyad dag gis chos ka tshang :zhes pa ltar/gshin rje'i zin kyang bzlog par nus pa tshe sgrub gshin rje'i gdong bzlog 'di las zab pa yod re rkan zhes bro bor ba gser khang gling du yi ge btab pa/dran pas 'tshang rgya ba 'od gsal 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'khor ba ldog med/gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i 'pho ba'i ye shes gsang lam/le lo can grol bar byed pa bar do gnad kyi zhal gdams/ḍā gi spyi gnad bla rdo'i 'khor lo padma'i snying khrag/mkha' 'gro'i gnad 'babs bcud kyi dum bu'i thigs pa/ma 'ongs skal ldan 'dren phyir yang gter zhal gdamasasnying gi dum bu/zhal gdams thor bu 'tsho rgyal gyis zhus pa'i tshig gsum ma/them med/zhal gdamasagand kyi thor bu smon lam 'chal ba'i mtha' can/thems med/snying gtam bcas su bzhag pa rigs kyi bu la dang du long zhig pa/them med/mthong bas yid ches bskyed pa gter ston gyi skyes rabs gsal ba'i sgron me lung bstan lde mig/317na po ma can rdo rje legs pa'i sgrub thabs reg gcod dug gi spu gri/brag btsun dmar po srog gi cog brdung /yab yum gsang ba/them ca/bcud thig gi rilabu'i dkar chag rnams legs par mnos la laXbang gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/

dam pa' chos kyi gsan yog gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganalo mes sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/mkha' 'grom shes 'tsho rgyal/lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas/chos rgyal zhig po gling pa/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/gcung ngag dbang grags pa/rje ngag dbang nor bu/rigs 'dzin nor bu yongs grags/mtshungs med nor bu yongasagrags/padma gsung gi sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub/grub chen da rma gsang sngags/khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/des bdag za hor bande gang shar rang grol la bka' drin du stsal to//yang na nor bu yongs grags/chos sdings dbang chen lhun grub/spel lcog sangs rgyas phun tshogs/chos ldan 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/drin can gter bdag gling pa/desabadag la'o//lung gi brgyud pa ni/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub nas/zur thams cad mkhyen pa chosadabyings rang grol/des bdag la'o//rigs 'dzin chen po zhig po gling pas mkhar chu dpal gyi phug rings kyi byang ngos zla gam steng nas yar gzhal ba'i g.yas phug brag nas gdan drangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po mun sel nyi ma'i snying po chos skor la/thems yig gser gyi thur ma zhes pa gab 'khrugs med pa'i bka' rtsis thems byang /de las byung ba'i chos skor la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/dang po la/lo rgyus37bskos la ba'i sgron me 'tsho rgyal/shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/shel dkar mgon skyid/lha sras rnams la chos 'di gdams pa'i mtha' can/brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs chosanyid spros bral ma/them ṣka/sngon 'gro rin po che'i sgron me zhes pa bla ma slob ma man ngag gi mtshan nyid gsum dang las 'bras/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/maṇḍal/bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbang ste spyi don drug gis gtan la dbab pa'i man ngag rnams/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dus gsum sangs rgyas nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu phyag rgya chen por mun sel nyi ma'i snying po'i 'khrid gzhung chen mo o rgyan padma'i thugs bcud yang dag pa/gnad kyi gegs sel lhan thabs gsal sgron zhal gyi gdams pa /༷ gsum ma rnams/thems med/gsum pa rjes la/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ne'akhrid yig gi rjes kyi gdams pa zhes pa skyong thabs/dam tshig/bka' rgya/bsngo ba ste don bzhisaston pa rin cen rgyan 'phreng /zhu lan lung byang gsal ba 'am zab mo snying byang zhal gdams rnamasathos pa'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku kun tu bzang po/longs sku rdo rje 'chang rsā/sprul sku me shes mkha' 'gro/slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/jo mo mkhar rṣa bza'/shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/shel dkar rdo rje/shel dkar mgon skyid/lha sras mu ne bas po/lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas/sprul sku zhig po gling ba/rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/de srasang ga dbang nor bu/mtshudas med nor bu yongs grags/dme 'phrin las rgya mtsho/sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/dar sdings rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/zur khyab 38na ) bdag chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//chos rgyal ratna gling pas gnyal smad dge ri spyang dmar chos rdzong gi gsang phug dmar po glang ru'i dbyibs 'dra ba nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos ni/bka'i rgya thems rin cen sgrom bu las/'di ni rjes 'a sun su dang sus bsgrubs kyang rnga yab gnas nas gu ru padma yis rgyun chad med par thugasarjes mi 'dzin re the tshom med dang dam tshig gtsang ba gces gsol ba thob cig rjes 'dug rig ldan rnams bu la dungs pa'i ma ltar bdag gis skyob nyams dang rmi lam dngos kyi tshul du yang tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bu dang zhal mjal nas ngo sprod dbang bskur chos la ra lung yang ston bslus na padma zhal no rjes 'asdug rnams zhes pa'i brjod don ltar thugs sgrub kun gyi nang nas zab cing rgya che ba don 'dril ba bka' gsang snying po'i yang zhun/rigs 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi thugasabacud/bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma/thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa yid bzhin gyi snying po bsam 'phel lta bu'i chos skor la/thog mar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog 'phreng ba/rtsa ba'i dbang lnga rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/rjes gnang gi dbang rim brgyad/rigs lnga sku'i dbang /lha dbang /sku gaXng thugs kyi rjes gnang /rang lus nang gi dkyil

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)'khor la brten nas gsang dbang /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang /sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje tshig gi dbang /rjes su gnang ba 'phrin las brgyad kyi dbang /dam tshig bsgrags cing the tshom 318ba ) gcod pa dang bcas so//dbang chog yid bzhi nor bu'i steng nas6)brgyud 'dzin 'gro don nus pa'i bu la gdamasapa gtad rgya'i dbang rnams smin rgyas su mnos nas/rgyab rten lung la/thugs sgrub yongs rdzogs yang snying 'dus pa'i bka' rgya thems byang rin cen sgrom bu/de nyid las/gdams pa 'di la chos skor rim gsum ste sgrub ba sgrub chen kha skong las tshogs skor zhes gsungs pa ltar/spros med rang don tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa bla ma sku gsung sgrub pa'i skor/spros bcas gzhan don du 'khor tshom bu dang bcas byang chub bsgrub pa sgrub pa chen po'i skor/de dag gi ma tshang ba'i kha skong zhing 'phrin las ga' na phan sgrub pa la sna tshogs pa'i skor dang gsum/dang po la/bsnyen sgrub dmar 'khrid sgrub pa'i khog 'bubs dang :sku gsum rang rang sgrub pa'i skor la gsum snying po'i gdams pa gsang 'khrid rim lnga dang sku gsum thugs 'khor sgrub pa'i kha skong yin de bas mang nyung byung na lhag chad de mthar thug snying po'i don yig snying la chongs zhes pa ltar/bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i khog phub sbyor ba spra 'khrid chen mo don gsum gyis bstan pa bsnyen sgrub kho na'i sgrub khog/bla ma sprul skur sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum tshang ba zab pa'i mthar thug/bla ma longs sku'i sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub las sbyor tshang ba mthar thug don gyi snying po o rgyan gsung bzhin nam mkha'i snying pos bris pa/bla ma chos sku'i sgrub thabs sgrub pa kun gyi snying mchog o rgyan thugs kyi yang bcud gsang sgrub rjes kyi las sbyor dang bcas pa/gu ru sku lnga'i gsang 'khrid rim pa lnga pa zhes pa 'dod chags kyi ngo bo sbyang ba bde stong gtum mo'i 'khrid/zhe sdang 319na gi ngo bo sbyang ba sgyu lus bar do'i 'khrid/gti mug gi ngo bo sbyang ba rmi lam 'od gsal gyi 'khrid/nga rgyal gyi ngo bo sbyang ba mnyam nyid phyag chen gyi 'khrid/phrag dog gi ngo bo sbyang ba pogs 'don gsang spyod kyi 'khrid /mas ston pa mkhar rṣa bzas yi ger bkod pa/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()sgrub pa la bar gcod mi 'byung zhing dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa steng 'khor gsang 'og 'khor rnams kyi bri yig/rtsa gsum rang dang 'du 'bral med pa'i gces gnad bla rdo srog 'khar bri yig dang bcad thabs bstan pa/gsang 'khrid gtum mo'i cha lag lus sbyor 'khrul 'khor rtsa tshig/74med/rtsa rlung thig le'i zab mo'i gnad kyi gegs sel chig brgyud ma gtogos mi spel bar padma'i shangs tshal las snag tsha byas te byin rlabs kyi yi ger bkod pa/them med/zab mo thabs lam zung 'jug rdo rje gsang ba'i them skas spyi don lngas bstan pa rigs 'dzin padmas sbyar ba/them med/de'i bu yig ṭwāṃXsdu /na phyag rgya'i mtshan dpyad dri med shel gyi me long skyon padma sam bha was bkod pa rnams/gnyis pa spros bcas ga' na don du 'khor tshom bu dang cas byang chub bsgrub pa sgrub pa chen po'i skor la/rtsab yan lag/kha skong dang gsum/dang po la/gsang sgrub mu po'i thems byang bstan pa ni sgrub khog wo mo kun gyi skye byed ma dbang gi rdzong 'a gsang dbang skor dang gsum dbang byang bka' ba de bzhi ma yig yin de yi bu yig 'dzab dgongs me mchod dang gzhal yas don bstod de gsum bu yig go zhes pa ltar/sgrub pa chen po'i khog 'bub spra 'khrid dbang gi gru bo zhes pa jo mo/gnubs nam snying 319bsgong 'a bdag/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/lang 'gro dkon cog phung gnas lnga'i don du mdzad pa/thugs sgrub rṣa mo'i dbang gi rdzong wo don bdun gyi sgo nas bstan pa/dbang gong ma gsum gyi bskur thabs gsang dbang gser gyi them skas phyon gyisamadzad pa/sta gon gyi lhan thabs man ngag dbang byang bkol ba o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa rnams/gnyis pa yan lag la/'dzab bstod gsal ba'i 'phreng ba/'phrin las bzhi myur 'grub me mchod sbyin sreg gi cho ga zab mo o rgyan gsung bzhin gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying pos bkod pa/gzhal yas don bstod ma bcos rang bzhin ma 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa rnams/gsum pa kha skong la/'khor ba dong sprug myong grol skye bdun kyi sgrub pa'i man ༷༷ bsam yas dbu rtse byang tso ོ po sku rgyab nas

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ (gnaspyan drangs pa/them med/bdud rtsi sman gyi pho brang la rigs 'dzin byin 'bebs chen po skyon gsung bzhin mkhar chen bzas bkod pa/grub chen gsang ba'i las sbyor gtor ma zor du 'phang ba'i bskul byang dam bdar 'og min chos dbyings ma lan cig ni thems med/brjod pas dam can las la rgyugs pa bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha rnams/gsum pa de dag gi ma tshang ba kha skong zhing 'phrin lasagazhan phan sgrub pa las tshogis kyi skor la/gsang sngags spyi sdom/sgrub dbang kun gyi kha skong rnal 'byor mnog chos sgrub pa'i rang gzhung /gdams skor yongs rdzogs kyi kha skong /rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog nyams chag kyi kha skong /gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin spyi la gces pa'i chos/'phrin las kha bsgyur/gang 'dul gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i chos/sgrub pa mthar 'don 320na gi yeng ba 'dor ba'i chos/ngo mtshar bskyed pa dang gnas skabs nyer mkho'i las phran dang bcu/dang po ni/kha stong las tshogis skor la rgya thems ni chos spyod lam rim gsang sngags spyi yi sdom zhes pa ltar/gsang sngags spyi chings chos spyod lam gyi rim pa chen mo skyon chen pos mdzad pa/gnyis pa sgrub dbang kun gyi kha stong ni/las byang sgrub mchod kun gyi kha stong yin zhes pa ltar/bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs shing bla med 'bras bu thob par byed pa las byang rin cen 'phreng ba slob dpon gyis gsung bzhin gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos bkod pa/las byang sgom khog 'bru 'grel mun sel sgron me gter ston gyis mdzad pa/pa med/las byang gi kha skong bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod 'phreng gnubasanam snying gi bkod pa rnams/them med/gsum pa rnal 'byor mnog chos sgrub pa'i rang gzhung ni/bdud rtsi sman sgrub drag po'i hūṃ sgrub gnyis rnal 'byor mnog chos sgrub pa'i rang gzhung yin zhesapa ltar/yon tan kun 'byung bdud rtsi sman gyi gsang sgrub chen mo mdo don rim pa gsum gyis bstan pa skyon mkhan po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/thugs bcud gsang ba bla na med pa drag po thugasakyi hūṃ sgrub/rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi rnam par dbye ba'i lde mig bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa'i yig chung slob dpon nyid la zhus te 'tsho rgyal gyis yi ge/ 6bkod pa/thems med/bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi gnad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebyang spra 'khrid lag len yig chung bkol ba/ dam sri myul le brtag pa dang 'dul rdzas sman gyi srung ma kun thub rgyal mo'i bskul
