dang bcas pa/ thems med/ srung ma rnams kyis dngos grub skyel ba'i rtagasadang dngos grub bskul chog (320bskond 'phyong zab mo sirnyi/ them med/ bdud rtsi sman gyi man ngag yig chung bkol ba lha dang rmu thag sbrel ba'i lag len zab mo/ thems ra/ sgrub pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa gsog thabs le'u gsum pa gud du bkol ba rnams/ thems ra/ bzhi pa gdams skor yongs rdzogs kyi kha skong ni/ sa dpyad gter lung gtad rgya gsang ba gsum gdams skor yongasardzogs kun gyi kha skong yin zhes pa ltar/ sgrub pa'i gnas kyi sa dpyad 'phrin las bzhi spyi mthun dang bye brag tu rgyas par bstan pa gser gyi lde mig padmas ma 'ongs don du brtsams pa/ gter lung gsal ba'i me long zhes pa bram ze pra chen hasti'i thugs kyi zhun thigs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi spyan drangs pa sogs ngo mtshar rten dang dam rdzas kyi lo rgyus/ thugs sgrub spel ba'i gsang ba'i zhal gdams rgya thems gtad rgya gsang ba rnams/lnga pa rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog nyams chags kyi kha skong ni/ bkang bshags dang ni gtor bzlog chen mo gnyis: rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog nyams chags bkang mdos yin zhes pa ltar/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bkang bshags dri med rab gsal slob dpon chen pos mkhar chen bza' la gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gtor bzlog rṣa mo zor cog 9)dang cas shin tu zab pa snying khrag gi dngas ma lta bu/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i las byang chen mo tsho gis mchod dang (ka)bcas pa sbyor dngos 'jug gsum gyis bstan pa/ mkha' 'gro 'bum tsho nyi shu'i bskul dur khrod rab 9)'jigs ma bro brdung dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro gling bzhi srid pa spyi mdos rdzas bsag pa/ 'phrin las gyer pa zor 'phang ste gsum gyis bstan pa shin tu bka' gnyan pa slob dpon chen po padma thod 'phreng gis mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gter (321na tha zlog gi las tsho gis zhes pa dal yams/ dmag 'byug bzlog pa/ gdon chen/ smyo bog 'dul ba/ ltasang na bzlog pa/ ru tra bsgral 466

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam gsum pa/ rtoganab/rbod gtong bzlog pa ste kha bsgyur bdun gyis bstan pa/mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gi lag len 'phyong dang bcas pa/mkha' 'gro'i bsu bzlog dar lam zhus lan bdun pa gong ma/slob dpon kyi bya ba'i zhus lan bdun rting ma zhar byung mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bzhugs par gsol ba/bsu bzlog gi mdos gzhud 'og ma bzlog bsgyur rnams/drug pa gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin spyi gzhes kyi chos ni/zhal thems gsang ba rgyud gtad cho ga gnyis gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin spyi la gces pa yin zhes pa ltar/rje 'bangs lngas gsang 'khrid rim lnga zhus dus gsungs pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis da'i zhal gdams gnad kyi 'phreng ba mkhar chen bzas yi ger bkod pa/skal ldan gyi bu la brgyud pa gto pa'i rjes gnang 4 gdams pa gto rgya'i dbang chog yid bzhin nor bu padma thod 'phreng gis dge ba mtha' kyi rgyas gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa/bdun pa 'phrin las kha bsgyur ni/stobs ldan rlung 'khor 'phrin las sgrub pa'i skor zhes pa ltar/'byung ba rlung la lasabacol nas 'phrin las bzhi myur du 'grub byed stod ldan drag po rlung gi 'khor lo/de'i cha rkyen 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor lo'i gnad thems sam man ngag zhal shes las byed rlung 'khor/thems med/gzhung du ma thus pa'i sngags byang rlung 'khor gyi man ngag zhal shes gud du sbas pa bcu bzhi rnams/them med/brgyad pa gang 'dul gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i chos ni/rten gsum rab gnas bdun tshigs gshin don sogs gang 'dul re skong 321bgi du la bya'i don rṣa yin zhes pa ltar/rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dri med rab tu gsal ba'i sgron med slob dpon padma saṃ bha was mdzad pa/gshin don bdun tshigs kyi rim pa 'khor ba dong sprug slob dpon rṣa po padmas mdzad pa/des mdzad pa'i ro bsreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus gnas ga bag chags phyir mi ldog pa/sku gdung su tsā'i rim pa zhesapar nang gses kyi dngos gzhi dang las tshogs la 'byung bzhi'i sum byang chub sgrub pa/sgrib sbyong /tshe sgrub/nor spel/sri'u gso ba/phur kha zor kha bzlog pa/'dul khrims nyams gso/dam tshig nyams gso/zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha bsgyur ba// pa skyon chen po'i gsung bzhin mkhar chen bza'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chos 'byung ko ro brag tu bkod pa rnams/dgu pa sgrub pa mthar 'don g.yeng ba 'dor pa'i chos ni/bcud len zab mo stobs bskyed tshe sgrub rnams sgrub pa mthar 'don g.yeng ba 'dor chos yin zhes pa ltar/shin tu zab pa 'od ldan rtag tu ngu'i bcud len zhes pa rtag cing 'thu ba/bskams te 'thag pa/brdang zhing byin gyis brlab pa ril bu sbyar ba/las sna tshogs kyi sgo nas za thabs te don ༄lngas bstan pa/tshe sgrub gsang ba'i bka' rgya ma zhes pa phyag rgya ma tshe lam can mtshan ldan la brten nas bsgrub pa dang dmigs bzlas la brten nas bsgrub pa/bya sla tshegs chung yon tan che ba gsang chen bdud rtsi'i bstod len rnams them med/bcu pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa dang gnas skabs nyer mkho'i las phran la/dpal bsam yas su rje 'bangs lngas thugs sgrub zhus dus lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas kyis gser gyi maṇḍal g.yu'i phra can phul nas zhus pa'i zhu lan chen mo gnad kyi lde mig zhal gdams 322na ) bka' rgya ma themasamed/jo mo dang lo tsā ba gnyis bsdur nas bsam yas dbu rtse bar ma'i shar sgor yi ger bkod pa/sngon 'gro thod pa brtag cing bcas bsham pa/dngos gzhi sgrub cing rtags dang las sbyor dam tshig/lo re bzhin bskyar sgrub phan yon/rjes 'bras bu/zhan byung 'khor lo'i bris yig bstan pa'i thod sgrub rin cen 'bar ba/them med/gud du sbas pa'i las tshogos bco lnga zhes pa sgrib shing /them ra/rdzasakyi ras rkyang bya ba/phyag rgya dbang bsdud/gdon chen 'don pa/rims nad drag po dmar nad rgyu gzer/zho chang /phyugs nad glo gor bsrung ba/me rta ge nam mkhar sdod pa/gtor ma dang bum chu khol ba/mngon shes bsgrub pa/bskrad pa dang dkrug pa/rbod gtong byad bzlog dang bcas pa rnams rdzogasapar thob pa las spel ka khra'i rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung gnyis ga'i brgyud pa ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku padma thod 'phreng rtsal/mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/mnga' bdag khri srong lde ba 'a/lang ༷༷ dkon cog 'byung gnas/shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnagater ston chos kyi rgyal po ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ thugs srasang ga dbang gragasapa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang nor bu/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang yongs grags/ ga me 'phrin las rgya mtsho/mang thos dharma'i mtshan can/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyingasarang grol/ des bdag za hor gyi brje'i mnog chos su stsal ba'i bka' drin ni byang chub (322ba)kyi bar du yang gzhal bar dka'o/ /dbang / las byang / chos spyod lam rim chen po gsum gyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ thugasasrasang ga dbang grags pa nas/ rje sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ rje sangs rgyas bde chen/ mkhas grub nyi zla sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /stobs ldan rlung 'khor gyi gzhung / de'i zhal shes las byed rlung 'bor/ pho 'khor mo 'khor bar 'bor/ zhi drag gi sgro 'dab/ rlung khang gi dpe ris dang phyag len zhal shes dmar 'khrid bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/rigs 'dzin tshe dbang yongs grags nas/ sde ba yug pa nor bu dbang rgyal/ zur bla med rdo rje rtsal/rlung mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur kun mkhyen chosadabyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na thugs srasang ga dbang grags pa nas bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ me long dkon pa padma gar dbang / snang gsal ba drung dkon cog pa/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /ga'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/dar sdings rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ grub chen ga me gsang sngags/ khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /spe'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ badze 'phrin las rgya mtsho nas/ spe lcog bla ma dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thugs sras chos rje chos bzang / khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /khra'i rtags yod pa'i gdams gtad dbang brgyud ni/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ bla ma kun dga' grags pa/ rje kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ gu ru skyon bstan 'dzin/ rigs 'dzin (323na tsher ja' tshon snying po/ rtse le sprul sku padma legs grub rtsal/ sngags 'chang dme gsang —469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesngags/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston zhig po gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring gzims khang rta rgyun byang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor zla gam steng gi brag la rin po che'i dong tse klu'i nor bur rgya rim bdun btab pa'i bla ma drag po thugs sgrub me'i 'khor lo'i chos sgor sprul pa'i gter ston zhig po gling pas byi ba'i lo la spyan drangs pa ni/thems yig rin cen gter mdzod las/ 'on kyang gu ru drag po'i gter kha 'di mtha' dbus kun tu lnga las sbas pa med de rnams nang nas yang zab snying lta bu mthar thug thugs bcud snying po'i yang zhun 'di zhes dang / de ltar thugs sgrub drag po'i rgya thems bcas lho gter rin cen 'bras bu'i tshul du sbas: zhes gsung pa'i bod yul drag sgrub kun gyi nang nas gnyan las ches gnyan/ zab lasaches zab/ kha tshang don 'dril/ thugs kyi yang bcud gser sbyangs zhun ma lta bu'i skor thob pa la/gtor ma la brten nas chos sgo 'byed pa/ drag po thugs sgrub kyi gtor dbang bsdus pa/ gtor masabum dbang / phyag mtshan gyis 'phrin las/ bdud rtsis gsang dbang / go cha'i lhas mthu stobs yongs rdzogs/ sku gzugs kyis lha dbang / sku/ dam rdzas/ sgrub yig /bzlas pa/ 'phreng ba rnams kyis rgyasathebs/ rjes gtad rgya dam tshig dang bcas pa'i don dbang nor bu lugs/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du btang ba'i cod pan gyi dbang / bum pas sku gsung thugs yongasardzogs/ bhanta bdud rtsis bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku/ dpal (323ba)gtor gyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ phyag mtshan gyis 'phrin las bzhi/ dbu rgyan rgyas khams gsum srid gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang / dur khrod mas dbang / lha dbang gis rab 'byams yongs rdzogs/ 'chi med tshe'i —470

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la gleg bam gsum pa/ rtoganadabang / sngags dbang / rang gzugs kyis sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog dbang nga mar nag /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du sher dbang / ngo sprod la brten nas tshig dbang / zhar byung / me long man shel a la brten nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams smin rgyasasu mnos/ rgyab brten lung la/ byang dang 'khor gyi rtags med pa rnams gter ston dngos kyi phyag dpe mkhas grub nyang po don grub rgyal po'i phyag bris ma'i steng nas tshar gcig dang spe'i rtags med pa rnams glegs bam gzhan zhig las tshar gcig ste tshar gnyis thob pa la/ gter byung las zur du bkod pa'i phug (byang/ring gter kha phyi ma brtan pa'i lo rgyus/ thugs sgrub drag po'i thems yig lde mig rin cen gter mdzod/ de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/ khungs btsun che ba bskyed pa lo rgyus/ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang / lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur ba sgrub pa/ smin zin grol bar byed pa'i 'khrid yig /kun gyi kha skong zhing tshad bstan pa 'phrin las dang rtags yig /bye brag rkyang par sgrub pa go cha'i lha'i sgos sgrub/ lha bsnyen rgyad du bsgyur nasa'aphrin las kyi kha bsgyur las tshogos/ bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba dam can gter srung / gud du sbas pa'i yang gces gsang ba thugs tig dmar nag (324na)thems med skor dang dgu /dang po ni/thems yig las/ chos kyi khungs btsun che ba bskyed pa'i phyir lo rgyus ma na ngag snying gi ti ka 'di yid ches bskyed phyir 'ga' la bstan kyang rung : zhes pas khungs btsun yid ches bskyed pa lo rgyusagasang ba snying gi ti ka 'tsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyi btus te ā tsarla ye shes kyis bka' shog la btab pa/ gnyis pa ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang ni/ chos kyi sgo 'byed lusang ga yid gsum smin byin rlabs rtsa ba dbang gi rim pa gsum bsdus pa gtor dbang byin rlabs sprin phung dang :'bring po don dbang nor bu'i lugs su bskur rgyas pa dregs pa'i srog tig dmar nag la gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo rim pa gsum pha rol blo dang gang 'tsham bskur bar bya 'on kyang dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par phu bskul ba'i las can 'ga' re ma gtags pa rang gi srog las—471 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonegaces so zhib tu dpyod ces pa ltar chos sgo 'byed pa drag po thugs sgrub kyi gtor dbang byin rlabs kyi sprin phung ngam ting nge 'dzin gyi gtor dbang nor bu lugs su bskur pa/ gang zag spros pa la mi 'ga' ba smin byed dbang chog 'bring po dbang bzhi nor bu lugs su bskur ba don dbang dngos grub byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor gtor ma rin cen 'bar ba/ sman raka /tsho gis gtore/ phyag mtshan gyi dpe'u ris/ gang zag spros pa la dga' ba smin byed dbang chog chen mo rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig dmar nag slob dpon gsung bzhin gzung ma 'tsho rgyal gyis skyen par bshus pa gsang ba'i bka' rgya can/ mchog dbang gong ma gsum bskur thabs bde chen (324ba tshe ma bor lo gu ru'i phyag len dang gsung bzhin ā tsarla ye shes kyis dpal gyi phug ring shar gyi yang thog tu shur te bris pa rnams/ gsum pa lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags chos kyi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur bar sgrub pa ni/ phyi sgrub khro 'dus me yi 'khor lo dang : nang sgrub yang snying rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang gsang sgrub yang gsang bla med gsum po ni sgrub pa'i rtsa ba snying po yin pa'i phyir las can bu mchog 'ga' la spel yang rung : de yang gsang sgrub rang gi snying ltar gces yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po dang : bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs 'di su la mi spel snying la mnog chos yin kun la gces pa'i gnad yig gzer thig dang : kun gyi kha skong khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'di srog ltar bca'o snod min shor ra re zhes pa ltar phyi sgrub byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba khro 'dus me'i 'khor lo don gsum gyis bstan pa dbyangs can mas phyi rabs don du bkod pa/ de'i gtor ma rin cen 'bar ba'i dpe ris/ nang sgrub yang snying rdo rje'i 'phreng ba skyon gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis mkhar chu dpal phug tu bris pa/ de'i dkyil 'khor/ bum pa/ gtor ma rin cen 'bar ba/ sman gtor rakta'i dpe ris/ gsang sgrub yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po mkhar chen bzas gu ru'i gsung bzhin la yag mon mkhar steng nas mkhar chu phebs tshe bkod pa de'i dkyil 'khor/ bum pa/ gtor ma rin cen 'bar ba/ ba / me long /tshe chang / tshe ril/ tshe 'grang gi dpe ris/ yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po yid bzhin nor bur sgrub —472

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa phyon chen po'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis skye na par bris pa/ bla ma kun (325na〉dus yid bzhin nor bur sgrub thabs snying la mnog chos gu ru'i gsung bzhin dbri bsnan med par mkhar chen bzas skyen par bris pa/ de'i dkyil 'khor/ bum pa/ gtor mar rin cen 'bar ba/ sman raka gtor ma'i dpe ris/ sbu gri srog gcod kyi las tshogs zhes pa phan gnod las sbyor gang byed kyang kun la gcis pa'i man ngag las kyi 'phyong du btags pa gnad kyi gzer thig zhar byung shin tu thu na gdul thabs kyi las mtha' dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs kun gyi kha skong khro rgyal stobs 'dus gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo mkhar chen bzas slob dpon gsung bzhin mkhar chu rta rgyun du bris pa rnams/ bzhi pa smin zin grol bar byed pa'i 'khrid yig ni/ bla ma'i thugs 'khrid yid bzhin nor bu dang : snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu gnyis sbrel ba yang zab snying po yin no snying la chongs zhes pa ltar srog rtsa'i dngas ma lta bu tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i nye lam thugs sgrub drag po'i yang gces bla ma'i rdzogs rim thugs 'khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ rnal 'byor rgyun gyi nyams len spros med don gyi sgrub pa snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu thugs sgrub kun gyi yang snying byin rlabs rtsa ba/ gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i gsol (byang/'debs mi dmigs chos dbyings ma rnams/ them med/ lnga pa kun gyi kha stong zhing tshad bstan pa 'phrin las dang rtags yig ni/ kun gyi kha skong las byang me rlung 'khyil bstod bskul rnam rgyal rtags yig nyi zla'i 'phreng 'phrin las myur byed me yi 'phreng ba rnams kun la gces so spel tshod rig par rtogs zhes pa ltar kun gyi kha skong las byang me rlung 'khyil (325ba)pa sngon 'gro dngosagazhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ dus 'khrug /dal yams gdon 'dul/ ltas ga bzlog pa sreg zor sogs kyi skabs bya ba bstod bskul rnam rgyal (byang/'bar ba'am dur khrod me dpung ma/ sgrub pa'i bzang ngan rtags rim rnam par gsal ba ston pa nyi zla'i 'phreng ba o rgyan chen po'i gsung bzhin mkhar chu dpal phug tu bris pa/ bya sla 'phrin las myur 'grub rgyas pa'i las sgrub me mchod kha skong sbyin sreg pho nya myur mgyogs/ de'i thabs/ dgang blugs kyi dpe ris/ ratna shwa ras mdzad pa'i drag —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepo'i sbyin sreg (byang/gdug pa tshar gcod rnams/them med/drug pa bye brag rkyang par sgrub pa go cha'i lha'i sgos sgrub ni/bye brag sgos sgrub rkyang par sgrub pa yang :'jam dpal sgrub pa rdo rje thod brtsegasadang :tshe dpag med pa rdo rje'i 'phrong 'dzin dang :rta mgrin sgrub pa me rlung dmar nag dang :gsang bdag sgrub pa drag po thog 'bebs dang :khyung nag sgrub pa gnam lcags spu gri dang :mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa snying po'i yang zhun dang :sdig pa'i sgos sgrub gnam lcags thog rgod dang :yakṣa me dpal khro rgyal stobs 'dus te 'di dag rnams kyang byin rlabs mthu rtsal ldan zhes pa ltar 'jam dpal sku'i sgrub pa rdo rje thod brtsegs/de'i dkyil 'khor/phur pa/sman raka gtor ma'i dpe ris/mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sgrub pa rdo rje'i 'phreng 'dzin/de'i dkyil 'khor/tshe bum steng du 'grang rgyas rta mgo can yod pa'i dpe ris/rta mgrin gsung gi sgrub pa me rlung dmar nag gu ru'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgya95 gyis bkod pa/shog ser gyi tshig dbang zhig na shel dkar bza' yi ge ma lags kho mo bris zhes pa'ang dkyus su bcug 326na khor snang /dkyil 'khor/rta phur/sman raka gtor ma'i dpe ris/phyag rdor thugs kyi sgrub pa rdo rje'i thogs 'bebs slob dpon gsung bzhi 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa/dkyil 'khor/phur pa/sman raka gtor ma'i dpe ris/khyung nag yon tan gyi sgrub pa gnam lcags spu gri/dkyil 'khor/phur pa/sman raka gtor ma'i dpe ris/mkha' 'gro gsang sgrub snying po'i yang zhun mchog thun dngos grub thob par the mi tshom pa 'tsho rgyal gyi dbu snyung ma/sdig pa'i sgos sgrub gnam lcags thog rgod gu ru'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa/sa ma rme mang tshur thong kho mo bri kyi khu ba yodakyu4su snang na ya spru me dbal 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa khro rgyal stobs 'dus dbyangs can mas bkod pa/dkyil 'khor/phur pa/sman raka gtor ma'i dpe dang bcas pa rnams/bdun pa lha bsnyen rgyad du bsgyur nas 'phrin las kha bsgyur lasatshogs la/rnal 'byor rang la gces pa/gang 'dul re ba skong ba/phan bya bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/lung bstan phan gnod las phran dang bzhi/dang po ni/snang srid dregs pa'i srog dbang dmar nag 'di gter kha 'di min drag sgrub gzhan dag tso sbaXpa med do bstan 'dzin snying gi bu lung rnams

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)bstan pa'i bu rnams ma ga rta gos pa bstan na rang srog chad do srog las gces gtor bzlog drag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang :bskang bshags dri med shel gyi 'phreng ba dang :mkha' 'gro'i grib sel shel gyi me long gsum rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog bye brag spyi la gces zhes pa ltar drag po me'i 'khor lo'i bka' dang 'bangs su gtod pa snang srid dregs pa'i srog dbang dmar nag don lngas326babastan pa bu mchog lnga la spel du mi rung ba/nang rgyas/rbod gtong ltasang na/yul sdigs/chagasanyams/rmi ltas/mtshan ngan/nad 'khrug/mtha' dmag sogs mi 'thun phyogs rnams bzlog pa gtor bzlog drag po marsā cha'i 'khor lo/bzlog gter gyi dpe ris/dam tshig nyams chags skong ba bkang bshags dri med shel 'phreng mkhar chen bzas dpal gyi phug ring du bris pa/sman gtor rakta/rol mo/rta g.yag/ra lug/bya khyi'i dpe ris/mkha' 'gro chos skyong khros pa sogs dam tshig nyams chags stong ba bshags skong grib sel shel gyi me long 'tsho rgyal gyis zhus te ā tsarla ye shes kyis bris pa/'grang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag/grib bdag/grib bshos/ba dan/zor gong /skyu gu/bum pa/me long /mda'i dpe ris bcas pa rnams/gnyis pa gang 'dul re ba skong ba ni/rnal 'byor tsho gos kyi lag mchod rab gsal dang :byab chog gdon 'grol khyung nag char 'bebs gsum gang 'dul gdul bya'i re ba kun skong yin zhes pa ltar/dam rdzas la brten nas dngos grub blang ba bdud rtsi lag mchod dngos grub kun 'byung skyon gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa/steng 'og gi gdon spyi dang khyad par klu gdon la byab chog gdon 'grol zhar byung man ngag gnad 'grol dang bcasapa/kun gyi re stong khyung nag gi char 'bebs drag rtsal thog 'bebs rnams/gsum pa phan bya bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/phan bya'i las tshogs bsrung 'khor yongs rdzogs ni byin rlabs nus ldan thog dang 'dra na yang :gdeng dang mi ldan 'bu ldog rang la yong nor dang ngo dga' mi 37na〉me phyir gtong na srog la yong bas rab tu 'tsho shes bya nyes pa kun sel rdo rje'i go cha dang :ngag mnan 'grol ba rdo rje rnam 'joms dang 'dzul chog / rje go cha la sogs pa'i zab gces 'ga' mchos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )mig 'bras lta bur btsa' zhes pa ltar drag po sku'i bsrung 'khor chen mo'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sde brgyad thams cad bsrung ba me chu rlung 'khrug yon du gser zho re ma byung na mi 'dogs pa/bsrung bzlog gnad kyi tsakra thub chod chen mo 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub pa/'gong po spun dgu bsrung thabs shin tu gnyan pa yod pa tsam gyis 'gong po nye bar mi nus pa srog ltar gces pa/ bsen ma bsrung ba bsen mo dang gson 'dre mo'i rigs kyis gnod pa mi nus pa/rgyal bsen shi sa bstan pa srog gi 'khor lo gser zho re med par mi 'dogs pa byung na ma btags pa rang la dga' ba/ dam sri dang chung sri gsad pa'i srog 'khor shin tu gnyan pa srog ltar gces pa/kun thub/ chu klung 'khrug pa/ thub chod chen mo/ 'gong po skrun dgu bsrung ba/ bsen mo bsrung ba/ rgyal bsen shi srog /dam sri chung sri gsad pa rnams kyi dpe ris/ nyes pa kun sel gyi bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i go khrab phra men rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas ba lhas pa 'di la nang gses kyi ngan sbyor gyi rtags/ de las 'grol thabs gshin rje nag po'i sbyor ba yang 'jig na ban dgra tsam smos ci dgos pa/ gtad kyi nyes pa 'grol ba klu bdud mgo dgu'i sgom bzlas/ phung sel gyi nyes 'grol stobs ldan nag po'i sgom bzlas dang bcas pa/ ngag mnan 'gro ba rdo rje'i rnam 'joms kyi man ngag gis(327bsko zhan gyi ngag gnon pa dang / rang gi ngag 'grol ba dpe ris dang bcas pa/ nyes pa kun grol gyi man ngag 'dzul chog rdo rje'i go cha mkha' 'gro ma'i snying thig dpe ris dang bcas pa rnams/ bzhi pa lung bstan phan gnod las phran ni/ g.yin yang bye brag lung bstan rim pa dang : man ngag kha 'thor 'ga' re yod pa rnams ston dang spel tshod gter bdag rang gis rtogs zhes pa ltar rgya 'dre 'gong po'i lung bstan shākya mu nir rgyab gtad pa'i lha chen gnyis byung ba la brten nas bod sdug bsngal ba/ de'i bzlog thabs lha sa'i sa dgra 'chos thabs/ 'gong po 'dul thabs kyi mnan pa dang bcas pa 'tsho rgyal gyis phyi rabs don du sbas pa/ logs su gab pa 'gong po sa the nag (bya ge po'i sprul pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan/ drag po'i las tshogos kha 'thor gyi ngan sngags reg phung nag po zhes pa rdzas kyi kha —476

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganabasgyur la brten nas rgya skad smra ba/ lkugs pa/ spyo nas btsun pa mang po'i dmag 'ong bar mthong ba/khrab can du mthong ba/ bud med du mthong ba/ gto du smyo ba/ blas 'chos pa/ de rnams gso thabs/lo tog bskam 'gro ba/ mdze gtad lo gsum las su mi rung ba/ mtshan gtad khrag 'dzag /de 'grol thabs/ mtshan gtad bskrangs nas 'chi ba/ zhing la sha ba/ dgo ba/ ri bong / byi ba bsrung ba/ 'ji ba/ri sbur/ shig bsrung / dug 'gred/ gag lhog zer gsum/ 'brum bu gnyan nad/ rgyal gnod 'dre skyon dang cho 'phrul/ lo nad cadang sad/ cham pa srung thabs rnams/ brgyad pa bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba dam can gter bsrung ni/ spu gri skor gsum gsang (328na)ba'i dril sgrub dang : ston kha'i bstod pa bskul dang bcas pa rnams gsang gter 'di yi gter srung chen po ste zab cing gnyan pas spel tshod rig par ltos zhes pa ltar drag po mched gsum/ 'bar ba spun gsum/ dmag rgyal spun gsum/ ldang lha mched gsum/ legs rtsal spun gsum sogs gzhi ga khrig la ming sna tsho gos su btags pa don du bdud nag srog gi spu gri /btsan dmar las kyi spu gri/ klu rgyal dug gi spu (byang/gri gsum gyi bod rbad gsad gsum gcig tu dril ba/ bstod bskul/ mnan sreg gis mjug bsdu ba dang bcas pa/ de'i gtor ma/ 'brub khung / rten rdzas/ ling ga /thod ngan gyi dpe ris/ gter srung dge bsnyen ston kha sgrub (bya nge cing bstod bskul gyi rim pa/ klu bdud nag po 'di bsgrub pa ni rnal 'byor pas bkang (byin gso mchod bstod gtong dus kyi gsol kha bstod bskul skyon padmas mdzad pa/ ston kha'i gnas brgyad (byang/kyi bstod pa rnams/ dgu pa gud du sbas pa'i yang gces gsang ba thugs tig dmar nag thems med skor la/ gu ru'i thugs bcud zil gnon drag po'i sgrub pa yang gces gsang ba srid gsum zil gnon chen po mkhar chen bzas bkod pa/ dam tshig nges don snying po don gyi hūṃ sgrub ces pa rdo rje gro (byi ge lod spyan mang gi sgrub pa 'tsho rgyal gyis dkar shog logs la bkod pa/ byang la ter rgyags spu si 'a snyus pa dang brjod don 'dra ba phrug drag po bde gshegs 'dus pa yang zhun gser gyi 'bru gcig rtog te re/mi gzhig gnam lcags rdo rje'i pha lam dang 'dra ba 'jig rten na —477—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedakon pa'i (328ba〉skrub thabs/ khyung dmar me'i 'phreng ba thog rgod kyi sgrub thabs zhes pa sgom bzlas/ rdzas sbyor gyis sde brgyad bsrung ba/ 'khor los bsrung ba/ bskrad gzir/ gsad pa/ gdon/nad gsob/ ser ba/ shwa bud bzlog pa/ zho chang bsrung ba/ ltas ga bzlog pa dang bcas ston pa/sde brgyad bsrung ba gnam lcags rdo rje'i 'khor lo (gter)'am yang bzlog me'i 'khor lo/ sku'i tsakra sa phyogasang na/ gza' 'byung ba'i dgra/ sde brgyad gnod pa/ dkar nag las thabs byas nyesarnams bsrung bzlog /gsung gi tsakra sa mnan pa'i nyes pa/ klu'i byad/ gtad ser gyi tshe rang lus/ sa dgra/ gza' skar ngan pa rnams bsrung bzlog /thugs kyi tsakra sa mthu gtad/ slar yang gnyan por bzlog pa/ rang bsrung rmi ltas ngan pa/ lha bsrung 'khu ba rnams bzlog pa ste don tshan bco lnga pa (byang/'khor lo'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/ dug bsrung ngo mtshar ('khon)ba'i man ngag zab mo yid bzhi nor bu/ ma' bsrung rdo rje'i go khrab ces pa (ni kho shelor lo sngags rdzas/ ting 'dzin bstan pa'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/ gza'i dgag 'khor gnam lcags ( ne te re/go cha shin tu 'khu ldog che bas re re tsam las spel du mi rung ba/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi snying gzer bzlog pa rang gshed drag sngags srog gcod sbu gri reg gcod mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes pa btson bu dong du gsod pa nas tsakra bca' ba'i bar te don bcu gnyis kyis bstan pa'i las tshogis yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyi yang gces gnad kyi man ngag (bya nge slus pa mkha' 'gro rigs 'dzin thams cad dbang med du 'du (329na)ba'i rten 'brel gyi rdzas bdud rtsi sbyor thabs dang 'bod rdzas rkang gling / gsang ba'i rnga chung / yang gsang gi rdzas mchog seng ldeng gi cang te'u gsum bca' thabs dpe ris dang bcas pa/rdo gtor zab mo 'jig rten gsum na dkon pa'i man ngag shin tu bka' gto cing zab pa sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa gnam lcags kyi dug mda' lta bu don gsum pa dpe ris dang bcas pa/las mtha' shin tu zab pa gtad bzlog nag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo (nyi)la nang gses kyi sde brgyad spyi lam chog chog gi 'khor lo/ bsil ba tshal gyi sgo srung dam sri nag po sbyang mgo can bsrung ba/ sha —478

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaza'i mkha' 'gro tsa muṇḍi zhes pa gson 'dre mo bsrung ba/ lha dang rdzas sngags la brten pa'i bsrung ba chig chog rgyal po gnam lcags rdo rje'i mkhar chen rnams/ rgyal bsen bsrung 'khor dam tshig srog gi 'khor lor grags pa lte bar rā dza dang cig shos kyi phyi la (6)gson 'dre mo'i gzugs bris pa'i zab khyad can/ rgya 'dre nag po ha la zhes bya ba'i dam sris rgyal po dang 'gong po skrun dgu bsdongs nas kun la gnod pa bsrung ( ne te re/ba bskrad mnan gnad 'khor yang zab mthar thug /lcags sdig dang bse sdig la brten pa'i dam (gte re/sri nag po dang rgyal po'i srog bcud 'bor ba/ ngag gnon rang gshed mnan pa'i 'khor lo shin tu zab pa gud du sbas pa/ zhe sdang can bsod nams gzhig par byed pa'i ga (byi sngags 'khor lo/ dgra bo nyes byas dran tsam ltas (bya geg nub re gtong ba'i 'dre gnon/ gza' dang rgyal po gnyis la brten nas drag po las kyi mtshon cha rtog te/khrid pa'i rtsa ba gcod cing 'byung ba dkrug pa'i man ngag dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa spu gri ar gtad nag po ral gri phyung brdeg ma/ rkyal nag phu 'debs kyis dgra bo gsod pa'i gdams pa rtog te re/mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gdug pa'i sbyor ba sgang tshal nag po/ mon nag gi bdag po tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyi sgrub pa las sbyor (gi te re/bskul nyi ma shar phyogs ma dang bcas pa/ zhing sel nag po'i sbyor ba shā ge rdzas la brten pa'i skye ba rgyun gcod/ 'khor lo dang thod par brten (byi ge pa'i zhing sel/ rdzas sngags kyis zhing la ri bong bsrung ba/ ri phyugs la spyang zhi shin tu thu na sngags kyis bsrung ba/ bu 'byung thabs mngal gyi rtsam dud 'grol ba/ chung sri gnon pa (nyi)zab gces snying dang 'dra ba/ phyugasashe la 'gro ba/ be'u 'jur sdom/ 'byung po'i rgyu lam gcod pa ('i kho ni/phyag rtags rdo rje rgya can rnamasardzogs par thob pa las spe 'khon gter gsum gyi rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ 'brom bza' byang chub sman/ shel dkar bza' rdo rje 'tsho/ dpal gyi —479—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shemachod gnas ma bram ze di paṃ/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ sgrub pa'i mchod g.yog lang 'gro lo tsā ba/gter ston chas rgyal zhig po gling pa/ sras dpa' bo mtha' yas grags pa/ mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje/ khri srong rnam (330na yil dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sprul sku kun bzang dbang po/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor brje'i mnog chos su stsal to/ /yang na dpa' bo mtha' yas grags pa nas/ lha bro sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ legs ldan rje man gong ltar/ yang na gter ston nas/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ sol mgon po rdo rje/bla ma ratna shwa ra/ bla ma mdo sde rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin padma dbang phyug /sngags 'chang bkra shis dbang phyug /chos rgyal dbang po'i sde man gong bzhin/ yang byang 'khon gter gsum gyi rtags can rnams ma yin pa'i dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ thugs sras ngag dbang grags pa/ drin can ngag dbang nor bu/ mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags/ gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang rgyal/ ga me 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ spe lcogs bla ma dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thugs sras chos rje rigs 'dzin chos bzang / khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /gtor dbang bsdus pa nor bu lugs su bskur ba dang bsrung 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter ston nas/ stag mgo yon tan dpal/ zings pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa/ sprul sku bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje du ma rang grol/ rigs 'dzin ye shes grub pa/zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ gu ru kun dga' grags pa/ brgyud 'dzin kun (330bang ga' bstan 'dzin/ ka thog pa dbang grags rdo rje/ du ma rang grol man gong ltar/ yang bsrung 'khor yongs rdzogs lugs gcig ni/ ka thog pa dbang grags rdo rje nas/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /'khon gyi rtags yod pa rnams —480

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ rje btsun sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ 'khrul zhig padma sangs rgyas/ rigs 'dzin nyi zla sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /gter gyi rtags can rnams kyi lung brgyud ni/ rkarma 'phrin las rgya mtsho nas/chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gung thang mkhar ram btsan mkhar ri mo can gyi shar lhor lta ba'i dkyil smad brag rta so 'dra ba sum brtsegs kyi mtha' ma nas sprul sku ratna gling pas spyan drangs pa'i tshe dpag med rdo rje 'phreng ba'i skor la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'bor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ rdor dril/ rdo rje/cod pan/ dril bus tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i dbang bum pas rigs bdag lnga'i dbang / gzan bum gyis yum lnga'i dbang dang bcas pa mnos nas/ lung la/ thems byang rgya bcu gsum gyis spras pa/ de las 'phros pa'i chos skor la/ tshe sgrub rdo rje 'phreng ba/ sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i chos brgyad/ yid bzhin nor bu'i chos bcu dang gsum/ dang po la ma lnga/ thems med lnga/ bu lnga ste gsum/ dang po ni/ slob dpon byon pa'i lo rgyus gleng gzhi dang : dkyil 'khor rdzas bsag sta gon rim (331na)pa dang :bdag 'jug slob dpon rang dbang dang : dngos gzhi slob bu'i dbang bskur dang : dam tshig cho ga'i rim pa ste ma lnga 'dzoms pa'i thems yig go zhes pa ltar las rgyun yod pa ni/ tshe sgrub rdo rje 'phreng ba'i lo rgyus mdo tsam bshad (rgya ge pa nyi ma'i snying po rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sngon 'gro dbang byang bkol ba sta gon gal (zur/mtho padmas khrigs su bkod pa las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/bdag 'jug slob dpon gyi dbang 'gro don mthar phyin bkra shis shog gi mtha' can/ gsang ba tshe'i dbang chog rdo rje 'phreng ba bskur thabs(zuge sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa rnams/gnyis pa thems med lnga ni/ gsang ba phyi'i sgrub rdo rje'i 'phreng (zur/ba o rgyan gyi thugs bcud nying khu phrad shog mtha' can/ shin tu zab pa nang sgrub rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan (zur/pa byon gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis bris pa/ mchog tu gyur pa gsang sgrub rdo rje —48/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'aphreng ba zab pa'i mthar thug (( ge ma chag na rdo rje che'i rigs 'dzin thob par dbu snyung gi mtha' tshig can/shin tu yang zab snying po'i bas du gyur pa gsang ba tshe 'khrid rdo rje'i 'phreng ba (ji ge tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par shog gi mtha' can/rdzas kyi tshe sgrub bcud len rdo rje'i 'phreng ba tshe'i sgrub pa (zur/yang snying srog thig phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/gsum pa bu lnga ni/dbang gi me mchod rnam bzhi dang :thabs lam tshe yi bcud sdud dang :ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lung bstan dang :spyi khyab gces pa'i yig chung dang :gter ston phyag rgya'i lung bstan 331bskong :de snga ma lnga'i bu yig yin zhes pa ltar/zhi rgyas dbang drag gi me mchod las(6re/zha dang phrad par smon pa/bud med mtshan ldan la brten nas che'i rigs 'dzin sgrub pa thabs lam padma bcud sdud gsang ba'i snying bcud/thugs sras nye ba'i 'khor brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis rang rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad phul nas zhus pa'i bstan pa spyi lung gang zag sgos lung mtha' dbus 'khrug tshul gyi lung bstan/'di srong bas bang sne ༄ phung bags yo pas lung gas ོ mo dang 〉rsāg/sgos su gter ston dang phyag rgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lung bstan/gter ston gyis dang spro bsam gto gling du mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro chos spyod tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ma/them med/da dung thems dang bstun na dam tshig rnam bshad dang spyi khyab cesapa'i chos gnyis ma byung /gnyis pa mthar thug sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i chos brgyad la ma bu gnyis las dang po ma bzhi ni/sngon 'gro spyi yi bca' thabs dang dbang bzhi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro dngos gzhi lha yi rnal 'byor dang :bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro sems nyid stong pa'i rnal 'byor ro zhes pa ltar/thugs rje chen po 'khor lo lnga'i gsang (zur/'khrid ces pa sngon 'gro'i bca' thabs/lusabaskyed pa lha'i 'khor lo/ngag bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khor lo/sems dran rtog chos nyid kyi 'khor lo'o/gnyis pa bu bzhi ni/'tsho rgyal zhus pa'i spros gcod dang :mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim dang za ba bdud rtsi 'khor lo dang :bag yangs spyod pa'i 'khor lo ste ma bzhi bu bzhi rnam brgyad de zhesapa ltar las spros pa gcod pa ma rnyed/mtshan ma // pa'i rdzogs rim/ 332na / zas bdud rtsi sman

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagyi 'khor lo/spyod lam bag yangs kyi 'khor lo rnams/gsum pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i chos bcu ni/kun la gces shing zab pa yi yid bzhin nor bu'i chos bcu la 'tsho rgyal zhus pa'i lo rgyus dang :kun la gces pa'i brjed tho'i tshul:slob dpon dngos 'byon tshes bas yi ji ltar gzung ba'i thabs lo rgyus/zhes sogs chos 'a bas nang nas/dus bzang tshes bcu gzung thabs phan yon bskul byang dang bcas pa sha mtshan mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dra'i las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can tsam las spyod yul du ma gyur to//de yang sa bcad snga phyi gnyis la chos wo so sor bcu dang bar ma la brgyad dgos pa'i rgyu tsho/rdo rje phreng ba'i ma bu bcu:gsang ba 'khrid kyi mo bu brgyad kun la gces pa'i yig chung bcu:nyi shu rtsa brgyad chos bka' tshang :zhes pas shes so//de ltar dbang lung rdzogs par thob pa las/dbang dang zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku tshe dpag rigs lnga/sprul sku spyan ras gzigs/o rgyan padma tshe dbang rtsal/grub chen rje 'bangs grogs lnga/chos rgyal ratna gling pa/gcung ngag dbang grags pa/rje ngag dbang nor bu/gtsug rgyan nor bu yongs grags/chos dbang yongs grags rnam rgyal/gsang sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o//lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/mkhas grub dme gsang sngags/ 332bkun mkhyen khra tshang pa chen po/des bdag la'o//la yag mon mkhar steng gi pha bong g.yu sgrom gyi byang /gnam skas can gyi brag ri'i shar phyogs stag lhags brgyangs 'dra'i dkyil nas sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas khyi lo rta zla'i tshes gcig la khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i 'dus pa skor bzhi las thugs rje chen po gsang ba bos pa'i chos skor la/tshom bu'i dkyil 'bor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi rgyud sbyang pa'i dbang /kṛ yog bum pa'i dbang /zhi ba'i chaX8 brgyad/rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/me tog 'phreng ba/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( )rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sku bzhi yongs rdzogs/ sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo brgyad/ thub pa drug /sangasargyas stong / sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ gsang ba/ rig rtsal/ sku gsung thugs/ rab tu gnas pa/ bza' bca'/ zhal zas/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ bkra shis tshe/ 'gro ba 'dul ba rnams kyi dbang / gsang dbang sher dbang / rang byung don dbang rnams/ gang zag spros pa la mi dga' ba'i don du gtor dbang du bsdus nas don dbang nor bu lugs su bskur ba dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/lung la/ yid ches khungs btsun pa thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i lo rgyus yid bzhin nor bu/thems byang gter gyi bum pa/ de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ chos 'di skyed byed rtsa ba rgyud/ de la brten pa'i bskyed rim sgrub thabs che chung / kha skong 'phrin las ma bu las tshogs/ rdzogs rim zab 'khrid man ngag ma bu/ mthar thug zab mo khyab par can tshe sgrub/ de dag phyi'i kha skong rgyab yig /bka' dang (333na)bstan pa bsrung ba chos skyong skor dang bdun/ dang po ni/ thems byang las/ thog mar chos 'di skyed byed ma yi tshul: thugs rje chen po gsang ba bos pa'i rgyud ces pa'i thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud chen po le'u bco lnga pa mkha' 'gro'i brda dpe las sgra rang bsgyur du mdzad pa/ gnyis pa de la brten pa'i skyed rim sgrub thabs che chung ni/ rgyud mchog de la brten pa'i man ngag skor sgrub khog chen mo dbang chog gter bum dang : gsang ba shes rab ye shes skor gsum dang nyer bsdus gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu dang : nang sgrub gsang sgrub bcas pa rtsa ba ste: zhes pa tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi khog phub chen mo sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs su 'dus pa' sgrub chen/ dbang chog rin cen gter gyi bum pa/ dbang gong ma gsum bskur thabs mkha' 'gro'i gsang dam can/ gang zag spros pa la mi dga' ba'i don du gtor ma la brten nas dbang bzhi nor bu lugs su bskur thabs/ 'phags pa nang bla ma dang dbyer med du sgrub pa longs sku'i sgrub thabs thugs bcud yang zab gnad tig /mthar thug sgrub pa'i snying po bstan pa gsang sgrub zab pa'i phul phyin rnams/ gsum pa kha skong 'phrin las ma bu las tshogs ni/ de yi kha —484

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaskong las byang 'dzab dgongs dang : mchod 'bum skye bdun sgrub dang las tshogs drug /de dag rtsa ba'i skor yin snying la chongs zhes pa thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus kyi las byang padma'i 'phreng ba/ 'dzab dgongs gnad kyi gzer thig /mchod 'bum rin cen 'phreng ba/ mkha' spyod skye (333ba)bdun sgrub pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu/ 'gro don las tshogs drug pa zhes pa thugs rten ga'u mkha' 'gro'i 'gro don/ nyi ma mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don/ me long mthong grol lam gyi bya thabs/ dmigs gtad mchod rten gyi 'gro don/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs kyi 'gro don/ chu bo dbyings khyab kyi 'gro don bya thabasarnams/ bzhi pa rdzogs rim zab 'khrid man ngag ma bu ni/ rdzogs rim gsang 'khrid thugs kyi snying po dang : btags grol gnyis dang rgyab yig ma bur bcas tshe tshad rmi lam brtag dang bcud len skor zab pa'i man ngag geg sel dbyug bcos bcas yang zab 'khrid kyi man ngag 'di yis tshang :zhes pa rdzogs rim zab don gsang 'khrid thugs kyi snying po ṭa rtog te re/la ye shes rang byung gi gnas su thugs rje chen po dngos kyi gu ru padma la gsungs pa/ gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rtog te re/rdo grugs rje'i sprin phung spros med mkha' dag ma/ rang byung rig pa'i man ngag btags grol snying po'i yang (gte re/zhun rab gnas dbang bskur dang bcas pa grol shog gi mtha' can/ btags grol kyi rgyab yig /spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sgo nas tshe dang 'chi ba brtag pa/ 'di'i 'og tu 'ji med bdud rtsi sman gyi bas len 'dug kyang dpe mo 'byor bsam thob/rnal 'byor lus kyi gegs sel ba dbyug bcos rnams/ sa bcad lnga pa ni tshe sgrub gsang 'dus kyi skor te logs su gsal/ drug pa de dag spyi'i kha skong rgyab yig ni/ de dag sbyi yi man ngag rgyab yig la 'chi ba brtag bslu gsal ba'i sgron me dang : sku gdung sātstsha rab gnas rin cen 'phreng : sreg sbyangs 'od 'phreng (334na)bdun tshigs thugs rje'i 'phreng : de yi lhan thabs zas gtad gter mdzod dang : sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan 'bum bcas pa rnams de dag phan byed spyi yi kha skong yin zhes pa 'chi ba brtags slu'i man rtog te re/ngag gsal ba'i me long / sku gdung su tsā'i rim pa la dngos dang lan phran —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nel tshe sgrub/ rmi lam ga pa dang rbod gtong bzlog pa/ sgrib sbyong / tshe 'das kyi don du 'debs pa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha bsgyur dang bcas pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga (gter)rin cen 'phreng ba/gshin don bdun tshig thugs rje'i 'phreng ba/ de'i zhal gdams lhan (gi te re/thabs gu ru'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa/ gshin po zas gtad (gter)kyi cho ga rin cen gter mdzod/ dusagasum rtog te sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i mtshan 'bum chen mo rnams/ bdun pa bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba chos skyong skor ni/ chos 'di'i bka' srungs man ngag las tsho gos skor dbang chen gsang sgrub srog gi spu gri dang : dbang dang las tshogs rin cen gter mdzod dang : bla rdo gnad 'bebs shi spobastan pa dang : nor sgrub yang gces cho 'phrul zab mo dang : las byang dang ni ma bu de yis tshang :kha ri'i gsang sgrub nor sgrub zab mo dang : dur khrod bdag mo ga ne'i sgrub pa dang : ye shes gragasakyi phyi nang gsang sgrub dang tsitta'i gsang sgrub rkun ma ngos 'dzin rnams zhes pa ltar gtor sku/ bla rdo/ phyag mtshan la brten pa'i dam can skyes bu chen po'i dbang nos nas/ lung la/ dam can skyes bu chen po'i gsang sgrub srog gi spu gri phrad shog (334ba)gi mtha' can/ de dang 'dra min (nyang)gcig thems med/ bcom ldan 'das sku'i sprul pa srid gsum sgrol byed mgar ba nag po rdo rje legs pa'i ngan sngags gdug pa'i mtshon chas dgra bo myur du sgrol ba'i man ngag bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang bcas pa dug gi spu gri gnam lcagasang ra ma dang 'dra ba/ them med/ skyes bu chen po'i rjes gnang dbang gi rim pa/ lusang ga grib ltar 'grogs pa bla rdo/ ra rog gi pags(nyam/pa la brten pa'i bla rdo/ rdo rje legasapa'i shi sa (nyang)bstan pa/ rno myur yang zab dam tshig can dam gyi nor sgrub rin cen gter mdzod/bod rbad gsad gsum sham bu bla dbab rnams kyi sngags kyi 'bru thems skyes bu drag rtsal yin no'i mtha' can/ dam sri sgab 'bru bdud btsun the'u brang gsum gnon thabs/ dam sri 'gong po spun (nyang/gsum 'dri ba'i phyag len/ dam sri mnan pa'i gsal byed (nyang/'khru ldog mi 'byung ba'i thabs/dam sri pho mo'i shi sa (nya ge bstan pa/ khyi dkar sna dmar gyi thod par brten nas cho 'phrul gtong ba —486

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganadon lngas bstan pa/ ra rog po'i mgo la bstan nas ltasang na btsan thabs su gtong ba/ thems med/las byang gsol kha rgyal ba shāka thub ma rnams/ kha ri'i skor ni dpe ma 'byor bas ma thob/ mu stegs kyi lha mo srog 6pe mib ma dur khrod kyi 'dre mo ga ne ma dkor srung gi sgrub pa/ nor bdag the'u brang ye shes grags kyi sgrub skor la/ phyi skyes bu don gsal du bsgrub pa/ nang dkor bdag lha rgyal du bsgrub pa/ gsang ba dge bsnyen ye shes grags su bsgrub pa rnams/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsitta'i nor (335na ba la nang gses kyi gnod sbyin sgrub pa/ yon bdag bsdu ba/ mkha' 'gro gnad por gsum gyis bstan pa/ rdo rje them med/ bsam grub (6)rtsal gyi nor sgrub rnams rdzogs par thob pa las thugs rje chen po'i dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ ā tsarla ye shes / sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ gar dbang las 'phro gling pa/ sras 'jig rten mgon po/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thugs sras rigs 'dzin chos bzang / rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor gyi sngags dkar ma ni bar stsal to/ /yang na tshe dbang grags pa nas/ ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang nor bu/ nor bu yongs grags/dbang chen lhun grub/ sangs rgyas phun tsho gos man 'dra/ gter dbang yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas phun tsho gos nas/ chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gter gyi rtags ma gtogs pa'i sa bcad drug pa yan dang a pa ra tsitta'i skor gyi lung brgyud ni/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ mtshungs med ngag dbang grags pa/ thugs srasang ga dbang nor bu/ rje gas nor bu yongs grags/ rje sras nor bu dbang rgyal/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ 'phrin las lhun (335ba'i ba man gong ltar/ gter gyi rtags—487—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheyod pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ nor bu yongs grags nas/ rgyal sras ga rma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ chosaldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /dam can gyi dbang dang gsol kha'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ dpa' bo mtha' yas grags pa/ gu ru ngag dbang lhun grub/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / rin cen bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rje du ma rang grol/ ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /sgab 'dre gnon thabs dang nyang gi rtags yod pa rnams ma gtogs pa'i dam can gyi chog skor rnams gyi lung brgyud ni/ kun dga' tshe mchog nas/ pha jo ga smo nu don grub/ rje chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /nyang gi rtags yod pa ma gtogos pa'i dam can gyi lung yongs rdzogos ni/rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub yan thugs rje chen po ltar la/ de nas mkhas grub dme gsang sngags/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /nyang gi rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/nor bu yongs grags nas/ na rma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i lung ni/ nor bu yongasagrags nas/ yong rdzong yab sras/ gung ru dpal ldan grags/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ rje 'phren las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /the'u brang ye shes grags kyi brgyud pa ni/ nor bu yongs grags nas/ rlung gi sngags(336na rdzong nga ma ni ind+ra rā dza/ rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gnas skabs klu bdud mgo dgu'i pho brang nas sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pasaspyan drangs pa'i 'dus pa skor bzhi las tshe dpag med gsang ba 'dus pa la thems byang logs su med pa thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus kyi thems byang na gsal ba'i sa bcad lnga pa'i skor rnams yin zhing / dbang chog tu sgrub khog ces zhal 'phangs mdzad pa thugs rje chen po'i sgrub khog las spros pa'i 'di la zur du med pas shes par nus la/ da lta phyag len la thob yig logs su mdzad srol ltar —488

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganathog mar ra bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ gtor ma/ tshe chang / tshe ril/rdo rje padma/ 'khor lo/ brog zhu/ rgya gram/ rdo rje'i go /snying po lnga/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang bcasapa'i bum dbang / byang sems la brten nas gsang dbang / phyag rgya la brten pa'i sher dbang / sprosamed tshig dbang / gtor ma brten pa'i don dbang nor bu lugs dang bcas pa legs par mnosanas/ rgyab rten lung gi skor ni/ thugs rje chen po thems byang las/ mthar thug zab mo'i tshe sgrub skor dag la tshe sgrub gsang 'dus de yi bstod bskul dang : tshe sgrub gsang 'dus yang zab sgrub pa dang :phyi nang gsang gsum spra 'khrid rtags yig bcas 'chi med tshe yi bcud len mthar thug go zhes pa ltar/ tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang cho ga'i rim pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa skyon chen (336ba)po'i gsung bzhin mkhar chen bzas bkod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ las byang gi bu yig bstod pa bcom ldan tshe bdag ma dang / thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba gsang 'dus tshes dkyil ma gnyis bsdoms par bstod bskul rgyas par bdag mkhar chen bzasabakod pa 'o'i mtha' can/ gsang 'dus dmigs rim 'gor de nas gzungs thag 'then la zhes pa dang rdo rje'i tshe thob par gdengs bskyed do'i mtha' can/ them med/ yang zab sgrub pa yang gces snyan brgyud gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa gud du sbas pa bka' bzhin bsgrubs na dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ phyi sgrub zab pa'i phul du phyin pa gsang sgrub tshe'i sgrub pa zab mo rgyud kyi khungasadang 'brel ba dus kyi mtha' phrad par shog gi mtha' can/ nang gi tshe sgrub thugs kyi yang zhun gcesapa'i lus dang 'dra ba 'di yis rang gzhan don la spyod par 'gyur gyi mtha' can/ nang sgrub dmigs rim khol du phyung ba 'gor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro zhing zhes dang sgra dir ri ri dbang bskur bar bsgom gyi mtha' can/ thems med/ gas nga sgrub snying dang srog gi dngas ma lta bu gter srung mched gsum thub par srungs kyi mtha' can/ spros med don dbang nor bu lugs su bskur ba gu ru'i gsung btsun pa rgya99ba mchog dbyangs kyis yi ger bris pa'i mtha' can/ thems med/ bum pa'i dbang —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shechog chen mo thugs kyi yang zhun rin po che'i gser lta bu des kyang bka' rgya spel tshod rig par ltos kyi mtha' can/ thems med/ dbang gong ma gsum rdo rje'i them skas zhes pa phyon chen po'i gsung bzhin mkhar chen bzas la yag mon mkhar du bkod pa/ them med/ (337na7rgyud pa'i lo rgyus 'od zer 'phreng ba dang dbang gi phyag len gangs ri'i chu rgyun gnyis bsdoms pa'i 'khor nam mkha' dang zhes dang bkra shis brjod do'i mtha' can/ them med/ bdag 'jug gzhan don dbur po ba mgon po rdo rjes sbyar ba skye shi 'gyur med ma las 'jug go'i mtha' can/ tshe gtor g.yang zhag 'khyil ba'i spra 'khrid yig chung bkol pa zab mo'i mtha' can/ brda rtags gsal ba'i me long zhes pa rmi lam gyi ltas dang tshe gtor gyi bkra rtags ston pa shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len lo gcig gi bar du chag med du zos na lo brgya thub par 'gyur ba dang phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams legs par mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku tshe bdag rigs lnga/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs lnga/ sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa/mtshungs med ngag dbang nor bu/ drin can nor bu yongs grags/ brje 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ nyang chosaldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ grub pa'i dbang phyug blo yangs 'od gsal/ sprul sku gter ston gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za ho bande la bka' drin stsal to/ /sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gnam skas klu bdud mgo dgu'i brag stag lpags brgyangs 'dra'i ngos nas sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus ni/ thems byang las/—490

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)khyad par yang zab nga yi thugs dam bskong : gsang ba 'dus pa zhi dang khro bo'i skor gnyis las rta mgrin (337ba)gsang ba 'dus pa ni padma nga yi thugs dam rtsa ba yin bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma thugs bcud snying po 'di nyid min re skan zhes mchog gi dngos grub myur du bsgrub pa'i zhan la thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med stsol ba/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang chen rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang chog chen mo dregs pa srog gi rgya can gyi steng nas dpal rta mgrin gsang ba 'dusapa'i dbang la/ sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dbu rgyan gyis rdo rje 'chang dang skal ba mnyam pa/cod pan gyi chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba/ gtor mas sku gsung thugs/ bum pas sku bzhi'i sangs rgyasathob pa'i dbang / dur khrod chas kyis zil gnon rang rtags che btsan dregs pa kun 'dul mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i dbang / phyag mtshan gyi 'phrin las rdzogs shing nyon mongs 'joms pa bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa/ gzig sham dang rgyan drug gis snang srid zil gyi gnon cing theg dgu yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / phur pas bsgral dbang / byang sems kyis bde stong / sku 'bag gis bskyed rim/ bzlas pa/rdzogs rim/ zhal zas tshe dang gal gyi dbang / dbang mchog yid bzhin nor bu'i steng nas byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du sher dbang / brda sprod pa la brten nas tshig dbang don gyi ngo bo/ dbang chog rin cen gter bum gyi steng nas gtor ma rin cen dbang gi rgyal po la brten nas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba/ sku gzugs sgrub yig phyag mtshan la brten nas(33ra tshe / gsung thugs dbang / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang chog yid bzhin nor bu'i steng nas 'jigs byed me'i spu gri'i dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa —3dbang bzhi/ bdud rtsi me long gis gsang dbang / rdor dril gyis ye shes lnga'i dbang / me long dang sku gzugs kyi ye shes rtsal dbang / phyag mtshan gyis 'phrin las bzhi khams gsum yongs sgrol mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i dbang / dur khrod mas kyi rab 'byams rgyal po'i dbang / sgrub gtor sku 'bag rten —491 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (re/gtor bcas pas sku gsung yongs rdzogs dang 'phrin las gang 'tsham grub pa'i dbang rnams/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog 'od zer 'phreng ba'i steng nas gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pas lha dbang / cod pan gyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa/bdud rtsis gsang ngag la nus pa bskyed pa/ sa bon rdol dril gyis thugs dbang / phyag mtshan gyis rtsal chen 'gro ba 'dul zhing 'phrin las rdzogs pa'i dbang / gtor ma sku 'bag dang bcas pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ khyung dang khro bcu'i lha dbang gis 'phrin las dang mthu rtsal yongs rdzogs/brda sprad pa rab 'byams bka'i dbang rnams/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chen drag po las drag por khros pa rta nag lcags ral can gyi smin byed la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa dang gtor mas yongs rdzogs chen mo'i dbang bzhi/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang /dpal gyi chas kyi rang rtags dregs par (338ba)dbang sgyur srid gsum bran 'khol gyi dbang / sku 'bag /sngags/ phyag mtshan/ glegs bam gyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang dngos grub kyi mtha' can bcas pa rnams legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ thems byang rin cen gter mdzod de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/ kun gyi rtsa ba rgyud kyi skor/ bskyed rim sgrub pa dbang 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i skor/ kha bsgyur sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi las tshogs skor/sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i yi dam sger sgrub skor/ ma tshang ba kha stong ba'i gdams phran sna tshogs skor/ yid ches bskyed pa zhal gdam kha 'thor skor/ thems med yum bka' zab khyad can gyi skor/sgos kyi bka' skyong sngags srung e ka dza ṭi'i skor/ spyi'i srung ma gnod sbyin drag po bshan pa dmar nag skor/ nor gyi dbang phyug rgyal chen rnam sras skor/ ngan thabs las phran skor dang bcu gcig /dang po ni/ thog mar chos 'di bskyed pa ma yi tshul: dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud ches yin:zhes pa/ yang gsang spu gri'i rgyud stong phrag lnga'i nang nas phyung ba'i chos 'di skyed par byed pa'i ma lta bu dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i drag sngags gnam thog me'i spu gri gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud chen le'u —492

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogananyer gnyis pa/ gnyis pa bskyed rim sgrub pa dbang 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i skor ni/ spyi sgrub 'khor lo rnam gsum sgrub pa dang : yang gsang nang sgrub bla ma dbyer med sgrub gsang sgrub khyad par yang zab sgrub pa dang : gtor dbang rin cen gter gyi bum pa dang : dbang chog rgyas pa dregs pa'i srog rgya can gsang dbang (339na〉skor gsum yid bzhin nor bu dang : las byang bskyed rim bstod pa 'gebs dang bcas de dag sgrub skor rtsa ba'i chos rnams tshang : de yi kha skong me mchod chen mo ste:mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes pa ltar lang 'gro lo tsā bas slob dpon chen po la rta mgrin gyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba'i gdams pa zhus tshe gnang ba spyi sgrub 'khor lo rnam gsum zhes pa phyi rta thod lha zhal la brten nas dregs pa can dbang du bsdu ba/ nang thod pa lha zhal la brten nas rang lus lhar bsgom pa/ gsang ba 'khor lo lha zhal la brten nas dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa gsum bstan pa/ rta thod/ thod pa lha zhal/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo rnams kyi dpe ris/ thems med/ rta phag yab yum nang bla ma dang dbyer med sgrub pa bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro spyi sgrub byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba 'tsho rgyal gyis slob dpon la lung zhus nas yi ger btab pa/yang thems med/ gsang gnas kyi sgrub thabs dgongs pa'i zhe phugs sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis bstan pa gsum las mi spel ba/ yang gsang gnad yig thems su ma bstan (gi te re/gud du sbas pa rang gi bcang bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ thems med/ dpal rta mgrin gsang ba'i sgrub thabs 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa rtags dang bcas pa slob dpon chen po'i gsung bzhin shel dkar bzas la yag mo mkhar steng du bris pa/ rta phag yang gsang ltar bsgrub pa'i spyi ( 5 ) sgrub dmar nag srog tig gud du sbas pa'i tshig brgyud las spel mi rung ba/ yang gsang bsgrub pa'i 'khor lo snying (5)byang lkog yig ces pa srog (339bskokhor bla rdo'i man ngag /thems med/ thod sku/ bla rdo'i snod dang sba lcags tshigs gsum dar sna lnga pa/ 'khor lo snying byang gi dpe ris dang bcas pa/ thems med/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa gsal ba'i me long shin tu zab pa spyi don gsum gyis bstan pa/ gtor ma rin po —493—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheche dbang gi rgyal po la brten nas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba rin cen gter bum slob dpon gsung bzhin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bris pa/dbang mchog chen mo dregs pa srog gi rgya can zhes pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes rkyang pa dang rjes kyi zab rgya dam tshig bcas pa'i don bzhis bstan pa/dbang gong ma gsum bskur thabs yid bzhin nor bu chig brgyud ma/dkyil 'khor rgyasabasdus/gtor ma/ba /cod pan/tshe ril/bum pa/dbu rgyan/dur khrod chas rgyan/rgyan drug/phur pa/tshe bum/gsang rdzas khebs bcas rnams kyi dpe ris/sgos kho/gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i las byang rin cen 'phreng ba zhes pa gter byon gzhir bzhag la gsang sgrub dang yang gsang khros pa sogs nas kha bskangs pa'i mang nyung ran zhing skyong bde ba shin tu legs pa/them med/lha bskyed spyan 'dren bstod pa sogs las byang 'gebs kyi rim pa gu ru'i gsung bzhin btsun pa mchog dbyangasakyis bris pa/sgrub pa'i kha stong gi las byang ni slong gsal snying tig na bod de bkol du rung zer ba 'dug/de dag gi kha skong me mchod rtog te sbyin sreg pho nya myur mgyogs rnams/gsum pa kha bsgyur sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi las tshogs skor ni/de yi lasatshogs man ngag bstan pa ni rtsa ba'i las tshogos khyung lnga'i sgrub pa dang sku sgrub 340na〉pas tshogis dgos 'dod kun 'byung dang :gsung sgrub las tshogis kun thub bsrung ba'i rgyal:thugs sgrub lasatshogs bdud zlog cog brdung dang :yon to las tshogs yang zlog spu gri dang :'phrin las lasatsho gis rdzas sbyor rwa bsrung bcas dbang chen phyi nang gsang gsum sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las ma lus thams cad tshang :de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad de mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs zab cing gnyan pas gdams pa 'tsho shes gces zhes pa ltar rtsa ba'i las tshogasadrag po khyung lnga'i sgrub pa gu ru'i gsung bzhin ā tsarla ye shes kyis bris pa/sku sgrub las tshogs dgosa'adod kun 'byung las nang gses kyi rmi lam ga pa zlog pa/khyim nang dam sri gdon pa/gtor mar me 'bar ba/spyo 'bog gdul ba/khyim nas gdon ༷༷ gdon pa/rdzas kyi gtug mo/mi phyugs kyi phrug

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)gu khong par shi ba gdon pa/ zho chang bsrung ba/ phyugs kyi glo gor/ chang bsrung zab pa'i mthar thug /des kyang ma thub na bsrung ba'i zab gnad can dang bcas pa/ gsung sgrub las tshogs rin cen gter bum kun thub bsrung ba'i rgyal po la sngags dmigs kyis 'go nad thams cad bsrung ba/ tsandan dkar po sogs sman drug dang sngags kyis rgyu gzer bsrung ba/ ga bur sogs sman bzhi dang sngags kyi rims bsrung ba/ phag rgod la brten pa'i gnyan sngags/ lhog pa gsod pa bram ze spun dgu'i man ngag /rdzas bzhi dang gsang sngags kyis rims thams cad bsrung ba/ gnyan lhog 'chi nges pa'i sngagasadamigs zab mo/ ling rtag 'phyag pa/ khrag (340ba tshes rgad/ srin nad gsob/ so srin sngags dang sngags rdzas gnyis kas gsod pa/ mes tshig pa gso ba/ sngags dang rdzas gnyis kyis mi phyugs kyi phru gu dang sha ma 'don pa dang sngags dang rdzas gcig gi gdon pa/ dug sngags/ srin gang la yang slebasachog ma/ lus kyi srog chags bsrung ba lan chags sbyang ba sngags rdzas dang rdzas rkyang gis bsrung ba/'brum bsrung / glo cham bsrung ba/ drag las thams cad gyi rang bsrung rdzas sngags kyi sbyor ba khyad par can/ shu ba gsob/ gag lhog gzer gsum gyi sman sbyor khyad par can la gag lhog gzer gsum 'joms pa/ mkha' 'gro'i me mda'/ rdo rje gsum sbyor/ mnyam sbyor stag seng / sman sbyor shin tu rno ba/ thog ltar 'bigs pa/ nag po dgu sbyor/ thog 'bigs dgu sbyor te brgyad dang bcas pa/ thugasakyi las tshogs bdud bzlog cog brdung nag po slob dpon rom bu gu rsha'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ yon tan gyi las tshogs byad ma mkhan rang gshed rang la dbab pa yang bzlog spu gri phur thogs stong dang 'gras kyang tshur mi gnod pa rdo rje'i brag dang 'dra ba rom bu gu tho tsanda'i thugs bcud/ 'phrin las kyi las tshogs dug khrag gi sgrub pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i rdzas rgod sbyor ba rwa bsrung (gro ge zhes pa drag po'i la sbyor rtsub spyod ci byas kyang nyam mi nga ba'i 'dzam gling bod kyi bsrung mchog gcig pu ma rnams/bzhi pa sku gsung thugs las sprul ba'i yi dam sgrub skor ni/ kun 'dus yi dam padma he ru'i rka'i sku ni 'jam dpal gshin rjer bsgrub pa ste 'jigs byed nag po me yi spu gri 'di byin rlabs mthu —495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shestobs 'gran dang bral ba'i yin 'di yi las tshogs tshe bdag nag po yi 341na ) bsrung bzlog gsang mnan rgyas bsdus rim par bcas sna res 'jig rten phung 'tshengs nus pa'i phyir snod dang mi ldan 'tsho shes rab tu gces de yi dbang mchog yid bzhin nor bu ste yang zab mthar thug snying la chongs shig rgya zhes pa ltar byin rlabs mthu stobs 'gran zla dang bral ba tshe bdag nag po'i thugs bas sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub thabs rdo rje ('khon)'jigs (gro ge byed ma'i sbu gri zhes pa mngon rtogs/las byang /bsnyen pa/rtags/sbyin sreg/bstod pa bcas tshang ba o rgyan gsung bzhin gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis la yag mon mkhar steng du bris pa/dkyil 'khor/bum pa/bla ma/gzhin rje/bka' bsrung gi gtor ma/phur ba/thun dong /ral gri/tho ba/ling ga rnams kyi dpe ris/thems med/de'i las mtha' bsrung bzlog gsad mnan gyi man ('i kho ni/ngag dregs(gung/pa bcad cham la 'bebs pa'i skor gsum/mtshan bzhi/gnad gsum dang bcaspopa'i yang zlog me'i spu gri/gud du sbas pa'i man (lo se/ngag la nang (du ge 'gras/thems med/thun zhabs kya dmigs pa/tsakra'i gnad/shing byang rlung 'khor dang bcas pa/dkyil 'khor/pu ri dkar nag/thun gtor/rakta/bsrung bzlog gsad pa'i 'khor lo/sgo gsum gnon 'khor/rma 'khor gyi tsos rnams kyi dpe ris/'jigs byed me'i sbu gri'i dbang chog yid nga (ni kho shā nor bu (guge.o rgyan gsung bzhin gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis yi ger bkod pa/las tsho gis sdig pa snying 'dzangs(du ge zhes pa grong khyer bzhig pa/pha tshan spun zla 'byed pa/dme 'khrug gtong ba gsum ston pa zab khyad can mu stegs sgrol byed nag po'i 341bsgon ngag/sgo med/dkyil 'khor/them mad/phag thod/phung bzhig/'byed pa/dme 'khrug gsum dang bcas pa'i dpe ris/pha rol gyi rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba bzlog (gu/lo| rje)pa ting 'dzin rdzas sngags gsum la brten pa'i gdam pa seng gzugs ma/thems ra/gshin rje zhing dang gi dgra mnan las kyi rlung dmar gnad rtogu ge thems9 rje)gshed bzhi'i man ngag bsrung bzlog gas/ ༷nan kha chang /mnan ling /bye brag ngag mnan

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganaling ga/'brub khung /mchod rten/thod pa/rwa sa nyi zla'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/thems med/phra men rang bsrung gnam lcags rdo rje'i go khrab/(gunga3s pa 6ge bsrung 'khor lus (rdo spul gdogs pa/thems ra/phra men zas su za ba/skom du 'thung ba/gdan du gding ba/zhwa ltar rgyan pa/rgyan du 'dogs pa'i zab khyad can dpe ris bzhi dang bcas pa rnams/thems med/thugs ni 'gyur med gsang ba'i bdag po ste 'di yi thugs sgrub me yi 'khor lo dang :byin rlabs dbang mchog 'od zer 'phreng ba dang :sku gsung thugs 'khor kun thub chen po ste:mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs zab cing gnyan pas gdams pa'i tsho shes kyis zhes pa ltar thugs mchog 'gyur med gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i gsang sgrub me'i 'khor lo yi dam sgrub thabs/bye ba dpag med kyi snying po gcig tu dril ba'i gsang bdag gtum po'i yang snying zhes pa dkyil 'khor rdzas dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor/dngos grub blang ba gsum gyis bstan pa/de'i dbang chog 'od zer phreng ba slob dpon gsung bzhin btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bris pa/dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i dpe ris/them med/las tshogs gsang bdag 342na lda rje gtum po'i tshig chog thugs kyi 'khor lo kun thub chen po dpe ris dang bcas pa/thems med/klu 'chi bdag nag po'i srog 'khor zhes pa lo rgyus/themasamed/'khor lo/gnas kyi yig chung gsum gyis bstan pa/de'i dpe ris/thems med/yang gsang khros pa rta mgrin nag po 'di nus mthu byin rlabs glog ltar myur ba'i phyir lcags ral sgrub pa me yi 'phreng ba dang :las tshogs dug gri srog gi 'khor lo dang :las mtha' phung gtad hur thums nag po ste zhes pa ltar nus mthu byin rlabs glog ltar myur ba rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs me'i 'phreng (snang/ba zhes pa (gung/di rdzas gsang sgrub pa las sbyor gsum bstan pa rje 'bangs grogs lnga lo tsā ba chen po bzhis dbang chen dmar nag rgyud dang man ngag tu byas pa'i mthar thug ā tsarla ye shes kyis yig mkhan byas te gnam skas brag la sbas pa/dbang mchog dregs pa'i srog gi rgya 6/yos ge gu ru'i gsung bawo btsun pa rgyaX ༷ mchog dbyangs kyis pha bong g.yu'i sgrom gyi shar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedu yi ger bkod pa/ thems med/ dkyil 'khor/ gtor ma/ them med/ bum pa/ mda'/ ral gri rnams kyi dpe ris dang bcas pa/ las tshogs dug gri srog gi 'khor lo (snang)khro nge/zhesapa rgyal bsen rtsad nas gcod pa/ seng phung la brten nas nad gdon bsrung ba/ nad rims thams cad khyad par grib dang mi gtsang ba bsrung ba/ ser rgod phral bzlog /rgyal po mi bsrun ba sus kyang thul dka' ba gdul ba'i man ngag srog tig gud du sbas pa bka' rgya dang bcas pa/ ling ga /khyi thod/ phur pa/gud du sbas pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyor dang bcas pa'i dpe ris/ them med/ rta (342bsgo grin nag po'i las tshogs gud du sbas (snang)91 ge pa nang gses kyi sri'u gso ba/ them med/ bsrung 'khor chen mo/bkru ba khrus/ dgra bgegs sreg pa/ bdug cing gzer ba/ dgra bgegs gnon pa/ gdon ngos gzung ba/ rta bro dang bcas pa rta mgrin nag po'i yig chung zab khyad them med/ 6nges zhu nges na la nang gses kyi drag po rdzas kyi bsrung ba/ bskyed pa ting 'dzin gyi bsrung ba/ drag po sngags kyi bsrung ba/dngos nyams kyi rtags la brten nas sngags kyi kha bsgyur/ gter 'bul bstod pa mthing nag gru gsum ma dang bcas pa/ rakṣa nag po'i rgyud las slob dpon shanti garbhas phyung ba'i phung gtad hur thums nag po don gsum gyis bstan (snang)dza nge/pa shi thebs snying gi bu gcig las mi spel ba dpe ris dang bcas pa/ thems ra/ phung byed khang ( )sel nag po/ the mir/ dus kyi snyigs ma la dgra sri gnon pa'i man (snang/khro geng ga /them med/ de'i ling ga /ra khyi phag gsum gyi thod pa/ mdzo ru bcas pa'i dpe ris/ them med/ gto gcig gi nang du dgra bo brgya thams9re/pa shong pa'i 'jig rten phung las kyi mes po srog gi skru gri/ thems med/ de'i gnad kyi man (dar/ngag yig chung zur du gab pa/ them med/ dgra ru yod lhog pa nag pos btsan thabs(dar/gsad pa'i zab pa'i mthar thug pa/ dgra bo 'dres gnon pa'i man ngag rdzas bca' gzhi sngags dang gsum gyis bstan pa/ them med/ pe dkar pe nag pe dmar gsum rtog te re/gyi za yig snying nang gi dngas ma rnams/lnga pa ma tshang ba kha stong ba gdams phran sna tshogs skor ni/ spyi yi las tshogis bzlog pa dug gri —498

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnam man ngag gter bum gzo na pa tra'i skor thod (343na)pa rdzas ngan yig sna kun thub skor man ngag gter bum dar sogs chos kyi gnad char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bus ma bu tshang :zhes pa ltar mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong can gyi las tshogs bzlog pa dug gri nag po zhes pa lo rgyus/bsnyen pa/ gang 'dul las tshogos la nang gses kyi yams nad dang rtsub sbyor kyi tshe rang bsrung / rmi lam ngan bzlog /phyogs ban/ gdon/ phyugs kyi glog gor bsrung ba/ bsrung bzlog dang bcas pa/man ngag rin cen gter bum la nang gses kyi zhwa chos rin cen 'bar ba gu ru'i gsung bzhin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bkod pa/ rdzas drug la brten pa'i rin cen gser gyi pa tra bzo ba/ rdzas dgu la brten nas bzo ba/ /tsi ma gi ta sogs drug la brten nas bzo ba/ g.yu rnying 'chos pa'i pa tra dang /gsar pa 'chos pa'i pa tra/ shel bum bzo pa'i pa tra/ mu men gyi bum pa bzo ba'i pa tra/ dkar yol gyi pa tra/ ko bsed dang shing bse'i pa tra/ shing kun/ rgya tshwa bzo ba/ kha ru tshwa rdzas bzhis bzo ba/ rdzas bdun gyis bzo ba'i sman gyi pa tra dang bcas pa/ gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas sogs la nye bar rtog te ma kho ba'i zhal ba'i gdams pa/ them med/ kun thub la/ ngan sngags yig sna kun thub/ ngan sngags 'khor lo kun thub/ thod ngan kun thub/ sna tshogs rdzasang na kun thub rnams gshin rje gsal shing gi rgyud nas btus pa/ zhwa chos kyi cha lag dar ras la tshos dmar ser/ sngon po/ nag po/ ljang khu/ lcags nag rgyag thabs/ 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod skong phyir char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu don gsum gyis bstan pa (343ba)phung byed shanti ga lha'i man ngag zab pa'i mthar thug /gzhan snang dbang du sdud ( gte re)pa tshangs dbyang tshogasung gi bcos thabs thems med/ rnga 'chos tshangs pa'i 'brug sgra sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi bstan pa thems med/ gu ru'i gsung bzhin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi bkod pa/ bsam yas ārla pa gling du gsungs(gter)pa'i dbang sdud las kyi yang khol/ dpal rta mgrin gyi bka' srung lcam dral gyi las kyi mde kha la bsnol gri'i thod pa brten nas dgra gsod pa/'brub khung dmar nag tu gsod pa/ thun gyi gsod pa/ ltas ga/ smin lam ngan pa/ smyo bog gsum —499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (negatong ba/ ser ba dang thog dbab pa/ rang bsrung / char 'bebs/ thog ser kha char gcod pa/ rbod gtong bod 'dre/ rmi lam ga pa/ dus min 'tshe ba bzlog pa/ tshe bsring ba/ longs spyod dang rigasabargyud spel ba/ phas kyi rbod gtong bzlog pa/ ngag gnon pa/ ngag 'grol/ klu gtad/ cog 'gyel du gsod pa/ jag 'ching / lha dbye/ nye 'byed/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud/ dgra la khang sel/ zhing sel/dur sel gtong ba dang bcas pa slob dpon padmas rje 'bangs la gtad pa rnams/ drug pa yid ches bskyed pa'i zhal gdams kha 'thor skor ni/gu ru'i rnam thar gser gyi 'phreng ba dang : zhal gdams lung 'phreng gnad kyi zhu lan rnams yid ches bskyed pa spyi yi kha skong yin zhes pa ltar gu ru'i rnam thar mtha' ( go te re)ma zhal gdams gser kyi 'phreng ba/ zhal gdams lung gi 'phreng ba zhes pa gter ston gyi sku tshe'i tshad/ gdul bya/mdzad tshul/ gsang yum phyogs gang nas 'byung sogs lang 'gro lo tsā bar gsungs pa'i gter bdag las(344na7na lung bstan du grags pa/ zhal gdams yang zhun gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa thugs sras nye ba'i 'khor brgyad kyis slob dpon la zhus lan ma 'ongs mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa tshul ldan dang ltar snang 'byung tshul dang bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi ring thung dang tshad sogs bstan pa mkhar chen bzas shog ser la btab pa/ chos rje rkarma pa'i gang zag ( go te re)sgos lung rnams/bdun pa thems med yum bka' zab khyad can gyis skor la/ ras bris dang si/ ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pas ye shes lnga'i dbang / thod pas mkha' 'gro lnga'i dbang / me long gis gsal stong rig pa'i dbang sku sngags ngo sprod gsum gyis sku gsung thugs kyi dbang rnams mnos shing / lung la/shel dkar bza' dang mon mo bkra shis khye 'dren gnyis kyi jo mo la zhus pa'i phyi ltar ye shes 'tsho rgyal lwa su'i skur sgrub pa shin tu byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan che ba mkha' 'gro dngos kyi gsung shel dkar bzas bkod pa/ ma gcig ye shes 'tsho rgyal nang ltar rje btsun sgrol mar sgrub pa le'u bco brgyad pa mon mo bkra shis khye 'dren gyis zhus pa'i sgrub mchog yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang ba ye shes —300—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)'tsho rgyal rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mor sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu don gsum gyis bstan pa/ gces gnad srog gi bla rdo tshig gsang ba snying gi yang zhun mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal phag mor sgrub pa'i dbang yid bzhin nor bu dkar bzas zin bris su btab pa/ bum pa/ dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi/ kha khebs/cang teg rakta/ mkha' 'gro/ yi dam/ ma mo/ chos skyong gi gtor ma/ bla rdo dang bcas pa'i dpe (344ba)ris rnams/brgyad pa sgos kyi bka' skyong sngags srung e ka dza ṭi'i skor la/ gtor ma sku 'bag phyag mtshan la brten pa'i mngon spyod drag po'i lha dbang lus la bskur ba/ gtor ma dang bdud rtsi brten nasadam bsre zhing gnyer gtad dam tshig bsgrag bcas mnos nas/ lung la/ thems byang las/ rta mgrin dbang chen sgos kyi bka' srung ni sngags srung gsang sgrub spu gri bsal rgal dang : dbang dang lasabyang bskang gsogan da yig gis ma bu tshang bas byin chen zab mthar thug ces pa ltar sngags srung ma'i gsang sgrub (gter)ma mo srin pa'i thog rgod srog rtsa dmar 'byin spu gri gsal rgal ma/ skal ldan skyes bu lung rdzogs kyi bu rtog te re)la rjes su gnang ba'i yi ge /dpal sngags kyi srung ma'i mchod bstod bkang thabs(gter)gsang 'dus khro bo'i bka' srung du mnam skas brag la sbas pa rnams/dgu pa spyi'i srung ma gnod sbyin drag po bshad pa dmar nag skor la/ dbang gi yi ger steng nas gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu dbang / bgo ba'i gos gsum/ phyag mtshan/thun rdzas zor dbang dang bcas pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge ltar dpal gtor sku 'bag phyag mtshan la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang / dbang gtor/ mchod gtor/ bdud rtsi la brten pa'i bka' gtad dam bsgo rnams mnos nas/ lung la/ dbang chen thems byang las/ e ma gnod sbyin drag po bshan pa dmar nag 'di gter kha 'di yi spyi srung chen po ste rno myur drag rtsal thog dang 'dra ba'i phyir padma nga yi bstan bsrung mthar thug ste zhes rags rim tsam bstan cing sgos kyi thems byang bka' (345na)rgya ma las/ rtsa ba'i srog sgrub srog rtsa dmar lan dang drag po'i srog dbang brten —50/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyi bca' thabs dang :gnad 'bebs yang gces shi sa bstan pa dang :rbad bskul bcom dam sngags kyi 'byin 'jug dang :gnyer gtad bcol dam nor sgrub gter bum dang :ltasang na bskul byang gnan sreg 'phrang gsum dang :rtags yig bla rdo las byang bkang gsodang :bkang mdos dag gis lhag chad med par tshang :zhes pa ltar thems byang bka' rgya ma shin tu gces pa'i snying byang /'gor phyon bdag gis bdud blon bsgral te zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus/thems med/phyi lha srin sde brgyad/nang rnam thos sras/gsang ba gza' rgod mig dmar te gnod sbyin ( gte dmar nag rtsa ba'i srog sgrub srog rtsa dmar len/gnod sbyin drag po'i srog dbang spu gri'i rgya can 'khod thebs snying gi bu gcig las spel du mi rung ba/gtor ma dang phyag ma' la brten pa'i gnod rtog te sbyin bshan pa dmar po'i dbang shin tu gnyan par grags pa rjes gnang gi yi ge/them med/gsang ba gnasakhang la chags pa pho brang rten gyi bca' thabs rtog te re/'khru ldog med cing lasahrūb pa/dam tshig bsre ba'i man ngag ( go te re)shin tu gnad che ba/thems med/shin tu mi bsrun pas ma 'chun na gnad 'bebs snying gi bu gcig las bstan du mi rung ba/de dang 'dra min zhig/thems med/yang gces rten 'brel stod la gnon pa sgrub pa chud mi za ba/lha dgra rang gsum shi sa bstan pa chig brgyud ma/rbad bskul srog gi spu gri rtog te re/dam tshig chen po ma/gsang rtags yid ches ma byung na sngags345bkyas yin 'jug sngags sgrol bsnal dkrug mtha' bsgyur can/gnyer gtad bcol dam chen (gter)mo tshangs pa'i dmag dpon ma/nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa 'dzam gling gi nor bdag tu 'gyur pa/ltas ga gtong ba thog rgod 'bar ba rtog te ge ltas༅ rgyun mi go du 'byung ba/las mtha' sdud pa mnan sregs 'phang gsum brnag pa'i mthar thug/bod rbad gsad gsum gyi yang (gter)zab rtagasayig gud sbas/yang gces bla rdo'i man rtog ter)ngag srog 'phrog bsdun du bzung ba lta bu/las byang gsol kha ( gte re/sngon bskal ma/bkang gso 'phrin las sbu (nyang)gri steng phyogs nam mkha' ma/bkang mdos 'phrin las gter mdzod (nyang)ba/ shis yon to dpag tu med de rnal 'byor pas

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ rtoganabartson par bya'o'i mtha' can rnams/bcu pa nor gyi dbang phyug rgyal chen rnam sras skor la/gtor ma la brten nas 'phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes shing khams gsum la dbang sgyur ba'i dbang /phyag mtshan bzhi'i dbang /gri rnying bla rdo'i dbang /gtor ma dang sgrub yig la brten nas dam bsre ba/tshe'i dbang /yid bzhin nor gyi dbang rnams mnos nas/lung la/thems byang las/nor gyi mnga' bdag rgyal chen rnam sras 'di rnal 'byor chos dang 'jig rten gang sgrub kyang :longs spyod dgos pas gsang gter 'di ru sbas gsang ba'i sgrub pa rjes gnang las gzhi bcas snying dang 'dra'o spel tshong zhabs togo ltos zhes pa ltar/gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu zhar byung khyad par gnad kyi zhal gdams dang bcas pa yang gsang snying gi sgrub pa/dbang chog yid bzhin 346na ) gter mdzod/las byang bkang gso'i rim pa dad pa dam tshig ma/bla rdo ces pa'i man ngag bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa/thems med/khong pa'i snying dang 'dra ba lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs thabs/srog rtsa gnad kyi 'khor lo zhar byung skab 'dre bse rag gnon thabs dang bcas pa/sgab 'dre bse rag gnod sbyin gzhan gyi mi thub pa dang rdzi bhi tri'u gnod pa'i lag len sgrub pa chud mi za bar bya ba/tsakra'i bri yig (nyi pe shes par gyis kyi mtha' 175/can/them ra/khyad par gnad nyi nge / kyi zhal gdams/rnam sras rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa'i tshe sgrub/them med/de'i las tshogs kyi char gtogs pa'i lde nag srog 'khor yid bzhin nor bu zhesapa'i yid ches kyi rtseb lo rgyus/sgo med/rten 'brel gyi che ba rdzas/gnad kyi che ba 'khor lo/lag len gyi che ba bcos thabs dang rab gnas/mtha' rgyas kyi che ba gzungs dang bcol bskul te lngasabastan pa/steng 'khor 'dod pa char 'bebs/them med/'og 'khor dngos grub mtsho 'khyil sa la nag po'i srog gi 'khor lo'i gzungs/thems med/gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs dang bcas pa rnams/them med/bcu gcig pa ༅ thabs las phran skor //gzhan yang bstan srung man ngag zab mo'i skor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheyang bzlog zab mo rdo rje'i pha lam 'di 'jig rten dkon pas spel na rang gshed 'ong :myur byed mu stegs sha za hor mo dang :ngan sngags mthar thug bse yi lha mo dang srog rtsa dmar 'byin khab mthu reg mchod dang :phung byed las sbyor rlung rta kha sbub thabs 'khor lo bcas mchog rlung rta rta khog ma mi 346ba〉rgod kha 'ching gcan gzan kha 'ching dang :phung byed sbyor nag phung byed spu gri'i skor phung byed sbyor ba rakṣa hur thums dang :bya rog lug pa'i nye 'byed yul sel ma cho 'phrul ltasang na myur byed la sogs pa sna res bstan bsrung 'jig rten phung las nus zhes pa ltar yang bzlog rdo rje pha lam (gung/'jig rten du dkon pa'i man ngag bsrung ba'i tsakra 'dri thabs/zla ba gcig nas dgra bo 'chi ba'i rno myur drag sngags spu gri 'dra ba dang bcas pa/de'i zhal shes snyan brgyud bka' (dir/rgya ma dmigs pa'i yang gces gud du sbas pa/thems med/mu stegs sha za (dar/hor mo'i gsad las/de'i sgo nas ltas9re/༅ gtang ba/bse mo'i drag sngags spu gri so gal 'a re so rje'i srog yod kyang the tsho med pa/mi ngan bsod nams dregs pas khengs pa bsod nams bsnab pa'i gdams pa (du ge phung gto rta dmar 'khor lo/dregs pa can
