gyi rlung rta bsgrub (du ge thabs zhes par mi mnyam mnyam du gzhug pa/mthon po 'bebs pa/dregs pa bsnub pa/nus pa sngon du 'byin pa'i zab khyad can rnams/de'i 'khor lo lidma'i dpe ris dang bcas pa/them med/gza' rgod rengs byed nag po'i man ngag (dar/mi rgod jag 'ching zha rengs ma/gdams pa khyad par can gyi shog dril bka' rgya (gung/ma phung byed spu gri la mu stegs 'dre 'dul nag po'i ngan sngags sel nag nag po dgu sbyor zhes pa mkhar 'jig pa/ston thog gtan mi skye ba/pha tshan phung ba/phyugs kha dag pa/rta 'ching ba bag mab po mi shis pa/rabs gcod pa/khyi tshogs na ngu ba/bya tshogs nas skad 'don pa/wa343thams cad 'dus nas brgyal ba/mi thams cad 'thab pa/nor dang dbral ba/khrag char zhag bdun 'bab pa/lha dang 'bral ba/mthu byad kho rang la bzlog pa/dmag bub par byed pa dang bcas pa/mu stegs a tsha kha che'i sel rgod dug mda' nag ༷ zhes pa khyim ri rul du gtong ba/mu stegs rin

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (ga)cen go cha'i gdams pa khang rmang mi phyugs thal ba rlung khyer/ ngan sngags 'dzul khung gtan brlag /pho mo 'byed pa/ bza' mi 'thab pa/ thog ser dbab pa/ pho mor gtong ba/ mi ldang ba/ na ba/ 'chi ba gsum kha bsgyur chog pa'i mdze gtad/ stu gtad dmar mo khrag 'dzag /dam nyams 'dres gnon thabs rang bsrung dang bcas pa/ nā ga klu'i cog rdung zhes pa bza' tshang 'byed pa/ gsod pa/ ngag gnon/ mdzes khyer gtad du phung ba/ lha bdud 'bab dang cas pa/ rgya'i phung byed bzhi'i gdamasapa khyim phung nor gyi khro tshags/ me 'bar ba'i rdzu tsol/ chang bsrung / chang gtad/ char bsrung / zhing gi 'bu bsrung ba rnams/ bya rog 'ug pa'i nye 'byed phung sel (dar/ma ji ltar mthun yang mi 'gyangs pa/ wa thod la brten pa'i ltasang na 'ge dmag gi rgyal po spun gsum gyi cho 'phrul/ 'jig rten phung byed bzan thabs(dang/kyi ser pa 'bebs pa/ thems med/ de'i cha lag gsang ba (dar/rdzas kyi dud pas yul lha bsgrad pa/ khrag 'thung nag po/ gtsug lag dpal dge spyin gyi shugs 'chang / shanti garbha bzhi'i ngan sngags las sbyor sum stong drug brgya rgya gar mkhas pa padmas mkhyen pas ma 'ongs sngags chung gsar ba'i don du spyi la gces(gung/pa'i srog khyim thems med/ zab mo/ (347ba)dgra bgegs sgo gcod phyir pho brgyud mo brgyud sgrub par rnyas pa'i (du ge pho gnad zab mo/ thems med/ dgra bo'i rang gshed skor pa (du ge lo zla zhag dus tshod kyi kha byang gsal ba'i sgron me thems med/ dgra bo'i bla (du nge khyogs tshad bstan pa zla ba dang dus tshod nag po'i ngos (du ge 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams thob pa las/ them med/ rta mgrin gsang ba bos pa'i dbang bzhi gtor dbang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa/sprul sku padma thod 'phreng rigs lnga/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ gsabs sangs rgyas ye shes/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas/ lo wo bee ro tsa na/ legs sbyin nyi ma/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/cog ro klu'i rgyal mas/ shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/ gter ston chos kyi rgyal po 'gro khrul gling pa/ rgyal —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesras tshe dbang grags pa/ mtshudas med ngag dbang grags pa/ gtsug rgyan ngag dbang nor bu/ bi ma'i rnam sprul nor bu yongs grags/ chos sdings sngags 'chang dbang chen lhun grub/ spel lcog ratna sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ nyang chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ drin can sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor brnye'i yi dam gyi lhar stsal to/ /'jigs byed me'i spu gri'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ bal mo ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas(348na)ye shes/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal ratna gling pa man gong ltar ro/ /gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i dbang brgyud ni/ kun bzang he ru ka /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/ gter ston man 'dra/ rta nag gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ khri srong lde btsan/ nam mkha' snying po/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ bee ro tsa na/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu rgyal mtshan/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/ sprul sku ratna gling pa nas nor bu yongs gragasabar gong ltar la/ de nas rgyal sras rkarma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin man 'dra/ yang na rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ grub chen rigs 'dzin dpal 'bar/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rdo rje/ mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na nor bu yongs grags/ yug rdzogs pa ma ni ind+ra rā dza/ zur dar ma pa bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin man 'dra/ yang na rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ gter ston nas mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang bar la dge slong dpal gyi rin cen zer ba las med pa gsan yig 'gar snang ba stag mgo yon tan dpal ba'i —506

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganamatshan gyi (348bskom grang su byas pa'i nye brgyud ring brgyud kyi khyad yin nam dpyad/ stag mgo yon tan dpal/ gu ru sangs rgyas ye shes/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / mtshungs med bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /rdo rje dang gter gyi rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i sa bcad drug pa yan gyi lung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ nor bu yongs grags yan gong gi sras brgyud ltar la/ de nas rje btsun nor bu dbang rgyal/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ dar sdings rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur khyab bdag chosadabyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor brnyel bka' drin du stsal to/ /dar gyi rtags med pa'i rta nag gi lung la spyi brgyud du ma zad rta nag sgos dbang gi brgyud tshul rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi po yang tshang bar yod do/ /'khon gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ nor bu yongs grags nas/ yug sngags 'chang nor bu dbang rgyal/ de sras mi 'gyur rdo rje/ gsang bdag gnyis pa rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ de sras gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa bcad drug pa yan gyi gter gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gsung sprul nas/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa bcad drug pa yan gyi gung dang rdo rje bcu gcig (349na)pa'i gung gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ yug rdzong mi 'gyur rdo rje nas/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ tshe dbang grags pa nas mtha' yas grags pa/ grags pa mchog legs/ kun bzang dpal 'byor/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ 'phrin las lhun grub man sngar bzhin no/ /sa bcad drug pa yan gyi dar dang bcu gcig pa'i dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gu ru dbyangs dpon pa yang gong ltar la/ de —507—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenas khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sa bcad bdun pa 'tsho rgyal skor gsum gyi dbang brgyud ni/ chos sku rdo rje phag mo/ longs sku rdo rje sgrol ma/ sprul sku ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho/ mon mo bkra shis khye 'dren/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ gter ston man sa bcad drug pa yan gyi brgyud pa dngos gzhi'i dar sdings pa yan 'dra ba la/ de nas grub chen ga rma gsang sngags/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /lung gi brgyud pa ni/ dar sdings pa nas/ zur drin can bla ma/ desabadag la'o/ /sa bcad brgyad pa sngags srung ma'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang yab yum khros ma nag mo/padma thod 'phreng / mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/ chos rgyal ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ gar dbang las 'gro gling pa/ sras 'jig rten mgon po/ spel lcogs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dbon rigs 'dzin chos bzang / rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/des bdag la'o/ /lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ tshe dbang grags pa nas/ ngag dbang nor bu/ nor bu yongs grags/ sras nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul/ 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ sa bcad dgu pa gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag gi rjes gnang dang nyang gi rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni gsang ba'i bdag po/ gu ru padma/ ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/'gro 'dul gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang nor bu/ nor bu yongs grags/ yug rdzong ma ni ind+ra dza/ sras mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dbyangs dpon pa mthu stobs gsang ba'i dbang phyug /zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang dbang rjes gnang dang gter dang nyang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ nor bu yongs grags yan gong ltar la/ de nas rgyal sras ga rma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ nyang chos ldan pa ratna 'phrin las bstan 'dzin/ grub pa'i dbang phyug klong yangs 'od gsal dam pa 'dzam gling yang ra/ sprul pa'i sku mchog —508—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagater bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /bcu pa rgyal chen rnam sras kyi nyang gi rtags ma gtogs pa'i dbang lung gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan yab yum/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba/ 'gro 'dul gling pa/ tshe dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kun dga' grags pa/ kun dga' (350na)bstan 'dzin/ ka thog pa dbang drag rdo rje/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/zur gzhon nu don grub/ des sras rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngag dbang grags pa nas/ ngag dbang nor bu/ nor bu yongs grags/ yug rdzong ba yab sras/ dbyangs dpon pa/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /nyang gi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/nor bu yongs grags nas/ chos sdings pa dbang chen lhun grub/ spel lcog pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/chos ldan pa ranta 'phrin las drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rjo nag srog 'khor gyi lung brgyud ni/ gsang bdag /ḍā ki ma ga ga na sirnyi/ dha na ko ka /rgyal po pu'o de wa/ o rgyan chen po man brgyud pa gong ma gnyis ltar ro/ /sa bcad bcu pa'i rdo rje pha lam gyi lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med yan rta nag gi lung brgyud ltar la/ de nas grub chen kun dga' rdo rje/ bla ma 'jam dpal 'od zer/dar sdings 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs skor/'di'i dbang chen zhus dus/ chos skor 'di dang lhan du spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin gyi phur pa lag tu 'byor bas kyang rten 'brel legs par 'grig go /lho brag gnam skas can gyi brag klu bdud mgo dgu'i pho brang nas sprul pa'i gter ston 'gro 'dul gling pas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po zhi —509—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedrag gi lam gyi cha rkyen gsang chen sngags kyi nye lam med du byung ba zab mo pho nya'i lam mchog gsang ba snying po 'dus pa'i skor la/ kun rdzob rdos bcas a 'thas kyi rnam smin sbyong bar byed pa bskyed rim gyi skor (350ba)don dam zag pa med pa'i bde stong lam du 'byer bar byed pa gzhung 'khrid kyi skor/ de dag gi bogs 'don zhing dmar cha'i dngas ma bsdus te 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gsang ba bcud len gyi skor/ gzhan don rgyud mi chad pa rigs brgyud spel ba'i skor/ mtshan ldan shes rab ma grol bar byed pa mo 'khrid gsang ba'i skor/ de dag gi kha skong man ngag sna tshogs pa'i skor dang drug /dang po la/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu gu ru'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis yi ger bkod pa/ dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub mchod khyad par can gyi manda la la g.yu'i phra bkod pa lta bu gu ru'i gsung bzhin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis shog ser la bris pa/sangs rgyas kun gyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro thod rgal gyi sgrub thabs gsang ba snying gi dum bu la nang gses kyi byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba snying dang 'dra ba bsnyen pa'i man ngag /dngos grub kyi rtsa ba snying sgrub thod rgal tsha ba dmar thag sgrub pa'i rim pa de'i zhal bsgrigs rdzas la brten pa'i gnad sgrub bcas chog thod rgyal 'phrul gyi dum bu/ 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba las sbyor gsang ba yang 'khor gnod sbyin ma nyi ma'i 'od zer las la bkol ba'i zab gnad/ de'i las phran rgyal khams dbang sdud/ mtshan ldan phyag rgya 'gugs pa/ sgrub thabs 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag zhal shes rnams/ gnyis pa don dam zag pa med pa'i bde stong lam du 'khyer ba byed pa gzhung 'khrid kyi skor la/ zab lam gsang 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung 'khrid (351na)chen mo zab pa'i mthar thug snying bcud dam pa yun gyi shes rab mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal gyis dgung lo nyis brgya bsgrubs pa'i tshe lug lo lho brag mkhar chur bris pa/ rtsa mdud 'grol zhing rlung dbu mar 'jug pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rtsa tshig tshigs bcad ma mkhar chen bzas mkhar chu phug ring du bkod pa de'i 'grel —510

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganab rtsa tshig rgyas pa bshad pa 'khrul zhig nyang po don grub rgyal pos mdzad pa/ rang lus bde ba'i mnyam sbyor sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa/ yang gces 'byung ba'i dug dbyung zab mo gser srang re'i bka' rgya ma/ lam 'bras yang gces sbas pa'i gnad yig thugs bcud snying po'i man ngag gser zhun ma lta bu/ rdzas kyi thabs lam zla ba btson 'dzin zhes pa 'gron bu dang rma bya'i rgyus pa rdo khab len la brten pa'i rigs gsum/ bde ba skyed thabs sbrang rgod dang rtag tu ngu dang /sgog gcig ma/ rdo khab len rnams la brten pa'i rigs bzhi/ bha ga dam po byed pa/ padma kha zum pa dang 'byed thabs/ rigs brgyud mi 'chol ba/ yid ches rgyas gdab dang bcas pa rnams/ gsum pa de dag gi bogs 'don zhing dmar cha'i dngas ma bsdus te 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gsang ba'i bcud len gyi skor la/ rdo rje chu 'thung gi man ngag snying gi dum bu gud du sbas pa/ dngas ma dkar po dang padma'i bcud bsdus pa gsang ba'i bcud len gsang ba 'dus pa zab rgya can/ zab lam snying po 'dus pa zhes 'dod chags la brten nas gsang (351ba)ba'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i man ngag rnams/bzhi pa gzhan don rgyun mi chad pa rigs brgyud spel ba'i skor la/ rigs brgyud sprul sku gzhag pa'i man ngag bka' rgya ma snying gi dum bu/ de'i bgegs sel gser srang re med par sbyin du mi rung ba/shin tu zab pa'i lte bsgyur gud du sbas pa rnams/ lnga pa mtshan ldan shes rab ma grol bar byed pa mo 'khrid gsang ba'i skor la/ las kyi phyag rgya ma grol bar byed pa gsang 'khrid snying gi dum bu sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa shel dkar bza' rdo rje 'tsho sgron gyis o rgyan rin po che'i gsung bzhin la yag mon mkhar du bkod pa/ drug pa de dag gi kha skong man ngag sna tshogs kyi skor la/dbang sdud thams cad kyi rgyal po las kyi yang khol rin cen gter mdzod/ bud med mtshan ldan 'gugs thabs mas bu mthong ba lta bu/ mu dra mtshan ldan dbang du bsdu ba nyin gcig gis 'grub pa 'grol thabs dang bcas pa/ mu dra'i ti ba drang ba rdzas la brten pa'i thabs lam zhar byung rang dang 'bral mi phod par bya ba/ phyag rgya'i srid gtad du gcod pa dang zhar byung gnas skabs su gcod pa/—511 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (nebud med sma dbab pa mtshan ma khrag tu skyug tu 'jug pa/ zab lam yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag khol phyung sha sbyor badzra rgyas pa'i rdzas sbyor log gnon 'bral mi phod pa'i dbang sdud dang bcas pa/ rten 'brel dbang sdud kyi man ngag mkha' 'gro gsang ba yang khol gyi tsakra khyad par can/ zab lam yid bzhin nor bu'i yang gces snying po snying (352na)byang logs su gab pa rdo rje chu 'thung gi gnad yig zhar byung gnas skabs kyi gegs sel/ srid mi chags pa'i thabs brgyad ya ga'i sgro skur spang phyir rdzas sngags kyi sgrib shing dang bcas pa/ srid gcod stag sbrul gyi 'khor lo zab mo/ bud med kyi gzugs la brten nas phyag rgya ma dbang du bya thabs yang zab yid bzhin nor bu zhan byung 'grol thabs dang bcas pa/ lus kyi dngas ma stobs skyed bcud len gyi man ngag ces pa tshe ring rgas sra nor 'phel phyir zla ba btson 'dzin/ gong gi de dang 'di gnyis don migacig khu dum snying gi lcags kyu las rdo rje khong skyong man ngag /srid gcod gzhon skyong bsrung ba/ lus stobs bskyed pa'i bas sbyor/ lnga sbyor/ bzhi sbyor/ gsum sbyor/ gnyis sbyor la brten pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku rta mchog rgyal po/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ shel dkar bza' rdo rje 'tsho sgron/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gling pa/ de sras tshe dbang grags pa dang / 'khrul zhig don grub rgyal po/ de gnyis kas mtshudas med ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med ngag dbang nor bu/ yongs 'dzin nor bu yongs grags/ skadze 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ mnyam med nam mkha' 'brug sgra/ dar sdings pa chen po 'phrin las lhun grub /zur kun mkhyen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /sprul sku (352ba)ratna gling pas rdo bod mtshams kyi 'bri thang ko ro brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rta phag gsang sgrub skor gsum du grags pa'i zab khyad can ni/ gsung gi dbang phyug dpa' bo rta mgrin thabs mchog rkyang par sgrub pa/ phag nag lcags mche shes rab yum rkyang du sgrub pa/ yab yum zung 'jug bde ba rgyas pa'i tshul gyis dbyer med du sgrub pa rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' —512

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun la glegs bam gsum pa/ rtog)yas/ rta phag yab yum/ slob dpon padma ka ra/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ dpa' bo mtha' yas grags pa/rje nor bu yongs grags/ rkarma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ rigs 'dzan 'phrin lasalhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston ratna gling pas dwags po ldang lung phra mo brag gi po to 'og ma nas stig lo 'brug zla'i lha'i dus la gdan drangs pa'i dpal chen rdo rje phur pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po ni/ thems byang las/ yi dam sgrub pa dpag med kun thob kyang : sngon las 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor me tog lha lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje phur pa 'di 'tsho rgyal bdag la bka' babs snying thig yin 'di la brgyud rim bka' gter dpag med kyang : yang gsang bla med spu gri'i skor 'di dag mon kha ne ring seng ge rdzong gsum du skyon rje dang bdag 'khor nyer gcig gis bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor (353na tshe skar phye bsgrubs rje la 'tsho rgyal bdag gis zla ba bdun seng ge rdzong du yi dam bsgrub pa'i tshe phur pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mngon sum mjal grub rtags rdo rje'i brag la phur pa btab: seng ge rdzong du tshe chu'i rgyun yang babs ma 'ongs dus mtha'i bar du gnas pa nges:su yis mthong yang tshe yi bar gcod sel zhes pa ltar khyad par 'phags pa phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi chos skor la dbang chog 'phrin las kyi gter mdzod la brten nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang / cod pan gyis ye shes lnga'i dbang / bum pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ bdud rtsis 'chad nyan/ gtso phur khro bcu sa gsod khra thabs/ phur bsrung bcu gnyis/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig /sgo ba bzhi/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnamasakyi phur sgrom la brten nas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / 'phrin las bzhi'i dbang / sgom zhing sgrub pa'i dbang / yongs rdzogs phyag mtshan gyi dbang / rtags kyi dbang / bsnyen sgrub 'dzab kyi dbang /—513—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedapal chen yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / drag po sgrol dbang / gtor dbang / 'phrin las sgrub nus pa'i dbang / tshe dbang longs spyod kyi dbang / phyag rgya la brten nas(353bskor dbang / bzhi pa rtsal dbang rnams/ yang gang zag spros pa la mi dga' ba'i don du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pas sku gsum thugs 'gyur med kyi dbang / phur pas sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang /bdud rtsi gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / phyag mtshan gyis 'phrin las rnam bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang / yab yum gyi chas dbang / 'chi med tshe dbang / bsgral dbang dang bcas pa smin rgyas su mnos nas/ lung la/ thems byang 'phrin las gter mdzod/ de las byung ba'i gdams skor la/ rtsa ba rgyud kyi skor/ stod las phyi nang gsang sgrub sgom khog zhu len dang bcas pa'i skor/ smin byed dbang gi skor/ 'phrin las gzhung srong smad las mngon spyod dang 'brel ba'i skor/ rkyen bzlog khro rol gtor bzlog gi skor/ las sna tshogs pa'i skor/ bstan pa bsrung ba bka' srung sgor dang bdun/dang po ni/ thog mar chos 'di skyed byed ma yi tshul: gsang ba snying po 'phrin las rgyud 'di ni bi dre'i rgyud las rtsa dum khol du phyung : mthar thug yin no rang gi yid la rnogs zhes pa'i bi drotta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud las khol du phyung ba'i phur pa gsang ba snying po 'phrin las kyi rgyud le'u bcu pa/gnyis pa stod las phyi nang gsang sgrub sgom khog zhu lan dang bcas pa'i skor ni/ sgrub pa'i rtsa ba sgrub khog chen modang : spra 'khrid sgom khog rin cen 'phreng ba gnyis: phyi nang sgrub pa (354na〉satsho gos gang byed kyang : 'di nyid blo la nges shing 'dris par bya zhes pa'i spros bcas 'khor tshom bu dang bcas pa mchog thun mong gi dngos grub dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub par byed pa'i phyi sgrub kyi sgrub khog chen mo gser gyi yang zhun lta bu 'tsho rgyal gyi dbu snyung ma/ sgrub chen them med/ gyi mtha' rgyasamar me'i smon lam gu ru'i gsung bzhin 'tsho rgyal gyis bkod pa/ ji ltar nyams su len pa'i spra 'khrid las byang gi cho ga'i sgom khog chen mo rin cen 'phreng ba mkhar chen bzas bkod pa/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa nang sgrub zab mo 'di kun gyi gnad 'dus rtsa ba 'di la thug gsang sgrub 'di ni rnal 'byor —314

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las gleg bam gsum pa/ (gnasnying la chongs 'di gnyis 'brel bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus 'byung ngo snying gi bu zhes pa'i kun gyi gnad 'dus bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug spros med nang ltar sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba yun gyi shes rab ma mkhar chen bzas ldang lung gsang ba'i brag phug tu bris pa/mon kha ne ring seng ge rdzong du rtags khyad par can la brten nas mkhar chen bzas phur pa'i yang zab snying po'i chos skor bcu gsum zhus pa'i nang tshan gsang sgrub snying gi ti ka rnal 'byor snying la bcang ba/ thugs kyi zhugal na gsal ba'i sgron me 'di gnad 'dus don gsal kun la gces pa'i phyir shes rab zab mos khong du chud par bya zhes pa'i zhal gdams gab pa gsal byed kyi me long yang zab thugs kyi zhus lan gsal ba'i sgron me rnams/gsum pa smin byed (354ba)dbang gi skor ni/ dbang chog rgyas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod dang : srung ma'i dbang chog gnam lcags 'khor lo gnyis shes rab blo ldan spros la dga' ba dang :brgyud 'dzin bu la gtad cing ston pa dang : don dbang bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di dbang rdzogs bka' dang byin rlabs 'dus pa'i phyir spros la mi dga' dad ldan bu la bskur zhes pa'i yang gsang bla med gdams pa'i snying po 'dus pa'i dbang chog 'phrin las gter mdzod don gsum gyis bstan pa/ de'i bu yig khro bcu za gsod bcas pa'i dbang chog mtshon cha'i 'khor lo brgyud 'dzin bu la gtod pa'i g.yar dam can/ spros pa la mi dga' bar don dbang yid bzhin nor bu byin rlabs bka' rdzogs dkyil 'khor rnam dag dri med gsal ba dang : gzhal yas don bstod yid bzhin nor bu gnyis dbang gi rgyab yig don gyi dmigs gsal yin zhes pa'i dbang gi rgyab yig dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag bshad pa dri med gsal ba/ gzhal yas don bstod yid bzhin nor bu rnams/bzhi pa 'phrin las gzhung srong smad las mngon spyod dang 'brel ba'i skor ni/ las byang dang ni srung ma bstod bskul bcas kun la gces pa'i kha skong mtha' rgyas yin dug phur nag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang : zab pa'i gnad 'phyong srog gi spu gri gnyis srung ma'i bskul byang dug mda' nag po —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsāsogs dgra bgegs tshar gcod bstan pa srung byed yin zhes pa las byang cho ga'i (355na)rim pa 'phrin las kyi spu gri sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis bstan pa mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'i yi ge bee ros mdzad pa/ las byang zur 'gebs kyi bstod pa dam tshig thugs dam ma/ smad las dug phur nag po mtshon cha las kyi 'khor lo don drug pa/ dug phur nag po'i gnad 'phyong mkha' 'gros lung bstan gsang ba srog gi spu gri padma'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ shā na mched bzhi/ ri ma mched bzhi/ bsemo mched bzhi/ skyes bu ging chen bzhi/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyi bskul byang du dug mda' nag po mkhas pa bee ro tsa nas shog ser la bkod pa rnams/lnga pa rkyen bzlog khro rol gtor bzlog gi skor ni/ gtor bzlog khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'di nyid dang : rdo gtor drag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnyis rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing : bstan pa srung byed las kyi mde kha yin zhes pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med drag sngags gnam lcags spu gri'i sgo nas bzlog pa'i las 'chol ba gtor bzlog khro rgyal stobs 'dus zab gnyan dkon pa ldang lha'i brag la sbas pa/ rdo gtor drag po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'am spu gri'i 'khor lor grags pa/ gtor bzlog kha bsgyur mde kha bcu gnyis zhes pa byad kha sogs mi mthun phyogs kun bsrung ba/ sde brgyad dang chos skyong gi 'khru ldog gnad dbab/ dgra bgegs gdul zhing gsang ba'i las mtha'/ gdon bgegs 'dul/ klu gdul ba/ spyo 'dre gdul ba/ rbod (355ba)gtong bzlog pa/ rgyal bsen gtum po ma rungs pa gdul ba/ zho chang bsrung ba/ drag po rdzas kyi las sbyor /sngags nag gi sbyor ngan bzlog pa/ gnas khang bsrung ba rnams/drug pa las sna tsho gos pa'i skor ni/ bkra shis rten 'brel sgrub dang las tshogos brgyad phan gnod las kyi mtha' rgyas kun la gces gsang thub dam tshig ldan pa'i bu la byin zhes pa'i lasachogs zab mo shin tu zab pa'i bka' rgya can la nang gses kyi spyi la gces pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid/bkra shis rten 'brel gyi che ba bum gter/ dgra jag chom rkun gyi gnod pa med par bkra shis 'dod —516

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnadagu 'grub thabs/ rta drel gnag phyugs kyi god kha gcod cing sgab 'phel thabs/ mi shis pa bzlog ste stobs chen bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa/ gnas khang gi mi mthun pa'i sa dgra bzlog cing bsrung ba'i rten 'brel rnams bstan pa/ las tshogs brgyad ces pa gag lhog gi zer gsum bsrung ba/'brum nad bsrung ba/ mon dug bsrung ba/ gso ba/ gag lhog gzer gsum/ rims/ 'brum nad bsrung ba/ sgo lcags dang g.yag shing 'byed pa/ kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi pra/ lcags 'byed zhal gdams rnams/ bdun pa bstan pa bsrung ba bka' srung skor ni/ ldang lha'i sgrub pa cog brdung spu gri dang : bram ze'i ngan sngags tshal pa nag po gnyis dgra lha'i cho 'phrul dam can lnga 'dul sogs gter kha 'di yi bka' srung mthar thug yin zhes pa'i gter srung ldang lha'i sgrub thabs dug gi spu gri'am srog (356na〉rga dmar 'byin du grags pa/ bram ze spun dgu'i ngan sngags ral gri phyung rdeg mu stegs tshal pa nag po/ dgra lha rdo rje legs pa'i ltas ngan cho 'phrul dam can lnga 'dus rnams dang bcas rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang he ru ka /rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje chos/ mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/ slob dpon 'od zer glang po/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ thugs srab(ngag dbang grags pa/ gu ru kun dga' grags pa/ gu ru kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ ka thog dbang drag rdo rje/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog /sngags 'chang lhun grub rdo rje/de sras gzhon nu don grub/ de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /lhun grub rdo rjes dbang drag rdo rje la yang gsan no/ /sprul pa'i gter ston rig 'dzin chen po ratna gling pa'i zab gter kha 'thor skor la/ mkhar chu gsang phug bzhugs khri'i steng logs kyi brag nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs sgrub yang gsang snying gi nor bu bla ma'i gsang sgrub thugs bcud du grags pa sku mtshal dang da ras rin cen dngul shog la btab pa/ de'i lhan thabs ne ring seng rdzong gi phug mo che nas spyan drangs pa'i smon lam btsan pa'i bu —5/7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegacig gi snying la gtad pa'i mtha' can/ bsam yas dbu rtse'i byang chub chen po'i sku rgyab nas spyan drangs pa la/ gter ston gyi skyes rabs lung gi lde mig bka' rgya ma/ zhu lan lung gi gter byang 'tsho rgyal gyis dkar chag dbu rtse bar mar btab nas pe har la gnyer du gtad pa shes rab blo ldan gcig la sprod pa'i mtha' can/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i gsang sgrub dri med rma bya'i rgya can/ shes bya kun la mi rmongs shing nad rims rgyu gzer dug gis mi tshugs pa'i phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs mdun bskyed 'jam dpal rnon por brten pa'i shes rab blo 'phel rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhas par shog gi mtha' can dang lnga/ bsam yas ārya pā lo'i rta mgrin sku rgyab nas spyan drangs pa'i 'bru gsum la rten nas dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi sgrub thugs srog snying po gcig tu dril ba yang snying thugs kyi gsang sgrub bam snying po'i yang zhun du grags pa 'gro don bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog gi mtha' can/lto brag mkho mthing lha khang dbu rtse'i seng ge'i lcam sna nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru'i bar dmar yid 'ong ri dwags can/ ma zhi'i chos gos dang 'tsho rgyal gyi na bza'i lo rgyus gsal ba'i sgron me/ skye ba bdun pa bram ze dri med snying po'i thugs kyi ril bu'i lo rgyus gsang ba'i sgron me gnyis/ gung thang mkhar gyi me long 'dra ba'i brag sgo nas spyan drangs pa'i jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyi sku tshab 'gro ba kun 'dul gyi rnam (357na)thar/ bsam grub bde ba chen po'i rten ga sdu'i pad 'dab nas spyan drangs pa'i chosadabang rin po che lo gcig tsam nas mya ngan las 'da' gong du sras padma dbang chen sogs 'khor bdun gyi zhus pa 'a ma 'ongs lung bstan sras kyis zin bris su btab pa nye mkhor zhu lan/ de rnams kyis zhug pa'i mnyam sbyor bsdus don dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku phyon padma/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rigasa'adzin ratna gling pa/ thugs sras tshe dbang grags pa/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ rje ngag dbang nor bu/ mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags/ rkarma 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje —518

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gna'aphrin las lhun grub/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /nye 'khor zhu len bsdus don dang bcas pa ni/ 'tsho rgyal nas/ gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug /sras padma dbang chen/ gter ston ranta gling ba man gong bzhin no/ /chos rgyal ratna gling pas kong po gsang ba yang mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'i sman sgrub chen mo gsang ba bdud rtsi mchog gi dam rdzas dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba bla med mchog gi sgrub pa'am sman sgrub gsang ba yongs rdzogs su grags pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje chos/ mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/ rigs 'dzin brgyad/ skyon chen po dang pan chen bi mā la gnyis kyis gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra dang trag ra lha mtsho gnyis la gnang / gnyags kyis phyag dpe (357ba)byin rlabs mchog tu che ba gu dra rnam gnyis kyis smon lam bkra shis mdzad nas shar gter gsang mdzod du sbas pa lang 'gro lo tsā bar bka' babs/ rim bzhin chos rgyal ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ thugs srasangag dbang grags pa/ drin can ngag dbang nor bu/ mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags/ gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang rgyal/ lhun grub pho brang gdan sa pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ e chos ldan pa rigs 'dzin ratna 'phrin las/ khyab bdag khra tshang ba rdo rje mi rtog rtsal/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku ratna gling pa'i gter ma bya khyung gi gzugs la brten nas lug nad gcod pa'i gdams pa ni/ phyon chen po/ mkhar chen bza'/ lang 'gro lo sto ba/ sprul sku ratna gling pa nas rim par/ pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /ratna'i gter ma'i rgyal bsen kha sbyar gyi bsrung ba dang / ldang lha phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i yang bzlog srog gi spu gri 'bru bzhi ma'i brgyud pa ni/ padma he ru ka /thugs rje chen po/ padma thod 'phreng / rje 'bangs grogs lnga/ gter ston rin chen dpal bzang / sras sku mched gnyis/ ngag dbang nor bu/ nor bu yongs grags/ yug ma ni ind+ra rā dza/ zur bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ rlung mi 'gyur rdo rje/ mthu chen dpal ldan grags/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /—519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sheratna'i gter ma'i thog bsrung zab mo thog ris 'khor lo ma dang / jag 'ching lcags spyang ma gnyis/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol gyi drin las thos/ gter gnas dang brgyud pa gsan yig khungs btsun 'dra las slar zhib (358na'i pyod dgos yod/ ratna'i gter ma'i tshe sgrub cing bar gcod sel ba'i za yig phyogs bcu kun gsal 'gor a dang mjug tu dza yod pa'i yig 'bru brtsegs ma bcu gcig la phan yon rdzas dmigs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ o rgyan yab yum/ gter ston yab sras gsum/ ngag dbang nor bu/ tshe dbang yongs grags/ yug pa yab srasaganyis/ dbyangs dpon pa/ zur gzhon nu don grub/ de sras rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku ratna gling pa'i khyung nag rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'i yang gsang khros ma nag mo las yang zab gsang ba'i za yig ces pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi za yig 'gor oṃ mjug tu tha yod pa'i gling bdun ma/ 'gor ā mjug tu gcig yod gling drug ma/ 'gor hūṃ mjug tu rā yod gling drug ma/ rdzas sgom bzlas phan yon bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ o rgyan padma/ rje 'bangs grogs lnga/ gter ston yab sras gsum/ kun dga' grags pa/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ dbang grags rdo rje/ du ma rang grol khu dbon gnyis/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul sku ratna gling pas brag dmar ri mo can nas spyan drangs pa'i bar gcod sel zhing bzlog pa'i za yig za dus kyi dmigs pa bcas pa'i gdams pa khyad par can ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/ o rgyan yab yum/ gter ston ratna gling pa/ sras mtha' yas grags pa/ mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po/ mkhas grub rab stims chos rje/ ma ni ind+ra (358ba)rwa dza/ gsang bdag bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba/ zur kun mkhyen/ desabadag za hor bande la'o/ /sprul sku ratna gling pas rnam thang dge gnas nas spyan drangs pa'i mnyam gnyis rtsal 'gran gyi gdams pa'i lung brgyud ni/ gter ston nas rim par/ bya'i sngags 'chang bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rje —520—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtogana'aphrin las lhun grub/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang sprul pa'i gter ston chen po ratna gling pa'i mnal lam dag snang snyan brgyud mdzod khang bcu gsum ma'i skor la/mdzod khang dang po dag snang yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen por rigs 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas mjal zhing sgrub dbang snyan brgyud kyi chu bo mtha' dag rdzogs tshul lho brag gangs ri'i ngogs dpal chos rdzong gi gnas su mdzad pa zhar byung kho bo bdag 'dra sprang ban ratna gling zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad yod pa/ mdzod khang gnyis pa snyan brgyud rin po che'i 'phrong ba zhes dag snang gong ma'i skabs su phung po ri bo cher slob dpon chen po mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas pa mjal nas ngo sprod gnang ba snying gi bu bag tsam ma gtogs gsang zhing bsdam par gsungs pa/ mdzod khang gsum pa dag snang yid bzhin nor bu'i skabs gu ru nyid la zhus pa'i snyan brgyud 'ga' re logs su shes zhes pa zur du bkol ba sprang ban ratna sa bkod par mkha' 'gro ko long mi sdom zhing bkra shis bde legs mtha' yas pa/ mdzod khang bzhi pa dag snang yid bzhin nor bu'i skababs ma ga ṇi ga 'tsho rgyal la zhus pa snyan brgyud zab mo 'ga' zhig (359na〉spogs su gsal zhes pa pho brang sne'u gdong rtser dbu btsugs nas mdzad pa/ mdzod khang lnga pa dag snang yid bzhin nor bu'i skabs gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ gnums sangs rgyas ye shes/ ngan lam rgyal mchog /dpal gyi ye shes/ rlangs dpal seng / slob dpon dpal dbyangs/ a tsa ra sa le/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra/ a tsa ra ye shes/ 'dan ma rtse mang / sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'dul rnams la zhus pa'i snyan brgyud zur du bkol ba/ mdzod khang drug pa dag snang yid bzhin nor bu'i skabs kyi sgrub chen phra tig phyag len 'phyug med dben gnas gling chung gi dgon pa ratna gling pas bkod pa/mdzod khang bdun pa mnal lam mkhas ma zhes slob dpon padma dang mjal zhing dbang bskur ngo sprod thob tshul gsal ba mkho mthing lha khang du bla ma chos dpal ba'i mkhar gyi yang rtser gter ston gyis bkod pa/ mdzod khang brgyad pa dag snang dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bsam grub bde chen du rgyud —521 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'abum gsan pa'i dus gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug dang mjal zhing bslab bya ngo sprod gsung tshul gtsug lag khang de nyid du bkod pa/ mdzod khang dgu pa zhu lan snying gi me long zhes 'phan yul rgya ma sogs su phebs skabs bal yul yang le shod du gu ru padma rigs 'dzin gyi tshogs bcad dang mjal tshul 'phan yul sman rtse'i ri khrod du bkod pa/ mdzod khang bcu pa rmi lam rang snang 'byul grol bar do gnad kyi 'phreng ba da dung rdzun la nan gyi dus der yi ger bkod pa/ mdzod khang bcu gcig pa 'khrul pa'i snyan brgyud don gsal me long zhes bya ba rgyal po'i pho brang sne'u gdong du bzhugs pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub (359ba)rang gshed kyi khyi'u dang mkha' 'gro mjal tshul dang tshes bco lnga la khra 'brug tu mjal tshul gnas chen de nyid du bkod pa/ mdzod khang bcu gnyis pa dag snang lung gi me tog ces bya ba kong btsun de mo'i spyan 'dren byung tshul g.yu ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyi bris pa/ mdzod khang bcu gsum pa dgung lo nga bzhi pa la chibs rdabs kyis zla ba dgu'i ring bsnyun pa'i tshe gsung sgros skyo ba bsang ba rgyan gyi 'phreng ba zhes rtsa gsum dang mjal zhing gsol ba btab pas sku khams gzhi med du gdangs tshul dang 'dun rnams kyi ngor bde chen gling du bkod pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/sprul sku dran mchog o rgyan/ bde chen bi mā la mi tra/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin bstoganyis sprul sku ratna gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ de srasangag dbang nor bu/ chos rdzogs da po chos dbang bzang po/ rje grags pa mchog legs/ bla ma dam chos bzang po/ rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/des bdag za hor bande la'o/ /yang na rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa nas/ dpa' bo mtha' yas gragasapa/ gdung sras grags pa mchog legs man gong ltar ro/ /—522

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganagater ston chen po padma gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos sna tshogs kyi skor/rgyal ba ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan gang 'dul gyi 'dren par bzhengs pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po padma gling pa ni/ rang gter lung bstan 'od kyi dra ba las/ da lta'i lha lcam padma gsal ma 'ongasabum thang skyes ba'i dus bdag gi thugs sras snying stobs can padma'i ming can skyes bu de zab mo'i gter dang phrad pa'i dus las ldan (360na)slob ma ji ltar yong : las kyi 'brel pa khri phrag gcig smon lam 'brel pa stong rtsa gnyis zab mo gnad 'brel bu bcu gcig dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bu bdun dang : thugs kyi snying sras gsum du 'byung : zhes dang / tshe sgrub rdo rje 'phreng ba las da lta'i lha lcam padma gsal: dag pa'i skye ba lnga len mtha' 'di nas lho nub bum thang phyogs lung pa thal sbyar 'dra ba'i dbus dben gnas gdugs kyi sham bur mtshungs hom khung 'dra ba'i yul nang du pha bzang ma ni padma'i bu lcags khams rta sbrul lo pa cig nga yi thugs sras snying stobs can:skyes bu padma'i ming can 'byung : zhes pa ltar/ sna chas rgyal sras mo lha lcam padma gsal gyi dag pa'i skye ba lnga'i mtha' la mon bum thang du sku 'brungs te zab gter gyi bdag por gyur pa'i tshe chos 'khor pa dpon thub pas khrom bsags nas gter thon na bya dga' ster ma thon na zog pos lung pa 'geng bsakhrims la bsgral zhes bsdigs pa'i tshe sgron shing me 'bar ba zhig bsnams nas mtsho nang la mchongs pas kun ha las pa'i mus la me ma shi zhing gter sgrom mchan khung du bcug nas zil pa khrom me byon par brten ngo mtshar snyan grags phyogs kun tu khyab pa gang des zab gter mang du spyan drangs pa'i nang nas bka' rdzogs pa chen po la pha brgyud dgongs pa kun 'dus/ ma rgyud slong gsal 'bar ba/gnyis med rgyud bu chung rnams deng sang yongs grags kyi pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi dbye ba lta bu min pa'i rtsa ba —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shergyud kyi mtshan la brten nas so sor bzhag cing / de gnyis so sor dbye ba med pas gnyis med du btags pa las don du gsum ga gnyis med kyi rgyud du dgongs pa (360ba)kun 'dus kyi lo rgyus rim pa bdun par/ tshig dang le'u rnams rgyud tshig tu yod pa dbang dang 'khrid rnams snying tig tu yod pa don thams cad man ngag tu yod pa pha rgyud ma rgyud med pa zhes pa'i tshig gi bstan no/ /de yang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chen mo las de 'dra'i dus ngan byung ba dang : padma nga yi smon lam mthus lha lcam khyod kyi skye ba ni lcags khams rta sprul lo pa gcig bum thang mthil du 'khrung bar 'gyur ban bon sngags pa'i rigs 'chang ba padma'i ming can shes rab can ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs byed tshig rtsub rta skad chol le smra nga yi thugs gter mnga' byed cing : zab chos rdzogs chen bdag por 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan dus babs nas gter ston padma gling pas bsam yas 'chims phu'i mchod rten nas gdan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po kun bzang dgongs 'dus kyi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas khrus lung dbang gi 'phreng ba le'u nyi shu tham pa'i steng nas mgon gyi dbang la 'jug pa/ gsol bdag dam tshig /bro/ khrus lung rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i rta mgrin gyi bum pa gtor ma'i dbang / so shing / dpung skud/ ku sha dang bcas pa/ rdzogs par rang byung dbang 'phreng las rim so gsum pa'i steng nas theg dgu'i dbang la gsol gdab/ sgrib sbyong/ rig pa ngar skyed/dam tshig rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i tshogs bsag /dbu rgyan/ bum pa/ cod pan phreng ba/ go cha/ rgyal mtshan/ gdugs/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ bza' btung / phur ba/ tshe dbang / chos spyi'i lung dab nga rnams kyis dbang gi sgo phye nas/ nyan rang / byang sems/ kri u/ yo ga /ma hā/ a nu/ a ti'i dbang dang bcas pa/ dbang chog dpag bsam ljong shing (361na tha'u brgyad pa'i steng nas zhi khro'i dbang la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ dam tshig /byin dbab/ gsang mtshan sngon du 'gro ba'i bum dbang /zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha dbang / bum pa dang khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi lha dbang / bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang / rjes ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ dbang chog rdo rje'i them skad le'u bcu bzhi —524

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganapa'i steng nas khro bo'i dbang la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ spyan dbye/ lha ngo sprad pa/ byin 'bebs/gsol gdab maṇḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i gri/ mda'/ phur pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad mar me/ gtor ma/phur pa/ thod pa/ tshil can/ me long / rma bya/ rgyal srid bdun/ lha dbang / bum dbang / dam rdzas/ rjes ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho le'u bdun pa'i steng nas spros bcas bum pa'i dbang la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ mda'/ gri/ me long / rma bya/ gtor ma rnams kyi dbang bskur/ rjes ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ gsang dbang rin chen 'khor lo le'u drug pa'i steng nas spros med gsang ba'i dbang la/ rig ma dbul ba/ lha sgom gsol gdab sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang po'i phyag rgya dang mkha' 'gro'i brda rtags bum pa/ gsang pa byang sems/ dbang zhabs gnyisamed bskur ba/ rjes kyi ngo sprod dang bcas pa sher dbang le'u bdun pa'i steng nas spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ zhu ba zhu lan/ dam tshig /lha sgom byin 'bebs/ lung gis bkrol ba/ phyag rgya sprad pa rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i skyon yab yum gyi sku 'bag /thod pa/ gtor ma/ rta phag /dam rdzas kyi dbang rjes ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ tshig dbang rin chen 'phreng ba le'u bzhi pa'i steng nas rab tu spros med tshig dbang la/ lung gis bkrol ba/ sdom pa gzung (361ba)ba / maṇḍal/ byin dbab sngon du 'gro ba'i/ sku/ thig le/ tshom bu'i zhing khams/ 'dod yon lnga la brten nas tshig dbang lung gis bkrol ba rnams/ rtsal dbang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi steng nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang la/ maṇḍal/gsol gdab/ dam tshig /byin 'bebs sngon du 'gro ba'i ka dag rig pa rang thog du ngo sprod pa'i rtsal dbang / btags grol gyi dbang rnams legs par mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ 'gor gdod nasarang byung gi sangs rgyas zhes yod pa'i kha byang gsang ba'i shel 'phreng snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ kha byang gi bzhugs tshul dang so so'i sde tshan bsgrig dka' zhing de dang mi mthun par bkod na/ma 'ongs dus su chos 'di 'chal dogs nas padma nga yis kha byang yi ger btab: ces gsung pasa'achal par spyad pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas sa bcad du ma phye zhing chos sde rnams kyi chos tshan so so'i —523—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (shebarjod don nang gses su dbye 'dug pas kha byang gi khungs drangs tshe mang skyon dang bskyar ldab lta bu nas lung khungs kyi spros pa bzhag ste bkod pa la/chos bdag dang gter 'don tshul bstan pa lung bstan mu tig 'phreng ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/glong ོ pa'i ga kho ma/1brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chen mo zhes pa dgongs brgyud/brda brgyud/snyan brgyud/gtad rgya/smon lam/bka' babs/grub thob rnal 'byor brgyud pa rnams bstan pa'i lo rgyus rim pa bdun pa padma 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/2'gor bcos slad dang bral ba zhes yod pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chung ba ka gdan dbus ma'i 'og tu sbas so'i mtha' can/slong 'a ༅ga kho ma/3zhug pa/nyams su len pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i lha lcam padma gsal gyis zhus lan 362na tshe5tpala'i 'phreng ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/4sku gsum sku lnga'i bdag nyid rig pa rang byung gi sangs rgyas ngo bo rang bzhin thugasarje gsum ldan rang la tshang tshul ston pa kun tu bzang po dgongs pa'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/5lta sgom spyod 'bras smin grol ma bu cha lag tshang bar ston pa snying po 'dus pa don gyi rgyud le'u ༄ slong ོ pa'i ga kho ma/gsum pa rdzogs chen rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu bsdus pa'i yang zab khol du phyung ba gdams pa 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba lta bu/6gzhi'i gnas tshul gtan la phab nas sku dang ye shes kyi bzhugs tshul rgyas par bshad pa skye med slong grol zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/7'brul gzhi gtan la phab nasalhun grub thugs rje rig ma rig snod bcud chags tshul 'pho 'gyur rnams gsal ba ston pa nyi zla rgya mtsho'i rgyud le'u drug pa padma nga yis bkod pa rdzogos so'i mtha' can/'a gi ༷ dzin wa 'khos da sha su ge rig/de'i rgyab skyor du lus sems gas tshi sogs 'khor ba'i mas nyid dang rig pa lhun grub rṣa por grol tshul ston pa rig pa slong grol gyi rgyud le'u lnga pa padma 'byung gnas kyis rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa ba lhas nas bkod pa/9spyi 7sa sdom byang dbang 'grel dam rdzo ston pa khyung ོ gshog rdzogs rgyud 'grel le'u bzhi pa/skad shan sbyar kyi bod skad du sa zer ba la mi bon kyang ma rdzun tu rgyud 'cha zer bsnang /10dus tshes gnas ma nyid snod baX sa cho go sogs las rim ༅ dgu ston pa sta

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ (gnagon gyi dbang chog khrus lung dbang gyi 'phreng ba rim pa nyi shu pa zhes pa bar chad sel zhing dbang dngos gzhi'i snod rung du bya thabs/ 11 spros bcas kyi sngon 'gro theg pa rim dgu'i dbang chog rdzogs pa rang byung zhes pa sta gon gyi dbang bcu bzhi theg dgu'i (362ba)dbang bco brgyad de bsgril ba las rim sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ 12 mchog dman bar gsum gyi dbang po dang bstun nas 'khrid pa'i man ngag theg pa rim dgu'i spyi 'khrid chen mo gser gyi them skas skad shan sbyar gyi bod skad du de zug tshog pa sa po mi' nge lon yong su gad ba theg na gu'i sud 'a tshe pa 2ga/le'u bcu gsum pa/ 13 khro bo'i dbang chog rdo rje'i them skas bskur thabs bzhi bcu rtsa drug le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 14 skad shan sbyar gyi bod skad du kun tu bzang po sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa'i rgyud ces bya ba gsang sngags kyi babs gzhung ston pa dbang thams cad kyi spyi chings phun sum 'di kha byang sga migs la/tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa dbang lung rgya mtsho/ 15 zhi khro gsang 'dus sam yang gsang bla med kyi las byang padma'i 'phreng ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes su so sor las rim brgyad kyi bstan pa dga' rab rdo rjes gu ru padma la gtad pa/ 16 zhi khro rtsa ba'i dbang chog dpag bsam ljon shing le'u brgyad pa zhi ba'i dbang sum cu rtsa gsum khro bo'i dbang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi kha skong rdzas dbang rnams bsdoms pas dgu bcu go lnga cho ga'i go rim sum cu rtsa drug la brten nas dbang bzhi dus gcig la rdzogs thabs mjug na de ltar zhi khro'i dbang chog 'di zhes sogs kyi dkar chag yod pa/ 17 de'i gsang 'khrid rdo rje sems dpa' rig pa mchog gi le'u lnga pa/ 1 smin byed spros bcas bum dbang smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho yo byad maṇḍal thig tshon lha 'god 'jug pa dbang bskur ngo sprod ston pa le'u bdun pa ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi yon tan gsal bar byed pa/ 19 de'i don 'khrid rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu'i bcud snying po gsal ba'i sgron mer bsdus pa le'u dang las rim bdun gyis sbyor dngos (363nasgo jug gsum tshang ba bstan pa/ 20de'i bu yig nyams len gnad kyi me long zab pa'i nyams 'khrid ston par byed pa skyes bu de dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'di gnyi4glong mu pa'i ga kho ma/ 21 spros med gsang ba'i dbang chog gsang ba rin —527—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (rsāpo che dbang gi 'khor lo rdzas rig ma mna' chu sgom bzlas dbang rjes dang bcas ston pa le'u drug pa/22 de'i bu yig mkha' 'gro brtag 'bum phyag rgya brtsal dgug bsten thabs skyon spang las rim bzhi pa/ 23 shin tu spros med gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur le'u bdun pa padma 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba las can snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 24 de'i bu yig gsang 'grel 'khor ba dong sprugs chags lam bsten pa'i las rim le'u bcu bzhi pa zhar byung phyag rgya 'gugs byed kyi dkar chag dang bcas pa/ 25 rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che'i 'phreng ba le'u bzhi pa lasacan la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 26 de'i rgyab skyor nyi ma'i snying po khregs cho de kyi thems byang na min dbang dang bu yig bsdoms pa le'u bzhir bshad pa dpe rgyun gsan yig rnams dang ma 'grigs pa dpyad/ gdams pa spyo1na padmas sbyar ba rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 27 kun tu spros med ka dag rig pa'i rtsal dbang 'khor 'das dbyer med khregs chod kyi rtsa ba padmas bkod pa brdar sha bcas pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/28 de'i 'grel pa yang gsang bla med don gyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba'am khregs cho de don gyi snying po nyon mongs 'bur 'joms kyi gdams pa yang dag pa chen po 'o'i mtha' can/ 29 de'i yang 'grel tshun padmas khregs chod thod rgal gyi gdams pa bkod pa rig pa klong yangs phrad shog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 30 kha byang du/ de gsum (363ba)bsgril bas khregs chod 'khrid bka' tshang zhes so/ /dbang bzhi tshig rdzogs su bskur ba'i cho ga dbang chog nor bu'i sgron ma le'u brgyad pa slob dpon slong 'a pa'i ga kho ma kha byang na migs la/ padmas sbyar ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 31 'di dbang gong ma rnams la bskur ba'i bsdus pa'i skabs mdzad pa yin pas dbang yongs rdzogs kyi skabs 'di mi bskur yang gong ma thob phyin gzhan la bskur rung ba yin no/ /sgron bzhi'i dbye gsal me long gi gdams pa dus gnas mtha' rten lus lam dbye tshul gyi las rim le'u drug pa snang bzhi sgron drug rgyas par bshad pa/ 32 snang bzhi gtan la 'bebs pa zab tig dgongs pa rang grol zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ 'di gnya4grong ོ pa' ga kho ma/ 33 de'i bu yig snang bzhi 'char byed nyi ma'i 'od zer —528

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganale'u bzhi pa'i kha gsal ma byung rung don gyis tshang ba la dgos sam snyam/ le'u bzhi pa snang nyams shes nyams kyi dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa/ 34 kha byang las/ de yis snang bzhi chos bka' tshang ba'o: zhes so/ /thob gsum gdengs brgyad kyi gdams pa skye med don sbyor mthar thug 'bras bu glong wo pa'i ga kho ma/ thob tshul rgyasapar bshad pa dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs su brgyud nas o rgyan padma la gnang ba/ 35 de'i bu yig sku gsum dbyer med 'khor ba dong sprugs zhes bya ba yang dag rdzogs 'tshang rgya tshul dga' rab rdo rje'i nyams brgyud o rgyan padmas yi ger bkod pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 36 de'i yang bu yig 'gor mngon par rdzogs pa'i rtags tshad ni zhes yod pa'i 'tshang rgya tshul sku gnyis gtan 'bebs longs sprul gyi dbye ba sku gsum 'char ba'i rtags tshad padmas phyi rabs don du bkod pa/ 37 kha byang du/tshang bzung 'brel ba'i chos rnams (364na 'di la tshang : zhes so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa tshig nyung ngur bsdus pa yang gsang rdo rje'i rgyud bu chung ngam rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa'i rgyud ces pa le'u gnyis pa yang gsang rgyud bu chung rdzogs byang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 38 de'i bu yig bar do bzhi sbyor gyi gdams pa ye shes gsang lam rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa le'u brgyad pa o rgyan padmas sbyar ba'i mtha' can/ kha byang las/ de yi bar do'i 'khrid bka' tshang ba'o: zhes so/ /36 ngo sprod rin cen dra ba 'od kyi zhing khams thams cad bstan pa'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa mjug tu ngo sprod bdun dang bcas pa ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag dpe don rtags gsum tshang ba o rgyan padmas sbyar ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ 40 de'i bu yig rdo rje sems dpa' thugasakyi me long snying po yang zab khol du phyung nas lag len mu tig 'phreng bar bsgril pa le'u drug pa zhar byung sku gsum ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ 41 kha byang du/ ma bu gnyis la ngo sprod 'khrid bka' tshang : zhesaso/ /mun 'khrid gsal ba'i sgron me nyin mo 'od gsal dang mtshan mo ar la gtad pa a ti'i mthar thug gcig dril lha lcam skye mthas spyod pas shog gi mtha' can/ 42 de'i bu yig dbang po yang rab grol bar byed pa'i thabs ar gtad lag 'khrid nyi ma'i snying po le'u bcu gsum pa nyin mtshan chos —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyi 'da' ba'i rim pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/43chu'i sgra la don gnyis kyi sgo nas bsgom tshul shog gcig ma glong gsal gsum gyi dgongs bcud snying thig kun gyi rtsa ba mthar thug/'di la kha byang du mig4/44kha byang du/de gnyis bsgril bas mun 364ba〉khrid tshang :zhes so//le lo can ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa zhan byung gsang 'grel bzlog dka' dang bcas pa/45de'i bu yig btags grol gnad kyi gdams pa bcang thabs yid bzhin nor bu le'u bdun pa/46kha byang las/de yis btags grol lag len 'khrid skor tshang :zhes so//dus min rkyen ga bzlog pa 'chi ba brtag bslu nyi zla'i ga'u las rim brgyad pa/47de'i bu yig dus min bar chad byung na 'pho ba'i gdams glong byu pa'i ga kho ma/pa rdo rje'i lcags kyu las rim lnga pa zhan byung gzhan don 'pho ba'i rim pa dang bcas pa/48de'i rgyab yig gang zag yid ches bskyed phyir rab zag bcas phung po mi snang ba 'bring bar do dang mtha' ma chos nyid bar dor grol ba'i 'bras bu thob tshul bstan pa/49kha byang du/de yis 'pho ba gos bu'i thob tshul tshang :zhes so//gdams pa'i che ba 'byin pa gsang ba ring bsrel sgrub thabs sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/50dus min 'chi rkyen sel ba'i 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa gsang 'dus rin po che/51nad kyi bar gcod bzlog pa ri khrod lo ma smo ma'i sgrub thabs sto mongs nad 'joms/52rlung mkhris ban gan tsha grang 'don dus kun 'joms gegs sel sman gyi man ngag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/53lus kyi dar gud snyoms byed rlung 'khrid gsang ba'i lde mig rtsa tshig nyer gsum pa/54zhan byung rtsa rlung gi rnam gzhag srod la gtum mo bsgom pa nam phyed shes bya bum par mjug pa tho rengs rig pa rang sar gzhag pa sogs nyin mtshan chos kyis zla ba/bde ba lam du 'byer ba gtum mo'i 365na gisang 'khrid bde chen lam rdzogs/55sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i bgegs g.yeng ba spang phyir de'i zhen pa gcod la bdud rtsi mtshan gyi bcud len rgyu dus sbyor ba za thabs bzhis bstan pa zhar byung sbos khrag glo nad sel ba/mig nad sel ༷ gzhen sha rgyas pa/lo brgya thub pa/dug rigs

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa/ rtoganakyis mi tshugs pa/ mdze sel ba/ nad rims kyis mi tshugs pa/ mkha' 'gro 'du zhing lus yang stobs bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa rnams ston pa/ 56 gter bdag rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs bla rdo rten rdzas bcang thabs gsol tshig steng phyogs dag 'phrul ma dang bcas pa/ pe har gyi gsol kha dgung sngon mthon po ma/ btsan gso bod yul dbus rgyal ma/ klu gsol ne'u sing sngo mtha' ma ste gter bdag po btsan klu gsum gyi gsol kha bskul dang bcas pa padma thod 'phrong gis sbyar ba rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ 58 kha byang las/ gter bdag mchod dang dpe tshan bdun de yis 'khrid kyi rgyab skyor tshang zhes so/ kha byang las/ spyi ru bsgril pas chos tshan ni lnga bcu rtsa gcig grangs su yod ces pa byung yang kha byang dang ngo 'phrod pa lnga bcu rtsa lnga byung ba yig skyon yin nam brtag /kha byang las/ e ka dza ṭi gza' dang rdor legs dang : ro sreg skor gsum lung byang ma tshang ngo :shog dril lnga po zho stod brag la yod de rnams ba 'a nas chos 'di sgo ba'o: zhes pa'i shog dril lnga mang rong gter ston 'jam dpal rdo rjes bton pa'i rgyun 'dug kyang brgyud pa gong ra ba nyi zla grags pa 'dug pas ma mnos/ chos kyi kha skong gter 'byung yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes pa nang so rgyal ba don grub kyis bskul (365bskos gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro chos spyod byin rlabs sprin phung snang ba ma bkod ma/ gsang dbang gi gsol 'debs zur du bkol ba snang stong dag pa ma/ o rgyan za hor ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor yid bzhin nor bu gsol 'debs mkha' dbyings rnam dag ma dang bcas pa/ sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol gyis gra dar rgyas gling du mdzad pa'i kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi snying po don 'khrid gsal ba'i sgron me man ngag nyams len snying po bsdus pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig ma rnams/ de yang mu tig 'phreng ba las/ de phyir 'tsho rgyal khyod kyis yi ger thob mchims phu dge'u gong /gdan 'og tu spos rag gdong nag mo e /dza ṭir gto padma gsal khyod skye ba mang brgyud nas
